description:
The opportunity: Senior Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - New Delhi Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves. Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function. To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities. We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens. CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management. It has multiple fields of play such as: Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives. Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs. Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Manager Organization: Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM)
 Location: Jasola, New Delhi
 Department: Marketing & Admissions
 Position: Digital Marketing Manager
 Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
 Experience Required: 4–7 Years (preferably in Education / EdTech / Lead Generation) About AIM Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM) is a leading management education institution in New Delhi with a legacy of nearly three decades. The institute offers industry-oriented management programs, including PGDM, MBA in Healthcare Management, and undergraduate programs. We are looking for a highly analytical, technically proficient, and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to oversee our digital marketing operations, manage external agencies, and ensure measurable growth in student applications and admissions. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Agency Management Act as the primary point of contact for all digital marketing and performance marketing agencies. Oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms. Monitor campaign budgets, lead generation, lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per application (CPA), and overall return on marketing investment. Independently review campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, keyword performance, and conversion tracking. Conduct regular performance reviews with agencies and ensure timely execution of agreed deliverables. Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend corrective actions. Ensure that agencies continuously optimize campaigns rather than simply manage advertising budgets. 2. Digital Marketing Tools & Technical Expertise The candidate should possess strong working knowledge of: Paid Advertising Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Remarketing) Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram) LinkedIn Ads and other relevant advertising platforms Analytics & Tracking Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag Manager (GTM) Google Search Console Looker Studio Meta Pixel and Conversions API UTM tracking, conversion events, attribution, and remarketing audiences SEO & Website Optimization On-page, off-page, and technical SEO fundamentals Keyword research using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Keyword Planner Landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) Website performance monitoring and user journey analysis CRM & Marketing Automation LeadSquared or similar CRM platforms Lead source attribution and campaign-to-CRM integration WhatsApp, email, and SMS marketing automation Lead nurturing workflows and remarketing campaigns 3. Lead Generation & Admissions Funnel Management Take ownership of digital lead generation performance across AIM's academic programs. Track the complete admissions funnel: Impressions Clicks Leads Qualified Leads Applications Admissions. Work closely with the admissions team to evaluate lead quality and conversion performance. Identify lead leakage, attribution errors, duplicate leads, and ineffective lead sources. Ensure accurate lead capture, campaign tagging, and CRM integration. Recommend strategies to improve lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Monitor program-wise performance and allocate marketing resources accordingly. 4. Reporting, Analytics & Budget Monitoring Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports. Develop dashboards to monitor campaign performance, expenditure, and admissions conversions. Track and analyze key metrics, including:
 Cost per Lead (CPL) Cost per Qualified Lead (CPQL) Cost per Application (CPA) Cost per Admission / Acquisition (CAC) Click-Through Rate (CTR) Conversion Rate (CVR) Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where measurable Verify agency-reported data against advertising platforms, analytics tools, and CRM records. Monitor budget utilization and ensure campaigns remain within approved spending limits. Present actionable recommendations to management based on performance data. 5. SEO, Content & Digital Brand Visibility Oversee SEO agencies and ensure improvements in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings. Coordinate with content and creative teams to ensure campaign messaging aligns with AIM's positioning. Review advertising copies, creatives, landing pages, and promotional content for accuracy and effectiveness. Monitor website traffic, organic leads, and search performance. Ensure consistent messaging across all digital channels. 6. Campaign Planning & Execution Work with management and agencies to develop program-wise digital marketing strategies. Coordinate campaign launches for admissions cycles, webinars, events, and institutional initiatives. Ensure timely delivery of creatives, landing pages, campaign assets, and tracking integrations. Research competitors, market trends, student search behavior, and emerging digital marketing opportunities. Support new initiatives involving marketing automation, AI-driven campaign optimization, and digital outreach. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 4–7 years of relevant digital marketing experience, preferably involving performance marketing and lead generation. Strong hands-on understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM, and digital analytics. Demonstrated experience managing or supervising significant advertising budgets. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and marketing dashboards. Experience working with marketing agencies and independently evaluating their performance. Understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lead management processes. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in higher education, business schools, education marketing, or EdTech. Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications. Experience with LeadSquared CRM. Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools, automation, and advanced reporting. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Quality and volume of leads generated across academic programs. Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Optimization of CPL, CPA, and cost per admission. Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and CRM attribution. Agency accountability, execution quality, and timely delivery of campaigns. Improvement in organic search visibility and website conversion rates. Effective utilization of digital marketing budgets. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing beyond dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate should be capable of logging into Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager, independently understanding campaign performance, identifying problems, questioning agency strategies, and recommending improvements. This is not merely an agency coordination role. The candidate must have strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate digital marketing expenditure into measurable student applications and admissions. The role requires someone who can take ownership, work independently, and ensure AIM's digital marketing agencies deliver results aligned with the institute's admissions objectives.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
TransUnions Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview We are seeking a Technical Product Manager who owns technical delivery and application solution outcomes for a major product area or
program workstream. This role partners closely with internal business resources and technical teams to analyze requirements and drive the
end-to-end design, development or development oversight, testing, implementation, delivery, and documentation of data processing solutions.
 
In this role, you will help sequence the roadmap for the next 2-3 Program Increments (PIs), ensure delivery commitments are feasible and well documented, and coordinate across scrum teams to support successful solution design, build, release, adoption, and ongoing improvement. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
 Role Overview And Core Responsibilities Agile & Scrum Leadership Lead delivery of strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data products, Blended Score capabilities, score deployment efforts, data provider integrations, compliance enhancements, platform modernization, and customer onboarding requirements. Own technical delivery and application solution execution for a major product area or program workstream; lead delivery across multiple scrum teams so requirements, solution designs, development work, testing, documentation, implementation, and release activities are sequenced, staffed, and ready for iterative delivery. Convert business strategy and stakeholder requirements into clear priorities, a sequenced roadmap, and actionable epics and stories; secure alignment across business, architecture, engineering, compliance, and delivery teams before commitment and maintain traceability from outcomes to requirements, user stories, releases, and supporting documentation. Manage cross-functional dependencies across product, engineering, analytics, operations, architecture, and support teams so plans are feasible and credible; surface risks early, coordinate mitigations across teams, and remove impediments before they become urgent. Escalate the right issues with clear options and trade-offs and drive timely decisions; facilitate prioritization and sequencing based on impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness. Cross Functional Program Leadership Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Product Management, Compliance, and Engineering teams to support the development, implementation, monitoring, and evolution of Alternative and Blended Score products. Coordinate dependencies related to data acquisition, model deployment, score production, validation, operational readiness, and customer adoption. Drive roadmap planning and execution for the FactorTrust platform and Alternative Credit ecosystem, balancing technical debt reduction, regulatory requirements, infrastructure modernization, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives. Partner with internal business resources and technical teams in a matrixed environment-including solutions/product, engineering, architecture, UX, data science/analytics, compliance, legal, product marketing, operations, and support-to analyze requirements, align on outcomes, and coordinate delivery commitments. Define and maintain a roadmap for the next 2-3 PIs for your product area/workstream; influence yearly planning and coordinate cross-team sequencing and dependencies. Run KPI-driven reviews and adjust the plan to maximize measurable outcomes; use delivery, quality, performance, and operational signals to surface improvement opportunities and drive changes that increase customer value, improve flow, and strengthen solution resiliency. Product Development Lifecycle Ownership Guide the full product and technical delivery lifecycle-from discovery through launch and iteration-ensuring readiness at each stage, including requirements analysis, solution definition, application design, development oversight, testing, delivery, release, adoption, and documentation. Translate customer, business, and stakeholder needs into actionable outcomes and deliverables for multiple teams, accounting for system boundaries, architecture constraints, dependencies, performance considerations, data movement,integrations, and operating model impacts. Own and communicate a sequenced roadmap and backlog; continually re-plan based on KPI performance, impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness while tracking medium-term risks and opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, requirements analysis, and technical solution discussions for foundational and high-visibility initiatives; evaluate options and trade-offs, align on approach, and drive end-to-end execution across teams and partner teams. Lead requirements definition and technical execution for credit risk products that leverage alternative data, including consumer reporting solutions, score development initiatives, prescreening capabilities, identity and fraud inputs, decisioning integrations, and customer-facing product enhancements. Ensure product designs and implementations support regulatory, operational, and customer requirements, including FCRA compliance, model governance standards, audit readiness, data quality controls, and appropriate use of consumer data 
 Required Knowledge And Experiences Technical Expectations A Technical Product Manager owns technical delivery outcomes and understands architecture patterns, application design considerations, data processing concepts, integration points, platform constraints, and application lifecycle practices. This role works directly with engineering to shape, oversee, and deliver sound technical solutions for high-volume, data-driven product platforms. Drive application solution ownership for high-volume, data-driven systems and credit risk platforms, including Alternative Data products, FactorTrust capabilities, Blended Scores, and supporting decisioning services by shaping the application design, development approach, testing strategy, implementation plan, operational readiness, and delivery documentation with engineering teams. Design or oversee the design and development of data processing solutions, including solution decomposition, application framework considerations, data movement, system integrations, performance, resiliency, debugging, and environment readiness. Provide technical direction for Ab Initio-based or similar data processing solutions, including Continuous Flows, application frameworks, performance tuning, debugging, metadata usage, and reusable patterns that can be leveraged by other applications or processes. Create and maintain clear documentation that communicates requirements, technical context, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders. Identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, services, and system integrations that enable end-user productivity, delivery efficiency, and consistent product execution. Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to translate model requirements into scalable production solutions, including score generation workflows, feature engineering requirements, model deployment processes, monitoring frameworks, and performance measurement capabilities. Understand credit bureau, alternative data, and blended scoring ecosystems, including data sourcing, consumer reporting requirements, score implementation considerations, model performance monitoring, and client integration patterns. Leadership Expectations Leads through influence across teams and partner organizations, secures alignment on direction and trade-offs, and operates with sustained independence while driving delivery, measurable outcomes, quality documentation, and continuous improvement. Influence strategic direction for Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives by aligning business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, data science priorities, and technology investments into a cohesive delivery roadmap. 
Qualifications Typically 8+ years of experience in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, data processing solution delivery, or related product-focused technical roles, including ownership of a product area or program workstream and leadership across multiple delivery teams. Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery environments and driving iterative delivery from requirements through development, testing, release, and post-launch adoption. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate and document technical concepts, requirements, risks, decisions, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders. Demonstrated ability to partner with technical teams on application design, data processing solution development, implementation planning, performance considerations, debugging, operational readiness, and process improvement initiatives. Experience with data-driven platforms, application ecosystems, cloud services, integration patterns, or related technical environments. Experience delivering data-intensive financial products, credit risk solutions, consumer reporting systems, scorecards, predictive models, or alternative data products. title: Deputy General Manager - Network, AI  & Strategic Collaborations
description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Deputy General Manager who will own a portfolio of strategic technology programmes at Tata Communications, ranging across network products, AI solutions, security and trust, and emerging federated network architectures. The role is equally about deep solutioning and broad collaboration : the successful candidate will architect end-to-end solutions for senior internal stakeholders and enterprise customers, drive multiple high-impact strategic partnerships in parallel (OEMs, hyperscalers, academia, standards bodies, customer co-innovation), and translate Tata Communications' technology strategy into measurable commercial outcomes. The successful candidate will be equally credible in a customer CTO conversation, an OEM negotiation, an engineering design review, and a board-level update. Key Responsibilities Solutioning and Solution Architecture. Architect and orchestrate end-to-end solutions for enterprise and carrier customers across the full Tata Communications portfolio connectivity, security, AI infrastructure, data platforms, and emerging federated architectures. Lead deep technical discussions with senior management, customer CXOs, and Tata Communications' executive committee. Translate complex requirements into deployable architectures with clear commercial and operational implications. Strategic Collaborations and Partnership Portfolio. Own and drive a portfolio of high-impact strategic collaborations across multiple counterpart types: OEMs and technology vendors evaluation, onboarding, joint roadmaps, joint go-to-market. Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — joint solutions and integrated offerings. Academic institutions — research collaborations with the IITs, IISc, and international universities on emerging technology (quantum, post-quantum, AI, networking). Standards bodies and industry consortia — ITU-T, ETSI, IETF, TM Forum, GSMA, and equivalent. Customer co-innovation programmes — joint design and pilot engagements with strategic enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will manage several of these collaborations concurrently, set the strategy for each, negotiate technical and commercial terms, and drive them through to measurable outcomes. Productization of AI Workloads. Oversee the productization of AI workloads — model serving, agentic systems, AI-augmented network and security operations, and customer-facing AI features — on Tata Communications infrastructure. Define product requirements, drive engineering execution, manage release governance, and own commercial readiness, including performance, observability, cost, and responsible-AI compliance. Productization of Federated, Intent-Driven Network Programmes. Lead the productization of one or more flagship network programmes that couple multi-domain connectivity, security and identity, federated governance, and intent-driven orchestration across the underlay and overlay. Current programmes include Quantum-Safe Networking, intent-based and policy-driven network automation, SASE evolution, and federated network and data architectures across enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will be expected to own one of these as the primary workstream while contributing to the others as their portfolio matures. Solutioning Excellence with OEMs and Partners. Convert OEM and partner capabilities into deployable Tata Communications solutions: identify integration points, design joint solution stacks, lead proof-of-concepts, and drive the implementation lifecycle with partner and internal engineering teams. Ensure that partner relationships translate into customer-facing value rather than abstract MOUs. Internal Cross-Functional Leadership. Build durable cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Procurement, and Customer Success. Operate as a credible bridge between technical and commercial functions and as a senior-management-facing voice for the product portfolio. Strategy Execution and Results Ownership. Translate organisational strategy into measurable outcomes. Maintain quantitative dashboards on adoption, deployment, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, partner health, and programme execution. Drive quarterly business reviews and proactively unblock cross-functional dependencies. Operate with a clear "outcomes over activity" discipline. Talent and Technical Leadership. Mentor solution architects, product managers, and engineering leads in your matrix. Set the bar for technical depth, customer empathy, partnership stewardship, and executive communication. Champion a culture of solutioning excellence and strategic clarity. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering discipline from a recognised institution. A management qualification (MBA, PGDM, or equivalent) is strongly preferred — the role explicitly requires a mix of computer-science depth and management acumen. Experience: 12–16 years of progressive experience in enterprise network products, telecom infrastructure, AI/ML productization, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity, with at least 4 years at a senior individual-contributor or leadership level driving cross-functional and cross-organisational initiatives. Technical depth in at least three of the following: Networking and connectivity — SD-WAN, SASE, SR-MPLS / SRv6, intent-based and policy-driven network automation (e.g., RFC 9315 IBN, TMF921), streaming telemetry (gNMI / OpenConfig), programmable data planes. Security, identity and trust — Zero Trust, identity and access management, federated identity (e.g., W3C DID and Verifiable Credentials), post-quantum cryptography, key and secret management. AI/ML productization — model deployment, MLOps, agentic systems, observability, responsible AI. Federated and decentralised data architectures — domain-oriented decentralised data ownership, federated data and policy governance, data-as-a-product thinking, policy-as-code. Cloud and hyperscaler architectures — AWS, Azure, GCP; multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud connectivity; service mesh and microservice patterns. Demonstrated track record of: Taking products from concept through commercial deployment at meaningful scale. Driving multiple strategic collaborations in parallel — OEMs, hyperscalers, academia, or standards bodies. Engaging at CXO level both internally and with enterprise customers. Operating in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder environment. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to federated data and policy architectures, decentralised data ownership models, or domain-oriented data platforms. Familiarity with intent-based networking standards (RFC 9315, TMF921), service-mesh patterns applied to network functions, or programmable data planes (P4 / eBPF). Familiarity with Quantum-Safe Networking, post-quantum cryptography, or QKD. Hyperscaler partnership experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) at the product-engineering level. Established relationships with global networking, security, or AI OEMs. Active participation in standards bodies or industry consortia. Academic-industry collaboration experience (joint research programmes, sponsored research, joint publications). Industry recognition through patents, peer-reviewed publications, standards contributions, or conference talks. MBA from a Tier-1 institution (IIM-A/B/C/L/I, ISB, INSEAD, Wharton, Booth, or equivalent). Prior experience in a Tier-1 telecom operator, cloud hyperscaler, networking OEM, or AI infrastructure company. Behavioural Competencies Self-motivated — operates with high agency across multiple parallel workstreams; does not require oversight to make progress. Strategy-driven — translates ambiguity into clear, executable plans across diverse programmes. Results-oriented — committed to measurable outcomes over activity. Executive communication — credible and concise with senior leadership, OEM executives, customer CXOs, and academic principals. Partnership stewardship — builds and sustains long-term collaborative relationships with external counterparts. Stakeholder management — earns trust across engineering, product, sales, partners, customers, and standards / academic communities. Intellectual curiosity — actively tracks emerging technology (AI, post-quantum, 6G, federated architectures, agentic systems) and brings external insight back into the organisation. Comfort with ambiguity — thrives at the intersection of new technology, evolving markets, and multi-counterparty dependencies.

Job Title: Product Owner(Shipping Operations)
Position: Senior Business Analyst
Experience: 8 to 12 Yrs
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: 10: to 6 PM (3 Days Mandatory Work from Office)
Main location:Chennai
Position ID: J0626-2024
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.

Position Description: We are seeking an experienced Product Owner with strong functional expertise in shipping operations, specifically in the Vessel Scheduling / Voyage Scheduling / Network Planning modules of shipping applications. This role will play a critical part in defining requirements, guiding development teams, and ensuring successful delivery of features that enhance schedule planning, vessel operations, and downstream operational workflows.
The Product Owner will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and IT delivery teams to translate operational scheduling needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between scheduling planners and technology teams, driving end-to-end delivery of a robust and efficient scheduling product. 

 Your future duties and responsibilities: 
 Key Responsibilities:

Acting as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Scheduling module including vessel voyage planning, port rotation, transit times, and service schedules.
Collaborating with business stakeholders in Network Planning, Marine Operations, Operations Control, and Booking teams to gather, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements.
Owning and managing the product backlog, including writing highly detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
Driving sprint ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, user story walkthroughs, and sprint review sessions.
Partnering with architects and technical teams to ensure correct interpretation of scheduling logic, operational rules, and integration touchpoints.
Supporting solution design, reviewing wireframes, validating mock-ups, and ensuring alignment with business workflows.
Performing functional validation of the scheduling module during development and supporting UAT cycles.
Analyzing gaps and identifying opportunities to optimize scheduling workflows, improve schedule reliability, and automate manual steps.
Ensuring smooth integration of scheduling functionality with dependent modules such as Booking, Allocation, Equipment Management, Marine Ops, and Operations Control.
Staying up to date with scheduling best practices, shipping industry trends, and operational constraints to continuously enhance the product.
Acting as the key advisor for requirement clarification, business process mapping, and stakeholder communication for all scheduling-related features. 

 Required qualifications to be successful in this role: 
 Must-Have Skills:
Professional experience in Shipping, Maritime, or Logistics with a strong understanding of container operations.
Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Functional Consultant in shipping products.
Experience working in agile delivery environments and participating in all SCRUM ceremonies.
Ability to work closely with business users to translate complex scheduling workflows into clear IT requirements.
Strong documentation skills including process flows, functional requirement documents, and feature definitions.
Willingness to work in client-aligned shifts (including German Shift if required).
Involvement in product development/enhancement including:
oRequirements analysis
oDocumentation
oValidation & UAT support

title: Embedded Software Engineer Specialist
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our team developing embedded software for railway train control and onboard equipment. This is an early-career engineering role for someone with strong software fundamentals who is keen to develop expertise in embedded systems and the railway domain. You will contribute to software design, development, testing, debugging, and documentation while working with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams. Responsibilities 
 Develop, modify, test, and debug embedded software in C/C++ based on defined requirements. Contribute to software design, unit testing, integration, and verification activities. Analyze and resolve routine software problems using established engineering practices. Participate in requirement, design, code, and test reviews. Identify technical issues and risks and communicate them clearly to the team. Create and maintain software engineering documentation and traceability. Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and validation teams. Follow established software development, coding, configuration-management, and quality processes. Support investigation and resolution of software defects within the assigned scope. Continuously build knowledge of embedded systems, product architecture, and railway applications. 

 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. 1-3 years of software development experience in embedded systems. Good programming fundamentals in C and/or C++. Understanding of embedded software concepts, including memory, interrupts, multitasking/concurrency, and hardware/software interfaces. Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix or an RTOS. Familiarity with software development lifecycle, debugging, version control, and unit testing. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively and learn from experienced engineers and subject-matter experts. 

 Good to Have 
 Exposure to QNX, FreeRTOS, or another RTOS. Knowledge of communication interfaces/protocols such as Ethernet/TCP-IP, CAN, UART, SPI, or I2C. Exposure to device drivers or BSP development. Python/Bash or other scripting experience. Familiarity with CI, automated testing, Agile/Scrum, or requirements traceability. Awareness of embedded cybersecurity concepts. Exposure to railway, automotive, industrial, aerospace, or another safety-critical domain. 

 What Success Looks Like 
 Deliver assigned software tasks with appropriate guidance. Apply established engineering practices to solve routine technical problems. Identify and communicate technical issues and risks. Learn the product, technology, and railway domain quickly. Collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines. Take feedback, continuously improve, and gradually handle more complex assignments.

Key Skills: aerospace,debug,electrical engineering,automated testing,cybersecurity,concurrency,digital solutions,embedded software

Job Title: Sales Engineer 
 About the Role 
We are looking for a skilled, motivated, and results-driven Sales Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the technical expert throughout the sales process, bridging the gap between our technical solutions and our clients business needs.
You will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand their challenges, demonstrate product capabilities, and recommend tailored solutions that deliver measurable business value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills.

Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective sales strategies and achieve revenue targets. Translate complex technical features into clear, customer-focused business benefits. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, addressing their technical questions and concerns. Support the sales cycle, including solution design, proposal preparation, and technical discussions. Work closely with product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure customer satisfaction. Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor offerings. Proposal Support: Help write, review, and price the technical portions of sales proposals and bids. The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. A proactive, self-motivated approach with a strong focus on achieving results.

description:
Alkemy EdTech is a DPIIT-recognised edtech startup in Hyderabad, running live, cohort-based programmes in AI for school students, college students and working professionals. 
 We're building our institutional partnership network in Hyderabad and Bengaluru, and we're looking for business developers who already know the people who make these decisions. 
 Strong relationships in schools: principals, correspondents and owners across CBSE, IB and ICSE schools and school chains, especially premium and international schools Strong relationships in colleges: TPOs, placement heads and management at engineering and degree colleges 
 What you'll do Own your territory. Build and manage the institutional pipeline for your city and track, from first contact to signed partnership. Open the right doors. Reach principals, correspondents, academic heads and school chain owners (schools track), or TPOs, placement cells and management (colleges track). Lead the conversation. Present Alkemy's programmes using our approved materials and pricing, and handle questions on curriculum, delivery and outcomes. Bring in the experts. Coordinate demos and walkthroughs with our academic team. Move deals to close. Take qualified institutions through to a signed MoU, with Alkemy signing every agreement. Keep the pipeline visible. Log every contact, meeting and next step in our CRM, and join a weekly pipeline review with the founder. Bring back market insight. Share what institutions are asking for, what competitors are offering, and where we can win. 
 What success looks like A full, qualified pipeline. A steady flow of meetings with real decision-makers, not just front-office contacts. Demos that convert. Institutions you bring to demos move forward to proposals and MoUs. Signed partnerships. Institutions sign MoUs and run Alkemy programmes with their students. Clean records. Every account and conversation is fully tracked in the CRM, so nothing depends on memory. Relationships that renew. Partner institutions come back for the next academic year. 
 Ideally you'll have 2+ years selling to schools or colleges: K-12 publishing, edtech, robotics or coding labs, campus training or placement services An active network of principals, school owners or TPOs in your city Confidence presenting to senior decision-makers Comfort with long sales cycles and disciplined follow-up Strong organisation, with your pipeline always up to date 
 Nice to have Experience selling AI, STEM, coding or skill-development programmes to institutions Existing relationships with school chains or college groups Your own vehicle for local travel

Role Overview The Clinic Head will be the face and owner of the Sugar.fit clinic.This is a highly ownership-driven role that combines sales, patient counselling, clinic operations, doctor relationship management and local marketing.The person will be responsible for ensuring that every lead coming into the clinic is followed up effectively, every patient visiting the clinic receives an excellent experience, and every eligible patient is converted into the right Sugar.fit program after their doctor consultation. The ideal candidate should be *extremely proactive, commercially driven, comfortable with targets and follow-ups, and willing to go beyond a traditional counselling role to build the clinic like their own business. Key Responsibilities 1. Clinic Ownership & Daily Operations * Take complete ownership of the day-to-day functioning of the assigned clinic(s). * Be physically present at the clinic during operating hours and ensure smooth patient movement and experience. * Ensure the clinic is well-maintained, welcoming, professional and aligned with Sugar.fit brand standards. * Coordinate with internal teams to resolve operational issues quickly. * Ensure every patient visiting the clinic is appropriately attended to and followed up. 2. Patient Counselling & Conversion * Interact with patients before and after their doctor consultation. * Understand the patient's health goals, concerns, challenges and motivation. * Explain the relevant Sugar.fit programs and services in a simple, empathetic and compelling manner. * Convert qualified patients into Sugar.fit customers after their consultation. * Handle objections around pricing, commitment, results, treatment approach, etc. * Ensure patients clearly understand the next steps and value of the program. * Maintain a strong focus on *conversion without compromising patient trust or experience.* 3. Lead Calling & Follow-ups * Proactively call leads assigned to the clinic and convert them into consultations. * Follow up with leads who have not yet booked a consultation. * Follow up with patients after consultations to drive program enrolment. * Maintain disciplined follow-up across hot, warm and pending leads. * Ensure there are *no unattended or forgotten leads*. * Maintain accurate CRM updates and lead status at all times. * Build relationships with prospects through multiple interactions rather than relying on a single call. 4. Doctor Relationship Management * Build a strong and professional relationship with doctors associated with the clinic. * Coordinate doctor schedules, patient flow and consultations. * Ensure doctors have a smooth consultation experience. * Understand the doctor's approach and ensure patients receive the right information after consultation. * Work closely with doctors to improve patient experience and clinic conversion. * Act as the key point of coordination between the doctor, patient and Sugar.fit team. 5. Camps & Offline Activities * Actively participate in and take ownership of health camps, screening camps and other offline activations. * Coordinate with internal teams to execute camps successfully. * Engage with patients and potential customers during camps. * Capture leads and ensure timely follow-up after every camp. * Convert camp-generated leads into clinic consultations and ultimately customers. * Identify opportunities for new camps, partnerships and local activations that can drive clinic footfall. 6. Local Clinic Marketing & Brand Building * Take ownership of building the Sugar.fit brand within the clinic's local catchment area. * Identify opportunities for local promotions, apartment activations, corporate tie-ups, community events and other offline initiatives. * Encourage and collect genuine patient reviews and testimonials. * Build strong word-of-mouth around the clinic. * Support local branding activities such as flyers, standees, boards, apartment/community activities and health awareness events. * Develop relationships with local communities, corporates, resident associations and other relevant partners. * Think continuously about *"How do I get more people to know about and visit this clinic?"* 7. Patient Experience & Retention * Ensure every patient feels heard, supported and guided throughout their journey. * Follow up with patients after consultations and enrolment wherever required. * Identify patient concerns early and coordinate with the relevant internal teams to resolve them. * Encourage satisfied patients to share their experience through reviews and testimonials. * Help create a strong referral and word-of-mouth pipeline. We are looking for someone who is: * *Highly aggressive about ownership and targets* * Extremely proactive and does not wait to be told what needs to be done * Strong in communication, persuasion and relationship building * Comfortable with sales and target-driven environments * Excellent at follow-ups and lead management * Empathetic and patient-centric while being commercially driven * Comfortable interacting with doctors, patients and senior stakeholders * Energetic and comfortable working in an offline clinic environment * Willing to step outside a traditional job description to make the clinic successful * Good at problem-solving and taking decisions independently * Comfortable conducting camps and local marketing activities * Highly organised and disciplined with CRM and reporting * Able to manage multiple priorities and potentially *one or two clinics simultaneously* Candidates with experience in any of the following would be preferred: * Healthcare / clinic sales * Hospital / diagnostic centre counselling * Wellness / health-tech * Weight-loss / diabetes / metabolic care * Fertility / IVF counselling * Insurance / financial services / high-ticket sales * Relationship management * Inside sales with strong follow-up ownership * Retail or service businesses involving high customer interaction

title: Sap Fico Project Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Function: Enterprise Technology Solutions Finance Products, Europe 
Experience: 10–14 years in SAP Finance, including 4+ years owning solution design and delivery of change through a partner-led development team 
Reporting to: Finance Products Lead, Europe Role Purpose Own the SAP Finance (FICO) product for Europe on the build-and-change side. The role is the accountable interface between European Finance business users and the Accenture development pod: converting business demand into the right solution design, getting it built and released on time and to quality, and owning every dependency the partner team will not own — integration, cross-functional, data, security and infrastructure. This is a product ownership role, not a coordination role. The person is expected to have an opinion on the design, to say no to the wrong design, and to be credible in front of both a Finance Controller and an Accenture solution architect. 
 Demand and solution design ownership Own the European Finance change pipeline end to end: intake, qualification, business case challenge, solution option analysis, prioritisation with process owners, and release planning. Work with business users and process owners to get to the best solution rather than the first one proposed — standard SAP over custom, global template over local workaround, reuse over rebuild. Document and defend the rationale. Review and sign off functional specifications, solution design documents and architecture decisions produced by the Accenture solution managers before build starts; ensure design fits the global template, the S/4HANA roadmap and the enterprise architecture guardrails. Assess and challenge impact on adjacent processes — O2C, P2P, R2R, tax, treasury, costing, intercompany, statutory and group reporting — before committing to a design. Maintain the product backlog, roadmap and release calendar for Finance applications in Europe, with clear prioritisation logic visible to stakeholders. Managing the Accenture delivery team Manage the Accenture pod covering solution managers, functional consultants, developers and testers: work allocation, sprint or release commitments, estimate review, dependency clearing and progress tracking. Hold the partner accountable for design quality, build quality, unit testing, documentation and on-time delivery; review estimates critically and challenge padding, scope creep and rebadged effort. Run the delivery governance cadence — design authority reviews, daily/weekly stand-ups, sprint or release reviews, defect triage, go/no-go decisions — and escalate early when a date is at risk. Own the quality gates the partner delivers into: design review, code review/ATC, SIT, UAT entry and exit criteria, cutover readiness and hypercare exit. Drive knowledge retention, documentation standards and reduced key-person dependency across the pod; sign off knowledge transfer before resource rotation. Cross-team liaison (dependencies outside the partner scope) This is a core part of the role, not an occasional extra. The Accenture team will not own these; the Product Manager does. Integration / BTP team — specify and drive interface requirements, iFlow design on SAP Integration Suite/CPI, API and event design, error handling and monitoring (AIF), interface testing windows and cutover sequencing. Data and MDM teams — master data readiness, data quality rules, migration and conversion objects, ownership of data-related design decisions. Security and GRC — role design, segregation-of-duties impact, access approvals and audit/SOX evidence for changes. Basis / infrastructure / transport management — landscape availability, transport sequencing across releases, system refresh impact on in-flight change. Other functional product teams and regional/global template owners — cross-module dependencies, template change requests, alignment where a European requirement touches the global core. Third-party and downstream systems — banking, tax engines, consolidation and reporting platforms, local statutory tools. Own the dependency and risk register for the Finance product; chase, unblock and escalate rather than waiting to be told a dependency has slipped. Stakeholder management and delivery accountability Act as the trusted point of contact for European Finance leadership, Controllers, Shared Service Centres and country Finance teams; communicate design trade-offs, timelines and constraints in business language. Manage expectations honestly on scope, cost and date — including saying no, or not yet, with a reasoned alternative. Own the plan and the date: baseline it, track it, report status without varnish, and land releases on time with no unmanaged surprises at cutover. Protect the financial close calendar — no release, cutover or freeze-window decision that puts month-end, quarter-end or year-end close at risk. Represent the Finance product in change advisory boards, architecture forums and release governance. 
 Required Skills & Experience 10–14 years in SAP with strong hands-on functional depth in FICO — GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, Product Costing, CO-PA, Intercompany, period-end close. S/4HANA experience expected. Proven track record of owning solution design and delivering change through a third-party system integrator (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, IBM or similar) — managing their solution managers and developers, not just receiving their output. Demonstrated experience in a large global FMCG/CPG environment of large scale — multi-country, multi-company-code, multi-currency, global template with local statutory variance, high transaction volumes, complex trade and promotional accounting. Strong integration literacy: able to write and challenge an interface requirement, understand SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) patterns, IDocs, APIs and events, and debug integration issues alongside technical teams. Cross-module fluency across FI/CO to MM, SD, PP, and to reporting and consolidation layers; able to spot the downstream impact of a Finance design decision. Product management discipline: backlog and roadmap ownership, prioritisation frameworks, requirement writing, release planning, benefits tracking. Delivery methods: Agile/Scrum and SAFe alongside stage-gated project delivery; comfortable with Jira or Azure DevOps and with ServiceNow-based change governance. Change and release governance: ChaRM / Solution Manager / Cloud ALM, transport discipline, CAB, emergency change protocols, audit-ready traceability. Excellent written and spoken English; ability to influence senior Finance stakeholders and hold a partner to account without escalating everything. 
 Good to Have Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or a Finance transformation/S/4 conversion programme. European statutory, VAT/e-invoicing, and local compliance exposure (e-invoicing mandates, SAF-T, Intrastat)

title: Senior Finance Analyst
description:
The Finance Analyst will be responsible for managing end-to-end financial operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, supporting planning and forecasting activities, maintaining compliance with statutory and internal policies, and providing financial insights to support business decision-making. The role requires strong analytical abilities, financial acumen, and collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. Record to Report (R2R) 
 Manage the end-to-end Record to Report process. Ensure accurate recording of financial transactions in accordance with accounting standards. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities. Maintain financial records and ensure timely reporting. 2. General Ledger (GL) Management 
 Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts. Review journal entries and ensure appropriate accounting treatments. Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies. Ensure chart of accounts integrity and financial accuracy. 3. Financial Planning Analysis (FPA) 
 Support annual budgeting and strategic financial planning processes. Analyze financial performance and business trends. Prepare management reports, financial dashboards, and presentations. Provide actionable recommendations to improve financial performance. 4. Operational Planning 
 Collaborate with business functions to develop operational budgets and plans. Evaluate operational costs and resource utilization. Support business expansion, cost optimization, and productivity initiatives. Monitor performance against operational targets. 5. Forecasting 
 Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts. Analyze business drivers impacting revenue, expenses, and profitability. Update forecasts based on market conditions and operational changes. Present forecast assumptions and risks to management. 6. Variance Analysis 
 Conduct detailed variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts. Identify financial risks, opportunities, and performance gaps. Explain key variances and recommend corrective actions. Support management reviews with meaningful financial insights. 7. Audit Support 
 Coordinate internal and external audit activities. Prepare audit schedules, supporting documentation, and responses. Ensure compliance with audit requirements and recommendations. Assist in implementing audit observations and process improvements. 8. Financial Statement Preparation 
 Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

title: General Manager - Cross-Border Healthcare
description:
General Manager Cross-Border Healthcare Company: VitaFly Consulting FZE
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 3 To 6 Years
 Locations: Mumbai, Delhi, Dubai, Geneva, Lagos, Abuja, Nairobi
 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid Compensation: Competitive compensation, commensurate with the candidates experience, skills, and expertise. Compensation is negotiable for exceptional candidates 
 Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on General Manager to lead business development, strategic partnerships, and operational coordination for a growing cross-border healthcare business. The role focuses on connecting patients, referring doctors, hospitals, insurers, and healthcare partners to facilitate access to quality and affordable international medical treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional teams to expand referral networks, develop hospital partnerships, improve patient coordination, and drive the adoption of a technology-enabled healthcare platform. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Healthcare Business Development & Partnerships Develop and manage relationships with doctors, hospitals, clinics, insurers, corporates, healthcare facilitators, and other referral partners. Drive patient referrals and build strategic partnerships across priority markets, particularly in Africa. Support partnership negotiations, agreements, onboarding, and ongoing engagement. Collaborate with digital marketing teams to support patient acquisition and business growth. 
 2. International Patient Management & Operations Oversee international patient journeys, from initial enquiries and treatment planning to travel, treatment, and post-treatment follow-up. Coordinate medical quotations, patient approvals, visa documentation, travel arrangements, accommodation, hospital coordination, insurance approvals, billing, and payments. Establish efficient workflows, service standards, and escalation mechanisms. Step in directly to resolve complex patient cases and operational challenges when required. 
 3. Hospital Network Development Expand and manage partnerships with hospitals across India, Trkiye, the UAE, Thailand, and other approved destinations. Coordinate hospital onboarding, commercial agreements, treatment quotations, and information collection. Work with hospitals, patients, and referring doctors to obtain treatment plans and necessary clarifications. Ensure clear documentation of patient cases, payment processes, and commercial arrangements. 
 4. Digital Healthcare Platform Adoption Work with product and technology teams to improve a digital platform supporting patients, hospitals, doctors, insurers, and healthcare partners. Provide operational feedback, participate in platform testing, and follow up on agreed development priorities. Onboard pilot partners and encourage active platform usage to increase patient referrals. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology. 
 5. Business Growth & Strategy Research new markets, healthcare services, and partnership opportunities. Support initiatives such as surgical camps, telemedicine services, post-treatment care, and insurance-focused healthcare solutions. Evaluate pilot projects and recommend opportunities for expansion. Support the implementation of business growth initiatives across international markets. 
 6. Team Management & Reporting Coordinate internal teams and external partners across multiple countries. Track patient cases, referral partnerships, hospital onboarding, and business development activities. Report performance, operational challenges, and key risks to the CEO. Ensure timely follow-ups, accountability, and a consistent patient experience. 
 Required Qualifications & Skills At least 4 years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, healthcare business development, patient services, or related fields. Strong experience in business development, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management, and team coordination. Excellent communication, negotiation, organisational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage strategic responsibilities while contributing directly to operational activities. Comfortable working in a growing business environment with evolving processes. Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in medical tourism, international patient management, medical travel, or cross-border healthcare. Experience working with hospitals, doctors, healthcare providers, insurers, or medical facilitators. Medical qualifications such as MBBS, BDS, or MDS will be preferred. Exposure to digital health platforms, telemedicine, or healthcare technology is an advantage. Experience working with international markets, particularly Africa, is desirable. 
 Key Performance Indicators Growth in active healthcare referral partners and qualified patient referrals. Number of successfully coordinated international patient cases and patient satisfaction. Expansion and performance of the destination-hospital network. Adoption of the digital platform by partners and pilot customers. Timely patient coordination, operational efficiency, and business growth. 
 What We Offer An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an international healthcare business. Exposure to healthcare markets and partners across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. A collaborative work environment with direct access to senior leadership. An opportunity to help build technology-enabled solutions that improve international patient access to healthcare. Competitive remuneration, with potential performance-linked incentives and stock options.

title: Business Development Executive Cum Senior Business Development
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE Cum Senior Business Development Executive Department: Sales & Business Development 
 Location: Mumbai 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Experience: 2-6 Years 
 Reporting To: Sales Manager / Director 
 2. About the Role We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Executive to identify new business opportunities, generate leads, acquire new B2B customers and expand the company's market presence. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, understanding their packaging requirements, developing business relationships, conducting sales meetings and converting prospects into customers. Candidates with experience in industrial sales, manufacturing, PP/HDPE woven bags or packaging products will be preferred. 
 3. Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 A. Lead Generation and Prospecting Identify potential B2B customers across relevant industries. Generate leads through cold calling, email outreach, referrals, networking and market research. Develop a database of prospective customers and identify their business requirements. Research companies that use PP/HDPE woven bags and other industrial packaging products. Contact decision-makers, purchasing managers and procurement teams to introduce company products. 
 B. New Business Development Develop and maintain a pipeline of potential customers. Approach new customers and create opportunities for business expansion. Understand customer requirements, product specifications and expected quantities. Arrange meetings with prospective customers to present the company's products. Follow up on enquiries and quotations to convert prospects into confirmed orders. Build long-term business relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business. 
 C. Sales Meetings and Negotiations Conduct customer meetings, product presentations and business discussions. Explain product features, specifications and suitability for customer requirements. Coordinate with the Sales Manager or management regarding pricing and commercial approvals. Discuss quantities, delivery expectations and payment terms within company guidelines. Support negotiations and follow up until the order is confirmed. 
 D. Market Research and Business Expansion Identify new industries, markets and customer segments for the company's products. Monitor competitor activities, market demand and customer preferences. Gather feedback on pricing, product quality and market requirements. Identify potential business opportunities and share market insights with management. Explore new geographical markets and customer segments as assigned. 
 E. Sales Coordination and Reporting Maintain records of leads, customer meetings, enquiries and sales opportunities. Update lead status and sales progress in the assigned CRM system or sales tracker. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly business development reports. Coordinate with the CRM Executive for customer follow-ups and enquiry tracking. Coordinate with Production, Dispatch and Accounts teams when required to support customer commitments. Share regular updates on lead conversion, pending opportunities and expected orders with the reporting manager. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Number and quality of new leads generated. Number of new customers acquired. Conversion of leads and quotations into confirmed orders. Sales revenue generated against assigned targets. Number of customer meetings and business opportunities developed. Growth in the active customer base. Accuracy and timely updating of sales reports. 5. Educational Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related field is preferred. 
 Experience 2-6 years of experience in business development, B2B sales or industrial sales. Experience in manufacturing, plastic packaging, PP/HDPE woven bags or related industries will be an advantage. Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to pursue sales may be considered separately. 
 6. Required Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Lead generation, cold calling and prospecting abilities. Customer acquisition and relationship-building skills. Negotiation and sales conversion skills. Market research and business development capabilities. Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office and CRM tools. Ability to meet sales targets and work independently. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and field sales as required. 
 7. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be confident in approaching new customers, identifying business opportunities and converting prospects into revenue. The candidate must be comfortable with B2B sales, regular follow-ups, customer meetings and field visits. Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in industrial packaging, PP/HDPE woven bags or manufacturing sales. 
 8. Salary and Incentives Salary will be based on the candidate's experience, relevant industry exposure, current compensation and interview performance. Performance-based incentives may be offered as per company policy. 
 9. Why Join Us? Opportunity to work in the manufacturing and industrial packaging sector. Exposure to B2B sales and business development. Opportunity to build customer networks and contribute to business growth.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Candidates preferred domain should be Cyber Security 
 About the role: As an Associate Product Manager on the VMDR team, you'll help define how security and IT teams discover, assess, prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities across on-prem, cloud, container and remote assets. Success is measured in real risk reduction (TruRisk), not raw finding counts. This role is for early-career problem-solvers with hands-on vulnerability management experience who want to grow into a full product manager. You'll own well-scoped features end to end and learn alongside senior PMs, engineering and Threat Research. Key responsibilities: 1. Product definition and roadmap Own and evolve well-scoped features in core VMDR modules such as Asset Discovery & Inventory, Vulnerability Detection (Cloud Agent, network scanners, passive sensors), TruRisk Prioritization (QDS, threat intel, CISA KEV, EPSS), Dashboards & Reporting, and Remediation (Patch Management, TruRisk Eliminate). Collaborate with engineering to define product requirements and specifications: PRDs, user stories, prioritization logic, workflows, wireframe annotations and acceptance criteria. Assist in developing the product roadmap and feature prioritization using frameworks such as RICE or MoSCoW, balancing customer asks, competitive gaps and engineering effort. Groom the backlog in Jira, prioritize with engineering, QA and UX, and track delivery against quarterly release plans. 2. Vulnerability assessment and threat analysis Perform hands-on vulnerability assessments: run authenticated and agent-based scans, review detections, investigate false positives/negatives and validate detection coverage. Conduct threat analysis on high-impact CVEs and zero-days (exploit availability, ransomware and malware association, CISA KEV listing, EPSS trend) with Threat Research, and turn findings into detection and prioritization requirements. Translate concepts such as CVSS vs. EPSS vs. QDS, asset criticality, toxic combinations, SLA breaches and MTTR into product features with measurable risk reduction. Test and validate features before release: scans, detections, QQL queries, dashboards, reports and APIs. 3. Customer reporting and insight Help design and generate vulnerability management reports for customers: executive TruRisk summaries Partner with SMEs, SSAs/TAMs, support and customers to refine requirements, triage escalations, validate assumptions and iterate fast. Define workflows for integrations with ServiceNow (ITSM/CMDB), Jira, SIEM/SOAR 4. Market research and competitive intelligence Assist in market research to identify new opportunities and customer needs in vulnerability and exposure management (CTEM, attack surface management, cloud and container security). Run competitive analysis against Tenable, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight and exposure management platforms; maintain feature comparison matrices. Stay current on industry trends and regulatory requirements affecting VM: NIST CSF/SP 800-40, PCI DSS v4.0, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SEC cyber disclosure rules, EU NIS2, DORA, CERT-In and DPDP Act (India). 5. Product collateral and enablement Help prepare product collateral: user guides, FAQs, datasheets, release notes, solution briefs and demo scripts. Create sales enablement content and support launches, webinars and customer demos. 
 Preferred candidate profile Must-have qualifications 
 Experience 25 years in product management, product analyst, technical program, solutions/sales engineering, or security engineering/analyst roles. At least 1 year working directly on vulnerability management, security operations, or a cybersecurity product (SaaS preferred). 
 Domain knowledge (must be able to explain in an interview) Vulnerability management lifecycle: asset discovery and inventory scanning (authenticated vs unauthenticated, agent vs network) prioritization remediation/patching verification and reporting. CVE, CWE, NVD, CVSS scoring, EPSS, CISA KEV, and the difference between severity and risk. Patch management, configuration management and asset management basics across Windows, Linux and cloud workloads. Working knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, ports, protocols), OS fundamentals and cloud basics (AWS, Azure or GCP). 
 Tool proficiency Area Tools (hands-on with at least one per row) Vulnerability scanners / VM platforms Qualys, Tenable (Nessus, Tenable.io/SC), Rapid7 InsightVM/Nexpose, Microsoft Defender VM, OpenVAS Security tooling exposure SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR (CrowdStrike, Defender), CSPM/CNAPP (Wiz, Prisma Cloud), ITSM (ServiceNow) Product and delivery Jira, Confluence, Aha! or Productboard Data and analytics SQL, Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups), a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) or product analytics (Pendo, Mixpanel) Design and docs Figma (reviewing wireframes), Lucidchart/Miro APIs Postman or curl; reading REST API docs and JSON 
 Core skills Excellent written and verbal communication: crisp PRDs, user stories and release notes, and confident explanation of technical topics to engineers, customers and executives. Strong analytical skills: collect, organize and analyze large vulnerability and usage datasets (SQL, Excel pivots/lookups) to reach clear recommendations; structured prioritization (RICE, MoSCoW or similar). Comfortable presenting to customers and engineering teams. Nice to have Security certifications: CompTIA Security+, CEH, CySA+, GIAC (GCIH, GEVA), CISSP associate, or Qualys/Tenable vendor certifications. Product certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic Institute, or AIPMM. Exposure to adjacent areas: patch management, EASM/attack surface management, CTEM/exposure management, container and cloud workload scanning, compliance scanning (CIS benchmarks). Scripting in Python or PowerShell for data pulls or API automation. Experience with AI/LLM features in security products (e.g. assisted prioritization, natural-language search). Prior work at a security vendor, MSSP, or in an enterprise SOC/VM team.

Convert business strategy and stakeholder requirements into clear priorities, a sequenced roadmap, and actionable epics and stories; secure alignment across business, architecture, engineering, compliance, and delivery teams before commitment and maintain traceability from outcomes to requirements, user stories, releases, and supporting documentation. Drive roadmap planning and execution for the FactorTrust platform and Alternative Credit ecosystem, balancing technical debt reduction, regulatory requirements, infrastructure modernization, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives. Partner with internal business resources and technical teams in a matrixed environment-including solutions/product, engineering, architecture, UX, data science/analytics, compliance, legal, product marketing, operations, and support-to analyze requirements, align on outcomes, and coordinate delivery commitments. Define and maintain a roadmap for the next 2-3 PIs for your product area/workstream; influence yearly planning and coordinate cross-team sequencing and dependencies. Run KPI-driven reviews and adjust the plan to maximize measurable outcomes; use delivery, quality, performance, and operational signals to surface improvement opportunities and drive changes that increase customer value, improve flow, and strengthen solution resiliency. Product Development Lifecycle Ownership Guide the full product and technical delivery lifecycle-from discovery through launch and iteration-ensuring readiness at each stage, including requirements analysis, solution definition, application design, development oversight, testing, delivery, release, adoption, and documentation. Translate customer, business, and stakeholder needs into actionable outcomes and deliverables for multiple teams, accounting for system boundaries, architecture constraints, dependencies, performance considerations, data movement,integrations, and operating model impacts. Own and communicate a sequenced roadmap and backlog; continually re-plan based on KPI performance, impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness while tracking medium-term risks and opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, requirements analysis, and technical solution discussions for foundational and high-visibility initiatives; evaluate options and trade-offs, align on approach, and drive end-to-end execution across teams and partner teams. Lead requirements definition and technical execution for credit risk products that leverage alternative data, including consumer reporting solutions, score development initiatives, prescreening capabilities, identity and fraud inputs, decisioning integrations, and customer-facing product enhancements. Ensure product designs and implementations support regulatory, operational, and customer requirements, including FCRA compliance, model governance standards, audit readiness, data quality controls, and appropriate use of consumer data 
 Required Knowledge And Experiences Technical Expectations A Technical Product Manager owns technical delivery outcomes and understands architecture patterns, application design considerations, data processing concepts, integration points, platform constraints, and application lifecycle practices. This role works directly with engineering to shape, oversee, and deliver sound technical solutions for high-volume, data-driven product platforms. Drive application solution ownership for high-volume, data-driven systems and credit risk platforms, including Alternative Data products, FactorTrust capabilities, Blended Scores, and supporting decisioning services by shaping the application design, development approach, testing strategy, implementation plan, operational readiness, and delivery documentation with engineering teams. Design or oversee the design and development of data processing solutions, including solution decomposition, application framework considerations, data movement, system integrations, performance, resiliency, debugging, and environment readiness. Provide technical direction for Ab Initio-based or similar data processing solutions, including Continuous Flows, application frameworks, performance tuning, debugging, metadata usage, and reusable patterns that can be leveraged by other applications or processes. Create and maintain clear documentation that communicates requirements, technical context, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders. Identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, services, and system integrations that enable end-user productivity, delivery efficiency, and consistent product execution.
