 JD: Product Manager NPD/NPI 
 The role is responsible for driving end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs for new vehicle, hardware, and R&D initiatives. The position requires ownership of the complete product development lifecycle, from concept and feasibility through design, prototyping, validation, pilot builds, and production readiness. The role will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, including R&D, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Finance, to ensure products are launched on time, within budget, and in line with defined specifications. Key Responsibilities 

 1. End-to-End Program Management 
 Own NPD/NPI programs from concept, feasibility, and design through prototyping, Design Verification Plan (DVP) execution, validation, pilot builds, and Start of Production (SOP). 2. Program Planning and Governance 
 Define and monitor program milestones, critical-path schedules, phase-gate reviews, and delivery commitments across cross-functional teams. 3. Product Requirements and Specifications 
 Translate business, market, and customer requirements into detailed product and engineering specifications in collaboration with R&D and design teams. 4. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management 
 Drive structured program governance forums to align stakeholders on scope, cost, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and risks. 5. Leadership Reporting 
 Present program health, risks, trade-offs, and key decisions to senior leadership through clear, actionable updates that support timely decision-making. 6. Cost Management and Value Engineering 
 Track Bill of Materials (BOM) costs, monitor budgets, and drive cost-reduction and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives with Sourcing and Finance. 7. Supplier and Vendor Readiness 
 Coordinate supplier readiness for new components and technologies, ensuring design releases, tooling timelines, and component availability are aligned with program milestones. 8. Risk and Compliance Management 
 Identify and mitigate technical, supply-chain, regulatory, and compliance risks throughout the product development lifecycle. 9. Build and Launch Readiness 
 Coordinate build planning, pilot production runs, and launch-readiness reviews to ensure quality and performance benchmarks are achieved before SOP. 10. Execution in a Dynamic Environment 
 Demonstrate high ownership, a bias for action, and the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment. Key Deliverables 
 Timely product development and launch in line with approved cost, quality, and technical specifications. Effective phase-gate governance and milestone tracking. Clear visibility into program risks, dependencies, costs, and schedule deviations. Improved BOM cost efficiency through cost-down and VAVE initiatives. Supplier, tooling, validation, and production readiness before SOP. Strong alignment between business requirements and engineering execution. 

 5. Key Skills 

 Mandatory Key Skills 
 End-to-end NPD/NPI program management. Automotive/EV product development, R&D program management, or 0-to-1 hardware/product development. Product lifecycle management from concept through SOP. DVP planning, product validation, phase-gate governance, and pilot builds. Cross-functional program management across Engineering, R&D, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing. BOM cost analysis, budget tracking, and value engineering. Risk assessment, mitigation, and program governance. Strong stakeholder management and leadership communication. Familiarity with MS Project, Power BI, JIRA, or similar program management tools. Familiarity with APQP, Agile, or equivalent structured governance frameworks. Strong business and analytical acumen, ownership, and execution capabilities. 

 Good to Have Skills

Exposure to EV-specific technologies, including batteries, motors, and power electronics. Experience with connected-vehicle or telematics programs. Genuine interest in EVs, commercial mobility, and the automotive transition in India.

title: Sales Manager (IT hardware & Networking Product)
description:
*Please read the JD before applying . 
 Urgent Requirement 
 Role & responsibilities 
 BizAarambh Catalyst Pvt Ltd Client is looking for an experienced and target-driven ASM/Sales Manager to manage sales growth, develop channel partners, handle key customers, and drive business across ISP, Telecom, IT Networking, Wireless, VoIP, and Enterprise segments. The Sales Manager will report to the Zone Head / Regional Sales Head and will be responsible for achieving sales targets, managing dealer/distributor/channel partner relationships, supporting OEM brand sales, handling team coordination, and ensuring timely payment collection and customer satisfaction in the assigned region. The role requires strong knowledge of IT networking products such as routers, switches, wireless devices, access points, VoIP products, fiber/networking products , and brands such as MikroTik, Cambium, Mimosa, Grandstream, Ubiquiti, TP-Link, Cisco, Optitera, or similar products. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Sales and Revenue Generation 
 Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Drive sales for networking, wireless, telecom, VoIP, ISP, and enterprise products. Develop and execute sales plans for the assigned region and product category. Identify new customers, dealers, channel partners, system integrators, ISPs, and enterprise accounts. Manage existing customers and generate repeat business. Drive upselling, cross-selling, and new product sales. Maintain sales pipeline, follow-ups, quotations, order status, and closure reports. Ensure timely customer communication and deal closure. 
 2. Channel Partner and Dealer Management 
 Appoint, develop, and manage channel partners, resellers, dealers, and system integrators. Build strong relationships with ISP, telecom, IT networking, and enterprise customers. Conduct partner engagement activities, product discussions, and sales follow-ups. Support partners with product information, pricing, availability, and schemes. Resolve partner issues related to pricing, delivery, stock, credit, payment, and support. Ensure partners follow company sales process and credit policy. 
 3. Product and Brand Knowledge 
 Maintain strong understanding of networking and telecom products. Understand product-wise and model-wise selling points. Coordinate with the technical team for product selection, compatibility, and customer queries. Promote company key brands and product categories. Understand pricing source, margin, stock availability, and competitor pricing. Participate in product training and ensure team knowledge improvement. 
 4. Team Management 
 Lead, guide, and monitor the sales team. Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for team members. Review daily activity reports, customer follow-ups, quotations, and closures. Ensure proper CRM/reporting discipline and timely updates from team members. Train team members on customer handling, product knowledge, communication, and closure. Conduct regular sales reviews and performance discussions. 
 5. Business Development 
 Identify new markets, customer segments, and business opportunities. Build business in ISP, telecom, enterprise, system integration, and networking markets. Work closely with OEMs for product promotion, schemes, and business growth. Lead high-value deal discussions, pricing negotiation, and closure. Track competitor activities and market trends. Support expansion of business in assigned territory. 
 6. Coordination and Order Closure 
 Coordinate with Sales Support, Technical Support, Accounts, Operations, Logistics, and Store teams. Ensure smooth order processing from quotation to delivery. Follow up for payment, credit approval, dispatch, invoice, and customer confirmation. Ensure proper closure of every task and customer requirement. Avoid pending work without ownership and timeline. Maintain email documentation for important discussions, commitments, approvals, and reports. 
 7. Payment Collection and Compliance 
 Follow company credit policy and payment terms. Ensure timely payment collection from customers and channel partners. Monitor outstanding payments and receivables. Coordinate with the internal team. 
 Required Skills and Competencies 
 Strong B2B sales and channel sales experience. Good knowledge of IT networking, wireless, telecom, ISP, VoIP, routers, switches, access points, and fiber products. Experience in dealer/distributor/channel partner handling. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to handle targets and work under pressure. Good customer relationship management skills. Team handling and leadership ability. Good coordination with internal departments. Strong follow-up and closure approach. Basic knowledge of CRM, Excel, email communication, and MIS reporting. Ability to work independently and take ownership. 
 Preferred Product Knowledge 
 MikroTik, Cambium Networks, Mimosa, Grandstream, Ubiquiti, TP-Link, Cisco, Juniper, Digisol, Optitera, AirPro or similar brands. Wireless access points, routers, switches, VoIP/IP phones, fiber networking products, ISP and telecom solutions. Basic understanding of Wi-Fi, wireless, switching, routing, VLAN, Cisco switches/routers, and related networking solutions. 
 Qualification 
 Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management will be preferred. Engineering or technical background will be an added advantage. Experience 5 to 8 years of experience in B2B sales. Experience in IT networking, telecom, ISP, wireless, or enterprise sales preferred. Minimum 2 to 3 years of team handling or senior sales responsibility preferred. Experience with channel partners, system integrators, OEMs, and distributors will be an advantage. 
 Please apply through Naukri or share Cv at hr@bizaarambh.com

title: Senior hardware Sales Manager
description:
Job Description: Hardware Sales Manager 
 We are hiring a Senior Hardware Sales Manager to scale revenue through distributors, resellers, system integrators, and partner networks as part of its hardware growth agenda. The role is best positioned as a channel and distribution leadership hire rather than a generic sales manager because effective hardware growth depends on partner-led go-to-market execution, coverage, forecasting, and relationship ownership across the indirect sales ecosystem. 
 Job Title: Hardware Sales Manager Location: Noida / NCR preferred; open to Pan-India travel Department: Sales / Business Growth Reporting To: CEO / Business Head 
 Key Responsibilities Build and execute the hardware channel sales strategy across regions, partner segments, and product categories to drive revenue growth and market share. Own relationships with distributors, resellers, system integrators, and regional partners; improve partner productivity, sell-through, and market coverage. Recruit, onboard, activate, and grow new channel partners in priority markets and industry verticals. Drive partner-led pipeline creation, deal closures, and repeat business through account planning and structured business reviews. Negotiate pricing, schemes, margins, commercial terms, and growth plans with distributors and strategic partners. Work with OEMs and internal teams on deal registration, incentive programs, promotions, certifications, and partner enablement initiatives. Build forecasting discipline, channel dashboards, review cadences, and operational rigor across pipeline, conversion, collections, and revenue tracking. Lead, coach, and scale the sales team to consistently achieve business targets through strong execution. Collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to improve demand generation, order fulfillment, and partner experience. Monitor market trends, competitive activities, regional demand shifts, and emerging opportunities across the IT hardware landscape. 
 Candidate Profile Required Experience 815 years of B2B IT hardware sales experience with strong exposure to channel, distribution, and partner-led business models. Proven success in managing distributors, partner ecosystems, and indirect sales across product categories such as PCs, laptops, peripherals, networking, POS solutions, enterprise devices, or related hardware. Strong network across distributors, regional partners, resellers, and OEM/vendor ecosystems. Demonstrated experience owning revenue targets, forecasting, partner performance, and sales team leadership. Core Skills Deep understanding of IT hardware channel dynamics, distributor management, partner recruitment, key account management, and commercial negotiations. Strong expertise in forecasting, sales operations, pipeline management, and performance review processes. Familiarity with deal registration, partner incentive programs, enablement initiatives, pricing structures, and channel conflict management. Excellent communication, relationship management, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and execution skills. What Good Looks Like Thorough understanding of how the Indian IT hardware channel operates, including distributor behavior, reseller economics, credit management, and sell-through strategies. Ability to quickly establish relationships with partners and convert them into active, revenue-generating accounts. Balances revenue growth with margin discipline, partner conflict management, and sustainable market expansion. Brings operational excellence through accurate forecasting, structured reviews, pipeline hygiene, partner activation, and disciplined deal closure. Successfully builds, mentors, and leads regional or national hardware sales teams that consistently deliver results. 
 Preferred Background Candidates from IT hardware brands, national distributors, value-added distributors (VADs), commercial device companies, POS and peripherals businesses, networking hardware firms, or other channel-led technology organizations will be highly preferred. Experience in developing partner-led growth strategies and building structured channel programs across India will be considered a strong advantage. Success Metrics Monthly and quarterly hardware revenue achievement. Growth in active partner count and partner productivity. Distributor performance and regional market coverage. Pipeline value, conversion rate, and forecast accuracy. Margin realization and collection efficiency. New partner onboarding and time-to-activation. Closing Statement The ideal candidate combines deep channel relationships with disciplined sales execution and has the ability to transform a partner ecosystem into a predictable, scalable, and high-performing revenue engine that drives Elcom Digital's hardware business growth.

title: Account Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities 
 Bookkeeping & Day-to-Day Accounting Record all financial transactions accurately and on time in Tally sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries, contra entries, and bank/cash transactions. Maintain general ledger, vendor ledger, customer ledger, and employee ledger with regular review and clean-up. Manage petty cash, employee reimbursements, and travel expense settlements as per Company policy. Maintain organized physical and digital records of vouchers, invoices, bills, and supporting documents. Accounts Payable & Receivable Process vendor invoices verify against POs / GRNs / agreements, apply correct GST and TDS, and ensure timely payment cycles. Raise customer/client invoices accurately, with applicable GST, and share with clients along with supporting documents. Follow up with clients on outstanding receivables; track ageing and escalate to the F&A Manager as needed. Reconcile vendor and customer ledgers periodically and issue/obtain confirmations. Bank, Cash & Reconciliations Carry out daily / weekly/monthly bank reconciliations for all bank accounts and credit cards. Support cash-flow tracking and prepare daily fund-position reports for the F&A Manager. Statutory Compliance Support Support GST compliance preparation of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and GSTR-2B reconciliation; coordinate with the F&A Manager/consultants for timely filing under the CGST / SGST / IGST Acts, 2017. Support TDS compliance — deduction at the correct rate, timely deposit, generation of Form 16A, and assistance with quarterly e-TDS returns (Forms 24Q, 26Q, 27Q) under the Income Tax Act, 1961. Support EPF, ESI, Professional Tax (where applicable), and Labour Welfare Fund inputs and challan generation under the EPF & MP Act, 1952; ESI Act, 1948; and applicable state laws. Support advance tax workings, income-tax computations, and ROC / MCA documentation under the Companies Act, 2013, in coordination with the F&A Manager and statutory auditors. Payroll, MIS & Closing Support Support month-end and year-end closing activities — provisioning, prepaid / accruals, depreciation entries, and ledger scrutiny. Prepare routine MIS — receivables ageing, payables ageing, expense trackers, and other reports as required. Support statutory, internal, tax, and GST audits with required schedules, vouchers, and reconciliations; respond to auditor queries in coordination with the F&A Manager. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timeliness and accuracy of bookkeeping and ledger maintenance. Zero / minimal errors in GST and TDS workings; adherence to statutory due dates. Timely bank, vendor, customer, and inter-company reconciliations. Accuracy and timeliness of MIS, payroll inputs, and month-end closing schedules. Quality of audit support and timeliness of query closures. Maintenance of organized, audit-ready records and files. 
 Required Competencies 
 Technical Skills Hands-on expertise in Tally (Tally Prime preferred) vouchers, ledgers, reports, GST and TDS modules, bank reconciliation. Working knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS / AS basics), GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and Professional Tax. Strong proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, sorting, filters, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables); working knowledge of MS Word. Good understanding of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and basic financial statements. Familiarity with statutory due dates and basic compliance calendars for GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and other applicable laws. Behavioural Skills Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to manage multiple tasks against deadlines. High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics in handling sensitive financial and employee information. Good written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate with vendors, clients, auditors, and internal stakeholders. Ownership, accountability, and a service-oriented mindset; willingness to learn and take direction from the F&A Manager. Team player with the ability to work calmly under month-end and audit-related deadlines.

title: ET SIC Reporting Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
 ET SIC Reporting Analyst is responsible for supporting vulnerability management reporting for ET (excluding Platform Mgmt) and providing accurate, timely and actionable compliance insights. This position requires close collaboration with global teams across ET, Infosec and business functions to align reporting with the broader risk frameworks. The analyst will be responsible for monitoring progress against vulnerability mgmt goals, validating that vulnerabilities are remediated or approved plans are recorded within defined SLA targets, and providing compliance status through regular assessments, on-going leadership reviews and real-time dashboards. As part of the role, the individual will assess existing reporting processes, refine them as business needs change, and work closely with Infosec and other stakeholders to strengthen data quality, reporting controls and governance models within Enterprise Technology. The ideal candidate brings relevant experience in IT risk reporting, governance and analytics, contributing to EY's overall risk management plan. Your key responsibilities 
 Prepare and maintain Global Vulnerability mgmt compliance reports for all in-scope IT functions within Enterprise Technology (excluding Platform Mgmt), including GRAC reporting for in-scope I&O functions. Consolidate vulnerability, remediation and exception data from approved sources; validate completeness and accuracy before reports are published. Monitor compliance within agreed SLAs as established by Infosec, tracking remediation progress, overdue items and adherence to security policies. Prepare weekly / monthly SIC updates and leadership review materials to provide clear insights into vulnerability mgmt performance. Maintain reporting definitions, templates, calculation logic and documented controls to enable consistent and repeatable reporting. Collaborate with Infosec and I&O product managers to understand reporting requirements, source-data changes and future product road maps. Maintain end-to-end reporting views for vulnerabilities across ET (excluding Platform Management), including remediation plans, exceptions, approvals and closure status. Work closely with Infosec and stakeholders within ET to provide reporting support for Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises. Produce vulnerability management dashboards, scorecards, trend analysis and actionable insights for operational and leadership reviews. Collaborate with stakeholders and act as a reporting conduit between Infosec, Product/Application, Engineering, Operations & Management; follow up on data gaps and unresolved ownership issues. Provide segmented reporting and follow-up views for Data Restricted Countries (DRCS) and Local Support teams (excluding Platform Management). Identify, assess and highlight risk trends, ageing, recurring issues and priority remediation areas for I&O (excluding Platform Mgmt). Compliance Management: Support reporting that demonstrates whether in-scope portfolios for I&O adhere to GCoC recommended policies, compliances, regulations and standards. Identify opportunities to automate and standardize data preparation, validation, dashboard refresh and recurring report distribution. 

 Skills and attributes for success 
 Experienced in managing key Stakeholder relationships, including Senior Management. Good understanding of Industry GRAC, vulnerability mgmt standards and compliance reporting. title: Sales Technology & CRM Administrator (Manager)
description:
The Manager - Salesforce Administrator will lead the ongoing development of our salesforce.com deployment. The successful candidate will have a record of success in improving processes and adoption using the Lightning platform. The administrator will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify develop and deploy new business processes. This role is part technical project manager, part administrator and part Salesforce.com analyst. The Senior Manager will be responsible for the executing on the day-to-day configuration, support, maintenance and improvement of our CRM platform. 
 Position Summary We are seeking a highly capable Sales Technology & CRM Administrator to own, administrator, optimize, and continuously improve our sales technology ecosystem. This individual will serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator and will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure our technology stack effectively supports the end-to-end sales lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong CRM administration expertise with sales operations knowledge, workflow automation, data management, reporting, dashboard development, and system integration capabilities. This is not simply a system maintenance role. We are looking for someone who can understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technology solutions that improve seller productivity, pipeline visibility, data quality, and management decision-making. Key Responsibilities 1. CRM & Platform Administration Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Manage users, roles, profiles, permissions, licenses, teams, territories, and access controls. Configure CRM objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, lead statuses, opportunity stages, and other system configurations. Manage platform configurations and ensure systems remain aligned with evolving sales processes. Monitor system utilization, adoption, data integrity, and platform performance. 2. Salesforce & HubSpot Optimization Configure and maintain lead, contact, account, and opportunity management processes. Design and optimize lead routing, assignment rules, qualification workflows, lifecycle stages, and opportunity processes. Develop automation to reduce manual activities performed by sales teams. Maintain standardized sales processes and ensure consistent CRM usage across teams. Identify opportunities to simplify CRM experiences and improve seller productivity. 3. Workflow & Process Automation Translate Sales and Revenue Operations requirements into automated workflows. Design automation for activities such as: Lead capture and enrichment Lead qualification Lead assignment and routing Account/contact enrichment Sales follow-up Opportunity stage management Notifications and alerts Sales handoffs Pipeline management Data synchronization Continuously identify manual sales activities that can be automated. 4. Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics Develop and maintain executive and operational dashboards covering areas such as: Sales pipeline Pipeline coverage Pipeline velocity Lead conversion Opportunity conversion Win/loss analysis Sales activity Lead source effectiveness SDR/BDR productivity Account penetration Forecast accuracy Sales funnel performance Create role-specific dashboards for Sales Executives, Sales Leaders, Account Executives, SDR/BDRs, and Revenue Operations teams. Ensure reporting definitions and KPI calculations are consistent across platforms. 5. Sales Intelligence & Prospecting Platforms Administer and optimize ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to support prospecting and account-based selling activities. Responsibilities may include: User/license administration CRM integrations Lead/contact enrichment Account mapping Prospect segmentation Data export/import processes Duplicate management Data quality monitoring Sales intelligence workflows Work with Sales leadership to improve adoption and maximize value from sales intelligence platforms. 6. Data Management & Governance Maintain high standards for CRM data quality, completeness, consistency, and accuracy. Develop policies and processes for: Data ownership Duplicate management Required fields Naming conventions Account/contact hierarchy Lead lifecycle governance CRM hygiene Conduct periodic data audits and recommend corrective actions. Establish data governance standards across the sales technology ecosystem. 7. Systems Integration Manage and monitor integrations between: ZoomInfo HubSpot Salesforce LinkedIn Sales Navigator Ensure information flows accurately across the ecosystem and investigate synchronization or integration issues. Partner with IT, vendors, or integration specialists when necessary to implement more advanced integrations. 8. User Support & Enablement Serve as the first point of contact for sales technology issues. Troubleshoot system, workflow, reporting, access, and data issues. Develop user guides, process documentation, and training materials. Train new and existing sales team members on appropriate use of the technology stack. Promote adoption of standardized sales processes and tools. 9. Continuous Improvement Partner with Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations to identify opportunities to: Reduce administrative effort for sellers Improve lead response time Improve pipeline transparency Increase CRM adoption Improve data quality Increase sales productivity Improve management reporting Automate repetitive activities Maintain a roadmap of system enhancements and prioritize improvements based on business impact. Required Qualifications 36+ years of experience in CRM Administration, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Technology, or Business Systems. Strong hands-on administration experience with Salesforce. Experience administering or configuring HubSpot. Experience working with sales intelligence/prospecting platforms such as ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Strong understanding of the B2B sales lifecycle, including: Lead MQL/SQL Opportunity Pipeline Closed Won/Lost Experience building CRM workflows, automation, validation rules, assignment rules, and notifications. Strong experience developing reports, KPIs, and executive dashboards. Understanding of CRM data models involving Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, Activities, and Campaigns. Strong data management and troubleshooting skills. Ability to translate business requirements into technical configurations. Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce Administrator certification. HubSpot certifications. Experience with Revenue Operations or Sales Operations. Experience integrating CRM and sales intelligence platforms. Familiarity with API/integration concepts and tools such as Zapier, Workato, Tray.io, or similar platforms. Advanced Excel/data analysis capabilities. Experience supporting SDR/BDR, Account Executive, and Enterprise Sales organizations. Familiarity with sales forecasting, territory management, account segmentation, and pipeline management.

title: Recruiting Solutions Professional
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we're on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 
 Job Description 
 Recruiting Solutions Project Manager, U.S. Bancorp India The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will support the U.S. Bancorp India Global Capability Center recruiting organization by enabling effective, compliant, and scalable recruiting operations across India. This position will play a central role in preparing and supporting recruiters through training, process and technology enhancements, change management, communications, risk and compliance coordination, and knowledge base management. The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will partner with the India recruiting team, Global Enterprise Recruiting Solutions team, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other key stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes and technology meet local business requirements, support a consistent recruiter and candidate experience, and are successfully adopted by the recruiting organization. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead and support recruiting operations, process, training, and technology initiatives for the U.S. Bancorp India GCC recruiting organization. Develop and deliver recruiter training, tools, job aids, and other enablement resources that strengthen recruiter readiness, process adherence, and operational consistency. Assess recruiter training needs and translate new or changing processes, policies, and technology capabilities into practical learning materials and communications. Partner with HR Product and Engineering teams to identify, document, prioritize, and track recruiting product enhancement requests based on India business and recruiter needs. Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing and post-implementation validation and hyper care for recruiting tools and system changes. Identify technology defects, process gaps, and user experience issues, document findings and partner with product team and vendors through resolution. Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other subject matter experts to ensure India recruiting processes, procedures, communications, and technology configurations align with applicable laws, regulatory expectations, company policies, and established controls. Develop and deliver appropriate change management, communication, training, and adoption plans in response to recruiting process, policy, and technology changes Monitor adoption of new recruiting processes and tools, gather feedback from users, identify barriers, and recommend actions to strengthen adoption and effectiveness. Maintain India recruiting knowledge base content and ensure materials remain accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with global standards and local requirements. Serve as a resource for India recruiters and recruiting leaders by addressing questions, identifying appropriate referrals, and supporting resolution of complex process and technology issues. Leverage recruiter feedback, operational data, testing results, and adoption insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Build strong partnerships across India recruiting, Global Enterprise Recruiting, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and successful delivery in a matrixed environment. Act as a recruiting operations and enablement subject matter expert by maintaining awareness of evolving business needs, India recruiting practices, technology capabilities, and industry trends. 
 Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience. Five years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting, change management, HR technology, learning and development, or a related field. 
 Preferred Skills/Experience Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting operations, recruiter enablement, HR technology, process improvement, or large-scale organizational change. Experience developing and facilitating recruiter training, process education, job aids, presentations, and other enablement materials. Knowledge of recruiting processes and technology, preferably including Workday Recruiting, Phenom, or comparable applicant tracking and candidate relationship management platforms. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, enhancement requests, use cases, testing scenarios, and acceptance criteria. Experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect documentation, issue resolution, and implementation of HR or recruiting technology. Understanding of India recruitment practices, employment-related compliance requirements, and the importance of partnering with Legal and Risk to translate requirements into practical recruiting procedures. Experience developing communications and change management plans that support successful adoption of new processes, policies, and technology. Strong technical writing and process documentation skills, including the ability to create clear knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, process guides, and user-facing instructions. Ability to synthesize complex policy, legal, risk, process, and technology information into clear and actionable guidance for recruiters. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines. Innovative, resourceful, solutions-oriented, and committed to identifying opportunities to improve recruiting processes, workflows, user experience, and operational efficiency. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively across global and cross-functional teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively across India and U.S. time zones when collaboration with global stakeholders is required. Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of recruiting reporting, metrics, and analytics is preferred.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
About Aptagrim Aptagrim designs, engineers and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems built around real business knowledge, decisions and operational workflows. Our work spans our bidPlan product and AI engineering services for enterprise clients. 
 About the role We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead the delivery of AI solutions and enterprise applications, from discovery and planning through development, client acceptance and production rollout. 
 You will own delivery commitments, client communication, resource planning and project financial performance across multiple engagements. You started in software engineering and progressed into technical leadership and delivery management, and you can still understand architecture, review code when needed and challenge technical assumptions. 
 This is an active delivery leadership role. You will work closely with technical leads, the Head of AI, engineering leadership, business analysts and sales to turn client requirements into achievable delivery plans. You will also help shape how delivery works at Aptagrim as the company grows. Key responsibilities 
 Delivery ownership Own the delivery lifecycle: discovery, scope definition and estimation through implementation, testing, acceptance, deployment and support transition. Run multiple engagements with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and acceptance criteria. Build realistic plans that account for technical uncertainty, data availability, integration dependencies and client responsibilities. Spot risks early and lead corrective action when scope, timelines, costs or quality drift from the agreed plan. Manage scope changes through documented impact assessment and client agreement. 
 Technical and AI delivery Work with the Head of AI and engineering leads to assess feasibility, architecture, effort and implementation options. Review technical designs and code when needed to investigate risks or unblock delivery. Ensure teams follow agreed engineering, testing, security and deployment standards. For AI engagements, agree data-readiness requirements, evaluation criteria and human-review needs with the client and technical team. Set clear decision points between feasibility, pilot and production rollout. Ensure production releases have monitoring, operational ownership and support arrangements in place. Factor infrastructure, model/API and maintenance costs into solution choices. 
 Client and commercial management Be the primary contact for delivery commitments, progress, risks, scope changes and escalations. Explain technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to business and technical stakeholders. Support sales with discovery, estimates, assumptions and statements of work before commitments are made. Own effort forecasts, staffing plans, budget tracking and delivery margins. Track acceptance and billable milestones, working with finance on invoicing documentation. Build client confidence through transparent reporting, timely escalation and dependable follow-through. 
 Team leadership and improvement Lead Technical Project Managers and Business Analysts, and coordinate delivery through project technical leads. Plan capacity and staffing with engineering leadership. Coach and develop your team, building a delivery bench that can take on larger engagements. Set clear expectations, delegate well and address performance or collaboration issues early. Run practical delivery reviews and retrospectives that improve estimation, execution and quality. Keep documentation and reporting clear without adding unnecessary process. 
 Required Skills & Experience 7+ years in software, starting in engineering and moving through technical leadership into client delivery ownership. Background in software consulting, product engineering services or enterprise implementation. A track record of delivering complex enterprise applications end to end, including production deployment and client acceptance. Hands-on experience delivering AI or data-driven solutions, with a working grasp of data dependencies, evaluation and production risk. Ability to read code, understand application architecture and constructively challenge plans and estimates. Experience with Python or Node.js backends, modern web applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms and CI/CD. Experience running multiple projects with cross-functional teams and enterprise stakeholders, including distributed or offshore teams. Strong planning, estimation, risk and scope control, plus ownership of budgets, effort forecasts and margins. Clear written and verbal communication, including difficult client conversations and escalations. Working knowledge of Agile delivery and tools such as Jira. Comfort in a growing company, balancing delivery discipline with practical decision-making. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 Preferred Delivery of generative AI, document intelligence, knowledge systems or intelligent workflow applications. Experience taking AI pilots into production. PMP or an equivalent certification (PRINCE2, SAFe, CSM). Familiarity with enterprise security reviews and operational readiness requirements. 
 What success looks like Delivery commitments are realistic, visible and consistently met. Risks and scope changes surface early, with clear recovery or resolution plans. Projects meet agreed acceptance criteria and move successfully into production. Clients get clear communication and trust the delivery team. Your team grows more capable and needs less intervention from senior leadership.

Key Skills: Product Delivery,Client Delivery,Django Framework,Project Delivery,Technical Delivery,Software Delivery,Technology Leadership,Delivery Leadership

title: GTM Project Manager
description:
Job Department Summary Showpad s Revenue Operations team owns the systems, data, and operating processes that allow the go-to-market organization to sell, service, and grow revenue. The team spans five disciplines - GTM Systems, Deal Desk, Business Intelligence, Sales Operations, and GTM Strategy - across North America, EMEA, and India. The GTM Project Manager exists to make that team deliver predictably. Today, Revenue Operations runs a large and highly interdependent portfolio, and the senior specialists who should be solving commercial and technical problems are instead managing their own project logistics: chasing stakeholders, scheduling follow-ups, keeping tickets current, and reporting status. This role takes that work off them and does it better. The role is based in Pune and reports to the Director, GTM Strategy. It supports the entire Revenue Operations team rather than any single function, and it is deliberately positioned as a delivery role, not an administrative one. The person in this seat is expected to hold senior stakeholders to commitments, surface risk before a date slips rather than after, and own a subset of projects end to end. How the role splits Approximately 25% of the role is ownership of the Revenue Operations backlog in Jira: data accuracy, delivery governance, reporting, cadence, and direct management of selected projects. The remaining 75% is embedded delivery support across Deal Desk, Business Intelligence, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, and GTM Strategy - driving the cross-functional projects those functions depend on, and unblocking the dependencies between them. Why this role matters Revenue Operations sits upstream of the company s ability to quote, book, forecast, renew, and report. When a Revenue Operations project slips, a sales team loses visibility, a renewal notification does not send, or an executive forecast is built on incomplete data. This role is the difference between a capable team and a team that reliably lands what it commits to. Key Responsibilities Jira Backlog Ownership and Delivery Governance (approximately 25%) Own the Revenue Operations project backlog in Jira as the single accountable person for its accuracy, structure, and currency. Maintain completeness of required fields on every ticket - assignee, effort, impact, ELT sponsor, functional sponsor, priority, target date, and confidence level - and run a regular triage cadence to close gaps rather than accumulate them. Run the team stand-ups, including agenda, follow-ups, and documented actions. Track delivery dates and confidence levels across the portfolio, and escalate items trending toward a slip early enough that the date can be defended or renegotiated deliberately. Produce the recurring delivery reporting used by Revenue Operations leadership and executive stakeholders, including weekly progress summaries and the monthly roadmap view organized by executive sponsor. Directly manage a defined subset of projects end to end - scoping, planning, coordination, delivery, and closeout. Maintain the distinction between business-as-usual requests and project work so that ad hoc demand does not silently consume roadmap capacity. Program Delivery Support Across Revenue Operations (approximately 75%) Partner with each Revenue Operations function to drive the projects they own, providing the project management discipline that allows specialists to stay focused on their discipline. Deal Desk - support quote-to-cash process improvements, CPQ and order form changes, bookings policy updates, and the coordination required across Sales, Legal, and Finance. Business Intelligence - coordinate dashboard and reporting delivery, including requirements capture, stakeholder review of wireframes, user acceptance, and launch communication. GTM Systems - support release planning and execution, including testing coordination, documentation, enablement, and post-release validation across Salesforce and the wider GTM stack. Sales Operations - support planning cycles, territory and quota coordination, forecasting process changes, and recurring commercial operating rhythms. GTM Strategy - support strategic programs and executive deliverables, including board, steering committee, and monthly operating review content coordination. Identify and drive resolution of cross-functional dependencies between these teams, which are frequently the real cause of delay rather than any single team s capacity. Stakeholder Coordination and Communication Act as the coordination point between Revenue Operations and its stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Partnerships. Schedule and drive the working sessions, reviews, and follow-ups that keep projects moving, and ensure the right people are present rather than merely invited. Hold stakeholders outside Revenue Operations accountable for their inputs, approvals, and testing commitments, escalating through the Director, GTM Strategy where required. Communicate status, changes, and delays clearly and early - no stakeholder should learn about a missed date from the absence of a deliverable. Ensure delivered work is communicated to the teams who benefit from it, so that improvements are adopted rather than unnoticed. Intake, Prioritization, and Capacity Support Operate the intake process for new Revenue Operations requests, ensuring each is captured with enough detail to be scoped and prioritized. Support the Director, GTM Strategy and VP, Revenue Operations in prioritization decisions by maintaining a current, accurate view of committed work and available capacity. When new priority work is accepted, document what is being deferred as a consequence so that trade-offs are explicit. Track effort and cycle time to build a defensible evidence base for future capacity and headcount planning. Process, Documentation, and Continuous Improvement Maintain project documentation, decision logs, runbooks, and process documentation so that knowledge does not sit exclusively with individuals. Define and improve the team s delivery standards, templates, and ways of working, including Jira configuration, workflows, and reporting views. Run retrospectives on significant deliveries and convert findings into changes to how the team operates. Identify opportunities to automate recurring project reporting and administration, including through AI tooling available to the team. Key Performance Outcomes Delivery Predictability Committed projects delivered by their agreed date, with on-time delivery tracked and reported month over month. Date changes are agreed in advance rather than discovered after the fact. Risks and blockers are raised with enough lead time to be acted on, not reported as explanations after a miss. Backlog Accuracy and Integrity Required fields complete across the backlog, with gaps closed on a defined cadence rather than accumulating. Jira reflects reality - leadership can rely on it without verifying against individuals. Backlog age and stale-ticket volume trending down against an agreed baseline. Leverage for the Team Measurable reduction in time senior specialists spend on project coordination, scheduling, and status reporting. Recurring reporting produced without manual assembly by directors or analysts. Cross-functional dependencies resolved without escalation to the VP, Revenue Operations in the majority of cases. Stakeholder Confidence Positive feedback from Revenue Operations functional leads and from stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. Stakeholders can answer where a request stands without asking, because status is visible and current. Delivered work is communicated and adopted, not shipped silently. Required Skills Experience Experience - Must have 10+ years in project management, program management, or delivery management, including ownership of concurrent cross-functional projects. Demonstrated hands-on ownership of Jira as the system of record for a delivery portfolio - not simply having used it, but having configured, maintained, and reported from it. Experience coordinating distributed teams across multiple time zones, including North America and EMEA. Experience running delivery cadences - stand-ups, sprint or roadmap reviews, retrospectives - and producing status reporting for senior audiences. Experience working directly with senior stakeholders, including the confidence to chase commitments and escalate constructively. Experience in a business systems, revenue operations, sales operations, or technology delivery environment. Excellent written communication in English, with the ability to summarize status and risk concisely. Experience - Nice to have Experience within a B2B SaaS go-to-market organization. Agile or Scrum delivery experience, including backlog grooming and sprint planning. Experience supporting Deal Desk, Business Intelligence, or CRM systems teams specifically. Experience in a post-merger or systems integration environment where priorities shift frequently. Experience building or improving an intake and prioritization process from a low baseline. Technical Skills - Must have Jira - boards, workflows, custom fields, JQL queries, filters, dashboards, and bulk import and export for backlog maintenance. Confluence or an equivalent documentation platform. Strong spreadsheet capability for backlog manipulation, effort tracking, and reporting. Slack or equivalent collaboration tooling, used for structured project communication rather than ad hoc messaging. Working understanding of CRM concepts and data structures sufficient to scope requests accurately and challenge vague requirements. Technical Skills - Nice to have Jira administration or configuration, including automation rules. Salesforce familiarity, including the release and sandbox lifecycle. Business intelligence tooling such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Tableau. Use of AI tooling to automate recurring reporting, summarization, and backlog analysis. 
 Competencies Self-directed - able to assess an unfamiliar environment, identify where to start, and begin delivering without waiting for a structured brief. Relentless follow-through. Nothing agreed in a meeting is allowed to quietly disappear. Comfort holding senior people to commitments without escalating unnecessarily or backing down when it matters. Sound judgement on what to escalate, when, and to whom. Calm and organized when priorities change mid-cycle, which they will. Bias toward clarity - clear dates, clear owners, clear next steps, and named trade-offs. Genuine interest in how a revenue organization operates, beyond the mechanics of project tracking. Certifications and/or Licenses PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project management certification - preferred. Atlassian Jira certification - nice to have. Bachelor s degree in business, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. Location and Working Hours Based in Pune, India, working in line with Showpad s hybrid working policy. Must maintain daily working overlap with EMEA and regular overlap with North America. Some meetings will fall in the early evening India time. Occasional international travel for team, planning, or stakeholder sessions.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
About the Role: We are seeking a Technical Marketing Project Manager to lead and coordinate digital marketing and web development initiatives across a large portfolio of corporate and marketing websites. This role will act as the bridge between technical and marketing teams, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate has experience managing website projects, digital campaigns, and cross-functional workflows in fast-paced environments. You will work closely with developers, SEO specialists, designers, content teams, and external vendors to support global marketing initiatives and platform optimization efforts. 
 Key Responsibilities: Project Coordination and Management Plan and execute website and digital marketing projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and marketing strategies. Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and risk assessments. Track progress across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring deadlines and budgets are met. Coordinate with Web Development Engineers, SEO Specialists, and Digital Marketing Specialists to align tasks and objectives. Facilitate clear and consistent communication between technical and marketing teams. Apply appropriate project management methodologies, including Agile and/or hybrid approaches, to support efficient planning, delivery, and continuous improvement. Use project management tools such as Monday.com and ClickUp to manage workflows and updates. Technical Support and Oversight Collaborate with Web Development Engineers to manage CMS updates, technical optimizations, and API integrations. Support technical audits and assist in implementing solutions to improve site performance and SEO. Coordinate with vendors and contractors to ensure technical deliverables meet project requirements. Oversee the deployment of landing pages, email templates, and campaign-specific web assets. Marketing Integration Work with marketing specialists to ensure project deliverables align with digital marketing goals, including lead generation, SEO performance, and social media campaigns. Support the execution of paid and organic search initiatives, ensuring smooth technical implementation. Facilitate the localization of campaigns, including coordinating translation workflows and localized content updates. Help optimize campaign assets such as landing pages and email templates for performance and usability. Reporting and Documentation Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, status reports, and post-project reviews. Track and report on key metrics related to project timelines, budget adherence, and performance outcomes. Analyze project data to identify opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with business, marketing, creative, technical, and external stakeholders to translate business requirements into actionable project plans. Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, and approvals throughout the project lifecycle. Serve as a central point of contact for technical and marketing teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and timelines. Schedule and facilitate meetings, including project kickoffs, status updates, and debriefs. Support stakeholder engagement by providing clear updates on project progress and addressing concerns. 
 Job requirements Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Marketing, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in project management, preferably within digital marketing or web development environments. Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp) and CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Drupal, HubSpot). Understanding of web development fundamentals, SEO best practices, and campaign deployment. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Experience working with international, cross-functional, and culturally diverse teams. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Fluent English 
 Nice to have: Basic knowledge of front-end and back-end development principles. Experience with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, or Moz. Familiarity with ABM strategies and global campaign localization. Work with international clients in the past Certifications such as PMP, CSM, or Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) are a plus.

title: Hardware Design Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Electronics Hardware Design Engineer to develop PCB designs for charge controllers used in EV chargers and power management systems. The ideal candidate will have expertise in high-speed PCB design, CAN communication, and other serial interfaces. This role involves schematic design, PCB layout, prototyping, and testing, ensuring compliance with industry standards. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Hardware Design & PCB Development: Design schematics and multilayer PCBs for EV charge controllers using tools like Altium Designer, KiCAD. Optimize PCB layouts for power handling, EMI/EMC compliance, thermal management, and signal integrity. 2. Communication Interfaces & Protocols: Integrate CAN (Controller Area Network), UART, RS-485, SPI, and I2C for reliable data exchange. Develop robust communication bus architectures for real-time monitoring and control of charge controllers. 3. Power & Analog Circuit Design: Implement current sensing (shunt, Hall sensors), RCD (Residual Current Device), and fault detection mechanisms. Design DC-DC converters, SMPS, power monitoring circuits, and charger protection systems. 4. Prototyping, Testing & Validation: Conduct PCB bring-up, debugging, and hardware validation using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and network analyzers. Perform EMI/EMC testing, surge protection testing, and thermal analysis. 5. Compliance & Safety Standards: Ensure PCB designs meet IEC, UL, and ISO safety standards for EV charging applications. Implement ESD protection, isolation techniques, and regulatory compliance in hardware designs. 6. Collaboration & Documentation: Work with cross-functional teams (firmware, mechanical, and power electronics engineers) to ensure seamless system integration. Prepare detailed design documentation, BOM (Bill of Materials), and test reports. 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Education: Bachelor's/Masters in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Embedded Systems. Experience: 0-6 years in hardware design, PCB development, and EV charger electronics (preferred). PCB Design Tools: Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, ORCAD, PADS, etc. Communication Protocols: CAN, CAN FD, UART, SPI, I2C, RS-485, MODBUS. Power Electronics: Experience with DC-DC converters, SMPS, surge protection, relays/contactors. Testing & Debugging: Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters, CAN analyzers, EMI/EMC compliance testing. Experience in EV charging systems (AC/DC chargers, OCPP integration). Familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, TI, NXP) and real-time systems. Hands-on experience with thermal management and reliability testing.

Manage Docker image repositories and registries, including access controls, image tagging, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Monitor security advisories and CVEs, and proactively update or rebuild affected images.
Implement image signing, provenance verification, and software supply chain security controls where applicable.
Collaborate with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to resolve container security issues.
Automate security checks, image validation, and remediation workflows using scripting and DevSecOps tools.
Maintain technical documentation, security assessment reports, remediation records, and compliance evidence.

It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team. 
 Position Overview: The System Administrator” is responsible for maintaining smooth day-to-day IT operations across the organization. This role covers end-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function. 
 Key Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests. Complete daily preventive checks across the office — verifying that IT hardware, servers, UPS, and internet links are up, both physically and logically — and act on any deviation. Manage the user account lifecycle — email IDs, AD accounts, distribution lists and group memberships, password resets, and access provisioning and revocation during onboarding and exit. Test and deploy Windows and third-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures. Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data-loss-prevention alerts, and validate licence terms for software approval requests. Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity. Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and facility requirements — obtaining and comparing quotes, securing approvals, releasing purchase orders, and following up until delivery and installation. Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team. title: Senior Engineer NPI
description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager / Manager NPI Engineering Department: Manufacturing Engineering
 Reports To: Senior Manager / Head – Engineering / Operations
 Experience: 8 - 10 Years
 Industry: Electronics Manufacturing / EMS Job Summary The Assistant Manager / Manager – NPI Engineering will be responsible for leading and managing the New Product Introduction (NPI) function, driving the successful transition of new electronic products from design and development into stable, scalable, and cost-effective mass production. The role will lead NPI activities across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement, and customer teams, ensuring product and process readiness within defined timelines, quality standards, and cost targets. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing, PCBA, SMT, through-hole assembly, box build, process engineering, DFM/DFT, and NPI execution, along with demonstrated experience in managing cross-functional teams and customer-facing NPI projects. Key Responsibilities 1. NPI Leadership & Project Management Lead and manage end-to-end NPI activities from project kick-off through pilot builds, validation, ramp-up, and mass production. Establish NPI project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements. Drive multiple NPI projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to quality, cost, delivery, and engineering requirements. Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers during the NPI execution phase , coordinating technical discussions, project updates, risks, and action plans. Review customer engineering data, drawings, BOMs, Gerber files, CAD data, specifications, and assembly requirements. Identify technical, manufacturing, material, and capacity risks at an early stage and drive mitigation plans. Conduct regular NPI project reviews with internal and external stakeholders. 2. Product & Process Engineering Lead DFM/DFT reviews and provide manufacturing inputs during the product development stage. Ensure products are designed for efficient manufacturing, assembly, inspection, and testing. Define and establish optimized manufacturing processes for SMT, through-hole, PCBA, cable assembly, box build, and final assembly. Develop process flow, work instructions, process parameters, inspection criteria, and manufacturing documentation. Lead process validation and ensure process capability and stability prior to mass production. Support development of tooling, fixtures, stencils, test fixtures, jigs, and other manufacturing aids. 3. Production Readiness & NPI Launch Drive complete manufacturing readiness for prototype, EVT/DVT/PVT, pilot, and mass-production builds, as applicable. Lead First Article / pilot production builds and ensure timely closure of all build-related issues. Analyze defects, yield losses, process deviations, and manufacturing issues during early builds. Coordinate with Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth production ramp-up. Establish production readiness checklists and ensure closure of all open actions before mass production release. Monitor NPI performance against agreed KPIs such as yield, cycle time, cost, quality, and launch timelines. 4. BOM, Engineering Data & Change Management Review and validate BOMs for completeness, accuracy, manufacturability, and ERP/MRP alignment. Ensure correct material structures, alternates, component specifications, and assembly requirements are established. Lead implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), product revisions, and process changes. Ensure engineering and manufacturing documentation is controlled and released through the appropriate PLM/ERP systems. Coordinate with customers and internal engineering teams on drawing, BOM, specification, and revision-related changes. 5. Customer & Cross-Functional Management Establish strong technical and professional relationships with customers during NPI and product transfer activities. Lead technical discussions related to manufacturability, process capability, quality, tooling, testing, and production readiness. Coordinate with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Production, and Test Engineering teams. Communicate project status, technical risks, resource requirements, issues, and recovery plans to senior management. Ensure timely escalation and resolution of critical NPI issues. 6. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop the NPI Engineering team. Allocate resources across multiple NPI projects based on project priorities and business requirements. Set objectives, monitor performance, and provide technical and functional guidance to team members. Build a strong culture of ownership, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Identify training and competency-development requirements within the NPI Engineering team. Support recruitment and capability development of NPI/process engineering resources. 7. Process Improvement & Cost Optimization Identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, productivity, quality, yield, and overall manufacturing cost. Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for NPI and early-production issues. Drive process optimization using appropriate problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and FMEA. Lead initiatives related to Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, waste reduction, cycle-time improvement, and process standardization. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement during NPI development. 8. Quality, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure NPI processes comply with applicable customer requirements, engineering standards, and quality management systems. Drive PFMEA, Control Plan, process validation, and related manufacturing quality activities. Ensure compliance with applicable IPC standards, including IPC-A-610. Support audits and customer assessments related to NPI and manufacturing engineering. Proactively identify and mitigate product, process, material, tooling, and production risks. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in Electronics Manufacturing / PCBA / NPI Engineering , with demonstrated experience in leading NPI projects and teams. Strong experience in an EMS / Electronics Manufacturing environment is preferred. Proven experience managing end-to-end NPI activities from engineering data review through mass production. title: Senior Manager
description:
Job Description Senior Manager Global Regulatory Affairs to lead regulatory activities for peptide and complex generic products across the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, and Emerging Markets. The role will be responsible for developing and executing global regulatory strategies, leading dossier submissions and health authority responses, supporting scientific advice and pre-submission interactions, and managing the regulatory lifecycle of products across multiple markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in CTD/eCTD submissions, ANDAs, EU/UK regulatory procedures, global registrations, regulatory strategy, CMC documentation, health authority interactions, and post-approval lifecycle management. Experience with peptide products, complex injectables, or other complex generic products is highly desirable. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Global Regulatory Strategy & Submissions • Develop and execute regulatory strategies for peptide and complex generic products across the US, EU, UK, and Emerging Markets. • Lead review and submission of regulatory dossiers in CTD, eCTD, ACTD, and country-specific formats, as applicable. • Drive regulatory planning from development through submission, approval, launch readiness, and post-approval lifecycle management. • Assess country-specific regulatory requirements, submission pathways, documentation gaps, and potential regulatory risks. • Ensure high-quality and timely submissions in accordance with applicable health authority requirements and committed project timelines . 2. Cross-Functional Regulatory Leadership • Coordinate closely with R&D/Formulation Development, Analytical Development, QA, QC, Manufacturing, Clinical/BE, Supply Chain, Program Management, Commercial, and other stakeholders to obtain regulatory submission documentation. Review documents received from cross-functional teams for adequacy, completeness, scientific consistency, and regulatory compliance before incorporation into regulatory dossiers. • Provide regulatory guidance to development and CMC teams to ensure that development programs and supporting documentation are aligned with target market requirements. • Identify potential regulatory gaps and risks early and facilitate appropriate mitigation plans with relevant stakeholders. 3. Health Authority Queries & Regulatory Interactions • Develop strategies for effective and timely responses to health authority deficiencies, information requests, and regulatory queries. • Review and approve responses prepared by cross-functional teams to ensure scientific accuracy, consistency with the submitted dossier, and regulatory compliance. • Coordinate multidisciplinary response teams and facilitate closure of agency queries within regulatory timelines. • Support review, and coordination of FDA Pre-ANDA meetings, Scientific Advice meetings, and other health authority interactions, as applicable. 4. Product Lifecycle Management • Lead regulatory activities associated with renewals, variations, supplements, amendments, annual reporting, and other post-approval changes across global markets. • Review and approve change controls and assess regulatory impact across affected markets. • Determine appropriate implementation and submission strategies for post approval changes in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. • Review regulatory approval packages and communicate approval conditions, commitments, and implementation requirements to cross-functional teams. 5. US Regulatory Activities • Provide regulatory oversight for ANDA submissions and post-approval regulatory activities for the US market. • Coordinate regulatory fee-related activities, including GDUFA cover sheets for ANDA-related fees, facility fees, and program fees, where applicable. • Support coordination of regulatory agency, consultant, and partner-related payments. • Contribute to regulatory strategy and documentation for Pre-ANDA interactions and other FDA engagements. 6. EU & UK Regulatory Activities • Support and manage applicable EU and UK submission procedures, including national and multi-country regulatory activities. • Coordinate national-phase submission activities following European procedures, including collaboration with local regulatory consultants and translation vendors. • Oversee documentation required for renewals, variations, post-approval commitments, and lifecycle management activities. • Facilitate implementation of approvals across relevant EU/UK markets. 7. Emerging-Market Registrations • Lead dossier preparation and country-specific submission activities for Emerging Markets in accordance with applicable CTD, ACTD, or national requirements. • Coordinate country-specific documentation, samples, legalization, translations, certificates, and other registration requirements, as applicable. • Ensure timely submission of registration samples required by health authorities. • Coordinate with local regulatory representatives, partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders to support submission and approval activities. 8. Regulatory Compliance & Systems • Ensure timely and accurate updates to Regulatory Information Management Systems (RIMS), including submission records, deficiency tracking, approval information, document archives, and dossier trackers. • Maintain appropriate regulatory records and ensure traceability of submissions, correspondence, commitments, and approvals. • Review documentation supporting GMP applications and manufacturing/site related regulatory submissions, as applicable. • Ensure regulatory commitments and agency requirements are appropriately tracked through closure. 
 Qualification & Experience • M.Pharm / M.Sc. / Pharm.D. / Ph.D. or equivalent qualification in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. • Approximately 12-15 years of experience in pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs, preferably encompassing global markets. • Strong hands-on experience with submissions and lifecycle management for the US, EU, UK, and Emerging Markets. • Experience with peptide products, complex generics, injectable products, or technically complex drug products is strongly preferred. • Good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements, CTD/eCTD dossier structure, ANDA requirements, EU/UK regulatory procedures, and post-approval change management. • Experience in managing regulatory authority queries and multidisciplinary response teams. • Experience with FDA Pre-ANDA meetings, Scientific Advice, or other health authority interactions would be an advantage. Key Competencies • Strong global regulatory strategy and regulatory science orientation. • Sound understanding of peptide and complex generic product development challenges. • Excellent dossier review and technical writing capabilities. • Strong analytical and regulatory problem-solving skills. • Ability to interpret evolving regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable development or submission strategies. • Proven capability to manage multiple products, markets, submissions, and competing timelines. • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management and influencing skills. • Ability to independently drive complex regulatory assignments and escalate critical risks appropriately. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

description:
