Establish and maintain product configuration baselines throughout the equipment lifecycle. How you'll make an impact: Engineering Change Management Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes. Evaluate the impact of design changes on installed fleets, manufacturing, suppliers, and service organizations. Coordinate approval workflows for design modifications and product updates. Maintain traceability of engineering changes throughout the product lifecycle. Implementation and validation of approved changes. Manage obsolescence and replacement strategies for components and assemblies. Product Data Governance Establish standards for product data quality, naming conventions, part numbering, and documentation. Govern master product data and associated technical documentation. Ensure consistency between CAD models, drawings, specifications, BOMs, and released documentation. Conduct regular audits to verify configuration accuracy and completeness. Drive data quality improvements and corrective actions. Configuration Baseline Management Define and maintain released product baselines. Manage configuration identification for transformer designs, accessories, controls, bushings, tap changers, cooling systems, protection systems, and digital solutions. Ensure product configurations are uniquely identifiable and traceable. Control revisions, versions, and release status of engineering deliverables. Maintain historical configuration records for regulatory, quality, and service requirements. Installed Base & Fleet Management Maintain as-built, as-tested, and as-installed configurations for customer equipment. Track field modifications, upgrades, retrofits, repairs, and modernization initiatives. Support lifecycle management of installed transformer fleets. Ensure service organizations have access to accurate configuration records. Provide configuration traceability for warranty, reliability, and root cause investigations. Compliance & Quality Ensure configuration processes comply with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements. Support ISO quality management requirements related to design control and configuration management. Maintain audit-ready records for customers, regulators, and certification bodies. Support product certification and qualification activities. Partner with Quality to investigate configuration-related nonconformances. Digital Engineering & Systems Integration Drive integration between PLM, CAD, ERP, MES, service systems, and digital engineering platforms. Establish digital thread capabilities across the product lifecycle. Enable digital twin and asset lifecycle initiatives through accurate configuration data. Support automation of configuration workflows and change processes. Define system requirements and enhancements to improve lifecycle data management. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as the central coordination point between Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Service, and Product Management. Facilitate configuration review boards and change control boards. Support new product introductions and technology deployments. Coordinate product lifecycle strategies including sustainment and end-of-life planning. Provide configuration management expertise to engineering project teams. Analytics & Continuous Improvement Develop configuration management KPIs and performance dashboards. Monitor engineering change cycle times and process effectiveness. Analyze recurring configuration issues and drive corrective actions. Identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and automation. Champion best practices in lifecycle and configuration management across Services Engineering. Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Partner with Product Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Sourcing teams to execute supplier development projects that align with business objectives and growth priorities. Lead implementation and compliance activities related to Production Part Approval Process requirements where applicable. Evaluate supplier manufacturing readiness, scalability, and operational effectiveness to support current and future business needs. Identify potential supply chain risks and implement mitigation plans that support business continuity and customer satisfaction. Drive supplier consolidation and optimization strategies by strengthening relationships with high-performing suppliers and identifying new sourcing opportunities. Deliver measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, productivity, capacity, and supplier responsiveness across the supply base. Who You Are: 
 You build strong partnerships and work collaboratively across functions, suppliers, and regions to achieve shared objectives. You make sound decisions by analyzing information, evaluating risks, and balancing short-term priorities with long-term business goals. You actively seek opportunities to improve processes, challenge conventional approaches, and drive innovative solutions that enhance performance. You develop effective plans, maintain accountability for results, and adapt to changing business needs while helping others succeed through clear communication, influence, and collaboration. Knowledge of supplier quality systems, manufacturing processes, and supply chain management principles. Experience working with machined, molded, and purchased components or comparable manufacturing categories. Ability to evaluate supplier capability, capacity, performance, and operational readiness. Understanding of continuous improvement methodologies, structured problem-solving approaches, and root cause analysis techniques. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Experience supporting new product introduction, supplier transitions, localization programs, or strategic sourcing initiatives. Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, First Article Inspection requirements, and supplier qualification processes. Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, operational excellence, or continuous improvement programs within supplier networks. Knowledge of supply risk management, supplier development frameworks, and global sourcing strategies. Experience working within a multinational manufacturing organization and collaborating with geographically dispersed teams. Professional certifications related to quality, operations, supply chain, or continuous improvement are valued. Demonstrated success achieving measurable improvements in supplier quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost performance. Our Culture and Commitment To You:

We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

Job Summary The opportunity: Senior Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad AMI: The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure. CNS - Risk - Process & Controls : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses. Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence Execute internal audit, risk advisory and controls assessment engagements across various business functions and industries. Develop an understanding of client business models, key processes, operational workflows and associated risks to support effective engagement delivery. Perform process walkthroughs, risk assessments, control testing and substantive procedures in accordance with EY methodology. Analyse financial, operational and transactional data to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps and improvement opportunities. Prepare high-quality working papers, process documentation, risk and control matrices (RCMs), report and other client deliverables. Support the review of policies, procedures and governance frameworks to assess compliance with internal and external requirements. Collaborate effectively with engagement teams and client stakeholders while demonstrating problem-solving skills and a commitment to continuous learning. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

title: Engineer , Sr Engineer - Test  ATE RF
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION RF ATE TEST ENGINEER Department: Test Development Services (TDS)
 Function: Semiconductor Test Development / IC Testing
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
 Experience: 3–14 Years
 Position Code: RF_01 : RF ATE Test Engineer (3-5 Years exp. ) Position Code: RF_02 : Sr RF ATE Test Engineer (5-14 years)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To develop, debug, characterize, and optimize Automated Test Equipment (ATE) test solutions for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal semiconductor devices. The role will support the complete product lifecycle, from first-silicon bring-up and characterization to production test release, yield improvement, and high-volume manufacturing. 2. Key Responsibilities A. ATE Test Development Develop, debug, and optimize production test programs for RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal ICs. Design and implement test solutions using Advantest V93K (SmarTest 8 preferred) or Teradyne UltraFLEX/J750 platforms. Develop and maintain test methodologies to ensure accurate, repeatable, and reliable device measurements. Support test program optimization, test coverage improvement, and production test-time reduction. B. Product Characterization and Validation Support first-silicon bring-up, device characterization, production test development, qualification, and production release. Execute characterization across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) conditions. Develop and characterize RF, Analog, and Mixed-Signal circuit blocks, including: Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) Digital-to-Analog Converters (DACs) Oscillators and timing devices Power management circuits RF transceivers and related IPs Correlate ATE measurements with laboratory bench measurements and validation results. C. RF Measurement and Data Analysis Perform RF characterization and testing involving frequency, output power, phase noise, harmonics, linearity, and sensitivity, as applicable to the device under test. Analyze characterization data and identify performance trends, outliers, and potential failure mechanisms. Use data analysis tools such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, or JMP to support engineering decisions. D. Debugging and Yield Improvement Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Drive yield improvement, test coverage enhancement, and product quality initiatives. Identify opportunities to optimize test time and reduce manufacturing costs without compromising quality or reliability. Support production ramp-up and resolve ATE-related issues in high-volume manufacturing environments. E. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate with Design, Product Engineering, Validation, Applications, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development cycle. Prepare test specifications, characterization reports, test documentation, and production release packages. Support product qualification, release readiness, and ongoing manufacturing improvements. 3. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor ATE test development, preferably involving RF, Analog, or Mixed-Signal products. Hands-on experience with at least one of the following ATE platforms: Advantest V93K – SmarTest 8 preferred Teradyne UltraFLEX / J750 Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, analog and digital electronics, mixed-signal testing, and semiconductor device characterization. title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Life at Ness At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a jobits a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter. 
 The Role We are looking for a hands-on Big Data Engineer with deep experience in developing and managing large-scale data platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong Spark, Python/Scala development skills, and solid understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem. Youll work in Agile teams on financial, analytical, and innovation-driven data productsdriving performance optimization, new development, and platform operations. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop big data solutions using Apache Spark, Hadoop, and cloud-native tools Write efficient batch and stream processing pipelines in Python and/or Scala Maintain and optimize data workflows and performance across large data volumes Manage source control, versioning, and deployments using Git, Jenkins, and other DevOps tools Conduct performance tuning, system monitoring, and issue resolution Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to align technical delivery with use cases Work with Cloudera Hadoop and manage activities like node configuration, file system maintenance, and backups Follow best practices across software development, code quality, and agile ceremonies Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring junior developers Support and enhance production environments, including disaster recovery planning 
 Qualifications and Skills 
 Core Skills 610 years of experience in big data development and operations Strong programming expertise in Python and/or Scala Hands-on with Apache Spark, Hadoop, Cloudera, Hive, and HDFS Proficiency with SQL, NoSQL, Oracle, and scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys) Experience in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and distributed systems Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, Ansible, and agile delivery models 
 Nice to Have Java development background Financial domain experience Knowledge of cloud data solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices Cloudera Hadoop Admin certification (for hybrid roles involving infra) Hands-on development in fast-paced environments Led small teams or initiatives within distributed systems projects Supported large-scale production platforms Strong communicator who can work across business and engineering teams 
 Why Join Us At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to applyeven if you dont meet every requirement, wed love to connect with you if this role excites you. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team members unique talents. With flexible remote options, diverse projects, and access to development resources, joining Ness means building a career that’s meaningful and impactful. 
 What to Expect Next We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply": 1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations 2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience 3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team 4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time. 
 Ready to Start Your Journey?

title: Engineer II To Senior Engineer | Project Planning & Controls
description:
Job Summary Overview The Project & Programme Services (PPS) team is a critical component of the Global Project & Programme Management Office (GPMO). The team delivers predictable and efficient project performance management, reporting, and business intelligence across global portfolios. Operating from the Global Technology Centre (GTC) in India, PPS provides cost-effective, agile, and scalable programme services using an onshore-offshore delivery model. Our ambition is to become the global leader in Programme Management Services by building a future-ready, digitally enabled, high-performing team. This position may be offered as either a contract-to-hire or a regular full-time role, depending on your overall experience and the technical competencies demonstrated during the interview process. We are seeking an experienced Planning & Project Controls professional to support the successful delivery of complex projects across Process, Manufacturing & Production, Energy, Pharma, Infrastructure, Transportation (Rail, Highways, and Aviation) sectors. The role combines expertise in planning, scheduling, cost management, project controls, reporting and performance monitoring to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget while meeting client and business objectives. Your Role Planning & Scheduling Develop, maintain, and control integrated project schedules using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and other planning tools. Establish and manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), activity sequencing, logic links, resource loading, and schedule baselines. Prepare detailed look-ahead schedules and monitor progress against approved baselines. Conduct Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis, schedule performance analysis, and delay analysis. Identify schedule risks and opportunities and develop mitigation and recovery plans. Support change management processes and update Performance Measurement Baselines (PMB) for approved scope and schedule changes. description:
Job Purpose To lead and manage the procurement function for ICS Foods, ensuring the timely, cost-effective, and quality-driven sourcing of raw materials, ingredients, packaging materials, consumables, engineering spares, and other operational requirements. The role will focus on cost optimization, supplier development, inventory availability, quality compliance, and uninterrupted production operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 A. Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with production plans, business requirements, and company objectives. Manage end-to-end purchasing of food ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, consumables, and other operational supplies. Identify, evaluate, negotiate with, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors. Obtain competitive quotations, conduct price comparisons, and negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial conditions. Ensure timely procurement to avoid production delays and material shortages. Develop alternate sources of supply to minimize procurement risks and dependency on individual vendors. B. Cost Control & Savings Drive cost reduction through strategic sourcing, bulk purchasing, rate contracts, and supplier negotiations. Monitor commodity price trends, market movements, and changes in raw material costs. Prepare and track procurement budgets, purchase cost reports, and savings initiatives. Analyze purchase price variances and take corrective actions to control procurement expenditure. C. Supplier Management Establish and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and service providers. Conduct supplier evaluations based on quality, price, delivery performance, reliability, and service. Monitor vendor performance and resolve issues related to delayed supplies, price discrepancies, and material quality. Coordinate supplier audits and assessments in collaboration with the Quality Assurance team. D. Food Safety & Quality Compliance Ensure purchased materials comply with approved specifications, food safety requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. Coordinate with Quality Assurance for supplier approval, material specifications, certificates of analysis, and other required documentation. Ensure appropriate traceability and documentation for ingredients and packaging materials. Support compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements, HACCP, GMP, and other relevant food safety systems, as applicable to the business. Ensure non-conforming materials are addressed through appropriate supplier corrective actions and replacement procedures. E. Inventory & Production Coordination Coordinate with Production, Planning, Stores, Quality Assurance, Finance, and Logistics teams to ensure material availability. Plan purchases based on production schedules, demand forecasts, stock levels, lead times, and minimum order quantities. Monitor inventory levels to prevent stockouts, overstocking, expiry, and material obsolescence. Support effective inventory control through reorder levels, safety stock planning, and periodic stock reviews. F. Purchase Operations & Documentation Oversee purchase requisitions, requests for quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, and order tracking. Ensure purchases are made as per approved budgets, authorization limits, and company procurement policies. Maintain accurate vendor databases, contracts, price lists, and procurement records. Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for invoice verification, purchase order matching, payment follow-ups, and vendor reconciliations. Develop periodic procurement reports and present key performance indicators to management. G. Team Management & Process Improvement Lead, guide, and develop the purchase team to achieve departmental objectives. Establish standard operating procedures and improve procurement processes. Promote ethical purchasing practices, transparency, accountability, and compliance with company policies. Identify opportunities to improve procurement systems, reporting, and digital purchasing workflows. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Procurement cost savings against approved budgets and benchmarks. On-time delivery of materials to meet production requirements. Material stockout frequency and production losses attributable to procurement. Supplier quality performance and rejection rates. Purchase price variance and adherence to negotiated rates. Inventory holding levels and reduction in excess or expired stock. Purchase order processing turnaround time. Supplier performance and compliance with approved procurement procedures. 4. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA in Supply Chain Management or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. Approximately 812 years of relevant experience in purchase, procurement, or strategic sourcing, preferably in food manufacturing, food processing, FMCG, or a related industry. Prior experience handling raw materials, food ingredients, packaging materials, and manufacturing procurement is preferred. Experience in vendor development, commercial negotiations, cost control, inventory planning, and procurement reporting. Working knowledge of ERP systems, inventory management, and Microsoft Excel. 5. Required Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and commercial decision-making skills. Excellent supplier relationship and vendor development capabilities. Analytical skills for cost evaluation, market research, and price benchmarking. Sound understanding of procurement processes and inventory management. Knowledge of food industry quality, safety, and regulatory requirements. Strong coordination, communication, and team leadership skills. High standards of integrity, accountability, and professional ethics. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under production deadlines.

title: Manager/Senior Manager- Minting (In house packing card production)
description:
About MMTCPAMP: MMTCPAMP is Indias first and only LBMA-accredited Gold & Silver refinery , renowned globally for its quality, integrity, and technological excellence. It is a joint venture between PAMP SA, Switzerland, and MMTC Ltd., a Government of India Undertaking . Established in 2008, the company operates one of the worlds most advanced precious metals refining and minting facilities , offering 999.9 pure gold and silver products crafted with Swiss precision and Indian artistry. 
 Official Website: https://www.mmtcpamp.com/ [mmtcpamp.com] 
 Role Overview: The Senior Manager Minting will lead the in-house Tool Room and Die Making workshop supporting packing card production, owning die design, manufacture, and maintenance end to end. The role combines hands-on die-making craft with CAD/CAM-driven tooling development, and leads a team of 20+ tool room engineers. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the in-house Tool Room / Die Making workshop operations for packing card (minting) production. Own the design, development, and maintenance of dies, tools, and fixtures used in packing card production. Provide technical leadership, coaching, and performance management for a team of 20+ tool room engineers. Drive CAD/CAM-based die and tool design using NX CAD, NX CAM, Carveco, and related software. Oversee CNC Lathe, VMC, Wire-cut, and EDM programming and machine operations for tool and die manufacture. Coordinate with production, quality, and maintenance teams to align tooling plans with production schedules. Plan and manage the tool room's budget, spares, and consumables. Drive continuous improvement in die design, machining processes, and tool life. Ensure the tool room follows safety standards and practices. Maintain documentation for tool/die designs, drawings, and process records. 
 Qualifications & Experience B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. 1215 years of overall experience, with a minimum of 5 years hands-on in a Tool Room Workshop. Robust core knowledge of the Die Making process, with hands-on experience built in the first 3–5 years of their career. Minimum 10 years' experience leading an industrial tool room, managing a team of 20+ engineers. 2–3 years of experience in the Printing industry is preferred. Must be located near the plant and flexible to reach the workshop on an urgent, 24x7 basis for tooling breakdown situations. 
 Preferred Technical Skills & Software Knowledge: Application Purpose NX CAD – engineering design NX CAM – programming Elcam Wire cut Carveco 3D relief designing E Cam V1 3D laser Rhino Laser programming AutoCAD 2D design Also preferred: VMC programming, Wire-cut programming, EDM programming, and CNC Lathe programming.

description:

 Direct Responsibilities Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular). Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance. Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions. Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration. Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery. Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization. Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube. Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Contributing Responsibilities Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery Contribute to improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team Technical & Behavioral Competencies Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred) Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team Specific Qualifications: Experience Level: 6+ years 4+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale 4+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills. Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow Domain Experience: Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities) Technical Skills: Required Skill Group Core Java & JDK 21+ Modern language features records, sealed classes, pattern matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional). Concurrency & Parallelism virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives. JVM & GC tuning G1/ZGC behavior, heap dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module system (JPMS) usage. Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling Build & Unit test foundation Maven/Gradle multi module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native image awareness. Spring Ecosystem Spring Boot 3.x create micro service skeletons, auto configuration, actuator health checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2)., Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation. Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API gateway pattern, externalised config (Config Server), and circuit breaker (Resilience4j). Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration Spring Security fundamentals – CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource server setup, basic role based access control, and token validation. Database & Data Access Engineering SQL & query optimization – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL). ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints. NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache aside), basic data modeling, and TTL/eviction policies. Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation level choices. Design & Architecture Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports and adapters, dependency inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring. Domain Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing. API first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer driven contract testing (Pact). Event driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation. Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security. Awareness around: Microservices design Pattern Concepts like - Circuit breaker, load balancer DevOps Containerization & K8s – Docker multi stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes. CI/CD pipeline basics – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static analysis steps; artefact publishing. Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK. Testing & Quality Engineering 1. Test pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact). 2. Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results. 3. Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set. title: Assistant Welfare Manager (Immediate Joiner, Garment Manufacturing)
description:
Position: Assistant Manager, Welfare
 Industry: Garment Manufacturing
 Department: HR / Welfare
 Gender: Female
 Location: Bengaluru
 Reporting To: HR Manager / Factory Head 
 1. Job Purpose To manage and strengthen employee welfare activities at the garment manufacturing facility, ensuring a safe, supportive, compliant, and employee-friendly workplace, with particular focus on the needs of women employees. The role will be responsible for employee welfare facilities, grievance handling, statutory welfare requirements, employee engagement, counselling/support, and coordination with internal departments and external agencies. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Absenteeism, Attrition & Employee Retention Management Monitor and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly absenteeism and attrition trends. Identify root causes of absenteeism and employee turnover through employee interactions, feedback, stay interviews and exit interviews. Track department-wise, line-wise, shift-wise and tenure-wise absenteeism and attrition. Identify high-risk employees and groups and take proactive retention measures. Follow up with frequent/long-absent employees and understand their concerns to support their return to work. Conduct regular employee connect sessions to identify and resolve workplace and welfare-related concerns. Develop and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives, particularly for women employees. Coordinate with HR, Production, and supervisors to address issues related to work environment, supervisors, transport, canteen, accommodation, working hours, and other welfare concerns. Monitor early attrition, particularly employee exits within the first 30/60/90 days, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare regular absenteeism, attrition, and retention MIS reports and present key findings and action plans to management. Measure the effectiveness of retention initiatives and continuously recommend improvements to reduce absenteeism and attrition. 
 B. Employee Welfare & Facilities Manage day-to-day employee welfare activities within the factory. Ensure availability and proper maintenance of welfare facilities such as: Canteen Drinking water Rest areas Washrooms Changing rooms First-aid facilities Transport facilities Childcare/crche facilities, where applicable Conduct regular welfare-facility inspections and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure welfare facilities are clean, hygienic, safe and accessible to employees. 
 C. Women Employee Welfare Act as a key point of contact for women employees regarding welfare-related concerns. Handle women employees' grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality. Support awareness initiatives related to workplace safety, dignity and respectful behaviour. Coordinate with relevant committees and management on matters concerning women employees. Support implementation and awareness of the organisation's POSH policy and related processes. Monitor issues affecting women employees and escalate serious concerns to HR management. 
 D. Employee Grievance Handling Receive, understand, and document employee grievances. Conduct employee interaction sessions and floor-level feedback activities. Coordinate with HR, Production, Compliance, and other departments to resolve grievances. Maintain proper records of grievances and closure status. Identify recurring employee issues and recommend preventive actions. 
 E. Statutory & Social Compliance Support HR/Compliance teams in meeting applicable labour and welfare requirements. Maintain welfare-related records and documentation required for audits and inspections. Coordinate preparation for customer/social-compliance audits. Ensure welfare practices are implemented in line with company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Support inspections by government authorities and other external agencies when required. 
 F. Employee Engagement Plan and coordinate employee engagement and welfare activities. Organise events and programmes such as:
 Employee awareness programmes Health and wellness activities Women's Day programmes Sports and cultural activities Employee recognition programmes Festival celebrations Counselling / awareness sessions Promote positive employee relations and improve employee participation. 
 G. Communication & Awareness Conduct regular employee awareness sessions on welfare-related topics. Communicate HR and welfare initiatives effectively to employees. Coordinate toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and employee meetings. Ensure employees understand available welfare facilities and support systems. 
 H. Employee Support & Counselling Maintain regular interaction with employees at the shop-floor level. Identify employee concerns relating to work environment, accommodation, transport, canteen, health, safety or personal difficulties. Provide basic counselling/support within the scope of the role and escalate sensitive or serious matters appropriately. Maintain confidentiality of employee information. 
 I. Reporting & Documentation Prepare periodic welfare reports for management. Track welfare complaints, actions and closure. Maintain records of welfare activities, inspections, meetings and employee engagement programmes. Analyse employee feedback and recommend improvements. Provide MIS reports to the HR Manager / Factory Head as required. 
 3. Key Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good employee-handling and grievance-management skills. Empathy and patience when dealing with employees. Strong understanding of workplace welfare practices. Ability to communicate effectively with women employees and shop-floor workers. Good coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good documentation and reporting skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams. Basic knowledge of MS Office / Excel / HR systems. 
 4. Qualification Master's degree in HR, Social Work, Labour Welfare, MBA or related discipline. 
 5. Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in employee welfare / HR/labour welfare, preferably in the garment, textile, manufacturing or factory environment . Experience handling a predominantly female workforce will be an advantage. Experience in social-compliance audits and employee grievance handling is preferred. 
 6. Preferred Knowledge Employee welfare practices Labour welfare requirements Grievance handling Women employee welfare POSH awareness and process coordination Social compliance requirements Factory welfare facilities Employee engagement Basic HR documentation and MIS Audit preparation and documentation 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely closure of employee grievances. Employee satisfaction with welfare facilities. Welfare facility inspection and corrective-action closure. Employee engagement and participation levels. Compliance with welfare-related requirements. Audit observations and timely closure. Effectiveness of employee communication and awareness programmes. Reduction in recurring employee welfare complaints. 
 8. Personal Attributes The candidate should be: Mature and responsible Approachable and empathetic Trustworthy and confidential Assertive when required Patient and calm under pressure Proactive in identifying employee issues Comfortable interacting with shop-floor employees Capable of handling sensitive employee matters professionally 
 Note: The position involves regular interaction with employees and may require frequent movement across the factory floor and welfare facilities.

Key Skills: Communication Skills,Employee Relations,Employee Engagement,Grievance Management,HR Policies,Disciplinary Proceedings,Posh,Labour Laws

title: Head of HR
description:
Head of HR Human Resources 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Head of HR to lead the overall human resources function for a growing, mid-sized organisation. The role will partner closely with the CEO and senior leadership team to develop and execute people strategies, strengthen organisational culture, build leadership capabilities, and establish scalable HR processes. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong experience across strategic HR business partnering, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee engagement, HR operations, and statutory compliance. The candidate should be commercially oriented, comfortable advising senior leadership, and capable of building a high-performing HR function that supports business growth. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic HR & Business Partnering Develop and implement a comprehensive HR strategy aligned with organisational goals. Partner with the CEO and leadership team on workforce planning, organisation design, restructuring, and change management. Develop people strategies that improve productivity, engagement, retention, and organisational effectiveness. Present HR metrics, workforce insights, and recommendations to senior management. 2. Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Lead recruitment strategy across leadership, managerial, and critical business positions. Build scalable recruitment processes, structured interviews, and candidate assessment frameworks. Improve time-to-hire, quality-of-hire, offer acceptance, and employee retention. Strengthen employer branding and talent sourcing strategies. 3. Performance Management & Compensation Design and manage performance appraisal systems, goal setting, feedback, and performance calibration. Develop compensation structures, salary bands, grading frameworks, and variable-pay policies. Establish career progression, internal mobility, and succession planning frameworks. Support leadership hiring, assessment, and long-term incentive initiatives where applicable. 4. Learning, Development & Employee Engagement Develop leadership development and management capability programs. Identify skill gaps and implement employee learning initiatives. Drive employee engagement, culture-building, recognition, and retention programs. Monitor engagement feedback and implement measurable improvement initiatives. 5. HR Operations & Statutory Compliance Oversee HR operations, onboarding, payroll coordination, employee exits, HR policies, and employee records. Ensure compliance with applicable Indian employment and labour laws, including PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, and relevant state-specific requirements. Manage employee relations, grievance resolution, investigations, and disciplinary processes. Strengthen HR systems, documentation, internal controls, and compliance audits. Implement HR analytics to track attrition, headcount, recruitment efficiency, and workforce costs. 6. Team Leadership Lead and develop HR business partners, talent acquisition, HR operations, and learning and development teams. Establish clear accountability, performance standards, and operating processes within HR. Build a high-performing HR function capable of supporting organisational expansion. 
 Required Qualifications & Experience 14-20 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in a Head of HR, HR Director, or senior HR Business Partner role. Experience supporting or leading HR in an organisation with approximately 3002,000 employees. Strong understanding of strategic HR, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee engagement, and HR operations. Demonstrated experience in workforce planning, organisational development, change management, and leadership advisory. Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements. Experience managing and developing HR teams. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills. MBA/PGDM in HR, MHRM, or an equivalent relevant qualification preferred. 
 Preferred Experience Experience in IT services, technology, BFSI, professional services, or other growth-oriented organisations. Experience in founder-led, high-growth, or PE/VC-backed businesses. Exposure to HRIS implementation, HR analytics, compensation benchmarking, and leadership hiring. Experience designing succession planning and long-term incentive frameworks. 
 Key Competencies Strategic HR Leadership | Business Partnering | Talent Acquisition | Compensation & Benefits | Performance Management | Employee Relations | Labour Law Compliance | Organisational Development | Change Management | HR Analytics | Leadership Development 
 What We Offer Opportunity to shape the organisation's people strategy. Direct engagement with the CEO and senior leadership team. Competitive compensation and performance-linked incentives. Scope to modernise HR processes and build a scalable people function.

title: Administration Executive
description:
91672 54109 Job Description: Service Coordinator 
 Company: Newtronic Lifecare Equipment Pvt. Ltd.
 Position: Service Coordinator
 Location: Ahmedabad / Pune / Bangalore
 Work Mode: Work from Office
 Experience: 12 Years
 Gender: Male
 Salary: Up to 2.5 LPA
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday
 Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM 
 About the Role We are looking for a proactive and organized service coordinator to support our branch service operations. The role will involve coordinating with service engineers, customers, the area service manager, the head office, finance, stores, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of service-related activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong follow-up ability, basic MS Office knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple administrative and service-coordination activities effectively. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Service & Payment Coordination 
 Follow up on outstanding service payments across AMC, Trading, Repair, Upgradation, and other service-related activities , including advance, due, and balance payments. Follow up on payments against both tax invoices and proforma invoices. Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure timely collection and closure of outstanding payments. Maintain proper records and follow-up trackers for pending payments. 
 2. Service Reporting & Documentation 
 Prepare and submit weekly service analysis reports to the Area Service Manager and Head Office. Maintain and share reports related to monthly revenue, expenditure, and collection . Ensure timely submission of service-related documents, including:
 Service Reports Installation Reports Customer Feedback Forms Vouchers Other relevant service documents Coordinate with service engineers to ensure proper documentation and timely submission. 
 3. Service Call & ERP Coordination 
 Monitor and maintain service call records in the IERP system , including:
 Call logging Call closing Service report uploading Status updates Follow up with service engineers for timely closure and documentation of service calls. Maintain the monthly complaint log of service engineers and submit the required report to HR. 
 4. Customer Coordination 
 Handle customer queries and service-related inquiries through telephone and email . Coordinate with customers and concerned service engineers for timely resolution of queries. Maintain professional communication and ensure timely follow-up on customer requirements. Coordinate for acknowledgement of spare parts/materials delivered through service engineers. 
 5. Spares & Gate Entry Coordination 
 Ensure that all spares/materials delivered through Service Engineers are properly acknowledged by the customer. Coordinate and collect required documentation such as delivery reports and gate entry details . Ensure proper records are maintained and submitted to the concerned department/head office. 
 6. Branch Administration 
 Maintain branch office attendance records and submit weekly attendance reports to Head Office. Coordinate routine administrative activities of the branch office. Coordinate housekeeping activities and ensure cleanliness and proper upkeep of the office/store area. Handle submission and coordination of various office utility bills and administrative documents with the Head Office. Maintain required attendance and administrative records of in-house staff. 
 7. Petty Cash & Courier Management 
 Handle branch-level petty cash and maintain proper records, supporting documents, and vouchers. Coordinate all incoming and outgoing courier activities. Maintain courier records and ensure timely dispatch and receipt of documents/materials. 
 8. Call Handling & Communication 
 Attend incoming and outgoing calls professionally. Direct calls to the concerned person, department, or extension. Maintain required call/communication records. Coordinate internal and external communication as required for smooth branch operations. 
 9. Inventory & Stock Coordination 
 Maintain proper stock records for the branch/store. Monitor stock movement and ensure records are updated regularly. Coordinate with the Stores Department regarding stock availability, movement, and requirements. Ensure proper documentation of material movement. Required Skills & Competencies 12 years of experience in service coordination / back office / branch administration / customer coordination / service operations. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication . Ability to maintain reports, trackers, and documentation accurately. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Customer-oriented approach with professional communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with Service Engineers and internal departments. Basic understanding of invoices, payments, and collection follow-up will be an advantage. Candidates from service-oriented, engineering, equipment, manufacturing, or technical organizations will be preferred. 
 Key Deliverables 
 Timely collection/payment follow-up. Accurate and timely weekly/monthly reporting. Proper service documentation and ERP updates. Effective coordination with Service Engineers and customers. Accurate branch attendance, petty cash, courier and administrative records. Proper stock and spare-part documentation. Timely escalation and closure of customer/service-related issues. 
 Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and current location .

The role will drive workforce planning, employer branding, recruitment excellence, talent pipeline development, and digital hiring transformation while ensuring quality, speed, diversity, and cost-effective hiring outcomes aligned with business growth objectives. 
 Talent Acquisition Strategy Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth plans. Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to forecast talent needs and create hiring plans. Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and niche positions. Lead workforce planning initiatives across manufacturing plants and corporate offices. 
 Recruitment & Selection Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership, technical, engineering, manufacturing, commercial, and support function roles. Ensure timely fulfillment of open positions while maintaining hiring quality standards. Establish robust candidate evaluation frameworks and competency-based hiring practices.

 Employer Branding & Candidate Experience Strengthen the organizations employer value proposition (EVP). Enhance candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Manage talent branding initiatives across professional networks, universities, and industry platforms. Represent the company in recruitment events, career fairs, and employer branding forums. 
 Campus & Early Career Programs Develop strategic partnerships with engineering, management, and technical institutions. Lead campus hiring programs, graduate trainee programs, apprenticeships, and internship initiatives. Build future talent pipelines to meet long-term workforce requirements. 
 Recruitment Technology & Analytics Leverage ATS, , and recruitment analytics to improve hiring effectiveness. Monitor hiring metrics and create dashboards for leadership review. Drive digitization and automation initiatives within recruitment processes. 
 Vendor & Stakeholder Management Manage recruitment agencies, search partners, and talent sourcing vendors. Negotiate contracts and optimize recruitment costs. Build strong relationships with business leaders, HR teams, and external stakeholders. 
 Diversity & Inclusion Develop and implement diversity hiring strategies. Ensure fair, equitable, and unbiased recruitment practices. Support organizational DEI goals through targeted sourcing initiatives.

title: Taxation Account Officer
description:
About Us Technocraft Ventures Limited (Formerly known as Technocraft Construction Private Limited) is a 27-year-old infrastructure company specializing in sewerage networks, sewage treatment plants, and allied water infrastructure works across India. We execute projects under national flagship programmes including AMRUT 2.0, Namami Gange, and state-level urban development missions, with operations spanning 6+ states and an annual turnover exceeding 300 crore Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Taxation Accountant with 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in GST compliance, TDS return filing, accounting, ITC reconciliation and statutory reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Tally, Computax, Microsoft Excel, the GST Portal and the TRACES Portal. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end GST and TDS compliance, maintaining accurate tax records, reconciling ITC, preparing statutory returns and coordinating with internal departments, senior officials and tax consultants to ensure timely and accurate compliance. 
 Key responsibilities 1. GST Accounting & Compliance Record all GST-related transactions in Tally, including purchases, sales, subcontracting, expenses, capital goods, ISD, RCM and GST TDS. Maintain GST liability, electronic credit and cash ledger records. Maintain invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills and supporting documents. Prepare state-wise GST liability and payment statements, including ITC, cash payments and challans. Verify GST TDS entries uploaded by government departments and other deductors. 2. GST Return Filing Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and ISD returns, wherever applicable. Review and process entries appearing in GSTR-2B. Prepare and file GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable. Ensure timely filing and accuracy of all applicable GST returns. 3. ITC Reconciliation Reconcile ITC between Tally books and GSTR-2B using Computax software. Extract accounting data from Tally and prepare Excel-based reconciliation reports. Identify missing invoices, excess or short ITC, mismatches and other discrepancies. Coordinate with the concerned SAO team for verification and finalization of ITC. Obtain necessary clarifications from DCFO, CAO and State GST Consultants, wherever required. Ensure finalized ITC is correctly considered before filing GSTR-3B. 4. Annual GST Return & Reporting Compile monthly GST and ITC data for annual reporting. Prepare consolidated data for GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. Review discrepancies and incorporate necessary corrections before finalization. Maintain GST records and supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes. 5. TDS Compliance & Return Filing Prepare and file salary and non-salary TDS returns using Computax software, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements. Prepare TDS liability statements covering tax, interest and late fees. Prepare section-wise and service-wise TDS reports for balance sheet and statutory audit purposes. Calculate employee salary tax liability based on applicable tax regimes, slabs, deductions and rebates. Download and coordinate the distribution of applicable TDS certificates, including Form 16 and Form 16A. Prepare and file revised TDS returns, wherever required. Handle TDS defaults, notices and outstanding demands through the TRACES Portal. 6. Documentation, Audit & Coordination Maintain systematic physical and digital records of GST and TDS documents. Prepare tax statements, reconciliations, challan records and compliance reports. Coordinate with internal accounts teams, SAO teams, senior finance officials and external tax consultants. Support statutory audits and tax-related assessments. Monitor compliance deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities. Required Skills & Software Knowledge 
 Strong practical knowledge of GST and TDS compliance. Hands-on experience in Tally and Computax software. Expertise in GST return filing and ITC reconciliation. Working knowledge of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. Experience with salary and non-salary TDS returns and the TRACES Portal. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reconciliation reports. Strong analytical, documentation and coordination skills. Candidate Requirements 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in taxation, accounting and statutory compliance. Graduate or postgraduate degree in Commerce, preferably B.Com or M.Com. Proven experience in independently handling GST and TDS compliance. Ability to manage multiple compliance deadlines with accuracy. Good communication and coordination skills. Preferred Candidate: An experienced taxation professional capable of independently managing end-to-end GST and TDS compliance, reconciliation, reporting and audit support. 
 Note : Please relevant candidate contact only Vinay Kumar (Manager HR ) Phone 9870507119

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience - High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. OR - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process - Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed. - Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources. - Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures. - Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings. - Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process. - Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures. - Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool. - Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection. Administering and Educating Employee Benefits - Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors. - Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management. - Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented. - Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee. Managing Employee Development - Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job. - Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations. - Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate. - Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture. - Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs - Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job. Maintaining Employee Relations - Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings). - Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action. - Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner - Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources. - Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary. - Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position. Managing Legal and Compliance Practices - Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time. - Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act. - Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file. - Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable). - Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook. - Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc. - Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims. - Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity. - Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs. - Oversees the selection/non-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non-selection and applicants receive status notifications). At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to guide team members while actively contributing to marketing execution and performance. Track campaign performance and update analytics trackers and reports. Monitor keyword rankings and maintain keyword tracking reports. Identify opportunities for campaign optimization and improved marketing performance.

Coordinate with website vendors for blog uploads, content updates, website corrections, and additional fixes. Ensure website resources and content are updated according to new designs and data. Design social media creatives using Canva and maintain organized creative folders. Schedule and publish posts across social media platforms. Draft email campaign content based on monthly topics and target audiences. Design and manage email campaigns using Mailchimp or relevant email marketing platforms. Schedule monthly email campaigns and track campaign performance. Prepare and update monthly email marketing analytics reports. Identify opportunities to improve email engagement and lead generation. 
 5. Paid Advertising Manage and monitor Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns. Track campaign performance, budgets, and key metrics. Make campaign adjustments and optimization recommendations wherever required. Maintain paid advertising trackers and ensure timely reporting of campaign results. Coordinate with the marketing manager on campaign strategy, targeting, and performance improvement. 
 6. LinkedIn Outreach & Lead Generation Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify and reach out to relevant prospects and decision-makers. Manage personalized LinkedIn messaging and outreach activities through designated accounts. Maintain and update LinkedIn follower lists and prospect databases. Track and support lead generation activities across LinkedIn and other marketing channels. Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure timely follow-up and accurate database updates.

Update Salesforce records and ensure database accuracy and completeness. Support email outreach to relevant decision-makers identified through Leadfeeder. Maintain clean and organized marketing databases as per business requirements.

Prepare press releases as and when required. Draft video scripts and coordinate video creation using relevant tools.

Allocate and track collateral development activities across team members. Ensure marketing assets are aligned with brand guidelines and approved before publishing. Coordinate with design and other internal teams to deliver high-quality marketing materials. 
 10. Competitor Analysis & Market Research Conduct competitor research across the USA and India markets. Monitor competitor marketing activities, content, campaigns, and digital presence. Prepare competitor analysis reports and share relevant insights with the marketing manager. Support market research and identification of new digital marketing opportunities. 
 11. Webinars & Marketing Campaigns Support the end-to-end planning and execution of monthly webinars for lead generation. Coordinate webinar promotional creatives, social media copy, email campaigns, and website content. Ensure promotional activities are planned and executed within timelines. Track campaign deliverables and coordinate with relevant teams to support webinar success. 
 12. Team Supervision & Coordination Supervise daily digital marketing activities and ensure timely completion of team deliverables. description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Digital Marketing & AI Product Specialist with 2 to 4 years of hands-on digital marketing experience and strong exposure to the latest generative AI tools. The candidate will work closely with our Product Owner and AI Engineering team to research, test, validate, and improve AI-powered digital marketing capabilities. This is not a traditional digital marketing execution role. It combines practical marketing expertise, AI experimentation, product testing, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate should be passionate about applying AI to real-world marketing challenges and helping build intelligent marketing solutions. Key Responsibilities 1. AI-Powered Marketing & Automation Research, evaluate, and experiment with the latest generative AI tools for digital marketing. Identify opportunities to improve and automate marketing activities using AI. Collaborate with AI engineers to translate marketing requirements into intelligent automation workflows. Test and validate AI-generated marketing content, strategies, and recommendations. Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, quality, relevance, and marketing effectiveness. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, agentic AI, and marketing automation trends. 2. Digital Marketing Strategy, Execution & Optimization Develop and execute digital marketing strategies across SEO, social media, paid advertising, and lead generation channels. Work with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, and other digital marketing platforms. Apply AI tools to improve campaign planning, content creation, audience targeting, and marketing performance. Understand SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and emerging AI-driven search trends. Use generative AI tools to create and evaluate marketing copy, images, videos, and advertising creatives. Understand lead generation funnels, customer segmentation, CRM workflows, and conversion optimization. Monitor campaign performance using metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates. Conduct A/B testing, analyze campaign results, and recommend improvements. Research industry trends, competitor capabilities, and emerging marketing technologies. 3. Product Development & AI Engineering Collaboration Work closely with the Product Owner to understand business requirements and product priorities. Translate practical digital marketing use cases into clear functional requirements for AI engineers. Collaborate with engineering teams to design, test, and improve AI-powered marketing features. Perform functional testing and quality assurance of AI-generated outputs. Identify gaps in existing capabilities and recommend product improvements. Participate in sprint planning, product demonstrations, and feature reviews. Document marketing workflows, best practices, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria. Provide actionable feedback to improve product usability and effectiveness. 4. Marketing Research, Analytics & Experimentation Research emerging digital marketing strategies, tools, and automation opportunities. Benchmark AI-powered marketing solutions against industry alternatives. Conduct experiments to validate marketing strategies and AI capabilities. Analyze marketing data and identify actionable insights. Develop reusable marketing templates, test cases, and best-practice guidelines. Prepare concise reports and recommendations for the Product Owner and engineering team. Required Qualifications 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing automation. Practical knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, and lead generation. Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI, or similar platforms. Understanding of digital marketing analytics, campaign optimization, and conversion funnels. Ability to evaluate AI-generated content and marketing recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and research skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with product and technical teams. Willingness to learn, experiment, and adapt to emerging AI technologies. Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Experience with AI-powered marketing automation tools. Familiarity with n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms. Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager. Exposure to HubSpot, Mailchimp, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM platforms. Familiarity with AI image and video generation tools. Basic understanding of prompt engineering, AI agents, and LLM capabilities. Awareness of APIs, webhooks, and automated workflows. Experience working with AI-powered products, agentic AI platforms, or technology startups. Programming experience is not mandatory. However, candidates should be comfortable working with AI engineers and understanding how marketing workflows can be automated. What We're Looking For We value hands-on experience, curiosity, creativity, analytical thinking, and a passion for AI over certifications or theoretical knowledge. The ideal candidate is someone who: Understands how digital marketing campaigns work in practice. Actively experiments with the latest AI tools. Can identify opportunities to improve marketing through automation. Enjoys collaborating with product owners and AI engineers. Takes ownership, learns quickly, and thrives in a startup environment.
