title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
Job Description 
 Were looking for a Senior Creative Designer with exceptional visual design skills, strong UI/UX knowledge, and a clear understanding of customer experience (CX). You should be able to turn business goals and customer needs into distinctive, intuitive, and consistent design. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to lead creative direction, mentor designers, and raise the quality of work across the team. We value someone who uses AI thoughtfully, understands its limitations, and brings original thinking and strong design judgment to every project. 
 What youll do: 
 Create high-quality designs for websites, digital products, brand experiences, and marketing initiatives. Set a clear creative direction through strong typography, layout, colour, imagery, and visual storytelling. Translate business requirements, user research, and customer insights into concepts, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces. Consider the complete customer journey, ensuring consistency across discovery, onboarding, product use, and support. Build and evolve design systems that balance brand expression, usability, accessibility, and development feasibility. Collaborate with product managers, developers, marketers, and stakeholders to take designs from concept to implementation. Present design decisions clearly, explain trade-offs, and incorporate feedback with purpose. Lead design reviews, guide project execution, and maintain high standards across team deliverables. Mentor designers through actionable feedback, coaching, and knowledge-sharing. Use AI tools to support exploration and execution while reviewing outputs for originality, relevance, consistency, and usability. 
 What were looking for: 
 A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative craft and thoughtful design across digital experiences. Solid knowledge of UI/UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, responsive design, and accessibility. An understanding of how design influences customer trust, satisfaction, conversion, and retention. Proficiency in Figma and relevant creative tools, with the ability to choose the right tool for the task. The ability to develop original concepts and carry them through to detailed, implementation-ready designs. Practical understanding of AI design limitations, including generic outputs, weak contextual understanding, inconsistent interfaces, and accessibility gaps. Sound judgment about when to use AI, when to refine its output, and when to design independently. Experience leading design work and a genuine willingness to mentor people and help them grow. Strong communication, collaboration, ownership, and attention to detail. Comfort balancing creative ambition with timelines, technical constraints, and business priorities. 
 Good to have: 
 Experience working with clients across different industries. Knowledge of user research, usability testing, customer journey mapping, and service design. Exposure to motion design, illustration, or brand identity. A working understanding of frontend development and design-to-development handoffs. 
 What success looks like: 
 Your work makes experiences visually distinctive and easy to use. You connect creative decisions to customer needs and business goals, help the team deliver consistently strong work, and develop designers who become more capable and independent. 
 When applying: 
 Share your portfolio and two or three projects that explain the problem, your contribution, your design decisions, and the outcome. If you used AI, explain where it helped and where your judgment changed the result. 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Visual Arts, Interaction Design, UI/UX Design, or a related field. Preferred: B.Des, BFA, M.Des, or equivalent design qualification. Candidates with a degree in Computer Science or a related field may also be considered if they have strong design skills and a relevant portfolio. A strong portfolio and relevant professional experience should carry more weight than the degree alone.

description:

**Summary of the role:**

You will help lead Levi Strauss & Co.’s 24/7 global IT Command Center operations and serve in the Manager on Duty rotation for high-impact technology events. This role coordinates major-incident response, drives service restoration, governs enterprise change activity through Change Advisory Board processes, and strengthens Incident, Problem, Change Management, and Disaster Recovery readiness. Working across technical resolver teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, you will help improve service continuity, operational discipline, and enterprise resilience.

* ITIL certification.
* ServiceNow Administrator or ITSM certification.

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

* Paid time off

title: Forward Deployed Engineer

We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.About the roleWe’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.What a week looks likeMonday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.What you’ll doScope the right thingRun discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.Own the client relationshipBe the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.Design the systemOwn the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.Build, verify and deployWrite backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.Design the experience and drive adoptionDesign screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.What you need3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.Fluent Hindi and English.Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.Nice to haveYou’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.Who succeeds hereYou have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.Work setupLocation: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.Travel: Regular visits to client sites.Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.Reports to: Tuning Research founders.Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.What success looks like30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.How we hireIntro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.Fill out the form https://forms.gle/L9M6MDArXLP6KFFc8

title: Founder’s Office (EA)
description:
* Location: Mumbai
* Experience: 7+ Years
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Compensation: 70-80K Per Month
* Industry: Real Estate
* Reporting To: Founder

**About The Role**
We are a Mumbai-based real estate company looking for an experienced
**Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder**
.
  
  
You will be the Founder’s first point of contact and representative, responsible for protecting his time and ensuring that the right people, priorities, and issues reach him.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong judgement, organisation, discretion, and confidence. You will manage the Founder’s calendar, travel, communication, coordination, and follow-ups while ensuring his day-to-day commitments run smoothly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Calendar & Priority Management**

* Manage the Founder’s calendar, meetings, appointments, and daily priorities
* Organise schedules to ensure effective use of the Founder’s time
* Coordinate meetings with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively
* Ensure important priorities and follow-ups are tracked through completion

**Travel Management**

* Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel end to end
* Manage flights, accommodation, transportation, itineraries, and other travel arrangements
* Handle last-minute changes and unexpected situations with practical judgement
* Maintain organised travel schedules and relevant documentation

**Gatekeeping & Founder Support**

* Act as the Founder’s gatekeeper and first point of contact
* Filter incoming requests and determine what requires the Founder’s direct attention
* Route matters to the appropriate internal point of contact when required
* Confidently and professionally decline or redirect requests when necessary
* Protect the Founder’s time while ensuring important matters are addressed

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate across internal teams, staff, and external stakeholders on the Founder’s behalf
* Communicate requirements and follow up on action items
* Build effective working relationships with people across different levels
* Ensure information reaches the right stakeholders accurately and on time

**Documentation & Follow-Ups**

* Maintain well-organised records and documentation
* Track meetings, commitments, action items, and follow-ups
* Ensure pending matters are followed through to completion
* Maintain clear and easily accessible information when required

**Confidentiality & Discretion**

* Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion
* Maintain professionalism when dealing with internal and external stakeholders
* Exercise sound judgement when managing sensitive matters on the Founder’s behalf

**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* 7+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant
* Based out of Mumbai
* Prior experience working in a startup (Preferred)
* Prior experience supporting a Founder or senior leadership is strongly preferred
* Experience within a founder’s office, startup, or real estate company is preferred
* Strong-minded and composed under pressure
* Confidence to establish and maintain boundaries firmly but politely
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
* Comfortable working with employees and stakeholders at every level
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail
* Strong documentation and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of important details
* High level of discretion and confidentiality
* Digitally inclined and comfortable using:

+ Calendars
+ Email
+ Productivity tools
+ Collaboration tools

* Some travel experience and broader exposure to planning complex itineraries

**The Ideal Candidate**
We’re looking for someone who can do much more than manage a calendar.
  
  
You should understand how to
**protect a Founder’s time, prioritise competing requests, coordinate with different personalities, and make practical decisions independently**
.
  
  
You should be confident enough to say no when necessary, composed enough to handle pressure and last-minute changes, and organised enough to ensure commitments and follow-ups never fall through the cracks.
  
  
Above all, you should be someone the Founder can trust to represent him professionally and handle sensitive information with complete discretion.
  
  
Skills: founder support,travel management,stakeholder management,discretion

title: Kitchen Helper
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a hardworking, reliable, and detail-oriented **Kitchen Helper** to join our culinary team. In this role, you will play a vital role in supporting chefs and cooks by handling basic food preparation, washing and sanitizing equipment, maintaining cleanliness across kitchen stations, and ensuring smooth kitchen operations during service hours.

**Key Responsibilities1. Food Preparation & Support**

* **Basic Prep Work:** Wash, peel, chop, slice, and dice vegetables, fruits, and meats under the guidance of chefs.
* **Ingredient Handling:** Measure out basic ingredients, assemble prep trays, and assist with portioning food items.
* **Station Setup:** Help set up cooking stations with required utensils, bowls, containers, and ingredients before service starts (*mise en place* support).

**2. Cleaning & Kitchen Hygiene**

* **Dishwashing & Warewashing:** Clean cookware, pans, pots, utensils, cutting boards, and dishware manually or using commercial dishwashers.
* **Station Cleaning:** Regularly sweep, mop, and wipe down kitchen counters, cutting tables, storage shelves, and cooking lines.
* **Trash Management:** Empty trash cans, compost bins, and grease traps regularly; clean waste disposal areas and ensure proper waste segregation.
* **Sanitation Compliance:** Follow all food safety standards, cleanliness guidelines, and sanitation rules (e.g., FSSAI / local health authority norms).

**3. Inventory & Material Handling**

* **Stock Unloading & Storage:** Help unload incoming food deliveries, dry goods, and kitchen supplies.
* **Stock Rotation:** Organize items in dry storage rooms, walk-in chillers, and freezers following **FIFO (First-In, First-Out)** principles.
* **Supply Monitoring:** Keep track of cleaning supplies, detergents, dish soaps, and paper products, informing supervisors when stocks run low.

**Key Requirements & QualificationsMandatory Criteria**

* **Education:** High school diploma, 10th/12th pass, or equivalent work experience (formal culinary training is a plus but not required).
* **Experience:** 0–2 years of experience working in a restaurant, hotel kitchen, cloud kitchen, or catering company. Freshers with a strong work ethic are welcome.

**Technical Skills & Capabilities**

* Basic understanding of knife safety, food hygiene, and kitchen sanitation practices.
* Physical capability to lift heavy food crates, stock bags, or large cookware (up to 15–20 kg).
* Ability to work comfortably in a fast-paced, warm kitchen environment.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong work ethic, punctuality, and reliability.
* Good listening skills and ability to follow verbal instructions accurately.
* Positive attitude and team-player mindset during high-pressure service hours.
* Flexibility to work morning/evening shifts, weekends, and holidays as per kitchen schedules.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview:**

At Haber, we help industries become sustainable by turning plant data into decisions that happen in real time. Our products collect data from sensors and devices inside live plants, and turn it into actions that save water, energy and cost. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the web applications our customers use every day - the dashboards, the reports and the screens that show what is happening inside a plant right now. You will work across React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend, with our data coming in from AWS and IoT devices.

You will work closely with the Technical Lead and with senior engineers. This is a strong role for someone who has 3 to 6 years of solid full stack experience and now wants to work on a product where the data is real, messy and arriving every second.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Build and maintain web applications using React.js, TypeScript, Node.js and REST APIs.

• Develop reusable and maintainable frontend components and backend services.

• Build screens and dashboards that display real-time plant and sensor data.

• Write and optimise REST APIs, and work with SQL databases.

• Work with AWS services to build and run cloud-based application features.

• Implement authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.

• Debug and fix issues across the frontend, backend and cloud layers.

• Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews.

• Work with the Technical Lead on design and architecture decisions for the features you build.

• Collaborate with product managers, QA and other engineers to deliver features end to end.

• Take part in production support and help find the root cause when something breaks.

**Must Have:**

**Frontend**

• 3 to 6 years of experience building web applications in production.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

• Strong proficiency in React.js, with JavaScript and TypeScript.

• HTML5, CSS3 and responsive UI development.• State management using Redux, React Query or similar.

**Backend**

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, with Express.js or a similar framework.

• RESTful API development.

• Asynchronous programming and understanding of event-driven architecture.

• Basic understanding of API security and authentication.

**Cloud and Data**

• Working knowledge of AWS - services such as Lambda, S3, API Gateway and CloudWatch.

• Good SQL knowledge and experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

• Git and Git-based workflows.

**Good to Have:**

• WebSocket and real-time communication.

• Experience with data visualisation libraries such as Highcharts, Chart.js or ECharts.

• Experience with AWS IoT Core, MQTT or any device-to-cloud communication.

• Experience with time-series databases such as InfluxDB, or NoSQL databases and Redis.

• Docker, CI/CD pipelines and Linux fundamentals.

• Understanding of frontend performance optimisation.

• Exposure to IoT, manufacturing, or other industrial and process environments.

• Experience working in a product company or a startup.

**What We Offer:**

• Real-World Impact: What you build is used every day by engineers running real plants

• Learn Across the Stack: Frontend, backend, cloud and IoT - not just one narrow layer

• Strong Mentorship: Work directly with senior engineers who will review your code and help

you grow

• Ownership: You will own features end to end, not just small tickets

• Fast-Track Learning: A startup where learning never stops and innovation is constant

• Collaborative Culture: A team that supports initiative, experimentation and personal growth

• Product-Minded Thinking: Your work will be closely tied to product and business decisions

**About Haber:**

With a mission to help industries become sustainable by converting data to actionable intelligence, our AI+IoT based technology helps our customers spend less time collecting and analysing data by predicting results and driving value in real-time. Our technology has been assuring performance and significantly reducing operating costs, as well as, reducing water and energy footprints for our customers.

title: Senior Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (f/m/x)
description:
We are actively hiring for an exciting opportunity with Sii Group, supporting a global Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales platform used across 55+ countries. As a Senior Dynamics 365 CRM Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing enterprise-scale CRM solutions, collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact outcomes. Leveraging Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, and .NET, you'll help build innovative, scalable solutions that drive business value on a global scale. This is a hybrid role based in Pune (2 days onsite per week), with a preference for candidates who can join at the earliest.
  
  
****Your tasks****

* Designing, developing, customizing, and implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales solutions, contributing across the full project lifecycle
* Building CRM functionality and integrations using Dynamics CRM SDK, C#, JavaScript, .NET, Power Platform (Canvas Apps and Power Pages), and Azure services
* Developing secure Azure-based applications and integrations using Azure Functions, Service Bus, Application Insights, APIs, OAuth 2.0, and MSAL
* Applying Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices, conducting code reviews, maintaining development standards, and managing source control using Git while supporting CI/CD processes
* Contributing to solution design, technical documentation, and architectural discussions; supporting production deployments, troubleshooting, and continuous platform enhancements in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical teams

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM and enterprise application development
* Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales, including participation in 4 full lifecycle implementations, CRM customization, configuration, and Dynamics CRM SDK development
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, .NET Framework, and the Microsoft Power Platform, including Canvas Apps and Power Pages
* At least 3 years of Azure development experience, with hands-on expertise in Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Application Insights, and system integrations
* Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), automated unit testing, and frameworks such as NUnit, FakeXrmEasy, and Moq
* Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, MSAL, authentication, and authorization mechanisms
* Experience with Git, code reviews, solution design, technical documentation, release management, and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English proficiency (minimum B2 level)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Software Engineer**

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.
  
  
**About the role:**

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing – to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs.
* Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features.
* As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs.
* Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements.
* Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing.
* Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.

**Requirements**

* **6+ years**
  of experience in
  **Java**
  -based backend development.
* Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
* Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture.
* Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers.
* Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application.
* Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
* Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
* Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude.
* Experience working with remote teams
* Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills

**Desired**

* Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture.
* Experience writing software applications in Go

**What success looks like in the role**

**Within the first 30 days you will:**

* Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment.

* Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it.

**By 90 days:**

* Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes 
  *many*
  ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team.
* Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here.
* Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day.

**By 6 months:**

* Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently.
* Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
* Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner.
* Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. 
  
 
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays
* Flexible Work hours

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Sr Lead - Informatica IDMC Developer
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
Empowered By Innovation
  
  
Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities.
  
  
Job Title / Position:
**Informatica IDMC Lead**
Experience: 8-10 years
  
  
Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai / Mumbai
  
  
Shift: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IDMC Development and Integration**

* Develop, configure, and maintain data integration mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and schedules using Informatica Cloud Data Integration (CDI).
* Build ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data across cloud and on-premises sources and targets.
* Configure and support Secure Agents, runtime environments, connections, parameterization, and deployment activities under architectural guidance.
* Develop reusable objects, templates, error-handling routines, logging, and restart mechanisms to improve solution maintainability.
* Create and consume REST and SOAP APIs, and support file-based, database, application, and event-driven integration patterns.

**Data Quality and MDM Support**

* Develop data quality rules, profiles, scorecards, standardization, cleansing, and validation logic using Cloud Data Quality (CDQ).
* Implement data matching, duplicate identification, reference data checks, and exception-handling workflows.
* Support MDM SaaS implementations such as Customer 360, Supplier 360, or Product 360 by configuring data loads, business rules, and integrations.

**Migration and Modernization**

* Assist in assessing and migrating Informatica PowerCenter or IICS assets to IDMC.
* Rebuild or refactor mappings, workflows, data quality assets, and interfaces based on approved migration designs.

**Testing, Support, and Delivery**

* Prepare unit test cases and test evidence; support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and performance testing.
* Troubleshoot mapping failures, connectivity issues, data quality defects, and performance bottlenecks.

**Collaboration and Documentation**

* Work with solution architects, business analysts, source-system teams, database administrators, and QA teams to translate requirements into technical deliverables.
* Create and maintain technical design documents, mapping specifications, runbooks, deployment checklists, and support documentation.
* Participate in design reviews and recommend practical improvements to performance, reliability, and maintainability.

**Required Skills**
**Informatica and Integration**

* Hands-on experience with mappings, taskflows, parameter files, scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and Secure Agents.
* Good understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and integration design patterns.
* Experience with REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, CSV, and secure file-transfer mechanisms. Exposure to Kafka or event streaming is a plus.

**Databases, Cloud, and Engineering Tools**

* Strong SQL skills and experience with at least two platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* Exposure to one or more cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About The Role**
As a Data Scientist II, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of data science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions that address business needs and improve customer experiences. You will apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and modern AI frameworks to build reliable analytical and intelligent capabilities.
  
  
This individual contributor role participates across the data science lifecycle, from data collection and preprocessing through model development, evaluation, integration, and production support. Working with a moderate level of guidance, you will solve complex technical problems, collaborate with senior data scientists and cross-functional partners, and expand your knowledge of enterprise AI technologies, business processes, and customer needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop data science and AI solutions: Prepare and analyze structured and unstructured data, engineer features, and contribute to predictive models, NLP and LLM solutions, RAG pipelines, intelligent assistants, and Agentic AI workflows.
* Evaluate and improve solution quality: Apply suitable metrics, test datasets, error analysis, experiment tracking, model validation, performance testing, and responsible AI checks to improve accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Support deployment and engineering: Build reusable code, APIs, notebooks, pipelines, containers, model artifacts, monitoring components, and automated workflows with engineering and senior data science team members.
* Collaborate, communicate, and maintain standards: Translate requirements into assigned deliverables, communicate insights through visualizations, prototypes, reports, and documentation, and manage code, data, and experiments in line with security, privacy, governance, version control, responsible AI, and current ML and AI practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 3+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, analytics, or AI-focused software development.
* Hands-on experience preparing data, conducting exploratory analysis, building features, developing models, and evaluating results for practical business problems.
* Experience contributing to at least one Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, or Agentic AI solution through development, testing, integration, or production support.
* Working knowledge of model validation, experiment design, performance metrics, data quality, and reproducible development practices.
* Ability to complete a range of technical assignments and solve moderately complex problems within established policies, procedures, and architectural patterns.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information clearly in straightforward situations.
* Strong collaboration, learning agility, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

**Technical Skills**

* Programming and analytics: Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Jupyter, data preparation, feature engineering, analysis, and visualization using Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Machine Learning, statistics, and NLP: Practical knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, model selection and evaluation, statistical analysis, experimentation, and foundational deep learning and NLP concepts using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or SpaCy.
* Generative AI and Agentic AI: Experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG, LLM evaluation, document-based use cases, tool-enabled agents, and workflow orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, with exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, and model APIs.
* Engineering, cloud, and governance: Experience with reusable Python code, REST APIs, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, containers, databases, data pipelines, and cloud services, with awareness of monitoring, observability, security, privacy, cost, explainability, and responsible AI practices.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role is measured through:
  
  

* Accurate, timely, and well-documented data preparation, analysis, and reporting.
* Reliable contributions to Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI development, testing, integration, and production support.
* Measurable improvement in model or application quality, including accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, cost, or user experience.
* Clear visualizations and actionable insights that support product and business decisions.
* Reusable, maintainable code and effective automation of repeatable data and AI workflows.
* Consistent adherence to data quality, security, governance, responsible AI, documentation, and team development standards.

description: About IDinsightWe're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most impact.IDinsight Is a Global Nonprofit That Equips Leaders With The Data, Evidence, And Technology To Improve Lives At Scale. With Our Partners, We Are Pioneering The Next Frontier Of Social Impact, Where Data And Technology Accelerate Progress For Millions. Build relationships with prospective partners and develop proposals that match IDinsight's capabilities to client needs.AI Transformation Advisory: Serve as the senior lead on advisory and evaluation engagements - identifying the right use-cases; building, testing and evaluating AI-based products; and integrating AI products responsibly into client systems and workflows.Thought leadership: Represent IDinsight in sector conversations on AI in the social sector through writing and external engagement.Training and workshops: Design and deliver executive workshops, workflow redesign sessions, and training programs that build lasting client capability.Financial managementDemonstrate a strong understanding of IDinsight's business model and contribute to a financially sustainable practice through sound strategic decision-making and resource stewardship.Review budget design and resource allocation, ensuring financial planning supports quality delivery, funder expectations, and growth of the practice.Build trust with clients and funders through timely, accurate, and strategic financial reporting.Who we are looking forQualificationsCommitment to IDinsight's values and mission6-10 years of professional experience, with significant time in consulting, digital transformation, product management, or technology implementation, ideally serving governments, foundations, or social sector organizations.Technical fluency: Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, AI agent architectures, and the practical realities of deploying AI in organizations. Ability to credibly direct a technical team. Business MIS & Performance TrackingBuild and maintain a simple, reliable view of business performance.Depending on the business requirement, this could include:Sales and revenue trackingStore performanceE-commerce performanceInventory and stockHiring and manpowerMarketing performanceKey project statusFinancial / operational metricsDepartment-wise targets and progressResponsibilities include:Collecting information from relevant owners.Validating data and identifying inconsistencies.Maintaining dashboards / MIS reports.Tracking targets versus actuals.Highlighting trends, gaps and exceptions.Preparing concise management reports.The objective is to help the Founder see what is happening in the business without having to chase information from multiple people.4. Cross-Functional Project ManagementTake ownership of selected business projects from start to completion.For example:Implementing a new process or systemSetting up a new dashboardImproving an existing workflowOpening / setting up a new storeHiring for a critical positionVendor / partner coordinationProcess documentationCost optimisation initiativesNew business initiativesFor every project, you will be expected to define:Objective → Action Items → Owner → Deadline → Status → Blocker → Next StepYou will coordinate with the relevant people and ensure that projects keep moving.5. Problem Solving & Business AnalysisSupport the Founder in answering business questions through structured analysis.Examples:Why are sales declining in a particular store/channel?Which categories are performing or underperforming?Where are operational bottlenecks?What is causing a recurring process issue?Which vendor / option is commercially better?What is the impact of a proposed business decision?Where can costs or time be saved?What information should be tracked going forward?You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous question and turning it into:Problem → Data / Information → Analysis → Options → Recommendation → Action6. Process & Systems ImprovementIdentify repetitive, inefficient or unclear processes and help improve them.This could involve:Mapping existing processesIdentifying gaps and bottlenecksCreating SOPs and checklistsImproving reporting systemsAutomating repetitive reporting where possibleCreating standard trackersImproving information flow between teamsEnsuring accountability and ownershipYou do not need to be a technical developer, but you should be comfortable with systems, data and technology.7. title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Marketing Manager – Growth & Performance Marketing

**Company:**
EaseToLearn

**Industry:**
EdTech / Online Education

**Location:**
Delhi

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹13 LPA gross annually, depending on experience and suitability

About EaseToLearn

EaseToLearn operates in the education technology sector, where digital accessibility, learner engagement and effective student acquisition are important to business growth.

We are looking for a results-oriented Marketing Manager who can strengthen our digital presence, attract prospective learners, generate qualified leads and convert marketing efforts into measurable business outcomes.

Role Overview

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning and executing marketing initiatives that support EaseToLearn's business objectives. The role will focus on performance marketing, lead generation, learner acquisition, campaign optimisation and brand development.

The ideal candidate should combine hands-on digital marketing expertise with analytical thinking, an understanding of the education market and the ability to translate marketing data into actionable growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities1. Growth Strategy and Student Acquisition

* Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with EaseToLearn's business and growth objectives.
* Identify target learner segments and develop campaigns to reach prospective students.
* Build and optimise lead-generation and learner-acquisition strategies.
* Work with relevant teams to improve lead quality and conversion into enrolments or other defined business outcomes.

2. Performance and Digital Marketing

* Plan, execute and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant digital channels.
* Monitor campaign performance, cost per lead (CPL), customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
* Allocate marketing budgets effectively and identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency.
* Conduct A/B testing of advertisements, landing pages, creatives and campaign messaging.

3. Content, SEO and Brand Development

* Coordinate SEO, content marketing, email marketing and social media initiatives.
* Ensure marketing communications are relevant to target learners and aligned with the company's brand positioning.
* Collaborate with content and design teams to develop effective campaign creatives, landing pages and promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility, audience engagement and brand awareness.

4. Marketing Analytics and Reporting

* Track and analyse campaign performance using Google Analytics and relevant advertising platforms.
* Prepare regular marketing reports covering expenditure, lead generation, conversions and campaign effectiveness.
* Use data to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and audience research to identify growth opportunities.

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with sales, product, content and other relevant teams to align marketing activities with business priorities.
* Establish feedback loops to understand lead quality, learner requirements and conversion challenges.
* Manage multiple marketing initiatives and ensure timely execution.
* Present marketing performance, insights and recommendations to management.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field. An MBA in Marketing will be preferred.
* 4–5 years of relevant marketing experience, with prior experience in EdTech, e-learning, online education or test preparation.
* Demonstrated experience in performance marketing, digital campaigns and lead generation.
* Hands-on proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and Google Analytics.
* Understanding of marketing funnels, conversion optimisation, CPL, CAC and ROAS.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage budgets, coordinate with cross-functional teams and deliver measurable results.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience marketing education products, online learning platforms or test-preparation services.
* A track record of generating qualified leads and improving campaign performance.
* Ability to connect marketing activities with business outcomes rather than focusing solely on reach and engagement.
* A data-driven approach to campaign planning, experimentation and optimisation.
* Willingness to take ownership of marketing execution and continuously improve results.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be evaluated through agreed objectives, which may include:

* Qualified leads generated.
* Cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
* Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate, where applicable.
* Return on advertising spend and marketing budget utilisation.
* Campaign execution, reporting quality and continuous optimisation.
* Contribution to brand visibility and overall business growth.

Specific targets will be established in line with EaseToLearn's business goals, marketing budget and available resources.

Compensation and Employment

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹13 LPA gross annual salary, depending on experience and suitability.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time.

Application Process

Interested candidates should complete the application form and submit their updated CV.

**Application form:**
https://tally.so/r/J9Nv6z

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their relevant EdTech marketing experience, campaigns managed, budgets handled and measurable business results.

title: Intermediate Professional, Digital Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an AI Engineer to develop and support production-oriented Generative AI solutions for the Middle East AI portfolio from the Bengaluru GCC. The role will work across AI products, agents, automation workflows and enterprise integrations, with emphasis on secure engineering, measurable quality and responsible AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop GenAI applications, agents and automation workflows using approved designs and engineering standards.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, structured outputs and prompt patterns to improve solution reliability and usability.
* Integrate AI components with enterprise systems, APIs, approved vector search services and governed data sources.
* Build and maintain ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured content.
* Create evaluation datasets and execute repeatable testing for accuracy, grounding, safety, latency and solution quality.
* Apply responsible AI controls including validation, guardrails, content filtering, traceability and human oversight.
* Develop clean, reusable and well-documented Python components and participate in code reviews.
* Support deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation of AI solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of relevant software, data or AI engineering experience, including internships or strong project experience.
* Working knowledge of Python, REST APIs, SQL and software engineering fundamentals.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
* Exposure to Azure AI services, Git-based development, CI/CD and cloud security principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**WSP-Aligned Technology Stack**
The role will use and support the approved enterprise stack below. Equivalent technologies may be considered only where formally approved through WSP architecture, security and governance processes.
  
  
**Cloud platform**
Microsoft Azure
  
  
**AI services**
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Machine Learning and approved Azure AI services
  
  
**Application hosting**
Azure App Service, Azure Functions and Azure Kubernetes Service where architecturally approved
  
  
**Data and security**
Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, SQL and approved NoSQL services
  
  
**Engineering lifecycle**
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Azure Monitor and approved observability services
  
  
**Architecture**
REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and serverless patterns, secure API-first integration
  
  
**Expected Outcomes**

* Deliver maintainable AI components that progress from prototype through controlled production deployment.
* Improve solution quality through structured evaluation, monitoring and iterative optimisation.
* Contribute to reusable AI capabilities and patterns across the Middle East portfolio.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Azure or Azure AI certification.
* Experience with agentic AI orchestration, document intelligence or enterprise search.
* Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management and production monitoring.
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary, agile or globally distributed teams.

**Ways of Working**

* Collaborate effectively with Middle East stakeholders, GCC delivery teams, product owners, engineering specialists and enterprise technology functions.
* Work within WSP standards for architecture, cybersecurity, data protection, responsible AI, quality assurance and delivery governance.
* Communicate clearly, document decisions and support transparent delivery reporting across distributed teams.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
### **Description**

**About the Role:**  
  
The Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for all global IT and service requests, resolving issues by phone, email, ticket and in person, and escalating what can't be fixed at first line. You should deliver excellent, timely support to users across multiple business areas, so that issues are resolved with minimal business impact and within SLA.  
  
The Global Service Desk Team has 5 analysts. It supports 1500+ users worldwide, 24 hours a day, 5 days a week (moving to 24x7), on a follow-the-sun shift pattern.

  

### **Responsibilities**

**Ticket and incident management**

* Act as first-level contact for users and resolve issues, or convey resolutions, by phone, email, service desk tickets and face to face.

* Maintain control of the Global Service Desk queue: log, prioritise, resolve and reassign tickets as soon as possible after they are raised.

* Take ownership of tickets and see them through to prompt, satisfactory resolution, collaborating with the team as needed.

* Prioritise business-affecting issues and escalate unresolved queries to the right level of support so problems are fixed within SLA.

* Track, route and redirect problems to the correct resources.

* Follow the Global Incident Management guidelines and ensure proper recording, documentation and closure of every ticket.

**User support and onboarding/off boarding**

* Walk users through the problem-solving process, follow up and provide feedback until the issue is resolved.

* Manage user on- and off-boarding in line with the agreed process flow and timescales, including updating user data.

* Set up new equipment globally, handing over to regional support where required.

* Install and configure software on user machines.

* Support multiple business areas, including IT, Application Support, Facilities and Travel.

**Service quality and relationships**

* Deliver efficient customer service that meets and exceeds user expectations.

* Build strong relationships across all business areas and represent the Service Desk positively to internal customers, clients and suppliers.

* Take part in the 24x5 global shift Rota (moving to 24x7) so users in every region are supported during their working hours.

* Produce activity reports and attend regular 1:1s with the department head to cascade priorities.

* Recommend procedure changes and improvements, and keep growing your knowledge of help desk procedures, products and services.

### **Skills and Experience**

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of help desk / ticketing software and remote-control tools

* Windows 10/11 and macOS (OS X) support

* Microsoft 365, including strong core Office skills (Excel in particular)

* Basic SharePoint and OneDrive management

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)

* Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills

**Professional**

* Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication

* Strong client-facing and customer service orientation

* Ability to priorities, multi-task and complete tasks to the end

* Good organizational and relationship-building skills

* Flexibility to work 24-hour shift patterns

### **Equal Opportunities**

*adm-Indicia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We recruit, employ, develop, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. Should you need any reasonable adjustments made to this application process, please don't hesitate to let us know.*

### **About adm-Indicia**

As a next-generation brand activation agency, adm Indicia's purpose is to simplify our clients’ below-the-line marketing, build sustainable ROI and engage their customers across the path to purchase. Everything we do is optimised through leading strategic capability and actioned through executional excellence.  
  
We transform marketing compromise into a powerful co-promise, creating and activating meaningful brand experiences that drive ROI. Brands have had to juggle multiple agencies, struggle to see value in ever-increasing customer data, and deliver disconnected digital and physical experiences – just some of the compromise frustrating marketing for too long. With joined-up strategy, execution and seamless activation, our combined expertise means we can help brands deliver impact through every stage of the customer journey.  
  
Founded in 1992, we have a global footprint with 46 offices in 33 countries, allowing us to deliver local activation of global strategies for brands across the world. Recognized with a platinum rating by EcoVadis for sustainability, we are experts at identifying the most impactful and sustainable solutions for over 800 brands around the globe.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Tech Lead.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:

•   Current CTC

•   Expected CTC

•   Notice period

•   Current location

•   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

The Senior Business Development Executive will be responsible for driving business growth in the Metal and Heavy Engineering sector. This is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division, requiring a proactive and self-driven professional capable of independently identifying and developing new business opportunities.

The role involves conducting market research, generating leads and RFQs, mapping potential customers, arranging client meetings, and converting business opportunities into revenue. * Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Metal and Heavy Engineering industry.

* Coordinate with internal technical and project teams to ensure timely submission of proposals and responses to customer inquiries.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging business opportunities within the Metal and Heavy Engineering sector.
* Travel extensively to customer locations to develop new business opportunities and strengthen existing relationships.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business Administration. An MBA or M.Tech is preferred.
* 4–6 years of business development experience in the Metal and Heavy Engineering industry, including Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminium, Copper, Non-Ferrous Metals, Foundries, Rolling Mills, or related sectors.
* Proven experience in market research, lead generation, appointment generation, RFQ and inquiry generation, and customer relationship management.

* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently identify business opportunities, develop customer networks, manage sales pipelines, and achieve business targets with minimal supervision.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and target-oriented, with a willingness to travel extensively.
* Fluency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of Hindi, Bengali, or Odia will be an added advantage.
