title: Physiotherapist
description:
Position
**: Physiotherapist**

Department : Clinical

Location : WohlPhysio – Trivandrum

Employment Type : Full-Time

Reporting To : Clinical Manager

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled, compassionate, and patient-focused
**Physiotherapist**

to join our clinical team. The role involves assessing patients,

developing individualized treatment plans, delivering evidence-based

physiotherapy interventions, monitoring progress, and educating patients

and caregivers about rehabilitation and preventive care.

The

physiotherapist is expected to maintain high clinical standards while

ensuring a positive and professional patient experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Patient Assessment

* Conduct detailed physiotherapy assessments based on the patient's condition and medical history.
* Identify functional limitations, pain, movement restrictions, muscle weakness, and other physical impairments.
* Establish appropriate short-term and long-term rehabilitation goals.
* Perform reassessments to track patient progress.

2. Treatment & Rehabilitation

* Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.
* Provide physiotherapy interventions for
  **orthopaedic, neurological, sports, geriatric, and post-operative conditions**
  .
* Deliver treatments such as:
* Therapeutic exercises
* Manual therapy
* Strength and conditioning
* Mobility and flexibility training
* Myofascial release
* Dry needling, where appropriately trained
* Electrotherapy and ultrasound
* Taping techniques
* Functional rehabilitation
* Balance and gait training
* Modify treatment plans based on patient response and clinical progress.

3. Patient Education

* Educate patients and caregivers regarding their condition and rehabilitation process.
* Provide appropriate home exercise programs.
* Explain preventive measures, posture, ergonomics, and lifestyle modifications.
* Encourage patient adherence and active participation in rehabilitation.

4. Documentation & Clinical Records

* Maintain accurate and timely patient records.
* Document assessments, treatment provided, progress, and future treatment plans.
* Follow clinic documentation standards and clinical protocols.
* Ensure all required records are completed within the prescribed timelines.

5. Patient Experience

* Build professional and trusting relationships with patients.
* Communicate treatment plans clearly and respectfully.
* Address patient concerns appropriately.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Ensure every patient receives a safe, respectful, and positive clinical experience.

6. Team Collaboration

* Coordinate with doctors, therapists, nurses, and other healthcare professionals when required.
* Participate in case discussions and multidisciplinary rehabilitation planning.
* Support other physiotherapists and clinical team members when required.

7. Quality & Compliance

* Follow clinical SOPs, safety protocols, infection-control procedures, and organizational policies.
* Maintain professional standards and ethical practices.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and clinical audits.
* Stay updated with current physiotherapy practices and evidence-based rehabilitation approaches.

8. Additional Responsibilities

* Participate in camps, health awareness programs, workshops, and community outreach activities.
* Support patient education and rehabilitation-related content when required.
* Assist in promoting awareness of physiotherapy and rehabilitation services professionally.
* Participate in internal training and continuous professional development programs.

Required Qualifications

* **Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)**
  .
* Valid professional registration/licence as applicable.
* Additional certifications in specialized physiotherapy techniques will be an advantage.

Experience

* **Freshers and experienced physiotherapists can apply.**
* Experience in orthopaedic, neurological, sports, geriatric, or rehabilitation settings will be an advantage.

Key Skills

* Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills
* Good knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and rehabilitation
* Manual therapy and exercise prescription skills
* Strong patient communication skills
* Empathy and patient-centred approach
* Good documentation skills
* Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
* Problem-solving and clinical decision-making skills
* Willingness to learn and develop professionally

**Performance Expectations**

The physiotherapist will be expected to maintain:

* High standards of clinical care
* Accurate and timely documentation
* Patient satisfaction and engagement
* Treatment adherence and follow-up
* Professional conduct and punctuality
* Compliance with clinical SOPs
* Continuous improvement in clinical knowledge and skills

Benefits

* **Health insurance**
* **Annual appraisal**
  with salary revision
* **Variable Pay Incentive (VPI)**
  linked to performance
* **Personal development allowance**
  to support your learning and growth
* **Leave:**

24 days of annual leave, 12 days of sick leave, plus maternity leave

(as per the Maternity Benefit Act) and up to 2 weeks of paternity leave

* **Team bonding allowance**
  every quarter for team outings
* **Statutory benefits:**
  PF, ESI and gratuity, as applicable

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a
**patient-focused, clinically competent, responsible, and growth-oriented physiotherapist**

who is passionate about rehabilitation and committed to delivering

measurable outcomes while creating a positive patient experience.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary rehabilitation team
* Exposure to diverse orthopaedic and neurological cases
* Opportunities for clinical learning and professional development
* Training in advanced rehabilitation techniques
* Opportunities to participate in community and healthcare initiatives
* Career growth opportunities within the organization

Job Description: IT Procurement Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Procurement Manager to oversee IT procurement activities, strategic sourcing, vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and tendering processes. The role involves managing procurement operations, collaborating with internal stakeholders, ensuring cost-effective purchasing, and leading a team to achieve business objectives.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end IT procurement activities, including sourcing, tendering, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and order tracking.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business requirements and cost-optimisation goals.
* Manage IT vendor relationships, evaluate supplier performance, and negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and service agreements.
* Oversee RFQ, RFP, and tendering processes, including bid evaluation, vendor shortlisting, and supplier selection.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls, contractual obligations, and approval workflows.
* Coordinate with IT teams, business stakeholders, requesters, finance, and legal teams to understand purchasing requirements.
* Monitor procurement spend, identify savings opportunities, and support budgeting and cost-allocation activities.
* Oversee purchase order management, order fulfilment, invoice-related queries, and resolution of procurement issues.
* Manage vendor onboarding, vendor master data, procurement catalogues, and supplier documentation.
* Identify opportunities to streamline procurement workflows, improve turnaround times, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Prepare procurement reports, analyse supplier performance, and provide updates on savings, spend, and key performance indicators.

People Management Responsibilities

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of procurement professionals to achieve operational and business targets.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor workloads, and ensure timely completion of procurement activities.
* Set individual and team performance goals and track KPIs, productivity, accuracy, and SLA adherence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify training and development needs.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Manager, Software Engineering**
with 12+ years of experience to lead our Database Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure team. In this role, you will lead a team of high-performing engineers responsible for architecting, scaling, and optimizing multi-cloud relational and in-memory database platforms. You will bridge technical execution, engineering leadership, and strategic infrastructure planning across AWS and Azure environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Lead the architectural design and operations of enterprise-grade, multi-cloud relational databases across AWS (RDS PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora) and Azure (Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance).
* Drive high-availability architecture strategies, including Multi-AZ deployments, auto-failover groups, read replica scaling, and cross-region disaster recovery (DR).
* Oversee zero-downtime operations, including major-version engine upgrades, schema migrations, and blue/green deployment strategies.

**In-Memory Infrastructure & Open-Source Strategy**

* Manage scale operations for in-memory datastores (AWS ElastiCache, Azure Cache for Redis), focusing on cluster mode operations, eviction policies, and persistence tuning.
* Spearhead open-source caching initiatives and migration pathways from Redis to Valkey (e.g., AWS ElastiCache for Valkey) using zero-downtime tools like RedisShake to ensure open-source license compliance and optimize cloud spend.

**Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps**

* Enforce an IaC-first engineering culture using Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation to eliminate manual configuration and console drift.
* Drive automated database provisioning, drift detection, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for database schemas using tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

**FinOps & Performance Optimization**

* Partner with Finance and DevOps to drive FinOps practices: conduct cost allocation, rightsizing exercises, and reserved instance / savings plan management.
* Evaluate and implement optimal architectural tradeoffs between serverless and provisioned computing models (e.g., Aurora Serverless v2, Azure SQL Serverless).
* Monitor performance using AWS Performance Insights and Azure Diagnostics to optimize query performance, indexing, and resource usage.

**Team Management & Operational Excellence**

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of senior database and cloud infrastructure engineers.
* Set operational standards, service level objectives (SLOs), and incident management practices for database availability, security, and scalability.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 12+ years of total software engineering / infrastructure experience, with at least 3–5 years in an engineering management or technical leadership role focused on cloud databases.
* Multi-Cloud Mastery: Deep hands-on experience operating managed relational databases in both AWS and Azure environments at enterprise scale.
* In-Memory & Valkey Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Redis clusters and navigating Redis-to-Valkey migration strategies to reduce operational overhead and licensing costs.
* Automation & IaC: Mastery of Infrastructure as Code principles (Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and database migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase).
* FinOps Expertise: Demonstrated ability to optimize multi-cloud infrastructure costs, manage serverless vs. provisioned workloads, and deliver measurable cloud cost savings (20–30%+).
* Operations & Resiliency: Direct experience implementing automated backups, zero-downtime blue/green deployments, major version upgrades, and multi-region disaster recovery.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Backend Software Engineer – Python & Platform Services**
**About The Role**
Humigent is an AI-native analytics company helping pharma and life sciences organizations unlock the value of their commercial and medical data. As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will design, build, and own the backend services behind our analytics products — APIs, data access layers, caching, and asynchronous processing. You will work across Python, FastAPI and Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery, collaborating with Engineering, Data, Product, and Delivery to keep our services correct, fast, and dependable under real production load. Exposure to GenAI tooling is a strong plus, as a growing part of our roadmap involves LLM-backed features.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* API & Service Development: Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python with FastAPI and/or Django. Own API contracts — versioning, pagination, error semantics, and backward compatibility. Structure applications so they remain maintainable as the team and surface area grow. Write services with clear boundaries and testable interfaces.
* Data & Persistence: Model and optimize data in PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing strategy, query tuning with EXPLAIN, and safe migrations against live systems. Reason about transactions, isolation levels, and locking. Manage connection pooling and query performance as traffic grows.
* Caching & Asynchronous Processing: Design caching and invalidation strategies with Redis, choosing the right data structures, TTLs, and eviction behavior. Build reliable background and scheduled workloads with Celery — task design, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and backpressure. Ensure async work fails safely and recovers predictably.
* Reliability & Performance: Own the performance and reliability of your services — profiling, load behavior, timeouts, and graceful degradation. Troubleshoot production incidents and drive fixes to root cause. Build in observability — metrics, logs, and traces that make failures diagnosable.
* Engineering Craft & Enablement: Participate in design discussions and technical reviews; document and defend tradeoffs. Review code and collaborate through disciplined Git workflows — branching, PRs, and clean history. Mentor mid-level engineers and raise the quality bar across the team.

**What You Bring**

* 6–9 years of hands-on backend engineering experience in a product or SaaS environment
* Strong production experience with Python — data model, concurrency (GIL, threading, asyncio, multiprocessing), typing, and testing
* Depth in FastAPI and/or Django — dependency injection, Pydantic validation, ORM internals, middleware, and authentication
* Strong PostgreSQL skills — indexing, query planning, transactions and isolation, locking, and connection pooling
* Practical Redis experience — caching patterns and invalidation, data structures, TTL and eviction behavior, and use as a broker
* Production experience with Celery — task design, broker and backend choices, retry and idempotency patterns, and worker scaling
* Confident with Git — branching strategies, rebase vs. merge, conflict resolution, and collaborative review practices
* Solid API design sense and the ability to reason about failure modes, not just happy paths
* Strong systems thinking and ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and product teams

**Nice to Have**

* GenAI, LLM experience — LangChain, LangGraph, agentic or multi-step LLM workflows
* RAG pipelines, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate), embedding and chunking strategies
* Prompt design, evaluation, and cost/latency management for LLM-backed features
* Docker and containerized deployments; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar)
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
* Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry, OpenTelemetry)
* Event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with high-traffic or data-heavy systems, or multi-tenant enterprise SaaS
* Experience in pharma tech, life sciences, or health data products

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package aligned with industry benchmarks
* Direct access to leadership and meaningful ownership over backend architecture
* Opportunity to build the services behind cutting-edge AI analytics in pharma and life sciences
* Fast-paced, high-growth environment with a culture of learning and experimentation

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description: DescriptionEveryday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.Key job responsibilitiesDesign, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.A day in the lifeMost days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.About The TeamOur team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. title: Software Engineer, AVP
description:
Join us as a Software Engineer
  
  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
* Day-to-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
* It’s a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
In your new role, you’ll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions. You’ll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.
  
  
**You’ll Also Be**

* Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
* Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning
* Collaborating to optimise our software engineering capability
* Designing, producing, testing and implementing our working code
* Working across the life cycle, from requirements analysis and design, through coding to testing, deployment and operations

The skills you'll need
  
  
You’ll need at least eight years of experience in software engineering, software design, architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers.
  
  
**You’ll Also Need**

* Expertise in TypeScript and ES6+, TypeScript along with experience in build tools such as Webpack, Node.js, and NPM
* Expertise in React.js for building scalable, maintainable, and responsive user interfaces
* Experience in cloud platform such as Azure, AWS and GCP and cloud-native services along with understanding of cloud-agnostic architecture principles
* Experience in platform and application monitoring, observability, and performance tuning using tools such as App Insights, New Relic, Grafana and Prometheus
* Expertise in designing and building RESTful APIs and backend services, with knowledge of databases, caching, messaging, resiliency, and Microservices architecture

title: Software Specialist
description:
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate
**Specialist - Software Engineering**
with focus on
**Software Engineering**
, to join the
**Bangalore**
technology center in India. If innovation and efficiency drive you forward, this is the place for you!
  
  
Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we adopt new technologies to develop innovative solutions, constantly striving to rewrite tomorrow. As a
**Specialist - Software Engineering**
, you will design, build, and maintain robust software solutions that power Nasdaq’s market platforms, working across the full development lifecycle to deliver high-quality, scalable systems.
  
  
We are looking for candidates with a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today’s markets.
  
  
**With this position we offer**
Join the
**Market Platform**
organization, a team that builds and maintains the technology infrastructure behind Nasdaq’s trading and market services. You will work on impactful, large-scale solutions that serve global financial markets every day.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
As a
**Specialist - Software Engineering**
, your focus will be developing and implementing software solutions. Besides working closely with your colleagues in
**Bangalore**
, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications for Nasdaq’s market platform.
* Write clean, well-tested code and conduct code reviews to ensure quality standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to capture requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes and engineering best practices.
* Support integration of platform components with internal and external systems.

**We expect you to have:**

* Experience Level: 5 to 8 years of software engineering experience.
* Primary Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C++); experience with RESTful API design; knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases; familiarity with CI/CD pipelines; experience with version control systems such as Git.
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; effective communication and teamwork in a team environment.
* Education Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Computer Science.

**It would be phenomenal if you have:**

* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with financial markets or trading platforms.
* Experience with containerization tools such as Docker or Kubernetes.

**Does it sound like you?**
As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2–3 weeks.
  
  
**Come as you are**
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law.
  
  
Nasdaq is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information, and public company services. As the creator of the world’s first electronic stock market, its technology powers more than 100 marketplaces in 50 countries. Nasdaq is home to over 4,000 total listings with a market value of approximately $12 trillion.
  
  
To learn more about our business visit business.nasdaq.com. Check out more about our Life at Nasdaq.
  
  
**Come as You Are**
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.
  
  
We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

title: Compliance Associate (Onboarding)
description:
**Who are we?**

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

**Who We Are**
--------------

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever-evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

FalconX is a digital assets prime brokerage platform redefining digital assets prime brokerage from the ground up. We are backed by some of the best investors in the world including Accel, American Express, GIC, B Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Fidelity, Flybridge, Lightspeed, and Tiger Global.

We deliver institutional digital asset customers best-in-class trading, credit, custody, and structured products. We trade, lend, and secure tens of billions of dollars monthly, are highly profitable, and growing fast, so we need your help!

* **We are data-driven:** Whether it's a growth or product decision, we believe data can always help us make more precise and informed choices.
* **We move fast:** Speed of execution is essential for any startup, but we believe this is even more pertinent in our 24/7 industry.
* **We prioritize learning:** Outcomes are mission-critical, but we also believe that learning in success and in failure will drive our continued success. Our industry is emergent; there's no shortage of experiments to get involved with and to continue growing and learning together.

FalconX has offices in the USA (San Mateo, New York), India (Bengaluru), Malta, Hong Kong, Singapore, and London.

**Who Is on the Team?**
-----------------------

* **We are entrepreneurs:** Many in our company have been founders or have aspirations to eventually start their own company. We take these ambitions and experiences to bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the problems we encounter day-to-day.
* **We are experienced:** We have been fortunate to have learned from mentors and peers at institutions such as Google, LinkedIn, JUMP Trading, Citadel, PEAK6 Investments, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Harvard Business School, Carnegie Mellon, IIT, and more.

**Impact**
----------

At FalconX, you'll help make global digital assets a successful asset class in the most compliant way. Some of the largest financial institutions from Wall Street to Silicon Valley and around the world will turn to us for the best market prices and insights on the crypto industry. You will understand the key money laundering risks within the global digital assets industry and assist in putting key risk mitigation controls in place. As a key member of the compliance team and key contributor to the global AML program, you will learn and grow our company's values which define our culture and drive day-to-day behaviors and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Ensure smooth and prompt onboarding of new prospective corporate/institutional customers (KYB/KYC) and conduct periodic refreshes in accordance with the Firm's global procedures while meeting local requirements.
* Perform Know Your Business (KYB) and Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence across multiple international jurisdictions, including **US, EU, and APAC** markets.
* Working with the Account Management team, review the onboarding of end users with Exchange partners, adhering to Exchange requirements and internal policies.
* Utilize AI, technology, and specialized platforms to conduct Customer Risk Assessments, Adverse Media screening, Sanctions screening, wallet screening, enhanced due diligence (EDD), and escalate complex issues to the Compliance Manager as appropriate.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Institutional Coverage, Sales, Partnerships, and Account Management regarding customer onboarding status based in APAC, EU, and global regions.
* Maintain comprehensive, audit-ready records of customer information and corporate legal documentation, providing real-time updates as needed.
* Provide KYB/KYC policy and procedure advisory to Sales and business units on documentation needs and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in the creation of management information (MI) and metrics for regulatory and internal reporting purposes.
* Proactively seek process improvements and technological enhancements to boost onboarding productivity and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* **Experience:** 4–8 years of direct experience in KYB/KYC onboarding, corporate due diligence, and general compliance operations within financial services, fintech, or digital assets.
* **Multi-Jurisdictional Exposure:** Proven experience dealing with multiple key international jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks, specifically **US, EU, and APAC** markets.
* **Tooling & Technology (Good to Have):** Hands-on knowledge or practical experience with **Sumsub** (or similar automated KYB/KYC identity verification platforms) is highly desirable.
* **Institutional Onboarding:** Demonstrated expertise in handling institutional customers, complex corporate ownership structures (UBO identification), and High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWI).
* **Digital Assets Expertise:** Prior experience with or exposure to digital assets/cryptocurrency compliance is a strong advantage.
* **Core Competencies:** Excellent analytical skills, sound regulatory judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong team player, adaptable to shifting priorities, resilient under pressure, and proactive in driving tasks to completion.

**Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy**

Applicants located in California and/or applying to a role based in California, please refer to our Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy here.

  

**Inclusivity Statement**

FalconX is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and safe workspace for all people. Our roles are intended for people from all walks of life. We encourage all those interested in applying to our organization to submit an application regardless if you are missing some of the listed background requirements, skills, or experiences!

As part of our commitment to inclusivity, FalconX would like to acknowledge that the EEOC survey has limited potential responses that you can select. For legal reasons, FalconX must use this language to align with federal requirements, however, we want to ensure that you are able to provide a response to our own voluntary survey questions about your identity that best aligns with your most true self.

*FalconX is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other legally-recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.*

*Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on FalconX. Please inform FalconX's People team at recruiting@falconx.io, if you need assistance with participating in the application process.*

title: Senior Lead - SAP Finance
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Summary of the role:**

Senior Lead - SAP Finance, part of the **FICO IT team** within LS&Co.’s Corporate Functions IT, reporting to the Director, ERP Finance & Controlling, GCC Delivery Lead.

The team represents Finance in ERP initiatives and is responsible for S/4HANA implementations, global template rollouts, and ongoing enhancements to improve finance operations across markets. This role plays a key part in **strategic solution design, finance transformation, and data migration activities** across implementation programs.

**About the Role-**

This role requires a strong functional SAP FICO expert with hands-on capability and strategic thinking to design, implement, and optimize finance solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead **solution design, architecture, and configuration** of SAP FICO aligned to LS&Co.’s global template
* Drive **strategic solutioning**, including design decisions, trade-off analysis (pros/cons), and scalable finance process frameworks
* Own and support **data migration and conversion activities** including:
  + Migration strategy and planning
  Data mapping (legacy+ S/4)
  + Data cleansing, validation, and reconciliation
* Collaborate with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to **define requirements and prioritize transformation initiatives**
* Lead **end-to-end project delivery** (design, build, test, deploy, stabilization)
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure **integration across SAP modules (PTP, OTC, etc.)**
* Drive **process improvements and adoption of new system capabilities**
* Facilitate workshops, solution validation sessions, and stakeholder alignment
* Support **testing cycles (SIT/UAT)** including test scenario design and issue resolution
* Lead **change management, business cutover, and hypercare support**
* Develop **process documentation, functional specifications, and training materials**
* Manage escalations, risks, and ensure timely issue resolution
* Lead and mentor a **medium-sized team**, owning deliverables and team development

**About You-**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance/Accounting or equivalent
* CA or advanced degree preferred

**Skills & Experience**

**Core SAP Expertise:**

* SAP FICO (15+ years) with strong hands-on expertise in:
  + General Ledger (incl. New GL, parallel ledgers, multi-GAAP, multi-currency)
  + Accounts Payable & Receivable
  + Asset Accounting / Banking
  + Controlling (CO modules)
* Experience in **integration with PTP, OTC and other modules**
* Strong exposure to **interfaces (ALE/IDOC/PI-PO)**

**Strategic & Transformation Experience:**

* Proven experience in **global template design and rollout** across multi-country environments
* Strong exposure to **finance transformation programs and S/4HANA implementations**
* Ability to drive **high-level solution design, process optimization, and future-state architecture**

**Data Migration & Implementation:**

* Hands-on experience with:
  + Data conversion strategy and execution
  + Data mapping, cleansing, and reconciliation
  + Migration tools/processes (e.g., Winshuttle preferred)
* Experience across **implementation, enhancements, and production support**

**Additional Skills:**

* Basic ABAP understanding (debugging, reading code) – good to have
* Exposure to reporting tools (BI HANA, Tableau)
* Familiarity with Jira/Confluence

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Experience managing small to medium-sized teams
* Strong stakeholder management across global teams
* Ability to lead workshops, drive decisions, and influence outcomes

**Other Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment

**Digital & Innovation Focus**

* Experience leveraging **AI, automation, or analytics in finance processes**
* Awareness of **SAP innovations** (embedded analytics, predictive accounting, AI-enabled finance use cases)
* Ability to identify and drive **technology-led process improvements**

**Benefits**  
  
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

Here's a small snapshot:

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity & family care leaves

title: Presales Executive - Chennai
description:
Roles & Responsibilities  
I. Lead Planning, Management & Execution

* Handle inbound customer enquiries generated through digital marketing campaigns, property portals, website enquiries, social media, referrals, walk-ins, channel partners, and other approved lead sources.
* Execute outbound calling to assigned customer databases and prospective buyers using the company's CRM and lead management systems.
* Understand and record customer requirements, including budget, preferred location, plot size, investment purpose, purchase timeline, and payment preferences.
* Introduce the company's plotted development projects and identify prospects with genuine purchase interest.
* Classify and prioritise leads as Hot, Warm, or Cold based on customer interest, budget, purchase readiness, and follow-up requirements.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of lead status, call outcomes, customer requirements, and next follow-up dates in the CRM.
* Prioritise high-potential leads and ensure that genuine customer enquiries receive timely attention.
* Reconnect with inactive and previously interested leads to identify potential sales opportunities.

II. Customer Engagement & Project Explanation

* Act as the first point of contact for prospective customers interested in purchasing residential plots.
* Explain the company's plotted development projects, including project location, connectivity, available plot sizes, layout details, amenities, infrastructure, and other key features.
* Provide accurate and updated information regarding plot pricing, availability, approved offers, payment plans, and booking procedures.
* Understand customer requirements and communicate suitable project options based on their budget, location preference, and intended use.
* Address customer queries professionally through telephone calls, WhatsApp, emails, and other company-approved communication channels.
* Share approved project brochures, location maps, presentations, videos, and other marketing materials with prospective customers.
* Handle common customer objections relating to pricing, location, accessibility, plot availability, payment terms, and purchase timelines.
* Escalate technical, legal, documentation, approval-related, or pricing queries to the appropriate internal team whenever necessary.
* Ensure all information shared with customers is accurate, transparent, and consistent with company-approved communication.
* Build customer trust through professional communication, timely responses, and consistent follow-ups.

III. Lead Qualification, Follow-Up & Sales Pipeline Management

* Qualify leads based on customer interest, budget suitability, preferred project location, purchase readiness, and willingness to attend a site visit.
* Identify genuine prospective plot buyers and distinguish them from general enquiries or prospects with no immediate purchase intent.
* Maintain a systematic follow-up schedule for interested customers and ensure that no qualified lead is missed due to delayed communication.
* Follow up with customers who require additional information, need time to discuss with family members, or are comparing different property options.
* Record customer objections, feedback, purchase timelines, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Re-engage older leads and prospects who previously showed interest but did not proceed with a site visit or booking.
* Share qualified leads and relevant customer information with the Field Sales Team to support effective customer engagement.
* Monitor the progress of leads from initial enquiry through qualification, site-visit scheduling, and subsequent sales follow-up.
* Maintain an updated pipeline of active prospects, follow-up cases, and potential sales opportunities.

IV. Site-Visit Coordination & Conversion Support

* Convert qualified customer enquiries into confirmed site visits for the company's plotted development projects.
* Explain the importance of visiting the project site to understand the actual location, layout, accessibility, surrounding development, and available plots.
* Schedule site visits based on customer availability and coordinate with the Sales Managers, Field Sales Executives, and Site Teams.
* Confirm scheduled visits with customers and provide reminders to improve attendance.
* Share customer requirements, budget details, preferred plot sizes, and previous discussion notes with the assigned Sales Executive before the site visit.
* Track scheduled, completed, rescheduled, and cancelled site visits in the CRM.
* Follow up with customers after their site visits to understand feedback, interest level, concerns, and further requirements.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team to identify prospects who require additional assistance before proceeding towards booking.
* Support the sales team in improving lead-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion ratios.
* Maintain regular communication with the Sales Team regarding high-potential leads and immediate sales opportunities.

V. Channel Partner Coordination (If Applicable)

* Coordinate with the Channel Partner Team or designated reporting manager regarding enquiries received through channel partners and property brokers.
* Record and track customer leads referred by channel partners in the prescribed CRM system.
* Ensure that channel partner leads are assigned, updated, and followed up on according to company procedures.
* Coordinate with the concerned internal team to obtain approved information regarding project details, pricing, availability, and sales processes for channel partner enquiries.
* Follow up on referred leads and coordinate with the Sales Team regarding site visits and subsequent sales progress.
* Maintain proper records of channel partner enquiries, lead status, site visits, and booking updates.
* Escalate channel partner-related queries or issues to the authorised team for resolution.
* Follow company policies concerning lead ownership, customer allocation, channel partner communication, and commission-related information.

VI. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets assigned by the reporting manager.
* Meet prescribed outbound calling and customer enquiry-handling targets.
* Maintain expected productivity in terms of connected calls, meaningful customer conversations, and qualified leads.
* Generate and schedule qualified site visits based on customer interest and project requirements.
* Improve site-visit attendance through timely confirmation calls, reminders, and follow-ups.
* Contribute to sales and booking objectives by providing qualified prospects and consistent follow-up support to the Field Sales Team.
* Monitor individual performance against assigned targets and take corrective action when required.
* Participate in daily reviews, weekly performance meetings, and monthly target assessments.
* Maintain a balance between calling volume, lead quality, customer experience, and conversion performance.
* Work towards the performance benchmarks established by management based on lead availability, campaign volume, and project requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Number of outbound calls made.
* Number of inbound enquiries handled.
* Number of connected calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of site visits scheduled and completed.
* Site-visit attendance and conversion rates.
* Follow-up completion and lead reactivation.
* CRM data accuracy and timely MIS submission.
* Contribution to sales opportunities and bookings.

VII. CRM, Documentation & MIS Reporting

* Maintain complete and accurate customer records in the company's prescribed CRM or lead management system.
* Update call outcomes, customer requirements, lead classification, follow-up dates, site-visit schedules, and sales progress promptly.
* Ensure proper lead allocation, status updates, and follow-up tracking in accordance with company procedures.
* Prepare and submit daily call reports, follow-up reports, qualified-lead reports, and site-visit updates.
* Prepare weekly lead pipeline and site-visit status reports for management review.
* Support the preparation of monthly performance reports covering productivity, lead conversion, site visits, and sales contribution.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all CRM entries, reports, and customer-related documentation.
* Avoid duplicate records, incomplete entries, and unauthorised changes to lead information.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information, company databases, project pricing, and internal business information.
* Follow company guidelines for CRM usage, data security, and customer information handling.

VIII. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with the Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager for daily activities, target allocation, lead prioritisation, and performance reviews.
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing Team to understand lead sources, campaign details, and the quality of incoming enquiries.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Field Sales Executives to facilitate site visits and support sales conversion.
* Liaise with the CRM Team for clarification regarding customer documentation, registration processes, and post-booking procedures when required.
* Coordinate with the Liaison Team for authorised clarification regarding project approvals and documentation-related queries.
* Communicate recurring customer objections, feedback, pricing concerns, and market observations to the reporting manager.
* Participate in project briefings, product training, sales meetings, and internal performance reviews.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination across departments to ensure a smooth customer journey.

IX. Professional Development

* Develop a thorough understanding of the company's plotted development projects, including location, layout, plot sizes, amenities, pricing, and approved payment plans.
* Upgrade knowledge of CRM tools, lead management practices, customer engagement techniques, and sales reporting.
* Stay updated on real estate market trends, customer buying behaviour, competitor offerings, and local property demand.
* Improve telephone etiquette, persuasion, negotiation, objection handling, and customer relationship management skills.
* Participate in internal training programmes, project presentations, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Implement feedback received from the reporting manager to improve productivity and conversion performance.

X. Behaviour, Teamwork & Workplace Conduct

* Maintain professional conduct and a customer-focused approach in all interactions.
* Demonstrate discipline, ownership, accountability, and commitment to assigned targets.
* Work collaboratively with the Pre-Sales, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and other relevant teams.
* Maintain a positive attitude while handling customer objections, repeated follow-ups, and target-related pressure.
* Demonstrate patience, emotional intelligence, and effective communication when dealing with diverse customer requirements.
* Follow ethical sales practices and provide only accurate, company-approved information to customers.
* Adhere to company policies, attendance requirements, reporting procedures, and workplace guidelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer data and company information.
* Accept performance feedback positively and demonstrate continuous improvement in individual and team performance.

Working Days & Week-Off Policy

* Sunday working is mandatory due to peak customer enquiries and site-visit requirements.
* Weekly off will be provided on a weekday as per management allocation.
* Flexibility to work during marketing campaigns, festive periods, special sales drives, and other business requirements is expected.
* Working hours, attendance, leave, and other employment conditions will be governed by company policy.

Key Working Relationships

**Internal**

* Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager
* Sales Managers and Field Sales Team
* Digital Marketing Team
* CRM Team / CRM Head
* Liaison Team, wherever required
* Other relevant departments as required for customer enquiry resolution

**External**

* Prospective Customers and Clients
* Channel Partners / Property Brokers, where applicable
* Other authorised external stakeholders, as required

Qualification & Experience

**Essential**

* Any graduate degree from a recognised university is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in real estate pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management, or target-based customer acquisition is preferred.
* Experience in residential plot sales, plotted developments, land sales, or other property-related businesses will be an added advantage.
* Good verbal communication skills in Tamil are essential for handling local customers.
* Basic to good English communication skills for professional interactions and reporting.
* Ability to work towards assigned performance targets and manage regular customer follow-ups.

**Desirable**

* Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA in Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Experience handling high-volume customer enquiries and digital marketing leads.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, lead management tools, and sales MIS reporting.
* Experience coordinating site visits and supporting real estate sales conversions.
* Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and a willingness to work in a target-driven environment may be considered based on business requirements.

Functional Competencies

* Lead Management and Qualification
* Customer Relationship Management
* Real Estate Project Knowledge
* Lead Conversion and Site-Visit Coordination
* Communication, Persuasion and Objection Handling
* CRM and Technology Utilisation
* Reporting and Performance Metrics
* Follow-Up and Sales Pipeline Management
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Target Achievement and Productivity Management

Behavioural Competencies

* Customer Focus
* Team Collaboration
* Emotional Intelligence
* Time Management and Prioritisation
* Adaptability and Initiative
* Accountability and Ownership
* Professionalism and Ethical Conduct
* Resilience and Target Orientation
* Attention to Detail
* Continuous Learning and Improvement

Pay: Up to ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications)
description:
**Full Stack Developer (AI/ML & Web Applications)**

**Role Summary**

The Full Stack Developer will design, build and deploy secure, scalable web applications with integrated AI and machine learning capabilities. The role requires strong full-stack engineering across frontend, backend, data and cloud layers, together with practical AI/ML engineering competence: integrating models across commercial, cloud and self-hosted providers, building retrieval and agent workflows, and adapting and serving models where required.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech., MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML or a related discipline
  **(Must have)**
* Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight
* Candidates with strong verifiable work (production applications or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification

**Experience**

* 4+ years of professional full-stack development (5+ years preferred);
  **minimum 2 years building and deploying AI- or ML-powered features in production applications**
* Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least one production web application, covering frontend, backend, database, deployment and monitoring
* **Demonstrable experience delivering at least one LLM or ML-powered application to end users**
  (such as a retrieval-augmented assistant, a document-processing workflow or an agent), including its evaluation and monitoring
* Hands-on experience with Python and TypeScript in production, and with React-based frontends
* Experience deploying containerised applications on cloud platforms through CI/CD pipelines
* Experience fine-tuning or self-hosting models, working in regulated sectors, or building Indian-language applications is a plus

**Key Responsibilities**

Application Development

* Design and develop responsive, accessible web applications using React and Next.js with TypeScript
* Develop backend services and APIs in Python (FastAPI) and Node.js, with clear contracts (OpenAPI or GraphQL) and versioning
* Design data models and optimise queries across relational and NoSQL databases, and implement caching and background job processing
* Translate functional requirements into well-structured, maintainable and production-ready code

AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate LLMs in a provider-agnostic manner across commercial APIs, cloud AI platforms and self-hosted open-weight models, through an abstraction or gateway layer, so that models can be switched or compared without application changes
* Build LLM-powered features, including streaming conversational interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation with source citations, structured extraction and tool-calling agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Implement retrieval pipelines covering document ingestion and parsing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid vector search and re-ranking
* Implement routing, caching, rate limiting and fallbacks across providers to control quality, cost and latency

Model Integration & Serving

* Integrate and serve pre-trained models (such as OCR, speech, classification and embedding models, including Indic language models) behind production APIs
* Fine-tune or adapt models where required (for example, LoRA fine-tuning of an LLM or embedding model), in coordination with data scientists
* Build evaluation suites for AI features (golden datasets, regression tests and LLM-based evaluation) and run them in CI as release gates

Security, Privacy & Responsible AI

* Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and role-based access control), and secure handling of APIs, secrets and personal data
* Apply OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications controls, including defences against prompt injection and data leakage
* Apply data-minimisation practices in compliance with applicable data protection law, including for data sent to external model providers, and design human review for consequential AI outputs

Quality, Deployment & Operations

* Practise test-driven development with unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and maintain adequate coverage
* Containerise applications and manage deployments through CI/CD pipelines on Kubernetes or serverless platforms, using infrastructure as code
* Instrument applications with logging, metrics and tracing, including LLM traces, token usage and cost, and participate in incident resolution
* Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 and GIGW) and support for Indian languages in user interfaces

Collaboration & Mentoring

* Participate in Agile delivery, code reviews and architecture discussions
* Mentor junior developers, and document designs, APIs and operational runbooks

Technical Competencies

* **Frontend:**
  TypeScript, React, Next.js (App Router and server components), Tailwind CSS, component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent), TanStack Query; accessibility and internationalisation
* **Backend:**
  Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio) and Node.js (NestJS, Fastify or Express); REST with OpenAPI, GraphQL; WebSockets and server-sent events for streaming; background jobs (Celery or BullMQ)
* **Databases & Caching:**
  PostgreSQL (with pgvector), MongoDB, Redis; ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Prisma or Drizzle); schema migrations and query optimisation
* **LLM Providers & Frameworks:**
  commercial APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini), cloud AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI), Indian providers (Sarvam, Bhashini) and self-hosted open-weight models via vLLM or Ollama; gateways such as LiteLLM; LangGraph, LlamaIndex or equivalent multi-provider frameworks; structured outputs, tool calling and MCP
* **Retrieval & Vector Search:**
  embeddings, chunking strategies, hybrid search and re-ranking; vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus or Weaviate); document parsing (Docling or vision-language OCR models)
* **Applied ML:**
  PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers for inference and fine-tuning (PEFT); scikit-learn; ONNX Runtime and quantised models; pre-trained models for OCR, speech (IndicConformer, Whisper) and Indic NLP (AI4Bharat)
* **AI Evaluation & Observability:**

title: Full Stack AI Engineering Lead
description:
**About Bloom AI**

Bloom AI builds
**AI-native intelligence systems and workflows**
for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions. We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations build systems that continuously understand context, generate intelligence and support action. Our model sits between traditional product companies and services firms. We build reusable technology and engineering patterns while deploying them against real enterprise problems and adapting them to different client environments.

Bloom AI is based in the U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR). This is a hybrid role.

**The Role**

We are looking for a
**hands-on Full Stack AI Engineer with 4–6 years of experience**
who can design, build and deploy production-grade AI applications, with particular emphasis on
**multi-agent systems, backend engineering and end-to-end application development**
.

This is a core engineering role for someone who combines strong software fundamentals with practical experience building LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows and intelligent data systems.

You should be comfortable working across the stack—from building agent orchestration and backend services to developing user-facing applications, integrating enterprise data and deploying solutions in cloud environments.

This is
**not a prompt-engineering or research-only role**
. We are looking for someone who can turn AI capabilities into reliable, scalable software that solves real business problems.

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment. You will be part of core team reporting to the CEO.

**What You'll Do**

**Build Agentic Systems**

* Design and develop multi-agent systems that coordinate specialized agents to execute complex tasks and workflows.
* Implement agent orchestration, planning, tool calling, task delegation, context management and state management.
* Build LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar**
  .
* Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, agent memory and knowledge retrieval capabilities.
* Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, databases, documents and external data sources.
* Implement evaluation, tracing, error handling, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems.

**Build Backend and Full Stack Applications**

* Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs and application logic using
  **Python and frameworks such as FastAPI**
  .
* Build user-facing applications using modern frontend frameworks such as
  **React, Next.js or similar**
  .
* Develop data models, database integrations and processing pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
* Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and integrations between application components.
* Design modular, maintainable architectures that support reuse across client environments.
* Own features end-to-end, including technical design, development, testing, integration and deployment.

**Work with Graph and Context Systems**

* Design data structures and retrieval mechanisms that help AI systems understand entities, relationships and context.
* Work with graph-based data models and knowledge graphs to represent relationships across enterprise and external data.
* Combine structured data, semantic search and graph-based retrieval to support richer agent reasoning and intelligence workflows.
* Contribute to the development of persistent context, memory and state-management capabilities for AI agents.
* Evaluate when relational databases, vector databases or graph-based approaches are appropriate for different problems.

**Deploy Production Grade Systems**

* Deploy and manage applications on cloud infrastructure, preferably
  **Microsoft Azure**
  , with AWS or GCP experience also relevant.
* Work with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, model APIs and enterprise AI services.
* Implement containerization, CI/CD, authentication, logging and application monitoring.
* Build systems with appropriate security, access controls, data privacy and reliability standards.
* Debug performance, integration and production issues across the full application stack.

**Solve Real Enterprise Problems**

* Work with business and technical teams to understand workflows and translate requirements into working AI solutions.
* Rapidly prototype new capabilities, evaluate technical approaches and move successful prototypes into production.
* Integrate AI systems with existing enterprise applications, data sources and workflows.
* Collaborate with engineers to improve architecture, code quality and reusable components.
* Participate in client discussions, technical demonstrations and solution design.

**What We're Looking For**

* **4–6 years of professional software engineering experience**
  , including hands-on development of AI/LLM applications.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python**
  , backend engineering, API development and software architecture.
* Practical experience building
  **agentic or multi-agent systems**
  , beyond basic chatbot or prompt-based applications.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar**
  .
* Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management.
* Experience developing full-stack applications, including working knowledge of
  **React, Next.js or another modern frontend framework**
  .
* Strong SQL, database design and data integration fundamentals.
* Working understanding of graph data structures, entity-relationship modeling and graph-based retrieval concepts.
* Experience taking applications from development through testing and production deployment.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging and independent execution skills.

**Good to Have**

* Start-up or 0->1 experience.
* Experience with
  **Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or other graph databases**
  , including knowledge graph construction, Cypher and GraphRAG.
* Experience building stateful agents, long-running workflows, persistent memory or context-management systems.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation, observability and tracing tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse or similar.
* Experience with
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
  , event-driven architectures, queues or distributed systems.
* Experience integrating AI into enterprise applications such as CRM, marketing, sales or research workflows.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients or in a fast-moving startup environment.

* Authentication and RBAC (JWT, role/permission models).
* Input validation (Zod / class-validator).

* PostgreSQL - schema design, relationships, indexing, query optimization.
* Prisma ORM (v7) - schema, migrations, and the client.

**General**

* Solid Git workflow (branching, pull requests, reviews).
* Good understanding of clean architecture, SOLID principles, and writing maintainable code.

* Docker and working with containers.
* Linux / VPS basics - deploying and running apps on a VPS (e.g. Hostinger), Nginx, SSL.
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) for automated build, test, and deploy.
* Swagger / OpenAPI for API documentation.
* Monorepo tooling (Turborepo) and pnpm workspaces.
* Testing - Jest / Vitest and integration tests.
* Payment integrations (e.g. Razorpay), messaging/WhatsApp APIs (e.g. DoubleTick).
* Image/CDN services (e.g. ImageKit) and media optimization.
* Component libraries such as shadcn/ui / Radix.
* Basic cloud exposure (AWS / GCP) and observability/logging.

React 19Next.js 16TypeScriptTailwind CSS v4TanStack QueryZustandNode.js 24NestJS 11PostgreSQLPrisma 7

Our core stack: React 19 · Next.js 16 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS v4 · TanStack Query · React Router DOM · Zustand · Node.js 24 · NestJS 11 · PostgreSQL · Prisma 7 · Redis. Tooling: Docker · CI/CD · Swagger · Turborepo · pnpm.

title: Automation Specialist
description:
**Company:**
Trikuta Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:**
IT / Business Automation

**Experience:**
3–5 years preferred

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Work Mode:**
As per company requirements

About the Role

Trikuta Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a hands-on Zoho Automation & Integration Developer with strong expertise in advanced Deluge scripting, custom function development, REST APIs, WhatsApp Business API, and omnichannel integrations.

The role focuses on developing custom code, integrating applications, automating workflows, and building a connected customer lifecycle automation ecosystem using Zoho CRM, Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Sign, and third-party platforms.

**This is a development-focused role, not a basic CRM administration position. Advanced Deluge scripting, API integration, and WhatsApp automation are mandatory.**

Key Responsibilities1. Advanced Deluge Scripting & Custom Development

* Develop advanced Deluge scripts, custom functions, reusable components, and scheduled functions.
* Build custom business logic, conditional workflows, event triggers, and multi-step automations.
* Automate record creation, updates, data validation, notifications, and cross-module operations.
* Develop custom solutions beyond standard Zoho workflow capabilities.
* Implement error handling, execution logs, retry mechanisms, duplicate prevention, and failure alerts.
* Debug and optimize scripts for reliability, execution limits, and API consumption.

2. Zoho CRM Custom Development

* Customize CRM modules, fields, layouts, relationships, validation rules, and record structures.
* Develop workflows, Blueprints, custom modules, scheduled actions, and approval automations.
* Build custom functions, buttons, widgets, and integrations where required.
* Automate record assignments, task creation, follow-ups, escalations, and status synchronization.
* Maintain data integrity and optimize CRM automation performance.

3. REST APIs & Third-Party Integrations

* Develop integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth 2.0.
* Connect Zoho CRM with external applications, websites, lead sources, and communication platforms.
* Build inbound/outbound data synchronization and event-driven integrations.
* Handle API authentication, pagination, rate limits, token refresh, and synchronization conflicts.
* Test APIs using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Implement logging, retries, error handling, and secure credential management.

4. Zoho WorkDrive & Zoho Sign

* Integrate Zoho CRM with Zoho WorkDrive and Zoho Sign through supported APIs and custom functions.
* Automate customer-folder creation, document organization, uploads, and permissions.
* Generate and send agreements using approved templates and CRM data.
* Synchronize document references, signature status, and completion dates with CRM.
* Handle failed uploads, expired agreements, incomplete transactions, and integration errors.

5. WhatsApp Business API Automation

* Integrate Zoho CRM with the WhatsApp Business Platform or approved solution providers.
* Develop API-based messaging functions and webhook handlers.
* Automate personalized messages, approved templates, appointment reminders, follow-ups, onboarding notifications, and customer updates.
* Process inbound messages and link customer responses to the correct CRM records.
* Handle message delivery statuses, failures, and supported interactive responses.
* Automate task creation, callback assignment, routing, and escalation based on incoming messages.
* Implement consent checks, opt-out handling, and WhatsApp policy compliance.

6. Omnichannel Integrations

* Integrate email, SMS, telephony, website chat, and other supported communication channels.
* Work with platforms such as Zoho SalesIQ, Zoho Desk, Zoho Voice, and third-party providers.
* Automate call logging, missed-call alerts, callback scheduling, IVR events, and communication follow-ups where supported.
* Synchronize communication history with CRM records.
* Develop routing rules, notifications, escalation logic, and duplicate-message prevention.

7. Workflow Engineering & Automation

* Develop event-driven, scheduled, and multi-step automation workflows.
* Connect CRM, WorkDrive, Sign, WhatsApp, email, telephony, and external applications.
* Automate lead capture, assignments, agreements, document collection, onboarding, task allocation, and case updates.
* Implement workflow sequencing, conditional triggers, failure recovery, and reconciliation mechanisms.
* Reduce manual work through custom functions, integrations, and automated data processing.

8. Testing, Debugging & Maintenance

* Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Troubleshoot Deluge scripts, API responses, webhook payloads, and synchronization failures.
* Test missing data, duplicate events, invalid inputs, and partial failures.
* Monitor API consumption, execution limits, failed workflows, and integration health.
* Maintain technical documentation, audit trails, security controls, and recovery procedures.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Advanced Zoho Deluge scripting and custom function development.
* Zoho CRM customization, workflows, Blueprints, and scheduled functions.
* REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and API authentication.
* Zoho WorkDrive and Zoho Sign integrations.
* WhatsApp Business API or an approved WhatsApp integration provider.
* Custom messaging automation and webhook-based event processing.
* Data synchronization, debugging, exception handling, and retry mechanisms.
* API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Secure credential handling and role-based access controls.

Preferred Skills

* JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and custom widget development.
* Zoho Flow, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, Zoho SalesIQ, and Zoho Voice.
* Node.js, Python, or other languages for middleware development.
* Telephony APIs, IVR, call logging, and call disposition automation.
* AI chatbot integrations and conversational automation.
* Git or equivalent version-control systems.
* Experience in BPO, CRM-based service businesses, or customer operations.

Practical Technical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to demonstrate a working solution involving:

1. A custom Deluge function for CRM record creation and updates.
2. REST API integration and webhook-based event processing.
3. WhatsApp message delivery and inbound response synchronization.
4. Automated WorkDrive folder creation.
5. Zoho Sign agreement generation and status updates.
6. Scheduled reminders and automated task assignments.
7. Error handling, retries, duplicate prevention, and execution logging.

Candidates must explain their code, integration architecture, authentication, debugging approach, and security controls.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three to five years of relevant development experience preferred.
* Demonstrable experience with Zoho CRM development, custom functions, and API integrations.
* Ability to independently develop, test, debug, and maintain production automations.
* Strong programming, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated on code quality, successful integration delivery, automation reliability, reduction in manual work, data synchronization accuracy, failure resolution, security, and technical documentation.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**developer first, Zoho specialist second**
—someone capable of writing custom code, building API integrations, automating WhatsApp communications, and solving complex technical challenges independently.

Candidates whose experience is limited to CRM data entry, basic workflow configuration, or user administration will not be suitable.

How to Apply

Submit your updated CV with details of your Zoho CRM development projects, Deluge scripts, API integrations, WhatsApp automation experience, and Zoho WorkDrive/Sign implementations.
