description: Line of ServiceAdvisoryIndustry/SectorFS X-SectorSpecialismOperationsManagement LevelManagerJob Description & SummaryAt PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.Those in intelligent automation at PwC will focus on conducting process mining, designing next generation small- and large-scale automation solutions, and implementing intelligent process automation, robotic process automation and digital workflow solutions to help clients achieve operational efficiencies and reduce costs.*Why PWCAt PwC, you will be part of a vibrant community of solvers that leads with trust and creates distinctive outcomes for our clients and communities. This purpose-led and values-driven work, powered by technology in an environment that drives innovation, will enable you to make a tangible impact in the real world. We reward your contributions, support your wellbeing, and offer inclusive benefits, flexibility programmes and mentorship that will help you thrive in work and life. Together, we grow, learn, care, collaborate, and create a future of infinite experiences for each other. Learn more about us.At PwC, we believe in providing equal employment opportunities, without any discrimination on the grounds of gender, ethnic background, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, religion or other beliefs, perceived differences and status protected by law. We strive to create an environment where each one of our people can bring their true selves and contribute to their personal growth and the firm’s growth. To enable this, we have zero tolerance for any discrimination and harassment based on the above considerations. "Role Summary Drive the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions built on a strong foundation of Java microservices, cloud-native architecture, and secure, scalable platforms. The role blends Agentic AI engineering with modern backend engineering practices to deliver production-ready, resilient, and governed AI systems, along with the ability to contribute to end-to-end application layers. Responsibilities THE MISSION Frontier models and autonomous agent frameworks have moved out of the lab and into the P&L. The binding constraint is no longer model capability — it is deployment. Most enterprise AI programmes stall in the gap between a pilot that impresses a steering committee and a system the business can actually run. The Frontier Deployment Consultant exists to close that gap. You will embed inside client environments — their tenancy, their data, their security review, their release process — and take a workflow from hypothesis to a production agentic system that keeps running after you leave the room. This is a builder-advisor role in the literal sense. You will hold the boardroom with structured business thinking and write the production code that makes the system real. Candidates who have only ever done one of the two will not be a fit. HOW THE ROLE OPERATES • Embedded, not adjacent. You work inside the client's environment on their infrastructure and release cadence. Expect 50–70% onsite presence, including travel across India, GCC hub cities and client HQ geographies where the engagement requires it. • Pod delivery. FDCs deploy in small pods — typically one Senior FDC plus two to three FDCs and engineers — with access to the practice asset library, PwC's Responsible AI framework and the GCC operating-model IP base. • Outcome-owned. Engagements are measured on time-to-value, reliability, adoption and realised ROI. Delivery milestones are an input, not the score. • Real enterprise conditions. You will work under client security clearance, on client-issued devices where mandated, and inside regulated, data-resident and occasionally air-gapped environments. WHAT YOU'LL DO 1. Diagnose and shape value Partner with CEOs, COOs, CDOs, CTOs and business unit heads to find the workflows where agentic execution changes unit economics rather than shaving minutes. Size the prize in terms a CFO will act on: cost-to-serve, cycle time, throughput per FTE, revenue leakage, total cost of ownership. 2. Build 0→1 at startup velocity Form the hypothesis, diagnose the workflow with structured consulting toolkits, and put a working, interactive prototype in front of the client in days. The proof is running software, not slideware. 3. Architect production agentic systems Design and implement multi-agent architectures across brownfield estates: planner-executor patterns, agent handoffs, durable state and checkpointing, retries and cancellation, human-in-the-loop escalation. Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) integration. Hybrid and graph-based retrieval over knowledge-graph and semantic-layer foundations. 4. Own the evaluation and run layer Build the evaluation harness before the system ships — golden datasets, regression suites, task-completion and toolcall accuracy, groundedness and safety scoring, LLM-as-judge where it is defensible. Instrument tracing end to end. Define and hold service-level objectives for accuracy, latency, cost per task and containment rate. 5. Engineer for the enterprise, not the demo CI/CD for non-deterministic systems, infrastructure as code, containerised deployment into client infrastructure, canary and rollback strategy, runbooks, incident response, and a documented handover that leaves the client's own team selfsufficient. 6. Make it safe and defensible Agent identity and credentialing, least-privilege tool scoping, secrets management, prompt-injection and OWASP LLM Top 10 defences, PII and DLP controls, data residency, full audit trail. Apply PwC's Responsible AI framework and map obligations to the DPDP Act 2023, sectoral regulation (RBI, IRDAI, HIPAA) and EU AI Act risk tiers where in scope. 7. Manage the room Translate non-deterministic behaviour, evaluation results, latency and cost trade-offs and governance constraints into commercially sound executive narratives. Own the working relationship with client CTO, CISO and CFO stakeholders. 8. Operate AI-native Set the benchmark for AI-accelerated delivery on the account — Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, agentic test generation, evaluations running in CI — and pull client engineering teams up to it. 9. Codify the IP Abstract deployment patterns into reusable assets: reference architectures, deployment blueprints, evaluation harness templates, governance artefacts, runbooks and role maps that travel across accounts and industries. WHAT YOU WILL BE HELD TO Accountability How it is measured Time-to-value First production workflow live within the mobilisation window agreed at engagement start Reliability Agreed SLOs on accuracy, groundedness, latency and uptime held after go-live, not just at demo Adoption Active usage against the target user base; workflow containment and fall-backto-human rate Unit economics Cost per task inside the agreed envelope; demonstrable TCO improvement against the baseline Self-sufficiency Client team operating and releasing the system without PwC in every change Asset contribution At least one reusable, documented asset contributed to the practice per engagement WHAT YOU'LL BRING — TECHNICAL Depth is assessed on demonstrated production work. Named tools are illustrative; equivalent experience counts. Core engineering — required • Python to production standard: typing, testing, packaging, profiling. Plus one of TypeScript/Node, Go or Java. • API and service design, microservices, async and event-driven patterns, Docker and Kubernetes. • Working depth in at least one hyperscaler — Azure, AWS or GCP — including networking, identity and cost controls. • Ability to architect hybrid pipelines that route across LLMs, SLMs and traditional ML components based on task fit, cost and reliability requirements Agentic build layer — required • Demonstrated depth in at least two of: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Pydantic AI. • Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and client implementation; agent-to-agent (A2A) interoperability patterns. • Multi-provider abstraction, model routing and fallback (LiteLLM or equivalent). • Long-running and durable execution (Temporal or equivalent), agent memory and state (Mem0, Zep or custom), checkpointing and replay. Retrieval and knowledge — required • Ingestion and chunking pipeline design, embedding lifecycle and re-indexing strategy, reranking, hybrid and graph retrieval, RAG evaluation. • Vector stores: Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector or Azure AI Search. • Knowledge graph and ontology work — Neo4j, GraphRAG, semantic layer design — is a strong differentiator. • Document AI and structured information extraction - extracting structured data from unstructured and semistructured sources (contracts, invoices, forms, scanned records, PDFs) using OCR, layout-aware models and document AI platforms (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI) Evaluation, observability and LLMOps — required, and assessed first • Evaluation harness design: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, adversarial and edge-case sets, statistical treatment of non-determinism. • Tracing, prompt and version management, drift and hallucination detection — LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave or equivalent. • Guardrail frameworks, red-teaming, and continuous evaluation running inside CI. • Traditional NLP, SLM fine-tuning, quantization and distillation to verify, ground or cross-validate LLM outputs Enterprise AI platforms — required • Production experience on at least one of: Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Snowflake Cortex. • Working familiarity with agent capabilities embedded in enterprise suites — Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow AI Agents, Microsoft Copilot Studio, SAP Joule. Integration and data — required • Systems of record: SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday. Integration middleware: MuleSoft, Boomi or equivalent iPaaS. • Event streaming (Kafka), CDC and ELT patterns, data quality, lineage and contract testing. • Comfort with undocumented legacy APIs, mainframe-adjacent estates, and incumbent RPA estates (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) that agents must displace or coexist with. Production operations — required • CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring and alerting, structured logging, incident management and on-call discipline. • Release strategy for non-deterministic systems: canary, shadow mode, staged autonomy, rollback. Security and Responsible AI — required • Identity and access for non-human actors: OAuth2/OIDC, service principals, workload identity, short-lived credentials, secrets management. • Least-privilege tool scoping, prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defence, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, PII and DLP handling, immutable audit trails. • Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act risk tiering and India's DPDP Act 2023. Inference economics — required • Token cost modelling, prompt and context caching, model cascading and routing, batch versus real-time tradeoffs, small-model substitution and distillation. WHAT YOU'LL BRING — CONSULTING AND COMMERCIAL • Structured problem solving. Issue trees, hypothesis-driven diagnosis, MECE decomposition — used to narrow scope fast, not to decorate a deck. • Commercial instinct. You design to ROI, TCO, adoption and change effort rather than to novelty, and can construct and defend a business case. • Executive presence. You can debate integration detail with client engineers in the morning and lead a board-level transformation session in the afternoon. • Change and adoption design. Role redesign, human-in-the-loop operating models, controls and assurance — the work that determines whether the system is actually used. • High agency. Ambiguous problem statements, undocumented systems and unhelpful vendors are the normal operating condition, not an escalation. THE EVIDENCE BAR We assess demonstrated deployment, not CV pattern-matching. Shortlisted candidates should be able to evidence all of the following: • At least two LLM or agentic systems you personally built that reached production and were used by people outside your own team. Internal demos, vendor lab builds, hackathon projects and proofs of concept that never entered a production environment do not qualify. • Code you have written in the last twelve months. You will be asked to walk through it line by line. • An evaluation harness you designed — and a specific failure it caught before it reached users. • A production incident on an AI system you owned: what broke, what you changed, what it cost. • A business outcome you can quantify and defend under CFO-grade questioning. • Willingness to remain hands-on. FDCs spend at least half their time building; Senior FDCs at least 30%. TWO LEVELS, ONE ROLE Level Experience Time building Owns Frontier Deployment Consultant (Manager) 5–7 years 50–70% Workstream outcomes, system build, evaluation harness, client engineering relationship Senior Frontier Deployment Consultant (Associate Director) 7–10 years 30–40% Account-level outcomes, pod leadership, architecture and governance standards, CXO relationships, practice assets BACKGROUND WE LOOK FOR A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent capability demonstrated through work. We deliberately do not filter on institution. Non-linear profiles are actively welcomed — technical founders, staff engineers who moved into client-facing work, consultants who learned to ship. An MBA is neither required nor an advantage on its own. Preferred, not required • Delivery experience inside a GCC or global business services environment. • Depth in one industry — BFSI, life sciences, energy, telecom or industrial products — and process fluency in S2P, O2C, R2R, claims, KYC/AML or clinical operations. • Deployment inside a regulated or data-resident environment. • Process mining or workflow discovery (Celonis or equivalent). • Open-source contribution, published technical writing or conference work in the agentic space. HOW WE SELECT • 1. Portfolio walkthrough (45 min). One production system you built, end to end, including what you got wrong. • 2. Live build (2–3 hours). A timeboxed agentic build against a messy, partially documented data source. AI coding assistants permitted and expected. • 3. Evaluation and failure design (60 min). You are handed a working agent, asked to design its evaluation harness, then asked to break it. • 4. Brownfield integration case (60 min). Architecture and trade-off reasoning against a legacy estate with real constraints. • 5. Executive simulation (45 min). Present outcome, risk and cost narrative to a mock CXO panel. • 6. Practice fit. Conversation with practice leadership on how you work and what you want to build. WHY JOIN PwC • Front-row impact. Shape the core AI strategies and operating fabric of leading global enterprises and Global Capability Centers, at the point where decisions actually get made. • Both halves of the job. The strategic reach, industry breadth and executive access of top-tier consulting, with the speed, autonomy and modern stack of a frontier AI team. • Leverage. What you build once becomes practice IP deployed across accounts and markets — your work compounds instead of ending at go-live. • Compounding learning. Senior practice partners, exceptional peers, and a direct hand in PwC's point of view on autonomous enterprise systems. title: Building Operations, Facilities Services
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Aim
  
To achieve excellence in preventive maintenance programs at site with highest standards. Assist in providing comprehensive facility, contract, and procurement management for technical services to Accenture. Achieve Key Performance Indicators and service level agreements targets
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Financial Management
  
To manage and control all critical spares for all installations as per manufacturer recommendations and inventory
  
Coordinate with AEM for collating all R&M requirements quarterly basis.
  
Follow up for assigned PO, work completion as per PO until invoice submission.
  
  
Operations Management
  
To carry out all engineering & operational procedures
  
Ensure proper functioning of the following system in the facility
  
All Electrical Systems
  
All HVAC system
  
All PAC’s
  
Water, Plumbing, Sanitary Systems
  
Elevators/Lifts
  
Cafeteria equipment’s
  
To liaise with the vendors for maintenance/service practices of M&E contactors to deliver quality work practices in line with the manufacturer recommendations.
  
To ensure that all maintenance related schedules & shut down in consultations with OEM & Accenture are followed.
  
Daily inspection of log books, history card, checklist, escalation charts, OCP & PPM schedules etc. for a better management of engineering systems
  
To ensure and guide the technical staff attends & work for closures for all F&S technical related issues in the facility.
  
To adhere to 52 weeks annual M&E maintenance schedule.
  
To maintain consistency on agreed SLA & KPI.
  
To participate during emergency evacuation procedure and manage all health & safety issues. 1Prepare and collate data related to vendor performance and escalate as required.
  
Ensure proper usage & functioning of e-fit facility tool (IMT, VMT, Sites ops modules, Site Inspection Tool) as per defined scope.
  
Ensure all PM work orders in 360 facility tool/ Archibus are closed and escalate in case of any deviation. Track and close all builder related queries in QMS on monthly basis.
  
Conduct M&E onboarding process, back to Basic as defined.
  
Ensure all the mandatory trainings are conducted as per schedule and track for attendance.
  
Coordinate for execution of works related to IC requests without escalations.
  
Conduct interview for M&E new joiners.
  
Ensure 100% usage of online work permit tool and upload incidents in the incident tool.
  
Proper handing & taking over tabs which are utilized for taking equipment readings.
  
Conduct central store audit, BMS store audit and BMS audit on monthly basis.
  
Facility walk around and ensure Walk around map & Guide is followed and maintained.
  
Coordinate with DM team for any issues that need help.
  
Important and VIP client visits to be coordinated with Events team and should be managed without escalations.
  
Ensure to close the Seibel tickets on time & weekly once do analysis for repeated complaints and highlight to CE
  
Ensure to support for all client audits /Internal & External audits
  
Ensure the functionality of all technology tools in the facility
  
  
Records Management
  
To ensure Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half Yearly & Yearly records are prepared and sent to the chief engineer for all engineering related activities.
  
To update & maintain all records on daily basis (Log books, History Cards, Equipment details, Service Reports, Incident Reports etc.)
  
  
Estate Management
  
To ensure Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half Yearly & Yearly records are prepared and sent to the chief engineer for all engineering related activities
  
Ensure visit and inspect all the critical areas maintained by builder wherever allowed on a daily basis – (Chiller, HT, DG, LT, LMR, STP and pump rooms)
  
Ensure daily co-ordination with the builder on the diesel / water
  
Track & ensure all the activities are performed by the builder as per the contract like FAPA test, Façade glass cleaning etc.,
  
Follow up on all the invoices submission by the builder on time
  
Intimate on any deviation in builder operation and follow up on closure
  
  
Reporting Management
  
Daily Report – DSR/walk around guide, SLA Report, Engineering report
  
Weekly report – Major highlights, zonal point, Weekly R&M tracker
  
Monthly Report –MMR, fortnightly central store SIH report, Energy Report, IIEE Report, Major works carried out report & Equipment Status Report, LCD Projector Report, Statutory Compliance Report, Monthly report
  
Escalation to be followed during an incident as per escalation matrix.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: IT Service Desk & Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

RCS EMS Private Limited provides specialized engineering support to PCB manufacturing and assembly facilities in the United States. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality technical services that help clients optimize production efficiency and product performance. Team members work closely with international partners, gaining exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies and global industry standards. RCS EMS offers opportunities to build expertise in electronics, PCB processes, and engineering support in a professional and collaborative environment.

**Position Overview**

The IT Service Desk & Level 1 Support Specialist will serve as an extension of the internal IT team, providing live user support, remote troubleshooting, ticket management, and basic infrastructure monitoring.

The primary responsibility is to provide a responsive and professional first point of contact for employees, resolve Level 1 issues when possible, and ensure issues requiring additional expertise are properly documented and routed to the appropriate Level 2 or Level 3 IT team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Desk & User Support**

* Provide live Service Desk phone support.
* Provide remote troubleshooting and resolution of common Level 1 IT issues.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate Service Desk tickets.
* Monitor the Service Desk queue and respond to incoming requests in a timely manner.
* Follow established troubleshooting procedures and knowledge-base documentation.
* Provide clear communication to users regarding ticket status and next steps.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Incident Triage & Escalation**

* Triage, categorize, and prioritize incidents and service requests.
* Resolve issues within the scope of Level 1 support.
* Properly document troubleshooting steps and relevant information.
* Route unresolved issues to the appropriate Level 2 or Level 3 IT support team.
* Immediately escalate critical or business-impacting issues according to established procedures.
* Monitor escalated tickets to ensure appropriate handoff and ownership.

**Infrastructure & Backup Monitoring**

* Monitor alerts for designated infrastructure, including:
* Windows servers
* Network devices and connectivity
* Infrastructure services
* Business applications
* Synology backups
* Arcserve backups
* Validate and document actionable alerts.
* Notify the appropriate system owner or internal IT team member when an alert requires attention.
* Escalate critical outages, system failures, or backup issues according to established procedures.
* Maintain tickets and documentation for significant alerts and incidents.

**User Account Support**

* Perform authorized Level 1 Active Directory account unlocks.
* Perform authorized password resets.
* Provide basic account and access troubleshooting.
* Escalate issues requiring higher-level identity or access administration.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve common IT issues.
* Knowledge of Information Technology fundamentals, including operating systems, basic networking, and standard office applications.
* Experience or familiarity with IT Service Management practices, such as ticketing systems and incident management workflows.
* Demonstrated Customer Service abilities, including clear communication, empathy, and professional phone and email etiquette.
* Relevant education such as a diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad and collaborate effectively with local and remote teams.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail when recording issues, actions, and resolutions.
* Willingness to learn, adapt to new tools and technologies, and follow established security and compliance guidelines.

title: Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)
description:
**Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing)**

*Build the operating backbone of a U.S. staffing company’s India business. Ahmedabad. Reporting to the CEO.*

**Company:**
STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited (STCPL)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat. On-site while the office is established and through the first 90 days; hybrid thereafter

**Type:**
Full-time. Must be able to start within 30 days of offer

**Reports to:**
Founder and CEO (U.S.)

**Manages:**
People and Operations Specialist (U.S. staffing operations); HR, Payroll and Compliance Specialist (India, planned hire); the Business Operations function as it grows

**Hours:**
Staggered India schedule, typically 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, with consistent overlap with U.S. morning hours and flexibility for local business needs

**About STEPS Talent**

STEPS Talent is a U.S. enterprise technology staffing company with a growing India company, STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited. We place ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity and Software Engineering professionals with enterprise clients in the United States and India. We are establishing Ahmedabad as our permanent India headquarters and hiring the person who will run it.

**The role**

This is a founding operator role. You will not inherit a finished system. You will build one.

This is not an HR Manager, Finance Manager or administrative role. It is a hands-on business operator who knows how a staffing company runs behind the scenes.

**You own India business and financial operations end to end:**
controls, monthly close, management reporting, intercompany billing with the U.S., HR and payroll oversight, statutory compliance, and the relationships with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers. You set up the Ahmedabad office and lead key corporate and banking projects. You build the Business Operations team under you. And you work directly with the Founder and CEO, with no layers in between.

**What you will build in year one**

* A finance and controls function that U.S. leadership can trust without checking the work twice: approval workflows, segregation of duties, auditable records
* The Ahmedabad office: premises, vendors, infrastructure, people
* A steady working rhythm with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers: clear handoffs, complete documentation, deadlines met without reminders
* HR, payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, Professional Tax) run by a specialist you hire and manage
* Oversight of staffing back-office operations: consultant onboarding, timesheets, billing and client portals
* The reporting rhythm: one monthly view of cash, billing, payroll, compliance and open issues
* The systems backbone across Zoho Books, Tally, HRMS and our staffing platforms

**What good looks like at 90 days**

* Monthly close, reporting and compliance running on schedule without CEO intervention
* The Ahmedabad office and professional relationships operating with clear ownership
* The first management dashboard live, and a prioritized systems plan for the next two quarters

**Who does well here**

* 10+ years in business operations, ideally IT staffing or professional services, with hands-on ownership of India finance operations: monthly close, reconciliations, vendor payments, payroll controls, management reporting
* Has worked directly with Chartered Accountants, tax professionals and payroll providers, and keeps ownership inside the company
* Reads a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and turns them into management action
* 5+ years managing people; working knowledge of Indian HR, payroll and employment compliance
* Working knowledge of U.S. staffing back-office operations: consultant lifecycle, W-2 and C2C, timesheets, client billing
* Has built processes, controls and reporting in a growing company and been personally accountable for the result. Been there, done that
* A problem-solver who owns outcomes: resolves issues at their level, escalates with options rather than questions, and does not need the CEO to close every open item
* Clear writer and speaker; discreet; comfortable working directly with U.S. leadership

**Preferred:**
Zoho Books, Zoho People, Tally, QuickBooks or comparable systems; SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba or similar MSP and VMS platforms; intercompany billing across related companies in different countries; setting up a new office or managing external advisers.

**Why this role**

* Founding seat in a new India headquarters, with the authority to design how it runs
* Direct line to the CEO. Your work is seen, and your decisions carry
* Cross-border scope: U.S. and India finance, tax, compliance and staffing operations in one role
* A path to Head of India Business Operations as the company grows

**To apply**

Send your resume directly to Sunny Patel at
**Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com**
, copying
**Shree.Singh@stepstalent.com**
, with the
**subject line “Senior Manager, Business Operations (IT Staffing) - Ahmedabad”**
.

In three lines, tell us the hardest operations problem you have fixed. Direct applicants only.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Sr. QA Automation Engineer

**Experience:**
4–6 Years

**Location:**
Ahmedabad

**Department:**
QA

**About Simform**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.

Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled
**Senior QA Automation Engineer with hands-on experience in test automation, AI-powered testing tools, and modern quality engineering practices.**
The ideal candidate will have experience designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks, leveraging AI tools to improve test coverage and efficiency, and ensuring software quality and stability. This role requires strong programming skills, proficiency in automation frameworks, familiarity with AI-assisted testing solutions, and the ability to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for functionality, performance, and security validation.
* Implement and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.
* Leverage AI-powered testing tools and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, improve test coverage, and optimize test maintenance.
* Explore and implement AI-driven test case generation, self-healing automation, intelligent test execution, and automated test failure analysis.
* Use AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools to generate, optimize, debug, and maintain test scripts.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-enabled testing platforms such as Testim, mabl, Functionize, or other relevant solutions where appropriate.
* Identify and resolve test failures, regressions, flaky tests, and application stability issues.
* Enhance test coverage, performance, and reliability across environments.
* Ensure automated tests are efficient, repeatable, maintainable, and scalable.
* Integrate automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, and engineering teams to refine test strategies and quality engineering practices.
* Debug and troubleshoot application and automation issues, using AI-assisted root-cause analysis where applicable.
* Perform API testing (REST/SOAP) using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar tools, including AI-assisted API test generation where applicable.
* Use SQL for database validation and test data management.
* Adhere to Agile methodologies in a Scrum environment.
* Utilize CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD) and version control systems (Git, Bitbucket).

* Active listening and consultative selling
* Target-driven, with persistence in follow-up
* Good time management and organisation
* Comfortable with phone and WhatsApp-based selling
* Team player with a positive, learning attitude

* A learning-focused, supportive workplace in a well-connected Edapally location, near the Metro

Send your updated resume to info@bretsenglish.com with the subject line *"Application – Sales Development Executive"*.

title: Field Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Marketing Manager – School Partnerships & Business Development
  
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (Field-Based / Regional)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time (Monday to Saturday)
  
  
Company: Star Innovators - https://staraiedu.com
  
  
About Star Innovators
  
At Star Innovators, we are transforming education by bringing hands-on AI and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) learning directly into school classrooms across Bangalore. Our experiential learning programs empower young minds through interactive sessions, practical science models, robotics, 3D printing, and aeromodelling. We equip students with the tools and skills needed to thrive in a tech-driven future.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are looking for an energetic, goal-driven, and highly persuasive Marketing Manager (School Partnerships) to expand our presence across schools in assigned territories in Bangalore.
  
  
In this role, you will be the face of Star Innovators. You will visit schools during operating hours, identify key decision-makers (Trustees, Principals, Directors, and Academic Coordinators), deliver compelling presentations, conduct complimentary demo sessions, and successfully close long-term school partnerships.
  
  
Work Schedule & Flexibility
  
Work Days: Monday to Saturday
  
  
Core Field Hours (6 Hours): 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Dedicated to school visits, stakeholder meetings, and live demos on-site).
  
  
Flexible Reporting Hours (2 Hours): Complete daily meeting reports, pipeline updates, and follow-ups at your convenience anytime during the day/evening.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Lead Generation & On-Field School Visits
  
Map out target schools within your assigned geographic territory in Bangalore.
  
  
Conduct regular on-field visits during school hours (10:00 AM – 4:00 PM) to establish direct contact with leadership teams.
  
  
2. Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Building
  
Connect with key decision-makers (Principals, Management, Trustees, and Academic Heads).
  
  
Pitch our end-to-end AI and STEM hands-on learning programs, emphasizing experiential value, hands-on kits, take-home models, and trainer support.
  
  
3. Demos & Conversions
  
Schedule and facilitate complimentary demo sessions for school leadership, teachers, and parents to showcase program impact.
  
  
Present customized offerings and value-driven pricing models to convert prospective leads into active partners.
  
  
4. Deal Closure & Daily Reporting
  
Manage the end-to-end sales cycle—from introductory visits to negotiations and partnership agreements.
  
  
Document daily school interactions, lead status, and visit summaries accurately during your 2 flexible reporting hours each day.
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
Experience: 2–5 years of experience in Educational Sales (EdTech / STEM / B2B Institutional Sales) or On-Field Business Development.
  
  
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
  
  
Skills:
  
  
Strong networking, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  
  
Proven track record of securing meetings with key decision-makers and closing institutional deals.
  
  
Deep geographic understanding of Bangalore’s school ecosystem.
  
  
Mobility: Must have a valid driver’s license and personal vehicle for daily field travel.
  
  
Languages: Fluency in English and Kannada is highly preferred to effectively engage with school management teams across Bangalore.
  
  
What We Offer
  
Competitive Salary: Attractive fixed pay package (₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month depending on experience) + fabulous performance-linked incentives.
  
  
Travel Allowance: Full fuel reimbursement for field visits.
  
  
Flexible Work Culture: Structured field hours with complete flexibility for administrative and reporting tasks.
  
  
Career Growth: Fast-track advancement opportunities as we scale our presence across new regions.
  
  
Meaningful Impact: Direct contribution to advancing hands-on STEM & AI literacy for school students.
  
  
How to Apply
  
Interested candidates can send their updated Resume/CV directly to savio@starinnovators.com or fill out the application form https://forms.gle/j6CJjsaPEq4VRsXs9

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
AVZA Move is a relocation services company that emphasizes energy, integrity, and solutions-oriented thinking for clients across India and around the world. Inspired by the eagle as a symbol of power and freedom, AVZA Move encourages team members to be proactive, sharp, and open-minded while operating within strong ethical and legal standards. The organization treats its people as core assets, promising fair treatment, respect, and transparent compensation, and expects the same respect to be extended to vendors and clients. AVZA Move’s mission is to deliver superior quality relocation services that clients enthusiastically recommend, that internal procurement teams prefer, that employees feel proud of, and that investors value for long-term returns. Its vision is to provide a prime relocation experience to individual and corporate clients through out-of-the-box solutions grounded in ethics, legal compliance, and shared goodwill.
  
**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for driving growth for AVZA Move’s relocation services. This position involves identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate and individual clients, and managing the sales pipeline from prospecting to closure. The Business Development Manager will prepare and deliver proposals and presentations, collaborate with operations and customer service teams to ensure seamless service delivery, and gather market intelligence to refine offerings and pricing strategies. Day-to-day responsibilities include meeting sales targets, attending client meetings and industry events, maintaining accurate CRM records, and providing regular reports and forecasts to leadership. The role also requires ongoing evaluation of client feedback and competitor activity to recommend improvements and support AVZA Move’s mission and vision.

* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, prospecting, and account management.
* Experience in client relationship management, negotiation, and closing deals in B2B or relocation/logistics services.
* Competence in market research, opportunity analysis, and sales forecasting to support data-driven decision-making.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate value propositions clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Solid organizational and planning abilities, including pipeline management, time management, and follow-through on commitments.
* Proficiency with CRM tools and standard office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, and reporting tools).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in relocation, logistics, real estate, or related service industries in Mumbai or similar markets is preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, self-motivation, and the ability to work independently without close supervision.

title: New Business Development Manager
description:
New Business Development Manager

**Company:**
Bhawal Group of Companies – RSM Super Metals LLP

**Location:**
Charni Road, South Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Industry:**
Minor Metals, Base Metals, Rare Earth Metals, Critical Minerals & Refractory Metals

About the Company

Bhawal Group of Companies is an established name in the metals industry, with a legacy dating back to 1979. Through RSM Super Metals LLP and its group companies, we specialize in the sourcing, processing, trading, and supply of
**Minor Metals, Base Metals, Rare Earth Metals, Critical Minerals, Refractory Metals, and Specialty Alloys**
.

We cater to diverse industries, including aerospace, defence, steel, foundries, engineering, electronics, and advanced manufacturing, supported by an extensive domestic and international business network.

Job Description

We are seeking a
**dynamic, ambitious, and result-oriented New Business Development Manager**
to identify new market opportunities, acquire customers, establish strategic relationships, and drive business growth across India and international markets.

The ideal candidate must possess strong commercial acumen, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to independently develop and convert new business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* **New Business Acquisition:**
  Identify, approach, and onboard new industrial customers across domestic and international markets.
* **Market Expansion:**
  **Develop business opportunities in Minor Metals, Base Metals, Rare Earth Metals, Critical Minerals, Refractory Metals, and Specialty Alloys.**
* **Lead Generation:**
  Identify potential customers through market research, industry networks, LinkedIn, trade exhibitions, and direct outreach.
* **Customer Engagement:**
  Conduct regular face-to-face meetings, factory visits, and business presentations to establish long-term relationships.
* **Sales Development:**
  Handle the complete business development cycle, including enquiries, quotations, negotiations, and order confirmations.
* **Strategic Relationships:**
  Build strong connections with procurement heads, technical teams, plant heads, and senior management.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Track global metal markets, competitor activities, pricing trends, demand patterns, and emerging opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with procurement, inventory, sales, and logistics teams.
* **Revenue Growth:**
  Achieve monthly and quarterly targets for customer acquisition, sales revenue, and business expansion.
* **CRM Management:**
  Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, customer interactions, enquiries, and follow-ups.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Metallurgy, Materials Science, Business Management, or a related discipline.
* **5–10 years of B2B business development experience**
  , preferably in metals, industrial raw materials, specialty alloys, or related sectors.
* Strong commercial understanding and proven negotiation abilities.
* Demonstrated success in developing new customers and generating business independently.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings, plant visits, and industry exhibitions.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and performance-driven.

Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a business creator, not merely an order taker.**

**Someone who can identify opportunities where others see none, open new markets, build lasting relationships, and independently convert prospects into profitable business.**

**We strongly believe that face-to-face interactions create stronger relationships and lasting business partnerships**
. Candidates must be comfortable with frequent customer visits and direct engagement with decision-makers.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in the rapidly expanding critical minerals and specialty metals industry.
* Exposure to domestic and international markets.
* Direct interaction with senior management.
* Independence to develop new markets and business opportunities.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Long-term professional growth within an established industrial group.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product ManagerTuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)About Tuning ResearchTuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.About the roleWe’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.What a week looks likeMonday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.What you’ll doScope the right thingRun discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.Own the client relationshipBe the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.Design the systemOwn the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.Build, verify and deployWrite backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.Design the experience and drive adoptionDesign screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.What you need3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.Fluent Hindi and English.Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.Nice to haveYou’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.Who succeeds hereYou have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.Work setupLocation: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.Travel: Regular visits to client sites.Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.Reports to: Tuning Research founders.Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.What success looks like30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.How we hireIntro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.Fill out the form https://forms.gle/L9M6MDArXLP6KFFc8

title: AI Agent Engineer
description: We are building an AI-native analytics function. Instead of analysts hand-writing every query and report, we want people who design AI agents that explore lending data, find insights and recommend actions on their own. You will connect LLMs to our data warehouse and internal tools. You will write the prompts, guardrails and evaluation loops that make the agents reliable.You don't need to be a lending expert. You need working knowledge of how lending and collections work, and deep skill in building and prompting agents. We'll teach the domain. We can't teach you to build good agents from scratch.What You'll DoDesign, build and ship LLM-based agents that query Snowflake, analyse portfolios and produce insights, such as roll rates, bucket movement, cohort performance and campaign effectiveness.Write and maintain production-grade system prompts, tool definitions and knowledge bases, so agents apply business rules correctly (for example, block-list filters, DPD definitions and loan-prefix logic).Build multi-step and multi-agent workflows: planning, SQL generation, validation, summarization and anomaly flagging.Create evaluation harnesses (golden questions, SQL-correctness checks, hallucination tests) to measure and improve agent accuracy.Automate recurring analyses: daily and weekly performance reports, pre-due and delinquent campaign tracking, field-visit and agency productivity analysis.Turn agent output into dashboards, artifacts or alerts that collections, risk and product teams use.Work with business stakeholders to turn vague questions ("why did the 30+ bucket worsen?") into agent-solvable tasks.Document agent behaviour, failure modes and costs, and keep token and compute usage under control.Must-Have SkillsAgent building: hands-on experience with tool-use / function calling and agent loops, using the Claude API/SDK, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph or similar.Advanced prompting: structured prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, output schemas, prompt versioning and debugging hallucinations.SQL (strong): Snowflake or a similar warehouse. You must be able to check whether an agent's SQL is right, not just trust it.Python: pandas, API integrations, scripting, basic orchestration (Airflow or cron).Insight generation: you can go from raw data to "what changed, why, and what should we do".Evaluation mindset: you test agents systematically and don't ship on vibes.Lending basics: understanding of DPD, buckets, NPAs, roll rates, collections efficiency, EMI cycles and credit-risk fundamentals.About Kissht: Kissht is India's leading listed fintech companies, offering fast, personalized digital credit through its mobile app to customers across the country. Founded in 2016 by IIT/IIM alumni Ranvir Singh and Krishnan Vishwanathan, both former McKinsey consultants, Kissht was listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.Kissht serves 74.6 million registered users and 12.25 million customers, with assets under management (AUM) of approximately ₹8,000 crore. Its growth is powered by proprietary AI/ML-based underwriting, a robust in-house technology stack, and a pan-India collections network.Headquartered in Mumbai and backed by marquee investors, including the Brunei InvestmentAuthority, Vertex Growth Fund, and the Government of Singapore, Kissht is now scaling as a publiccompany and is looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent to join nits next phase of growth.

title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.
* Data Engineering & Analytics Platforms
* Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
* Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. The company is known for investing in its people through training, mentoring and opportunities to take on larger responsibilities over time.
* In this role you will have room to experiment with modern cloud tools, AI and automation, while staying grounded in the day to day needs of engineers and designers. For the right person, this is a chance to grow into a trusted partner for project leaders and a key voice in how digital work evolves in the OGC practice.

* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, software engineering trends, and cloud-native best practices.

* Python
* ReactJS
* REST APIs
* Git
* CI/CD
* Distributed systems design

* AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, SageMaker or similar services)

* Experience with ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and modern front-end development frameworks

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience mentoring teams and driving technical strategy across multiple projects.
* Familiarity with digital assets, financial technology (FinTech), trading platforms, tokenization, blockchain ecosystems, or related financial services domains is desirable

**Additional Information**
Why Version 1?
  
  
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

title: Edge Platform & Deployment Engineer
description: Type: Full- timeExperience: 1 - 3 YearsLocation: MumbaiAbout The RoleYou own the stack that sits on the plant floor, and you grow it. Our edge gateway runs on a Linux box in a control panel. It talks to PLCs, CNCs and meters on one side and to our cloud on the other, and it has to keep doing that unattended for months. Every protocol we support is a separate installable app, and the list keeps growing: whenever a customer brings a controller we don't speak yet, you build the adapter for it.This is partly a product role. Most people who use what you build won't be engineers: plant operators, maintenance teams, our solutions and support staff, and partners setting up their own sites. You decide what gets built and how it works, so that someone who has never heard of a register map or a system unit can still configure a device, add tags, and know whether their data is healthy. If a feature only works when you're the one using it, it isn't finished.One morning you might be tracing a bad RS-485 cable on site. That afternoon you might be wrapping a vendor's C library for a new CNC, or redesigning a setup screen because a technician got stuck on it. You maintain the platform, extend it, shape it, and personally get it running on real devices at real sites.What You'll DoDecide what the platform should do next. Turn field problems, support tickets and customer requests into features, set priorities, and make the trade-offs between power, simplicity and reliability.Design for people unfamiliar with the tech:– Guided setup with defaults that work, plain-language errors, and validation that catches mistakes before they reach a device– Status and health that a non-engineer can read at a glance– Configuration that can't silently break something.Watch real users set up and run the product, find where they get stuck or need to call us, and remove those steps.Build new protocol apps to extend the ecosystem: take a protocol or controller we don't support yet, find the best library or vendor SDK for it, and ship a production adapter that follows our app contract (polling, packaging, install scripts, configurator, monitoring), so that every new protocol is just as easy to set up as the existing ones.Pick the right language for each job. Today the platform runs on Node.js, Python, C++, TypeScript and Bash, and the next adapter might need C#, Go, Java or Rust if that's where the only solid driver lives.Commission edge gateways at customer sites: install the device, configure the network, connect it to the PLCs, SCADA, DCS or meters, onboard it to the cloud, and confirm the data is right, not just that it's flowing.Read the existing OT setup before touching it: identify the assets, controllers, protocols, register and tag maps, network layout, and who owns what.Configure and troubleshoot the existing adapters (Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, Siemens S7, Omron FINS, Mitsubishi MC, Fanuc FOCAS) and validate every value against the source.Maintain the core platform: the orchestrator and its web UI, the configurator, the install and uninstall scripts, and the data pipelines (Redpanda/Kafka, MQTT, HTTP).Own releases end to end: build, package, version, ship, and roll out to devices in the field without breaking any that are already live.Diagnose failures remotely and on site using logs, metrics, VPN, SSH and packet captures, then fix the root cause, not just the symptom.Keep deployments secure by default: segmented networks, least privilege, managed secrets, and read-only access to controllers unless writes are explicitly approved.Write the user guides, runbooks and site documentation that let others deploy and run the product without you.What We're Looking ForEngineering degree. Mandatory. Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.1 - 3 years in industrial automation, IIoT, OT integration, systems engineering, or a field-facing technical role.Product sense:– You think about who will use a feature before you think about how to build it– You can explain a technical constraint in plain language– You'll cut a clever option if it confuses the person on siteA generalist engineer, not a one-language developer:– You can pick up an unfamiliar codebase or language and be productive in it quickly– You choose tools by what the job needs (library maturity, vendor support, performance, how it deploys on an edge box), not by habit– You're comfortable reading C headers, vendor SDK docs and protocol specs to work out what a driver actually does.OT fundamentals you can apply on site:– PLCs, SCADA, DCS and historians: what each does and where data really lives– Industrial sensors, transmitters and energy meters– Digital and analog I/O: 4–20 mA, 0–10 V, scaling, dry and wet contacts– Serial wiring and RS-485 multidropHands-on with industrial protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU (function codes, register maps, byte order), OPC UA, and MQTT. Exposure to S7, FINS, MC, FOCAS, BACnet, EtherNet/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850 or IEC 60870-5-104 is a plus.Networking you can debug by hand: IP addressing and subnets, static vs DHCP, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, isolated or air-gapped plant networks, and Wireshark.Comfortable on Linux: the shell, systemd, journald, Nginx, permissions and sudo, package management, bash scripting.Basic IT/OT security principles: the Purdue model and network segmentation, IEC 62443 concepts, least privilege, secrets handling, and why you don't write to a running PLC without sign-off.Structured troubleshooting: you isolate the layer that's failing (wiring, device, protocol, network, service, cloud) instead of guessing.Clear written English. Your guides and site reports get read by people who weren't there, and often by people who aren't technical.Willing to travel to plants and work in panel rooms and on shop floors, roughly 30–40% of the time.Bonus PointsHas built a tool or internal product that non-technical people actually adopted, and iterated on it based on how they used it.Has written a protocol driver, or wrapped a vendor library, and run it against real hardware.Experience with Kafka/Redpanda, Prometheus/Grafana, React or TypeScript, CMake/vcpkg, or cross-compiling for ARM.CI/CD and packaging (Jenkins, offline installs for air-gapped sites).Comfortable using AI-assisted development to get up to speed on a new language or library quickly, and to close a gap while you're still on site.Has commissioned a system that actually went live and stayed live, or is an ex-automation, instrumentation or plant engineer who moved into software.Comfortable being told the panel is undocumented, the tag list is wrong and the network is flat, and getting it working anyway.Why Faclon?Industrial AI at real scale, across sectors and geographies. You own a platform that runs on real machines, not a demo. You decide which protocol it learns next and how easy it is for the next person to deploy. A small team where your judgment decides what ships, how it holds up in the field, and who can use it.
