title: Project Manager/Senior Project Manager – School Governance
description: About the job Project Manager/ Senior Project Manager - School GovernanceOrganisation: Central Square FoundationTeam: School GovernanceLocation: Gandhinagar, Gujarat (travel within the state and periodic travel to Delhi)About Central Square FoundationCentral Square Foundation is a nonprofit organisation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. Since 2012, we have been partnering with the government and ecosystem stakeholders to improve the learning outcomes of children, especially from low-income communities. We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN) EdTech Early Childhood Education (ECE) School GovernanceLearn more about CSF on our website.About The TeamThe School Governance team at Central Square Foundation envisions a transformed school education delivery system that is principally accountable and transparent about its learning outcomes. It targets measuring and publicising the achievement of quality outcomes in public and private schools and establishing a State Schools Standards Authority to enable this reform.The ProblemDespite extensive efforts to increase access to education, learning outcomes have remained alarmingly stagnant in the current educational landscape. Major government initiatives have focused on expanding access and providing input to schools, but their impact on improving educational outcomes has been tenuous, at best. An absence of outcomes-oriented and evidence-based governance is aggravated by a regulatory system where the government runs its own schools and regulates all schools, posing a conflict of interest due to the operator being the regulator. Further, there is no way to reliably measure the learning attainment of schools, making it difficult to hold them accountable for results.The SolutionCSF's Schools Governance team acknowledges the pressing need for a systemic reform in education, which can be solved with a two-fold approach. The states need to: -Establish a robust and reliable learning outcome indicator at the school level by assessing student competencies through a competency-based census assessment (CCA). This will involve public disclosure of school data, while keeping the student data anonymous, to transparently show every school's quality and nudge them to make the necessary improvements.Create an independent school regulator, the State School Standards Authority (SSSA), which will operate outside the current Department of School Education. This body will focus on setting school standards and demand accountability from all schools, government or private.About The Work In GujaratCSF's School Governance team helps states move from input-based regulation to outcome-based regulation, in line with the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020). In Gujarat this means three connected pieces of work: building a reliable, school-level learning indicator through a Competency-based Census Assessment (CCA); enabling public disclosure of school quality while keeping student data anonymous; and supporting the State School Standards Authority (SSSA) as a regulator. Gujarat already runs a school quality programme, Gunotsav, which this work seeks to strengthen and align to outcomes.Position SummaryYou will run CSF's day-to-day execution of this programme in Gujarat. You are the single point of accountability who keeps government partners, technology vendors, and the internal team moving together. You are stepping into a live programme with existing relationships, an in-progress portal build, and a current roadmap, so the first priority is to absorb context quickly and hold continuity, not to rebuild from scratch.Key Responsibilities Programme executionOwn the Gujarat workplan, timelines, and deliverables for the SSSA programme, covering the CCA, public disclosure, and the supporting portal systems.Keep the programme on track against milestones, surface risks early, and drive decisions to closure. Government and stakeholder managementBe CSF's primary working contact for the state education department, GCERT (Gujarat Council of Educational Research and Training), the SSSA body, and data or hosting agencies.Build trust at both the official and field level, manage approvals and clearances, and turn CSF's recommendations into actions the government can adopt. Quality assurance and GunotsavDevelop a clear view of where Gunotsav helps and where it falls short against the outcome-based intent of NEP 2020, keeping students and parents as the test of value.Work with the state to improve how assessment is done, how results are disclosed, and how findings feed back into teaching and school improvement. Product, portal, and vendor coordinationTranslate ground realities into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the school quality and assessment portals.Manage technology vendors on scope, delivery, quality, and timelines, and steer the path to production readiness across security, performance, scale, data privacy, and hosting.Coordinate integrations where needed, for example with UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus). Monitoring and continuityTrack adoption and usage, and share regular dashboards and honest progress updates with the state team and leadership.Keep clean documentation, decision logs, and a current handover record so the programme never depends on one person's memory.Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities4 to 7 years of experience delivering complex programmes or technology-enabled projects, ideally in government, public systems, or the social sector.A graduate or postgraduate degree in any discipline.A track record of managing external vendors on time and quality.Strong stakeholder management, structured problem-solving, and clear written communication.Comfort working with data and digital platforms, including requirements, quality assurance, and releases. You do not need to write code, but you must be able to hold vendors to account on it.Fluent in English. Working Gujarati is a strong advantage for the field and government interface.Willing to be based in Gandhinagar and travel within the state.Familiarity with the Indian school education landscape and state-level systems. (preferred)Exposure to GovTech or large public sector platforms, and to government hosting and compliance, for example NIC hosting, security audits, and data protection. (preferred)Experience taking a product or programme from pilot to stable operation at scale. (preferred)Other DetailsRemuneration competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales, based on experience.Start date: Immediate.

title: Google Apps Script Developer (Ecommerce Automation)
description:
**Devsatva LLP**

📍 [Ahmedabad] · Full-time · 1+ years experience

**About us**

Devsatva LLP is an AI-native data engineering and analytics consultancy. We build real-time data pipelines, agentic AI workflows, and MarTech automation for clients including Singapore Airlines, Unilever India, and Billabong High. We’re a small, senior team — you’ll own problems end to end.

**The role**

We’re building Google Workspace–based inventory and order management tooling for sellers operating across Amazon, Walmart, and other marketplaces. Think: live inventory syncing across channels, order and settlement reconciliation, low-stock and overselling alerts, bulk listing updates — all driven from Sheets that operations teams can actually use day to day.

You’ll be the person who makes those systems reliable. Marketplace APIs are rate-limited, inconsistent, and occasionally hostile; the job is to build around that so the warehouse team never sees a stale number.

**What you’ll do**

* Build inventory sync engines in Apps Script that keep stock levels accurate across Amazon, Walmart, and other sales channels
* Integrate marketplace APIs — Amazon SP-API, Walmart Marketplace API, and others — handling auth, pagination, throttling, and retries
* Automate order ingestion, fulfilment status updates, returns, and settlement reconciliation into Sheets and BigQuery
* Build bulk listing and price update workflows, including feed submission and status polling
* Set up alerting for stockouts, overselling risk, failed feeds, and API errors — so problems surface before clients notice
* Design around Apps Script’s execution limits: batching, time-driven triggers, resumable jobs, caching
* Work with our data engineers to graduate mature automations into the wider pipeline

**What we’re looking for**

* 1+ years of hands-on Google Apps Script experience (share examples or a repo)
* Strong JavaScript fundamentals — ES6+, async patterns, clean modular code
* Real experience consuming REST APIs: OAuth 2.0, signed requests, pagination, rate limits, idempotency
* Deep Google Sheets knowledge — formulas, named ranges, data validation, and where it starts to break at scale
* Understanding of Apps Script quotas and execution limits, and how to design systems that survive them
* Git, and the habit of using it

**Strongly preferred**

* Prior work with Amazon SP-API, Walmart Marketplace API, Shopify, or similar ecommerce platforms
* Familiarity with ecommerce operations concepts: SKU mapping, FBA vs FBM, multi-warehouse stock, ASINs, feeds, buy box
* BigQuery or Looker Studio for reporting on top of the operational data

**Nice to have**

* clasp and a local development workflow
* Python for anything that outgrows Apps Script
* Google Cloud Platform exposure

**Why Devsatva**

* Direct client exposure from week one — no layers between you and the problem
* Systems that are genuinely load-bearing: if your sync breaks, someone oversells
* Room to grow past automation into data engineering and agentic AI work

title: Transaction Reporting Analyst
description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
The overnight Transaction Reporting Analyst is a critical role responsible for the operational integrity of DriveWealth's regulatory trade reporting during the newly extended 24/5 equity trading session. This role owns the overnight monitoring, exception handling, and repair of trade reporting submissions to FINRA's Trade Reporting Facility (TRF). The role also assists with other aspects of brokerage trade reporting, including the Consolidated Audit Trail (CAT) and Electronic Blue Sheets (EBS). This Transaction Reporting Analyst acts as the first line of defense against reporting breaks before the U.S. core trading day begins. This role works cross-functionally with Brokerage Operations, Compliance, and the U.S.-based Trade Reporting team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Monitor TRF and ORF (Trade Reporting Facility) submissions overnight for health, rejections, and out-of-tolerance conditions.
* Execute the 9:00pm (NYC Time) TRF opening rejection repair process, correcting and resubmitting failed trade reports within FINRA's reporting windows.
* Review and manage the EBS (Electronic Blue Sheets) submission queue, escalating unresolved items to the U.S. team.
* Confirm successful completion of CAT (Consolidated Audit Trail) submissions, investigating and escalating failures.
* Prepare detailed end-of-shift reports summarizing exceptions, open items, and notable activity for the incoming U.S. team.
* Escalate unresolved or high-severity issues promptly, exercising judgment on when an issue requires immediate U.S. involvement versus next-business-day follow-up.
* Maintain organized, auditable records of all monitoring activity, repairs, and escalations in line with the firm's written supervisory procedures.
* Build working familiarity with FINRA/SEC trade reporting rules to identify patterns and recommend process improvements.
* Partner with Engineering and Brokerage Operations to improve the automation and reliability of overnight monitoring workflows.

**You Bring**

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in financial services operations, trade support, or regulatory reporting.
* Direct exposure to FINRA trade reporting (TRF/CAT/EBS) or equivalent regulatory transaction reporting (e.g., MiFID II or EMIR transaction reporting) is a plus.
* Ability to work a shift aligned to the U.S. overnight trading session. Shift starts at 6:30 AM IST.
* A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes, deadline-driven environments.
* The ability to prioritize effectively and know when to escalate versus resolve independently.
* Strong written communication skills — this role's primary deliverable to the U.S. team each day is a clear, accurate handoff report.
* Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, high attention to detail and a deep respect for risk, controls, and regulatory obligations.
* Bachelor's degree (or local equivalent post-secondary qualification) in Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following location:
**GIFT City, India**
*Shift start time: 6:30 AM (IST)*

* If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
  
  
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
  
  
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
  
  
**How We Think About AI**
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
  
  
**Compensation**
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
  
  
**Agency Disclaimer**
DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

+ Stay current on emerging technologies and advocate for continuous front-end innovation.
+ Implement modern front-end architectures leveraging SSR, SSG, and client-side rendering where appropriate.
+ Integrate front-end applications with GraphQL and RESTful APIs.

* Operational Excellence and L3 Support

+ Provide technical expertise during triage and incident management.
+ Support production deployments and maintain operational resilience.
+ Embed observability and telemetry best practices within the front-end codebase.

* Collaboration and Delivery

+ Work closely with UX/UI, Product, and Platform teams to deliver optimal customer experiences.
+ Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical estimation.
+ Cultivate a DevOps mindset.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Peer code reviews and pair programming to uplift engineering quality.
+ Recommend and implement continuous improvements to workflows, tooling, and processes.
+ Help foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and high performance within the web development community.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. * Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

strategies

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  
  
The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  
  
This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  
  
We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.  
Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.  
Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.  
Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.  
Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.  
Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.  
  
A day in the life  
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  
  
About the team  
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Create and maintain SOPs, RACI matrices, SRTs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and KT materials.  
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to junior team members and offshore/nearshore delivery teams.  
Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders in a large, matrixed organization.  
Ensure endpoint solutions meet organizational security, compliance, availability, performance, and operational requirements.

Must To Have Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM.  
Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, device enrollment, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, and endpoint lifecycle management.  
Strong understanding of Intune Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, Device Restrictions, Security Policies, Custom Scripts, and Remediation.

Strong knowledge of Conditional Access, DLP, Exchange integration, device compliance, and endpoint security.  
Experience with Intune and SCCM co-management and dual-management environments.  
Strong MECM/SCCM experience including Collections, Application Deployment, Packages, Task Sequences, OSD, Software Updates, SUP, WSUS, DP, MP, and client troubleshooting.  
Experience in SCCM infrastructure administration, upgrades, migration, Current Branch/CU maintenance, and endpoint management.  
Strong understanding of Windows patch management, servicing, software update deployment, and update channel management.  
Experience with Windows Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, certificate management, and Windows Server technologies.  
Hands-on experience configuring VPN, Wi-Fi, email, domain join, and other endpoint configuration profiles.  
Knowledge of NDES and SCEP-based certificate deployment using Microsoft Intune.  
Experience managing iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS device enrollment, compliance, retirement, and wipe processes.  
Familiarity with MDT and Windows image management.  
Good understanding of Azure Virtual Desktop/VDI environments and integration with VMware Horizon or similar technologies.  
Exposure to third-party endpoint management and security integrations such as Jamf, TeamViewer, Nexthink, and related solutions.  
Strong troubleshooting, log analysis, problem-solving, customer handling, and communication skills.  
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make sound technical decisions.  
Ability to engage with customers in an advisory capacity and translate business requirements into technical endpoint-management solutions.  
  
Additional Information  
The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management technologies.  
The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM administration.  
Experience supporting medium to large enterprise or global endpoint management environments is preferred.  
Experience working with global customers and distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams is an advantage.  
Experience in Modern Workplace transformation, endpoint migration, and co-management projects is preferred.  
Experience with MDT, Nexthink, Jamf, or other EMM/endpoint management solutions is an added advantage.  
A Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.  
Experience providing voice-based technical support and handling high-priority customer situations is desirable.  
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required.

  
15 years full time education

title: Senior Engineer, Embedded Software
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Battery Management Systems

Build production software that advances intelligent battery systems across markets

**Role Overview**
=================

Analog Devices Inc. (ADI) is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with four to six years of experience to build and productize software across the complete Battery Management Systems (BMS) stack. You will work from MCU platforms and BMS IC device drivers through battery-algorithm implementation and integration, creating scalable solutions for automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging markets.

This role offers broad technical ownership and the opportunity to solve demanding hardware–software and algorithm-integration problems. You will combine strong Embedded C and Python skills with mathematics, electrical engineering, and systems thinking to deliver efficient, production-quality software for resource-constrained real-time platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Build the complete BMS software stack** , including MCU platform software, hardware abstraction, diagnostics, BMS IC and peripheral device drivers, communication, monitoring, protection, and balancing.
* **Deploy battery algorithms on embedded targets** , translating models and reference code for SOC, SOH, power capability, diagnostics, anomaly detection, and impedance-based functions into deterministic Embedded C.
* **Optimize for real-world constraints** , including execution time, memory, power, numerical accuracy, scaling, and fixed- or floating-point behavior.
* **Scale software across products and markets** through reusable architectures and configurable solutions for multiple MCUs, BMS ICs, toolchains, battery topologies, and operating environments.
* **Create robust Python engineering tools** for automated testing, data processing, visualization, calibration, profiling, and algorithm validation.
* **Own delivery from concept to release** , driving requirements, design, implementation, verification, troubleshooting, reviews, and maintenance in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* B.E. / B.Tech or M.E. / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of embedded software experience in BMS, battery monitoring, power electronics, automotive, energy, industrial, or another safety- and reliability-focused domain.
* Proven delivery of embedded features from requirements and design through integration, verification, and release.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* **Embedded C and Python:** Strong programming skills and the ability to independently develop production embedded software and maintainable tools for automation, testing, data analysis, visualization, and algorithm validation.
* **Embedded systems:** Strong knowledge of MCU architecture, interrupts, timers, memory, DMA, peripherals, boot flow, RTOS or bare-metal systems, communication protocols, build systems, debugging, version control, and continuous integration.
* **BMS and electrical engineering:** Understanding of battery cells and packs, sensing, ADCs, isolation, contactors, protection, balancing, diagnostics, filtering, signal integrity, and basic controls; ability to interpret schematics, data sheets, and timing diagrams.
* **Mathematics and algorithms:** Strong quantitative foundation in calculus, probability, statistics, numerical methods, linear systems, and signal processing, with practical understanding of precision, scaling, overflow, error, and computational complexity.
* **Engineering quality:** Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, supported by disciplined requirements, design, review, configuration management, testing, traceability, and defect management practices.

**Behavioral Expectations – Senior Engineer**
---------------------------------------------

* Take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality results.
* Use structured, data-driven thinking to solve complex and ambiguous problems.
* Collaborate effectively and communicate decisions, risks, and results clearly.
* Adapt, share knowledge, support colleagues, and continuously improve.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with SOC, SOH, state-of-power, impedance, estimation, prediction, or diagnostic algorithms.
* Exposure to MATLAB/Simulink, model-based development, code generation, calibration, or algorithm prototyping.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, functional safety, cybersecurity, Automotive SPICE, MISRA C, static analysis, performance optimization, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or data-driven battery analytics.

**Why Join ADI?**
-----------------

* **Own meaningful technical challenges** across the full BMS software stack and product lifecycle.
* **Build solutions with market impact** across automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging applications.
* **Grow with a strong engineering community** that values technical depth, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Employment Type:** Full time, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

The R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) is a senior, hands-on full-stack engineer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure web and cloud solutions for AVEVA CONNECT. The role requires strong expertise in C#, .NET/ASP.NET Core, Angular with Highcharts, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, and Azure DevOps CI/CD, along with strong engineering practices around quality, security, and performance.

The SMTS works closely with Product Owners and cross-functional R&D teams to drive end-to-end delivery and architecture decisions, resolve customer issues, and mentor engineers through design/code reviews and best practices, including effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable full-stack web and cloud applications.
* Work closely with the Product Owner, stakeholders, and Scrum Team to understand requirements and design, implement, and deliver software solutions that meet business and customer needs.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning/estimation, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Customer Support to troubleshoot customer-reported issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution through hotfixes and regular releases.
* Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code that is peer-reviewed, unit/integration tested (as applicable), documented, and delivered in line with agreed engineering standards.
* Ensure solutions meet security and compliance requirements, applying industry-standard secure coding and cybersecurity practices.
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps pipelines), improving reliability of builds, deployments, and release readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement of engineering practices, performance, observability, and overall product quality; mentor junior engineers and support technical reviews.

**Essential requirements**

* *8+ years of software engineering experience.*
* *Strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, and enterprise cloud-based application development.*
* *Strong hands-on experience with modern front-end development, particularly Angular (TypeScript) and data-visualization libraries such as Highcharts.*
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI application development.
* *Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architecture (microservices, containers, Kubernetes, messaging, observability).*
* *Strong software design fundamentals, including OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and reusable framework/component design.*
* *Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding,* *authentication/authorization,* *dependency risk management, and vulnerability remediation.*
* *Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R&D teams.*
* *Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and secure SDLC practices.*
* *Ability to translate business/product requirements into technical designs, executable backlogs, dependencies, estimates, and realistic delivery plans.*

**Desired skills and competencies**

  

* Good understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Azure automation using PowerShell / Azure CLI.
* Strong operational awareness, including observability, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance diagnostics, and production support.
* Experience with technical discovery, prototypes/POCs, architecture documentation, and communicating technical decisions across teams.
* Experience using AI to improve developer productivity, automated testing, code quality, and engineering workflows.
* Familiarity with emerging AI development frameworks and tools.
* *Good knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and performance considerations.*

**R&D at AVEVA**

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

**India Benefits include:**

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

**Hybrid working**

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Hiring process**

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

title: Lead Frontend Engineer
description:
Job ID

72732

Category

Enterprise Technology

Chennai, India

On-site

Description

* Own end-to-end frontend architecture for AI and Non-AI Platform products, defining patterns for streaming UI, real-time agent responses, tool-call visualization, citations/grounding display, and multi-turn conversational state.
* Define and enforce the frontend technology stack, coding standards, component architecture (design system), and state-management strategy across all AI Platform UI surfaces.
* Architect the integration layer between frontend applications and AI backend services (Vertex AI / Gemini, Google ADK agents, RAG pipelines, LangGraph/LangChain orchestrators) via secure, well-documented APIs (Fast/REST/GraphQL/WebSocket/SSE).
* Drive technical decisions on rendering strategy (SSR/CSR/ISR), edge/streaming delivery, performance budgets, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) for AI-heavy, latency-sensitive interfaces.
* Design and maintain the AI Platform's internal Developer Portal / Self-Service Console, enabling engineering teams to provision AI resources (RAG pipelines, agents, vector indices, environments) without manual tickets — extending self-service cloud infrastructure provisioning patterns into the UI layer.
* Build and version a reusable AI-UI Component Library / Design System (chat widgets, agent trace viewers, citation cards, feedback/human-in-the-loop widgets, prompt/response inspectors) consumable by multiple product squads across the enterprise as a shared platform capability.
* Define 'golden path' frontend templates and starter kits (Next.js/React + AI SDK boilerplate) so downstream product teams can spin up new AI-powered UIs in days, not weeks — a core platform-engineering productivity outcome.
* Own the frontend layer of platform Service Catalog entries (e.g., 'Conversational Agent UI', 'Document Intelligence Console') including golden-path templates, scorecards, and documentation, aligned to internal developer-platform (IDP) practices.
* Partner with platform/infra teams to expose infrastructure and model-routing configuration (e.g., cost-aware model selection between Gemini Flash/Pro) through simple, safe self-service UI controls rather than backend-only configuration.
* Establish frontend observability (RUM, tracing of AI response latency, token-stream monitoring) integrated with platform-wide SRE/observability tooling leveraging Dynatrace SaaS.
* Build production-grade full-stack features spanning UI, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layer, and orchestration services that call LLM/agent backends (Vertex AI Gemini, Google ADK multi-agent workflows).
* Implement secure, low-latency streaming pipelines (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) for token-by-token AI responses, agent 'thinking' states, and tool-execution progress indicators.
* Integrate authentication/authorization (OAuth2 client credentials, API Gateway via Apigee X) into frontend session and API-call flows, ensuring B2B and B2E security compliance.
* Collaborate with backend/platform engineers on API contracts, chunking/retrieval metadata exposure (for citation rendering), guardrail/response-safety signal surfacing, and error/fallback UX for model or agent failures.
* Evaluate and select appropriate technologies and tools to support the development and deployment of products on the eCommerce foundation layer
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements, and translate them into technical and non-functional specifications
* Work with Product teams to understand their pain points and increase the Developer Experience through Platform Engineering Capabilities
* Strategize & work with senior leaders across Ford’s Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations to make significant, measurable impact on the eCommerce Platform
* Experience in Cloud FinOps to optimize Cloud Infrastructure Consumption Cost

Responsibilities

* AI-Native Chat & Agent UI: Production conversational interface with streaming responses, multi-agent trace visualization, citation/grounding display, and tool-call transparency, built with React 18+/Next.js (App Router, Server Components/Actions).
* AI SDK Integration Layer: Frontend integration React.js-Node.js (Typescript) / LangChain.js / Google ADK web clients for streaming completions, function-calling UI, and structured output rendering.
* Design System & Component Library: Versioned, themeable component library (Storybook-documented) with AI-specific components — chat bubbles, agent step timelines, feedback thumbs-up/down + RLHF capture widgets, prompt inspector, retrieval-source cards.
* Real-Time & Streaming UX: SSE/WebSocket-based streaming UI patterns, optimistic UI, token-level rendering, and graceful degradation/fallback states for model latency or failure.
* State Management: Robust conversation/session state handling using modern state libraries supporting multi-turn context and agent memory visualization.
* Accessibility & Performance: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, Core Web Vitals-optimized AI UI, with performance budgets for time-to-first token and time-to-interactive.
* Testing Suite: Component (Jest/RTL), E2E (Playwright) test suites including deterministic mocking strategies for non-deterministic LLM outputs.
* Developer Self-Service Portal UI: Internal web console for provisioning AI resources, viewing agent/RAG pipeline health, and managing environment configs, aligned to Cloud Platform self-service provisioning.
* BFF / API Layer: Backend-for-Frontend service (FastAPI / Node.js) mediating between UI and AI backends, handling auth, request shaping, response streaming, and caching.
* Agent & RAG Orchestration Integration: Full-stack wiring to Google ADK multi-agent workflows (intent classification, routing, guardrails) and Vertex AI RAG Engine / Gemini for grounded, cited retrieval-augmented responses.
* Vector Search & Retrieval UI-to-Backend Contract: End-to-end pipeline exposing embeddings/vector search results (BigQuery, Vertex Vector Search) with chunk-level metadata surfaced in the UI for source citation.
* Secure API Gateway Integration: Full-stack OAuth2 (client-credentials) authentication flows through Apigee X / API Gateway, including token refresh, session handling, and role-based UI rendering.
* Cost-Aware Model Routing UI: Full-stack feature exposing dynamic LLM routing (e.g., Gemini Flash vs. Pro) based on query complexity, with a UI toggle/telemetry dashboard for cost and latency visibility.
* Deployment on Kubernetes (GKE): Containerized frontend and BFF services with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Cloud Build), deployed via GKE with progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) and environment promotion aligned to platform standards.
* Observability & Feedback Loop: Full-stack telemetry capturing latency, token usage, guardrail triggers, and user feedback, feeding back into model/prompt evaluation dashboards.
* Reference Architecture & Golden Path Repo: A reusable, documented starter template (frontend + BFF + agent integration) published to the internal platform catalog for rapid onboarding of new AI product teams.
* Platform-as-a-Product mindset: Define and track adoption, developer satisfaction (DevEx/NPS), and time-to-first-deploy metrics for teams consuming the AI UI SDK/component library.
* Service Catalog ownership: Publish and maintain frontend 'golden path' templates as catalog entries (e.g., via Backstage-style internal developer portal) with clear SLAs, ownership, and versioning.
* Self-Service Enablement: Extend self-service cloud infrastructure provisioning into the presentation layer — enabling product teams to self-provision chat UIs, agent consoles, and dashboards without platform-team tickets.
* Reusability & Multi-Tenancy: Architect UI components and BFF services to be multi-tenant and configuration-driven so multiple business units/products can adopt the same platform UI foundation.
* Governance-as-Code: Embed responsible-AI, security, and accessibility guardrails directly into shared components and CI pipelines so consuming teams inherit compliance by default.
* Platform Roadmap & Feedback Loops: Run regular platform reviews with consuming teams to prioritize the AI-UI roadmap, deprecations, and versioning strategy.

title: Senior Software Engineer (For Pooling Only)
description:

We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
  
  
This role will help build the customer-facing surfaces that define the Bluehost experience for millions of small businesses. We're scaling fast and rebuilding as we go: new architectural patterns, AI-native features, and a bar for craft that keeps rising. This is a role for a builder who owns outcomes end-to-end, moves ideas from concept to production in days rather than sprints, and wants to help redefine how our front-end systems get built and shipped.

This posting is currently for talent pooling purposes. While there may not be an immediate opening, qualified candidates may be considered for future opportunities.
  
  
**What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.**

* Build scalable, responsive, and high-performance web applications.

* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and deployment activities.
* Contribute ideas that improve user experience, engineering processes, and product quality.

**Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.**

* 5-8 years of experience in frontend development preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies, especially AI-driven applications.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Passion for building intuitive and user-friendly digital experiences.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver within deadlines.

**Tech Knowledge Required**

* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.
* Deep understanding of React concepts including Hooks, Context API, component lifecycle, state management, routing, and reusable component architecture.
* Experience with responsive and mobile-first web development.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
* Knowledge of version control systems like Git.
* Unit & automation testing using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress or any other lib; integrated with CI/CD for continuous quality assurance.

* Understanding state management libraries like Redux or Zustand.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks and debugging tools.
* Basic understanding of web performance optimization and accessibility standards.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and Agile/Scrum development practices is a plus.

**Why you’ll love us.**

* We’ve evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences: We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, where lean, high-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end-to-end - from initial design through to production - and who wants to grow their craft in a fast-moving, ambitious environment.
  
  
Where you'll focus
  
  

* Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js)
* Backend development using Python-based microservices
* System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale
* End-to-end feature ownership across the stack
* (Nice-to-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain full stack features - from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python.
* Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale.
* Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services.
* Work with AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high- quality, AI-assisted engineering work.
* Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
* Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise.

**What are we looking for?**

* Have around 5+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Have strong, hands-on experience with front-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python-based microservices.
* Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role.
* Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns.
* Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast-moving teams.
* Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build.
* Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly - we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match.
* Have an awareness of spec-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI- assisted engineering work.
* Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change.
* Have an active interest in self-learning and growing your craft.
* Nice-to-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus).

You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear
  
  
from you.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC.
* Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities
* Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc
* 25 days of paid holiday + your birthday off!
* Quarterly team socials

**Our Values and Principles -**
You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
  
  

* Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
* Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
* Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
* Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
* Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.
