title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.
* Data Engineering & Analytics Platforms
* Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
* Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. The company is known for investing in its people through training, mentoring and opportunities to take on larger responsibilities over time.
* In this role you will have room to experiment with modern cloud tools, AI and automation, while staying grounded in the day to day needs of engineers and designers. For the right person, this is a chance to grow into a trusted partner for project leaders and a key voice in how digital work evolves in the OGC practice.

**Reporting Relationships**

* The Technology Solutions Specialist reports directly to the Technology and Innovation Manager. The role also maintains strong functional working relationships with the GP Manager, Engineering Manager, Department Managers and other Design Application Specialists. Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.

**Future Roadmap**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a technology leader within our organization. In the first year, you will focus on mastering our existing systems and delivering key software projects. Following that, you will have the opportunity to lead new initiatives, mentor junior team members and specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture. We are committed to your professional development and will provide you with the resources and support needed to stay at the forefront of technology and advance your career.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DataNimbus:**

DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually operate, not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets perform, and how businesses grow. We go deep so our customers don't have to start from scratch.

***Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes.***

**Why Join DataNimbus?**

At DataNimbus, we believe in shaping a sustainable, AI-driven future while offering an environment that prioritizes learning, innovation, and growth. Our core values—Customer-Centricity, Simplicity, Curiosity, Responsibility, and Adaptability—are the foundation of our workplace, ensuring every team member can make a meaningful impact. Joining DataNimbus means being part of a dynamic team where you can:

* Work with cutting-edge technologies and revolutionize workflows in Data+AI solutions.
* Contribute to solutions that are trusted by global businesses for their scalability, security, and efficiency.
* Grow personally and professionally in a culture that values curiosity and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about innovation, ready to solve complex challenges with simplicity, and eager to make a difference, DataNimbus is the place for you.

**Role summary**

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the Field Innovation team for DataNimbus's Payments business. They spend their time on-site with customers in Mumbai and alongside our implementation teams. They understand the customer's view, find gaps in how FinHub is used, and close them - by building new solutions, fixing what blocks adoption, and helping Customer Success keep accounts healthy and growing.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Be the customer's voice**

* Spend time with client users and implementation teams to understand how FinHub is used day to day, and where it falls short.
* Capture gaps in the product, the implementation and the client's own processes, and bring them back with evidence and a proposed fix.
* Help Customer Success read account health: adoption, friction points, risks and early warning signs.

**Strengthen implementations and customer success**

* Work alongside delivery owners and technical leads on live projects to unblock tricky integrations and edge cases.
* Step in on technical escalations with the implementation team, and turn the fix into something reusable.
* Support account reviews with insights, demos and improvement proposals.
* Spot expansion opportunities from what you see on the ground and shape them with the Customer Success and Sales teams.

**Discover**

* Work alongside client business, operations and IT teams to understand how money moves and where it breaks.
* Turn vague asks into clear problem statements, success criteria and a scoped pilot.

**Build**

* Build working prototypes on FinHub and around it: integrations with core banking, payment rails, host-to-host and API banking, escrow and virtual accounts.
* Write production-quality code (APIs, integrations, data pipelines, dashboards) that can be hardened.
* Use AI where it helps the client: reconciliation, exception handling, document processing, insights.

**Prove and hand over**

* Run pilots in the client's environment and measure results against the agreed success criteria.
* Present results and demos to client stakeholders up to CXO level, with Sales and Customer Success.
* Hand pilots to the Delivery/Competency team with clean code, documentation and a rollout plan.

**Make the product better**

* Turn what you build for one client into reusable accelerators and FinHub features.
* Bring client feedback and recurring gaps to Engineering and the product roadmap.

**Experience and skills**

**Must have**

* 5–10 years building software, with at least 2 years in client-facing/product engineering roles.
* Strong coding in at least one of Java, Go, Node.js / TypeScript or Python, plus SQL and a NoSQL store such as MongoDB.
* Built and integrated REST APIs, message queues and event-driven systems.
* Comfortable on cloud and container platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP; Docker, Kubernetes).
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical client stakeholders.
* Domain knowledge of banking / payments /transaction banking / liquidity / cash / escrow.
* Ability to travel and work on-site for 5-days during client engagements.

**Good to have**

* Indian payments domain: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, escrow, virtual accounts, cash management or corporate API banking.
* Experience with core banking integrations (e.g. Finacle, Flexcube) or host-to-host file formats.
* Hands-on use of LLMs or ML in a working product.
* Awareness of RBI rules for payment aggregators, escrow and data localisation.

**Soft Skills**

* Bias to action: ships something useful in days, not months.
* Enjoys being on the client floor and is credible in the room.
* Owns outcomes end to end and is comfortable with ambiguity.
* Writes things down so others can pick up the work.

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Interested?

Send in your CV to
careers@datanimbus.com
ASAP.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Software Engineer**

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.
  
  
**About the role:**

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing – to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs.
* Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features.
* As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs.
* Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements.
* Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing.
Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.  

  

**Requirements**

* **6+ years** of experience in **Java** -based backend development.
* Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
* Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture.
* Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers.
* Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application.
* Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
* Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
* Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude.
* Experience working with remote teams
Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills  

**Desired**

* Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture.
Experience writing software applications in Go  

**What success looks like in the role**

  

**Within the first 30 days you will:**

* Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment.

Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it.  



**By 90 days:**

* Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes *many* ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team.
* Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here.
Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day.  

**By 6 months:**

* Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently.
* Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
* Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner.
Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.  

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.
  
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays

description:
**Company Description**

Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an **AI-enabled solutions partner**.

We have over 200 talented employees working both on-site and remote/hybrid at locations:

* Danang: 81 Quang Trung, Hai Chau 1 ward, Hai Chau District, Danang
* Hanoi: Zodiac building, 19 Duy Tan Street, Dich Vong Hau ward, Cau Giay District, Hanoi

  
**Job Description**

**About the role**

SmartDev is a Creatio implementation partner delivering enterprise **CRM** programmes for banks. The current engagement is an on-premises banking CRM with fifteen integration interfaces to core banking and surrounding systems, five promotion environments, and the bank's own change control over every release.

This is the technical core seat, and it is for someone already certified and already fluent in the platform. You write server-side logic and custom web services in versioned **Creatio** packages, build **Freedom UI components** where the standard palette is not enough, and own the integration contracts with the bank's systems.

Two constraints are not negotiable here: the product core is never modified, only supported extension points are used; and external systems never touch the Creatio database directly — everything goes through OData, DataService and governed APIs.

The third principle surprises most developers: you write code only where configuration genuinely cannot do the job. Your value on a low-code programme is measured as much by the code avoided as by the code shipped.

 **Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* **Active Creatio Developer certification**. Hard requirement for this opening; advanced-level certification is a significant plus.
* 3+ years developing on Creatio for real client implementations.
* **Strong C# / .NET**, plus working JavaScript and Angular for Freedom UI customization.
* Package architecture and versioning: file-system development backed by Git, dependency management, promotion across environments.
* Platform data access: EntitySchemaQuery, Entity, and the direct query classes, with the judgement to choose between them.
* Integration work you built yourself: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, authentication, retries, idempotency, error handling.
* SQL Server performance: you can read an execution plan and fix a slow query rather than route around it.
* **English** at B2 or above.

**Strong advantages**

* **Banking** or fintech domain.
* On-premises deployment and clio CLI automation.
* Redis, Docker, CI/CD pipeline construction.
* RTL or Arabic interface work.
* Experience mentoring developers new to the platform — you would be one of the most experienced platform people in the team.

**What you will own**

* Server-side logic, custom services and Freedom UI components for assigned areas.
* Integration implementation against the bank's service bus and core systems.
* Code and configuration review across the team.
* Contribution to the practice's reusable accelerator set.

 **Additional Information**

**What we offer**

* A senior seat in a practice being built now, with influence over its engineering standards.
* The integration block — the technically hardest and commercially most valuable part of the scope.
* An international banking programme with direct client exposure.
* Continued funded certification on the Creatio track.
* Competitive compensation, hybrid working, and a senior engineering organisation with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS delivery credentials.

**Benefits**

* International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction.
* 20 days of annual leave – Hybrid working mode.
* Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
* Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
* Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity.
* Engaging company culture with fun activities
* Global collaboration – Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a high-caliber **Senior Software Engineer / Lead Design Engineer** to drive the development of next-generation railway subsystems. You will be responsible for designing and deploying critical electronic systems for Indian Railways, including **CVVRS**, **Remote Monitoring Systems**, and **Radio Communication sub-systems**.

This role demands a mix of embedded software expertise, networking protocol mastery, and deep familiarity with railway standards (RDSO, IEC, EN). As a lead engineer, you will own the software lifecycle, guide engineering teams, and ensure all systems are robust, scalable, and compliant.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Design & Development:** Design and develop software for critical railway technologies, including Camera systems, M-NVR, PoE Switches, Voice over IP (VoIP), Door Control Units, Water Level Indicators, OBCMS, and UHF Radio communication.
* **Protocol & Driver Implementation:** Write and optimize software drivers for image sensors, networking protocols, and industrial communication buses (CAN, MVB, RS485, and 4G/5G cellular transmission).
* **Project & Technical Leadership:** Plan, coordinate, and define engineering work packages for rolling stock projects. Drive end-to-end accountability for software deliverables while mentoring multi-functional teams.
* **Triage & Troubleshooting:** Lead complex debugging and triaging activities. Resolve hardware-software integration issues seamlessly alongside hardware and system engineers.
* **Backend Architecture:** Build and scale robust backend systems capable of processing and storing data from edge systems to multi-cluster cloud nodes.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Education**

* **B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech** in Computer Science Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or a related field.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 6 years** of experience in the design, development, and manufacturing of railway electronics or safety-critical embedded systems.
* **Minimum 2 years** of experience in a **Lead Engineer** or Project Driver capacity, handling multiple teams and projects simultaneously.

**Technical Expertise**

* **Embedded Networking & Hardware:** Deep understanding of Train Communication Networks (**TCN/VCU**). Hands-on experience with **CAN, MVB, RS485**, and wireless transmission over **4G/5G** networks.
* **Video & Image Processing:** Proven expertise in writing control applications for image sensors, video processing pipelines, and Video Management Software (VMS).
* **Core Fundamentals:** A deep understanding of computer architecture and networking infrastructure—ranging from localized desktop environments to distributed cloud nodes.

**Standards & Compliance**

* Strong working knowledge of current **RDSO specifications** and testing protocols.
* Demonstrated experience design-testing to comply with national and international railway standards (**IS / IEC / EN**), specifically:
* **IEC 60571 / EN 50155** (Railway applications - Electronic equipment used on rolling stock)
* **IEC 61375** (Train Communication Network)
* **IEC 61000-4-2, 3, 4, 5** (EMC/EMI immunity testing for ESD, Radiated RF, EFT, and Surge)

Pay: ₹680,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform
description:
**The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)**

**About Sezzle:**

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

**Compensation**:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
* Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
* Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners finding system-of-record tickets metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
* Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
* Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
* Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
* Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

**What We Look For:**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
* Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
* Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
* Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
* Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
* Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
* Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

**Preferred Knowledge and Skills:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
* Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
* Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
* Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
* Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
* Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

**About You:**

* You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
* You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
* You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
* You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.

  You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

**Sezzle's Technology Stack:**

* **Languages:** Golang, Typescript, Python
* **Frontend:** Typescript - React and React Native
* **Backend:** Golang
* **Database:** MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
* **DevOps & Cloud:** AWS, Kubernetes
* **Version Control:** Git
* **CI/CD:** Gitlab
* **Testing:** Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
* **Open Source:** Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

**What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?**

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

description:

Website Pandas – AI & Performance-Driven Digital Agency

We are looking for a
**strong WordPress Developer**
who can build, customize, and maintain high-quality websites across
**WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow**
.

You will work on
**production websites**

* PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

**developers**
, not just site assemblers.

* Experience building custom WordPress themes or plugins
* Familiarity with REST APIs or third-party integrations

* Experience working with U.S. or international clients

* Work on real, production-grade websites
* Exposure to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, and other modern stacks
* Collaborative environment with SEO and strategy teams
* Clear expectations, clean processes, and quality-driven work
* Professional on-site office environment in Noida Sector 2

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**Job Summary**
The Software Development Engineer role at Clearwater Analytics spans a spectrum of responsibilities with a focus on designing, implementing, and managing software systems. The role requires continuous learning and application of new technologies and trends. Engineers at entry-level work on coding, debugging, and learning new software technologies. With progression in this track, the responsibilities expand to include leading teams, designing complex software systems, providing mentorship, and managing cross-functional integration. The more senior roles are responsible for defining the company's technological vision, making strategic decisions, driving innovation, and setting new industry standards. Across all levels, a successful software development engineer will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, excellent coding abilities, a keen understanding of the software ecosystem, and a cooperative team player attitude.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain quality code that is simple, well-structured, clear, and well-tested.
* Effectively break down and solve complex problems that require research or collaboration.
* Communicate effectively, regardless of medium, audience, or timing.
* Strong command of multiple levels of automated testing (e.g., unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, etc.).
* Mentor new and less-experienced team members.
* Initiate design and feature discussions, advocating for improvements in software performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Coordinate with other teams to ensure the successful integration of software applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents quickly and effectively.
* Understand, respond to, and address customer needs and issues with empathy and timeliness.
* Any other reasonable activity required by management.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in a typed, object-oriented programming language.
* Deep knowledge of software methodologies, tools, and typical architectural patterns.
* Enthusiasm for software work in a software-as-a-service company.
* Driven by client satisfaction.
* Strong teamwork skills.
* Ability to manage own time and deliver expected results on time.
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
* Exceptional analytical skills.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities.

**Education And Experience**

* Degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 4+ years of software development experience.

title: Experienced Embedded Software EngineerEngineer
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced embedded software engineer to lead the development, and integration of embedded platforms spanning MCU firmware, RTOS, embedded Linux, platform-management protocols, and hardware-backed security.
  
  
This role combines module-level technical ownership with hands-on development and debugging. You will implement the design of secure, resilient, and recoverable platforms while ensuring the translation of complex requirements into reusable, validated software solutions.
  
  
**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with 7+ years of embedded software experience and a demonstrated track record of technical ownership for complex platforms or subsystems.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in C and low-level embedded software development, with deep expertise in processor architecture, interrupts, DMA, synchronization, memory protection, and hardware–software interactions.
* Substantial expertise in one or more of the following areas: Zephyr OS, RTOS-based MCU development, or embedded Linux platform development, complemented by practical experience integrating firmware, drivers, middleware, and host-side software.
* Demonstrated implementation or architectural experience in at least one of the following domains: firmware development, secure boot, platform security, or specification-driven software development.
* Proven ability to lead complex debugging efforts, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and resolve technical trade-offs while remaining actively involved in implementation.
* Strong communication, technical documentation, planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to take ambiguous technical challenges from investigation through implementation and validation.
* Nice to have:

+ Experience with Rust.
+ Experience with FPGA-based firmware development.
+ Upstream open-source contributions.
+ Experience developing software for NXP MCUs or MPUs.
+ Experience with secure boot, hardware-backed security, trusted firmware, secure firmware updates, or recovery systems, including the ability to reason about trust boundaries, failure modes, and the security implications of design decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse & understand the requirement, hardware, software architecture documentation and technical direction for embedded platforms.
* Develop and implement embedded platform software solutions based on hardware and requirements documentation. Convert system requirements into robust software
* Develop & integrate firmware, drivers, subsystems (e.g., security), middleware, and applications while ensuring effective hardware-software integration. Address initialization dependencies, asynchronous communication, concurrency, resource constraints, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms.
* Support platform bring-up, and root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, protocols, and operating system components.
* Deliver engineering quality and technical execution by establishing design review and validation standards and coordinating with cross-functional teams, architects, customers, and open-source communities.

title: Flutter Developer
description:
Flutter Developer — Challenge App

💰 ₹15,000/month · 📍 Fully Remote (India) · 💼 Full-time

About us

We're an early-stage startup building Challenge App — a mobile platform that helps people run and join multi-day growth challenges. Users create challenges with structured action steps, track their progress day-by-day, see how their community is doing on leaderboards, and stay on track with reminders and accountability features.

We're a small team, and we build fast using AI-assisted development (Cursor + Claude). That means less time typing boilerplate, more time making smart architecture decisions and shipping real features. If you've been curious about working with AI tools or already love them — you'll fit right in.

Qualifications

• 1-3 years of hands-on experience with Flutter/Dart

• Published at least one Flutter app (Play Store, App Store, or equivalent)

• Strong understanding of clean architecture, SOLID principles, and design patterns

• Comfortable reading and reviewing code — not just writing it

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote, async setup

• Good communication skills — you'll be collaborating directly with the founder

🔴 Must Have Skills

• Flutter / Dart — Our entire frontend. You need to be comfortable here.

• Clean Architecture — We follow strict layers: Page → Cubit → UseCase → Repository → API. Not negotiable.

• BLoC / Cubit (flutter\_bloc) — Every feature uses it for state management.

• Dio — All API integration goes through these.

• Freezed + build\_runner — Code generation for models and state classes.

• GetIt + Injectable — Dependency injection throughout the app.

• GoRouter — Navigation and deep linking.

• Firebase — Auth, Firestore, Storage, and Cloud Messaging.

• Functional error handling — Either<Failure, T> pattern with dartz/fpdart.

• AI-code review skills — You need to catch when AI gets it wrong — this is the real skill.

🟢 Good to Have

• Node.js / TypeScript — Our backend is Express + MongoDB + Zod, on Google Cloud.

• MongoDB / Mongoose — Schema design, indexing, queries.

• Shorebird — OTA code push for instant updates.

• Razorpay — Payment gateway we use.

• Hive CE — Local caching and storage.

• Media handling — Camera, image picker/cropper, video, audio recording.

• Charts (fl\_chart) — Data visualization in the app.

• Push + local notifications — firebase\_messaging + flutter\_local\_notifications.

• Google Cloud Platform — Where our backend runs.

How we work

• AI-first workflow — Cursor + Claude is our daily driver. You'll direct AI, review its output, and handle the parts it can't.

• Clean, enforced architecture — the codebase has rules, and we follow them.

• You'll have real ownership — small team means your decisions matter.

• Async-friendly & flexible hours — work when you're most productive.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Our unified technology platform, powered by data and machine learning, enables secure, personalized, and differentiated experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

* Design, develop, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and related Apple frameworks, ensuring performant, reliable, and maintainable mobile experiences.

* Solid understanding of mobile system design fundamentals, including API design, data modeling, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization on iOS.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative engineering environment, participating in code reviews, using source control, and following established engineering and operational practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving iOS application architectures (such as MVVM, VIPER, or similar patterns) and contributing to shared mobile platforms or libraries used across multiple teams or product areas.

description:

**About this role**

* The Senior Software Engineer, Product and Front-end will help build Prudential Japan's next generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation initiative.

What you could work on We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Customer servicing, portals used by our employees as well as customers to view policy information and execute certain business workflows. Sales Enablement, portal used by our sales team to manage leads and maintain regulatory records.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build customer-facing journeys, and the internal tools staff use when a customer cannot complete one alone.
* Model identity, consent and authority as first-class concepts, including the cases where one person acts on anotherʼs behalf.
* Work directly with the staff who handle these requests today, watching real cases rather than reading summarised tickets.
* Design for users of every age and confidence level, treating accessibility as a design constraint rather than an audit term.
* Instrument journeys so drop-off, error and abandonment are visible, then act on what they show.
* Share the APIs your journeys need together with their backend owners, rather than accepting whatever exists.
* Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.
* Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to replace and what to leave alone.
* Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design, development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.
* Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for someone to blame.

**Qualifications**

**General**

* You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.
* Five or more years in product engineering with genuine front-end depth, TypeScript and a modern framework.
* Demonstrated accessibility practice, with examples of what you changed and why.
* Experience in designing workflow and state and not only screens.
* User research or direct observation as a normal part of how you work.
* Advantageous: contact center or telephone integration, identity, consent or KYC workflows, and designing for older or less confident users.
* Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

* We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.

* Frontend: TypeScript with React, and a framework such as Next.js. Strong CSS and layout skills
* Testing: component and end-to-end testing as a habit. Playwright, Vitest or Jest and accessibility checks in the pipeline.
* Design systems: consuming one, contributing to one, and knowing when to break it.
* Backend for frontend: API gateway with lambda or a small service, enough to own the layer your journeys depend on.
* AWS ecosystem
* Nice to have: analytics and session instrumentation (such as Amplitude), design tooling fluency (such as Figma), and telephony and contact centre integration such as Genesys telephony or Amazon Connect.

**Language**

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.

**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business domains Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices

title: PHP Developer
description:
PHP Developer – Custom Web Applications & Business Systems

**Company:**
Code With Agni

**Website:**
https://www.codewithagni.live

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Salary:**
₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Location:**
Hybrid

**Department:**
Software Development

About Code With Agni

Code With Agni is a web development and software solutions company focused on building custom web applications, business management systems, SaaS platforms, e-commerce solutions, and workflow automation systems.

We work on projects involving CRM, ERP, inventory management, quotation and pricing systems, booking platforms, payment integrations, third-party APIs, and other business-specific software solutions.

We are looking for a skilled and motivated PHP Developer with 2–3 years of practical experience who can develop, maintain, and improve web applications while contributing to the complete software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and enhance web applications using Core PHP, CodeIgniter, and Laravel.
* Build custom business applications, including CRM, ERP, inventory management, quotation systems, order management, and administrative dashboards.
* Write clean, reusable, secure, and maintainable code following established coding standards.
* Design, develop, and optimize MySQL databases, including tables, relationships, indexes, queries, and transactions.
* Implement business logic, complex calculations, pricing rules, workflow automation, and role-based access control.
* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.
* Customize and maintain WordPress websites, themes, plugins, and CMS-based solutions.
* Work with Shopify and other e-commerce platforms when required.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs, third-party services, payment gateways, webhooks, and notification systems.
* Debug existing applications, identify performance issues, fix bugs, and implement new features without disrupting existing functionality.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Test features, validate edge cases, and ensure application reliability, security, and performance.
* Assist with application deployment, server configuration, database migrations, and production troubleshooting.
* Collaborate on project requirements, technical implementation, code reviews, and delivery timelines.

Required Technical Skills

**Backend Development**

* Strong understanding of Core PHP and object-oriented programming (OOP).
* Practical experience with CodeIgniter and/or Laravel.
* Good understanding of MVC architecture, authentication, sessions, validation, and reusable application components.
* Ability to implement complex business logic and multi-step workflows.

**Database Management**

* Strong knowledge of MySQL and relational database design.
* Experience with joins, indexes, constraints, transactions, and query optimization.
* Ability to design efficient database structures for real-world business applications.

**Frontend Development**

* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and responsive web design.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.
* Ability to convert UI designs or requirements into functional web interfaces.

**Development Tools and Integration**

* Experience with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP methods, and third-party integrations.
* Knowledge of debugging, error handling, application security, and testing.

Preferred Qualifications

The following skills will be considered an advantage:

* Experience developing or maintaining CRM, ERP, SaaS, inventory, billing, booking, or other business management systems.
* WordPress theme and plugin development or customization.
* Shopify theme customization and e-commerce development.
* Experience integrating payment gateways, email services, SMS/WhatsApp notifications, or external business platforms.
* Familiarity with cron jobs, webhooks, scheduled tasks, and workflow automation tools such as n8n.
* Basic knowledge of Linux servers, Apache/Nginx, Docker, and application deployment.
* Experience working with AI APIs, OCR services, document processing, or other automation-related integrations.
* Familiarity with Laravel migrations, Eloquent ORM, PHPUnit, or equivalent framework tools.

What We Are Looking For

* A developer who understands how to translate business requirements into functional software.
* Someone who can independently handle assigned modules and take ownership of deliverables.
* Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail, especially when working with calculations, database relationships, and business workflows.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different project requirements.
* Ability to work with existing codebases, understand unfamiliar systems, and improve them systematically.
* Good communication skills, accountability, and a commitment to meeting deadlines.

Compensation

**Monthly Salary: ₹20,000 – ₹25,000**
, depending on technical proficiency, practical experience, and the ability to work independently.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with the following details:

1. Total PHP development experience.
2. Experience with CodeIgniter and Laravel.
3. Links to previous projects, GitHub repositories, or portfolio, if available.
4. Experience developing CRM, ERP, SaaS, or other custom business applications.
5. Current location and notice period.
6. Expected salary.

**Apply through:**
info@codewithagni.live

Website: https://www.codewithagni.live

* *Candidates may be asked to complete a short technical assessment as part of the selection process.*

title: Developer Advocate
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
Trailblazer Relations APAC is a team of creative, highly technical advocates, community builders, and program leaders. We inspire, enable, engage, and support the ever-growing Trailblazer community across Asia Pacific. We help Trailblazers succeed on the Salesforce Platform and use cutting-edge technologies like AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
  
  
Our work goes well beyond developer advocacy. We grow and support Trailblazer Community Groups, MVPs, and Group Leaders. We run community events and executive engagements. We also partner with customers, partners, and local ecosystems across the region. For developers, we write blog posts, produce video content, host workshops, and engage in person and virtually at Salesforce and third-party events.
  
  
We work closely with Trailblazer Community, Architect Evangelists, marketing, product management, engineering, and product marketing. We are the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC, bringing regional perspectives into the company to shape the Salesforce experience, especially around AI and data.
  
  
**Who You Are**
We're looking for an experienced technologist who embraces enterprise software development and is passionate about the transformative power of AI and data. You're a creative thinker who understands when to choose visual builder tools or when building with code from scratch. You're equally comfortable working with front-end and back-end programming languages, APIs, and are eager to explore new paradigms in AI-driven development.
  
  
You love going broad and deep, creating inspirational and technical open source demos, and complementing those demos with accessible written and video content. You're comfortable sharing your knowledge in front of a camera, and you're looking forward to domestic (sometimes international) travel to present to live audiences of hundreds of people.
  
  
**You Are Excited About This Role Because You Will**

* Develop and maintain your expertise with the Salesforce Platform, AIforce, Agentforce, and Data Cloud, and create content that integrates them with other Salesforce technologies.
* Build end-to-end apps and integrations that support the programs and initiatives run by the team.
* Create code samples, prototypes, and visually compelling demos that inspire Trailblazers and help them succeed when adopting Salesforce, with a focus on AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and scalable data architectures.
* Write technical content and produce on-demand and live-streamed videos that showcase practical applications across the Salesforce portfolio, tailored to APAC audiences and languages where relevant.
* Support virtual and in-person events, including Trailblazer Community Group meetups, with technical talks, demonstrations, and workshops.
* Work with Trailblazer Community Group Leaders, MVPs, and other community members to help them grow and succeed.
* Work closely with product, engineering, and other cross-functional teams as the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC.

**We're Excited About You, Because You Have**

* 5+ years of experience implementing on the Salesforce Platform, with a creative technical mindset.
* Deep understanding of and passion for the needs of enterprise developers who build on Salesforce, especially when using AI and data for business solutions.
* Proven technical expertise in web applications, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Apex, and APIs, and a willingness to learn and apply new technologies related to AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Certifications or equivalent hands-on technical experience in Salesforce development.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills, and experience making complex technical concepts accessible and understandable.
* A solid understanding of how quickly and constantly the ways people consume content and share their experiences are shifting.
* Drive to be a self-starter and, at the same time, a highly collaborative team player.
* Passion for learning and working with new technologies.
* A strategic mind and strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

title: LLVM Compiler Engineer
description:

We are reimagining how customers use Java, bringing them the tools and insight they need to deliver faster, more performant, more dependable, and less expensive Java services. Come join one of the most influential members of the Java and OpenJDK community and help influence the future of Java.

  

**Falcon**
is one of the key technologies in Azul Platform Prime. It is a
**Just-In-Time compiler**
for Java bytecode based on LLVM that pushes Java performance to the levels never reached before. Azul's compiler team is looking for an
**LLVM Compiler Engineer**
interested in helping us improve Falcon even further.

  

In this role you will be working with a distributed but highly collaborative team of compiler experts. You will be creating new features and optimization in Falcon compiler, improving LLVM performance for managed languages, and contributing to open source.

**Minimum Requirements**
  

  
* Strong C/C++ design and coding skills
  
* 5+ years of experience developing LLVM compilers, or transferable experience with another compiler
  
* Strong background in compiler theory and development
  

  
**Very Nice to Have / Preferred Experience**
  

  
* Solid experience in developing language runtimes and JIT compilers
  
* Thorough knowledge of x86\_64 and/or ARM64 instruction sets and optimizations
  
* Performance analysis experience
  
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin
  
* PhD in Computer Science, and/or significant research experience

title: Consultant - TTC - Oracle GTM Techno - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on translating global trade compliance, logistics, and business requirements into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and integrations. You will support compliant and efficient trade processes across areas such as screening, classification, licensing, duty and tax determination, documentation, and reporting. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and process transformation in a global environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Tax Consultant II on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead workshops, document trade processes, define business rules, and create functional specifications, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Configure Oracle GTM objects, business rules, workflows, approvals, notifications, exception handling, role-based access, and audit requirements.
* Design and validate integrations between Oracle GTM and enterprise systems, support data mappings and governance, and assist with data conversion and migration activities.
* Plan and execute system integration testing, user acceptance testing, compliance scenario testing, defect resolution, cutover support, and hypercare activities.
* Develop standard operating procedures, training materials, compliance reporting outputs, and audit support documentation for operational and compliance teams.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Oracle and trade transformation teams help organizations improve the way they manage global trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross-border operations through technology-enabled solutions. The team works across business, compliance, and technology stakeholders to design and implement scalable processes that support accuracy, control, and operational efficiency. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving enterprise systems, data, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience implementing or supporting Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) in a functional or techno-functional capacity.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo compliance, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation concepts, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating compliance policy into system-enforceable rules and workflows.
* Experience documenting business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, process diagrams, and test scripts.
* Experience with APIs, flat files, middleware, data mapping, or error handling for system integrations.
* Knowledge of cross-border trade process flows across order, ship, invoice, customs, logistics, and returns.
* Experience with data analysis, reconciliation, and defect triage.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud or similar middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with Oracle ecosystem integrations, including enterprise resource planning or supply chain systems.
* Experience with multi-country or global trade programs and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations.
* Experience modernizing trade compliance operating models and master data governance.
* Prior consulting delivery experience, including estimation, RAID logs, status reporting, or client leadership.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:

Within Search Platform, engineering leaders work on problems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, data infrastructure, developer platforms, product impact, and operational excellence.

* We care deeply about customer impact, service reliability, and scalable platform design.
* We believe strong engineering management combines clear execution, thoughtful people leadership, and sound technical judgment.

* Set technical and execution direction for a team working on large-scale search infrastructure.

* Lead through incident readiness, operational reviews, capacity planning, and architecture decisions for high-availability systems.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineers and managers, creating clarity, accountability, and growth across the team.
* Improve engineering effectiveness by strengthening planning, prioritization, technical design, and delivery rhythms.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Requirements:**

* Proven experience leading high-performing engineering teams that build and operate large-scale distributed systems.
* Demonstrated success managing senior engineers and driving delivery in complex, cross-team environments. Experience growing staff-level technical leadership and beyond.

* Experience operating business-critical services with clear ownership of availability, incident response, and operational health.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with senior technical and organizational leaders.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience with search infrastructure, indexing systems, large-scale data pipelines for search/ML, storage engines, or low-latency retrieval systems.
* Track record of leading platform teams that serve many internal customers and balance roadmap work with reliability investment.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description: ABOUT XPLORETEQXploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.ROLE OVERVIEWWe are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESAssessment & Design• Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.• Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.• Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.SASE/SSE Implementation• Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.• Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.• Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.• Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.Integration & Go-Live• Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.• Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).• Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS• 3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.• Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.• Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.• Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS• Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).• Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS• Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.• Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.• Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.WHAT WE VALUEAt Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.REPORTINGReports to the Tech Lead.TO APPLYInterested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:• Current CTC• Expected CTC• Notice period• Current location• Brief summary of relevant experience for this role
