title: Lead Salesforce
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:

+ Service Cloud
+ Sales Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Salesforce Platform

* Deep technical expertise in:

+ Apex
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ Integration Patterns
+ REST/SOAP APIs
+ Salesforce Security Model

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Data Architecture
+ Security & Sharing Models
+ DevOps & CI/CD
+ Release Management
+ Application Lifecycle Management

* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management (ITAM)
+ Service Catalog
+ Enterprise Operations Management

* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.
* Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways.
* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

**Join Us ?**
If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of
**Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**
. This role offers the opportunity to combine
**technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence**
while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Role : Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Experience: 5**+ Years

**Location:** Bengaluru (Hybrid)

**Type:** Full-time

**About Digit88**

Digit88 is an AI-native product engineering partner helping startups and enterprises build, scale and operate intelligent software products.

We are a lean, high-impact team of 75+ technologists, backed by leaders with deep experience across startups and global enterprises. We build strong, outcome-driven engineering teams that solve complex, real-world problems.

From GenAI applications and data platforms to enterprise-grade SaaS, we deliver scalable, reliable, production-ready systems. Our expertise spans AI/ML, RAG systems, agentic workflows and large-scale data engineering - enabling businesses to move from idea to production with speed and confidence.

Our teams operate as a true extension of our clients, with full ownership and flexible engagement models focused on measurable business outcomes - not just delivery.

With 80+ AI implementations and proven success in scaling dedicated teams and driving significant cost efficiencies, we partner for long-term impact.

We bring experience across B2B and B2C SaaS, web and mobile platforms, e-commerce and domains such as Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering - thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.

**The Vision:**

To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide, delivering ownership, speed, and measurable outcomes.

**Job Profile:**

Digit88 is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who works directly with customers to discover problems, design solutions, write production-quality code, build integrations, debug issues and drive deployment of Conversational AI and customer experience applications. The FDE owns outcomes from discovery through production and must be able to code, troubleshoot and explain technical trade-offs to customer and engineering stakeholders.

Java backend engineering and Python-based AI engineering are mandatory. Conversational AI experience is a must. Consumer-facing CCaaS experience across messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI is a major advantage because this role requires credible customer-facing subject-matter expertise.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with customer product, engineering, operations and customer experience teams to understand workflows, pain points, success metrics and technical constraints.
* Translate customer requirements into working solutions, APIs, data models, integration contracts, implementation plans and acceptance criteria.
* Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Java and Spring Boot for customer-facing and platform workflows.
* Build AI/LLM capabilities in Python, including agent workflows, tool/API calling, evaluation, guardrails, automation and MLOps support.
* Integrate Conversational AI with contact-center/CCaaS systems, CRM, ticketing, identity, knowledge bases and enterprise APIs.
* Work with ElevenLabs for Voice AI, OpenAI for LLM capabilities, and Strands as a decision-making/orchestration layer where appropriate.
* Design secure, observable cloud solutions on AWS, using DynamoDB and PostgreSQL based on data needs. Collaborate on React-based frontend workflows as required.
* Build for production: authentication, authorization, retries, idempotency, rate limits, timeouts, error handling, logging, monitoring, deployment and incident response.
* Design for concurrent customer sessions and latency-sensitive interactions using appropriate multithreading, asynchronous processing, resource limits and backpressure.
* Advance multimodal experiences spanning voice, text and images, including context management, routing, evaluation and graceful failure handling.
* Prototype quickly, validate with customers, iterate on real usage and turn successful prototypes into maintainable production systems.
* Own technical troubleshooting and customer escalations; coordinate with Product and Engineering on platform gaps and reusable capabilities.
* Document architecture decisions and reusable implementation patterns without sacrificing customer-specific needs or platform integrity.

**What success looks like:**

* Customer requirements become working, production-ready solutions with measurable outcomes.
* Integrations and AI workflows are reliable, secure, observable and maintainable.
* Customer issues are diagnosed and resolved quickly with clear communication and effective escalation.
* Solutions meet agreed measures such as resolution/containment, latency, reliability, adoption, satisfaction and operating cost.
* Reusable patterns reduce implementation time without compromising customer requirements or platform integrity.

**Requirements:**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, ideally 4+ years, delivering customer-facing enterprise software into production.
* Mandatory Java competency for backend engineering, preferably Spring Boot, REST APIs, dependency injection, testing, exception handling and service design.
* Mandatory Python competency for AI engineering, automation, LLM integrations, tool calling, evaluation and/or MLOps workflows.
* Hands-on Conversational AI experience, including conversation state, context handling, fallback, escalation and production measurement.
* Experience building APIs and enterprise integrations; familiarity with authentication, webhooks, retries, idempotency, rate limits and event-driven patterns.
* Strong debugging and production-readiness skills across testing, observability, performance, reliability and secure customer-data handling.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, handle ambiguity, explain trade-offs and take ownership from problem definition through deployment.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture and deployment practices; AWS experience is preferred.

**Good to have:**

* Consumer-facing CCaaS/contact-center experience across Messaging, Digital AI, IVR, Voice AI, routing and/or agent assist.
* AWS production experience with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
* React or another modern frontend framework, sufficient to debug integrations and collaborate full-stack.
* Experience integrating ElevenLabs, OpenAI and/or Strands, or equivalent Voice AI, LLM and agent-orchestration technologies.
* Practical understanding of multimodal AI, concurrency/multithreading and high-volume, low-latency services.
* AI evaluation, prompt/version management, model monitoring, guardrails, human handoff and AI quality measurement.

**Benefits working @ Digit88:**

* Comprehensive Insurance (Life, Health, Accident).
* Flexible Work Model.
* Accelerated learning & non-linear growth.
* Flat organization structure driven by ownership and accountability.
* Opportunity to own and be a part of some of the most innovative and promising AI/SaaS product companies in North America and around the world.
* Accomplished Global Peers - Working with some of the best engineers/professionals globally from the likes of Apple, Amazon, IBM Research, Adobe and other innovative product companies.
* Ability to make a global impact with your work, leading innovations in Conversational AI, Energy/Utilities, ESG, HealthTech, IoT, Risk/Compliance, CyberSecurity, PLM and more.

You will work with a founding team of serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits to their credit. The learning will be immense just as will the challenges.

**This is the right time to join us and partner in our growth**

title: Global Data Analytics Expert
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a rigorous, systems-minded quantitative leader to own our core commercial intelligence engine end-to-end. This is not a traditional dashboard-building or BI reporting seat. You will define, build, and encode the mathematical logic, unit-economic models, and predictive forecasting systems that power our product and drive real commercial decisions for our brands.

You will sit at the intersection of **finance, data science, and product engineering**, turning complex commercial data, messy founder inputs, and predictive models into defensible, automated product logic and AI agent workflows.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

### **1. Proprietary Systems: Growth Forecasts & P&Ls**

* **Growth Forecasting:** Build and own the methodology that takes a brand’s current performance and projects a defensible 12-month forecast, complete with a rigorous assumption set.
* **Financial Architecture:** Construct brand-level P&Ls directly from the forecast, mapping revenue, COGS, contribution margin, and operating costs.
* **Variance & Calibration:** Continuously run models against real outcomes, measure errors, track actuals against projections, and explain every variance.

### **2. Productization & Agentic Workflow Design**

* **Product Logic:** Translate sophisticated financial and statistical models into production-ready product logic so the system calculates and delivers outputs natively.
* **AI Agent Specification:** Define what data agents compute, what internal data/benchmarks they draw on, and what assertions they are strictly barred from making.
* **Human-in-the-Loop Orchestration:** Replace manual validation with automated product rules while establishing clear review gates for human sign-off before deliverables ship.
* **Data Schemas & Engineering Collaboration:** Specify data structures, validation rules, and pipelines across structured commercial inputs, partnering directly with engineering to bring models to life in production.

### **3. Decision Framing & Commercial Rigor**

* **Decision-First Modeling:** Design every analysis backwards from the specific commercial decision it is meant to change.
* **Uncertainty & Stated Confidence:** Size uncertainty statistically, state clearly what sparse or self-reported data *cannot* support, and attach a stated confidence level to every output.
* **Benchmark Library Management:** Define and version the benchmark repository (category, stage, market) to evaluate brands accurately even when data is sparse.

### **4. Enablement & Commercial Communication**

* **Cross-Functional Communication:** Present complex numbers, models, and uncertainties to founders and operators with clarity and authority.
* **Quantitative Literacy:** Raise the analytical bar across the business by teaching teams how to read and interpret model outputs correctly.
* **Documentation & Standards:** Write airtight documentation and standards for data/finance deliverables so cross-functional delivery teams can execute autonomously.

**What This Seat Is Not**
-------------------------

* **Not a BI/Reporting Seat:** Dashboards are merely one downstream output of this work; your primary focus is proprietary modeling and product architecture.
* **Not Research Without Action:** We judge models by the decisions they actually changed, not academic complexity.
* **Not a Data Engineering Seat:** You will specify pipelines, schemas, and logic for engineering to build—you won't be maintaining core infrastructure tables yourself.

**Ideal Background & Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* **Experience:** 6–8 years in growth, marketing, commercial, or product analytics within DTC, e-commerce, marketplaces, or specialized platforms.
* **Proven Track Record:** End-to-end ownership of a forecasting, unit-economics, or media-mix model that commercial teams relied on for high-stakes budget or strategic decisions. You can name the decisions your model changed and what followed.
* **DTC Unit Economics Mastery:** Deep fluency in CAC, AOV, COGS, contribution margin, LTV, payback period, breakeven, retention cohorts, and working capital reconciliation.
* **Modelling with Incomplete Data:** Demonstrated ability to build robust outputs from banded, self-reported, or partial founder inputs while explicitly quantifying confidence levels.
* **Statistical Rigor:** Strong foundation in sizing uncertainty, managing sample limitations, and maintaining analytical integrity.
* **Technical Depth:** Hands-on daily fluency in **SQL and Python**.
* **Product & Engineering Collaboration:** Experience working directly with engineering teams to turn quantitative models or metric definitions into production software.
* **Communication:** Exceptional presence and ability to defend underlying assumptions and model uncertainty under direct challenge.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Media mix modeling (MMM), incrementality testing, or causal measurement methodologies.
* Applied machine learning experience (forecasting, propensity, or segmentation models in production).
* Experience evaluating generative AI or multi-agent system outputs.
* Familiarity with modern data stack layers (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt) and attribution platforms (Triple Whale, Northbeam, Rockerbox).
* Exposure to multi-brand ecosystems via agency, consulting, or platform environments.
* Experience in early-stage product environments where models and products were co-developed from scratch.

*The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now*

**Our Hiring Process**

We want interviews to be valuable for both sides. Throughout the process, you'll meet the people you'll work with, learn more about the role, and get a chance to understand how we think and operate.

Our process typically includes:

* Introductory conversation with our Talent team <> 30 mins

title: Business Analyst II, Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  
  
We are looking for a good fit to join our Transportation Long Term Capacity Planning Team, part of the larger Supply Chain Team. This team plays a crucial role in strategically planning and executing Amazon's Last Mile Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. As a Last Mile Business Analyst II, you will be at the forefront of enabling cross-functional teams to evolve our delivery network, continuously analyzing and optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability while maintaining a strong customer focus.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing analytical frameworks and capacity models that address both current and future demands, ensuring business continuity even through peak periods. Your analysis will directly contribute to our long-term strategy programs, preparing Amazon's last mile delivery network for sustained growth while striking the delicate balance between delivery speed, operational efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.  
  
You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, long-term forecasting, and capacity modeling to generate data-driven insights that shape the future of our Last Mile operations. This position requires strong analytical skills, a strategic mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams across the organization. Your insights and recommendations will be instrumental in guiding senior leadership decisions and driving the continuous improvement of our vast delivery network.  
  
As a key member of this team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's ability to meet and exceed customer expectations in the years to come, playing a vital role in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.  
  
You are expected to have exceptional analytical, planning, and written/verbal communication skills. You know and love working with business intelligence tools, are comfortable accessing and working with big data from multiple sources, and are enthusiastic about partnering with the business to deliver results. You are a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.  
  
Join our team and help shape the future of Amazon's last mile delivery network, contributing to our mission of becoming Earth's most customer-centric company while balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and maintain long-term forecasting models for the Last Mile network, focusing on Quarterly Guidance Numbers Validation
* Build and run complex analytical models to predict network capacity requirements 1-3 years in advance
* Partner with cross-functional teams to gather data and insights for accurate long-term forecasting
* Analyze historical data, market trends, and business strategies to refine long-term forecasting methodologies
* Present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior leadership, supporting strategic decision-making
* Support the Plan of Record (POR) planning process through analytical inputs, ensuring alignment with company objectives and financial targets
* Identify opportunities for network improvements and cost optimizations through deep-dive analysis of long-term forecasting data
* Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and automated analytical tools to improve forecasting accuracy and visibility
* Develop capacity models for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods
* Contribute analytical frameworks to long-term strategy programs that prepare Amazon's last mile delivery network for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness

  
About the team  
The Long Term Middle and Last Mile Capacity Planning Team strategically plans and executes Transportation network topology over a 1-3 year horizon. We unite teams to evolve the network, optimizing cost, speed, and reliability with customer focus. We develop capacity solutions for current and future demands, ensuring business continuity through peak periods. Our long-term strategy programs prepare Amazon's logistics for growth, balancing delivery speed with efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of experience working with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and data visualization tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, Excel)
* Experience with forecasting models and capacity planning methodologies
* Experience defining requirements and using data to back up assumptions and drive actions
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders through data-driven insights

title: Lead Quantitative Analytics Specialist
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Quantitative Analytics Specialist.

The Retail Investing and Financial Advice Modeling (RIFAM) team is seeking an experienced quantitative modeling professional with a strong track record in the development, documentation, validation, and governance of quantitative models within the Wealth and Investment Management (WIM) space.

The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing and expanding the firm's modeling capabilities for the Securities Based Lending (SBL) business within the Banking, Lending & Trust (BL&T) business in WIM. This includes the development and enhancement of model-based capabilities in setting the lending and maintenance margin across a broad range of financial products and lending strategies.

A strong understanding of portfolio risk methodologies, including Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), stress testing, and other quantitative risk modeling techniques is highly desirable. Experience modeling both traditional and more complex financial instruments (linear and non-linear), coupled with knowledge of the securities-based lending business, will be a significant advantage.

Beyond Securities Based Lending, the individual will contribute to a broader portfolio of quantitative models and analytical initiatives across Wealth & Investment Management (WIM), partnering closely with business stakeholders, risk management, model validation, audit, and technology teams. The role offers an opportunity to influence strategic modeling decisions, enhance modeling capabilities, and support the continued evolution of the firm's quantitative modeling framework.

**In this role, you will:**

Lead complex initiatives including creation, implementation, documentation, validation, articulation, and defense of highly statistical theory

Qualify monitor markets and forecast credit and operational risks

Strategize short and long-term objectives, and provide analytical support for a wide array of business initiatives

Utilize stochastic, structured securities, spread analysis, with the expertise in the theory and mathematics behind the analysis

Review and assess models inclusive of technical, audit, and market perspectives

Identify structure and scope of review

Enable decision making for product and marketing with broad impact and act as key participant to develop and document analytical models

Collaborate and consult with regulators and auditors

Present results of analysis and strategies

**Required Qualifications:**

5+ years of Quantitative Analytics experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Bachelor's degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, economics, or computer science

Python / SQL / GitHub programming skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

PhD degree in a quantitative discipline

Model development and implementation experience in Financial Services industry

Strong expertise in Securities Based Lending (SBL) modeling, including risk measurement methodologies such as Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), stress testing, and scenario analysis.

Solid understanding of the securities-based lending business, including collateral risk management and lending portfolio analytics.

Deep experience modeling a broad range of financial products, including equities, fixed income, structured products, pooled investments, floating-rate instruments, ESOPs, IPOs, and digital asset-related products.

Solid understanding of statistics and time series analysis.

Experience with model review, model validation and model lifecycle activities within a large financial institution is desirable.

Working experience developing or benchmarking models in Python.

Experience with GitHub is a must.

Proven track record of delivering high-impact modelling solutions with strong ownership and accountability.

Ability to lead through ambiguity, challenge conventional thinking, and drive informed decision-making.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience partnering across business, risk, and technology organizations.

Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative concepts into clear business insights for executive-level audiences.

Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments while maintaining a focus on quality, execution, and business value.

title: Risk Analyst II, Account Integrity
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.  
  
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
- Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.  
- Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.  

* Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.

- Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.  

* Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
* Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
* Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same when the automated-abuse landscape shifts in real time - your week balances hands-on investigation, strategy, and close ML partnership to keep Anti-Automation ahead of emerging threats:  
  
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)  

* Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action.
* Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
* Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.

  
Strategy (Building What's Next)  
- Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.  

* Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.

  
ML Partnership (Scaling the Defense)  

* Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
* Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
* Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.

  
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)  

* Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
* Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.

  
About the team  
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.  
  
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The Anti-Automation vertical sits at the front line of that fight, taking on bots and scripted abuse at the scale.  
  
If you want to do work where your findings directly translate into customer trust at global scale - and where the adversary never stops evolving - this is the team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data-driven role (e.g. business analyst, risk analyst, data analyst, operations analyst, or research analyst) or similar quantitative/analytical roles across any domain

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Master's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related Science field, or experience in data

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Job Title: Senior Security Engineer

Shift Timings: General Shift Role

  

Summary:

The Senior Security Engineer will lead application security engineering across the software development lifecycle. Strong hands-on SAST and DAST scanning experience is required, with primary ownership of DAST operations, SAST engineering, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation and DevSecOps enablement. The role will embed security into design and development, integrate security testing into Secure by Design (SBD), GitHub, Azure and CI/CD workflows, and work closely with development, QA, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to ensure security controls are implemented before production release.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Application Security & Secure by Design

* Embed security requirements, threat considerations, secure coding practices, and control validation across design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
* Work directly with development teams to identify security gaps early and provide practical remediation guidance while applications are being built.
* Define and maintain security gates, minimum control requirements, exception handling, and evidence expectations for application releases. SAST, DAST & Penetration Testing - Technical Responsibilities
* Own the implementation, configuration, administration, tuning and continuous improvement of enterprise SAST and DAST capabilities.
* Configure, operate and optimize Invicti for authenticated and unauthenticated DAST scans, including scan profiles, authentication, scheduling, coverage, validation, reporting, retesting and troubleshooting.
* Perform SAST scan onboarding and configuration, validate code-level findings, analyze data flows and sources/sinks, tune rules, suppress verified false positives with evidence and provide developer-ready remediation guidance.
* Plan and execute web application, API and network-focused penetration tests using approved methodologies and tools; document reproducible evidence, risk ratings, business impact and corrective actions.
* Triage and correlate SAST, DAST and penetration-testing findings; validate exploitability, remove duplicate or false-positive results, prioritize risk and confirm closure through rescans and retesting.
* Monitor technical scan performance, including scan completion, coverage, authentication success, scan failures, false-positive rates, recurring findings, test effectiveness and remediation trends. DevSecOps, CI/CD, Azure & GitHub Security
* Integrate approved SAST and DAST controls into Secure by Design processes, GitHub repositories, pull requests, build workflows, CI/CD pipelines and release gates.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement automated security scans, quality gates, severity thresholds, break-build criteria, and risk-based exception workflows.
* Administer and monitor security controls across GitHub and Azure development environments, including code scanning, secret scanning, dependency alerts, repository security settings, pipeline findings and cloud security configurations.
* Enforce branch protection, mandatory reviews, least-privilege access, environment separation, secure secrets handling and controlled promotion to production.
* Investigate scan and integration failures and retain security evidence for release governance and audit requirements. Vulnerability Management & Remediation
* Manage the end-to-end application vulnerability lifecycle: identification, validation, prioritization, assignment, remediation tracking, retesting, closure and reporting.
* Drive SLA-based remediation with development owners, escalate overdue risks, support documented risk acceptance where justified and verify fixes through rescans or retesting.
* Maintain dashboards and metrics covering vulnerability aging, severity, closure performance, recurrence, scan coverage and application risk posture. Collaboration, Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the application security partner for developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product owners, cloud teams and infrastructure teams.
* Deliver secure coding guidance, developer awareness sessions, tool onboarding and knowledge-sharing based on observed vulnerability patterns.
* Contribute to application security standards, procedures, checklists, playbooks, audit evidence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AppSec and DevSecOps capabilities and recommend improvements that increase coverage, automation, accuracy and remediation speed.

  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on cyber security experience, with strong focus on application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management or penetration testing.

  

Required:

Strong hands-on experience implementing, configuring, operating, tuning and troubleshooting both SAST and DAST solutions in enterprise software development environments.

Hands-on experience with Invicti or a comparable enterprise DAST platform, including authenticated scanning, scan configuration, validation, tuning, reporting, troubleshooting and retesting.

* Hands-on experience integrating security scanning into GitHub pull-request workflows, Azure or equivalent cloud development environments, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure security concepts, GitHub security capabilities, source control governance, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, common web and API vulnerabilities, risk methodologies. rating, remediation techniques and penetration-testing
* Ability to interpret code-level findings and collaborate with developers on remediation across at least one common language or framework.
* Experience managing remediation SLAs, exceptions, evidence, dashboards, metrics, and stakeholder reporting.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and corrective actions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Skills and Certifications
* Experience with additional SAST, SCA, container, API or cloud-native security tools.
* Exposure to tools and platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent technologies.
* Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, software supply-chain security, SBOM practices, and compliance frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, , CEH, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent AppSec / penetration-testing credentials.

**About Digit88**

Digit88 is an AI-native product engineering partner helping startups and enterprises build, scale and operate intelligent software products.

We are a lean, high-impact team of 75+ technologists, backed by leaders with deep experience across startups and global enterprises. We build strong, outcome-driven engineering teams that solve complex, real-world problems.

From GenAI applications and data platforms to enterprise-grade SaaS, we deliver scalable, reliable, production-ready systems. Our expertise spans AI/ML, RAG systems, agentic workflows and large-scale data engineering - enabling businesses to move from idea to production with speed and confidence.

Our teams operate as a true extension of our clients, with full ownership and flexible engagement models focused on measurable business outcomes - not just delivery.

With 80+ AI implementations and proven success in scaling dedicated teams and driving significant cost efficiencies, we partner for long-term impact.

We bring experience across B2B and B2C SaaS, web and mobile platforms, e-commerce and domains such as Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering - thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.

**The Vision:**

To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide, delivering ownership, speed, and measurable outcomes.

**Job Profile:**

Digit88 is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who works directly with customers to discover problems, design solutions, write production-quality code, build integrations, debug issues and drive deployment of Conversational AI and customer experience applications. The FDE owns outcomes from discovery through production and must be able to code, troubleshoot and explain technical trade-offs to customer and engineering stakeholders.

Java backend engineering and Python-based AI engineering are mandatory. Conversational AI experience is a must. Consumer-facing CCaaS experience across messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI is a major advantage because this role requires credible customer-facing subject-matter expertise.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with customer product, engineering, operations and customer experience teams to understand workflows, pain points, success metrics and technical constraints.
* Translate customer requirements into working solutions, APIs, data models, integration contracts, implementation plans and acceptance criteria.
* Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Java and Spring Boot for customer-facing and platform workflows.
* Build AI/LLM capabilities in Python, including agent workflows, tool/API calling, evaluation, guardrails, automation and MLOps support.
* Integrate Conversational AI with contact-center/CCaaS systems, CRM, ticketing, identity, knowledge bases and enterprise APIs.
* Work with ElevenLabs for Voice AI, OpenAI for LLM capabilities, and Strands as a decision-making/orchestration layer where appropriate.
* Design secure, observable cloud solutions on AWS, using DynamoDB and PostgreSQL based on data needs. Collaborate on React-based frontend workflows as required.
* Build for production: authentication, authorization, retries, idempotency, rate limits, timeouts, error handling, logging, monitoring, deployment and incident response.
* Design for concurrent customer sessions and latency-sensitive interactions using appropriate multithreading, asynchronous processing, resource limits and backpressure.
* Advance multimodal experiences spanning voice, text and images, including context management, routing, evaluation and graceful failure handling.
* Prototype quickly, validate with customers, iterate on real usage and turn successful prototypes into maintainable production systems.
* Own technical troubleshooting and customer escalations; coordinate with Product and Engineering on platform gaps and reusable capabilities.
* Document architecture decisions and reusable implementation patterns without sacrificing customer-specific needs or platform integrity.

**What success looks like:**

* Customer requirements become working, production-ready solutions with measurable outcomes.
* Integrations and AI workflows are reliable, secure, observable and maintainable.
* Customer issues are diagnosed and resolved quickly with clear communication and effective escalation.
* Solutions meet agreed measures such as resolution/containment, latency, reliability, adoption, satisfaction and operating cost.
* Reusable patterns reduce implementation time without compromising customer requirements or platform integrity.

**Requirements:**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, ideally 4+ years, delivering customer-facing enterprise software into production.
* Mandatory Java competency for backend engineering, preferably Spring Boot, REST APIs, dependency injection, testing, exception handling and service design.
* Mandatory Python competency for AI engineering, automation, LLM integrations, tool calling, evaluation and/or MLOps workflows.
* Hands-on Conversational AI experience, including conversation state, context handling, fallback, escalation and production measurement.
* Experience building APIs and enterprise integrations; familiarity with authentication, webhooks, retries, idempotency, rate limits and event-driven patterns.
* Strong debugging and production-readiness skills across testing, observability, performance, reliability and secure customer-data handling.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, handle ambiguity, explain trade-offs and take ownership from problem definition through deployment.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture and deployment practices; AWS experience is preferred.

**Good to have:**

* Consumer-facing CCaaS/contact-center experience across Messaging, Digital AI, IVR, Voice AI, routing and/or agent assist.
* AWS production experience with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
* React or another modern frontend framework, sufficient to debug integrations and collaborate full-stack.

* Practical understanding of multimodal AI, concurrency/multithreading and high-volume, low-latency services.

* Opportunity to own and be a part of some of the most innovative and promising AI/SaaS product companies in North America and around the world.

You will work with a founding team of serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits to their credit. The learning will be immense just as will the challenges.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.

### **What Will You Do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

### **Why SentinelOne?**

title: Staff Engineer - Cross Border, Mercari India
description:
About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

**Bold Challenges**

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**  
Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Mercari's JP marketplace domain and internal platforms.
* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

  
**Benefits**

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

Owned Media

* Mercari Engineering Portal
* Mercari Engineering Blog: Backend
* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

Learn about XB and the Global App

* Building one global app platform (XB tech blog)

Related Articles

* Mercari Careers
* Culture Doc, the internal document that summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its members

**Role Summary**:

The Firewall Specialist is responsible for the administration, operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of enterprise network security infrastructure comprising Fortinet Firewalls, Check Point Firewalls, and Ubika Web Application Firewall (WAF).

The engineer will provide Level-2 support for security incidents, firewall policy changes, VPN management, WAF rule tuning, and problem resolution while ensuring compliance with security standards and service level agreements.

The role requires strong expertise in firewall security technologies, threat prevention, access controls, VPN technologies, and web application security.

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Firewall Operations & Administration: Manage and maintain Fortinet FortiGate and Check Point firewall environments. Implement, modify, and optimize firewall security policies, NAT rules, routing policies, and object groups.

* Perform rule reviews, policy recertification, and firewall cleanup activities.

* Manage firewall high-availability clusters and security gateways.

* Support Internet, Extranet, and DMZ security architectures.

* Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

* Validate firewall configurations against security baselines and best practices. Incident & Problem Management: Provide L2 support for firewall and network security incidents.

* Investigate connectivity, routing, VPN, and security policy issues.

* Analyze firewall logs and security events for root cause determination.

* Coordinate with L3 engineers, vendors, and infrastructure teams during major incidents.

* Participate in post-incident reviews and recommend corrective actions.

  

**Ubika WAF Administration**:

* Manage Ubika WAF policies and application protection configurations.

* Implement and tune WAF security rules to minimize false positives.

* Monitor and investigate WAF-generated alerts and attacks.

* Support secure publication of web applications.

* Configure URL filtering, access control, bot protection, and application security policies.

* Conduct WAF policy reviews and security assessments.

  

**Security Monitoring & Compliance:**

* Review security events generated by firewalls and WAF platforms.

* Support audit and compliance requirements.

* Generate operational and compliance reports.

* Assist in vulnerability management and remediation activities.

**Summary**

Grant Thornton GTech’s Data & Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization’s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption.

* Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns.

* Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation).

* Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption.

* Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders.

* Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs.

* Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers.

* Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets.

* Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

* Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation.

* Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members.

**Skills**

* Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing.

* Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics.

* Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct & optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis & troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams & Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets.

* Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers.

* Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance).

* Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement).

* Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

* Strong understanding of data lineage, metadata traceability, and impact analysis.

* Experience applying governance-by-design and data observability (data quality tests, lineage, and certified datasets).

* Effective communication skills with ability to work directly with business stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

* 5+ years of analytics engineering, BI/data warehouse development, or related data experience in enterprise data environments.

* Preferred: Experience in professional services, accounting industry, or client service/consultative technology roles.

* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, dbt).

* Experience with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).

* Experience with data modeling methodologies (Dimensional modeling, Data Marts, Data Warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema).

* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Agile/Scrum delivery exposure.

* Act as a security advisor for Open Platform and collaborate across product, architecture, and delivery teams.
