title: Data Architect & AI Engineering Lead, Cybersecurity - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**
==========================

**The Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Assistant Vice President, will provide technical and strategic leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities. This role will drive the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI solutions that convert complex security telemetry into actionable intelligence. The AVP will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, and risk stakeholders to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making while establishing scalable engineering and data science practices across the organization**


  
  

**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

As a Data Engineer / Scientist, you will:

* Design and deliver scalable **data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, data models, and analytics-ready datasets** using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud technologies.

* Build reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, data quality, reconciliation, orchestration, lineage, and observability.

* Develop statistical, machine-learning, and AI models to identify **patterns, anomalies, relationships, threats, and risk signals** across cybersecurity datasets.

* Apply **ML, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI** to improve threat detection, vulnerability prioritization, incident enrichment, cyber-risk scoring, and security posture insights.

* Develop AI solutions leveraging **LLMs, embeddings, semantic/vector search, RAG, and intelligent workflows** to summarize, classify, correlate, and enrich cybersecurity information.

* Operationalize data science and AI solutions through **feature pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, and production workflows** .

* Engineer and analyze high-volume **structured, semi-structured, time-series, graph, and unstructured security data** across cloud and enterprise platforms.

* Build Power BI dashboards and self-service analytical products to communicate **security trends, operational performance, risk insights, and model outcomes** .

* Establish strong engineering and responsible AI practices covering **performance, scalability, resiliency, explainability, security, privacy, lineage, governance, and auditability** .

* Partner with cybersecurity, data and platform engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to translate complex security challenges into scalable **data and AI solutions** .

* Evaluate emerging **data engineering, ML, GenAI, graph, cloud, SIEM/SOAR, and cybersecurity technologies** and drive their practical adoption.

  

**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong technical expertise across **Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI/GenAI.**

* Deep understanding of **Lakehouse architectures, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, orchestration, and pipeline optimization** .

* Hands-on expertise with **Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms.**

* Experience with **statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, supervised and unsupervised learning, experimentation, and model evaluation.**

* Practical knowledge of **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, NLP, graph analytics, and responsible AI practices.**

* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts including **security telemetry, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity risk, threat intelligence, incidents, and SIEM/SOAR workflows.**

* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and communicate effectively with **technical teams and senior stakeholders** .

* Strong focus on **automation, reusable engineering patterns, operational excellence, governance, and measurable business outcomes.**

**Education & Qualifications**
==============================

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 15 to 20 years of professional experience across **data engineering, data science, analytics, cloud, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines.**

* Experience applying data engineering, analytics, ML, or AI techniques to **cybersecurity, risk, fraud, identity, infrastructure, or other large-scale enterprise datasets.**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

* Strong hands-on experience **with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, and large-scale data engineering.**

* Experience with **Lakehouse/data platform architecture, data pipelines, modeling, data quality, monitoring, lineage, and performance optimization** .

* Working knowledge of **AWS or comparable cloud data and analytics environments** .

* Experience operationalizing analytical and ML solutions using **CI/CD, version control, testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices** .

* Experience with **Power BI or equivalent visualization technologies.**

* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or advanced coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.

* Experience with **Databricks/Delta Lake and Medallion architecture patterns** .

* Experience with **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or AI-assisted workflows** .

* Experience developing production-grade **ML/AI pipelines, model monitoring, feature pipelines, APIs, or MLOps solutions.**

* Experience working with cybersecurity datasets such as **endpoint telemetry, authentication events, cloud security logs, vulnerability data, asset inventories, network events, incidents, SIEM data, and threat intelligence.**

* Experience in **financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise environments** with strong security, privacy, governance, and audit requirements.

* Relevant **Security+, CySA+, GIAC, CISSP, AWS, Databricks, Data Engineering, ML/AI, or cybersecurity certifications** are advantageous.

  
  

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Data Engineering**

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability

**Data Science / ML**

Statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, experimentation, model evaluation and explainability.

**AI & Gen AI**

LLMs, NLP, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows.

**Cloud & DevOps**

AWS, cloud data services, CI/CD, Git, automated testing, scalable processing and MLOps.

**Cybersecurity Analytics**

SIEM/SOAR workflows, alert enrichment, cyber telemetry, vulnerability data, identity risk, incident and response datasets.

**Visualization & BI**

Power BI dashboards, operational metrics, executive-ready reporting, trend analysis, self-service analytical products.

  
  

**Additional Requirements**
===========================

* This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration expectations.

* The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

* The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**
====================================

**Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. This role will bridge Data Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and AI, building trusted data foundations and intelligent solutions that improve threat detection, risk prioritization, security operations, and enterprise decision-making.**

We are a lean, high-impact team of 75+ technologists, backed by leaders with deep experience across startups and global enterprises. We build strong, outcome-driven engineering teams that solve complex, real-world problems.

From GenAI applications and data platforms to enterprise-grade SaaS, we deliver scalable, reliable, production-ready systems. Our expertise spans AI/ML, RAG systems, agentic workflows and large-scale data engineering - enabling businesses to move from idea to production with speed and confidence.

Our teams operate as a true extension of our clients, with full ownership and flexible engagement models focused on measurable business outcomes - not just delivery.

With 80+ AI implementations and proven success in scaling dedicated teams and driving significant cost efficiencies, we partner for long-term impact.

We bring experience across B2B and B2C SaaS, web and mobile platforms, e-commerce and domains such as Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering - thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.

**The Vision:**

To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide, delivering ownership, speed, and measurable outcomes.

**Job Profile:**

Digit88 is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who works directly with customers to discover problems, design solutions, write production-quality code, build integrations, debug issues and drive deployment of Conversational AI and customer experience applications. The FDE owns outcomes from discovery through production and must be able to code, troubleshoot and explain technical trade-offs to customer and engineering stakeholders.

Java backend engineering and Python-based AI engineering are mandatory. Conversational AI experience is a must. Consumer-facing CCaaS experience across messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI is a major advantage because this role requires credible customer-facing subject-matter expertise.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with customer product, engineering, operations and customer experience teams to understand workflows, pain points, success metrics and technical constraints.
* Translate customer requirements into working solutions, APIs, data models, integration contracts, implementation plans and acceptance criteria.
* Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Java and Spring Boot for customer-facing and platform workflows.
* Build AI/LLM capabilities in Python, including agent workflows, tool/API calling, evaluation, guardrails, automation and MLOps support.
* Integrate Conversational AI with contact-center/CCaaS systems, CRM, ticketing, identity, knowledge bases and enterprise APIs.
* Work with ElevenLabs for Voice AI, OpenAI for LLM capabilities, and Strands as a decision-making/orchestration layer where appropriate.
* Design secure, observable cloud solutions on AWS, using DynamoDB and PostgreSQL based on data needs. Collaborate on React-based frontend workflows as required.
* Build for production: authentication, authorization, retries, idempotency, rate limits, timeouts, error handling, logging, monitoring, deployment and incident response.
* Design for concurrent customer sessions and latency-sensitive interactions using appropriate multithreading, asynchronous processing, resource limits and backpressure.
* Advance multimodal experiences spanning voice, text and images, including context management, routing, evaluation and graceful failure handling.
* Prototype quickly, validate with customers, iterate on real usage and turn successful prototypes into maintainable production systems.
* Own technical troubleshooting and customer escalations; coordinate with Product and Engineering on platform gaps and reusable capabilities.
* Document architecture decisions and reusable implementation patterns without sacrificing customer-specific needs or platform integrity.

**What success looks like:**

* Customer requirements become working, production-ready solutions with measurable outcomes.
* Integrations and AI workflows are reliable, secure, observable and maintainable.
* Customer issues are diagnosed and resolved quickly with clear communication and effective escalation.
* Solutions meet agreed measures such as resolution/containment, latency, reliability, adoption, satisfaction and operating cost.
* Reusable patterns reduce implementation time without compromising customer requirements or platform integrity.

**Requirements:**

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, ideally 4+ years, delivering customer-facing enterprise software into production.
* Mandatory Java competency for backend engineering, preferably Spring Boot, REST APIs, dependency injection, testing, exception handling and service design.
* Mandatory Python competency for AI engineering, automation, LLM integrations, tool calling, evaluation and/or MLOps workflows.
* Hands-on Conversational AI experience, including conversation state, context handling, fallback, escalation and production measurement.
* Experience building APIs and enterprise integrations; familiarity with authentication, webhooks, retries, idempotency, rate limits and event-driven patterns.
* Strong debugging and production-readiness skills across testing, observability, performance, reliability and secure customer-data handling.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, handle ambiguity, explain trade-offs and take ownership from problem definition through deployment.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture and deployment practices; AWS experience is preferred.

**Good to have:**

* Consumer-facing CCaaS/contact-center experience across Messaging, Digital AI, IVR, Voice AI, routing and/or agent assist.
* AWS production experience with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
* React or another modern frontend framework, sufficient to debug integrations and collaborate full-stack.
* Experience integrating ElevenLabs, OpenAI and/or Strands, or equivalent Voice AI, LLM and agent-orchestration technologies.
* Practical understanding of multimodal AI, concurrency/multithreading and high-volume, low-latency services.
* AI evaluation, prompt/version management, model monitoring, guardrails, human handoff and AI quality measurement.

**Benefits working @ Digit88:**

* Comprehensive Insurance (Life, Health, Accident).
* Flexible Work Model.
* Accelerated learning & non-linear growth.
* Flat organization structure driven by ownership and accountability.
* Opportunity to own and be a part of some of the most innovative and promising AI/SaaS product companies in North America and around the world.
* Accomplished Global Peers - Working with some of the best engineers/professionals globally from the likes of Apple, Amazon, IBM Research, Adobe and other innovative product companies.
* Ability to make a global impact with your work, leading innovations in Conversational AI, Energy/Utilities, ESG, HealthTech, IoT, Risk/Compliance, CyberSecurity, PLM and more.

You will work with a founding team of serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits to their credit. The learning will be immense just as will the challenges.

**This is the right time to join us and partner in our growth**

* Design end-to-end automation architecture spanning provisioning, configuration management, patching, monitoring, and lifecycle operations across on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

* Design and govern Azure Identity & Access Management (IAM): role-based access control (RBAC), Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), automated access provisioning/deprovisioning, and identity governance across hybrid environments.

* Architect and manage SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) environments for OS deployment, patch management, software distribution, and endpoint compliance automation.

* Hold architect-level ownership of at least one public cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) — landing zone design, account/subscription structure, networking, security baselines — and integrate multi-cloud DevOps practices into a unified automation framework.

* Define and enforce Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards with strong hands-on depth in Terraform and Terragrunt (module design, remote state management, workspace/environment isolation, DRY variable hierarchies) alongside ARM/Bicep and Ansible; own IaC governance across teams.

* Partner with delivery, operations, and security teams to translate manual/legacy processes into automated, auditable workflows.

* Own architecture documentation, automation design specs, and implementation planning (phased rollout, risk assessment, rollback strategy).

* Mentor engineering teams on automation best practices and drive adoption across the infra org.

Required Skills & Experience

* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering/architecture roles, with 3+ years focused on automation/DevOps.

* Hands-on expertise with Azure DevOps (pipelines, YAML, release management).

* Strong background across classic infrastructure: Windows Server, Linux/Unix, VMware virtualization, enterprise databases (SQL/Oracle or similar), storage & backup platforms (NetApp, Veeam, Commvault, etc.), and enterprise networking.

* Strong hands-on experience with Azure IAM — RBAC, Conditional Access, PIM, Entra ID (Azure AD) automation and governance.

* Proven experience with SCCM for endpoint management, patching, and OS/application deployment automation.

* Experience with monitoring/observability tools (SCOM, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, or similar) and integrating automated remediation.

* Architect-level expertise in Azure, AWS, or GCP — able to design landing zones, account/subscription hierarchies, network topology, and security/governance baselines, not just automate within an existing environment.

* Working knowledge of at least one additional public cloud beyond the primary and cloud-native DevOps tooling.

* Proficiency in scripting/automation languages: PowerShell, Python, Bash.

* Strong, hands-on IaC experience with Terraform and Terragrunt (module authoring, remote state, environment/workspace isolation, DRY configuration patterns) as the core automation toolchain, plus ARM/Bicep templates and Ansible/Chef/Puppet.

* Proven ability to produce automation design documents and implementation/rollout plans for enterprise environments.

* Excellent stakeholder communication skills — able to present automation strategy to both technical teams and leadership.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

* Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional) or Google Professional Cloud Architect; HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate; Azure Identity & Access Administrator (SC-300); VMware VCP; ITIL Foundation.

* Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments (banking, healthcare, government).

description:

* Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).
* Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Role Overview:**

The Data Architect will be responsible for defining, designing, and governing the data architecture for Billing end to end process, that enables scalable, secure, and business-aligned data platforms! This role requires deep expertise in data modeling, cloud data warehousing, integration patterns, governance frameworks, and modern analytics architectures to support reporting, regulatory compliance, and advanced analytics.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Enterprise Data Architecture**

Define and maintain the data architecture roadmap aligned with business and technology strategies.

Design scalable and reusable data architectures, including operational, analytical, and reporting data layers.

Establish enterprise data models, conceptual, logical, and physical data models, ensuring consistency across domains.

Develop and maintain dimensional models, star schemas, and canonical data models to support reporting and analytics requirements.

Drive architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices for data platforms and integrations.

  

**Data Acquisition & Integration**

Design and govern data ingestion, integration, and transformation frameworks using native AWS tools like Glue, Air Flow and Snowflake , Data Bricks as Data Store

Architect data pipelines and integration patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources.

Ensure end-to-end data lineage, reconciliation, and traceability across all billing process data flows.

Define standards for data quality, validation, and data synchronization across platforms.

Optimize data movement and transformation processes for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  

**Cloud Data Platform & Warehousing**

Architect enterprise data solutions leveraging Snowflake and cloud platforms including AWS.

Define data storage, compute, security, and data lifecycle management strategies.

Design modern data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse architectures to support enterprise-wide reporting and analytics.

Establish standards for data partitioning, clustering, performance optimization, and workload management.

Collaborate with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure resilient and scalable data environments.

  

**Reporting & Analytics Enablement**

Partner with reporting and analytics teams to ensure data architectures support business intelligence and self-service analytics.

Define and maintain certified data products and semantic layers for reporting tools such as Power BI.

Ensure data models are optimized for analytical consumption and regulatory reporting requirements.

Enable consistent metrics, KPIs, and master data definitions across business functions.

  

**Governance, Metadata & Security**

Lead implementation of enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and policies.

Establish and manage metadata management, business glossaries, and data catalog capabilities.

Define data security architecture, including role-based access controls, encryption, masking, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Ensure adherence to audit, risk, privacy, and regulatory standards.

Promote data stewardship and ownership across business and technology teams.

  

**Data Operations & Orchestration**

Define standards for workflow orchestration and scheduling using Control-M or equivalent enterprise scheduling tools.

Design monitoring frameworks for data quality, pipeline reliability, and operational excellence.

Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity considerations are embedded into data architecture designs.

* Experience with ETL/ELT platforms such as AWS Glue, Airflow, Ab Initio, Matillion, DataStage, or comparable technologies.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure data services.

* Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.

* Experience defining architecture standards, integration patterns, and technology roadmaps.

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

------------------

  
  

We're looking for someone who can work with our Data Scientists to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable machine learning and AI solutions. To be successful in this role, you'll need experience designing, building and supporting production machine learning and AI solutions within a modern engineering environment. You'll ideally hold an undergraduate or master's degree in a quantitative, engineering or computer science discipline, or demonstrate equivalent practical experience.

  
  

You'll also need strong software engineering experience, including cloud-native development, data engineering and machine learning operations. Ability to self-manage, take initiative and demonstrate a proactive approach to delivering high-quality engineering outcomes is also required.

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
  
• Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
  
• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• SQL Querying skills
  
• Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
  
• Banking domain knowledge
  
**Other Skills**  
• AML knowledge
  
• Interpersonal skills
  
• Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills and Eligibility**  
• Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
  
• Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
  
• A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
  
• Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
  
• The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
  
• Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
  
• Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
  
• Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
  
• Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
  
• Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
  
• High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
  
• Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? * Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.

* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.

description:

**About the Company**

**Expeditors** is a **Fortune 500** global logistics leader headquartered in **Bellevue, Washington**. With a worldwide network of over **335+ locations across 100 countries**, we employ more than **20,000 trained professionals** dedicated to solving the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

**About the Expeditors Chennai GCC**

The **Global Capability Center (GCC)** in **Chennai, India**, is a core strategic arm of **Expeditors Corporate Headquarters (CHQ) – Information Services**.

Today, our thriving hub of **500+ employees** is responsible for delivering **world-class information services** on a global scale. As a vital pillar of the organization, the Chennai GCC drives **measurable value** for our people, our business, and our global customers.

We are committed to **technological excellence** and will continue to **pioneer innovative services** as we grow responsibly in the coming years. **Join us** and be a part of a strategic team that **moves the world**.

 **Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The Engineer III is an experienced individual contributor who independently designs, develops, implements, and supports secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration solutions. The role combines strong EDI and API engineering capabilities with technical ownership across middleware, messaging, file-based interfaces, automation, modernization, and platform services. The Engineer III consistently delivers high-quality work, contributes to technical decisions and design reviews, guides peers and junior engineers, and helps shape solutions across systems, services, platforms, and products within the assigned domain.

Working across engineering teams and business stakeholders, the Engineer III drives complex integration delivery, strengthens operational resilience, improves code quality and performance, promotes engineering standards, and translates business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. The role also contributes through mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, continuous improvement, and portfolio or department-level initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Software, API, and Platform Development**

* Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and support application components, services, APIs, EDI translations, middleware integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Independently develop and maintain REST-based APIs, web services, system interfaces, reusable components, and automation utilities using established engineering standards and architectural patterns.
* Perform thorough self-reviews and code reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers and junior engineers, and improve the maintainability, reliability, security, and performance of solutions.
* Develop and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage to improve software quality and reliability
* Optimize complex code, mapping logic, services, and integration flows to reduce processing time, resource usage, defects, and repeated implementation effort.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support coding, testing, documentation, defect detection, and technical analysis while maintaining established quality and security standards.

**EDI and Enterprise Integration Delivery**

* Design, develop, and support enterprise integrations across ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, APIs, middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, and managed file-transfer patterns.
* Own complex EDI and integration projects, including requirement interpretation, mapping and transformation logic, interface design, validation, testing, implementation, deployment, and post-production support.
* Analyze input and output data, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner configurations, routes, canonical structures, and downstream system behavior to confirm accuracy, completeness, and expected processing.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, API, middleware, mapping, dataflow, transactions, communication, and performance issues by isolating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts early, and recommend mitigation approaches for complex or cross-system changes.
* Contribute reusable integration patterns, utilities, templates, and documentation that improve quality and consistency, acceleratetime to market, and strengthen team effectiveness.

**API Engineering and Modernization**

* Design, consume, test, secure, document, and support REST APIs and related system interfaces, including API contracts, request and response structures, validation, error handling, and versioning considerations.
* Contribute to API enablement that complements EDI capabilities and supports modern, reusable, and self-service integration experiences where appropriate.
* Apply microservices, messaging, event-driven, distributed system, and domain-driven design concepts to assign solutions when applicable.
* Contribute to application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms to modern architecture and engineering practices.
* Collaborate with platform, architecture, security, product, and adjacent engineering teams to align API and integration solutions with enterprise patterns and strategic objectives.

**Technical Design and Architecture**

* Lead or actively contribute to technical design for systems of significant size and near- to mid-term business impact.
* Participate actively in technical design reviews, provide feedback on other designs, incorporate feedback, and help shape technical decisions of significant complexity, ensuring alignment with Engineering Principles and architectural standards.
* Apply Engineering Principles and approved architectural patterns to improve modularity, interoperability, reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Evaluate system dependencies, design tradeoffs, operational impacts, failure modes, and downstream effects when developing or changing solutions.
* Document technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, implementation decisions, test evidence, deployment details, operational procedures, and support findings.

title: Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer
description:
As a **Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer**, you will develop and operate the infrastructure, tooling, and workflows that enable effective use of AI and Machine Learning at CMT. Your responsibilities will span operationalizing AI developer tools and model services, automating model workflows, and improving reliability, observability, and cost efficiency. You will partner with Engineering, Machine Learning, Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE to translate their requirements into operational capabilities and controls.

You will apply reproducible workflows, evaluation, controlled deployment, monitoring, and incident response to existing developer harnesses and coding tools, large language model (LLM) applications and agents, and machine learning training and inference. Current priorities emphasize AI usage across engineering teams, with shared operational ownership of model development and release infrastructure. The role requires hands-on expertise in scalable AI/ML systems, independent technical judgment, and the ability to turn operational needs into reusable capabilities.

CMT is looking for a collaborative, customer-committed, and creative **Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer** who wants to join us in making roads safer by making drivers better!

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and optimize scalable AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring a balance between cost-efficiency and speed, with the goal of empowering Engineering and Machine Learning teams
* Operationalize AI developer harnesses, coding tools, and shared model services by tuning model configurations, integrating tools into engineering workflows, evaluating their effectiveness, and implementing usage controls agreed with Compliance and Security Engineering
* Optimize model access and inference through routing, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and fallbacks. Monitor token usage, latency, efficiency, throughput, and costs. Attribute usage and costs by team and workload, and implement budgets, quotas, and capacity controls
* Establish monitoring infrastructure for evaluating the performance of AI applications and machine learning models at scale. Trace model calls, retrieval, tool execution, and training workflows; monitor data quality, model drift, and output quality; and implement safeguards for sensitive data and tool access
* Operationalize evaluation workflows for models, prompts, and AI tool configurations. Work with Engineering and Machine Learning teams to track quality metrics and detect regressions, and with Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE to incorporate policy, security, and reliability requirements into evaluation workflows and deployment decisions
* Develop and manage reproducible agent, training, and evaluation workflows, including permissions, execution limits, failure recovery, and traceability of inputs and outputs
* Build robust infrastructure to expedite the delivery of new models and AI capabilities, enhancing the efficiency of experimentation, validation, and deployment. Automate versioning, experiment tracking, model registries, release pipelines, retraining, and rollback
* Manage, configure, deploy, and troubleshoot AI/ML workloads on AWS and Kubernetes/EKS. Automate infrastructure with Terraform, Helm, and Argo CD, and optimize CPU/GPU capacity and autoscaling for training and inference
* Partner with SRE, Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to define operational metrics and service-level objectives, investigate production issues, and conduct root-cause analysis for model services, AI tools, and training pipelines. Coordinate with Security Engineering and Compliance when incidents involve security or policy concerns, and implement improvements that prevent recurring failures
* Design and document systems, including writing and reviewing code, to automate operational problems within the team's domain. Evaluate emerging AI/ML tools and operational practices against workload requirements, reliability, security, and cost, and mentor teammates
* Architect software solutions integrating developer tools, backend, and research domains, facilitating effective data collection and transmission to support AI applications and ML models. Build and optimize ingestion, retrieval, feature engineering, model training, and validation pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Ray, and AWS services

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience and/or certification in a related field
* 4+ years of relevant working experience, with experience working as an AI / ML Operations Engineer a plus
* Demonstrated experience independently designing, delivering, and operating production AI/ML infrastructure, with ownership of technical decisions, deployment, reliability, and operational improvements.
* Hands-on experience integrating and operating LLM services or AI tools, including model APIs, provider quotas, context and token limits, and failure handling
* Experience with model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring, including reproducibility, experiment tracking, model versioning, and evaluation-driven releases.
* Experience with big data infrastructure and software, such as Databricks, SageMaker, Spark, and S3
* Strong Python programming skills and experience with SQL and shell scripting for model integrations, data processing, and operational automation. Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes, including management, configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Ability to design and document systems, including writing and reviewing code, to automate operational problems across AI/ML workflows.
* Good understanding of AWS services, including model services such as Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker, and experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or Argo CD.
* Demonstrated experience with production monitoring, and troubleshooting model, data, and infrastructure issues
* Ability to navigate code, retrieve data from data sources, and implement bug fixes; actively seeks feedback and resolves discrepancies with teammates
* Ability to collaborate across Engineering, Machine Learning, Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE teams, translate their requirements into AI/ML operational practices and controls, evaluate technical tradeoffs, drive implementation through production rollout, and mentor engineers

**Nice to Haves:**

* Experience operating AI developer harnesses, coding tools, or agent workflows, including tool integrations, permissions, and usage management
* Experience with AI evaluation and tracing tools such as Langfuse or LangSmith, or ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow
* Experience using EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS/PostgreSQL, NGINX, S3, and Kinesis in production environments
* Experience building scalable data processing systems for production environments, including retrieval, embedding, or feature pipelines
* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch, including visualization and performance analysis
* Experience with GPU provisioning, model serving, or training and inference optimization
* AWS certification and/or Kubernetes certification

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience including Provident Fund (PF), Corporate NPS, and a meal card program
* Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Medical Benefits (Health insurance, Personal accident insurance, Group term life insurance), gratuity, parental leave, sick/casual leave, leave encashments, and public holidays
* Employees are eligible for flexible allowances which includes Leave Travel Assistance, Telephone/Mobile Expenses, Professional development expenses, Meals Coupon, Vehicle Reimbursement
* Flexible scheduling and hybrid work arrangements, as appropriate based on role and responsibilities

**Additional Perks:**

* Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world
* Join an industry leader — 65+ million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries
* Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified
* Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety
* Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters
* High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact
* Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge
* Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness
* Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs
  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai

**About Cambridge Mobile Telematics:**

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world's largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world's roads and drivers safer. The company's AI-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT's technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

title: Senior Lead Python AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and visionary **Senior Lead Python AI/ML Engineer with Generative AI Capabilities** to lead the design, development, and deployment of next-generation artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions based out of our **Chennai** center (operating in a **Hybrid** work model). With **10 to 12 years of hands-on software and machine learning engineering experience**, the ideal candidate will drive the convergence of traditional predictive ML models and modern Foundation Model / GenAI architectures.

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high-scale, low-latency AI solutions applied to **Fraud Mitigation, Risk Scoring, and Loss Prevention** across US Retail Banking products

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture**

* Architect, build, and deploy production-grade Generative AI systems, including **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**, autonomous agents, semantic search pipelines, and multi-modal AI workflows.
* Integrate state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs)—including **Google Gemini**, **Anthropic Claude**, and open-source models (Llama, Mistral)—optimizing for latency, cost, and accuracy.
* Build domain-specific prompt engineering frameworks, fine-tuning pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA), model evaluation benchmarks, and guardrails to minimize hallucinations and bias.
* Lead the architecture of predictive ML algorithms (anomaly detection, graph neural networks, supervised/unsupervised classifiers) tailored to real-time risk assessment.

**Software Engineering & System Scalability**

* Design resilient, low-latency, and horizontally scalable microservices and APIs in **Python (FastAPI, Flask, AsyncIO)** handling high-throughput transactional traffic.
* Integrate vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, pgvector) with distributed caching and event streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Implement robust MLOps and LLMOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, automated model retraining, observability with MLflow/Weights & Biases, model drift monitoring).

**Fraud Analytics & Domain Innovation**

* Collaborate closely with US-based and global Risk, Compliance, and Loss Prevention teams to build AI solutions targeting identity theft, account takeover (ATO), synthetic identity fraud, card-not-present (CNP) fraud, and transaction anomaly detection.
* Utilize unstructured data (investigator notes, SAR filings, customer interaction logs) via GenAI to automate fraud triage and investigative summarization.
* Ensure strict adherence to US Banking regulatory standards (FCRA, GLBA, Model Risk Management SR 11-7, Fair Lending, Explainable AI / XAI).

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Mentor senior/mid-level data scientists and software engineers across the Chennai engineering hub in modern GenAI patterns, clean code principles, and production readiness.
* Drive technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI frameworks, conduct proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and present architectural proposals to global engineering leadership.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* **Total Experience:****10 to 12 years** of professional experience in software engineering and production AI/ML system development.
* **Core Python Expertise:** Advanced proficiency in Python 3.x (multiprocessing/asyncio, design patterns, profiling, packaging, and clean code paradigms).
* **Core ML Frameworks:** Deep practical experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM.
* **Generative AI Proficiency:**
  + Demonstrated success building production GenAI applications (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen).
  + Hands-on experience with embedding models, dense retrieval, rerankers, and vector indexing strategies.
* **Distributed Systems & Cloud:** Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and distributed data processing (PySpark, Ray).
* **MLOps / LLMOps:** Proven track record in orchestrating end-to-end ML lifecycles from data validation to real-time inference monitoring.

**4. Preferred & Good-to-Have Skills**

* **Google Gemini & Anthropic Claude:** Hands-on experience with API integration, function calling/tools, context caching, and prompt optimization specifically for Google Gemini (Pro/Flash) and Anthropic Claude (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku).
* **Domain Knowledge (Fraud & Loss Prevention):**

  + Familiarity with transaction monitoring, biometric behavioral analytics, and fraud consortium datasets.

title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead
description:
Posted date Oct. 13, 2026

Contract type Full time

Job ID R-261745

  

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. The majority of your work will be field based, and will require you to be highly-organised, planning your monthly schedule, attending meetings and calls, as well as writing up reports.

**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-261745 **Date posted** 10/13/2026

**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**

**GCL: F**

**Location: Chennai**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.

**Accountabilities:**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact.

**Call to Action:**

Step into this role to architect the AI foundations of drug development and amplify your impact—share your profile and start shaping what’s next.

**Date Posted**

13-Oct-2026

**Closing Date**

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

### **Explore the local area**

Take a look at the map to see what’s nearby.

**Reasons to Join**
-------------------

### **Thomas Mathisen**

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java Backend) ,Retail Engineering
description:
**Summary**
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together, we craft products and experiences that people once couldn't have imagined — and now can't imagine living without.
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
  
  
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
  
  
**Description**
You'll operate at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and leadership — influencing solution design, mentoring developers, and driving best-in-class technical outcomes. You'll architect and design scalable microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful APIs, and own systems where reliability, latency, and throughput genuinely matter.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep backend engineering rigor with curiosity about where the field is heading — someone who's as comfortable reasoning about circuit breakers and backpressure as they are experimenting with LLMs and agentic workflows to solve real engineering problems. If you're passionate about contributing to what's next, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop highly scalable and reliable backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices following modern backend engineering practices.
* Design distributed systems capable of handling high traffic, large data volumes, and demanding latency requirements.
* Develop and maintain Kafka-based event-driven systems, including producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, retries, and failure handling.
* Design and optimize caching solutions using Redis or equivalent technologies to improve application performance and scalability.
* Participate in production operations, incident management, root-cause analysis, and service reliability improvements.
* Own features and services throughout the complete SDLC, from technical design through production deployment and support.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to architectural decisions and technical roadmaps for backend platforms.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience in Java backend development.
* Experience building production applications using Spring Boot and Spring Framework.
* Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and backend design patterns.
* Experience with Kafka or equivalent event-streaming platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Redis or other caching technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and operating high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Experience with AWS services, including EC2, EKS, ALB, CloudWatch, S3, ElastiCache, or equivalent services.
* Experience with Redis/Valkey, cache invalidation strategies, TTL management, distributed caching, and cache failure scenarios.
* Strong understanding of Kafka architecture, including partitioning, replication, ordering, consumer lag, rebalancing, retries, and exactly-once/at-least-once processing.
* Experience with MongoDB replication, sharding, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and high-volume workloads.
* Track record of brainstorming and shipping POCs using AI/ML/GenAI services to solve new or existing enterprise problems, with the ability to manage partner communications and navigate ambiguity in a fast-changing, matrixed environment

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

description:
