ABOUT QUIPU

Quipu is AI infrastructure for long-term memory. We give every entity in a complex system a single, audit-grade memory so engineering teams can study cause and effect instead of guessing at it.

Our platform powers real enterprise work:

- Vehicles with component-level traceability and failure prediction

- Drug development with fewer risky experiments

- Battery storage systems with trusted cell-ageing models

- AI agents with a shared persona that never resets

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is an on-site role at T-Hub, Hyderabad, on a 6-day working week for the first 9 months. We're building core infrastructure on a hard timeline and would rather be upfront about the commitment than surprise you later. After 9 months, the schedule moves to a standard 5-day week.

Applications with less than 3 years of professional Java experience will not be considered.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Java backend engineer who thinks in systems, not just code. You'll own architecture decisions on the core services behind a distributed graph memory platform: graph storage, streaming ingestion, ETL pipelines and semantic retrieval at scale. We expect you to reason about trade-offs and failure modes before you write a line of code.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and evolve Spring Boot microservices at the core of the platform

- Own architecture decisions: service boundaries, data flow, failure handling and how the platform scales

- Design security and access control: authentication, authorization, multi-tenant data isolation and secrets management

- Build event-driven, Kafka-based pipelines with backpressure-aware stream processing and actor-model concurrency

- Build and operate ETL and ingestion workflows across heterogeneous data sources

- Model and query data across graph (Neo4j), distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), vector stores and embedded key-value stores

- Own features end-to-end: design, build, test, deploy and debug in production using logs, metrics and traces

- Take part in design reviews and explain your decisions with clear reasoning

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST-HAVE

✅ 3–7 years of production experience with Java and Spring Boot

✅ Strong core Java: collections, concurrency, JVM fundamentals

✅ Experience designing service boundaries and owning systems beyond single features

✅ Security in Java apps: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, role- and attribute-based access control, secure API design

✅ Production experience with Kafka or a similar event-streaming platform

✅ Experience building or operating ETL / data pipelines

✅ Distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, partitioning, idempotency, retries, backpressure, failure handling

✅ Strong SQL plus experience with at least one NoSQL or graph database

✅ Available on-site in Hyderabad, 6 days a week for the first 9 months

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STRONG PLUS

⭐ Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault or production IAM integration

⭐ Akka / Apache Pekko (actors, streams, cluster)

⭐ Neo4j, Cypher or graph data modeling

⭐ Distributed SQL (YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner-class systems)

⭐ Vector databases and semantic search (Milvus, pgvector, etc.)

⭐ Python (FastAPI) for service sidecars

⭐ LLM-integrated systems: prompt pipelines, extraction workflows, RAG

⭐ Jenkins, Docker, containerized deployments on Linux

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHO YOU ARE

- You ask "Why is the system shaped this way?" before "What do I build?"

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and small-team ownership, without rigid specs or hand-holding

- You debug from first principles and write down what you learn

- You communicate trade-offs clearly and disagree constructively

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT WE OFFER

🔹 Direct ownership of core infrastructure: your work ships and matters immediately

🔹 Deep, unusual problems: bitemporal modeling, graph traversal at scale, streaming knowledge extraction

🔹 A small, high-ownership team building infrastructure for enterprise clients

title: Software Engineer IV
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**

  

Do you love building software that thrills your customers using AIDLC? Do you insist on high standards for the systems you and your teams design and build? Are you a progressive, hands-on software engineer with an architect’s mindset, an advocate of agile development practices, and a proponent of continuous improvement? Well if this is you, then join an energetic team of engineers building next generation applications for PDI! Software Engineer 4 is our senior-most engineering level and operates at the scope of a Software Architect. You will own the technical architecture and solution design for your product area as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility, defining how services are structured, integrated, secured, and scaled, and making the key design decisions for new and existing applications. You will lead medium and large sized projects, set technical direction and engineering standards across teams, and guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels. You will partner with Product Management, Software Architects, and DevOps on solution feasibility, estimation, and the technical roadmap, and serve as the evangelist and custodian of our technology, architecture, and product. With the variety of environments, platforms, technologies & languages, you must be comfortable working in both Windows & Linux environments and learning a variety of programming languages.  
  
This is a hands-on architect-level position (~60% hands-on design and coding, ~40% architecture, technical leadership, and mentoring) requiring expert proficiency in .NET Core, React, SQL Server, and cloud-native architecture on Azure, with ownership of system design, architectural decisions, and engineering quality across teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and solution design for your product area, and be accountable for design decisions for new and existing applications, proactively escalating issues and seeking assistance to overcome obstacles.
* Define and document target-state architecture, system designs, and architecture decision records (ADRs); run design reviews and ensure implementations stay consistent with the agreed architecture.
* Design for non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, and compliance such as PCI DSS) and make the trade-offs between them explicit.
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns (REST, messaging and event-driven), and data models across services and third-party systems.
* Lead medium and large sized projects end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment.
* Set technical direction, coding standards, and engineering best practices across teams; guide, train, and mentor engineers at all levels, including through code and design reviews.
* Actively design, develop, and maintain critical services and enterprise applications using .NET Framework, .NET Core, and React, building reference implementations and proofs of concept.
* Partner with Product Management to consult on solution feasibility, high-level effort estimation, and the technical roadmap.
* Prepare and provide project status and risk assessments, including technical and architectural risks, to management with appropriate levels of detail to ensure programs stay on schedule.
* Collaborate with Software Architects and DevOps teams to evaluate tools, processes, technologies, and cloud infrastructure, including build-versus-buy decisions.
* Make recommendations for technology adoption and framework improvement, analyzing trends, patterns, and best practices for software, including AI-assisted development (AIDLC).
* Serve as the evangelist and custodian of technology, architecture, and product.
* Identify systemic performance, reliability, and scalability risks; drive root-cause analysis of production incidents and the architectural fixes that follow.
* Use a disciplined approach in an Agile environment to assist in analysis and determination of preferred solutions to technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot, test, and validate software issues; resolve issues with due urgency and maintain thorough documentation of all software solutions.
* Work with Product Owner to clarify and estimate feature work, and with QA Engineers to develop optimal product test plans and resolve issues found during release stabilization.
* Own the technical debt roadmap: identify, prioritize, and drive modernization and improvements across teams.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field plus 9+ years’ experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications in a software product development environment, OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience serving as a technical team lead or in an architecture role.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud-native systems end-to-end, including microservices, event-driven architecture, and API design.
* Expert in: .NET Framework, .Net/.NET Core, C#, SQL, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, MVC, REST API, React.
* Strong knowledge of architecture and design principles: design patterns, domain-driven design, SOLID, scalability, resiliency patterns, caching, and messaging (for example, Azure Service Bus).
* Strong experience with SQL Server and NoSQL data stores (for example, Cosmos DB): data modeling, stored procedures, and query performance tuning.
* Deep knowledge of C# development including: multi-threading, memory management, async programming, microservices, dependency injection.
* 3+ years of experience designing and running cloud native applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP): Infrastructure as a Service, Docker/containers, CI/CD, and observability.
* Understanding of application security and compliance (OWASP, PCI DSS), with experience in payments or other regulated domains preferred.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (AI-based agents) and the ability to drive their adoption across teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Visual Studio IDE and the use of Azure DevOps or Jira.
* 2+ years of practical experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others and take action.

title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
description:
**Senior Software Performance Engineer**

*6+ Years Experience | PAX India*

**About the Role**
==================

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud — building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others.

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too — the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly.

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Load & Synthetic Test Tooling**
---------------------------------

* Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework — test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting.
* Apply AI capabilities to improve test development — AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis.
* Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc.

**Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis**
-----------------------------------------------

* Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation.
* Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/.NET and/or Java services.
* Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics).

**Ongoing**
-----------

* Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating.
* Design and maintain C#/.NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability.
* Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

* 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering.
* Strong C#/.NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience.
* Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments.
* Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic).
* Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis).
* Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues.
* Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance.
* Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You**
=====================================

* Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction.
* Have systemic curiosity — you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database.
* Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Gatling or Playwright experience specifically.
* AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens.
* Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript.
* Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning).
* Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis.

**Quick Summary**
=================

*“Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/.NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability.”*

title: AI Engineer*
description:
**Description**

  
We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in building AI Agents from the ground up, designing agentic workflows, and integrating enterprise tooling and MCP servers into production-grade agent systems. The ideal candidate has a builder's mindset someone who has architected and shipped real agents, not just experimented with frameworks. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, workflow automation, and enterprise integration. You will design agents that reason, act, and collaborate across business systems and make them accessible to end users through platforms like Slack

**What You'll Do**

**Agent Development & Architecture**

* Build AI Agents from scratch, including reasoning loops, memory management, tool calling, and state handling
* Design and implement multi-agent systems with defined roles, handoffs, and coordination logic
* Build agent orchestration layers to manage task delegation, agent communication, and failure recovery
* Implement planning and reflection patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, etc.) for autonomous task completion
* Design agents capable of handling long-running, multi-step workflows with human-in-the-loop checkpoints

**MCP Integration**

* Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients from the ground up
* Integrate MCP servers into agent runtimes to expose enterprise tools, APIs, and data sources as callable context
* Design reusable MCP tooling layers that agents can dynamically discover and invoke
* Ensure secure, governed access when agents interact with internal systems via MCP

**Tool & System Integration**

* Integrate agents with enterprise tools including Jira, Salesforce, Slack, Notion, GitHub, ServiceNow, and others
* Build robust tool-calling interfaces, error handling, and retry logic for agent-tool interactions
* Connect agents to internal APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms via structured integration frameworks
* Develop and maintain an internal tool registry accessible by agents at runtime

**Agentic Workflows & Automation**

* Design end-to-end agentic workflows that automate complex, multi-step business processes
* Build automation pipelines that route tasks intelligently across agents, tools, and human reviewers
* Implement event-driven agent triggers integrated with enterprise systems and data streams
* Optimize workflows for reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

**Slack Platform & Agent Accessibility**

* Deploy and expose AI agents as interactive Slack bots and workflow apps
* Build Slack surfaces (slash commands, modals, home tabs, message actions) that connect users to agent capabilities
* Implement conversational agent interfaces in Slack with context retention across threads
* Enable agents to proactively surface insights, alerts, and task updates within Slack channels

* Implement RAG architectures to ground agents in enterprise knowledge bases
* Build vector pipelines, embeddings, and retrieval systems that agents query at runtime
* Integrate Snowflake (Cortex, Snowpark) as a data backbone for agent memory and structured data access

**AI Security & Governance**

* Implement prompt injection defenses, access controls, and data leakage prevention within agent pipelines
* Design RBAC and audit logging for all agent actions and tool invocations
* Ensure agents operate within defined security and compliance boundaries

* 5+ years of software or AI engineering experience
* Proven experience building AI Agents from the ground up — not just configuring frameworks
* Hands-on experience integrating MCP servers and clients into agent systems
* Experience designing and deploying agentic workflows and multi-step automations
* Experience building and deploying Slack bots or Slack-integrated AI applications
* Strong Python skills with experience in async, event-driven, and API-heavy architectures
* Experience with tool-calling patterns, function routing, and agent-tool error handling
* Solid understanding of LLM behavior, context windows, and prompt engineering
* Experience with RAG architectures and vector databases

* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex or Snowpark for AI workloads
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source LLMs
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS)
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Experience with AI observability, tracing, and evaluation frameworks
* Snowflake certifications are a plus

* Tool integration and function calling
* Slack Platform (Bolt SDK, Block Kit, Slack APIs)

title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-253537 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.

This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.

The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.
* Experience working across digital product, software engineering, data, analytics, and/or AI product teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change from project-based technology delivery toward persistent product teams and outcome-oriented delivery.

description:

Overview:

The Product Support Specialist I is a role within the Customer Support team, supporting customers on Seismic's sales enablement platform. This is a chat-first role focused on delivering fast, friendly answers to customers via ServiceNow chat, with a goal of maintaining a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score above 90%. The Specialist owns and resolves Q&A and how-to style chat conversations directly, while opening and routing more technical cases to Level 1 or Level 2 Support Engineers with clear context. The role also contributes to the team's shared product knowledge by identifying gaps in existing documentation and adding new or updated knowledge base content. This role will become a subject matter expert in all areas of the product in order to assist customers with questions in real time.

  

Who you are::  

* 2+ years of relevant work experience in a customer service or technical support role.
* Expected to obtain Seismic Learning or Seismic University Certifications during tenure.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Basic technical knowledge related to SaaS platforms.
* Ability to distinguish between a straightforward question and one that needs technical escalation, and to follow structured processes for each.
* Team-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to learning and contributing.
* Demonstrates reliability and consistency in handling customer interactions.
* Resolves Q&A/how-to cases efficiently while routing technical cases cleanly, with minimal back-and-forth for Support Engineers.
* Shows eagerness to learn and grow within the role and organization.
* Makes a measurable impact on customer satisfaction.
* Actively surfaces knowledge gaps and helps strengthen the team's shared product knowledge base.
* Builds strong working relationships within the team and across support tiers.

Key Responsibilities

* Respond to customer inquiries via ServiceNow chat in a timely and professional manner.
* Own and resolve Q&A and how-to style support cases directly, end to end.
* Open cases for more technical or complex issues, and route them to a Level 1 or Level 2 Support Engineer with clear, complete context (what was tried, what the customer reported, relevant details).

* Apply basic troubleshooting techniques across core Seismic product areas (e.g., LiveSend, LiveDocs, DSR, Meetings) to answer common questions and guide customers through standard how-to scenarios.
* Recognize the line between a Q&A/how-to case you can own and a technical issue that needs engineering-level troubleshooting.
* Identify gaps in existing knowledge base articles and documentation.
* Contribute new knowledge articles and article updates.
* Collaborate with Support Engineers to ensure smooth handoff and follow-up on routed cases.
* Use appropriate macros for support and escalation.
* Learn the Sev-0/Sev-1 incident response process, including recognizing when a customer issue may be part of a broader incident.
* Demonstrate initiative by contributing to side projects and team improvements.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
We are building an AI-native analytics function. Instead of analysts hand-writing every query and report, we want people who design
**AI agents**
that explore lending data, find insights and recommend actions on their own. You will connect LLMs to our data warehouse and internal tools. You will write the prompts, guardrails and evaluation loops that make the agents reliable.

You don't need to be a lending expert. You need working knowledge of how lending and collections work, and deep skill in building and prompting agents. We'll teach the domain. We can't teach you to build good agents from scratch.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, build and ship LLM-based agents that query Snowflake, analyse portfolios and produce insights, such as roll rates, bucket movement, cohort performance and campaign effectiveness.
* Write and maintain production-grade system prompts, tool definitions and knowledge bases, so agents apply business rules correctly (for example, block-list filters, DPD definitions and loan-prefix logic).
* Build multi-step and multi-agent workflows: planning, SQL generation, validation, summarization and anomaly flagging.
* Create evaluation harnesses (golden questions, SQL-correctness checks, hallucination tests) to measure and improve agent accuracy.
* Automate recurring analyses: daily and weekly performance reports, pre-due and delinquent campaign tracking, field-visit and agency productivity analysis.
* Turn agent output into dashboards, artifacts or alerts that collections, risk and product teams use.
* Work with business stakeholders to turn vague questions ("why did the 30+ bucket worsen?") into agent-solvable tasks.
* Document agent behaviour, failure modes and costs, and keep token and compute usage under control.

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Agent building:**
  hands-on experience with tool-use / function calling and agent loops, using the Claude API/SDK, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph or similar.
* **Advanced prompting:**
  structured prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, output schemas, prompt versioning and debugging hallucinations.
* **SQL (strong):**
  Snowflake or a similar warehouse. You must be able to check whether an agent's SQL is right, not just trust it.
* **Python:**
  pandas, API integrations, scripting, basic orchestration (Airflow or cron).
* **Insight generation:**
  you can go from raw data to "what changed, why, and what should we do".
* **Evaluation mindset:**
  you test agents systematically and don't ship on vibes.
* **Lending basics:**
  understanding of DPD, buckets, NPAs, roll rates, collections efficiency, EMI cycles and credit-risk fundamentals.

**About Kissht:**

Kissht is India's leading listed fintech companies, offering fast, personalized digital credit through its mobile app to customers across the country. Founded in 2016 by IIT/IIM alumni Ranvir Singh and Krishnan Vishwanathan, both former McKinsey consultants, Kissht was listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.

Kissht serves 74.6 million registered users and 12.25 million customers, with assets under management (AUM) of approximately ₹8,000 crore. Its growth is powered by proprietary AI/ML-based underwriting, a robust in-house technology stack, and a pan-India collections network.Headquartered in Mumbai and backed by marquee investors, including the Brunei InvestmentAuthority, Vertex Growth Fund, and the Government of Singapore, Kissht is now scaling as a publiccompany and is looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent to join nits next phase of growth.

title: Data Analytics Customer Engineer, Google Cloud (English)
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience as a data or systems engineer, solutions architect, or pre-sales consultant.
* Experience delivering demos, workshops, or architect overviews to business leaders.
* Experience migrating, refactoring, or debugging proprietary or open source workloads.
* Experience building data platforms, warehouses, or data lakes, and experience with data programming languages and leveraging agentic platforms.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to manage stakeholder relationships.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience designing and deploying enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM) application integrations, or context orchestration frameworks.
* Experience implementing enterprise data/AI governance, metadata management, access control, or lineage tracking across modern catalogs.
* Experience with developer advocacy, building internal technical programs, delivering technical enablement, or contributing to open-source data/AI communities.
* Experience in core data science workflows, including proficiency with data manipulation libraries and integrating data pipelines with ML platforms.
* Experience applying value-selling principles to align technical architectures with business outcomes.

**About The Job**
As an Agentic Data Cloud Customer Engineer, you are the premier technical subject matter expert in your territory. You will partner with Sales Specialists to execute the technical pre-sales strategy for customers, serving as the trusted technical advisor to CDOs, CTOs, Lead Architects, and developers. You will lead proactive discoveries to map complex, legacy customer data estates and qualify them for migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
You are a builder and architect that designs, codes, and deploys production-grade, end-to-end Data + AI pipelines that solve real-world enterprise problems. You will whiteboard modern open lakehouse architectures and run code demonstrations showing how unified data foundations power deterministic, hallucination-free conversational AI.
  
  
Leveraging a background in value-selling, you will conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership analyses and optimize architectures to prevent runaway spend. You will help customers adopt modern data engineering practices that securely unify data, analytics, and AI. If you possess deep expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data systems, and can translate technical excellence into business-transforming migrations, you will grow in this highly technical role.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy for large accounts, engaging C-level executives via live demonstrations to solve business problems using the Agentic Data Cloud.
* Design, code, and deploy production-grade Data + AI pipelines (e.g., fraud detection, recommendation engines) and map legacy data estates to open-format architectures (Apache Iceberg).
* Orchestrate Intent-Driven data engineering to autonomously deploy PySpark pipelines using the Data Agent Kit, Antigravity, and Model Context Protocol.
* Lead high-impact showcases and technical value validations using BigQuery, Borderless Lakehouse, Knowledge Catalog, Spark, and Vertex AI to prove business outcomes.
* Conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses and optimize architectures (such as balancing DRAM/SSD, compute shapes, and token spend) to prevent runaway costs on the Lightning Engine.

title: Sales Analytics Senior Analyst - AVP - MUMBAI
description:
**Role Overview**
Citi is seeking an Assistant Vice President within the Sales Analytics team to support the development and delivery of sales performance metrics, client analytics, and management reporting across Markets. Working closely with senior stakeholders and the broader analytics team, the successful candidate will help transform complex data into actionable business insights that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of data, finance, and business strategy, offering exposure to senior Markets leadership and the opportunity to contribute to key franchise-wide initiatives. The individual will play an important role in delivering recurring analytics, developing reporting methodologies, and supporting the evolution of self-service analytics capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain recurring sales productivity reporting and performance metrics for Markets businesses, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* Support the development and enhancement of Client Value (CV), Wallet, and sales performance methodologies across products and regions.
* Analyze client, sales, and commercial performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.
* Consolidate and transform client feedback data from multiple sources, including relationship manager interactions, call reports, and client management systems.
* Create and maintain senior management reporting materials, including client profiles, business reviews, and performance scorecards.
* Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, COO, Client Analytics, and Technology teams to source, validate, and reconcile data.
* Develop compelling visualizations and dashboards that communicate business performance clearly and effectively.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives to reduce manual reporting activities and improve data accessibility.
* Contribute to the development of self-service reporting and AI-enabled analytics tools.
* Ensure strong governance, documentation, and quality control across analytical outputs.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, finance, sales analytics, or management reporting within financial services or a corporate environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience using data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, Python, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Markets, Institutional Banking, Capital Markets, or other financial services businesses.
* Exposure to client analytics, sales productivity measurement, wallet analysis, or commercial performance reporting.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and client feedback data sources.
* Experience building dashboards, automated reporting solutions, or self-service analytics tools.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics capabilities and their application in business reporting.
* Understanding of benchmarking or third-party market intelligence datasets.

**Success in the Role**
The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Deliver reliable and insightful analytics that support management decision-making.
* Build strong partnerships across business and functional teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and analytical methodologies.
* Identify commercial opportunities through thoughtful analysis of client and sales performance data.
* Contribute to the team's broader goal of creating scalable, self-service analytics capabilities.

title: Senior Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

The Senior Customer Success Data Analyst owns how Customer Success uses data to improve adoption, retention, drive expansion and decide where CSMs focus.

You will own the CS analytics strategy, metric framework, customer health score and churn-prediction approach, and act as the analytics partner to the Head of CS Operations and CS leadership. As the team is new, you will design how data from various platforms, databases and raw Excel dumps in Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk and product telemetry comes together, and set the standard for how we use analytics and AI across Customer Success.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

**CS analytics strategy**

* Own the CS analytics roadmap with the Head of CS Operations, prioritizing work by impact on retention and growth.
* Act as the trusted analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping decisions on segmentation, coverage models and customer playbooks.
* Present insights to CS leadership and contribute to board-level reporting.

**Customer health and churn prediction**

* Own the customer health score methodology end to end — design, validation against actual renewal and churn outcomes, and regular recalibration.
* Build predictive churn and propensity models (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis) and turn them into early-warning signals CSMs can act on.
* Compare retention and outcomes across customer groups (industry, region, account segments, products, sign-up period) to uncover what drives churn and growth.
* Lead root-cause analysis of churn and downsell.

**Metrics, dashboards and reporting**

* Define and govern the CS metric framework and a single source of truth so CS, Sales, Finance and Product report the same numbers and details.
* Own reporting on core CS KRAs — Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR/NRR), other renewal and growth details, time-to-value, adoption and health distribution.
* Oversee dashboards in Excel, presentations and Power BI for CS leadership and CSMs.
* Lead data and meeting preparation for internal monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and leadership/board reporting.

**Product usage, renewals and expansion**

* Partner with Product and Engineering to model product telemetry for adoption and value-realization metrics.
* Own risk-weighted renewal forecasting, so leadership sees a realistic outlook and CSMs know which renewals need attention.
* Analyze feature adoption, usage depth and breadth, and onboarding milestones to identify at-risk and high-potential accounts.
* Build models that identify upsell and cross-sell signals from usage, license utilization, account health and intelligence, and share them with CSMs.
* Measure the impact of CS programs and plays on retention and expansion revenue.

**Data foundations**

* Set data-quality and governance standards for CRM and CS-platform data, and drive fixes with system owners
* Design the CS data model and integrations across Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk, internal deployment tools and product data.
* Document metrics, data sources and processes so analytics can scale with the team.

**AI-enabled analytics**

* Use LLMs such as Claude hands-on to accelerate building modules, analysis of data, querying data, documentation and insight generation.
* Design and roll out AI-assisted workflows and agents for CS — e.g. account summaries, sentiment analysis, renewal-risk briefs etc.
* Set guidelines for responsible, secure use of AI with customer data, in line with Seclore's data-protection standards.

**Your first 90 days:**

First 30 days

* Understand our customers, products and CS motion; assess data sources across various tools like Salesforce, Statisfy, product telemetry etc.
* Deliver a gap assessment of data quality.
* Deliver a baseline view of retention and renewals.

By 60 days

* Get the CS metric definition and framework agreed across CS and Finance.
* Launch the first version of CS leadership dashboard.
* Present the health-score framework and churn-model design.

By 90 days

* Launch V1 of the health score.
* Deliver a risk-weighted renewal forecast framework to CSMs for regular use.
* Publish a prioritized CS analytics roadmap.

**How we will measure impact over time:**
Predictive accuracy of the health score and churn models, use of insights in leadership and CSM decisions, data-quality improvements in CRM/CS platforms, and measurable contribution to GRR, NRR and adoption.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, with at least 2–3 years in customer success, revenue or business operations analytics, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Proven track record of building customer health scores or churn models end to end and getting them adopted by CS teams.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python for data wrangling, statistical analysis and predictive modeling (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis).
* Expert-level dashboard building in Power BI and Excel.
* Deep experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) data — accounts, opportunities, renewals.
* Hands-on experience administering or configuring a customer success platform such as Statisfy, Gainsight, Totango or ChurnZero.
* Experience designing data models and working with data from multiple systems and raw sources.
* Strong command of SaaS and subscription metrics: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, renewal rate, adoption.
* Advanced, hands-on AI user with experience applying LLMs such as Claude to analysis, coding, automation and documentation.
* A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions with data and clear storytelling.
* A builder mindset and comfort creating structure, standards and processes where none exist yet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in cybersecurity, data security or another enterprise B2B technology domain.
* Experience leading small analytics projects or teams.
* Experience helping build a CS Ops function from scratch.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience building AI agents or automated workflows for business teams.
* Exposure to customer segmentation and CS coverage-model design.

**Who you will work with:**

You will work closely with CSMs, Solution Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Consultants, and Sales to monitor account health, identify risks, generate renewal and expansion insights, support renewal forecasting, manage expansion pipelines, and maintain shared CRM data standards. You will partner with Product and Engineering to leverage usage telemetry, drive adoption insights, and establish product feedback loops. You will also collaborate with Finance and Leadership on ARR, GRR, NRR, and retention reporting for business and board reviews.

**Why join us**

* Be the senior analytics voice in a new CS Operations team and shape how Customer Success uses data.
* High visibility, with direct exposure to CS, Sales, Product and Finance leadership decisions.
* Work on meaningful problems for global enterprise customers in data security.
* Hands-on use of modern analytics and AI tools, with room to experiment.

**How to Apply**

1. Complete the Microsoft Form.
2. After submitting the form, continue and submit your application on LinkedIn.

**About The Role**
MitKat Advisory is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Analyst who is responsible for managing end-to-end security data collection, governance, integration, and operational analytics across assigned service locations. The position centralizes and validates data streams from physical security systems, dashboards, and logbooks to build real-time automated visualizations, conduct predictive modeling, and track program costs. By identifying trends and operational vulnerabilities, the Data Analyst delivers actionable, data-driven insights to optimize tactical resources, improve response capabilities, and support executive decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Centralize, clean, and validate data streams at service locations from physical security systems, including Access Control, CCTV, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Incident Management Systems.
* Aggregate data from security service provider dashboards, logbooks, registers, and digital feeds.
* Conduct operational data collection as required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compile security operational reports.
* Establish data hygiene processes to guarantee security data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with corporate privacy standards.
* Design, build, and maintain real-time automated operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) deployments, equipment readiness, and incident response times.
* Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual security operational reports analyzing security trends, site-level risks, and resource utilization across locations.
* Perform variance analysis comparing actual deployments and equipment costs against maximum Statement of Work (Scope of Services) caps and monthly baseline targets.
* Analyze physical security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, and asset loss logs to identify emerging security trends and operational vulnerabilities.
* Deliver data-driven recommendations for optimal CIRT operator headcount, hardware, and tactical gear allocation across regions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in BI tools (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Desktop Specialist) or data management.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Practical experience in data aggregation, data hygiene, governance, and statistical analysis.
* Experience designing and maintaining interactive dashboards using industry-standard visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
* Hands-on experience performing financial variance analysis, cost tracking, and operational metric modeling.
* Experience handling operational data streams, incident log analysis, or physical security metrics
* Strong knowledge of data governance principles, data hygiene practices, and corporate privacy compliance standards.
* Familiarity with predictive modeling techniques, trend analysis, and pattern identification methodologies.
* Understanding of operational performance metrics, resource utilization analysis, and budget variance tracking.
* Basic understanding of physical security technology systems (Access Control, CCTV, IDS, and Incident Management Systems).
* Data Visualization & BI: Advanced proficiency in building real-time dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
* Data Cleansing & Governance: Capability to integrate, validate, and sanitize disparate physical and digital data logs.
* Financial & Cost Analytics: Proficiency in performing cost variance analysis against baseline targets and Scope of Services budget caps.
* Technical Writing & Reporting: Ability to draft clear, error-free operational reports summarizing trends and strategic recommendations.
* Analytical Thinking: Translates raw, multi-source data into structured, predictive insights and actionable operational strategies.
* Data Integrity & Precision: High attention to detail ensuring complete accuracy, hygiene, and confidentiality across all reports and dashboards.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies operational vulnerabilities, process enhancements, and system optimization opportunities.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Communicates complex analytics effectively to support operational leaders and vendor management teams.

Why Join Us?
  
  
At MitKat Advisory, you will work on high-impact geopolitical and strategic intelligence projects supporting global decision-makers. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to executive-level strategy while working within a dynamic and growing advisory environment. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their CV and a brief writing sample demonstrating strategic analytical capabilities.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description: We are building an AI-native analytics function. Instead of analysts hand-writing every query and report, we want people who design AI agents that explore lending data, find insights and recommend actions on their own. You will connect LLMs to our data warehouse and internal tools. You will write the prompts, guardrails and evaluation loops that make the agents reliable.You don't need to be a lending expert. You need working knowledge of how lending and collections work, and deep skill in building and prompting agents. We'll teach the domain. Founded in 2016 by IIT/IIM alumni Ranvir Singh and Krishnan Vishwanathan, both former McKinsey consultants, Kissht was listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.Kissht serves 74.6 million registered users and 12.25 million customers, with assets under management (AUM) of approximately ₹8,000 crore. Its growth is powered by proprietary AI/ML-based underwriting, a robust in-house technology stack, and a pan-India collections network.Headquartered in Mumbai and backed by marquee investors, including the Brunei InvestmentAuthority, Vertex Growth Fund, and the Government of Singapore, Kissht is now scaling as a publiccompany and is looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent to join nits next phase of growth.

Are you curious, enthusiastic about infrastructure, and ready to solve complex challenges in the AI era? Join us as a **Cloud & AI Solution Engineer - Infrastructure** focused on the **Azure Platform** for **commercial customers** at Microsoft.

In this technical sales role, you will help customers design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures that support their modernization goals. Using Azure’s IaaS and PaaS services, you will guide organizations through migration, modernization, optimization, and innovation—translating technical capabilities into significant business outcomes.

You will collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions that enhance agility, reduce costs, and unlock value through AI-powered infrastructure.

As a Cloud & AI Digital Solution Engineer for the Azure Platform, you will play a key role in helping customers modernize their infrastructure and unlock the full value of Microsoft’s cloud. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient architectures that support AI workloads and business-critical applications.

You bring deep expertise in migrating core workloads—including Windows, SQL Server, Linux, PostgreSQL, and Oracle—to Azure. Beyond migration, you lead customers through modernization using the 6R strategy, containerization best practices, and Azure-native services like AKS and Arc, while exploring how AI and intelligent agents can accelerate legacy transformation.  
You also apply strong networking knowledge to design hybrid and cloud-native solutions, including virtual networks, VPNs, and secure routing architectures that meet enterprise performance and compliance needs. You complement this with trusted partner solutions like NetApp, VMware, RedHat, and SAP to ensure a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.

As you join the team, You will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise with access to a wide range of Microsoft learning resources—including support for earning industry-recognized certifications across Azure infrastructure, security, and AI.  
  
With a solid understanding of Azure security services and compliance frameworks you will help customers meet regulatory requirements and build Cloud environments that are ready for the future.

* Drive technical sales by using technical demos, proofs of concept, and technical architecture accelerators to influence solution design and enable deployments.
* Lead architecture sessions and technical workshops to accelerate Azure adoption.
* Build trusted relationships with platforms leads to co-design secure, scalable solutions.
* Resolve technical blockers by collaborating with engineering and sharing customer insights.
* Maintain expertise in cloud migration (Windows, SQL, Linux, PostgreSQL, app workloads), resiliency, security, and compliance.
* Deepen knowledge of enterprise apps (SAP, Oracle) and Azure VMware Solution (AVS).
* Represent Microsoft in customer forums and technical communities through thought leadership.

  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
  + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ year(s) technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
  + OR equivalent experience

* Strong understanding of Azure services, including security, compliance, and hybrid cloud scenarios.
* Ability to engage technical and business stakeholders to design and deploy scalable, secure cloud solutions.
