title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.

 **Job Description**

The **Lead AI Engagement Specialist** owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.

This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.

**Where this role sits**

**Reports to:** Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

**Alignment:** Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover

**Works with:** AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required

**Owns:** The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.

**Accountable for:** Realised, measured business value — not deployment count

**What you will own**

**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**

This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.

**Strongly preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What this role is not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What success looks like**

**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How we assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

 **Additional Information**  

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

**Strong Plus**
---------------

* Exadata-specific depth: IORM policy tuning, smart scan diagnostics, storage server failure recovery, and hardware lifecycle decision-making
* Kubernetes-native data platform experience with stateful workload operators (Strimzi, Cassandra Operator, OpenSearch Operator, Redis Operator)
* Experience with AIOps or observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) including custom exporter and agent development
* Familiarity with agentic integration patterns (MCP, tool-use APIs) for building AI-augmented operational toolchains
* Hands-on coding in Python, Go, or shell scripting — enough to design and ship internal tooling independently
* Background in security or compliance-adjacent industries where data integrity and auditability carry regulatory weight

**Who This Role Is For**
========================

This role is for a data platform leader who still gets pulled in by a gnarly execution plan, and who sees a recurring on-call alert as a signal that something needs to be built — then builds it. You lead by doing as much as by directing, and your team follows you because they know you have sat in their chair.

You hold Oracle's feet to the fire in a negotiation and hold your engineers to a high bar in a design review. You speak reliability to a DBA and business risk to a CFO. You don't wait to be handed a mandate — you see the gap, take the charter, and grow the team around it. You balance operating rigorously today with shaping the platform for where the business will be in three years.

If you are energized by owning something truly foundational — the data layer that everything else at Qualys depends on — and you want to build the next generation of AI-driven reliability engineering, we would like to hear from you.

**This Role Is Not For**
------------------------

* DBAs focused on ticket-based operations who are not comfortable driving architectural decisions and organizational change
* Leaders who are not hands-on in production systems — this role requires genuine technical engagement, not just team management
* Candidates whose AI experience is limited to tool adoption — we need operators who have shipped agents and measured the impact
* Candidates who need full-stack mastery on day one — we value depth in core areas and intellectual range over checklist coverage

**About Qualys**
================

Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based security, compliance, and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Description: Senior DevOps Engineer (Production Stability)

**Experience:** 9+ Years  
**Location:** Pune  
**Mandatory Skills:** AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, Ansible

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Senior DevOps Engineer (Production Stability)** to operate and stabilize a complex, business-critical DevOps environment supporting Unite Services and integrations across 24x7 systems.

The environment includes a combination of legacy and modern tooling, hybrid infrastructure (cloud and on-premises), and partially documented systems.

You will work as part of a contractor pod of 3–4 engineers, ensuring reliable production operations, stable CI/CD pipelines and deployments, and fast, effective incident response.

This is a hands-on role with approximately 90% individual contributor responsibilities and participation in an on-call rotation, primarily on weekdays.

Key Responsibilities1. Production Operations & Incident Response

* Support 24x7 production systems for Unite Services and integrations.
* Participate in the on-call rotation, primarily on weekdays.
* Troubleshoot incidents across CI/CD, Kubernetes, API Gateway, networking, and applications.
* Perform incident triage, mitigation, and recovery.
* Ensure safe deployments and reliable rollback capabilities.

2. CI/CD & Deployment Stability

* Operate and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and Octopus.
* Debug and resolve pipeline failures quickly.
* Support multi-environment deployments across DEV, QA, PROD, and special environments.
* Improve deployment reliability without disrupting delivery.

3. Kubernetes & Infrastructure Operations

* Support Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Perform troubleshooting, patching, and basic upgrades.
* Tune CPU and memory resources and investigate performance issues.
* Work with supporting services such as Redis, RabbitMQ, databases, and API gateways.
* Manage containerized environments using Docker.

4. API Gateway, Cloud & Legacy Systems

* Support AWS API Gateway and related infrastructure.
* Work with existing Terraform configurations and modules.
* Troubleshoot routing, domain, and traffic issues involving Cloudflare and Azure API Management (APIM).
* Support critical legacy systems, including Windows-based services such as Task Manager.
* Work across AWS and Azure cloud environments.

5. Observability & Technical Support

* Use monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and logging platforms to investigate issues.
* Improve alerts and dashboards where required.
* Collaborate with support teams on operational tasks and escalations.

6. Automation, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

* Use scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell to automate operational tasks.
* Document deployment, rollback, and recovery procedures.
* Contribute to runbooks for critical systems.
* Share knowledge with the team and contractor lead.

Required Skills & Experience

* 9+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or production infrastructure operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with **AWS and Azure cloud platforms**.
* Practical experience with Kubernetes operations and troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of Docker and containerized applications.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform, including working with existing configurations and modules.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting business-critical production systems and handling incidents under pressure.
* Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools, including Prometheus, Grafana, and logging systems.
* Experience working in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, APIs, infrastructure, and applications.
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.
* Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and take ownership of production stability.

Success Criteria: First 90 Days

* Independently support production systems and operational workflows.
* Stabilize CI/CD pipelines and make deployments more predictable.
* Handle incidents quickly and effectively.
* Document critical workflows and recovery procedures.
* Collaborate smoothly with the contractor lead and the engineering team.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Strong operational mindset with a focus on production stability.
* Comfortable working in complex, imperfect, and partially documented environments.
* Quick learner who can take ownership of systems and resolve issues independently.
* Calm and effective under pressure in incident-driven environments.
* Focused on reliability, service continuity, and practical improvements.

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

* Prefer greenfield development or highly standardized environments.
* Focus primarily on architecture rather than hands-on operations.
* Avoid production ownership or on-call responsibilities.
* Expect fully documented systems and processes from day one.

Pay: Up to ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**About Brikby**

﻿

Brikby is an AI company that makes instant property ownership verification a possibility. Brikby ingests property documents (any state, language, format and even hand written documents) and provides users with document scrutiny, title flow, missing documentation, red flags and provides BFSI customers with product (loan-type) specific insights. Further, it verifies documents provided by the customer against government records in real time.

Right now we’re working in the BFSI sector and have successfully reduced our customers’ property verification TAT from 4 days to under 30 minutes. Since January, we have processed over 15,000 loan logins. Our plan is to become the gold standard in BFSI and then provide property ownership verification for any use case (B2C, infrastructure, development, telecom, etc.) which requires it.

**What you will work on**

* Work directly with lenders and lawyers to find what slows them down, then design, test and validate the fix with them.
* Turn direct customer metrics into insights that shape what we build next.
* Architect and scale the document ingestion pipeline so every report gets faster and more reliable as volume grows.
* Find out why LLM output goes wrong, fix it at the root, and build evals that keep it fixed.
* Build out our multi agent system and the tools it uses across government sources.
* Ship features end to end in the web app, and run it on GCP with an eye on cost and latency.

**What we are looking for**

* 0 to 5 years of experience building and shipping software. Internships, freelance work and serious side projects all count.
* Strong TypeScript and Node.js, with working knowledge of React, SQL and a cloud platform (GCP preferred).
* Hands on experience with LLM APIs: tool calling, structured output and multi agent orchestration, using agent traces and evals to debug and measure them.
* Experience building backend systems that hold up in production: queues, retries, idempotency, and logs and traces to debug them.
* A habit of measuring: you instrument what you ship and let the data decide what to do next.
* Experience integrating with websites and APIs that were never built for you: sessions, form posts, HTML parsing and rate limits.

**Nice to have**

* Durable workflows and reliable delivery: idempotency keys, the outbox pattern, signed webhooks
* PDF and image processing: OCR and scanned documents
* Reads Hindi, Kannada, Telugu or Tamil
* Exposure to fintech, lending or legal work
* Happy to work from our Gurugram office 5 days a week

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform**

**About this role**

The Senior Software Engineer, Backend and Platform will help build Prudential Japan's next

generation Product Engineering capabilities as part of the Japan Technology Transformation

initiative.

This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating digital products and platforms that

support customer journeys, sales journeys, policy administration experiences, and business

workflows across Prudential Japan's end-to-end journey of life insurance value streams.

As part of a newly established Product Engineering organization, this role offers the opportunity

not only to build products, but also to help establish engineering practices, standards, and ways

of working that will shape the future of technology delivery at Prudential Japan.

What you could work on

We allocate after offer, across multiple domains. Policy administration, where contract truth must

survive multiple years and a change to old insurance product must never silently break tens of

thousands of live contracts. Customer communications, where essential customer

communications reach every customer in one immovable window. CRM, where customer and

agent information and interactions are managed consistently across products and channels.

New business and policy issuance, where an application must move accurately from initial

submission through underwriting and approval to a legally effective insurance contract.

Integration, where the industry wide used services, banking and government systems meet our

systems. And the compliance records, which are essential to maintain as an insurer.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design, build and continuously improve backend services and data models for systems of

record, where a change can alter an obligation the company owes a customer rather than only

an applicationʼs behavior.

Create, maintain and enhance software capabilities and functionality across modern

technology stacks, integrations and the full software lifecycle.

Own integrations with external parties you do not control, including government and banking

systems, shared industry data services and print and delivery vendors.

Build and operate scheduled and batch processing that must finish inside a fixed window,

including month end and year end cycles.

Build and extend the audit and evidence layer: what was shown, agreed, triggered and paid,

retrievable for years.

Work closely with systems engineers, architects and business partners to ensure the quality

and reliability of the product, and to deliver on business objectives.

Work alongside long-lived legacy systems and decide, case by case, what to wrap, what to

replace and what to leave alone.

Engage with broader product considerations and planning across ideation, design,

development, testing, business engagement and team leadership.

Carry on-call for what you own, and run incident reviews that look for causes rather than for

someone to blame.

**Qualifications**

**General**

You do not need insurance experience. We will teach the domain.

Five or more years building and operating backend systems in production, including

ownership of something that mattered when it broke.

Strong data modelling, especially temporal and bitemporal data modelling.

Transactional integrity, idempotency and reconciliation as daily practice rather than interview

vocabulary.

Integrating with external organizations where the interface is theirs and will not change for

you.

Real-time as well as batch processing at scale, with a working understanding of time windows

and dependency chains.

Any high consequence or regulated domain is an advantage: payments, healthcare, logistics,

energy, safety-critical systems.

Degree in relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical**

We run on AWS. We are not dogmatic about languages or frameworks and we do not screen

on keyword matches: we care that you have gone deep in at least one stack and can pick up

another. Depth in one column beats a shallow tick in all of them.

AI assisted development: Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor. Knowing how to build Agent skills

is an advantage.

**Languages:** Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node.

Data: PostgreSQL or Aurora as the default. Experience with schema evolution on live data

matters more than any particular engine.

AWS Ecosystem

Integration: REST and event-driven patterns, plus the older shapes you will meet at the

boundary, including scheduled file exchange and message queues.

Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: Terraform or CDK or Ansible, with pipelines you have

owned rather than inherited.

Observability: Structured logging, metrics and tracing. CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry,

Dynatrace, or Datadog

Nice to have: Kafka or Kinesis, and any experience bridging a mainframe or vendor package

to modern services.

**Language**

English: Fluent to Native

Japanese: Working level. JLPT N2 or native is an advantage.

**Culture and Leadership Expectations**

* Act as One Prudential for customers by building integrated products across business

domains

* Drive Change by modernizing legacy systems and improving engineering practices
* Be Highly Accountable for code quality, delivery, reliability, and production outcomes
* Engage with Candor through open collaboration and constructive technical discussion
* Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and

Winning with Integrit

**Skills:** AWS , Java or Kotlin, Go, Python or TypeScript on Node , PostgreSQL or Aurora

title: Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

Working alongside product, data, and engineering teams, you will translate complex business problems into scalable, reliable AI-powered solutions.

* Fine-tune and optimize pre-trained large language models for domain-specific use cases.

* Implement CI/CD pipelines for model training, testing, and deployment using tools like MLflow, Weights & Biases, or Kubeflow.
* Monitor production model performance — tracking accuracy drift, data drift, latency, and system health with alerting pipelines.
* Optimize models for production: quantization, distillation, ONNX export, and hardware-specific inference tuning.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, and domain experts to define AI solution requirements and success metrics.
* Mentor junior engineers and data scientists; contribute to code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical documentation.
* Communicate complex AI concepts and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay current with latest AI/ML research; evaluate and advocate for relevant new tools, frameworks, and methodologies.

* Proficiency in Python.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Ability to work with large datasets and expertise in data preprocessing and collection techniques.
* Familiarity with language models and generative AI is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, and Transformer-based models.

* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases for data storage and retrieval.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for model deployment and scaling.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools — Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of REST API development and integrating ML models into production applications.
* Understanding of data versioning, feature stores, and pipeline automation best practices.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in ML/AI engineering roles, building and deploying production-grade models.
* Demonstrated ownership of the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, model development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Proven experience with NLP or Computer Vision solutions using modern architectures (BERT, GPT, YOLO, ResNet, etc.).
* Practical experience integrating and fine-tuning large language models for real-world applications.
* Experience deploying ML systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML).

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with meticulous attention to detail.

title: Full Stack Developer-MERN, Nest and NextJs
description:
**Job Overview**

Earthlix Commerce LLP is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to develop, maintain, and scale a robust e-commerce and procurement platform. The platform includes product and inventory management, advanced search capabilities, barcode generation, role-based access control, supplier management, supply-chain workflows, and Request for Quotation (RFQ) management.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, database optimization, search technologies, cloud deployment, and building secure, scalable applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Frontend Development**

* Develop responsive and high-performance web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build user-friendly interfaces for product catalogs, inventory, pricing, orders, customers, and procurement modules.
* Implement large data grids with server-side pagination, sorting, filtering, search, virtualization, and optimized rendering.

**2. Backend Development and API Integration**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Node.js, NestJS, and Express.js.
* Integrate payment gateways and shipping/logistics APIs, including webhooks, order tracking, refunds, cancellations, returns, and inventory synchronization.
* Implement pincode-based serviceability checks and Order Management System (OMS) workflows.
* Develop secure, reliable, and scalable backend architecture.

**3. Database Management and Search Optimization**

* Design and optimize PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, including schema design, data modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
* Implement Redis for caching, session management, rate limiting, and background job processing.
* Develop advanced search functionality using Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, including SKU search, fuzzy search, autocomplete, faceted filtering, catalog indexing, and relevance tuning.

**4. E-commerce and Procurement Workflows**

* Develop and maintain product catalog, pricing, inventory, order, and customer management modules.
* Implement procurement workflows covering purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval processes, and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs).
* Build supplier onboarding and management features, supply-chain tracking, inventory replenishment, and RFQ workflows.
* Implement quotation management, quotation comparisons, negotiation processes, and approval workflows.

**5. Barcode, QR Code and GST Invoicing**

* Develop server-side barcode and QR code generation for SKUs, product labels, shipping packages, and GST invoices.
* Generate barcode and QR code assets in SVG and PNG formats and manage secure storage using AWS S3.
* Implement GST invoicing for CGST, SGST, and IGST, including credit notes and digital tracking QR codes.

**6. Security and Access Control**

* Implement authentication, authorization, JWT-based security, session management, and secure password hashing.
* Develop role-based access control (RBAC), permission management, and audit logging.
* Follow OWASP security best practices and ensure appropriate data protection.

**7. Cloud Deployment and Maintenance**

* Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications on AWS.
* Work with services such as EC2, S3, Route 53, Application Load Balancer (ALB), Auto Scaling Groups, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and ACM.
* Support application scalability, performance optimization, and infrastructure security.
* Troubleshoot production issues and maintain technical documentation.

**8. Testing and Collaboration**

* Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest and Playwright.
* Use Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI for API testing and documentation.
* Work with Git, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3

**Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, REST API development

**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, database design, indexing, query optimization

**Caching and Search:** Redis, Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

**Cloud and Security:** AWS deployment, JWT authentication, API authorization, RBAC, OWASP best practices

**Development and Testing Tools:** Git, Docker, Linux, CI/CD, Jest, Playwright, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* 3–6 years of professional experience in full-stack development.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.
* Practical experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and AWS deployment.
* Good understanding of scalable application architecture, database optimization, API design, and application security.
* Experience developing and maintaining production-grade frontend and backend applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise applications or complex e-commerce platforms.
* Knowledge of inventory management, procurement, supplier management, supply-chain operations, and RFQ workflows.
* Experience with barcode and QR code generation and GST invoicing.
* Hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, including EC2, Route 53, S3, ALB, Auto Scaling Groups, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and ACM.
* Experience working with large SKU catalogs, high-volume data grids, and search optimization.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a technically strong and solution-oriented developer who can independently handle frontend and backend development, optimize application performance, and contribute to building a scalable e-commerce and procurement platform.

Candidates with practical production experience in complex business workflows, database optimization, search technologies, and AWS infrastructure will be preferred.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resume and details of their relevant full-stack development experience.**

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Technology Platform Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Technology Platform Engineer

Creates production and non-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Spring Boot
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Technology Platform Engineer, a typical day involves setting up and managing both production and non-production cloud environments tailored for various projects or products. This role includes deploying automation pipelines to streamline the creation and configuration of these environments, ensuring smooth and efficient operations. The position requires continuous monitoring and adjustment of platform components to support evolving project needs, collaborating with different teams to maintain a reliable and scalable infrastructure.

* Experience with cloud environment setup and management.
* Strong understanding of automation pipelines and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with configuration management and infrastructure as code principles.

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Spring Boot.
* This position is based at our CODC1A - SEZ office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: AI Engineer – On-Premises AI, LLM & Infrastructure
description: Job Description: AI Engineer – On-Premises AI, LLM & InfrastructureExperience: 1–5 YearsEmployment Type: Full-TimeJob OverviewWe are looking for an AI Engineer with hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing AI applications on on-premises infrastructure. The candidate should have knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intent parsing, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.The role involves working with locally hosted AI models and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S. The candidate will also be responsible for application containerization, Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, performance optimization, scalability, networking, security, and maintaining reliable on-premises AI environments.The ideal candidate should be capable of taking AI applications from development and experimentation through deployment, optimization, and production maintenance.Key Responsibilities1. LLM Deployment & On-Premises AI • Deploy, configure, and manage locally hosted LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, and other suitable open-weight models. • Work with inference frameworks such as Ollama, vLLM, and similar model-serving technologies. • Deploy AI workloads on NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, and compatible GPU infrastructure. • Optimize model inference, GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, response latency, and throughput. • Evaluate model performance, tool-calling capabilities, accuracy, and hardware requirements. • Implement quantization, batching, streaming inference, and other optimization techniques where appropriate. • Troubleshoot GPU drivers, CUDA compatibility, memory allocation, and model-serving issues. • Maintain local AI deployments with an emphasis on data governance, privacy, and reduced dependence on external AI services.2. RAG, Intent Parsing & AI Orchestration • Develop RAG pipelines for retrieving information from documents, databases, and enterprise data sources. • Implement document parsing, text extraction, OCR where required, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking. • Build intent-parsing and routing mechanisms to identify user requirements and determine the appropriate processing workflow. • Implement LLM-based tool calling and function calling to interact with APIs, databases, and third-party applications. • Develop multi-step orchestration workflows involving retrieval, tool selection, execution, and response generation. • Implement MCP servers and clients to connect AI models with compatible tools and data sources. • Design and maintain centralized tool registries with tool definitions, input schemas, execution handlers, and permissions. • Implement guardrails, validation, fallback mechanisms, error handling, and controlled tool execution. • Improve response accuracy, contextual relevance, source attribution, and reliability.3. Backend Development & Application Integration • Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI. • Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, document repositories, and third-party APIs. • Build reusable connectors for data retrieval and authorized application actions. • Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, session management, and streaming responses. • Develop modular services for model inference, orchestration, retrieval, and external integrations. • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and deployment scripts. • Collaborate with frontend and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end AI applications.4. Real-Time Voice AI & Conversational Systems • Develop AI-powered conversational applications supporting real-time voice interactions. • Integrate speech-to-text, LLM inference, text-to-speech, and optional avatar animation. • Work with technologies such as Faster-Whisper/Whisper, Kokoro TTS, MuseTalk, and NVIDIA Audio2Face. • Build low-latency audio-processing pipelines and streaming conversational workflows. • Implement conversation context management, interruption handling, session management, and error recovery. • Optimize audio processing, inference latency, GPU utilization, and concurrent session handling. • Integrate voice AI components with backend APIs and application interfaces.5. Microsoft Hyper-V & On-Premises Infrastructure • Provision, configure, and manage virtual machines using Microsoft Hyper-V. • Deploy and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments for AI applications and supporting services. • Configure virtual CPU, memory, storage, networking, and resource allocation. • Enable and troubleshoot GPU access for virtualized AI workloads using supported GPU-P or passthrough configurations, depending on hardware and operating-system compatibility. • Understand GPU virtualization requirements for NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S platforms. • Deploy AI inference services and supporting applications across virtual machines and physical servers. • Configure virtual switches, network segmentation, firewalls, DNS, and secure service communication. • Troubleshoot virtualization, GPU availability, driver compatibility, storage, and networking issues. • Maintain infrastructure documentation, backup procedures, and operational runbooks.6. Containerization & Deployment • Containerize AI models, backend services, RAG pipelines, MCP services, and voice-processing components using Docker. • Use Docker Compose or similar technologies to manage multi-service applications. • Configure GPU access for supported NVIDIA-enabled containers. • Manage environment variables, secrets, persistent storage, service dependencies, and deployment configurations. • Deploy applications across Hyper-V virtual machines and on-premises GPU servers. • Implement health checks, logging, monitoring, service recovery, and deployment automation. • Maintain reproducible and reliable deployment environments.7. Performance, Scalability & Reliability • Benchmark inference latency, time to first token, tokens per second, throughput, and concurrent user capacity. • Identify CPU, GPU, VRAM, storage, and networking bottlenecks. • Optimize resource allocation for multiple AI models, applications, and concurrent users. • Implement caching, asynchronous processing, queues, batching, and streaming where appropriate. • Design reliable services with timeouts, retries, fallback mechanisms, and graceful error handling. • Monitor GPU utilization, memory consumption, application health, and inference performance. • Ensure AI applications remain scalable, maintainable, and reliable as workloads increase.8. Security & Maintainability • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, and secure API integrations. • Configure TLS, reverse proxies, firewalls, and secure inter-service communication. • Apply appropriate access restrictions to tools, documents, databases, and connected applications. • Implement input validation, output validation, audit logging, and secrets management. • Ensure that RAG retrieval and tool execution respect user permissions and tenant boundaries. • Maintain clean, modular, testable code and well-documented infrastructure. • Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve system security and stability.Example Use CasesThe engineer may work on use cases such as:1. Real-Time AI CompanionDevelop an AI companion that interacts with users in live, one-on-one sessions and answers queries through natural conversations. This may involve locally hosted LLMs, Faster-Whisper for speech recognition, Kokoro for speech generation, and MuseTalk or NVIDIA Audio2Face for avatar animation. The focus is on low-latency interactions, conversational context, GPU optimization, and concurrent sessions.2. Multi-Source Enterprise ChatbotDevelop a chatbot that retrieves information from multiple authorized data sources and interacts with connected applications. This may involve Qwen 14B or Mistral models, document parsing, RAG, API integrations, databases, MCP, and a tool registry. The processing workflow may include intent routing, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, guardrails, and response generation.Required Technical Skills • Python programming and backend API development. • Experience with or understanding of LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, or Kimi. • Familiarity with Ollama, vLLM, or similar inference frameworks. • Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. • Understanding of intent parsing, tool calling, MCP, and AI orchestration. • Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment. • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V and virtual machine management. • Understanding of NVIDIA GPUs, GPU memory, inference performance, and model optimization. • Knowledge of networking, security, and application troubleshooting.Preferred Skills • Experience with NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, or comparable GPU infrastructure. • Knowledge of CUDA, NVIDIA drivers, and GPU monitoring. • Experience with GPU virtualization or passthrough in Hyper-V where supported. • Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux, and virtual networking. • Experience with Faster-Whisper, Kokoro, MuseTalk, NVIDIA Audio2Face, or related voice AI technologies. • Familiarity with MCP SDKs, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks. • Knowledge of OCR, reranking, hybrid retrieval, and document-processing pipelines. • Experience with reverse proxies, TLS, monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.Candidate Profile • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Hands-on approach to AI development, deployment, and troubleshooting. • Ability to work across LLMs, backend applications, and infrastructure. • Understanding of the trade-offs between model quality, latency, GPU requirements, and scalability. • Ability to develop maintainable and secure AI applications.Willingness to learn emerging LLM, agentic AI, voice AI, and GPU technologies.

title: Salesforce Technical Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

The
**Salesforce Technical Manager**
will bridge strategic solution design, enterprise delivery leadership, and hands-on technical management. This role serves as a key technical leader overseeing cross-functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, Data Cloud, and AI).

You will manage end-to-end technical execution, enforce strict technical governance, architect secure integrations with legacy/third-party systems, drive DevOps maturity, and directly mentor development teams to deliver zero-defect implementations aligned with client goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture, Multi-Cloud & Solution Design**

* Blueprint and architect robust, end-to-end multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, and Data Cloud) aligned with enterprise business requirements.
* Lead the technology selection, application design, configuration, and custom component design for high-performance platform execution.
* Evaluate AI-driven features (Data Cloud, Agentforce) and modern platform capabilities to design future-ready systems.

**2. Enterprise Integration & Data Management**

* Architect and oversee programmatic integration topologies connecting Salesforce to external platforms, legacy ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle), and third-party middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Boomi, CTI).
* Direct secure API orchestration, Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth, JWT, and large-scale data migrations.
* Oversee large data volume (LDV) strategies, sharing models, and privacy controls across multi-org environments.

**3. Technical Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Direct day-to-day technical team activities, supervising custom development in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Flow Orchestration.
* Run mandatory code review sessions, enforce bulkification and governor limit patterns, and eliminate platform bottlenecks.
* Mentor and coach technical team members through developer and architect certification pathways, fostering a high-quality delivery culture.

**4. DevOps, Quality & Technical Governance**

* Establish and drive CI/CD release and environment automation pipelines using tools such as Git, Jenkins, Copado, Flosum, or GitHub Actions.
* Participate in Architectural Review Boards (ARB) to critique, standardize, and approve solution designs.
* Enforce native platform security controls, environment segregation, and corporate IT compliance standards across all project tracks.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Advisory**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client leadership, security boards, and key business stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into strategic advice for non-technical business leaders.
* Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Project/Delivery Managers, and sales teams to validate SOWs and project delivery constraints.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Total Experience:**
  12+ years in technical software engineering and development, with a minimum of 8+ years focused explicitly on Salesforce platform development and architecture.

* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**The Role and Impact**  
As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing and optimizing logic designs for high-performance IP blocks that drive Intel's cutting-edge SoC solutions. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include writing register transfer level (RTL) code, conducting simulations, and ensuring designs meet stringent power, performance, area, and timing goals. You'll play a pivotal role in delivering quality IPs while collaborating across architecture, verification, and SoC integration teams to ensure seamless handoffs and impactful results.
  
  
**Business group**  
The Central Engineering Group (CEG) is Intel's leading innovation hub, focused on designing foundational technologies for integration across Intel's product portfolio. Within this team, the UIC Fabric Design organization specializes in developing reusable IP blocks and subsystems that enhance system-level capabilities. This group contributes to Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class solutions to revolutionize computing across industries.

* Design and develop RTL code for IP blocks, ensuring functionality, quality, and scalability.
* Optimize logic designs to meet power, performance, area, and timing objectives.
* Collaborate with architecture teams to define microarchitecture features of IP designs.
* Participate in verification plan reviews and implement corrective measures for failing RTL tests.

* Work with physical design teams to address timing and implementation challenges.
