title: Staff Technical Support Engineer
description:
### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you will be tasked with providing responsive, high-quality technical assistance to customers across our global customer base, investigating and resolving technical issues across Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud, networking, and security environments while communicating clearly with customers throughout the troubleshooting process. Technical Support sits on the front line of SentinelOne's commitment to customer outcomes, where every interaction is an opportunity to solve a customer problem, build confidence in SentinelOne, and create knowledge that makes the next customer experience even better. This role is about more than responding to tickets, as great Support Engineers combine technical curiosity, disciplined troubleshooting, customer empathy, strong documentation, and a desire to continuously increase what can be solved at the frontline.

### **What Will You Do?**

Primary responsibilities include:

* Provide customer support through phone, email, chat, and other Support channels, communicating clearly, proactively, and professionally throughout the customer experience.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across SentinelOne products and supported operating environments, gathering the technical information, logs, reproduction steps, and environmental context required to diagnose issues effectively.
* Perform performance tracing and system-level diagnostics, kernel debugging (Mac, Linux), and memory dump and crash analysis.
* Reproduce issues by building scripts, automation, and test environments.
* Own customer cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation, meeting established response and resolution service levels and documenting troubleshooting activity and customer interactions clearly and consistently.
* Apply existing knowledge, documentation, diagnostics, and tooling before escalating issues.
* Collaborate with senior Support engineers, escalation specialists, and more specialized technical teams on complex technical problems that require deeper investigation, and with Support, Product, Problem Management, and Principal Engineers on large-scale investigations.
* Identify recurring issues and repeatable solutions, and contribute knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, videos, and other reusable resources to the collective knowledge of the Support organization.
* Provide structured feedback when product usability or supportability improvements could reduce customer effort.
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies.

### **What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**

Ideal candidates will have:

* Strong customer orientation and desire to solve technical problems, with strong collaboration skills and a willingness to learn from others.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to systematically investigate technical issues and clearly document findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux, and an understanding of networking and basic security concepts.
* Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec VPNs, SSL/TLS, and Web proxy, and proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, MTR, and Curl.
* The ability to deliver timely, high-quality customer resolutions; maintain strong SLA performance and high customer satisfaction; demonstrate strong case ownership and communication; increase first-line resolution whenever technically appropriate; produce clear, complete, and technically accurate case documentation; reduce avoidable escalations; contribute reusable knowledge that improves Support at scale; and continuously expand technical proficiency.
* Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with endpoint security or enterprise security products, or troubleshooting endpoint or server environments, is highly desirable, as is familiarity with cloud platforms or SaaS technologies.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tools is highly desirable.
* Cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience is highly desirable.

### **Why SentinelOne?**

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

title: DATA ARCHITECT
description:
Lead the architecture, design and deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, ML and deep learning solutions end to end: data pipelines, retrieval, agent orchestration, model serving, evaluation and monitoring on AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI and Databricks.

**Roles & Responsibility:**
---------------------------

**Solution Architecture**
-------------------------

* Own and lead the enterprise AI reference architecture and end-to-end design for Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, covering data ingestion, retrieval, orchestration, model serving, security, and monitoring.
* Select the optimal models, platforms, and architectural patterns across AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Databricks, balancing accuracy, latency, scalability, cost, and compliance requirements.
* Develop architecture blueprints, reference designs, and technical decision records (TDRs).
* Lead architecture reviews and establish engineering, security, and coding standards for AI solution delivery.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**
------------------------------

* Design and implement multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, and Amazon Bedrock Agents.
* Build enterprise-grade RAG solutions leveraging chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search, semantic search, re-ranking, and vector databases.
* Implement prompt engineering, guardrails, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Establish LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt versioning, groundedness validation, tracing, monitoring, and cost optimization.

**Data Science, Machine Learning & Deep Learning**
--------------------------------------------------

* Develop machine learning and deep learning solutions for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, optimization, NLP, and predictive analytics.
* Build scalable data and feature engineering pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow.
* Deploy AI models and intelligent agents as scalable APIs using FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Must Have**

* 7+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering, including 3+ years architecting production GenAI/LLM solutions.
* Proven experience designing and deploying Agentic AI or Multi-Agent systems.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Databricks.
* Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and PySpark with solid ML and statistical fundamentals.
* Experience deploying AI solutions using FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience with LLM fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT) and evaluation frameworks.
* Exposure to Knowledge Graphs, Document AI, OCR, or Computer Vision.
* Experience with engineering data domains (BOM, PDM, SAP) or financial risk modeling (Credit Risk, IFRS 9).
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Machine Learning, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Databricks Generative AI Engineer.

**Competencies**
----------------

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

**ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY**

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

title: AI Engineer
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time AI Engineer in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your AI and data science expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, collaborative, and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a crucial role in defining, developing, managing, and sustaining AI models to meet project and customer needs. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as software development, data engineering, and project management), collaborate with domain experts to understand requirements and data characteristics, and research new methods to enhance the robustness and trustworthiness of AI/ML algorithms, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of designing, building, and maintaining AI/ML models, but also supporting the industrialization of AI solutions and contributing to the AI community through publications and projects.

We’ll look to you for:

* Collecting, transforming, and exploring data from diverse sources to prepare it for model construction
* Identifying biases or flaws in datasets and ensuring training/validation design aligns with operational needs
* Collaborating with domain experts to understand product specifics and data characteristics
* Designing and implementing AI/ML models to automate and enhance operational efficiency
* Researching new methods to improve AI robustness, explainability, and trustworthiness
* Showcasing AI capabilities through prototypes, presentations, dashboards, and technical reports
* Collaborating with external partners to evaluate new mathematical approaches and AI technologies
* Supporting software development teams in industrializing AI solutions
* Planning and executing AI training sessions
* Participating in conferences and contributing to the AI community
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, or engineering supplemented by extensive training in Data Science and AI (minimum 8 years of experience)
* Excellent knowledge of Python programming
* Knowledge of modern statistics, text mining, image processing, or natural language processing (NLP, NLI, NLU)
* Experience with Python data science tools (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, Keras, NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI)
* Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platform
* Strong knowledge of AI and machine learning algorithms (e.g., classification, regression, dimensionality reduction, Bayesian models, neural networks, deep learning)
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) such as BERT, GPT-4, Llama 2, and Mistral
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and tools
* Knowledge of Generative AI frameworks (e.g., HuggingFace, LlamaIndex)
* Experience developing AI-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications
* Experience with cloud services (e.g., PaaS, SaaS, REST APIs, serverless functions)
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Flexibility to work successfully with both local and international teams
* Fluent in English
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous routines
* Work with cutting-edge AI and data technologies
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of smarter mobility
* Utilize our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning opportunities
* Progress towards senior roles in AI and data science
* Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

description:
**India T Special Bonus:**

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a TechOps Engineer to join our team in Bangalore of NTTDATA PAN India Offices, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
TechOps Engineer – Digital Science and Automated Solutions (DSAS)
  
  
Working Hours - We need resources who can work to support US hours, IST hours will be 12:30 AM till 10:30 AM Monday to Friday
  
  
Digital Science and Automated Solutions (DSAS) delivers software that streamlines scientific and business processes, connects people, systems, processes, and data, and helps customers make informed decisions, advance research, and bring high-quality products to market faster.
  
  
DSAS works with organizations at different stages of digital transformation, helping them adopt digital technologies and advance Industry and Pharma 4.0 strategies. In collaboration with teams across , DSAS develops and commercializes software products and services that support complete scientific workflows.
  
  
The TechOps Engineer helps keep DSAS cloud-hosted products and customer environments secure, reliable, cost-effective, and compliant. This role designs and operates AWS infrastructure, automates operational work, supports incident response and service recovery, and maintains the controlled processes and records required in a quality-managed environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, deploy, maintain, and improve production infrastructure as code (IaC) in Amazon Web Services (AWS), with a focus on quality, performance, scalability, availability, and maintainability.
* Operate and support containerized environments, including Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, and Kubernetes.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure, operating systems (Windows, Linux, and Unix), databases, networks, and cloud-hosted applications; investigate issues and help restore service.
* Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, problem investigation, and service recovery. Document findings, corrective actions, and follow-up work as required.
* Develop, automate, implement, and test secure deployment practices, backup and recovery processes, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Protect data at rest and in transit through appropriate encryption, access controls, network segmentation, and perimeter security.
* Implement and maintain security controls for infrastructure, networks, and applications, including logging, auditing, vulnerability assessment, and validation.
* Use approved security testing and vulnerability assessment tools to identify and help remediate weaknesses. Work with Corporate Information Security (CIS) and other teams to implement corporate security requirements.
* Follow applicable Quality Management System (QMS) procedures and controlled processes when making changes to production and customer environments. Maintain traceable change records, required evidence, and documentation to support validation, audits, and inspections.
* Support QMS activities such as change control, risk assessment, deviation investigation, corrective and preventive actions, and periodic reviews, as applicable to the assigned systems and procedures.
* Apply FinOps practices to AWS environments. Monitor usage and cost trends, improve resource tagging and cost visibility, identify waste, and recommend or implement rightsizing, scheduling, storage, and other cost-saving measures while preserving reliability, security, and quality requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks and carry improvements through implementation, testing, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Plan and perform scheduled maintenance, infrastructure changes, and product upgrades for cloud services.
* Maintain operational processes, runbooks, system records, and customer environment documentation. Contribute to infrastructure documentation and the knowledge base.
* Troubleshoot and support VPNs and network connectivity; contribute to network design and reliability.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Quality, Security, and other partners to support customer needs and improve service reliability and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Three to five years of relevant experience in cloud operations, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or a related technical role.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code.
* Experience supporting Linux and/or Windows systems, production applications, and cloud networking.
* Working knowledge of containers and orchestration technologies such as EKS, ECS, or Kubernetes.
* Experience with monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, security controls, and backup or disaster recovery practices.
* Ability to work within documented procedures and maintain accurate, traceable operational records in a quality-managed environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical procedures and work effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience supporting cloud-hosted software products or customer environments in a regulated or quality-managed industry.
* Familiarity with QMS practices, change control, audit readiness, validation evidence, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Experience with AWS cost management, FinOps practices, or cloud optimization.
* Experience with automation and scripting, CI/CD pipelines, vulnerability management, or network security.

title: MI/Reporting Engineer
description:
**Role Overview:**

The **MI / Reporting Engineer - Billing Transformation** will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust Management Information (MI), operational reporting, and analytics solutions that support the organization's Billing Transformation programme. This role requires expertise in data integration, reporting technologies, billing processes, and data modelling to deliver accurate, timely, and trusted insights across the Order-to-Cash lifecycle!

The successful candidate will work closely with Billing Operations, Finance, Commercial, Product, and Technology teams to enable effective decision-making through high-quality reporting and analytics solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Management Information & Reporting**

Design and develop reporting solutions that provide visibility into key Billing Transformation initiatives and operational performance.

Build and maintain reports and dashboards covering:

* Billing and invoicing operations
* Revenue and billing accuracy
* Customer billing lifecycle
* Billing exceptions and disputes
* Collections and receivables performance
* Service and product billing trends
* Transformation programme progress and KPI tracking

Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into scalable reporting solutions.

Develop executive and operational dashboards that provide actionable insights and support strategic decision-making.

Publish and manage governed datasets that enable self-service analytics across Finance and Billing Operations teams.

  

**Data Modelling & Analytics**

Develop and maintain reporting sematic data models using **dimensional modelling** and **star schema** methodologies working closely with ETL team.

Design reporting structures that support:

* Customer reporting
* Product and service hierarchies
* Invoice and billing transaction analysis
* Revenue and collections reporting
* Operational billing performance metrics

Optimise data models and reporting datasets for scalability, performance, and usability.

Work with Data Architects to ensure alignment with enterprise data standards and architecture principles.

  

**Business Intelligence & Visualisation**

Develop and maintain reporting solutions.

Create interactive dashboards and scorecards that provide visibility into:

* Billing accuracy
* Invoice processing performance
* Revenue trends
* Billing exceptions and disputes
* Collections effectiveness
* Customer billing behaviour

Ensure reporting solutions meet performance, usability, and accessibility requirements.

  

**Governance & Controls**

Apply data governance standards across all reporting assets.

Maintain metadata, documentation, and data lineage for reporting solutions.

Implement controls that support Revenue Assurance, Financial Control, and audit requirements.

Ensure compliance with security policies, regulatory obligations, and enterprise standards.

Perform reconciliation and validation processes to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience in **Management Information (MI), Reporting, and Business Intelligence** delivery.
* Experience supporting **Billing, Revenue Management, Order-to-Cash (O2C), Invoicing, or Finance Transformation** processes.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake** and cloud-based data warehousing solutions.
* Expertise in Reporting tools like Power BI dashboard and reporting development.
* Strong SQL development and query optimisation skills.
* Solid understanding of **billing processes** , invoice generation, receivables, collections, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on large-scale **Billing Transformation** , **ERP Transformation** , or **Finance Modernisation** programmes.
* Knowledge of billing platforms such as **Salesforce Billing** , **SAP BRIM** , **Oracle Billing** , **Zuora** , or similar solutions.
* Understanding of Revenue Recognition and Order-to-Cash business processes.
* Experience in financial, risk, information services, technology, or subscription-based business environments.
* Familiarity with data cataloguing and governance tools such as **Collibra** , **Alation** , or **Microsoft Purview** .

* Dedicated Employee Assistance and Wellbeing support.

**Innovative Mindset:** A passion for staying current with emerging technology trends, including AI-driven generative design, design for additive manufacturing, AR collaboration, and IoT-driven design.
  
•
  
**Strategic Contribution:** The ability to help shape the future of engineering design by experimenting with new technologies and contributing to the strategic roadmap.
  
•
  
**Exceptional Communication:** Superb written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and effectively.

Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

  

**Job Description**: Firewall Specialist (Fortinet / Check Point / Ubika WAF) – L2 Engineer

**Experience**: 3-5 Years

**Location**: Mumbai / Bengaluru

**Mandatory Skills**: (Any one from below Firewalls and Cloud WAF product) Fortinet Firewalls Checkpoint Firewalls Ubika WAF

  

**Role Summary**:

The Firewall Specialist is responsible for the administration, operation, troubleshooting, and optimization of enterprise network security infrastructure comprising Fortinet Firewalls, Check Point Firewalls, and Ubika Web Application Firewall (WAF).

The engineer will provide Level-2 support for security incidents, firewall policy changes, VPN management, WAF rule tuning, and problem resolution while ensuring compliance with security standards and service level agreements.

The role requires strong expertise in firewall security technologies, threat prevention, access controls, VPN technologies, and web application security.

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Firewall Operations & Administration: Manage and maintain Fortinet FortiGate and Check Point firewall environments. Implement, modify, and optimize firewall security policies, NAT rules, routing policies, and object groups.

* Perform rule reviews, policy recertification, and firewall cleanup activities.

* Manage firewall high-availability clusters and security gateways.

* Support Internet, Extranet, and DMZ security architectures.

* Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

* Validate firewall configurations against security baselines and best practices. Incident & Problem Management: Provide L2 support for firewall and network security incidents.

* Investigate connectivity, routing, VPN, and security policy issues.

* Analyze firewall logs and security events for root cause determination.

* Coordinate with L3 engineers, vendors, and infrastructure teams during major incidents.

* Participate in post-incident reviews and recommend corrective actions.

  

**Ubika WAF Administration**:

* Manage Ubika WAF policies and application protection configurations.

* Implement and tune WAF security rules to minimize false positives.

* Monitor and investigate WAF-generated alerts and attacks.

* Support secure publication of web applications.

* Configure URL filtering, access control, bot protection, and application security policies.

* Conduct WAF policy reviews and security assessments.

  

**Security Monitoring & Compliance:**

* Review security events generated by firewalls and WAF platforms.

* Support audit and compliance requirements.

* Generate operational and compliance reports.

* Assist in vulnerability management and remediation activities.

* Ensure adherence to organizational security standards and change management processes.

  

**Change & Release Management**:

* Execute firewall and WAF changes through approved change management processes.

* Prepare implementation, rollback, and validation plans.

* Participate in CAB discussions when required.

* Validate successful completion of security changes.

  

**Documentation & Governance**:

* Maintain network security diagrams, policies, and operational runbooks.

* Document troubleshooting procedures and known error records.

* Create knowledge articles and operational handover documents.

Provide technical support during audits and governance reviews.

title: Android SE 2 - Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Location**
- Pune

**Software Engineer 2 –**
Android Full Stack Engineer

**About the company**

Helpshift - A Keywords Studio, bridges the disconnect between conventional customer service channels — such as email and phone support — and a growing consumer base that does more on mobile phones and has a strong preference for messaging as the primary mode of communication. Through Helpshift’s AI-powered customer service platform, companies can resolve issues more efficiently, boosting customer satisfaction in the process. Companies such as Supercell, Scopely, Rovio, and hundreds of other leading brands use the Helpshift platform to provide messaging-first customer support. Helpshift is installed on two billion devices worldwide and serves more than 820 million active consumers. We are looking for an ambitious, experienced, driven & solution orientated individual that thrives in a fast-paced, cutting-edge, technology-driven environment. You will be an integral part of our custom development and professional services team and collaborating with multiple teams to deliver solutions to our clients.

Keywords Studios continues to build world leading capabilities in services that video game and similar interactive content creators need. We stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients working as their external partner, providing access to our teams of experts where and when needed.

People that work at Keywords are passionate, talented, committed, and resourceful. Human talent is our most valuable resource and as a business, we thrive on diversity, celebrate uniqueness and work as teams whether we are physically together in one of our 70+ studios around the world or working together virtually.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Software Engineer 2 who combines strong Android development expertise with solid experience in either backend or frontend systems. You will own end-to-end features that span mobile clients and the supporting web or service layer, working closely with Product Managers to turn high-level requirements into production-ready solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional experience in Android development and/or backend/frontend engineering
* Hands-on experience shipping production Android applications
* Solid understanding of modern Android architecture and tooling
* Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale systems or high-traffic dashboards.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Android**

* Strong command of Java, MVVM architecture and clean code practices.
* Deep familiarity with Activities, Fragments, and WebViews
* Production experience with network layers (Retrofit/OkHttp or equivalent), WebSockets, and efficient data handling.
* Deep expertise in FCM Push Notifications and other optimal data fetching mechanisms.
* Proficiency with the Gradle build system, dependency management, and multi-module projects
* Experience shipping apps to production (Play Store or enterprise distribution)
* Proficiency in using AI tools for accelerated development workflows.
* Hybrid app development experience with platforms like ReactNative/Unity/Cocos2dx etc.

**Backend or Frontend (one track required)**

* Backend track: Experience designing and operating large-scale systems, API design, data modeling, and cloud deployment (preferably AWS)
* Frontend track: Experience building high-traffic dashboards or web applications using React (or similar), modern JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, and deployment platforms such as Vercel
* Comfort working across the stack when needed (e.g., integrating Android clients with backend services or embedding web content)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Product Managers to gather, clarify, and refine requirements, then break them into well-scoped features and technical tasks
* Design, implement, and maintain Android features while ensuring clean architecture, testability, and performance
* Contribute to backend services or frontend dashboards that support the mobile product (depending on your primary secondary skill)
* Own existing features end-to-end: monitoring, debugging, optimization, and iterative improvements
* Write high-quality, maintainable code with appropriate unit, integration, and UI tests
* Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical design documents
* Collaborate with designers, QA, and other engineers to deliver polished, reliable experiences
* Identify technical debt and propose pragmatic improvements that balance velocity and long-term health
* Mentor more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing
* Contribute to team processes around CI/CD, release management, and observability

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, or modern Android UI frameworks
* Familiarity with real-time systems (WebSockets, push notifications, background work)
* Exposure to infrastructure-as-code, monitoring/observability tools, or performance optimization at scale
* Prior experience in a product-driven, cross-functional team environment

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months you will have independently delivered meaningful features across Android and the supporting backend/frontend layer, improved the reliability or performance of existing systems, and become a trusted technical partner to Product and Engineering leadership.

* Experience mentoring developers and contributing to technical standards and development best practices.
* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment practices, and Agile delivery models.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) - Autofill Coverage
description: Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that “we are all in this together” – we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on Bitwarden’s Autofill Coverage team, you will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuously checks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill’s performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammatesand in close partnership with the wider Autofill team.WHAT YOU WILL DOUI Automation: Build and maintain browser automation that checks autofill across popular real-world websites and purpose-built test pages. Keep suites stable as sites change, with reliable locators, sensible waits, and flakiness fixed at its root.Performance Testing: Run, extend, and maintain lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory in the browser. Set up runs, review results, and investigate numbers that look wrong.Trustworthy Results: Make sure test and benchmark results can be relied on. Confirm that two runs did the same work before comparing them, and flag misleading metrics before anyone acts on them.Test Scenarios: Build and maintain test pages that recreate tricky real-world patterns, such as dynamic forms, shadow DOM, and iframes, so they can be tested repeatably.Failure Triage: Reproduce autofill failures found by automation, support, or internal reports. Document them clearly, hand dataset fixes to teammates, and route the rest to the right owner.Reporting and Observability: Publish results to dashboards, set up alerting on regressions, and report coverage and trends on a regular cadence.AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Help keep test documentation and Claude skills current as new autofill code lands.Learning and Collaboration: Pair with senior engineers on hard problems, share what you learn, and review teammates’ pull requests with care.Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Software Engineer teammates, the Autofill team, Product, and Security on triage, test strategy, and release coordination.WHAT YOU BRINGOverall Experience: 4–8 years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering roles, with hands-on UI automation of web applications and exposure to front-end performance testing.Technical Stack: We value strong automation fundamentals and a performance mindset over an exact tool match. Experience with load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6 is welcome, but this role centres on performance inside the browser.Expertise- UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium/WebDriver, or Puppeteer, including stable locators, waits, and handling flaky tests JavaScript or TypeScript, and Node.js HTML, the DOM, and CSS selectors Front-end performance testing with the Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or Core Web Vitals toolingExperience- CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar, and running tests in Docker. Interpreting performance results: percentiles, variance, and comparing runs fairly Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, or similar. Data or API validation with JSON Schema, Postman, or similar AI-assisted development, preferably Claude CodeFamiliarity- Chrome DevTools Protocol and browser Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) Browser extensions and how they are tested (Manifest V3) Shell scriptingEngineering Mindset: Curious about why a test failed, not just that it failed. You treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than rerun until green, and you pick up new tools quickly.Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.Secure Coding: Familiarity with secure coding practices and care in handling test credentials and sensitive data, with an interest in how security shapes product decisions in a zero-knowledge product.Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.Why Join UsThis is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world.If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.Equal Opportunity EmployerWe are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description:

Outscale Partners is a fully owned subsidiary of The Argenbright Group and was established in 2022. The group brings more than 45 years of experience in transforming labour-intensive, essential frontline services across industries. Reporting to the
**Senior AI Consultant**
, the AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and operate AI systems across Unifi Service’s enterprise platforms.
  
  
The role spans the entire AI lifecycle — use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.
* Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.
* Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.
* Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
* Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.

**Must-Have (Non-Negotiable) Skills & Experience**

* 7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.
* Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.
* Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).
* Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.
* Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.
* Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.
* Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.
* Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of LLMOps & MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.
* Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.
* Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc

**Language & Documentation Expectations**

* All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.
* AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.
* Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.

**What We Offer**

* High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.
* Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.
* Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

Must have skills
  
  

* RAG pipelines
* LLM orchestration frameworks
* vector databases
* Python
* prompt engineering

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each oneAI and ML Applied to EvaluationApplies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools changeBuilds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose-built analysisExternal RepresentationPresents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research communityTeam building and enablementFosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organizationWillingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding teamOvertime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvementDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.RequirementsEssentials:Relevant professional background: 7-9 years of experience in M&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international developmentRigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research labApplied AI and ML fluency: is already using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work todayCost-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non-technical decision-makerAnalytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified briefProgram collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; can understand how program needs and constraints differ from research needs, and adjusts the evidence agenda accordinglyClear communication: shows clarity of thought, writes compellingly, and translates technical information into common language for varied audiencesExternal credibility: can present to funders, government counterparts, and technical peers and hold up under questioningExperience navigating Indian government data systems and state-level reporting requirementsComfort with ambiguity: a track record of doing well in early-stage, resource-constrained environments where the path is not defined and you build it as you goInitiative and bias to action: takes ownership of unassigned problems and moves without being askedWhat Success Looks LikeIn the First 6 Months:You have a working measurement approach with key indicators for the agriculture program, agreed with the Program Director, that specifies what evidence would change the program's directionYou have built or adapted a cost-effectiveness model for at least one priority intervention, and leadership understands and trusts its assumptionsYou have mapped the available data landscape in India, including what government and partner systems can and cannot tell usCompensation : Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.BenefitsEAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisionsLife and Accidental insurancePF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirementsGenerous leaveMental and physical wellbeing benefitsLearning & Development benefitsAvenues for engagement and recognitionNote: This role will be open for applications until October 30,2026 . Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a talented Film Editor to join our creative team, focusing on AI-generated films, web series, microdramas, and other fiction-based content. In this role, you will transform AI-generated visuals and scenes into cohesive, cinematic narratives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of film editing, storytelling, character progression, and visual continuity, while also navigating the unique challenges presented by AI-generated footage.

title: System Administrator II

title: L1 IT Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including University of Melbourne, University of New South Wales, Adelaide University, University of Sydney, Harvard University, Yale University, and Stanford University. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced L1 IT Specialist to provide responsive, hands-on technical support to JoVE employees across a distributed work environment. This role is focused on end-user and deskside support, including troubleshooting laptops, desktops, peripherals, software, user accounts, connectivity, and collaboration tools. The L1 IT Specialist will own routine support requests through resolution, document work clearly, and escalate more complex issues when appropriate. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service, practical troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 technical support to employees through the ticketing system, remote support channels, and hands-on/deskside support when applicable.
* Troubleshoot and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, peripheral, printing, audio/video, and connectivity issues.
* Set up, configure, deploy, replace, and maintain laptops, desktops, monitors, mobile devices, printers, and other end-user equipment.
* Support Windows and macOS environments, standard productivity applications, browsers, email, collaboration tools, and remote-access tools.
* Diagnose basic network and connectivity issues, including Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP, and escalate infrastructure issues when required.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, access changes, software installation, and equipment recovery.
* Perform routine user and access administration, including password resets, MFA enrollment, group membership, distribution lists, licenses, and approved permissions.
* Support and troubleshoot business phone/VoIP systems, including user provisioning, device/application setup, call-quality issues, and basic configuration for platforms such as GCF, RingCentral, 8x8, or similar solutions.

* Maintain accurate IT asset and inventory records, including device assignments, replacements, returns, repairs, and spare equipment.
* Follow IT security, access-control, data-protection, change-management, and support procedures; escalate suspected security issues promptly.
* Create and maintain support documentation, knowledge-base articles, setup instructions, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
* Coordinate hardware repairs, warranty/vendor support, and equipment replacements as needed; perform other IT support duties assigned by the Team Manager.

* 3+ years of demonstrable experience in IT help desk, desktop support, deskside support, or a similar end-user technical support role.

* Working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and macOS, with the ability to install, configure, update, and troubleshoot end-user devices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace applications and common collaboration tools.
* Ability to diagnose basic network and remote-access issues involving Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.
* Experience with employee onboarding/offboarding, device deployment, account administration, MFA, permissions, and software installation.
* Experience with ticketing/ITSM platforms such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Salesforce.
* Strong customer-service mindset with excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and troubleshooting steps clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation habits, prioritization skills, and ability to manage multiple support requests.
* Basic understanding of IT service-management concepts, SLAs, KPIs, escalation practices, and frameworks such as ITIL.
* Ability to work independently on routine incidents while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
* Computer Science, Information Technology, or related degree/diploma, or equivalent practical experience.

**Must Have Tools Qualifications at Admin (not user) level**

* Google Admin Console / Google Workspace administration
* Microsoft 365 Admin Center / Entra ID user and access administration
* Slack Admin Console

**Nice to have Tools Qualifications at Admin (not user) level**

* Endpoint/device management tools such as Microsoft Intune, MDM, RMM, SCCM, or equivalent
* Apple Business Manager (ABM) knowledge, including device enrollment and assignment workflows.
* Experience supporting and administering phone/VoIP systems such as GCF, RingCentral, 8x8, or similar platforms.
* Active Directory / Entra ID group, user, and permission administration
* Atlassian Admin Suite / Jira Service Management
* ChatGPT and Claude administration consoles
* Salesforce, AWS, and Zoom administration
* Remote support tools and basic PowerShell or other scripting/automation experience.

 **Benefits**  

* A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales

* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description:
**The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)**

**About Sezzle:**

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

**Compensation**:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is **$5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level** and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact **Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response**, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.

You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

**What You'll Do:**

* Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflows
* Design and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetry
* Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
* Investigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixes
* Run proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatable
* Operate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teams
* Triage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediation
* Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systems
* Apply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediation
* Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product
* Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response
* Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

**What We Look For:**

* **6+ years of experience** in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges
* Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response
* Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows
* Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification
* Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices
* Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data
* Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews
* Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)
* Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations
* Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

**Preferred Knowledge and Skills:**

* You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting
* Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases
* Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work
* Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security
* Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings
* Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations
* Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

**About You:**

* **You think like an investigator** - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.
* **You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable** - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.
* You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate
* You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way
* **You have relentlessly high standards** - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* **You're not bound by convention** - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* **You need action** - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* **You earn trust** - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* **You have backbone; disagree, then commit** - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* **You deliver results** - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

**Sezzle's Technology Stack:**

* **Languages:** Golang, Typescript, Python
* **Frontend:** Typescript - React and React Native
* **Backend:** Golang
* **Database:** MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
* **DevOps & Cloud:** AWS, Kubernetes
* **Version Control:** Git
* **CI/CD:** Gitlab
* **Testing:** Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
* **Open Source:** Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

**What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?**

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineering Architect to serve as a technology leader driving enterprise-scale AI strategy, architecture decisions, and innovation across global client engagements. This role is central to shaping how AI engineering capabilities are built, scaled, and adopted across application security and offensive security domains.
  
  
As a senior technologist, you will lead front-end client conversations, define enterprise-level AI architecture standards, and guide organizations in solving complex real-world problems using advanced AI capabilities. While primarily focused on architecture and technology leadership, you will remain hands-on when required to prototype solutions, validate emerging approaches, and solve complex technical challenges.

* Define and evolve enterprise-level AI reference architectures, frameworks, and engineering standards.

* Guide teams on advanced AI implementation approaches, including fine-tuning strategies, optimization techniques, and system-level design.
* Lead and mentor architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality AI solutions.
* Provide strategic oversight for complex programs, ensuring alignment with architectural vision and business objectives.
* Contribute to go-to-market initiatives, practice-level AI propositions, and thought leadership assets.
* Represent EY in client forums, innovation discussions, and external thought leadership engagements.

**Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred):**

* Enterprise-scale secure AI architecture strategy and DevSecOps integration for AI systems
* Convergence of AI with secure SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, API security, identity, and cloud-native security controls

**Offensive Security:**

* AI-driven threat modeling, adversarial evaluation strategies, and red teaming frameworks
* Convergence of AI with VAPT methodologies, attack simulations, and emerging AI threat landscapes

**Technical Skills and Expertise:**

* Strong proficiency in Python with ability to prototype complex AI solutions when required
* Deep expertise in AI/LLM tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, or similar
* Advanced knowledge of AI frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents
* Strong understanding of AI architecture patterns: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, and scalable pipelines
* Cloud platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP with architecture-level expertise
* AI platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
* Vector databases and retrieval systems: Pinecone, FAISS, Azure AI Search, Weaviate, or equivalents
* Observability, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI systems
* DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering practices

**Soft Skills and Attributes**
:
  
  

* Strong technology leadership and architectural vision
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business-aligned solutions
* Innovation mindset with passion for emerging technologies
* Ability to influence and drive change across teams and organizations

**Performance Expectations / KPIs:**

* Adoption of AI platforms, accelerators, and reusable assets
* Innovation output including POCs, labs, and thought leadership assets
* Contribution to practice growth and capability maturity
* Effectiveness in mentoring architects and engineering leaders

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
* 12+ years of experience in AI engineering, architecture, or advanced technology consulting
* Proven experience leading complex AI transformation and architecture initiatives
* Strong track record of driving innovation and technology adoption
* Relevant certifications (preferred):

+ Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect / AI Engineer
+ AWS Solutions Architect / Machine Learning Specialty
+ Certified Information Systems Security Professional

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

● Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

● Independently manage technical discussions, escalations, and decision-making

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Professional Experience

● 10+ years of professional software engineering and system development experience

● Proven experience as Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect

● Demonstrated experience owning complex, mission-critical enterprise applications or platforms

● Successfully taken projects from architecture and design through production deployment

● Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with varying levels of expertise

Technical Competencies

● Deep knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems

● Strong backend/server-side software engineering fundamentals

● Strong foundation in microservices architecture, APIs, databases, and data systems

Core Competencies & Attributes

● Exceptional problem-solving ability - can break down complex, ambiguous problems and derive practical solutions

● Strong architectural thinking - understands complete system requirements while maintaining implementation depth

● Complete ownership mindset - takes responsibility for technical outcomes without waiting for detailed instructions

● Client maturity and confidence - can effectively represent the organization before senior enterprise stakeholders
