title: Staff Engineer - Cross Border, Mercari India
description:
Introduction

About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

Bold Challenges

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**

Requirements

Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Mercari's JP marketplace domain and internal platforms.
* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

  
**Benefits**

Working Conditions

* **Employment Status:** Full-time
* **Office:** Bangalore
* **Hybrid workstyle**
* + We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.
  + To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase
  + We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs

Media

Owned Media

* Mercari Engineering Blog: Backend
* Mercan, introduces the people that make Mercari
* https://about.in.mercari.com/category/news/
* https://about.in.mercari.com/life/

Learn about XB and the Global App

* Building one global app platform (XB tech blog)

Related Articles

Senior Software Engineer 2 - (iOS, Swift)

Job Description

You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift — UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain iOS features in Swift using UIKit and SwiftUI, following MVVM and clean architecture principles
* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
* Write concurrent, responsive code using GCD, OperationQueue, async/await and Combine
* Own quality: unit tests with XCTest, profiling with Instruments, crash triage and fixes
* Handle code signing, provisioning, App Store Connect submissions and release management
* Review code, mentor SE1–SE3 engineers and raise the bar on iOS standards across the team
* Work with the client's product, backend and security teams; translate requirements into technical designs and estimates
* Contribute to presales solutioning (architecture inputs, effort estimates) when needed
* Be open to picking up React Native or Flutter work when project demand shifts

**Must-have skills:**

* 4+ years of hands-on iOS development with at least 2 apps shipped to the App Store.
* Swift & Xcode- Strong Swift (protocols, generics, optionals, value vs reference types), Xcode project structure, UIViewController lifecycle, working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code
* UI — UIKit- Storyboards, Auto Layout, UITableView, UICollectionView, custom views, navigation and modal flows
* UI — SwiftUI- Views, modifiers, stacks, NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, sheets and modals; can mix SwiftUI with UIKit
* Concurrency- GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Task, structured concurrency, thread-safety and main-thread discipline
* State & architecture- @State, @Binding, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject, MVVM, dependency injection (Needle, Swinject or similar)
* Reactive & networking- Combine (publishers, operators, cancellables), URLSession, Codable, SSL/certificate pinning, API error handling
* Persistence- UserDefaults, Core Data; exposure to Realm and SwiftData
* Quality & debugging- Xcode debugger, Instruments (Time Profiler, Leaks, Allocations), crash log symbolication, XCTest unit and UI tests

title: Sr. Associate Salesforce Engineer
description:
As a Salesforce Software Engineer within our global Commercialization Technology team, this role will help evolve portfolio governance operations capabilities. Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!
  
  
This position will involve hands-on development on the Salesforce platform, including declarative configuration, custom Salesforce development, integrations, APIs, and secure enterprise delivery. The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, architects, and agile teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions primarily using Salesforce, while also contributing to custom web and integration technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, and modern API frameworks when appropriate.

* Develop, enhance, and support Salesforce applications using established engineering standards and architectural guidance.

* Translate user stories, wireframes, and design specifications into high-quality, reusable Salesforce components and user experiences.
* Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise APIs, databases, data services, and other business applications.

* Develop and contribute to appropriate unit, integration, API, UI, accessibility, security, and data-validation testing as part of the software development lifecycle.

* Use source control, code reviews, CI/CD, Salesforce deployment tooling, monitoring, rollback, and incident-management practices to support reliable application delivery.
* Write clean, reusable, well-documented, secure, and testable Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript/TypeScript, and integration code.
* Participate in code and configuration reviews and incorporate feedback to improve quality, performance, accessibility, security, and maintainability.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production applications across Salesforce, APIs, data integrations, databases, cloud, and AI-enabled components; support defect resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, integration/API documentation, deployment procedures, configuration documentation, and runbooks.
* Contribute reusable Salesforce components, engineering standards, and continuous improvements that strengthen the broader Commercialization Technology ecosystem.
* Work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, UX/design teams, data engineers, QA engineers, and other technology teams.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

title: India First Engineer
description:
Supply & Friends is a New York City based AI company building modern, beautiful software for the fashion industry, the world’s largest creative industry and its most global. Our mission is to grow global GDP and connect the world's cultures.

India is one of the most ambitious and future-facing countries in the world, and is central to our mission. We are excited to bring on our First India Engineer in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai to help us build the next generation of AI-native product (and infra).

We are intentionally discreet about what we are building. You will learn more when we chat.

**Our core values**

* Unflinching Optimism. Let's make this world even better.
* Global DNA: Think, act, be global from day one.
* Respect the domain. Study it and learn from others to master it.
* 1st generation immigrant mindset. Work hard, don't take anything for granted.
* Honest trade & commerce. Act with integrity.
* Bring beauty into the world. Let our products reflect the beauty of the industry we serve.
* Arm the makers. Free them up with great technology to do what they do best: CREATE.
* Customers, customers, customers. Always start with the customer first.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Full-Stack + LLM Engineer in India who wants real ownership and intensity.

Not a narrow specialist.

Not a pure researcher.

Not a ticket-closer.

We want a hacker and builder. You will not be a small cog in a large machine. You will help define how this product evolves.

This is a fast-moving, high ownership role. You will be our 1st engineer in India and a foundational part of our long-term presence here.

We operate at very high intensity. 70+ hours and 6+ days per week is normal for us. This is not seasonal. This is how we build. If you are optimizing for balance first, this is not the right role for you.

**Role mission**

Design, build, and ship AI-native web experiences that combine world-class full-stack engineering with real-world LLM systems -- including reasoning models, decision models, and agentic pipelines -- helping us take an AI-native product used by global customers from early traction to real scale.

You will:

* Build beautiful, fast, production-grade frontend systems in React
* Architect and own backend systems: APIs, data models, and services
* Integrate and orchestrate LLM workflows -- including reasoning models, decision models, and multi-step agentic pipelines -- into product flows
* Own features end-to-end, from idea to shipped code
* Define how AI features are surfaced and integrated into core product workflows
* Continuously improve the quality, reliability, and UX of AI-powered features in production

**Role outcomes**

* Within the first two weeks:
* Understand customers, product, UX philosophy, tech stack & AI architecture
* Familiarize yourself with the codebase, internal tools, and services
* Ship meaningful code, including at least 1 feature
* Within 45 days:
* Own full features across frontend, backend, and LLM logic
* Improve UX polish and system responsiveness
* Propose improvements to AI workflows
* Within 90 days:
* Architect and ship major AI-powered product flows
* Take responsibility for performance, reliability, and LLM evaluation workflows
* Improve our team workflows to be more efficient and productive
* Within 6-12 months:
* Help build the India engineering core
* Raise the bar on full-stack craft and AI-native thinking
* Lead major product surfaces across web and mobile
* Travel occasionally to meet customers globally
* Always:
* Talk directly to users around the world
* Ship fast
* Iterate
* Maintain high standards for reliability and stability

**Our tech stack**

* AI: GPT, Gemini, Claude, GLM (Zhipu), Jev (TypeSafe), Cursor, evaluation pipelines
* Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind
* Backend: NodeJS, Express, Postgres, AWS, Modal, DeepInfra, Cloudfront
* ML / open source: SigLIP, OWL-ViT v2, DINOv2, pHash, dHash
* Analytics: Posthog, Sentry

**You:**

* Have 3 to 7 years of experience building real products end-to-end, across frontend and backend
* Are extremely strong in React and modern frontend frameworks
* Have solid backend experience: API design, data modeling, and building reliable services
* Have built and shipped things outside of your job simply because you were curious, and can show us what you made
* Think like a product owner, not just an implementer, and care about the customer and business
* Care deeply about UX, speed, and polish
* Have built real LLM-powered features in production -- not just demos -- using reasoning models, decision models, agentic pipelines, structured outputs, and evaluation frameworks
* Understand prompt engineering, context management, and failure handling at scale
* Have worked with or have a point of view on decision models like Jev and how they differ from traditional generative LLMs
* Want your code to have impact and you're a self-motivated super hard worker
* Are excited to work fully remotely (and occasionally in person)
* Live in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai and are excited to be based there long-term

*Bonus points if you:*

* Have worked at a high-grade startup or product company (Swiggy, Zepto, Razorpay, Meesho, CRED, Groww, or similar)
* Have prior experience in B2B SaaS, fashion tech, or e-commerce
* Have an eye for design and/or a sense of craftsmanship
* Are a curious world citizen with empathy for other cultures and/or speak 2+ languages
* Have built personal AI tools, bots, SaaS, or internal productivity systems
* Have contributed to open source

**What's in this for you**

* High ownership from day one
* Direct exposure to global customers
* Travel opportunities
* Salary competitive for the India market, with equity upside (stock options).
* The opportunity to become a foundational engineering leader in India

**How to apply**

We are intentionally selective and use a rigorous process.

If this excites you, please get started by applying on LinkedIn. We review every application.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer ( PHP -Laravel )
description:
**Senior Full Stack Developer — B2B Pipeline**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to take technical ownership of key capabilities within our B2B SaaS platform and partner pipeline.

This is a hands-on engineering role for an experienced developer who has previously built or supported B2B SaaS capabilities such as enterprise authentication/SSO, third-party API integrations, payment workflows, multi-tenant applications, partner administration, and customer-facing analytics.

The developer will work primarily within a Laravel/PHP-based platform supporting multiple partner types, from smaller co-branded organizations to larger enterprise customers requiring deeper integrations and configurable workflows.

The ideal candidate can independently take a business requirement from discovery through technical design, development, testing, and production deployment. We are specifically looking for someone whose prior experience aligns with the capabilities on our B2B roadmap—not simply a generalist full stack developer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and deliver B2B features and modules from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* Design and develop scalable, secure backend services and application functionality using Laravel and PHP.
* Design and maintain multi-tenant SaaS architecture supporting multiple business partners while maintaining appropriate separation of partner configuration and data.
* Build and enhance enterprise authentication and Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations for external partner organizations.
* Design and implement API integration frameworks that allow partner applications and portals to securely interact with the platform.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, webhooks, application routing, and other integration mechanisms for real-time and asynchronous communication with external systems.
* Implement and maintain payment integrations and B2B payment workflows, including payment processors, invoicing, configurable partner payment options, and business-sponsored payment models.
* Build administrative functionality that allows partner-specific settings and configurations to be managed without requiring custom development for each customer.
* Develop B2B dashboards and reporting capabilities, including metrics related to utilization, conversions, transaction/visit volume, and revenue.
* Implement appropriate authorization and data-access controls to ensure users and partner organizations can access only the information appropriate to their roles.
* Support configurable partner experiences, including partner-specific branding, content, legal documentation, workflows, and integrations.
* Establish and maintain regression coverage for existing B2B functionality to protect platform stability as new partner capabilities are introduced.
* Troubleshoot complex application and integration issues across the full technology stack.
* Participate in technical design decisions and identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off partner customizations.
* Communicate directly with product, business, and client-facing stakeholders to translate partner requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Provide technical estimates, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate implementation tradeoffs before development begins.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-documented code and participate in peer code reviews.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4+ years of professional full stack development experience, including ownership of production application features or modules.
* Strong hands-on experience with Laravel and PHP in production environments.
* Demonstrated experience building or maintaining B2B SaaS or multi-tenant applications serving multiple organizations or customers.
* Prior experience implementing or integrating Single Sign-On (SSO), federated authentication, or enterprise identity solutions for external customers or partner organizations.
* Strong experience designing, building, and consuming APIs and third-party integrations.
* Experience implementing webhooks and event-driven integrations with external platforms.
* Experience integrating payment processors or payment gateways into production applications and supporting non-trivial payment or billing workflows.
* Experience designing role-based authorization and data-access controls, particularly where information must be segmented by organization, customer, or user role.
* Strong understanding of application routing, authentication, authorization, API security, and secure web application development.
* Experience developing within a multi-tenant architecture, including tenant-aware data access, configuration, and application behavior.
* Full stack development capability, including JavaScript and modern front-end technologies sufficient to independently deliver customer- and administrator-facing functionality.
* Experience working with relational databases and designing data models supporting complex application workflows.
* Experience with automated testing and regression testing of production applications.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own features from requirements through production deployment.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across application, integration, database, and external-service boundaries.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to work directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise identity standards and technologies such as SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
* Experience integrating Stripe or comparable payment platforms into SaaS applications.
* Experience supporting multiple payment models, such as direct consumer payments, business-sponsored transactions, invoicing, or partner-managed payment gateways.
* Experience building partner/customer administration portals that allow organizations to manage their own configuration.
* Experience developing customer-facing analytics dashboards, including conversion, utilization, transaction, or revenue metrics.
* Experience developing configurable or dynamically generated partner-specific content, branding, legal documents, or workflows.
* Experience designing reusable integration frameworks that support multiple external partners without requiring separate custom implementations for each partner.
* Experience working in environments handling sensitive or regulated data, with an understanding of data segregation, least-privilege access, and secure application design.
* Experience with healthcare, telehealth, or other regulated SaaS environments is beneficial but not required.
* Experience working directly with B2B customers, implementation teams, product teams, or business stakeholders during technical discovery and integration planning.

**Technical Competencies**

The strongest candidates will demonstrate practical experience across several of the following areas:

**B2B SaaS & Multi-Tenancy**

Ability to design application functionality that can support multiple organizations, configurations, and partner workflows from a common platform without creating unnecessary customer-specific code.

**Enterprise Authentication & SSO**

Experience integrating external organizations into centralized authentication workflows and troubleshooting identity and access issues across organizational boundaries.

**API & Partner Integration Architecture**

Ability to design secure, maintainable APIs and integration patterns that allow external partner systems to interact reliably with the platform.

**Payments & Billing**

Experience implementing payment gateways and supporting multiple payment paths and business rules within a SaaS application.

**Authorization & Data Segregation**

Ability to implement application-level controls that associate users with organizations while enforcing appropriate boundaries around sensitive or restricted information.

**Partner Configuration**

Experience creating configurable functionality that enables new B2B customers to be onboarded without requiring significant custom engineering.

**Analytics & Reporting**

Ability to translate business metrics into reliable customer-facing dashboards and reporting functionality.

**Production Quality & Regression Testing**

Ability to extend an existing production platform while protecting established functionality through automated testing, regression coverage, code review, and disciplined deployment practices.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a senior-level developer who combines strong technical execution with B2B product and integration experience.

This person should be comfortable being given a business capability—such as enabling enterprise SSO, integrating a partner portal, introducing a new payment workflow, or creating configurable partner functionality—and independently determining how to translate that requirement into a secure, scalable implementation.

The successful candidate will understand the difference between delivering a one-time customer customization and building a reusable SaaS capability that can support future partners.

This role is best suited for a hands-on engineer who can operate with autonomy, communicate effectively with stakeholders, make sound technical decisions, and take accountability for delivering production-ready B2B functionality.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-stack
description:
**About ValGenesis**
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
  
  
Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Understand the business requirements and technical constraints and architect/design/develop.
* Participate in the complete development life cycle.
* Review the architecture/design/code of self and others.
* Develop enterprise application features/services using Azure cloud services, C# .NET Core, ReactJS etc, implementing DevSecOps principles.
* Own and be accountable for the Quality, Performance, Security and Sustenance of the respective product deliverables.
* Strive for self-excellence along with enabling success of the team/stakeholders.

**Requirements**

* 4 to 10 years of experience in developing enterprise software products
* Strong knowledge of C#, .NET Core, Azure DevOps
* Working knowledge of the JS frameworks – Preferably ReactJS
* Experience in container-based development, AKS, Service Fabric etc
* Experience in messaging queue like RabbitMQ, Kafka
* Experience in Azure Services like Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions
* Experience in databases like SQL Server, PostgreSQL
* Knowledge of reporting solutions like PowerBI, Apache SuperSet etc
* Knowledge of Micro-Services and/or Micro-Frontend architecture
* Knowledge of Code Quality, Code Monitoring, Performance Engineering, Test Automation Tools

**We’re on a Mission**
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
  
  
Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
  
  
**The Team You’ll Join**
Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
  
  
We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
  
  
We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
  
  
We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
  
  
**How We Work**
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
  
  
ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Edge Platform & Deployment Engineer
description:
**Type:**
Full- time
  
  
**Experience:**
1 - 3 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About The Role**
You own the stack that sits on the plant floor, and you grow it. Our edge gateway runs on a Linux box in a control panel. It talks to PLCs, CNCs and meters on one side and to our cloud on the other, and it has to keep doing that unattended for months. Every protocol we support is a separate installable app, and the list keeps growing: whenever a customer brings a controller we don't speak yet, you build the adapter for it.
  
  
This is partly a product role. Most people who use what you build won't be engineers: plant operators, maintenance teams, our solutions and support staff, and partners setting up their own sites. You decide what gets built and how it works, so that someone who has never heard of a register map or a system unit can still configure a device, add tags, and know whether their data is healthy. If a feature only works when you're the one using it, it isn't finished.
  
  
One morning you might be tracing a bad RS-485 cable on site. That afternoon you might be wrapping a vendor's C library for a new CNC, or redesigning a setup screen because a technician got stuck on it. You maintain the platform, extend it, shape it, and personally get it running on real devices at real sites.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Decide what the platform should do next. Turn field problems, support tickets and customer requests into features, set priorities, and make the trade-offs between power, simplicity and reliability.
* Design for people unfamiliar with the tech:

– Guided setup with defaults that work, plain-language errors, and validation that catches mistakes before they reach a device
  
  
– Status and health that a non-engineer can read at a glance
  
  
– Configuration that can't silently break something.
  
  

* Watch real users set up and run the product, find where they get stuck or need to call us, and remove those steps.
* Build new protocol apps to extend the ecosystem: take a protocol or controller we don't support yet, find the best library or vendor SDK for it, and ship a production adapter that follows our app contract (polling, packaging, install scripts, configurator, monitoring), so that every new protocol is just as easy to set up as the existing ones.
* Pick the right language for each job. Today the platform runs on Node.js, Python, C++, TypeScript and Bash, and the next adapter might need C#, Go, Java or Rust if that's where the only solid driver lives.
* Commission edge gateways at customer sites: install the device, configure the network, connect it to the PLCs, SCADA, DCS or meters, onboard it to the cloud, and confirm the data is right, not just that it's flowing.
* Read the existing OT setup before touching it: identify the assets, controllers, protocols, register and tag maps, network layout, and who owns what.
* Configure and troubleshoot the existing adapters (Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, Siemens S7, Omron FINS, Mitsubishi MC, Fanuc FOCAS) and validate every value against the source.
* Maintain the core platform: the orchestrator and its web UI, the configurator, the install and uninstall scripts, and the data pipelines (Redpanda/Kafka, MQTT, HTTP).
* Own releases end to end: build, package, version, ship, and roll out to devices in the field without breaking any that are already live.
* Diagnose failures remotely and on site using logs, metrics, VPN, SSH and packet captures, then fix the root cause, not just the symptom.
* Keep deployments secure by default: segmented networks, least privilege, managed secrets, and read-only access to controllers unless writes are explicitly approved.
* Write the user guides, runbooks and site documentation that let others deploy and run the product without you.

**What We're Looking For**

* Engineering degree. Mandatory. Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 1 - 3 years in industrial automation, IIoT, OT integration, systems engineering, or a field-facing technical role.
* Product sense:

– You think about who will use a feature before you think about how to build it
  
  
– You can explain a technical constraint in plain language
  
  
– You'll cut a clever option if it confuses the person on site
  
  

* A generalist engineer, not a one-language developer:

– You can pick up an unfamiliar codebase or language and be productive in it quickly
  
  
– You choose tools by what the job needs (library maturity, vendor support, performance, how it deploys on an edge box), not by habit
  
  
– You're comfortable reading C headers, vendor SDK docs and protocol specs to work out what a driver actually does.
  
  

* OT fundamentals you can apply on site:

– PLCs, SCADA, DCS and historians: what each does and where data really lives
  
  
– Industrial sensors, transmitters and energy meters
  
  
– Digital and analog I/O: 4–20 mA, 0–10 V, scaling, dry and wet contacts
  
  
– Serial wiring and RS-485 multidrop
  
  

* Hands-on with industrial protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU (function codes, register maps, byte order), OPC UA, and MQTT. Exposure to S7, FINS, MC, FOCAS, BACnet, EtherNet/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850 or IEC 60870-5-104 is a plus.
* Networking you can debug by hand: IP addressing and subnets, static vs DHCP, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, isolated or air-gapped plant networks, and Wireshark.
* Comfortable on Linux: the shell, systemd, journald, Nginx, permissions and sudo, package management, bash scripting.
* Basic IT/OT security principles: the Purdue model and network segmentation, IEC 62443 concepts, least privilege, secrets handling, and why you don't write to a running PLC without sign-off.
* Structured troubleshooting: you isolate the layer that's failing (wiring, device, protocol, network, service, cloud) instead of guessing.
* Clear written English. Your guides and site reports get read by people who weren't there, and often by people who aren't technical.
* Willing to travel to plants and work in panel rooms and on shop floors, roughly 30–40% of the time.

**Bonus Points**

* Has built a tool or internal product that non-technical people actually adopted, and iterated on it based on how they used it.
* Has written a protocol driver, or wrapped a vendor library, and run it against real hardware.
* Experience with Kafka/Redpanda, Prometheus/Grafana, React or TypeScript, CMake/vcpkg, or cross-compiling for ARM.
* CI/CD and packaging (Jenkins, offline installs for air-gapped sites).
* Comfortable using AI-assisted development to get up to speed on a new language or library quickly, and to close a gap while you're still on site.
* Has commissioned a system that actually went live and stayed live, or is an ex-automation, instrumentation or plant engineer who moved into software.
* Comfortable being told the panel is undocumented, the tag list is wrong and the network is flat, and getting it working anyway.

**Why Faclon?**
Industrial AI at real scale, across sectors and geographies. You own a platform that runs on real machines, not a demo. You decide which protocol it learns next and how easy it is for the next person to deploy. A small team where your judgment decides what ships, how it holds up in the field, and who can use it.

title: iOS Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced iOS Lead Engineer who can drive the technical direction of

our iOS platform, contribute hands-on to daily development, and represent the iOS tech stack at

the organizational level. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural

thinking, and the ability to mentor and guide the team toward building a world-class mobile

experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of complex iOS features.

Strong understanding of the iOS tech stack including:

* NSURLSession, networking, and API integrations

* Own and shape the entire iOS technical roadmap.
* Work on high-impact features with a strong cross-functional team.
* Build a product used at scale with a focus on performance and quality.
* A culture centered on innovation, autonomy, and solving meaningful problems.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description: Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXRVenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds with LLMs rather than around them.What You'll BuildFeatures, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.Tech StackFrontend: React.jsBackend: Python, DjangoAI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCPAI-native, and we mean it literallyMost job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of: Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building itWhat we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.What You Need One to two years shipping product React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight. At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holdingYour work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.What HelpsEach one moves you up the list. Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness Working knowledge of Generative UI. AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus. Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domainHow We Work Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked Vitality — energy that holds up in month sixIn practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.The processThe take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for. Tech screening round — 30 minutes. Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying. Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it. Interview round 2 - Technical + ManagerialBaner, Pune. Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker

title: Jr. Software Platform Engineer
description:
Role Value Proposition:
  
  
MetLife is the leading provider of Group Benefits.  The Group Disability technology organization is a diverse team of technologists, all working towards the common goal of ensuring the customer is at the center of everything we do.  As a Software/Platform engineer you are responsible for the design, development, implementation and maintenance of solutions supporting Disability & Absence products at MetLife - products that provide income protection and job protection to millions of employees across the United States. You will collaborate closely with the Scrum Lead, Product Owner and ART Leadership. You will have an opportunity to impact every part of the system and iterate over solutions to be the very best you can be to deliver for our customers.  Your responsibilities include writing full stack code, reviewing code written by the team, design and development of systems, frameworks, applications, and APIs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Assist in the collection and documentation of user requirements as well as the development of user stories and estimates with software, strategic platforms and/or COTS.
* Assists in developing, testing, implementation and support of application systems of a less complex nature. Responsible for front or backend software development, front SaaS and/or COTS development, with oversight.
* Participate in peer reviews of solution designs, related code, and/or related SaaS and/or COTS configuration.
* Assist in the investigation and resolution of production management incidents, problems, and service requests (in partnership with SaaS providers for Platforms).
* Participates in the support of production applications/platforms (in partnership with SaaS providers for Platforms).
* Identifies innovative solutions to technical challenges
* Hands on development with UI, Backend, Database, APIs, DevOps. Specifically React, Java, SQL, Micro services, Azure DevOps. Similar related technologies will be an asset.
* Estimate user stories, as part of release plan and participate in iteration plan exercises
* Key participant in user story breakdowns, user story elaboration, and user story reviews

**Expected Behaviors**

* A self-starter capable of acting independently and proactively requiring minimal management oversight.
* Ability to work across cultures and geographies to encourage team to adopt best practice

Essential Business Experience and Technical Skills:
  
  
Required:
  
  

* 4-5 years related work experience successfully delivered on large, complex projects with demonstrated technical leadership in delivery.
* End-to-end system design that balances the tradeoffs between technical solution, business value and operational simplicity.
* Core hands-on development skills in JavaScript (React or Angular), Java, OOP, SQL, JSON, No-SQL (MongoDB, CosmosDB), Kubernetes, and Scripting.
* Experience developing CRUD APIs, and critical applications from the ground up.
* Experience with Queues/Kafka, Micro services, message brokers, integration patterns.
* Experience developing and deploying applications using GCP or Azure OR AWS solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of the principles in software engineering, system analysis and design, design and analysis of algorithms, computer system architecture, and data structures.

  
  
**Preferred**

* BS/MS in Comp Science/IS.
* Disability product experience or Insurance industry knowledge.
* Experience using AI/ Co-Pilot.
* Experience with Python.
* Experience working in cross-functional, multi-location teams.
* Experience in SAFe, Agile methodology, tools, and Agile integration with Waterfall.

At MetLife, we’re leading the global transformation of an industry we’ve long defined. United in purpose, diverse in perspective, we’re dedicated to making a difference in the lives of our customers.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We're Hiring: AI/ML Engineer
  
  
**Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)**
**Location:**
Kothrud, Pune (In-Office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
0–3 Years (Freshers Welcome)
  
  
**Salary:**
Based on demonstrated skills
  
  
**Apply at:**
https://careers.vopa.in
  
  
**About VOPA**
Vowels of the People Association (VOPA) is a Pune-based organization working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and education technology for social impact.
  
  
Our flagship product,
**NIPUN Maharashtra**
, powers foundational literacy and numeracy assessments across
**70,000+ schools in Maharashtra, serving 5 million students**
.
  
  
We build AI that works for underserved populations — real classrooms, real children, real impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a passionate and technically strong
**AI/ML Engineer**
to join our team.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role with a research orientation. You will work on fine-tuning open-source models, designing machine learning pipelines, and deploying production-ready AI systems at scale.
  
  
**Our Key Focus Areas Include**

* Handwritten answer evaluation
* Marathi Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
* Computer Vision for Indic scripts
* Low-resource language AI models
* Efficient cloud and on-device AI inference

**What makes this role exciting?**
We have already shipped a fine-tuned vision model (Gemma 4 31B using Unsloth and LoRA) that surpasses many state-of-the-art models on Marathi children's handwriting recognition.
  
  
You will build on this foundation, improve existing systems, and explore new approaches to solving challenging AI problems.
  
  
**Important:**
This is not a data annotation or prompt engineering role. We are looking for someone who understands how machine learning models work internally.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Fine-Tuning & Training
* Fine-tune open-source LLMs and vision models using LoRA, QLoRA, and other Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques.
* Work with Hugging Face Transformers, Unsloth, and PEFT libraries.
* Optimize GPU training performance and resource utilization.
* Experiment with model architectures for domain-specific educational applications.
* Computer Vision & Speech AI
* Develop models for Marathi handwriting recognition and answer evaluation.
* Work on speech recognition systems for Marathi and other Indic languages.
* Design AI-based rubric scoring and evaluation mechanisms.
* Handle noisy, inconsistent, and low-resource real-world datasets.
* Model Deployment & Optimization
* Deploy fine-tuned models to AWS infrastructure, including ECS/Fargate and GPU inference endpoints.
* Optimize inference performance, latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
* Explore quantization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and other inference optimization techniques.
* Investigate on-device AI deployment for Android applications.
* ML Pipelines & Evaluation
* Build end-to-end ML pipelines covering data preprocessing, augmentation, training, evaluation, and serving.
* Define and track evaluation metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and Devanagari-aware benchmarks.
* Perform structured error analysis to identify model weaknesses.
* Improve model reliability and accuracy through systematic experimentation.
* Research & Engineering Collaboration
* Read and evaluate recent AI/ML research papers.
* Translate research ideas into practical experiments and production implementations.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate AI models into FastAPI services.
* Contribute to technical decisions regarding model architecture, training, and deployment.

**Required Technical Skills**
Model Fine-Tuning & Deep Learning
  
  

* Strong understanding of Transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, embeddings, and positional encoding.
* Knowledge of encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder architectures.
* Hands-on experience with LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning using Hugging Face PEFT or Unsloth.
* Understanding of model quantization techniques such as NF4, GPTQ, and AWQ.
* Familiarity with learning rate scheduling, gradient accumulation, and mixed-precision training.
* Ability to diagnose training instability, loss spikes, and gradient-related issues.

ML Engineering & Programming
  
  

* Good programming skills in Python or Rust.
* Proficiency in PyTorch, including autograd, tensor operations, and custom loss functions.
* Experience with Computer Vision (CNNs, image preprocessing, augmentation) and/or Speech AI (CTC, attention-based models, audio feature extraction).
* Understanding of dataset preparation, labeling strategies, and train/validation/test splits.
* Ability to write clean, modular, production-oriented code.

Model Deployment & Inference
  
  

* Experience deploying ML models using Docker and cloud infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GPU-based inference environments.
* Understanding of inference optimization, batching, ONNX, TensorRT, and KV caching.
* Awareness of model size, latency, and runtime constraints for edge devices.
* Ability to balance inference cost, latency, and throughput.

**Preferred Skills (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience using Unsloth for efficient model fine-tuning.
* Familiarity with Marathi, Devanagari, or multilingual NLP/ASR systems.
* Experience working with children's handwriting or speech datasets.
* Knowledge of AWS services such as ECS, S3, CloudFront, and Lambda.
* Exposure to model watermarking, AI model security, or on-device inference protection.

Who Can Apply?
  
  
**We Welcome Applications From**

* Freshers with strong practical AI/ML skills and demonstrable projects.
* Engineers with 0–3 years of relevant experience.
* Candidates who have independently fine-tuned or deployed ML models.
* Individuals who enjoy research, experimentation, and solving real-world engineering challenges.

**A Specific Degree Or Certification Is Not Required.**
We value demonstrated technical skills, problem-solving ability, and hands-on experience over academic credentials.
  
  
Our Selection Process
  
  
Our hiring process is entirely skill-based.
  
  
Candidates will be evaluated through a
**practical technical assessment**
designed to test their understanding of AI/ML concepts and their ability to solve real engineering problems.
  
  
Degrees and certifications will not determine selection.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Real-world impact: Build AI systems used across 70,000+ schools, reaching millions of children.
* Meaningful engineering challenges: Work on low-resource languages, handwritten text recognition, speech AI, and edge deployment.
* Technical ownership: Take responsibility for research, development, optimization, and deployment.
* Collaborative environment: Work with a technically strong, mission-driven team.
* Growth opportunities: Contribute to AI research and architectural decisions as VOPA scales.
* High autonomy: We value outcomes, independent thinking, and engineering excellence.

Apply Now
  
  
Interested in building AI systems that create meaningful educational impact?
  
  
**Submit Your Application Through Our Official Careers Portal**
https://careers.vopa.in
  
  
**Applications are accepted only through the VOPA Careers Portal.**
**Vowels of the People Association (VOPA)**
*Building technology for meaningful social impact.*
Salary Range
  
  
4.00 - 5.00 LPA

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. **Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

The role will embed security into design and development, integrate security testing into Secure by Design (SBD), GitHub, Azure and CI/CD workflows, and work closely with development, QA, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to ensure security controls are implemented before production release.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Application Security & Secure by Design

title: Sr Security Architect II(XDR - Endpoint Security)
description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department:** Cyber Defence Center (CDC), STO-XDR, Global Business Services

**Location:** Bengaluru, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Senior Security Architect II (XDR - Endpoint Security), you will own the architecture that protects every Novo device and the threat detection built on it. You will set the vision, standards and roadmap for XDR and endpoint security, turning business and operational needs into designs that hold up as Novo grows into new regions. Your work helps the Cyber Defence Center see threats sooner and respond faster, so the business can operate safely.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You combine deep endpoint security expertise with the judgement to balance strong security with what the business needs.

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration or a related field (BE, MSc, MBA or similar).
* 12+ years of IT experience, including security, operation, project and services , project management and service management roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in EDR/XDR and endpoint protection, including Microsoft Defender XDR and Trellix Endpoint Security(EPO, HX, EDR-F).
* Experience with application control and whitelisting, attack surface reduction, endpoint hardening and vulnerability management.
* 5–8 years of experience working with GxP requirements, validation and compliance, and in-depth knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management.
* Experience from large, cross-geographical projects and the ability to present complex topics clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
* A structured, self-driven way of working, with an end-to-end mindset and comfort collaborating across cultures and time zones.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Trend Micro Portable Security or cloud and SaaS security posture management.
* Exposure to cloud security and cloud migrations.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or Agile frameworks.
  

**What you’ll do**

* You will make architecture decisions within your governance area and stay close to how the services run day to day. You will:
* Define and evolve the architecture, strategy and roadmap for XDR and endpoint security, in line with Novo’s enterprise cybersecurity strategy.
* Set standards, reference architectures, guardrails and security baselines for Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Trellix and Trend Micro Portable Security, including Trellix policy architecture and modernisation.
* Assess emerging technologies through PoCs, product evaluations and gap analyses, and recommend what to adopt and when.
* Drive a security-by-design approach: assess exceptions, exclusions and whitelisting requests, and find secure, sustainable alternatives wherever possible.
* Oversee service health, coverage and compliance, from agent health and policy deployment to exposure data and malware detections, and coordinate remediation with technical teams.
* Support incident response with endpoint telemetry and evidence for Threat Operations, and keep services audit-ready through strong lifecycle management, documentation and vendor coordination.
* Support end-user issues, including—but not exclusively—those related to performance, false-positive troubleshooting, and software conflicts.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

* You will join STO-XDR within the Cyber Defence Center, Novo’s dedicated cyber defence organisation. The CDC protects the company from cyber threats, detects incidents, responds quickly and hardens technologies, processes and systems so the business can operate safely. STO-XDR runs and sustains the security technology stack: managing day-to-day platform operations, upgrades and vendor relationships, ensuring logs and telemetry flow into the CDC ecosystem, and keeping platforms audit-ready and supported to agreed SLAs.
* Your closest partners will be CDC units in Denmark and India, CDC management and the CISO organisation. You will also work with Defence Engineering, Threat Operations, Digital Workplace, Infrastructure, Enterprise IT, and IT service, system and quality managers across the business. Externally, you will work with strategic suppliers including Microsoft, Trellix, Carbon Black and Wiz.
* You will bring different perspectives together, influence stakeholders with differing interests and speak up when things stall, so endpoint security stays consistent as services expand across the enterprise.
  

**What you can expect here**

* You will be trusted to work independently, own architectural decisions and set direction with significant impact across a wide, international and cross-functional area. You will have room to test new technologies and keep improving how Novo protects its endpoints.
* You will grow through global collaboration, close work with leading security vendors and the chance to mentor colleagues and train service desk and technical teams. The work moves at pace, with clear expectations and a team that values curiosity, honest feedback and quality.
  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape the endpoint security that keeps Novo protected, apply for the Senior Security Architect II (XDR - Endpoint Security) role by 27 oct 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

* Your closest partners will be CDC colleagues in India and Denmark, CDC management, the CISO organisation, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Workplace, Cloud Platform, Security Operations, Enterprise IT, and IT service, system and quality managers across the business. Externally, you will work with strategic suppliers including Mimecast, Microsoft, Wiz, Valimail and cloud workload protection vendors.
* You will bring different perspectives together, influence stakeholders with differing interests and speak up when decisions stall, so security is built in from the start.
  

**What you can expect here**

* You will be trusted to work independently, own architectural decisions and set direction with significant impact across a wide, international and cross-functional area. Your expertise will be heard in technical forums and architecture discussions, and you will have room to evaluate emerging technologies and keep improving how Novo protects its email and cloud landscape.
* You will grow through global collaboration, close work with leading security vendors and the chance to mentor colleagues in your field. The work moves at pace, with clear expectations and a team that values curiosity, honest feedback and quality.
  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape the architecture that keeps Novo secure, apply for the Senior Security Architect II (Email & Cloud Security) role by 27 Oct 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
