title: Guidewire Integration Architect
description:
India - Bangalore

Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to deliver complex cloud implementations that reduce effort, accelerate time‑to‑value, and unlock measurable business outcomes through our InsuranceSuite platform and AI‑enabled services.
  
  
We work as one global team, combining deep insurance domain expertise, modern delivery methods, and a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and curiosity in how we serve customers.
  
  
As a Guidewire Integration Architect, you will lead end‑to‑end solution architecture across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter for strategic customer programs, primarily on Guidewire Cloud. You will shape technical direction, mentor delivery teams, and embed automation and AI‑powered methods to cut implementation effort and time while ensuring scalable, maintainable, and upgrade‑ready solutions.
  
  
This role sits at the heart of Guidewire’s mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business by making cloud and AI adoption faster, safer, and more valuable.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**

* Serve as the lead architect for complex InsuranceSuite implementations, defining target architectures and integration patterns across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter, and surrounding systems.
* Translate business and product requirements into cloud‑ready, scalable, and upgrade‑safe solution designs, balancing configuration, integration, and extension options on Guidewire Cloud.
* Provide design authority on programs (including SI‑led deliveries), ensuring alignment to Guidewire best practices, reference architectures, and Professional Services priorities to reduce implementation effort and time and improve delivery quality.
* Partner with customer architects, product teams, and delivery leads to embed AI‑ and automation‑enabled methods, accelerators, and repeatable offerings throughout the implementation lifecycle, improving productivity and time‑to‑value.
* Review and govern critical design decisions, code approaches, performance considerations, and data models to ensure quality, resilience, security, and operational efficiency in production.
* Mentor and coach consultants and engineers on InsuranceSuite architecture, cloud patterns, and modern engineering practices, helping build AI‑enabled delivery capability across Professional Services.
* Contribute to the evolution of standard assets, templates, and methodologies that can be reused across customers to scale services‑led innovation, support revenue growth, and improve margins.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data‑driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.
  

  

**What you’ll bring**

*Required*

Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data‑driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

* Extensive hands‑on experience architecting and delivering Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and/or ClaimCenter solutions, ideally including cloud implementations and large‑scale transformations.
* Strong background in enterprise application architecture, integration patterns (REST APIs, messaging, batch), and secure, scalable design in a SaaS or cloud environment.
* Ability to lead technical direction on large, multi‑stakeholder programs, influencing decisions through clear reasoning, structured trade‑offs, and collaborative problem solving.
* Proficiency in core technologies used with InsuranceSuite (e.g., Java, Gosu, relational databases, integration middleware) and familiarity with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Proven track record of mentoring and upskilling engineers or consultants, with an emphasis on quality, automation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to convey complex technical concepts in accessible language to technical and non‑technical audiences.
  

  

**Preferred**

* 10+ years of overall software/solution architecture experience, including significant time on Guidewire implementations; prior experience in a consulting or Professional Services context is a plus.
* Experience applying AI‑ or automation‑based accelerators (e.g., code generation, intelligent testing tools, migration scripts) within delivery projects to reduce effort and improve reliability.
* Knowledge of P&C insurance domains (policy administration, billing, claims) and related industry standards or regulatory environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  

**Your Impact**

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you will immerse yourself in Guidewire’s architecture patterns, Professional Services delivery methodology, and AI‑enabled services strategy, then take ownership of solution architecture for one or more strategic customer programs in the region.

  
  

You will define target architectures, guide critical design decisions, and help teams adopt repeatable patterns that reduce implementation effort by up to 50% and time by 30%, directly supporting cloud adoption and measurable customer value for insurers.

  
  

As you grow in the role, your work will influence how insurers modernize their core platforms, how our partners deliver implementations, and how Guidewire advances its wider mission to transform P&C insurance through trusted cloud and AI‑powered platforms.

  
  

**What’s in it for you**

  
  

The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:

* Flexible work environment.
* Health and wellness benefits.
* Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
* Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
* Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.
  

  

All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.

Interested in this position?

  

**About Guidewire**

  
  

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

  
  

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

  
  

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

  
  

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

  
  

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. title: SENIOR TECHNICAL LEAD
description:
**SENIOR TECHNICAL DEVELOPER**

**AI-led Java Modernisation | GKE on Google Cloud**

**Role Type**
  
Hands-on Senior Individual Contributor

**Experience**
  
10-18 years

**Location**
  
India - Hybrid / Remote, subject to program needs

  

**Preferred Domain**
  
Airline, Travel or GDS

**Target Platform**
  
GKE on Google Cloud Platform

**Employment Type**
  
Full-time / Program Assignment

**Role Purpose**
================

**We are seeking a highly capable, hands-on Senior Technical Developer to contribute to a large-scale technology modernisation programme.** The role requires deep Java/J2EE engineering expertise, strong cloud-native development skills, and the ability to use both AI-assisted tools and AI-agentic engineering approaches to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, compliance, maintainability or operational resilience.

The successful candidate will work with minimal supervision, take end-to-end ownership of assigned outcomes, and contribute across analysis, design, build, testing, deployment and production-readiness activities. Prior experience in airline, travel or GDS platforms is strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Hands-on Software Engineering**
---------------------------------

� Design, develop, test and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java, J2EE, Spring Boot and related frameworks.

� Build secure, scalable and resilient microservices, REST APIs and event-driven components.

� Apply clean-code, SOLID, domain-driven design and twelve-factor application principles.

� Produce maintainable, testable and production-ready code with appropriate technical documentation.

� Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, optimise performance and reduce technical debt.

**Modernisation Delivery**
--------------------------

� Analyse and reverse engineer legacy applications, interfaces, data flows and business rules.

� Translate legacy functionality into modern service boundaries, APIs and cloud-native implementation patterns.

� Contribute to solution design, decomposition, dependency analysis, migration planning and cutover readiness.

� Create reusable engineering accelerators, templates and reference implementations for modernisation squads.

**GCP and GKE Engineering**
---------------------------

� Develop, containerise and deploy workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine within Google Cloud Platform.

� Work with Docker, Kubernetes manifests or Helm, configuration management, secrets, service accounts, ingress and workload identity.

� Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, observability, logging, monitoring and production support.

� Engineer for reliability, scalability, fault tolerance, cost awareness and operational supportability.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------

� Apply secure-by-design and privacy-by-design practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

� Follow OWASP guidance, secure coding standards, least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption and API security practices.

� Remediate vulnerabilities identified through SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, container scanning and penetration testing.

� Maintain traceability and evidence required for enterprise governance, audit, change management and regulatory compliance.

� Ensure AI-generated outputs are reviewed, validated and handled in accordance with data classification, intellectual-property and responsible-AI policies.

**Ownership and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

� Work independently with minimal supervision while proactively escalating risks, decisions and dependencies.

� Collaborate with architects, product owners, domain SMEs, platform teams, security teams, testers and SRE/operations teams.

� Mentor engineers, promote engineering standards and contribute constructively to design and code reviews.

� Demonstrate accountability for committed outcomes, quality, timelines and production readiness.

**AI-related Skill Requirements**
=================================

Candidates should demonstrate practical capability in both AI-assisted engineering and AI-agentic engineering. Tool familiarity alone is not sufficient; the candidate must be able to apply these capabilities responsibly within an enterprise delivery environment.

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Indicative Evidence / Tools**

**AI-assisted software engineering**

Use generative-AI coding assistants for code completion, explanation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, defect analysis and developer productivity. Validate outputs against requirements, coding standards and architecture constraints.

GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, IDE-integrated assistants or equivalent.

  

**Prompt and context engineering**

Create precise prompts, task instructions, examples, constraints and acceptance criteria. Select and structure relevant artefacts so that AI outputs are grounded in approved program knowledge.

Prompt patterns, reusable instruction files, context packs, coding standards, architecture guidance and domain glossaries.

  

**AI-agent configuration**

Configure specialised agents with defined roles, goals, tools, workflow steps, guardrails, memory boundaries, escalation rules and output formats.

Agent definitions, system instructions, tool permissions, workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  

**Agent skills and reusable capabilities**

Create or configure reusable agent skills for reverse engineering, design support, story elaboration, code generation, testing, review, documentation and troubleshooting.

Skill files, templates, procedures, tool adapters, validation rules and structured outputs.

  

**Knowledge-context management**

Curate and maintain trusted knowledge contexts drawn from requirements, legacy code, design documents, API specifications, coding standards, test assets and operational documentation.

Repository-based context, indexed documentation, retrieval workflows, metadata, versioning and access controls.

  

**Agentic SDLC execution**

Use coordinated agents across multiple SDLC steps while preserving traceability, deterministic quality gates and human accountability.

Multi-step workflows for analysis-to-code, code-to-test, review, defect remediation and documentation.

  

**AI output evaluation and quality control**

Assess accuracy, completeness, security, hallucination risk, code quality, test adequacy and alignment with architecture. Define feedback loops and measurable acceptance thresholds.

Golden datasets, benchmark tasks, review checklists, automated validations, regression testing and quality metrics.

  

**Responsible and secure AI use**

Protect confidential information, prevent unauthorised data exposure, respect licensing/IP constraints, and comply with enterprise AI governance and model-use policies.

Data classification, approved models, access controls, audit logs, prompt/output handling standards and responsible-AI controls.

  

**AI-enabled delivery acceleration**

Demonstrate measurable improvements in cycle time, engineering throughput, defect prevention or documentation quality without weakening controls.

Productivity metrics, reuse assets, reduced rework, improved coverage and evidence-based delivery outcomes.

**Required Technical Skills**
=============================

**Java and Application Engineering:** Java 11/17 or later; J2EE/Jakarta EE; Spring Boot; Spring Framework; Spring Data/JPA; Hibernate; REST/JSON/XML; Maven or Gradle; unit and integration testing.

**Architecture and Integration:** Microservices; API-first design; event-driven architecture; distributed systems; resilience patterns; domain-driven design; synchronous and asynchronous integration.

**Cloud, Containers and DevOps:** Google Cloud Platform; GKE; Docker; Kubernetes; Helm or equivalent; Git; CI/CD; infrastructure/configuration awareness; logging, monitoring and observability.

**Data Engineering:** Strong SQL; relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL; schema design; query optimisation; transaction management; exposure to NoSQL or messaging platforms is advantageous.

**Engineering Quality:** Test automation; code coverage; static analysis; dependency management; performance engineering; peer review; production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

**Security and Compliance:** OWASP Top 10; secure coding; IAM; secrets management; encryption; API security; vulnerability remediation; DevSecOps controls; audit and change-management discipline.

**Preferred Airline / Travel Domain Experience**
================================================

� Passenger service, reservations, ticketing, pricing, check-in, departure control, loyalty, revenue management or airline operations.

� GDS, distribution, interline, codeshare, NDC or airline partner integrations.

� Modernisation of high-volume, mission-critical legacy airline platforms and interfaces.

� Understanding of availability, reliability, data integrity and operational continuity expectations within airline systems.

**Behavioural Competencies**
============================

**Competency**

**Expected Behaviour**

**Ownership**

Takes end-to-end responsibility and follows through until outcomes are achieved.

  

**Independence**

Operates effectively with minimal supervision and seeks guidance only where decisions materially require it.

  

**Problem solving**

Breaks down ambiguity, diagnoses complex issues and makes evidence-based technical decisions.

  

**Communication**

Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders; raises risks early.

  

**Collaboration**

Works constructively across architecture, product, domain, security, testing and platform teams.

  

**Learning agility**

Adopts new tools, AI practices and modern engineering patterns rapidly and responsibly.

  

**Quality mindset**

Balances delivery speed with security, maintainability, testing and operational resilience.

**Qualifications**
==================

� Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

� Relevant Java, GCP, Kubernetes or cloud-native certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

� Demonstrable hands-on engineering capability and delivery outcomes will be weighted more strongly than certification alone.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

**Outcome Area**

**Success Measure**

**Delivery**

Consistently completes committed outcomes with limited supervision and transparent risk management.

  

**Engineering quality**

Produces secure, maintainable, well-tested code with low defect leakage and manageable technical debt.

  

**AI-enabled productivity**

Uses AI-assisted and agentic practices to demonstrate measurable cycle-time, quality or throughput improvements.

  

**Modernisation**

Successfully translates legacy capabilities into scalable, supportable cloud-native services.

  

**Security and compliance**

Meets required security controls, evidence standards, governance gates and remediation timelines.

  

**Cloud readiness**

Deploys and supports reliable workloads on GKE/GCP with appropriate observability and operational controls.

  

**Reuse and capability building**

Creates reusable prompts, skills, agent configurations, engineering assets and patterns that improve squad performance.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
===========================

The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who remains deeply hands-on, understands enterprise Java and cloud-native engineering, and treats AI as an engineering capability rather than merely a productivity tool. The candidate can configure AI agents, reusable skills and trusted knowledge contexts; evaluate AI-generated outputs rigorously; and apply these methods to accelerate modernisation delivery while maintaining security, compliance, quality and human accountability.

**Assumptions Used in Preparing This**
======================================

� The target experience range is 10-18 years; this may be adjusted based on internal grade architecture.

� The modernisation programme uses Java/Spring-based microservices deployed to GKE on GCP.

� AI tools and models will be restricted to enterprise-approved platforms, repositories and data-handling policies.

� Airline domain experience is preferred, not mandatory, unless the role is assigned to a highly specialised functional area.

� The employer will insert company-specific information such as location, reporting line, equal-opportunity statement, benefits and application process before external publication.

title: Senior AI QA Engineer
description:
### **Opportunity:**

As a **Senior AI QA Engineer**, you will go beyond traditional functional testing. You will be responsible for building the framework that ensures our clinical insights are accurate, safe, and reliable. This role requires a unique blend of high-level software testing and data engineering to validate complex, non-deterministic medical outputs using a hybrid of automated grading methodologies.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architect Multi-Layered Validation Frameworks:** Design and implement structured testing strategies that combine deterministic checks, semantic similarity metrics, and model-based evaluations.
* **Automated Model Grading:** Develop systems to evaluate clinical pipeline outputs for faithfulness, safety, and hallucination detection using various automated scoring techniques (e.g., BERTScore, ROUGE, or custom heuristics).
* **Vibe-Driven Development:** Leverage agentic AI tools to rapidly prototype complex test harnesses, "red-team" clinical logic, and build internal validation utilities at high velocity.
* **Data Pipeline Integrity:** Execute integration and regression tests for data-heavy backend processes, ensuring medical data remains consistent from ingestion to insight generation.
* **Collaborative Strategy:** Work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to define "Ground Truth" datasets and clinical evaluation rubrics.
* **Root Cause Analysis:** Deep-dive into complex system failures to identify whether issues stem from code logic, data drift, or model behavior.

### **Requirements:**

* **6+ years of technical experience** in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on system architecture and backend data validation.
* **Advanced Python Proficiency:** Expert-level skills in Python for building custom test scripts and working within AI/ML ecosystems.
* **AI/ML Validation Experience:** Proven experience testing model outputs using diverse metrics (e.g., **Semantic Similarity, NLP metrics, and custom scoring algorithms**). Familiarity with tools like **LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or MLflow**.
* **Vibe Coding Mastery:** Proficiency with AI-native development tools such as **Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code**.
* **Modern Automation Stack:** Proficiency with frameworks like **PyTest**, and experience with traditional tools (Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium) for end-to-end flows.
* **API & Data Testing:** Solid understanding of API testing (Postman/RestAssured) and database validation (SQL/NoSQL).
* **Strategic Thinking:** Experience serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on test process development for large-scale systems.

### **Preferred (Good to Have):**

* **Clinical Domain Knowledge:** Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as **FHIR, HL7, or SNOMED CT**.
* **Healthcare Compliance:** Understanding of **HIPAA** regulations and the nuances of handling ePHI/PHI.
* **Statistical Foundation:** Understanding of sensitivity, specificity, and F1-scores in a clinical context.

  

**About GW RhythmX**

GW RhythmX is revolutionizing healthcare through connected, AI-native intelligence that unites clinical insight, patient engagement, and system-wide care orchestration. The company combines market-leading AI precision care technology with extensive trusted patient engagement leadership to help health systems deliver the right care, at the right time, through the right clinician and channel. Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U.S. military veterans. The company's award-winning solutions were recognized again in 2024 by KLAS Research, Fierce Healthcare, and AVIA Marketplace. A SymphonyAI Group company, GW RhythmX leverages various firm assets, including $1B+ in R&D investment, longitudinal data related to 300 million patients, 4.4 billion total annual claims, and 1.8 million healthcare professionals at more than 3,000 facilities globally.

GW RhythmX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age or veteran status.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
**Senior QA Engineer**

At Sangoma, we're looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** who is passionate about delivering high-quality software and exceptional customer experiences. In this role, you'll play a critical part in ensuring the quality, reliability, scalability, security, and performance of our cloud communications platforms and frontend applications.

You'll work closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, Technical Support, and fellow QA engineers throughout the software development lifecycle. As a senior member of the QA team, you'll take ownership of quality for assigned products and features, contribute to test automation and QA strategy, mentor junior team members, and help drive continuous improvements in testing practices and product quality.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and QA strategies for UCaaS, CCaaS, web, and frontend applications.
* Develop, maintain, and execute automated tests to expand regression coverage and improve testing efficiency.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, system, API, compatibility, performance, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Technical Support to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and customer-reported issues.
* Analyze application behavior, logs, network traffic, and SIP traces to identify root causes and validate fixes.
* Test REST APIs and backend services, including validation of data, integrations, error handling, and system behavior.
* Verify new features, enhancements, and bug fixes to ensure they meet functional, technical, usability, and quality requirements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release readiness activities.
* Identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation plans.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, testing methodologies, automation frameworks, documentation, and overall test coverage.
* Mentor junior QA engineers through technical guidance, test reviews, automation support, and best-practice sharing.
* Maintain accurate test documentation and provide clear reporting on testing progress, defects, quality metrics, risks, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Investigate complex production and customer-reported issues and support root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Stay current with emerging QA tools, automation technologies, and industry best practices.

  
**Requirements**  

* + 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including experience testing complex web, cloud, VoIP, or communications applications.
  + Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, Agile/Scrum practices, and QA best practices.
  + Demonstrated experience designing and executing functional, regression, integration, system, API, performance, and end-to-end testing.
  + Hands-on experience developing and maintaining test automation using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar technologies.
  + Experience with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar.
  + Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or equivalent tools.
  + Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with DevOps tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.
  + Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or Xray.
  + Strong experience analyzing application logs, network traffic, and debugging complex software issues.
  + Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for data validation and troubleshooting.
  + Experience with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, or similar is preferred.
  + Experience with UCaaS, CCaaS, VoIP, SIP, WebRTC, or other real-time communications technologies is highly desirable.
  + Strong understanding of software quality principles and the ability to identify quality risks throughout the development lifecycle.
  + Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  + Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
  + Demonstrated ability to mentor junior QA engineers and champion QA best practices.
  + Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Experience testing distributed cloud-based applications and microservices.
  + Experience with SIP signaling, RTP/media flows, WebRTC, or telecommunications protocols.
  + Experience with containerized environments such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  + Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  + Experience building or enhancing automated test frameworks and reusable test infrastructure.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Sangoma?

At Sangoma, we value our employees and provide benefits designed to support their professional growth, financial security, and overall well-being.

* **Health & Medical Coverage.** Comprehensive medical insurance to support you and your family's healthcare needs.
* **Work Life Balence**. Flexible work schedules that help maintain a healthy balance between your professional and personal commitments.
* **Financial Security**. Provident Fund (PF) benefits and Gratuity in accordance with applicable statutory requirements.
* **Career Growth.** Opportunity to work on innovative telecom and cloud communication technologies while collaborating with experienced engineering and product teams.
* **Learning & Development.** Gain hands-on exposure to advanced VoIP, SIP, SBC, and gateway technologies while continuously expanding your technical expertise.

If you're passionate about software quality and enjoy solving complex technical challenges in cloud communications, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Hardware -Embedded Engineer
description:
Countai Private Limited is seeking a highly skilled Embedded & Controls Engineer to help develop the next generation of deployable quantum networking hardware.

You will take end-to-end ownership of the electronics and control architecture that connects our advanced photonic and quantum hardware to countai software and orchestration platforms. Your work will span custom PCB design, mixed-signal and high-speed electronics, FPGA and embedded systems, firmware, precision control algorithms, hardware APIs, and rack-level system integration.

Working closely with our photonics, software, systems, and mechanical engineering teams, you will transform laboratory prototypes into robust, manufacturable systems capable of operating outside the laboratory. You will address challenging requirements including ultra-low-noise electronics, precise synchronization, sub-nanosecond timing, high-speed signal integrity, closed-loop optical control, and reliable remote management.

Your work will establish the electronic and control infrastructure required to bring Countai private limited from research prototypes into scalable, field-deployable platforms.

**You Will**

* Architect custom mixed-signal PCBs for precision control, data acquisition, timing, and communication within rack-mounted quantum systems.
* Develop embedded software and firmware to control custom electronics, optical components, and photonic devices.
* Design high-speed analog and digital signal paths while maintaining stringent requirements for signal integrity, latency, synchronization, and noise.
* Interface with embedded processors, FPGAs, ADCs, DACs, and discrete control and telemetry signals.
* Design, implement, and tune digital control loops for precision regulation and stabilization of optical and electronic hardware.
* Architect low-noise power distribution, grounding, and control electronics for sensitive quantum hardware.
* Develop interfaces for system communication using technologies such as Ethernet, UART, SPI, USB, GPIO, and high-speed data-converter interfaces.
* Define and implement APIs that enable higher-level software platforms to control hardware and access system status and telemetry.
* Develop custom cable harnessing and interconnect solutions for RF, digital, analog, telemetry, and high-speed signals.
* Collaborate with software, systems, mechanical, optical, and photonics engineers to optimize thermal performance, grounding, EMI/EMC, signal integrity, and overall system reliability.
* Lead hardware bring-up and debug complex interactions between electronics, firmware, FPGA logic, and system-level software.
* Create and implement comprehensive hardware, firmware, and system-level test plans; analyze results and drive design improvements.
* Transform laboratory and benchtop prototypes into reliable, manufacturable, field-deployable rack-mounted systems.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.
* 3+ years of experience developing custom electronic hardware and embedded control systems.
* Experience designing mixed-signal PCBs incorporating embedded processors, microcontrollers, or FPGAs.
* Experience in embedded software/firmware development using C/C++.
* Experience with FPGA-based systems, including familiarity with RTL and/or High-Level Synthesis (HLS).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing electronics and control systems for lasers, electro-optic modulators, optical switches, photonic integrated circuits, or other photonic devices.
* Experience with analog and digital electronics, signal integrity, impedance matching, grounding, and high-speed PCB design
* Experience working with ADCs, DACs, and mixed-signal data-acquisition and control systems.
* Experience with common communication interfaces including Ethernet, UART, SPI, USB, and GPIO.
* Experience designing low-noise power distribution and electronics for sensitive instrumentation.
* Background in classical optics, quantum optics, quantum networking, photonics, or precision instrumentation.

title: System Architect - Automation Train Protection Systems
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for a System Architect - Automation Train Protection Systems**

**You’ll make a difference by:**

* We are seeking an experienced System Architect to lead the design and specification of Automatic Train Protection (ATP) systems in the railway domain. This role focuses on embedded safety-critical systems and requires deep expertise in SIL4-compliant architectures, systems thinking, and stakeholder collaboration. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with train protection technologies such as Kavach (TCAS), PTC, ETCS, and TCAS.
* **Key Responsibilities:**
* System Architecture & Design
* Define and maintain System Requirements Specifications (SRS) and System Architecture Specifications (SAS).
* Develop and manage Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and ensure seamless integration across subsystems.
* Ensure system design complies with SIL4 safety standards (EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129).
* Apply systems thinking to analyze, design, and optimize complex embedded systems.
* Quickly understand base solutions and adapt them to meet evolving customer and regulatory requirements.
* Utilize UML modeling for system design and documentation.
* Apply simulation tools to validate system behavior and performance under various operational scenarios.
* Quickly Understanding base solutions and defining reuse approach.
* Stakeholder Management
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, software, safety, and validation.
* Engage with customers, certification bodies, and railway operators to align system design with expectations.
* Lead technical discussions and ensure traceability of requirements through the development lifecycle.
* **Domain Expertise**
* Apply knowledge of Train Protection Systems such as:
* Kavach (TCAS) – Indian Train Collision Avoidance System.
* PTC – Positive Train Control (USA).
* ETCS – European Train Control System.
* Understand operational scenarios, fail-safe mechanisms, and interoperability requirements.
* Technical Leadership
* Guide engineering teams in implementing system-level designs and safety architectures.
* Support safety case development, validation, and certification processes.
* Evaluate and recommend tools, platforms, and technologies for system development.
* Required Skills & Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in embedded systems architecture, preferably in railway or other safety-critical domains.
* Proven experience with SIL4-compliant system design and safety lifecycle processes.
* Strong understanding of real-time systems, microcontrollers, and communication protocols.
* Familiarity with tools like DOORS, Enterprise Architect, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE).
* Proficiency in UML design and system modeling.
* Experience with simulation environments for embedded systems validation.
* **Generic Skills & Experience:**
* Strong foundation in systems thinking and architectural abstraction.
* Strong experience in handing of Nonfunctional requirements at architectural level
* Experience with requirement engineering, traceability, and change management.
* Familiarity with Agile, V-Model, or hybrid development lifecycles.
* Exposure to configuration management and version control tools (e.g., Git, SVN).
* Understanding of formal verification, validation, and safety case development.
* Background in programming languages such as C/C++, Python.
* Experience in system integration and managing cross-domain dependencies.
* **Preferred Experience:**
* Hands-on experience with Kavach (TCAS), PTC, ETCS, or similar ATP systems.
* Exposure to railway signaling, onboard control systems, and interoperability frameworks.
* Experience with formal methods, hazard analysis, and safety documentation.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Strong analytical and systems thinking.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills and stack holder management experience
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex technical programs.

**Your success is grounded in:**

* 15+ years of experience is required.
* Great Communication skills.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.  
  
This role is based in **Pune**, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** **www.siemens.com/careers** **& more about mobility at** **https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html**

title: Agentic AI Solution Architect
description:
Role Purpose

TGC is transitioning its software engineering environment toward an Agentic-AI-first development model, where AI agents participate across requirements, architecture, frontend and backend development, testing, security, deployment and ongoing application maintenance.

We are looking for a hands-on Agentic AI Solution Architect who can architect, implement and govern this engineering environment.

This is not a conventional Solution Architect or Generative AI role. The successful candidate must be capable of using AI coding agents to build and deploy real production applications while establishing the architecture, guardrails and development practices required for engineering teams to work effectively with agents.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Architecture

- Design TGC's end-to-end Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (A-SDLC).

- Build and configure specialized agents for frontend, backend, database, QA, security and DevOps activities.

- Design effective system prompts, context engineering, tool access, agent memory and orchestration.

- Establish agent-to-agent workflows and human approval gates.

- Create reusable engineering instructions and standards across TGC products.

Application Architecture

Own and guide architecture across:

- Angular and TypeScript

- Angular Micro-Frontend architecture

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs

- Microservices

- SQL and NoSQL databases

- Azure cloud services

- API integrations

- Authentication, authorization and RBAC

- Scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Agentic Development

The role must be highly hands-on.

The candidate should be able to take:

Requirement → Architecture → Agent Instructions → Generated Code → Testing → Security Validation → Deployment without defaulting to manual coding whenever an agent encounters a problem.

When agents fail, the individual should diagnose whether the failure resulted from context, instructions, architecture, tooling, permissions, test coverage or model limitations and improve the agentic system accordingly.

DevOps & Deployment

- Design AI-assisted CI/CD workflows.

- Implement automated build, testing and deployment.

- Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub pipelines.

- Implement Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.

- Manage Azure Key Vault and application secrets securely.

- Establish automated rollback, logging and monitoring.

Engineering Governance

Create and enforce:

- Agent-first development standards

- Coding and architecture standards

- Automated testing requirements

- AI-generated code review processes

- Security validation

- Human approval gates

- Production deployment controls

- Documentation and traceability of agent-generated changes

Team Enablement

A major responsibility will be helping TGC's existing engineering team transition from conventional development to AI-native engineering.

Essential Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with:

- Agentic AI / AI coding agents

- LLM system prompting and context engineering

- Tool/function calling and agent orchestration

- MCP or equivalent agent-tool integration

- Git/GitHub

- Angular / TypeScript

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs and microservices

- SQL / database architecture

- Microsoft Azure

- Docker / containers

- CI/CD

- Automated testing

- Application security

Experience with modern AI development environments such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalent agentic coding platforms is highly desirable.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who thinks:

"How do I make the agent solve this reliably and repeatedly?"

rather than:

"I'll just fix the code myself."

The ideal candidate is:

- Architecturally strong

- Extremely hands-on

- Comfortable experimenting with rapidly evolving AI technology

- Strong at debugging AI-agent behaviour

- Able to distinguish AI limitations from poor instructions or architecture

- Security conscious

- Product and UX aware

- Comfortable challenging traditional software-development practices

- Capable of teaching other engineers how to work effectively with AI agents

Selection Process

Candidates should expect a practical assessment.

They may be provided with a partially functioning application and access to an AI coding environment and asked to:

Diagnose, correct, test and deploy the application primarily through AI agents rather than manually rewriting the code.

We are interested not simply in whether the candidate solves the problem, but how they design, instruct, supervise and improve the agentic engineering process used to solve it.

Success in the First 90 Days

The successful candidate should:

- Establish TGC's Agentic Development Architecture.

- Implement the Agentic SDLC.

- Create reusable FE, BE, QA, Security and DevOps agents.

- Establish automated development and deployment pipelines.

- Introduce measurable agentic engineering standards.

- Reduce dependence on manual coding.

- Improve development velocity without compromising security or quality.

- Transition the engineering team toward an AI-native development model.

Core Mandate

Build the engineering system that enables AI agents and humans together to deliver secure, scalable production software faster and more reliably.

Work Location Requirement: This is a full-time, work-from-office position based in Pune. Candidates must be willing to work from the Pune office; hybrid and remote working are not applicable to this role

Pay: ₹682,000.00 - ₹770,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)
description:
**Job title:** Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Company:** Yutrix Labs LLP  
**Location:** Pune (Baner), hybrid. Occasional international travel to North America (2–4 weeks at a time).  
**Experience:** 8–12 years  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Yutrix Labs**  
Yutrix Labs is a Pune-based technology company building AI-native platforms for regulated and operations-heavy businesses. We are building an AI Restaurant Manager for a North American QSR franchise brand. It is an operating-control platform that watches inventory, food cost, food safety, service speed and loss prevention across restaurants. It flags exceptions with evidence and tells managers what to fix today.

We are looking for a domain lead who has run the back office of a QSR chain and wants to turn that experience into a product.

**What you will do**

* Own the business side of the product: inventory, purchasing and receiving, recipe and food cost, waste, cash control, HACCP/food safety, speed of service.
* Lead discovery workshops with the client’s operations, finance, procurement and QA teams, and with store managers.
* Turn SOPs and operating standards into system rules: thresholds, tolerances, severity levels, escalation paths and KPIs.
* Write user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and UAT scripts for the engineering and AI teams.
* Define how theoretical vs actual food cost, inventory variance, receiving variance and cash exceptions are calculated and explained.
* Review POS, inventory and purchasing data to assess data quality and design dashboards and reports.
* Support the pilot restaurant go-live: training, threshold tuning, and feedback from store teams.
* Act as the trusted operations voice with the client, and challenge scope where it doesn’t match how restaurants really work.

**What we are looking for**

* 8–12 years in QSR or fast-casual chains, with at least 3–5 years in restaurant operations, cost control, supply chain or operations excellence at a multi-unit or franchise brand.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of:
* Recipe/BOM costing, yields, portion standards and packaging BOMs
* Theoretical vs actual (AvT) food cost and variance analysis
* Inventory management: cycle counts, UOM conversions, FEFO/expiry, transfers, shrinkage
* Purchasing and receiving: par levels, reorder logic, 3-way match, price variance, supplier claims
* Store operations: opening and closing, waste capture, cash reconciliation, voids, refunds and discounts
* HACCP and food safety: temperature logs, holding times, cleaning, allergen control, audits
* Speed of service and KDS flow
* Franchise standards, audits and scorecards
* Experience working with technology teams on a POS, inventory, ERP or restaurant software rollout, as business owner or functional consultant.
* Strong analytical skills (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus).
* Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence running workshops with senior client stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Experience with restaurant systems such as POS/KDS, inventory and costing tools (e.g. Restroworks/Posist, MarketMan, Restaurant365, CrunchTime) or ERP purchasing modules.
* Central kitchen or commissary operations, halal or spec-compliant sourcing.
* Loss prevention or internal audit experience in F&B or retail.
* Exposure to North American or Middle East QSR markets. French is a bonus.

**Why join us**

* Shape an AI product from day one, alongside architects, data scientists and engineers.
* Work directly with an international QSR brand, with travel to the client.
* A small, senior team that builds fast and makes heavy use of AI tools.
* Competitive compensation.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,050,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:

title: Data Platforms and AI Access Control Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Role Purpose**

The **Data Platform & AI Access Control Lead** is responsible for ensuring the secure, compliant, and responsible usage of organizational data and AI systems. They bridge the gap between AI engineering, information security, and governance by defining permissions for both human users, Functional Accounts, Service Principles and autonomous AI agents across modern Data Platforms, Analytics ecosystems, AI/ML solutions, and Generative AI environments.

This role will be responsible for establishing secure and compliant Data & AI Access ecosystems by integrating IAM, governance, privacy, risk management, and regulatory compliance into Data Platforms and AI Operations.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Access Management practices in cloud-native data, AI platforms, AI/GenAI security, Role Based Access Control methodologies, regulatory compliance frameworks, and secure engineering practices.

The role requires strong collaboration across Data & AI Platform Engineering, IT, Security, Legal, and AI Engineering teams (data science/DevOps/Machine Learning Engineering) to ensure secure, compliant and resilient access control management across Data & AI environments

**Key responsibilities:**

**Data & AI Platforms Identity & Access Management Governance**

* **Entity Permissions:** Define and manage access rights for both human employees and non-human entities (e.g., AI agents, MLOps pipelines, service accounts).

* **Access Control Matrix:** Develop and maintain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) matrices to dictate who (or what) can read, write, modify, or execute datasets and models.

* **Principle of Least Privilege:** Enforce minimum-necessary access to limit the blast radius ofdata exposure and internal threats

* **Access Architecture:** Design end-to-end authorization frameworks enforcing least-privilege and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) across Azure data estates

* **IDAM Tools Integration:** Manage integrations between IDAM Tools like Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), SailPoint, Octa etc and data platforms (Azure Data Lakes, Azure Synapse, Fabric, and Databricks, and AI/ML Platforms).

* **Lifecycle Management:** Automate access provisioning, role mapping, and de-provisioning workflows for clinical, research, and business users.

* Define, monitor & track Access Controls, risk metrics & KPIs against Data Access Management Policies.

* Identify and mitigate Data & AI-Specific access risks including Data Leakage, Unauthorized Data Exposure, etc.

* Maintain enterprise Access Management policies, standards, and control frameworks

* Ensure Secure access to enterprise data ecosystems including but not limited to: Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT Pipelines, Analytics Platforms, Data APIs, Gen AI Applications and Services.

* Ensure implementation of secure data access, encryption, masking, retention, and governance controls across Data Engineering & MLOps pipelines.

* **Conduct Data Access (IDAM) Compliance & Data Security Assessment:** Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Databricks, Snowflake, enterprise Data & AI platforms and Applications by conducting Monthly, Quarterly & Half-Yearly and Yearly Access assessment Audits

* Maintain SOPs, Runbooks and Knowledge Repositories.

* Maintain risk registers and access governance reporting mechanisms.

* Support investigations and Perform root cause analysis related to Data & AI platform access violation incidents.

* Collaborate with Business users, Application Owners, IAM teams to ensure enterprise IDAM policies implemented across Data & AI platforms.

* Closely working with AI Governance & Responsible AI central teams to align with enterprise policies and regulatory expectations.

* Implement automated compliance reporting and logging to audit how Data & AI models interact with sensitive corporate and customer data.

* Lead Compliance Initiatives aligned with ISO 27001, SOC2, GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPPA, DPDP and AI Governance Frameworks.

* Coordinate audits, assessments, and evidence management activities.

* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Risk, and Audit teams to ensure regulatory adherence.

* Contribute directly to **hands** ‑ **on capacity** to Gen AI Operations troubleshooting, and optimisation.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* **Cross-Functional Liaison:** Serve as the primary connector bridging Data Science/AI Engineering teams with Legal, Privacy, and Cybersecurity departments.

* Strong collaboration with Data & AI Operations Lead, Data & AI Security Compliance lead to ensure alignment among all services towers

* Mentor Data Engineering, Access and Operations professionals.

* Lead awareness and training programs related to Data & AI Access Management best practices.

* Escalate and remove blockers in a complex, matrix organisation, engaging senior stakeholders as required.

* Act as the primary point of contact for Data & AI Platform Access Management Programs.

* Drive user adoption, service awareness, training coordination, and feedback management.

* Ensure Timely Communication to stakeholders during Access Control Shortfalls, High Impact Incidents and Changes.

* Support AI Governance and Responsible AI processes through engagement with **Architecture Review Boards and AI/ML Architects**

Ensuring close alignment to internal & external regulatory and compliance requirements, Access Governance & Data Lifecycle Audits with no critical or high findings or violation against them.  



**Key Skills:**

* Identity & Access Management

* AI & GenAI Data Security

* Access Compliance & Governance

* Data Platform & Cloud Security

* Access Risk Management

* Regulatory Compliance

* Security, Risk and Compliance Audit Management

Stakeholder Management  



**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

* 10+ Years of experience in:

* Identity & Access Management

* Enterprise Data Security

* Compliance and Governance

* Proven track record of enterprise IAM and IDAM policies.

* Strong understanding of SSO, Tokenized Access, PAM (privileged access Management)

* Knowledge of at least one IDAM / IAM tool wiz Okta, Sailpoint, Cyberarc, Microsoft Entra ID etc

* Strong experience in representing the organization to Internal and External Access Management, Risk and Compliance Audits.

* Strong Experience with Enterprise Data, AI and Analytics Ecosystem

* Hands On Experience with Data Platforms, AI/ML or Generative AI Security.

* Knowledge of DevSecOps, MLOps, CI/CD, API security, and container security.

* Deep understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)

* Strong strategic and operational leadership skills.

* Excellent communication and executive presentation abilities.

* Ability to influence global cross-functional teams.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Passion for emerging technologies, cybersecurity innovation, and responsible AI governance.  



**Job Posting End Date**

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-261745 **Date posted** 10/13/2026

**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**

**GCL: F**

**Location: Chennai**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.

**Accountabilities:**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. title: Manager, Data Analysis
description:
Requisition Number: 63962

Job Location: Chennai, IND

Global Grade: Band 7

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 13/10/2026

Posting End Date: 31/10/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
  
• Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
  
• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• SQL Querying skills
  
• Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
  
• Banking domain knowledge
  
**Other Skills**  
• AML knowledge
  
• Interpersonal skills
  
• Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills and Eligibility**  
• Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
  
• Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
  
• A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
  
• Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
  
• The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
  
• Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
  
• Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
  
• Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
  
• Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
  
• Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
  
• High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
  
• Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

**About Standard Chartered**

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. * Lead the design and delivery of enterprise LLM applications, agents, complex skills, and AI apps that create measurable business value across the firm
