title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.
* Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.
* Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.
* Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.
* Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.
* Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.
* Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
* Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.
* Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.
* Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.
* Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.
* Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.
* Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.
* Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.
* Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.
* Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
  
  
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
  
  
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
  
  
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
  
  
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 13, 2026 - October 26, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Staff Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Lead / Architect to own the architecture and technical direction of enterprise data, integration, and automation platforms built around Snowflake, AWS, Salesforce, APIs, and modern cloud technologies.This is not a purely advisory architecture role. The ideal candidate is a strong technical builder who can translate business requirements into scalable architectures, establish engineering standards, make key technology decisions, and work directly with engineers to deliver production-grade solutions.You will provide technical leadership across data engineering, system integrations, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and enterprise applications. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Integration Engineers, AI Engineers, Product Managers, Security, and business stakeholders to build reliable platforms that connect enterprise systems and make trusted data available across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

### **Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across Snowflake, AWS, Salesforce, APIs, integrations, and enterprise applications
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans
* Define architectural patterns, engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and technical guardrails

* Provide hands-on technical guidance to Data Engineers, Integration Engineers, AI Engineers, and other engineering teams
* Evaluate new technologies and determine where they should fit within the enterprise technology landscape
* Identify and reduce technical debt while balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform strategy

### **Snowflake & Data Architecture**

* Design scalable Snowflake architectures supporting analytics, operational reporting, integrations, and AI use cases
* Define data modeling, ingestion, transformation, serving, and data-sharing patterns
* Establish standards for database, schema, table, warehouse, and role design
* Design efficient ELT/ETL architectures for batch, near-real-time, and event-driven workloads
* Drive Snowflake performance optimization, workload management, and cost governance
* Define patterns for secure data access, RBAC, data masking, auditing, and governance
* Guide the use of Snowpark, Cortex, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and other Snowflake capabilities where appropriate

### **AWS & Cloud Architecture**

* Design cloud-native architectures using AWS services
* Define patterns for compute, storage, networking, messaging, event processing, secrets management, and observability
* Architect event-driven and serverless solutions using services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, and related AWS technologies
* Ensure architectures meet enterprise requirements for security, availability, disaster recovery, and scalability
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and environment-management standards

### **Salesforce & Enterprise Integration**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce, Snowflake, AWS, and other enterprise platforms
* Define patterns for Salesforce API, Bulk API, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and event-driven integrations
* Design reliable synchronization strategies between operational systems and analytical platforms
* Establish API-first and event-driven integration standards
* Define canonical data models and integration contracts for shared enterprise entities
* Ensure integrations include appropriate retry, reconciliation, monitoring, and failure-recovery mechanisms

### **API & Integration Architecture**

* Define standards for REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven integrations, and asynchronous processing
* Establish reusable integration frameworks and common service patterns
* Design API authentication, authorization, rate limiting, versioning, observability, and lifecycle management
* Ensure integrations are loosely coupled, resilient, and independently scalable
* Drive standardization of logging, tracing, alerting, and error-handling patterns

### **Security, Governance & Reliability**

* Embed security and governance requirements into architecture from the beginning
* Design RBAC, secrets management, encryption, audit logging, and data protection patterns
* Partner with Security and Compliance teams on enterprise controls
* Define availability, reliability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational support standards
* Establish architecture and engineering practices that support production observability and incident response

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Conduct design and code reviews for critical components
* Mentor engineers and raise engineering standards across teams
* Define CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, and release-management practices
* Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, decision records, and implementation standards
* Drive proof-of-concepts when evaluating new technologies or architectural approaches

**What You'll Bring**

  

* 8+ years of software, data, platform, or integration engineering experience
* 3+ years in a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect capacity
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and modern data architectures
* Strong AWS architecture and engineering experience
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise data and application platforms
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and integration patterns
* Experience designing scalable ETL/ELT and data-processing platforms
* Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python
* Experience designing secure enterprise systems using RBAC, encryption, secrets management, and audit controls
* Experience with CI/CD, Git, infrastructure-as-code, and modern DevOps practices
* Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives from architecture through production delivery

**Nice-to-Have**

  

* Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Snowpark, Streams, Tasks, and Dynamic Tables
* Experience with Salesforce Platform Events and Change Data Capture
* Experience with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, and Step Functions
* Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience designing platforms supporting AI/ML or agentic AI workloads
* Experience with data governance, lineage, observability, and quality platforms
* Snowflake, AWS, or Salesforce certifications are a plus  
    
  Technical Skills
* Snowflake Architecture & Engineering
* AWS Cloud Architecture
* Salesforce Integration
* Data Architecture & Data Modeling
* REST APIs & Enterprise Integration
* Event-Driven Architecture
* Python & SQL
* ETL / ELT Architecture

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Software Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of a multi-tenant AI platform, including the integration bus, semantic layer, agent runtime, workflow engine, and data stores. The role requires expertise in distributed systems, enterprise integrations, AI agents, scalability, and security.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target architecture and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* Finalize the durable workflow engine, tenancy model, and data-store boundaries within the first two weeks.
* Design and build the semantic resolution engine with AI engineers, translating plain-language definitions into systems, tools, and access rights.
* Define API contracts, event schemas, adapter contracts, supervisor graph state schemas, and security standards.
* Conduct design reviews, unblock engineers, and review critical code.
* Own scalability, tenant isolation, latency, data retention, disaster recovery, and load testing.
* Ensure the platform supports up to 10,000 concurrent runs.
* Collaborate with pilot customers' architects and security teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience designing and shipping scalable, multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, durable workflows, sagas, Kafka, idempotency, back-pressure, and failure handling.
* Expertise in relational, in-memory, and vector databases.
* Production experience with LLM-based systems, tool calling, agent orchestration, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, RAG, and evaluation.
* Enterprise integration experience with CRM, ERP, and legacy systems using REST, SOAP, JDBC, and file-based integrations.
* Strong understanding of B2B security architecture, RBAC, tenant isolation, secrets management, and PII handling.
* Hands-on coding experience and the ability to make and explain critical architecture decisions.

**Good to Have**

* Production experience with Temporal.
* Experience with Apache Camel or similar integration frameworks.
* Kubernetes operations at scale.
* Published technical talks, research papers, or open-source contributions.

**Key Focus Areas**

* Multi-tenancy and enterprise security
* Distributed systems and durable workflow execution
* AI agents, semantic resolution, and RAG
* Enterprise integrations and data architecture
* Scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery

title: Global Product Owner and Delivery Lead for Printing Services
description:
***Job Title:*** *Global Product Owner and Delivery Lead for Printing Services*

* *Location; Hyderabad, India*
* *Job type: Full time*

*About Sanofi*

*At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.*

*Our Team: Global Services & Experience – Devices Management*

*The Digital Workplace Services team is at the heart of Sanofi's employee experience and productivity. We design, deliver, and operate the foundational technology services that enable seamless work experiences for over 100,000 employees across 70+ countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent service delivery, user-centric design, and world-class platform management.*

*We're responsible for core services and products that sustain employee productivity and day-to-day operations, covering Office (Multi-Functional Printers) ans M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers), print platform management, managed service vendor governance, and the technology roadmap that powers secure and efficient printing across Sanofi's global footprint. We don't just manage printers—we architect the future of how Sanofi employees print, scan, and share documents, ensuring every device, platform, and service interaction is optimized for performance, security, cost-efficiency, and sustainability.*

*Role Overview*

*As Global Delivery Manager for Printing Services, you will be a strategic leader and hands-on operational manager responsible for evolving Sanofi's global Office Printing Services into a secure, cost-optimized, and future-ready foundation. This is not a traditional printer support role—this is a strategic operational leadership position that bridges vendor governance, product ownership, financial management, platform oversight, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.*

*You will own the end-to-end delivery of Office Printing Services globally, drive vendor performance excellence, and champion the transformation from reactive device support to intelligent, data-driven print operations. You'll work at the intersection of managed services, device lifecycle management, print platform management, and modern security frameworks, building partnerships with the global managed service provider and internal stakeholders to deliver world-class printing experiences across all Sanofi sites.*

*This role demands a proactive problem-solver who can negotiate, architect, analyze, and lead—someone equally comfortable managing multi-million-dollar budgets, defining technology roadmaps, optimizing print costs, and collaborating with Security and Compliance teams to implement secure print practices. You will drive operational excellence while challenging the status quo and identifying opportunities for automation, cost reduction, and service innovation.*

*Main Responsibilities*

***Managed Service Vendor Governance & Contract Management***

* *Lead the global managed services contract for Office and M&S Printing Services, ensuring the vendor delivers against agreed SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments across all Sanofi locations*
* *Define, monitor, and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the managed service provider, conducting monthly/quarterly business reviews and driving corrective actions for under performance*
* *Act as the primary escalation point for vendor performance issues, service disruptions, and contract disputes, coordinating resolution with internal stakeholders and vendor leadership*
* *Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance teams on contract renewals, amendments, pricing negotiations, and vendor performance assessments*
* *Ensure the managed service provider adheres to Sanofi's security, compliance, data protection, and operational standards for all printing services*
* *Manage vendor relationship at a strategic level, fostering partnership and continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for service delivery*

***Budget Management & Financial Governance***

* *Own and manage the global budget for Office and M&S Printing Services, including hardware, software, managed services fees, consumables, and maintenance costs*
* *Develop annual budget forecasts in collaboration with Finance, tracking actuals vs. budget monthly and providing variance analysis and corrective action plans*
* *Optimize cost efficiency through vendor negotiations, consumption analysis, and identification of cost-saving opportunities (e.g., print policy optimization, device rationalization, etc.)*
* *Approve purchase orders, invoices, and financial commitments related to printing services within delegated authority*
* *Provide regular financial reporting to Digital leadership and Finance stakeholders, including cost per page, total cost of ownership (TCO), and ROI metrics*

***Service Quality & Operational Delivery***

* *Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of Office (Multi-Functional Printers) and M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers) across all Sanofi sites globally, meeting or exceeding service quality targets*
* *Monitor service performance metrics including device uptime, incident resolution time, user satisfaction (CSAT), and service request fulfillment rates*
* *Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service reliability, user experience, and operational efficiency*
* *Oversee incident and problem management processes for printing services, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis for recurring issues*
* *Coordinate with regional Digital teams and site stakeholders to address location-specific service needs and escalations*
* *Conduct regular service quality audits and site visits (virtual or physical) to validate vendor performance and identify improvement opportunities*

***Product Ownership & Technology Roadmap***

* *Serve as the Product Owner for Office and M&S Printing Services, defining the strategic vision, product roadmap, and technology evolution aligned with Sanofi's Digital strategy*
* *Gather and prioritize requirements from business stakeholders, Digital teams, and end users to inform product development and service enhancements*
* *Define and maintain the technology roadmap for printing services, including hardware refresh cycles, software upgrades, security enhancements, and new capability introductions (e.g., mobile printing, secure print release, cloud printing)*
* *Evaluate emerging printing technologies and industry trends, making recommendations for adoption or pilot programs to enhance service value*
* *Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure printing solutions align with Sanofi's technical standards and security policies*
* *Manage the product backlog, prioritizing initiatives based on business value, risk, cost, and strategic alignment*

***Platform Management (Outsourced)***

* *Oversee the managed service provider's delivery of platform management services, including print server infrastructure, print management software, and monitoring tools*
* *Define platform performance requirements, availability targets, and technical standards for the outsourced printing platform*
* *Ensure the vendor maintains platform security, applies patches and updates, and adheres to Sanofi's change management and incident management processes*
* *Coordinate with the vendor on platform upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects, ensuring minimal disruption to end users*
* *Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance metrics, escalating issues and driving resolution with the vendor*
* *Validate disaster recovery and business continuity plans for the printing platform, ensuring resilience and compliance with Sanofi's IT standards*

***Stakeholder Management & Communication***

* *Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Digital, Finance, Procurement, and business functions globally*
* *Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all Office and M&S Printing Services matters, providing consultative guidance to stakeholders*
* *Communicate service updates, planned maintenance, incidents, and roadmap changes proactively to stakeholders through regular updates and governance forums*
* *Represent Printing Services in Digital governance meetings, Digital leadership forums, and cross-functional planning sessions*
* *Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication, issue escalation, and post-incident reporting*
* *Act as the voice of the customer within the vendor relationship, translating business needs into service requirements and holding the vendor accountable for delivery*

***Compliance, Security & Risk Management***

* *Ensure printing services comply with Sanofi's information security policies, data protection regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and industry standards*
* *Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to implement secure printing practices, including user authentication, print release, and data encryption*
* *Conduct regular risk assessments for printing services, identifying and mitigating risks related to data leakage, service availability, and vendor dependency*
* *Ensure vendor compliance with Sanofi's audit requirements, providing documentation and evidence for internal and external audits*

***Service Scope Management***

* *Own and communicate the Office and M&S Printing Services scope boundary: Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs) for office environments, including print, scan, copy, and fax capabilities and M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers)*
* *Proactively manage scope creep risks, escalating and resolving boundary disputes with stakeholders and the vendor*

*About You*

***Required Qualifications***

* *Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field*
* *Experience: Minimum 8–10 years of experience in IT service delivery, managed services, or vendor management roles*
* *Global Service Management: Minimum 3–5 years of experience managing global Digital services or infrastructure platforms*
* *Contract & Budget Management: Proven track record of managing large-scale managed service contracts, including budget accountability (multi-million dollar contracts preferred)*
* *Product Ownership: Demonstrated experience in product ownership, roadmap definition, or platform management*
* *Vendor Management: Experience managing third-party vendors or managed service providers in a global, multi-site environment*
* *Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Office Printing technologies, including Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs), M&S Printing technologies, including (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers), and print servers, print management software, and mobile/cloud printing solutions*
* *ITSM Knowledge: Proficiency in IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, particularly ITIL, including incident, problem, change, and service level management*
* *Financial Acumen: Strong budget management and financial analysis skills, including forecasting, variance analysis, and cost optimization*
* *Product Management: Ability to define and manage technology roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and balance business value with technical feasibility*
* *Roadmap Definition: Ability to define and manage technology roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and balance business value with technical feasibility*
* *Platform Management: Understanding of platform management concepts, including infrastructure, monitoring, security, and disaster recovery*
* *Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)*

***Preferred Qualifications***

* *Advanced Education: Master's degree in relevant field or MBA*
* *Skills: ITIL Foundation or ITIL Expert certification; Product Management or Agile Product Owner certification , or relevant printing certifications*
* *Print Domain Expertise: Specific experience in Office Printing Services, Multi-Functional Printers (MFPs), M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers) or print management platforms (e.g., LMS, PaperCut, Equitrac, PrinterLogic, or similar)*
* *Cloud Printing: Knowledge of cloud printing solutions and mobile printing technologies*
* *ITSM Tools: Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools*
* *Compliance: Understanding of data security and compliance requirements for printing services (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)*
* *Agile Methodology: Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management frameworks*
* *Language: Additional local language proficiency (Telugu/Hindi) is advantageous for Hyderabad site engagement. English is mandatory.*
* *AI & Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI-assisted automation*

***Preferred Skills:***

* *Output management Solutions, e.g. LRS Output management and Printing solutions in office and industrial environments*
* *Experience in Agile*
* *Problem-solving and analytical thinking*
* *Collaboration and communication in international teams and with stakeholders*
* *Network and Cloud Knowledge*

***Leadership Competencies***

* *Proactive & Strategic: Self-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement and innovation*
* *Problem-Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex operational, financial, and technical issues and architect scalable solutions*
* *Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to articulate technical and financial concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders*
* *Collaboration & Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional teams across time zones and cultures*
* *Vendor Management Excellence: Strong negotiation skills with ability to hold vendors accountable while fostering collaborative partnerships*
* *Change Leadership: Comfortable challenging the status quo, driving transformation, and managing resistance to change*
* *Results-Oriented: Track record of delivering high-impact outcomes in fast-paced, dynamic environments with measurable KPIs*
* *Financial Discipline: Strong budget management discipline, including cost-per-page optimization, TCO analysis, and print cost reduction strategies*

*Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary*

*Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.*

description:

Job Category

Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Role Summary**

This is a core investigative role on the team responsible for handling customer cybersecurity incidents — offering a unique opportunity to fight threat actors at scale. The job is investigation: driving incidents from raw log data to a defensible account of what actually happened, what the threat actor touched, and what was at risk. We want a strong, independent analyst — someone who runs to the data, builds a solid timeline from imperfect evidence, and doesn't need a senior sitting next to them to get to the answer on a well-understood incident. We are looking for people who raise the bar — if you see a broken process, you fix it; if you encounter a repetitive task, you automate it. The right person is comfortable veering from the documented playbook when an incident's attributes don't fit it — and disciplined enough to document why. Operational coordination and customer work sit on top of that investigative foundation. If you want to be right in the middle of the action fighting threat actors at scale, this is where you want to be. If you can own an investigation end-to-end and know when a case is genuinely novel enough to pull in help, this role is built for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the analysis on investigations independently — take multi-source datasets (Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), SQL) and reconstruct what the threat actor did, what they accessed, and what was at risk, across varying Salesforce products.
* Adapt the investigative approach when standard playbook procedures don't map cleanly to the incident — document the deviation and the rationale rather than working around it silently.
* Perform log analysis independently: multi-source joins, regex parsing, and hypothesis-driven pivoting across data sources — needing no assistance beyond peer review.
* Scope advanced exfiltration patterns (Aura, GraphQL, Bulk API) on well-documented TTP types without requiring senior guidance.
* Produce accurate, complete case documentation and investigation timelines; review your own case work end-to-end before submission, catching gaps proactively rather than relying on peer review — and contribute to customer-facing reports.
* Lead investigations into ATO, credential compromise, data exfiltration, and API abuse incidents; escalate genuinely novel or multi-cloud/complex cases to a Technical Lead.
* Execute containment actions independently (credential rotation, IP blocks, OAuth revocation); escalate strategic or platform-level actions (deployment moratoriums, platform cuts) for approval and appropriate stakeholder coordination.
* Interact directly with customers through our case management system and lead standard, non-hostile customer calls — explaining log data and delivering complex technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences without requiring a senior team member on the call.
* Prepare comms requests with enough technical detail that the comms team can act on them without follow-up clarification.
* Proactively identify detection opportunities and gaps surfaced during analysis — partnering with Detection Engineering to tune existing coverage and raise net-new detection logic.
* Identify procedural gaps or friction during investigations — actively documenting updates to fix broken processes and automating repetitive workflows.
* Complete AppExchange audits and ISV investigations without senior supervision on standard cases.
* Share knowledge with the team on a regular cadence — case walkthroughs, team presentations, or documentation contributions.
* Support our AI-first initiatives — use and help improve automated agents for triage, documentation, and investigation workflows.
Build working relationships across ITM/SSRC — Detection, Product Security, Legal — and leverage them to accelerate incident resolution.  

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in security incident response with consistent hands-on technical case work; currently performing active investigations, not purely coordinating.
* Strong, independent analytical skill under pressure. Demonstrated ability to take multi-source data and produce a correct, defensible account of incidents without hand-holding.
* Proficient log analysis — Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), and SQL, including multi-source joins and regex parsing — performed independently, with no more than peer review.
* Hands-on threat hunting — able to run hypothesis-driven hunts across large security datasets (NG-SIEM, Splunk) to surface malicious activity that isn't yet alerting, and pivot what you find into an active investigation.
* Solid hands-on experience with Account Takeover, credential compromise, data exfiltration, and API abuse incidents.
* Proactive "raise the bar" mindset — a track record of fixing inefficient processes, automating manual toil, and looking for ways to leave workflows better than you found them.
* Strong technical knowledge across systems, networks, cloud security, and forensic techniques.
* Demonstrated composure and judgment across multiple concurrent investigations.
* Strong familiarity with Salesforce products/ecosystems, or comparable multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Ability to lead standard customer calls and communicate complex technical findings to non-technical audiences clearly.
* Working familiarity with regional and global compliance standards (GDPR, PCI-DSS, DORA).
* Ability to drive an investigation to a clear, defensible outcome and coordinate across functions.
* Desired Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
* Software development and/or detection engineering background — comfortable writing code/scripts to extend tooling, automate repetitive investigative tasks, build agentic workflows, or translate findings into detection logic. Day-to-day this role tunes rather than owns detections (see leveling note), so this is a force-multiplier, not a core requirement.
* Prior experience operating within a large, global enterprise organization or high-scale SOC/IR environment.
* Salesforce Admin certified.
* Experience with forensic cases involving large or unusual datasets.
* Hands-on experience with AI/automation tooling in security operations (automated triage, detection tuning, agentic workflows).
* Certifications such as SANS GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, OSCP, or equivalent (or actively working toward one).
* Experience with cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Familiarity with Marketing Cloud and Commerce Cloud log analysis and incident patterns.

**Implement Data Quality Controls and Release Quality Gates**

* Implement automated controls for data accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, referential integrity, schema drift, freshness, lineage, tenant isolation, and authorized data usage.
* Monitor for anomalous data volumes, distributions, and quality trends throughout ingestion, processing, and consumption layers.
* Integrate automated testing and regression suites into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish automated quality gates that support reliable and secure software releases.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark, or PySpark.

* Experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation to testing, data profiling, anomaly detection, log analysis, or defect triage.

* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

**Then we want to** **meet** **you!**

title: Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Integration Engineer to design, build, and operate reliable integrations across Salesforce, Snowflake, AWS, enterprise SaaS platforms, internal

The ideal candidate is an API-focused engineer who understands how to connect complex enterprise systems using REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, message queues, and data synchronization patterns. This role will be responsible for building the integration layer that allows enterprise applications and data platforms to communicate reliably, securely, and at scale.

**What You'll Do**

Enterprise Integration Development

* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Salesforce, Snowflake, AWS, and enterprise SaaS applications
* Develop reusable integration services and frameworks
* Build synchronous and asynchronous integration workflows
* Implement reliable system-to-system data synchronization
* Develop integration logic for high-volume enterprise workloads
* Design integrations that support retries, replay, reconciliation, idempotency, and failure recovery

API Development & Integration

* Build and consume REST APIs and webhooks
* Design reusable API clients and integration libraries
* Implement authentication patterns including OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWT, and service credentials
* Handle API pagination, throttling, rate limits, retries, and transient failures
* Develop API versioning and backward-compatibility strategies
* Implement structured request/response validation and error handling
* Build monitoring and logging around API interactions

Salesforce Integration

* Build integrations using Salesforce REST API, Bulk API, Composite API, and other Salesforce APIs

* Handle standard objects, custom objects, relationships, and Salesforce schema changes
* Build scalable synchronization between Salesforce and Snowflake
* Implement data reconciliation and exception-handling processes
* Ensure integrations respect Salesforce API limits and platform constraints

Snowflake Integration

* Build integrations that read from and write to Snowflake
* Develop efficient bulk and incremental data-loading patterns
* Build Snowflake-based staging and reconciliation processes
* Integrate operational applications with curated Snowflake datasets
* Implement secure Snowflake connectivity and role-based access
* Work with Data Engineers to define appropriate data contracts and interfaces
* Support Snowflake-driven downstream workflows and automation

AWS & Event-Driven Integration

* Build integrations using AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, and Step Functions
* Design event-driven and asynchronous workflows
* Implement queues and dead-letter queues for reliable message processing
* Build serverless integration services
* Implement event routing, filtering, transformation, and delivery patterns
* Design integrations for horizontal scalability and failure isolation

Integration Reliability

* Implement idempotency to prevent duplicate processing
* Build retry strategies with appropriate backoff and failure handling
* Implement dead-letter queues and replay mechanisms
* Build reconciliation jobs to identify missing or inconsistent records
* Design graceful handling for downstream outages and API failures

* Participate in troubleshooting and production incident resolution

Security & Governance

* Implement secure authentication and authorization for integrations

* Apply least-privilege access principles
* Ensure sensitive information is encrypted in transit and at rest
* Implement audit logging for system interactions

* Implement centralized logging for integration services
* Build metrics and alerts for failures, latency, throughput, and queue depth
* Implement distributed tracing where appropriate
* Create operational dashboards and runbooks
* Proactively identify integration degradation before it impacts downstream users
* Support production integrations and participate in incident root-cause analysis

Engineering Excellence

* Write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable code
* Develop automated unit and integration tests
* Participate in architecture and code reviews
* Maintain API documentation, integration mappings, and technical runbooks
* Build CI/CD pipelines for integration services
* Contribute reusable components to the enterprise integration framework

* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems

* Experience with event-driven architectures, queues, and messaging systems

title: Global Banking & Markets, Mortgage Loan Engineering Lead, Vice President, Mumbai
description:
The Mortgage Loan Engineering Team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM Private) is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting robust, scalable applications for mortgage structured products on behalf of our businesses and clients. Our core focus is building highly scalable systems to drive and support the expansion of the lending business within the Capital Solutions Group (CSG) and GBM Private.

This dual-functional role offers a unique opportunity to act as the GS India Finance Limited (GIFL) IT Entity Lead and technical driver. You will collaborate directly with GBM Private businesses, strats, and front-to-back engineering teams in GBM, utilizing a cutting-edge technology stack while navigating the complex regulatory, operational, and financial landscape of the Indian market.

  

**Role Overview**

You will oversee the design, development, and governance of strategic reporting platforms, data pipelines, and internal regulatory applications. Concurrently, you will serve as the primary IT administrative and regulatory contact for the GIFL entity.

Your contributions will directly ensure structural and technical compliance with key regulatory bodies—such as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)—while modernizing financial operations, leading legacy systems migration, integrating enterprise data lakes, and leveraging state-of-the-art AI-assisted development tools.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Reporting & Data Engineering**

* Design, optimize, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines to ingest complex financial products (including corporate and mortgage loans, commercial paper, and debt instruments) from distributed enterprise data repositories and data lakes.
* Implement automated reporting frameworks for core business metrics, including Asset Classification (days-past-due calculations), Statements of Account (historical and projected cash flows), and Secured Borrowing Monitoring (portfolio concentration risk).
* Transition legacy operations into platform-independent, single-click executable workflows to systematically retire redundant applications and manual processes.
* Establish secure, automated connectivity with enterprise data lakes utilizing cloud-native events and secure file transfer mechanisms.

**2. Software Modernization & AI-Driven Development**

* Modernize legacy core business applications by leading enterprise framework migrations (such as upgrading legacy Java and Spring Boot applications).
* Leverage cutting-edge AI software engineering assistants and generative AI coding tools to accelerate codebase refactoring, dependency upgrades, and code quality.
* Drive security migrations from legacy internal authentication systems to robust, industry-standard single-sign-on (SSO) and OAuth protocols.
* Architect complex regulatory compliance workflow portals and tracking databases using enterprise low-code platforms.

**3. IT Governance, Regulatory Compliance, & Audits**

* Serve as the primary IT contact for local regulatory inquiries, managing timely compliance responses and gap analyses against updated IT outsourcing guidelines and directives.
* Drive technical preparation and map deliverables for internal and external IT audits, deploying real-time data reconciliation engines to secure clean, issue-free audit outcomes.
* Prepare and present IT operational, cybersecurity, and compliance metrics to the IT Strategy Board of Directors on a quarterly cycle.
* Manage recurring access certifications, capacity-utilization audits, and tracking of committed technical remediation deliverables.

**4. Production Support & Optimization**

* Enhance API retrieval speeds through multithreading, multiprocessing, and database query optimization.
* Maintain robust, automated synchronization between core internal databases and external asset management or vendor systems.
* Architect scalable, high-performance data schemas supporting both single-tenant and multi-tenant structures.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Min. 8 years of working experience and deep proficiency in Java or Python, with hands-on experience executing complex framework migrations. Familiarity with modern web technologies (such as HTML5, JavaScript, React/Redux, and JSON).
* Hands-on experience driving Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) efficiency using modern generative AI-assisted programming tools.
* Strong track record working with cloud ecosystem services, automated data-ingestion pipelines, secure file transfer protocols, and modern data lakehouse architectures.
* Experience building enterprise compliance portals and workflows using professional low-code development platforms.
* Expertise in multithreaded API optimization, relational and NoSQL databases, proprietary querying and modeling environments, and modern authentication frameworks.
* Strong experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), and standard build automation and scripting tools.
* Familiarity with local financial market regulations, specifically IT outsourcing standards, insider trading prevention, and structured regulatory digital tracking requirement is highly desirable.
* Exceptional communication and relationship-management skills with a proven track record of collaborating with executive board members, external regulators, internal control groups, and front-office desks.

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Architect Manager, Data & AI (GenAI) — Tax Automations & Innovation
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Tax Technology Automations & Innovation team — known internally as the AI Team — builds the automations, Generative AI, and internal tooling that let DoorDash's global Tax function scale as the business grows across the US, Canada, and — through Wolt and Deliveroo — internationally. We turn manual, repetitive tax work into reliable, governed software, and we bring modern AI into the heart of how a tax function operates — responsibly, and with auditability built in. The team is organised into an AI Strategy function and three regional pillars: EMEA, US & Canada, and Coffee & Special Projects.

This role sits in the AI Strategy function and reports to the Tax Technology lead. You will set the technical and AI direction the three regional pillars build around, and partner across Tax, Tax Tech, Data Operations, Accounting, Product, and Engineering, as well as InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.

**About the Role**
------------------

DoorDash is looking for a senior-level AI and data expert to lead how the Tax department operates through automation, Generative AI, and intelligent data tooling. Beyond building high-impact automation, you will set the strategy for how LLMs, GenAI, and machine learning are integrated into critical tax workflows at scale, and act as the AI authority for the function.

This is the role that makes the entire team AI-native rather than merely AI-assisted. By owning the AI and automation governance framework, you will also ensure that everything the team builds on top of sensitive tax data stays controlled, defensible, and audit-ready. You don't just build — you set the bar, mentor the regional teams, and decide how we adopt a fast-moving technology responsibly.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Define and lead the GenAI strategy for the Tax function, identifying high-value use cases and setting adoption standards.
* Architect and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions — intelligent assistants, AI-driven classification, anomaly detection, automated audit support, document summarization, and retrieval-augmented reporting.
* Own the AI and automation governance framework — model risk, change control, testing and validation standards, documentation, and auditability for tools that touch tax data and filings.
* Set the rules for responsible, controlled AI use, including data privacy, data residency, and what data may be sent to external model providers, partnering with InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.
* Partner with senior Tax, Product, and Engineering leaders to drive requirements and deliver measurable business impact.
* Mentor the Senior Analysts and Associate Managers across all regional pillars on applying GenAI/LLMs effectively and within governance guardrails.
* Quantify, track, and communicate the business impact of AI solutions (efficiency gains, error reduction, compliance risk mitigation).

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AI, GenAI, and data automation, delivering production-grade solutions at scale.
* You have deep expertise in LLMs and GenAI techniques — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation frameworks, conversational AI, classification, and summarization.
* You are advanced in Python and SQL and have built scalable AI and automation pipelines.
* You have a strong background in automation and applied analytics, ideally in tax, finance, or regulated industries.
* You have deployed AI in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Databricks.
* You have expertise in AI governance, compliance, and risk management for regulated environments.
* You can translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive tools for non-technical users, and influence at all levels from hands-on teams to executives.
* You have a Bachelor's degree or higher.
* You have (preferably) knowledge of tax technology platforms or experience with global tax teams
* You have (preferably) experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or e-commerce company.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling our test automation ecosystem — owning quality end-to-end, from test design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust, reliable, and release-ready at all times.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Design, build & maintain** scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG.

* **Own test strategy** for assigned squads — defining scope, coverage, and risk from requirements through production.

* **Write BDD feature files** (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product stakeholders.

* **Implement TDD practices** — writing tests before or alongside code to drive quality in development cycles.

* **Integrate automated suites** into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback.

* **Perform API testing** and validate end-to-end user journeys across web and services.

* **Identify, document & triage defects** with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis.

* **Mentor junior QA engineers** and champion quality best practices across the engineering org.

* **Continuously evaluate** test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps — iterating to keep automation suite trustworthy.

  

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* **3+ years** of hands-on experience in QA automation in a product engineering environment.

* Strong proficiency with **Selenium WebDriver** — page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing.

* Solid experience with **Cucumber (BDD)** — writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks.

* Hands-on with **TestNG** — test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, and reporting.

* Working knowledge of **TDD principles** and integrating tests into agile development workflows.

* Proficiency in at least one programming language — **Java or Python** preferred.

* Experience with **CI/CD integration** and running tests in automated pipelines.

* Strong analytical thinking with an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes.

* Excellent communication skills — ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

  

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* **Domain knowledge in Payments** — understanding of payment flows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems.

* Experience testing **APIs** with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar.

* Familiarity with **performance / load testing** tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6).

* Exposure to **cloud testing environments** (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm).

* Knowledge of **security testing** basics relevant to financial or transactional systems.

* Experience with **mobile automation** (Appium or similar).

  

**The Mindset We Value**
========================

Beyond technical skills, we hire for how you think and operate:

  

* **Ownership mindset** — you treat quality as your personal responsibility, not a sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and see bugs as a systemic problem to solve.

* **Shift-left thinking** — you involve yourself in requirements and design discussions, not just execution phase.

* **Bias for automation** — if something is tested manually more than twice, you ask how to automate it.

* **Collaborative** — you work with developers as partners, not adversaries, and build shared ownership of quality.

* **Continuous improvement** — you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices, improving coverage, speed, and reliability.

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.
