title: Lead AI Engagement Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.

 **Job Description**

The **Lead AI Engagement Specialist** owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.

This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.

**Where this role sits**

**Reports to:** Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

**Alignment:** Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover

**Works with:** AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required

**Owns:** The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.

**Accountable for:** Realised, measured business value — not deployment count

**What you will own**

**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**

This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.

**Strongly preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What this role is not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What success looks like**

**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How we assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

 **Additional Information**  

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Head of Banking Platforms**

The Head of Banking Platforms is responsible for establishing and scaling AI-native engineering capabilities across the organization. This role leads the adoption of modern AI-assisted software engineering practices, leveraging AI platforms, ownership of governance standards, and delivery frameworks to improve software quality, engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and product innovation.

Global Banking Technology is responsible for delivering the technology strategy, platforms, products and engineering capabilities that underpin a number of CIB’s front line value streams. title: Principal Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Principal Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Enterprise Data Platform**

**OpenSearch Anchor Expertise | Enterprise Architecture | Distributed Systems | Automation | Strategy**

**Level**

Principal DBRE

**Domain**

Enterprise Data Infrastructure and Multi-Paradigm Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Enterprise technical direction anchored in OpenSearch, distributed-systems reliability, automation platforms, cross-domain architecture, and multi-year strategy

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking a hands-on Principal DBRE to serve as the highest individual-contributor technical authority for enterprise data-platform reliability and architecture. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the required anchor expertise. The role also requires strong breadth across distributed and relational data technologies, automation, observability, capacity, resilience, and technology strategy.

The Principal DBRE defines multi-year direction, resolves consequential cross-domain architecture issues, establishes enterprise engineering principles, and influences senior engineering and executive leadership. The role guides domain specialists without requiring the individual to be the deepest expert in every database engine.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Principal DBRE is an executive-adjacent individual-contributor technical leadership role. The Principal establishes enterprise direction across multiple platform domains, resolves the most consequential architecture and reliability problems, and creates standards and investment priorities that scale across the organization.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Shapes enterprise reliability, scalability, resilience, security, cost, and lifecycle direction across distributed and relational data-platform families.

**Anchor Technical Depth**

Serves as a recognized authority in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch and distributed-systems architecture, with enough depth to lead the most consequential technical decisions.

**Cross-Domain Breadth**

Demonstrates strong experience in at least two complementary domains such as Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, and can guide specialists across unfamiliar technologies.

**Strategic Leadership**

Defines multi-year architecture principles, technical roadmaps, production-readiness expectations, and investment priorities aligned with business needs.

**Organizational Influence**

Builds alignment across senior engineers, leaders, platform teams, and application organizations through clear tradeoffs, evidence, and measurable outcomes.

**Platform Engineering**

Champions reusable automation, observability, governance, and self-service capabilities as enterprise platform products.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. Enterprise Data-Platform Architecture**
--------------------------------------------

* Define enterprise architecture principles and target-state direction anchored in OpenSearch and distributed-systems reliability.
* Guide cross-domain decisions spanning search, streaming, caching, and relational services without displacing domain specialists.
* Resolve architecture conflicts involving scalability, resilience, operability, security, cost, data movement, and lifecycle constraints.

**B. Reliability and Resilience Strategy**
------------------------------------------

* Establish enterprise production-readiness, SLI/SLO, backup, recovery, DR, capacity, lifecycle, and incident-learning principles.
* Lead the technical response and systemic review for the most consequential multi-platform failures.
* Translate recurring incidents and platform risks into architecture safeguards and prioritized investment roadmaps.

**C. Automation and Platform Engineering**
------------------------------------------

* Define the strategy for shared Python automation platforms, operational APIs/CLIs, CI/CD guardrails, validation frameworks, safe remediation, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Promote self-service and platform-as-a-product practices that reduce toil while preserving change safety and accountability.

**D. Technology Strategy and Organizational Influence**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead workload-relevant evaluation of emerging technologies, including operability, failure behavior, migration risk, performance, and total cost.
* Partner with senior engineering and executive leadership on multi-year technical direction, platform investments, and modernization decisions.
* Mentor Staff and Lead engineers, cultivate technical leadership, and improve architecture-review and decision-making quality.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 12+ years of relevant database, DBRE, SRE, platform, or distributed-systems engineering experience with Principal, Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership responsibility.
* Expert-level OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch architecture and production operations experience.
* Strong distributed-systems reasoning and meaningful production experience in at least two of Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
* Strong software-engineering and automation capability, preferably Python-based platform tooling and APIs.
* Proven ability to define multi-year technical direction, resolve cross-domain architecture problems, and influence senior engineering and executive stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of reliability, capacity, observability, lifecycle management, DR, security, and cost tradeoffs.
* Excellent written communication, technical judgment, mentorship, and organizational influence.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Breadth across both distributed and relational database technologies.
* Kubernetes stateful platforms, cloud-managed data services, hybrid architectures, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, NewSQL, stream processing, or similar emerging technologies.
* Experience influencing vendors or open-source communities and guiding major modernization programs.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Deliver an evidence-based enterprise data-platform architecture and reliability roadmap with clear priorities, ownership, and investment tradeoffs.
* Establish measurable baselines and lead material improvements in cross-platform reliability, MTTR, capacity risk, operational toil, and recovery readiness.
* Define and gain adoption of shared production-readiness, architecture-review, automation, and lifecycle-management principles.
* Guide at least one consequential platform modernization or technology decision from evaluation through an approved and supportable execution plan.
* Develop Staff and Lead technical leadership and improve cross-organizational architecture decision quality.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned.
* The Principal DBRE is not expected to be the deepest hands-on expert in every database technology; OpenSearch is the anchor expertise, supported by credible cross-domain breadth.
* This role does not replace Staff, Lead, or domain-specific subject-matter experts and operational owners.
* This role is not an executive approval authority; decisions are shaped through technical evidence, influence, and established governance.
* This role does not personally own every incident, implementation task, or operational detail; it focuses on the highest-impact cross-domain problems and systemic outcomes.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Director,DBRE
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Qualys runs one of the largest and most complex data platforms in the enterprise security industry — a massive Oracle and Exadata estate at the core, surrounded by a self-managed open-source big data fabric: Kafka, Hadoop, Cassandra, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes. These systems directly underpin the product SLAs we deliver to 10,000+ customers worldwide.

We are looking for a Director of Database Reliability Engineering who combines deep technical craft with the leadership instinct to scale a team and the builder's mindset to ship systems that eliminate toil. You don't have to be the world's leading expert in every technology on the stack — but you must carry genuine depth in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem, and the intellectual range to go deep where the situation demands it. We do not expect day-one mastery across every system; we expect depth in core areas and the proven ability to rapidly develop expertise where the platform needs it.

This role directly owns database platform operations and reliability practices, and influences adjacent infrastructure and application teams through technical credibility and cross-functional partnership. You will lead a team of ~30, serve as the final technical escalation point for the data platform, and shape the multi-year strategy for how Qualys builds, automates, and evolves its data infrastructure.

**Core Focus Areas**
====================

This is a wide-scope role. Here is how candidates should prioritize their self-evaluation:

**01** **Oracle + Distributed Systems Technical Depth** — Deep in one, strong across the other — enough to lead architecture and hold the team accountable

**02** **Data Platform Reliability & Incident Ownership** — SLOs, escalation authority, DR, predictive capacity — the foundational mandate

**03** **AI-Driven Automation & Toil Elimination** — Building and shipping agents, not just evaluating tools — measurable impact on MTTR and operational load

**04** **Team Leadership & Org Development** — Managing ~30 across ICs and managers; building culture, career ladders, and hiring bar

**05** **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization** — Oracle relationship, licensing discipline, and infrastructure cost efficiency

**What Makes This Role Unique**
===============================

* **Breadth of scope, depth of ownership** — You hold the charter for Oracle/Exadata AND the full open-source big data stack — accountable for reliability across all of it
* **Build AI systems, not just use them** — We expect shipped production tooling — AI agents, autonomous remediation, intelligent observability — not proof-of-concept demos
* **Strategy and execution in equal measure** — You will define the multi-year data platform roadmap and then make it happen — this is not a pure operations role
* **Real cross-functional influence** — Data reliability touches every product team; this role earns authority through technical credibility, not org chart position
* **A platform worth modernizing** — Battle-tested at scale, with genuine complexity — and a leadership team committed to doing it right

**What You Will Build**
=======================

Beyond running the platform, we expect this leader to leave a concrete engineering footprint. Examples of the systems we want this role to build and own:

* **AI-assisted incident triage system** — LLM-powered log analysis and alert summarization that cuts triage time from minutes to seconds
* **Autonomous remediation agents** — Self-healing workflows for common failure patterns — space exhaustion, replication lag, lock contention, consumer group lag — with safe human escalation fallback
* **Natural-language operational query interface** — Engineers ask questions in plain English; the system queries metrics, logs, and configuration state to answer
* **Predictive capacity and anomaly models** — ML-driven forecasting for Oracle tablespace growth, Kafka partition pressure, and Cassandra compaction backlog
* **Reliability-as-code pipeline gates** — Automated schema review, load test, and regression detection integrated into CI/CD so reliability issues are caught before production

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Own the Data Platform Reliability Charter**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and drive SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across Oracle, Exadata, Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, and Kubernetes-hosted data services
* Serve as the final technical escalation point for all P0/P1 incidents; lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent resolution — not workarounds
* Own disaster recovery architecture, backup integrity standards, and data durability SLAs — validated through regular DR exercises
* Establish predictive capacity planning and performance baselines across the full data platform footprint
* Drive cost efficiency and infrastructure utilization optimization — right-sizing resources, eliminating idle capacity, and building chargeback/showback visibility for leadership

**Define and Execute the Multi-Year Data Platform Strategy**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and own a multi-year DBRE roadmap — covering reliability targets, modernization priorities, platform consolidation opportunities, and AI automation milestones
* Drive platform evolution decisions: when to standardize, when to consolidate, when to retire, and when to invest in new capabilities
* Provide architectural guidance for major data platform initiatives — schema design, topology changes, new technology adoption, and migration planning
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leadership to embed reliability and cost constraints into platform direction from day one

**Go Deep on Oracle and Exadata**
---------------------------------

* Carry deep technical authority for Oracle Database (19c+), RAC, Data Guard, RMAN, and Exadata — sufficient to lead architecture reviews, diagnose production incidents, and hold senior engineers accountable
* Drive query optimization, AWR/ASH-based diagnostics, execution plan analysis, and schema design reviews for mission-critical OLTP and analytical workloads
* Manage Oracle vendor relationships with technical and commercial depth: negotiate support contracts, challenge licensing interpretations, escalate through Oracle's senior channels, and ensure Qualys negotiates from a position of knowledge
* Own Oracle licensing compliance end-to-end — a material financial and risk area requiring both engineering precision and commercial acumen
* Lead Exadata patching cadence, storage cell failure playbooks, IORM policy tuning, and hardware lifecycle planning

**Lead the Open-Source Big Data Platform**
------------------------------------------

* Architect and operate Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, and Ceph deployments — self-managed at scale, not cloud-managed services
* Apply strong distributed systems fundamentals — consensus and replication models, storage I/O patterns, network latency sensitivity, and horizontal scaling — to architectural decisions that hold under load
* Partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering on Kubernetes-native stateful workloads: operators, persistent volumes, storage class optimization, and capacity planning
* Drive standardization of runbooks, alerting, and operational playbooks across all technologies — documented, automated, no tribal knowledge

**Build AI-Powered Reliability Systems**
----------------------------------------

* Design and ship AI agents that automate tier-1 database operational toil — systems running in production with measurable impact on MTTR and alert noise
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) into operational workflows for log triage, incident summarization, runbook execution, and anomaly-triggered decision support
* Evaluate AIOps platforms and observability tooling with engineering rigor — quantify the actual value, not the vendor pitch
* Embed reliability-by-design upstream: schema review gates, load test automation, and database performance regression detection in CI/CD pipelines

**Lead and Develop the DBRE Team**
----------------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and develop ~30 DBAs, SREs, and data platform engineers across individual contributors and engineering managers
* Define hiring standards, career ladders, and team structure that attract and retain senior database and reliability talent
* Build a culture of technical rigor, blameless learning, and relentless automation — where manual toil is a bug, not a process
* Eliminate single points of knowledge failure through documentation, cross-training, and disciplined on-call rotation design
* Own workforce planning: headcount forecasting, skills gap analysis, and building specialist sub-teams as the platform evolves

**How We Measure Success**
==========================

* **Platform Availability** — SLO attainment across all data services — reduction in unplanned production incidents attributable to DBRE gaps
* **MTTA / MTTR** — Measurable improvement in time to detect and resolve incidents, accelerated by AI tooling
* **Automation Coverage** — Percentage of tier-1 operational tasks eliminated through shipped agents and tooling
* **Cost Efficiency** — Infrastructure utilization rates, Oracle licensing optimization, and idle/over-provisioned resource reduction
* **Team Health & Retention** — On-call load reduction, career growth trajectory, and senior IC/manager retention
* **Platform Strategy Execution** — Multi-year roadmap milestones delivered; capacity forecasts validated against actual growth

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Must Have**
-------------

* 15+ years in database engineering, reliability engineering, or data platform operations — with 5+ years leading multi-person teams including at least one layer of managers
* Deep expertise in Oracle or large-scale distributed data systems, with strong working knowledge across the broader ecosystem (Kafka, Cassandra, Hadoop, OpenSearch, Redis, Ceph, Kubernetes)
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals — replication and consensus models, storage I/O, network latency tradeoffs, and scaling patterns for stateful workloads — applied to real production decisions
* Shipped operational tooling or agents using LLM APIs with measurable impact (MTTR reduction, toil elimination, alert noise reduction) — production systems, not proofs of concept
* Oracle vendor relationship management — commercial negotiation, license compliance ownership, and technical escalation through Oracle's support and sales organizations
* Infrastructure cost control — hands-on experience right-sizing compute and storage, eliminating idle capacity, and building cost visibility (chargeback/showback) across database infrastructure
* Track record leading teams of 15+ engineers with both IC and manager-level reports; experience growing technical talent and building hiring bars
* Executive communication skills — translating database risk, reliability posture, and investment needs to C-suite audiences with clarity and commercial grounding
* Experience serving as final escalation point for production data platform incidents — with the technical depth to diagnose, direct, and close

**Strong Plus**
---------------

* Exadata-specific depth: IORM policy tuning, smart scan diagnostics, storage server failure recovery, and hardware lifecycle decision-making
* Kubernetes-native data platform experience with stateful workload operators (Strimzi, Cassandra Operator, OpenSearch Operator, Redis Operator)
* Experience with AIOps or observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) including custom exporter and agent development
* Familiarity with agentic integration patterns (MCP, tool-use APIs) for building AI-augmented operational toolchains
* Hands-on coding in Python, Go, or shell scripting — enough to design and ship internal tooling independently
* Background in security or compliance-adjacent industries where data integrity and auditability carry regulatory weight

**Who This Role Is For**
========================

This role is for a data platform leader who still gets pulled in by a gnarly execution plan, and who sees a recurring on-call alert as a signal that something needs to be built — then builds it. You lead by doing as much as by directing, and your team follows you because they know you have sat in their chair.

You hold Oracle's feet to the fire in a negotiation and hold your engineers to a high bar in a design review. You speak reliability to a DBA and business risk to a CFO. You don't wait to be handed a mandate — you see the gap, take the charter, and grow the team around it. You balance operating rigorously today with shaping the platform for where the business will be in three years.

If you are energized by owning something truly foundational — the data layer that everything else at Qualys depends on — and you want to build the next generation of AI-driven reliability engineering, we would like to hear from you.

**This Role Is Not For**
------------------------

* DBAs focused on ticket-based operations who are not comfortable driving architectural decisions and organizational change
* Leaders who are not hands-on in production systems — this role requires genuine technical engagement, not just team management
* Candidates whose AI experience is limited to tool adoption — we need operators who have shipped agents and measured the impact
* Candidates who need full-stack mastery on day one — we value depth in core areas and intellectual range over checklist coverage

**About Qualys**
================

Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a pioneer and leading provider of disruptive cloud-based security, compliance, and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings.

Qualys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see our EEO policy for details.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About the Role**

As a Data Scientist II, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of data science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions that address business needs and improve customer experiences. You will apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and modern AI frameworks to build reliable analytical and intelligent capabilities.

This individual contributor role participates across the data science lifecycle, from data collection and preprocessing through model development, evaluation, integration, and production support. Working with a moderate level of guidance, you will solve complex technical problems, collaborate with senior data scientists and cross-functional partners, and expand your knowledge of enterprise AI technologies, business processes, and customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Develop data science and AI solutions:** Prepare and analyze structured and unstructured data, engineer features, and contribute to predictive models, NLP and LLM solutions, RAG pipelines, intelligent assistants, and Agentic AI workflows.
* **Evaluate and improve solution quality:** Apply suitable metrics, test datasets, error analysis, experiment tracking, model validation, performance testing, and responsible AI checks to improve accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, and cost.
* **Support deployment and engineering:** Build reusable code, APIs, notebooks, pipelines, containers, model artifacts, monitoring components, and automated workflows with engineering and senior data science team members.
* **Collaborate, communicate, and maintain standards:** Translate requirements into assigned deliverables, communicate insights through visualizations, prototypes, reports, and documentation, and manage code, data, and experiments in line with security, privacy, governance, version control, responsible AI, and current ML and AI practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* **3+ years of relevant professional experience** in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, analytics, or AI-focused software development.
* Hands-on experience preparing data, conducting exploratory analysis, building features, developing models, and evaluating results for practical business problems.
* Experience contributing to at least one Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, or Agentic AI solution through development, testing, integration, or production support.
* Working knowledge of model validation, experiment design, performance metrics, data quality, and reproducible development practices.
* Ability to complete a range of technical assignments and solve moderately complex problems within established policies, procedures, and architectural patterns.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information clearly in straightforward situations.
* Strong collaboration, learning agility, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

**Technical Skills**

* **Programming and analytics:** Proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience in Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Jupyter, data preparation, feature engineering, analysis, and visualization using Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, or Power BI.
* **Machine Learning, statistics, and NLP:** Practical knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, model selection and evaluation, statistical analysis, experimentation, and foundational deep learning and NLP concepts using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or SpaCy.
* **Generative AI and Agentic AI:** Experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG, LLM evaluation, document-based use cases, tool-enabled agents, and workflow orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph, with exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, and model APIs.
* **Engineering, cloud, and governance:** Experience with reusable Python code, REST APIs, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, containers, databases, data pipelines, and cloud services, with awareness of monitoring, observability, security, privacy, cost, explainability, and responsible AI practices.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role is measured through:

* Accurate, timely, and well-documented data preparation, analysis, and reporting.
* Reliable contributions to Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI development, testing, integration, and production support.
* Measurable improvement in model or application quality, including accuracy, relevance, reliability, latency, cost, or user experience.
* Clear visualizations and actionable insights that support product and business decisions.
* Reusable, maintainable code and effective automation of repeatable data and AI workflows.
* Consistent adherence to data quality, security, governance, responsible AI, documentation, and team development standards.
* Effective collaboration with senior data scientists, engineering teams, product partners, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated growth in technical capability, business understanding, and ownership of moderately complex assignments.

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.
  
  
You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, AI & Data
description: About The TeamWe’re the company’s internal AI & Data team — a small, fast-moving pod. Our mission is to make the rest of the company dramatically more capable, using AI and Data to automate work, unlock insight, and build the tools and systems teams rely on.This role is the versatile builder who turns all of that into working software — and who can pick up whatever the moment demands.The roleYou’re a builder, full stop. You’ll work on many things — internal tools, services, interfaces, integrations, automation. You’ll move fluidly between them as priorities shift. This is deliberately a broad, flexible seat: we’re not hiring for one stack or one problem, we’re hiring someone who can build whatever the company needs next and do it well.AI is a tool in your kit, not the thing you specialize in. You don’t need to design retrieval systems or agents from scratch — but you’re comfortable working with them, wiring them into products, and shipping the software around them. Your superpower is range and reliability: you take things from idea to shipped, across the stack, without needing a narrow lane.What You’ll DoBuild across the stack. Design and ship internal tools and systems end to end — back-end services and APIs, front-end interfaces, data integrations, and the deployment and infrastructure glue that makes them real.Work on many things. Move between projects and problem types as priorities shift — one week a workflow-automation tool, the next an internal dashboard, the next helping ship an AI-powered feature. Breadth is the point.Put AI to work. Integrate the LLM, RAG, and agent capabilities the team builds into usable software, partnering closely with the Applied AI Engineer to turn intelligence into product.Enable the company. Sit with teams across the business, understand their problems, and build the right solution — measured by how much more effective you make everyone else.Ship reliably. Own what you build through to production and beyond, with the quality and judgment to know when good-enough-shipped beats perfect-delayed.What You'll BringStrong full-stack engineering. You write production-grade code and build comfortably across the stack — back end, APIs, and front end (e.g. Python and/or TypeScript with a modern web framework). You’re not boxed into one layer.Range and adaptability. A track record of picking up unfamiliar problems and shipping — you’re energized by variety, not thrown by it.Comfort with AI as a tool. You’ve worked extensively with AI — integrating APIs, building features on top of models — even if AI isn’t your specialty.A builder who talks to people. You can understand a non-technical team’s problem and turn it into a working solution. Internal enablement rewards engineers who listen as well as they build.Data fluency. Enough comfort with pipelines, databases, and structured/unstructured data to work directly with what your software touches.Autonomy in a small team. You thrive without heavy process, set your own direction, and are happy wearing whatever hat the moment calls for.Bonus pointsExperience building internal tools or platforms that other teams depend on.Cloud, DevOps, or deployment experience — CI/CD, containers, infrastructure-as-code.Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features in production.A portfolio of varied systems you’ve built end to end.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Introduction:

**About SymphonyAI**  
SymphonyAI Industrial is a global leader in Industrial AI, enabling manufacturers and asset-intensive enterprises to transform fragmented IT, OT, and edge data into real-time, contextual intelligence that improves uptime, throughput, and operational efficiency.

Job Description:

**About the Role**

Build technical depth while providing dependable customer support across SymphonyAI Industrial products. This is the foundational engineering level, focused on disciplined triage, clear customer communication, accurate documentation, and resolution of common issues with guidance from more experienced engineers.

This role participates in both Level 1 (L1) and Level 2 (L2) support activities based on business need, skill, access, and incident priority. The role also participates in the 24/7 on-call rotation and responds to assigned incidents within applicable service-level targets and escalation procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Customer Support and Incident Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.
* Perform L1 triage and resolve common L1 and L2 issues using documented procedures, known solutions, and guidance from senior engineers.
* Collect complete diagnostic information, reproduce issues when feasible, and escalate with a clear problem statement, evidence, customer impact, and actions already attempted.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, customer communications, time entries, resolution details, and handoff notes.

**Technical Investigation**
---------------------------

* Use foundational skills in SQL, Windows/Linux, application logs, networking concepts, and cloud services to investigate incidents.
* Execute approved diagnostic queries, scripts, and operational procedures without introducing avoidable risk.
* Support root cause analysis by gathering evidence, documenting observations, and validating corrective actions.

**Knowledge and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Create and update knowledge articles, troubleshooting notes, and customer-specific support documentation.
* Participate in team meetings, technical deep dives, shift handoffs, and product knowledge sessions.
* Support project transitions and hypercare activities by validating support readiness and reporting issues promptly.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years of technical support, system administration, software operations, or comparable experience, including internships or equivalent practical experience.
* Working familiarity with SQL, one or more scripting or programming languages, Windows or Linux, and basic cloud concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, careful documentation habits, and willingness to ask for guidance.
* Ability to prioritize work, follow change and escalation controls, and learn multiple products and customer environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

description:

=================

* Strong expertise in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, and AI/GenAI.

* Deep understanding of Lakehouse architecture, distributed processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, integration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and governance.

* Strong hands-on skills in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud technologies.

* Experience designing enterprise-scale, secure, resilient, and governed data platforms.

* Practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, NLP, knowledge graphs, and responsible AI architecture.

* Understanding of cybersecurity telemetry, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, identity risk, threat intelligence, and incident data.

* Ability to influence architecture decisions and engage effectively with **technical teams, architects, product leaders, and senior stakeholders**

**Education & Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* **15+ years of experience** across Data Architecture, Data Engineering, enterprise data platforms, cloud, analytics, AI, or related technology disciplines.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and Lakehouse solutions.

* Strong experience with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, data modeling, and AWS or comparable cloud platforms.

* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, data governance, and engineering best practices.

* Experience in cybersecurity, financial services, regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable

* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

  

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Data Architecture**

Lakehouse, enterprise data modeling, data domains, data products, data contracts, integration patterns, reference architecture, metadata and governance

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability.

**AI & Gen AI**

LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, NLP, knowledge graphs, responsible AI and AI-enabled workflows.

  

**Cloud & DevOps**

AWS, CI/CD, Git, automated testing and scalable cloud data processing

SIEM/SOAR, security telemetry, vulnerability, identity, incident and threat intelligence data.

Power BI, semantic models, operational metrics and executive reporting.

===========================

* The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

* The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.

====================================

**Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. We are looking for a Specialist DevOps Engineer to join a distributed team, working day-to-day alongside fellow engineers to deliver and maintain reliable, scalable infrastructure. In this role, you will be a strong hands-on practitioner — deploying and operating Kubernetes-based platforms, building CI/CD pipelines, and contributing to the team's shared tooling and practices. You will work collaboratively within established patterns and under the guidance of principal-level engineers, helping the team execute consistently and continuously improve.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

**Kubernetes & Container Platform**

* Deploy, operate, and maintain Kubernetes workloads on Redhat Openshift and AKS in production and test environments.
* Work within established cluster standards — applying RBAC policies, namespace conventions, and workload placement guidelines set by the team.
* Implement GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and work with the Kubernetes tooling ecosystem: Helm, Kustomize, ingress controllers, and service mesh.
* Follow and help maintain container image standards: base-image usage, vulnerability scanning, and registry hygiene.

**CI/CD, IaC, & Cloud Platform**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines to support consistent and reliable software delivery.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, following shared module patterns and team standards.
* Support Azure platform operations including networking, IAM, and Azure-native services within defined team practices.

**Observability, Reliability, & Security**

* Instrument monitoring services using the team's observability stack (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting); respond to and investigate incidents.
* Contribute to post-mortems and help implement follow-up improvements to increase system reliability.
* Apply security practices across day-to-day work: secrets management, network policies, and policy enforcement tooling.

**Collaboration & Team Contribution**

* Work closely with fellow engineers and principal-level team members, proactively communicating progress, surfacing blockers, and contributing to shared solutions.
* Maintain and improve team documentation, runbooks, and operational guides to support consistent practices.
* Participate in code and infrastructure reviews, providing constructive feedback and applying guidance received

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* BTech/MTech/MCA
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering.
* Solid Kubernetes experience in production environments; familiarity with Redhat Openshift or AKS.
* Working proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code and ArgoCD for GitOps-based deployments.
* Practical experience with Azure services: networking, identity, and cloud-native tooling.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms and the software delivery lifecycle.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and security fundamentals.
* Clear communicator who works well in a team environment and takes direction effectively.
* Experience migrating workloads to Kubernetes or working with on-premises Kubernetes deployments.
* Familiarity with containerization strategies and best practices for legacy application modernization.
* AWS experience or exposure to multi-cloud environments.
* Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD).

  

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

title: Lead QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for products in the Cybersecurity and Compliance domain used by thousands of enterprise customers.

You will act as a senior individual contributor and technical mentor for QA and automation engineers. You will define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive the move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on technical role: you set quality direction, influence release decisions, and actively write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out.

**Responsibilities**

**QA Mentorship & Strategy**

* Mentor and guide QA and automation engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for legacy components by improving automation coverage, while ensuring all new components are fully automated from the start.
* Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make data-backed go/no-go recommendations.
* Establish scalable QA processes: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects.
* Track and report quality metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time) to engineering and product leadership.
* Partner closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues.

**Test Automation (Hands-On)**

* Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines.
* Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling.
* Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs.

**AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation**

* Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes.
* Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle — generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs.
* Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise.
* Set guardrails for AI use in QA — validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes.

**Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 8-10+ years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team.
* Proven track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product.
* Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an **AI-based or self-healing automation** solution, with the ability to explain how you measured its impact.

**Skills**

Automation & Testing

* Robot, Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest
* API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, schema validation
* Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)
* Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling
* Visual regression and accessibility testing

**Programming & Backend**

* Python, Java(17+) and JavaScript/TypeScript
* SQL and data validation on Oracle or similar
* Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka (or other event streaming systems)

**AI in QA**

* Self-healing locator strategies and intelligent element matching
* LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling
* AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization
* Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus
* Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

**DevOps & Tooling**

* CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
* Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
* Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)
* Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

**Technical Mentorship**

* Strong ability to mentor engineers through technical guidance and code reviews
* Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
* Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

**Preferred**

* Background in cybersecurity — vulnerability management, Policy Compliance
* Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes.
* Open-source contributions to testing or automation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)
description:
**Job title:** Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Company:** Yutrix Labs LLP  
**Location:** Pune (Baner), hybrid. Occasional international travel to North America (2–4 weeks at a time).  
**Experience:** 8–12 years  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Yutrix Labs**  
Yutrix Labs is a Pune-based technology company building AI-native platforms for regulated and operations-heavy businesses. We are building an AI Restaurant Manager for a North American QSR franchise brand. It is an operating-control platform that watches inventory, food cost, food safety, service speed and loss prevention across restaurants. It flags exceptions with evidence and tells managers what to fix today.

We are looking for a domain lead who has run the back office of a QSR chain and wants to turn that experience into a product.

**What you will do**

* Own the business side of the product: inventory, purchasing and receiving, recipe and food cost, waste, cash control, HACCP/food safety, speed of service.
* Lead discovery workshops with the client’s operations, finance, procurement and QA teams, and with store managers.
* Turn SOPs and operating standards into system rules: thresholds, tolerances, severity levels, escalation paths and KPIs.
* Write user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and UAT scripts for the engineering and AI teams.
* Define how theoretical vs actual food cost, inventory variance, receiving variance and cash exceptions are calculated and explained.
* Review POS, inventory and purchasing data to assess data quality and design dashboards and reports.
* Support the pilot restaurant go-live: training, threshold tuning, and feedback from store teams.
* Act as the trusted operations voice with the client, and challenge scope where it doesn’t match how restaurants really work.

**What we are looking for**

* 8–12 years in QSR or fast-casual chains, with at least 3–5 years in restaurant operations, cost control, supply chain or operations excellence at a multi-unit or franchise brand.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of:
* Recipe/BOM costing, yields, portion standards and packaging BOMs
* Theoretical vs actual (AvT) food cost and variance analysis
* Inventory management: cycle counts, UOM conversions, FEFO/expiry, transfers, shrinkage
* Purchasing and receiving: par levels, reorder logic, 3-way match, price variance, supplier claims
* Store operations: opening and closing, waste capture, cash reconciliation, voids, refunds and discounts
* HACCP and food safety: temperature logs, holding times, cleaning, allergen control, audits
* Speed of service and KDS flow
* Franchise standards, audits and scorecards
* Experience working with technology teams on a POS, inventory, ERP or restaurant software rollout, as business owner or functional consultant.
* Strong analytical skills (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus).
* Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence running workshops with senior client stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Experience with restaurant systems such as POS/KDS, inventory and costing tools (e.g. Restroworks/Posist, MarketMan, Restaurant365, CrunchTime) or ERP purchasing modules.
* Central kitchen or commissary operations, halal or spec-compliant sourcing.
* Loss prevention or internal audit experience in F&B or retail.
* Exposure to North American or Middle East QSR markets. French is a bonus.

**Why join us**

* Shape an AI product from day one, alongside architects, data scientists and engineers.
* Work directly with an international QSR brand, with travel to the client.
* A small, senior team that builds fast and makes heavy use of AI tools.
* Competitive compensation.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,050,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.

title: Team Leader – Quality Methods & Insights (QMI), Pune
description:
Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes - all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.

  
  
  
  

**The team:**

  

Data Management & Operations (DMO) serves as the Chief Operations Office for Bloomberg Data, with the Quality Methods & Insights (QMI) team acting as its strategic analytics and methodology partner. QMI drives data quality, timeliness, and operational efficiency across Bloomberg's data products by establishing quality governance standards, optimizing workflows, delivering common reporting and analytics, applying decision science to support investments and operational change, and developing workflow telemetry and productivity measurement capabilities. We partner closely with Data Operations, Vendor Management, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure global data processes scale efficiently, predictably, and with measurable quality outcomes.

  
  
  

**The role:**

  

In this role, you will lead a regional team of process engineers, data quality analysts, decision scientists, and analytics specialists who partner directly with APAC-based Data operations, Vendor Managers, and Product Engineering. You will act as the regional ambassador for QMI’s methodologies, driving high-impact initiatives that range from operational workflow measurement and vendor quality governance to process redesign. Success in this position requires a balance of inspirational people leadership, rigorous analytical craft, and executive stakeholder management. You will champion a culture of "context over control," empowering your team to solve complex problems independently while ensuring regional deliverables seamlessly align with QMI’s global strategic objectives across London, Princeton, and New York.

  
  
  

**We'll trust you to:**

* Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing APAC team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
* Build strategic partnerships with regional Data, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Vendor Management leaders to identify priorities, align on outcomes, and drive data-driven decision making.
* Drive operational excellence through workflow measurement, process optimization, productivity benchmarking, and scalable automation initiatives, including AI-enabled solutions.
* Oversee data quality governance and decision analytics capabilities, leveraging statistical methods, experimentation, and AI evaluation frameworks to improve quality, quantify impact, and reduce operational risk.
* Partner with global QMI and Technical Project Management teams to deliver governed analytics platforms, reusable frameworks, and disciplined project execution, ensuring measurable business impact and consistent technical standards.

  
  

**You'll Need to Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of building, coaching, and developing high-performing analytical or technical teams.
* Strong analytical background in areas such as Applied Statistics, Decision Science, Data Quality, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating operational systems.
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with experience using tools such as Python, SQL, or equivalent analytics platform
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex cross-functional environments, and drive alignment across regional and global teams.
* Experience in operational performance and quality management, leveraging data-driven approaches to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making.
* Experience leveraging AI, causal inference, Bayesian modelling, and LLM evaluation to drive operational and decision-making improvements.
* Ability to scale impact through others by setting direction, coaching teams, and establishing repeatable frameworks and operating mechanisms.
* A strategic yet execution-oriented mindset, capable of balancing long-term capability building with immediate business impact.
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

* Familiarity with enterprise data quality and governance frameworks such as DCAM, DAMA, statistical quality monitoring, and semantic validation.
* Experience with modern data platforms and analytics architectures, including Spark, dbt, Iceberg/Delta, Lakehouses, or Knowledge Graphs.
* Knowledge of workflow management and operational tooling, such as Jira, queue management, or work routing platforms.
* Experience in financial market data, global operations, or third-party vendor management environments.

Summary:  
As a Senior Intune/MECM Administrator, a typical day involves managing and supporting Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enterprise environments. The role includes administering endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration profiles, application deployments, Windows Autopilot, patch management, Windows servicing, and co-management capabilities. The role also involves supporting Modern Workplace initiatives, contributing to migration and transformation projects, developing technical documentation, and providing advisory support to customers on endpoint management and security strategies.

Expected to perform independently and become an SME in Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM technologies.  
Own and manage EUC incidents and problems, providing 3rd-line technical support through successful resolution.  
Administer and support Microsoft Intune infrastructure, endpoint enrollment, device compliance, configuration policies, and application management.

Collaborate with Microsoft and third-party vendors for advanced troubleshooting, escalation management, and resolution of critical incidents.
