Contribute to Intune/MECM transformation, migration, upgrade, and co-management projects.  
Collaborate with project, security, infrastructure, and service management teams to ensure successful delivery of endpoint management solutions.  
Participate in team discussions and contribute to technical solutions for complex operational and project-related challenges.  
Create and maintain SOPs, RACI matrices, SRTs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and KT materials.  
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to junior team members and offshore/nearshore delivery teams.  
Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders in a large, matrixed organization.  
Ensure endpoint solutions meet organizational security, compliance, availability, performance, and operational requirements.

Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, device enrollment, Auto-Enrollment, Hybrid Azure AD Join, and endpoint lifecycle management.

title: Oracle ODI / ETL Developer – Data Migration
description:
**Oracle ODI / ETL Developer – Data Migration**

**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Engagement Type:** Full-Time  
**Project:** Oracle Database, ODI/ETL & Data Warehouse Migration  
**Location:** On\_Site

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on **Oracle ODI / ETL Developer** to develop, migrate, rebuild and execute ODI/ETL workflows as part of an enterprise Oracle-to-Oracle database and data warehouse migration project.

The candidate will be responsible for ODI development, repository and integration configuration, SQL/PLSQL migration scripting, source-to-target data transformation, bulk loading, reconciliation and production migration support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **ODI Development & Migration:** Develop, migrate and rebuild Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) mappings, packages, procedures, scenarios and load plans.
* **ODI Configuration:** Configure and support ODI repositories, topology, contexts, agents, physical/logical schemas, knowledge modules and environment migration.
* **ETL Development:** Design and execute extraction, transformation and loading workflows across Oracle EBS, ERP systems, Oracle databases and enterprise data warehouses.
* **SQL/PLSQL Development:** Build and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, packages and migration scripts.
* **Data Migration Execution:** Perform Oracle-to-Oracle bulk loading, incremental/delta loads, data transformations and automated migration activities.
* **Data Warehouse Integration:** Develop and migrate staging, fact/dimension, historical and aggregated data processing workflows.
* **Data Mapping & Validation:** Implement source-to-target mappings, business transformation rules, reconciliation checks and exception-handling processes.
* **Performance Optimization:** Tune ODI jobs, SQL queries and ETL processes to support large-volume data migration.
* **Testing & Cutover:** Execute unit testing, integration testing, mock migrations, production loads and post-migration troubleshooting.
* **Documentation:** Maintain ODI technical specifications, mapping documents, migration scripts, job execution logs and handover documentation.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **Oracle ODI 12c:** Strong hands-on experience with ODI Studio, repositories, topology, agents, mappings, packages, scenarios and load plans.
* **SQL/PLSQL:** Advanced Oracle SQL, PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages and performance tuning.
* **ETL Development:** Proven experience designing, developing, modifying and rebuilding complex ETL workflows.
* **Oracle-to-Oracle Migration:** Hands-on experience with data extraction, transformation, bulk loading and incremental/delta migration.
* **ODI Environment Migration:** Experience with ODI object deployment, repository configuration, topology changes and migration between environments.
* **Data Warehousing:** Strong knowledge of staging tables, fact/dimension models, data warehouse loading and transformation logic.
* **Data Reconciliation:** Source-to-target record validation, transformation checks, data integrity and exception resolution.
* **Performance & Troubleshooting:** ODI job monitoring, error handling, SQL tuning and high-volume ETL optimization.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle EBS/ERP source integration and data structures.
* Oracle Data Pump, SQL\*Loader and Linux/Unix shell scripting.
* ODI knowledge modules, automation and scheduling.
* Familiarity with OBIEE/OAS data connectivity and downstream reporting dependencies.
* Experience in Oracle data warehouse modernization or migration projects.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in Oracle ETL development, ODI and database migration.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on Oracle ODI development experience.
* Experience in at least one end-to-end Oracle data migration or enterprise ETL modernization project.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, technical documentation and independent execution capabilities.

**Mandatory Selection Criteria:** Candidates must have hands-on ODI development, SQL/PLSQL scripting, ETL migration and production data loading experience. Profiles limited to ODI administration, ETL testing, BI reporting or application support will not be considered.

title: Global IT Quality Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

The People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest and most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable global technology for BCG’s People Function, including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility & Career Development); L&D; and Core HR (including Workday, Compensation and Benefits).

We are seeking a **Global Quality Engineer Manager** to lead quality engineering execution for our **Vendor Management System (VMS)** products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of enterprise SaaS applications through effective manual and automated testing.

**You will:**

* Lead and mentor quality engineers across manual and automated testing, providing technical guidance, coaching, and quality oversight.
* Develop and execute test strategies for the VMS product/platform, aligned with established quality engineering standards.
* Remain hands-on with test automation, contributing to framework development, implementation, and code reviews.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve test coverage, efficiency, reliability, and release confidence.
* Ensure comprehensive testing of VMS workflows, business rules, APIs, integrations, databases, and backend services.
* Partner with product owners, business analysts, and engineers to translate requirements into effective test scenarios, including negative, boundary, integration, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines** and enable continuous testing.
* Lead defect triage and root cause analysis for complex or recurring issues and work with engineering teams on preventive actions.
* Track and report quality metrics, including defect trends, test coverage, automation coverage, and defect leakage, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Provide quality assessments and recommendations to support release readiness and release decisions.
* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing tools and technologies to improve quality engineering effectiveness.
* Drive adoption of established QA practices and foster a **quality-first culture** within the VMS team.

What You'll Bring

**Required Experience:**

* **8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering**, with expertise in both manual and automation testing.
* Experience leading or technically guiding QA/Quality Engineering teams and mentoring engineers.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
* Experience testing **SaaS-based enterprise products,** preferably multi-tenant and cloud-native applications.
* Experience testing workflow-driven enterprise platforms such as **Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), HR, or similar business applications**.
* Experience across functional, integration, regression, API, UI, end-to-end, and data validation testing.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, backend services, and enterprise system integrations.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum environments** with globally distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience testing SaaS-based **Vendor Management or Procurement platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Coupa, or similar enterprise workflow applications.**
* Experience with performance and load testing.
* Exposure to **AI-enabled testing tools or applications of AI within Quality Engineering.**

**Key Skills**

* Strong understanding of **QA methodologies, SDLC, STLC, Agile testing practices, and Quality Engineering principles**.
* Hands-on expertise with **Playwright (preferred) or Selenium**.
* Experience with automation approaches such as **Page Object Model (POM), Hybrid, and Data-Driven frameworks.**
* Proficiency in **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python** for automation scripting.
* Experience with **API testing using Postman**; knowledge of **REST Assured** or similar frameworks is an advantage.
* Experience with test and defect management tools such as **JIRA, Zephyr, and QMetry**.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.**
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and workflow-driven systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll work with a globally distributed, cross-functional team of **product owners, business analysts, software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, quality engineers, and business stakeholders** in a fast-paced Agile environment.

As a hands-on technical quality leader, you will mentor quality engineers and partner with product and engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle

Additional info

**You’re Good At:**

**Technical Leadership**

* Providing clear technical direction while remaining hands-on when needed.
* Coaching and developing quality engineers.
* Raising engineering standards through constructive reviews and knowledge sharing.

**Problem Solving & Decision Making**

* Anticipating risks and identifying issues early.
* Making pragmatic, risk-based decisions while balancing quality, timelines, and business priorities.
* Navigating complex technical and business problems with sound judgment.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influencing teams and building alignment across functions and geographies.
* Giving and receiving constructive feedback effectively.

**Work Management & Organization**

* Managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader outcomes.
* Taking ownership and driving work through to completion.

**Customer & Business Focus**

* Understanding business workflows and the impact of product quality on users.
* Balancing technical quality with business needs and user experience.
* Maintaining a strong focus on reliable and scalable product outcomes.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Challenging existing ways of working and identifying practical opportunities for improvement.
* Staying current with evolving quality engineering technologies and practices.
* Promoting learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Values & Ethics**

* Demonstrating accountability, sound judgment, and integrity.
* Handling confidential business and user information appropriately.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Integrated Logistics Customer Onboarding Solution Lead
description:

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
Leads the assessment and integration of customer system processes for seamless 4PL onboarding, aligning configurations with business goals while minimizing complexity. Skilled in ERP/TMS platforms and stakeholder engagement, this role ensures standardized, blueprint-driven solutions, proactive troubleshooting, and precise documentation to support a smooth go-live experience.

* Conduct in-depth assessments of customer system processes to evaluate their compatibility with the 4PL logistics framework.
* Define and optimize data flows and system configurations to ensure efficient, low-complexity onboarding that aligns with business objectives.
* Work closely with the Onboarding Process Engineers to ensure the processes are well supported by IT systems.
* Evaluate trade-offs between customization and blueprint enhancements through deep knowledge of system architecture.
* Make informed decisions to balance customer requirements with standardized system capabilities, minimizing unnecessary complexity.
* Engage customers with clear, persuasive communication to promote standard integrations and discourage inefficient custom solutions.
* Align onboarding activities with internal best practices and standardized blueprints to uphold system efficiency and integrity.
* Demonstrate hands-on experience with TMS and ERP systems.
* Possess strong working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA, with emphasis on logistics-related modules and configuration.
* Identify onboarding risks early and respond with effective troubleshooting and real-time mitigation strategies.
* Adjust system setups dynamically to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline the onboarding process.
* Maintain rigorous attention to detail in documenting onboarding configurations and processes.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of system setup through validation and testing prior to go-live, minimizing error rates and reducing rework.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure a smooth onboarding experience and timely decision-making.

What we would like you to bring
  
  

* Proven experience in ERP or TMS implementations.
* Background in IT project management or solution architecture.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational concepts effectively.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential challenges.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a meticulous approach to documentation and process configuration.
* Ability to critically assess and optimize customer requirements for long-term success.
* Experience in leading client workshops and coordinating across multiple teams.

What's in it for you
  
  
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

Who we are
  
  
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

description:
***Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time***

**The Role**

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to build features for a production AI-powered SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe, and to own its quality. About half of the role is feature work across Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL. The other half is making sure every release works: end-to-end test suites, release checks, and the deployment pipeline. If you enjoy shipping features and take pride in catching what breaks before users do, this is the role. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **Product Features:** Build customer-facing flows end to end, mobile first, from database to UI
* **Accounts & Payments:** Implement sign-up, social login, roles and permissions, and online payment flows
* **Multi-Tenancy:** Build features that serve multiple business customers from one system, each with its own data and configuration
* **Admin Tools:** Build internal screens that let business users manage their data and settings
* **Quality Ownership:** Own the end-to-end test suite, regression checks, and sign-off for each release
* **DevOps:** Maintain deployment, hosting, domains, monitoring, and backups for a containerised application
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with tests as the safety net

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years building and shipping web applications in production
* **Frontend:** React and Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, responsive and accessible UI
* **Backend & Data:** Node.js, PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma, API design, and input validation
* **Authentication:** OAuth and social login, sessions, and role-based access (e.g. Auth.js / NextAuth)
* **Testing:** End-to-end testing with Playwright or similar, plus unit tests; the habit of starting a bug fix with a failing test
* **DevOps:** Docker, CI/CD, Linux servers, and basic monitoring and logging
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Payment providers (e.g. Stripe), multi-language applications, GDPR awareness, three.js or React Three Fiber, self-hosted deployment platforms, React Native or iOS development

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
03
  
  
**Who We Are**
**Kensho is S&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation**
. With expertise in Machine Learning and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions for S&P Global and its customers worldwide. Our solutions help businesses harness the power of data and Artificial Intelligence to innovate and drive progress. Kensho's solutions and research focus on Generative AI, LLM Agents, speech recognition, entity linking, document extraction, text classification, natural language processing, and more.
  
  
At Kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. We dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. As a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join the group of Machine Learning Engineers working on developing a cutting-edge GenAI platform, LLM-powered applications, and fundamental AI toolkit solutions such as Kensho Link. We are looking for talented people who share our passion for bringing robust, scalable, and highly accurate ML solutions to production.
  
  
You can read about some of our cutting-edge GenAI application at:
  
  

* S&P Global Launches Adaptive Retrieval, Giving Customers a New Way to Access Data Across AI and Agentic Workflows
* S&P Global and Anthropic Announce Collaboration to Bring Trusted Financial Data into Claude
* S&P Global Data Retrieval Agent for Gemini Enterprise | Google Cloud AI agent finder

**About The Role**
As a Senior ML Engineer, you will work across a broad set of machine learning areas at Kensho. This includes building retrieval-driven AI agents that ground LLM outputs in trusted S&P data, as well as developing and operating production-grade machine learning systems that power our essential AI toolkits like Kensho Link or NERD. Across these areas, your focus will be on creating reliable, scalable, and transparent ML solutions that deliver real value to users.
  
  
**This Role Is Ideal For Engineers Who**

* Enjoy building robust, production-grade ML systems end to end
* Have strong ML fundamentals, with a practical understanding of the backend and deployment work needed to run these systems in production
* Want to work across data, retrieval, modeling, and system design

You will partner with ML engineers, backend engineers, and product managers to drive the next generation of Kensho’s AI products.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Kensho is expanding its portfolio of ML-powered products, and we are looking for engineers who are excited to build and deploy state-of-the-art ML systems at scale. You will have the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions, experiment with new approaches, and accelerate the pace at which we prototype, develop, and maintain high-impact ML solutions.
  
  
We are seeking a mid-to-senior level Machine Learning Engineer who can help elevate and streamline our ML development lifecycle, setting a high bar for excellence in modeling, deployment, and production operations.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For-**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of significant, hands-on industry experience with machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and information retrieval systems, including designing, shipping, and maintaining production systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience reading and understanding SQL databases and writing queries for specific access patterns.
* Proven experience building ML pipelines for data processing, training, inference, maintenance, evaluation, versioning, and experimentation.
* Demonstrated effective coding, documentation, collaboration, and communication habits.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Experience working with machine learning libraries/frameworks for Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, such as Langchain.
* (Preferred) Experience working with RAG based system

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop Advanced ML Systems: Create, refine, and deploy machine learning systems that solve complex business problems and power Kensho products.
* Build Retrieval-Driven AI Agents: Design AI agents that fetch, validate, and structure data from S&P datasets, ensuring answers produced by LLMs are grounded in S&P’s data universe.
* Evaluate LLM-based Agents: Identify and resolve performance gaps in both online and offline settings, addressing issues such as performance, latency, memory usage, compute efficiency, and feature consistency.
* Work With Domain Specific Data: Leverage proprietary structured and unstructured datasets, deep dive to have domain understanding, work with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Scale ML Applications: Optimize and scale ML systems to support high demand, efficient resource utilization, and reliable production behavior.
* Reduce Technical Debt: Proactively identify areas of the stack that can be improved, and propose solutions that strengthen reliability and maintainability.
* Taking Initiative: Scope, plan, and execute ML initiatives that develop core capabilities across Kensho products.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Data, Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth operations and contribute to long-term product vision.
* Improve User Experiences: Partner with Product and Design to develop ML-driven functionality that enhances user workflows and aligns with business needs.
* Drive the ML Lifecycle: Engage in all phases of the ML lifecycle, from problem framing and data exploration to model deployment and production monitoring, ensuring continuous improvement.

**Technologies We Love**

* Traditional ML: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM
* ML/Deep Learning: PyTorch, Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain
* Deployment tools such as: Docker, Amazon EKS, Jenkins, AWS
* EDA/Visualization: Pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, Weights & Biases
* Tools/Toolkits: DVC, MosaicML, NVIDIA NeMo, LabelBox
* Techniques: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Information Retrieval, Data Embedding
* Datastores: Postgres, OpenSearch, SQLite, S3

**What’s In It For**
**You?**
**Our Mission**
Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  
**Our People**
We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  
**Our Values**
**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**
Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits**
We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
**Our Benefits Include**

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
* Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
* Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
* Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries
  
  
**Global Hiring And Opportunity At S&P Global**
At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Opportunity:**

Get Well is seeking a highly skilled and proficient **Staff AI Engineer** to drive the development and implementation of advanced AI solutions. This role focuses on the technical execution of AI projects, leveraging expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), multimodal AI systems, and agentic systems to create innovative healthcare solutions. You will work closely with AI engineering teams, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate technological capabilities into impactful healthcare solutions, serving as a key technical liaison.

**Responsibilities:**

AI Solution Development

* Design, develop, and implement AI solutions leveraging unimodal and multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic systems.
* Develop and integrate agentic systems using frameworks like CrewAI, LangChain, and LangGraph to enable autonomous decision-making and workflow automation.
* Enhance product ecosystems by incorporating emerging AI technologies to improve functionality and user experience.
* Execute model training, fine-tuning, and optimization of inference engines for high-performance AI systems.
* Ensure technical excellence in AI solution design and implementation.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies into existing systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Serve as primary technical liaison between AI engineering teams and product teams
* Translate technical capabilities into product requirements and user-centric solutions
* Help facilitate communication and alignment across engineering, product, and clinical teams
* Drive collaborative innovation and knowledge sharing

Infrastructure and Optimization

* Optimize cloud-based AI infrastructure for scalability, performance, and reliability.
* Implement best practices for efficient AI system deployment and maintenance, including agentic workflows.

Performance and Quality Assurance

* Establish and maintain rigorous testing and validation protocols for AI models
* Drive continuous improvement in AI model accuracy, efficiency, and robustness.

Monitoring and Observability

* Implement and manage monitoring solutions for AI systems using tools such as Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent platforms to ensure operational health and performance.
* Analyze observability data to identify and resolve issues in AI model behavior, agentic system performance, and system reliability.
* Develop proactive monitoring strategies to detect anomalies and ensure reliability of AI deployments.

Compliance and Ethical AI

* Ensure AI solutions adhere to healthcare regulatory standards and data privacy requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
* Develop and enforce ethical AI guidelines to mitigate biases
* Uphold high standards for secure handling of sensitive information, including ePHI and PHI, per federal, state, and local regulations.

**Requirements:**

* Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a closely related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with minimum 3+ years of technical experience in AI/ML technologies
* Proven track record of delivering complex AI solutions in healthcare or technologically advanced domains
* Deep technical proficiency in:

* + Large Language Model (LLM) architectures
  + Multimodal AI system design
  + Agentic system development using frameworks like CrewAI, LangChain, and LangGraph.
  + Machine learning model training and fine-tuning
  + Cloud computing infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  + AI/ML frameworks and development tools (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face)
  + AI monitoring and observability tools such as Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent platforms.

* Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or other relevant languages.
* Experience in agile and adaptive project management methodologies
* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on delivering scalable solutions.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional teams.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team development.
* Knowledge of healthcare technology landscapes and regulatory environments (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) is a plus.
* Awareness of emerging AI technologies, including agentic systems, MCP, A2A protocol and their potential applications.
* Adaptability to work in fast-evolving technological environments.
* Commitment to adhering to organizational information security policies and protecting sensitive information, including ePHI and PHI, in accordance with Federal, State, and local regulations.

**About Get Well:**

Now part of the SAI Group family, Get Well is redefining digital patient engagement by putting patients in control of their personalized healthcare journeys, both inside and outside the hospital. Get Well is combining high-tech AI navigation with high-touch care experiences driving patient activation, loyalty, and outcomes while reducing the cost of care. For almost 25 years, Get Well has served more than 10 million patients per year across over 1,000 hospitals and clinical partner sites, working to use longitudinal data analytics to better serve patients and clinicians. title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Introduction:

**About SymphonyAI**  
SymphonyAI Industrial is a global leader in Industrial AI, enabling manufacturers and asset-intensive enterprises to transform fragmented IT, OT, and edge data into real-time, contextual intelligence that improves uptime, throughput, and operational efficiency.

Job Description:

**About the Role**

Build technical depth while providing dependable customer support across SymphonyAI Industrial products. This is the foundational engineering level, focused on disciplined triage, clear customer communication, accurate documentation, and resolution of common issues with guidance from more experienced engineers.

This role participates in both Level 1 (L1) and Level 2 (L2) support activities based on business need, skill, access, and incident priority. The role also participates in the 24/7 on-call rotation and responds to assigned incidents within applicable service-level targets and escalation procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Customer Support and Incident Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.
* Perform L1 triage and resolve common L1 and L2 issues using documented procedures, known solutions, and guidance from senior engineers.
* Collect complete diagnostic information, reproduce issues when feasible, and escalate with a clear problem statement, evidence, customer impact, and actions already attempted.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, customer communications, time entries, resolution details, and handoff notes.

**Technical Investigation**
---------------------------

* Use foundational skills in SQL, Windows/Linux, application logs, networking concepts, and cloud services to investigate incidents.
* Execute approved diagnostic queries, scripts, and operational procedures without introducing avoidable risk.
* Support root cause analysis by gathering evidence, documenting observations, and validating corrective actions.

**Knowledge and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Create and update knowledge articles, troubleshooting notes, and customer-specific support documentation.
* Participate in team meetings, technical deep dives, shift handoffs, and product knowledge sessions.
* Support project transitions and hypercare activities by validating support readiness and reporting issues promptly.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years of technical support, system administration, software operations, or comparable experience, including internships or equivalent practical experience.
* Working familiarity with SQL, one or more scripting or programming languages, Windows or Linux, and basic cloud concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, careful documentation habits, and willingness to ask for guidance.
* Ability to prioritize work, follow change and escalation controls, and learn multiple products and customer environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Exposure to Azure or AWS, Kubernetes or Docker, application performance monitoring, and ticketing platforms such as Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Jira, or ServiceNow.
* Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA, or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in industrial software, manufacturing, IoT, or operational technology.

**Role Success and Growth**
===========================

* Progress is demonstrated through reliable ticket ownership, accurate diagnosis, complete documentation, safe execution, and increasing independence.
* Development path may include Technical Support Engineer 2, product specialization, project support, or other technical roles.

About Us:

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

title: AI Engineer, Harness & Eval
description:
You'll be one of the first engineers in NAVEX's AI Centre of Excellence, a new function with a company-wide mandate to put AI into how the business runs. We build AI for business operations and internal agentic products.
  
You'll build production agents and, more importantly, the harness around them: the evals, tracing and guardrails that tell us an agent works before a user finds out it doesn't. Some agents you'll build from scratch. Others were built by external partners and are moving in-house. You'll own both.
  
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world-making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose - as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  
**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people-at a scale few companies can match.
* High-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas- not people-and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**  

* Build and ship agents for business operations and internal products. End to end: retrieval, tool use, orchestration, state, and handoffs to human
* Build MCP servers and tool integrations that give agents safe, reliable access to company systems and data
* Design the eval harness. Golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge where it earns its place, human review loops. Every change ships with evidence that it made things better
* Instrument agents in production. Tracing, failure taxonomies, cost and latency tracking. When something degrades, you find out first and know why
* Take over agents built by external partners. Read the code, find where it breaks, add the evals and observability it shipped without
* Hold a verification bar. In a compliance company, an answer we can't source or explain doesn't ship

**What you’ll bring:**  

* 3+ years of AI engineering experience, most of it building LLM systems that real users depend on
* Hands-on experience building with agentic harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar
* You've built MCP servers, eval harnesses or LLM Systems, not just used them and can explain how you knew a change was an improvement
* You've owned a system that degraded in production and diagnosed why, and can walk us through it
* Strong Python. Comfortable with at least one agent framework, and willing to go below it when it gets in the way
* Experience deploying on a major cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
* You've shipped end-to-end and own outcomes, not just tasks
* You can take a non-technical team's workflow and turn it into a working system
* Bonus points for:
* Building RAG over messy enterprise documents—proposals, contracts and policies
* Working with AWS Bedrock or inside VPC-constrained enterprise environments
* Building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains
* Sharing your work through writing, talks or open source
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 3,000,000 INR with 10% MBO. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

title: Test Development Engineering Technical Leader
description:

Within Cisco's Product Operations, we transform engineering innovation into products that power the internet — from enterprise networks to the world's most demanding hyper-scaler AI infrastructure. Our Manufacturing Test Development team sits at the critical intersection of design engineering and global manufacturing, ensuring that Cisco's most complex systems are launched with the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and scale. Your Impact
  
  

* As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end test strategy from Design for Testability (DFT) assessments through mass production readiness.
* Drive the development and deployment of board and system-level automated functional test processes at contract manufacturing sites globally, ensuring maximum test coverage and manufacturing efficiency.

title: Principal TPM: DGX
description:

------------

Intuit's Data, Growth, & Experiences (DGX) organization is building the system of intelligence that powers every AI-driven customer experience across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp. As a Principal TPM on this team, you will sit at the intersection of enterprise data infrastructure and marketing technology — orchestrating the programs that enable 100M+ customers to experience Intuit as one seamlessly intelligent platform.  
This is a strategic leadership position for a technical operator who understands data platforms and MarTech ecosystems deeply, moves with urgency, and earns the trust of both engineers and executives. You will drive programs that define how Intuit collects, manages, and activates data to deliver personalised, agentic, done-for-you financial experiences at scale.

**Responsibilities**

Lead Platform Programs at Enterprise Scale

* Own end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of strategic programs spanning data infrastructure (lakehouse, streaming, IDX), MarTech platforms (CDP, campaign orchestration, personalization), and AI-powered experimentation
* Drive program strategy, architecture alignment, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication from initiation through business outcome realization
* Maintain unwavering focus on outcomes — not just delivery milestones — translating engineering execution into measurable business impact

Operate at VP Level with Executive Authority

* Partner directly with VP and Director-level leaders across DGX to shape investment priorities, resolve organizational dependencies, and hold delivery commitments at scale
* Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product management, data science, marketing, and business stakeholders — enabling decisions that would otherwise stall in silos
* Drive regular executive readouts, program reviews, and async communication that give senior leadership real-time visibility into portfolio health and emerging risks

Build the DGX Program Operating Model

* Define and continuously evolve the TPM frameworks, program health metrics, operating cadences, and delivery standards for the DGX organization
* Establish portfolio visibility practices — dependency maps, risk registers, milestone dashboards — that enable a high say-do ratio across all DGX programs
* Champion Agile and adaptive delivery methodologies, calibrating process rigor to program complexity without adding unnecessary overhead

Champion AI-Native Program Management

* Bring AI tools and agentic workflows into your program management practice — accelerating planning, risk synthesis, stakeholder communication, and decision support
* Collaborate with engineering leads on AI platform programs (e.g., GenOS, agentic pipelines) as a technically fluent partner who can evaluate architectural trade-offs and drive delivery
* Model what it means to be an AI-first builder: demonstrate and teach how LLMs, automation, and intelligent tooling can make the entire team faster and sharper

Develop the TPM Community

* Coach and mentor program managers across DGX, raising the technical and strategic capabilities of the team
* Define best practices, playbooks, and frameworks that scale the TPM discipline and elevate program management standards across the broader Intuit TPM community
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering leaders — someone who is brought in early on hard problems because of the clarity, rigor, and influence you bring

**Qualifications**

Experience & Track Record

* 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in large-scale, matrixed technology organizations
* Demonstrated history of delivering enterprise data platform programs — data warehouses, lakehouses, event streaming pipelines, data mesh architectures, or large-scale API platforms
* Direct experience with MarTech ecosystems — CDPs (e.g., Segment, Salesforce, Adobe), campaign orchestration platforms, personalisation engines, A/B experimentation infrastructure, or growth technology
* Proven ability to influence VP- and Director-level stakeholders on strategic investment decisions and organizational priorities

Technical Depth

* Strong conceptual and applied understanding of modern cloud data architectures: data lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery), event streaming (Kafka, Flink), data mesh or data fabric patterns, and API design
* Fluent in the MarTech stack: understands how CDPs, DMPs, campaign tools, measurement frameworks, and personalization engines interconnect to create unified customer data activation
* Comfortable leading architectural design reviews, evaluating technical trade-offs, and representing engineering complexity in executive narratives
* Conversant in AI/ML concepts as applied to customer data: feature pipelines, model serving, real-time inference, experimentation, and responsible AI practices

Strategic & Analytical Mindset

* Uses data as a first-class tool for program management: monitors leading and lagging indicators, constructs health dashboards, and makes evidence-based course corrections
* Anticipates risks before they materialize; designs mitigation strategies that address root cause, not just symptoms
* Sees across organizational boundaries — identifies systemic dependencies, cross-team sequencing risks, and alignment gaps that others miss

Communication & Influence

* Exceptional written and verbal communicator; able to distill highly technical and complex program status into clear, executive-ready narrative
* Skilled navigator of ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational tension — influences outcomes without relying on authority
* Builds trust rapidly across engineering, product, data, design, and business functions through credibility, follow-through, and genuine intellectual curiosity

Education

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent practical experience
* PMP, SAFe, or Agile/Scrum certifications are a plus; demonstrated equivalent mastery is equally valued

NICE TO HAVE

* Prior experience at a company with significant MarTech or data platform infrastructure at consumer scale (e.g., Google, Meta, Adobe, Salesforce, Uber, Airbnb, Netflix, Amazon, Intuit)
* Background in financial technology, SaaS, or consumer platforms with 50M+ active users
* Hands-on experience with GenAI application development, LLM platform programs, or agentic AI system delivery
* Familiarity with privacy-by-design frameworks, consent management platforms, or data governance programs at enterprise scale

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

PyxTech is a B2B SaaS and AI technology company specializing in enterprise software, AI-powered solutions, digital engineering, and technology consulting. We help organizations modernize enterprise architecture, automate workflows, and unlock business value through intelligent data and AI solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Semantic Data Architect / Ontologist** with strong expertise in enterprise ontology development, RDF-based semantic modeling, and knowledge graph architecture.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies, building semantic data models, connecting fragmented enterprise data sources, and implementing W3C semantic web standards to support enterprise search, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic knowledge models.
* Build RDF-based semantic data structures using RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems into connected knowledge graphs.
* Develop and manage controlled vocabularies, metadata models, and taxonomy lifecycle processes.
* Implement SHACL-based data validation and constraints, along with SKOS for knowledge organization.
* Deploy and manage knowledge graphs using Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Work with ontology and taxonomy management platforms such as PoolParty and TopBraid EDG.
* Optimize semantic models for enterprise search, analytics, metadata extraction, and AI applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Support cloud-based deployments using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of overall IT/data experience.
* **Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience specifically in RDF-based semantic ontology development and modeling.**
* Strong expertise in enterprise ontology design, taxonomy development, and semantic metadata management.
* Expert knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Practical experience with SHACL and SKOS.
* Production experience with at least one graph database: Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ontology/taxonomy management platform, such as PoolParty, TopBraid EDG, or GraphDB (Ontotext).
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and overlap with US business hours.
* Maximum notice period of 30 days.

Preferred Skills

* NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and semantic metadata extraction.
* Experience with spaCy or similar NLP tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise search, knowledge discovery, and AI-driven applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Library Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Interview Process

* HR Screening and Initial Evaluation
* Client Technical Assessment / Deep Dive
* Client Final / Behavioral Interview

How to Apply

If you have strong hands-on experience in RDF-based ontology engineering, semantic data architecture, and enterprise knowledge graphs, we would love to hear from you.

**Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your ontology projects, RDF experience, graph database expertise, and notice period.**

**Important:** This role requires substantial practical ontology engineering experience, not just general data architecture or basic knowledge of graph databases.

### **ASIC Verification Engineer, Staff**

### **We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, enabling everything from self-driving cars to advanced learning machines. As the global leader in EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and silicon engineering solutions, we empower the creation of the world’s most advanced chips across AI/ML, high-performance computing, automotive, cloud, and mobile applications. Within our division, we develop and deliver interface subsystems that power industry-leading SoCs. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation and world-class engineering excellence.

### **You Are:**

You are an enthusiastic engineer who thrives at the intersection of various interface IPs. Your analytical mindset and collaborative spirit drive you to solve complex technical challenges that shape the future of connectivity. You are passionate about deepening your expertise and excited by the opportunity to work on advanced DDR/HBM/PCIe/UCIe/Ethernet/UALink IP integration deployed in the most innovative SoCs. You value technical mastery, teamwork, mentorship, and the continuous pursuit of innovation. Your curiosity leads you to understand diverse interface IPs, and you ensure the highest standards of silicon performance through meticulous attention to detail. Navigating simulation environments and debugging challenging issues is second nature to you, and you excel at collaborating with teams across the globe.

### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Technically leading and driving ownership of critical areas of verification alongside a team of talented verification engineers.
* Defining, implementing, and tracking comprehensive verification test plans to ensure robust coverage and quality.
* Specifying, building, enhancing, and maintaining state-of-the-art Subsystem top-level UVM-based System Verilog testbenches, integrating RTL and behavioral models
* Coding and debugging test cases, including the creation of complex checkers and assertions using System Verilog/UVM.

title: Data Scientist I
description:
Category: Data & AI

Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Job Title:** Senior Data Scientist

**Department:** AI Data Solutions, AI Reinvent & Engineering

**Location:** Bengaluru, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Senior Data Scientist, you will turn data and AI into decisions that help consumer health products across diabetes, obesity and wellness reach the people who need them. You will build production-grade machine learning and LLM capabilities that show what works across campaigns, channels and HCP engagement – and why. Your work will help commercial teams act with clarity and speed, and support more relevant engagement with people living with serious chronic diseases.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You know how to take models from idea to production and keep them performing. You will bring:

* 8+ years of professional experience in data science, with clear evidence of production implementation – not only prototypes.
* Hands-on experience building pipelines and models in enterprise environments, including one or more of Snowflake, Databricks or Dataiku, and/or Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Mastery of machine learning, deep learning and practical statistical modelling, backed by strong feature engineering and sound data preparation.
* Proven LLM implementation experience, including fine-tuning with PEFT/LoRA or equivalent methods.
* Hands-on delivery of RAG and agentic AI workflows.
* Proven MLOps experience, such as automated training pipelines, deployment, performance monitoring and continuous improvement. The tools you have used can vary.
* A strong understanding of the privacy and compliance constraints that apply to analytics and AI.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience in pharma or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with orchestrators and ML platforms, such as MLflow, Airflow, CI/CD tools, containerisation and model registries.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will own the path from data to decision: building models and AI tools that measure impact, guide campaigns and keep running reliably in production.

* Design, build and productionise machine learning and deep learning models for consumer analytics, demand forecasting, personalisation and performance measurement.
* Engineer robust features – including time-series, cohort, interaction and embedding-based features – with careful leakage control and handling of missing data.
* Apply advanced statistics and causal thinking, such as experimentation design, segmentation, uplift and attribution, to evaluate campaign impact, channels, TRx/NRx depth and breadth, content affinity and patient engagement, with robust validation and uncertainty estimates.
* Develop RAG and agentic workflows (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex) for content analysis and synthesis, literature review support, HCP/KOL knowledge tools and grounded Q&A assistants.
* Build an LLM/RAG-driven campaign optimisation and decision-support engine, covering channel engagement recommendations, content selection and experiment support.
* Deliver end-to-end pipelines and MLOps – automated training and refresh, data and model versioning, batch and near-real-time deployment, drift monitoring, evaluation gates, alerting and documentation – while keeping data private, compliant (GDPR/HIPAA where applicable), reproducible and traceable.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the AI Data Solutions team, part of EAI Reinvent & Engineering within Enterprise IT & Quality. Enterprise IT & Quality works across the full Novo value chain, staying close to business stakeholders to deliver on their needs. Its focus is clear: the highest quality for patients, trusted technology and environmentally responsible ways of working.

In AI Data Solutions, you will combine advanced analytics, AI and deep domain expertise to build tools that strengthen patient engagement, improve interactions with healthcare professionals and create measurable progress across therapy areas.

Your closest partners will be the commercial colleagues who act on your insights – across campaigns, channels, content and HCP/KOL engagement – and the technology colleagues behind the enterprise platforms your models run on. Together, you will set clear priorities, decide and follow through, speak up when work stalls, and never compromise on privacy, quality or ethics.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will work at the forefront of AI and technology, as Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases. Your expertise will shape how AI is used in real commercial decisions, and your voice will count.

You will grow with colleagues on the job and through relevant learning offerings. Expectations are clear, results are recognised, and you will be trusted to take ownership with the support you need to perform at your best.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to put production-grade AI to work for better health, apply for the Senior Data Scientist role by 26 oct 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Job Description

As a **Principal AI Scientist** with deep expertise in **Agentic AI** , **Generative AI** , and **Natural Language Understanding (NLU),** you will lead high-impact technical innovation in HIS applications. In this role, you will be a **hands-on research and development leader** - driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Innovation**

* Design, prototype, and evaluate novel AI models for autonomous, agent-based systems in healthcare workflows.
* Advance state-of-the-art NLU for clinical, operational, and administrative healthcare text.
* Explore and implement new capabilities in reasoning, decision-making, and multi-modal understanding.

**Healthcare-Focused AI Development**

* Adapt and fine-tune large language models to handle healthcare-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.
* Create AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).
* Contribute to domain-specific model architectures that improve clinical decision-making, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement.

**Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* **Technical Authority:** Serve as the lead architect for AI/ML strategy, ensuring all models are explainable, robust, and compliant with healthcare regulations (HIPAA/HITRUST).
* **Research to Reality:** Bridge the gap between theoretical research and practical engineering, ensuring prototypes are built with deployment and maintenance in mind.
* **Mentorship:** Elevate the engineering team through rigorous code reviews, architectural design docs, and best practices in data science.

**Data & Operational Excellence**

* **Data Integrity:** Oversee the processing of structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes) ensuring high data quality and security.
* **Validation:** Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks to detect bias and ensure clinical accuracy.

**End-to-End System Architecture**

* **Design & Deploy:** Lead the full lifecycle of AI applications, from initial data exploration and model training to deploying secure, scalable services in a production environment.
* **Hybrid Modeling:** Intelligently combine Classical ML (Random Forests, XGBoost, etc.) with Deep Learning and Generative AI to solve complex healthcare problems efficiently.
* **Agentic Frameworks:** Architect agent-based reasoning systems to automate clinical workflows while maintaining strict "human-in-the-loop" safety standards.

**Operational & Compliance Excellence**

* Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).
* Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD or Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, with a strong portfolio of deployed models.
* Proficiency in Python, R, and modern ML libraries.
* Experience with GenAI, LLMs, and transformer architectures.
* Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, RAG systems).
* Hands-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems.
* Strong track record applying AI to healthcare or life sciences use cases.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and MLOps practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Multi-modal AI research experience (text, image, structured data).
* Knowledge graph integration and symbolic reasoning expertise.
* Proven ability to take AI research from concept to production.
