title: USI- Cyber- DT&P-Identity - AI Security Analyst
description:
As a Security Engineer II specializing in Identity within Deloitte Cyber’s Cyber for AI practice, you will help clients secure how AI agents, workloads, and users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data. You will work with architects and engineers to assess current-state controls, implement target-state capabilities, and test production solutions. This role combines client collaboration with hands-on technical delivery across enterprise and cloud environments.

**Work you'll do**

As a Security Engineer II on the Identity team, you will be responsible for:

* Gather requirements and document identity flows, trust boundaries, permissions, and dependencies across users, agents, models, tools, and data sources.
* Configure and integrate agent identities, service principals, managed identities, workload federation, secrets, and short-lived credentials across AI and enterprise environments.
* Implement authentication and authorization controls using standards and patterns such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, token exchange, role-based access control, and policy-based access control.
* Build automation for identity onboarding, access assignment, credential rotation, access review, and deprovisioning, and troubleshoot token, consent, and policy issues using platform and application logs.
* Document configurations, test results, and operating procedures, and support client delivery through handoff activities, reusable patterns, prototypes, and demonstrations.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

Within the practice, the Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads and people are identified, authenticated, authorized and governed across enterprise and cloud environments.

**Location: Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Chennai / Pune**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience
* 2+ years of experience in cybersecurity and AI engineering, including production work in both domains
* Experience deploying or securing at least 1 production generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agentic workload using a managed service or self-hosted stack
* Experience with at least 1 major cloud platform, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and identity security patterns in cloud environments
* Experience securing workload or non-human identities, including service accounts, service principals, managed identities, federation, secrets, or credential lifecycle controls
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0 or 2.1, OpenID Connect, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), token exchange, public key infrastructure (PKI), or mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS)
* Experience building identity integrations or automation using Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, or a comparable language, together with Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs), JSON or YAML, and Git

Preferred:

* Experience in consulting, client delivery, or customer-facing engineering roles
* Experience with both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring
* Experience with machine learning lifecycle tools or frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow

title: Security Engineer - Network
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As a **Security Engineer | Network**, you will provide design, review, and analysis expertise across the client's firewalls, intrusion prevention, secure web gateway, and remote access controls.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Assess firewall, intrusion prevention and gateway change requests for security risk and design quality and prepare change designs for implementation by UK-based personnel.
* Carry out quarterly firewall rule-base reviews (and after significant change) using configuration exports, and report findings and recommendations.
* Analyse network security log and alert reporting monthly, and on request during incidents, and provide recommendations.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) releases against the 48-hour application target and advise on critical updates, working with the Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Contribute to secure web gateway, remote access and CASB policy design and review.
* Review network segmentation and IT/OT boundary controls and recommend improvements.
* Define audit logging requirements for network security devices, in line with the logging design.
* Produce internet access usage and network security reports in the agreed format and to the agreed schedule.
* Maintain network security infrastructure diagrams and configuration documentation.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, networking, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vendor firewall certification, e.g. PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4 or above (at least one required).

CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CCNP Security, or an SSE/SASE vendor certification would be advantageous

Essential skills:

**Essential Skills**

* Next-generation firewall design and rule-base review (e.g. Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).
* Intrusion prevention and network detection technologies (e.g. Trend Micro TippingPoint, Cisco Firepower, Darktrace).
* Secure web gateway, SSE/SASE and remote access (e.g. Prisma Access, Zscaler, Netskope).
* TCP/IP, routing, VPN, network segmentation and IT/OT boundary concepts.
* Security log analysis and ITIL change and incident processes.
* Clear written reporting and documentation.

Desired skills:

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* Rule-base analysis tools (e.g. AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon).
* Web application firewall and load balancer experience (e.g. F5 BIG-IP).
* OT network security experience (e.g. Nozomi, Claroty) and energy or CNI sector exposure.

Experience:

**Experience**

* 3-6 years in network security engineering or operations.
* Experience of firewall rule-base review and change risk assessment in enterprise environments.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are a network security engineer who enjoys analysing complex rule-bases and designing robust controls, we encourage you to apply today.

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-261745 **Date posted** 10/13/2026

**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**

**GCL: F**

**Location: Chennai**

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?

In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.

Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.

**Accountabilities:**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.

Responsibilities:

1. Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.

2. Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.

3. Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.

4. Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.

5. Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.

6. Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.

7. Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.

8. Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

Desired Qualifications:

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

2. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.

3. Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.

4. Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.

5. Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.

6. Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.

7. Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.

8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.

2. Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.

3. Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.

4. Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.

5. Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.

6. Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. title: Senior CV Engineer
description: Job Description Role: AI / Computer Vision Engineer – Flight Turnaround Monitoring System Key Responsibilities • Model development: Design, train and optimise deep learning models for object detection, multi-object tracking, segmentation and video-based activity recognition on airport apron footage. • Activity-detection pipeline: Build the end-to-end pipeline that converts detections and tracks into turnaround events – combining detectors, trackers, stand-zone (ROI) geometry, temporal action models and a rule/state-machine layer with robust start/end timestamping. • Accuracy ownership: Define the evaluation protocol with the product team, build and maintain a golden test set, and drive per-activity precision, recall and timestamp accuracy to the agreed targets. • Dataset engineering: Own the data strategy – camera-view coverage, annotation guidelines and QA, active learning, hard-negative mining, class-imbalance handling and synthetic/augmented data for rare or safety-critical events. • Robustness: Make models reliable across night, rain, fog, glare, shadows, heavy occlusion by aircraft and vehicles, small/distant objects, differing camera angles and different airports or stands. • Error analysis: Run systematic failure analysis (by activity, camera, time of day and weather) and convert findings into data, model or logic improvements in fast iteration cycles. • Production inference: Optimise multi-stream, low-latency inference with GPU acceleration (TensorRT / ONNX Runtime / DeepStream) on data-centre or edge hardware. • MLOps: Set up experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, automated evaluation, shadow-mode validation, drift monitoring and a retraining loop with human-in-the-loop correction. • Integration: Work with backend, product and operations teams to publish activity events via Redis / RabbitMQ / SQL to dashboards, alerts and turnaround-time (TAT) analytics. • Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, contribute to architecture decisions, technical reviews and roadmap planning, and track emerging research in video understanding and edge AI. Accuracy & Performance Expectations Targets below are indicative and will be finalised per activity during the pilot. The engineer is expected to define how they are measured and to reach them in production conditions, not only on a held-out dataset. • Event-level detection: Target ≥ 95% precision and ≥ 90–95% recall per activity (event level F1), measured against a manually annotated golden set; safety-critical activities (e.g. refuelling, chocks, pushback) held to the higher bar. • Timestamp accuracy: Start/end times of activities within an agreed tolerance (e.g. ± 5–10 seconds) of ground truth; reported using temporal IoU and mean absolute timestamp error. • Object detection / tracking: Strong mAP on apron object classes (aircraft, GSE, personnel, doors, cones, chocks, hoses) with stable track IDs through occlusion (high IDF1 / low ID-switch rate). • Robustness: Performance reported per slice (day/night, weather, camera, stand) with no slice falling materially below the overall target. • Operational: Real-time processing across all configured camera streams per GPU, with a false-alarm rate that operations teams can act on. Required Skills and Qualifications Core computer vision and deep learning• Expert-level Python with strong software engineering practices (testing, packaging, code review). • Strong foundation in machine learning, neural networks and image/video processing. • Extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch for training, fine-tuning and deploying models. • Proficiency in OpenCV and video I/O (FFmpeg, GStreamer, RTSP/H.264/H.265 streams). • Practical experience with modern detectors and segmenters (YOLO family, RT-DETR / DETR, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, U-Net) including fine-tuning on custom datasets. Video understanding and activity recognition (critical for this role) • Multi-object tracking: ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, DeepSORT or similar, including re identification and handling of long occlusions. • Action recognition / temporal action detection: SlowFast, X3D, TSM, TimeSformer, VideoMAE, Video Swin or similar; experience with temporal modelling (LSTM / GRU / Transformers / temporal convolution) on top of frame-level features. • Spatio-temporal reasoning: zone/ROI-based logic, object–object and object–person interaction (e.g. vehicle docked at aircraft door, hose connected), and rule or state-machine event engines. • Pose estimation and small-object detection techniques (tiling / SAHI, high-resolution inference, multi-scale features). Data, training and accuracy engineering • Building annotation pipelines with CVAT / Label Studio or similar; writing labelling guidelines and running inter-annotator QA. • Handling class imbalance and rare events: hard-negative mining, active learning, focal / weighted losses, targeted augmentation, semi-/self-supervised learning and synthetic data. • Rigorous evaluation: mAP, precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, temporal IoU, IDF1/MOTA, threshold and confidence calibration, and sliced analysis by lighting, weather and camera view. • Robustness to domain shift: day/night, rain, fog, glare, camera placement and cross-site generalisation; low-light enhancement and, where applicable, thermal/IR imagery. • Experiment tracking and reproducibility: MLflow or Weights & Biases, DVC or equivalent for dataset/model versioning. Deployment and integration • Real-time inference optimisation with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT (FP16/INT8 quantisation, batching); NVIDIA DeepStream or Triton Inference Server is a strong plus. • Experience running multi-stream video analytics on GPU servers and/or edge devices (e.g. NVIDIA Jetson). • Proficiency in Docker and CUDA for containerised, GPU-accelerated deployment. • Experience integrating with Redis, RabbitMQ (or Kafka) and SQL databases for event streaming and storage. • Strong command of Linux, including scripting, debugging and performance profiling. Experience and soft skills • 2+ years in applied computer vision, with at least 2 years delivering video-based detection or activity-recognition systems to production. • Proven record of taking a model from a prototype to meeting a measured accuracy target in real-world conditions. • Ability to solve complex problems independently, lead technical initiatives and mentor others. • Clear communication for cross-functional collaboration and technical documentation. Good to Have • Prior work in aviation, airport operations, logistics, industrial safety or other CCTV-based activity monitoring. • Experience with vision-language / foundation models (e.g. CLIP, SAM, Grounding DINO, VLMs) for auto-labelling or open-vocabulary detection. • Knowledge of A-CDM / turnaround milestone standards and airport ground-handling processes. • Experience with multi-camera calibration, camera-to-stand mapping, and model compression (pruning, distillation). • Publications or open-source contributions in video understanding or object tracking.

title: Applied AI Engineer ServiceNow - Lead Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Lead Applied AI Engineer II – ServiceNow**
**Role Overview:**
As a ServiceNow Lead Applied AI Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks—together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver—consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes—and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build.
* Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, low-level architecture and component design, development, testing, integrations, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of architecture and technical stack to the enterprise standards and strategy. Manage dependencies, code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 10+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, SQL/NoSQL, REST/API integrations, ServiceNow application development and deployment patterns, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks.
* 3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration, and applied AI capabilities on platforms such as ServiceNow.
* 5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, micro-services, or enterprise platform deployment models, including Azure, AWS, GCP, including their AI/ML services such as ServiceNow NowAssist plus application-level infrastructure-as-code, and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability)
* 3+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, Automated Test Framework (ATF), MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. ServiceNow NASK, MCP, LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.
* ServiceNow engineering experience, including platform architecture, workflow automation, integrations, and AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities, with the ability to translate product needs into scalable enterprise solutions.
* Preferred certifications may include ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS-HRSD, CIS-Data Foundations, CIS-ITSM, CIS-IRM, CIS-SPM, AI/GenAI-focused ServiceNow credentials, or relevant cloud/AI certifications.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: India First Engineer
description:
Supply & Friends is a New York City based AI company building modern, beautiful software for the fashion industry, the world’s largest creative industry and its most global. Our mission is to grow global GDP and connect the world's cultures.

India is one of the most ambitious and future-facing countries in the world, and is central to our mission. We are excited to bring on our First India Engineer in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai to help us build the next generation of AI-native product (and infra).

We are intentionally discreet about what we are building. You will learn more when we chat.

**Our core values**

* Unflinching Optimism. Let's make this world even better.
* Global DNA: Think, act, be global from day one.
* Respect the domain. Study it and learn from others to master it.
* 1st generation immigrant mindset. Work hard, don't take anything for granted.
* Honest trade & commerce. Act with integrity.
* Bring beauty into the world. Let our products reflect the beauty of the industry we serve.
* Arm the makers. Free them up with great technology to do what they do best: CREATE.
* Customers, customers, customers. Always start with the customer first.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Full-Stack + LLM Engineer in India who wants real ownership and intensity.

Not a narrow specialist.

Not a pure researcher.

Not a ticket-closer.

We want a hacker and builder. You will not be a small cog in a large machine. You will help define how this product evolves.

This is a fast-moving, high ownership role. You will be our 1st engineer in India and a foundational part of our long-term presence here.

We operate at very high intensity. 70+ hours and 6+ days per week is normal for us. This is not seasonal. This is how we build. If you are optimizing for balance first, this is not the right role for you.

**Role mission**

Design, build, and ship AI-native web experiences that combine world-class full-stack engineering with real-world LLM systems -- including reasoning models, decision models, and agentic pipelines -- helping us take an AI-native product used by global customers from early traction to real scale.

You will:

* Build beautiful, fast, production-grade frontend systems in React
* Architect and own backend systems: APIs, data models, and services
* Integrate and orchestrate LLM workflows -- including reasoning models, decision models, and multi-step agentic pipelines -- into product flows
* Own features end-to-end, from idea to shipped code
* Define how AI features are surfaced and integrated into core product workflows
* Continuously improve the quality, reliability, and UX of AI-powered features in production

**Role outcomes**

* Within the first two weeks:
* Understand customers, product, UX philosophy, tech stack & AI architecture
* Familiarize yourself with the codebase, internal tools, and services
* Ship meaningful code, including at least 1 feature
* Within 45 days:
* Own full features across frontend, backend, and LLM logic
* Improve UX polish and system responsiveness
* Propose improvements to AI workflows
* Within 90 days:
* Architect and ship major AI-powered product flows
* Take responsibility for performance, reliability, and LLM evaluation workflows
* Improve our team workflows to be more efficient and productive
* Within 6-12 months:
* Help build the India engineering core
* Raise the bar on full-stack craft and AI-native thinking
* Lead major product surfaces across web and mobile
* Travel occasionally to meet customers globally
* Always:
* Talk directly to users around the world
* Ship fast
* Iterate
* Maintain high standards for reliability and stability

**Our tech stack**

* AI: GPT, Gemini, Claude, GLM (Zhipu), Jev (TypeSafe), Cursor, evaluation pipelines
* Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind
* Backend: NodeJS, Express, Postgres, AWS, Modal, DeepInfra, Cloudfront
* ML / open source: SigLIP, OWL-ViT v2, DINOv2, pHash, dHash
* Analytics: Posthog, Sentry

**You:**

* Have 3 to 7 years of experience building real products end-to-end, across frontend and backend
* Are extremely strong in React and modern frontend frameworks
* Have solid backend experience: API design, data modeling, and building reliable services
* Have built and shipped things outside of your job simply because you were curious, and can show us what you made
* Think like a product owner, not just an implementer, and care about the customer and business
* Care deeply about UX, speed, and polish
* Have built real LLM-powered features in production -- not just demos -- using reasoning models, decision models, agentic pipelines, structured outputs, and evaluation frameworks
* Understand prompt engineering, context management, and failure handling at scale
* Have worked with or have a point of view on decision models like Jev and how they differ from traditional generative LLMs
* Want your code to have impact and you're a self-motivated super hard worker
* Are excited to work fully remotely (and occasionally in person)
* Live in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai and are excited to be based there long-term

*Bonus points if you:*

* Have worked at a high-grade startup or product company (Swiggy, Zepto, Razorpay, Meesho, CRED, Groww, or similar)
* Have prior experience in B2B SaaS, fashion tech, or e-commerce
* Have an eye for design and/or a sense of craftsmanship
* Are a curious world citizen with empathy for other cultures and/or speak 2+ languages
* Have built personal AI tools, bots, SaaS, or internal productivity systems
* Have contributed to open source

**What's in this for you**

* High ownership from day one
* Direct exposure to global customers
* Travel opportunities
* Salary competitive for the India market, with equity upside (stock options).
* The opportunity to become a foundational engineering leader in India

**How to apply**

We are intentionally selective and use a rigorous process.

If this excites you, please get started by applying on LinkedIn. We review every application.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

title: Faculty - Generative & Agentic AI
description:
We are looking for an experienced Generative AI & Agentic AI Trainer to deliver practical, industry-oriented classroom training to students, freshers, and working professionals. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and Python programming, along with excellent communication skills and mandatory prior experience in conducting face-to-face classroom training sessions.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct instructor-led classroom training sessions on Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts.
* Explain Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI application development.
* Provide hands-on training in Python programming and AI/ML fundamentals.
* Train learners to build AI-powered applications using APIs from leading LLM providers.
* Teach AI agent development, tool calling, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
* Provide practical exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex.
* Guide trainees in developing chatbots, AI assistants, RAG-based applications, and autonomous AI agent projects.
* Demonstrate vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and document retrieval techniques.
* Prepare course materials, presentations, coding exercises, assignments, and assessments.
* Evaluate learner performance and provide technical guidance and feedback.
* Explain responsible AI practices, security considerations, evaluation, and deployment of AI applications.
* Maintain training attendance, learner progress, and assessment reports.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Proficiency in Python programming and API integration.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG pipelines.
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and AI agents.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools.
* Understanding of function calling, tool integration, agent workflows, and multi-agent collaboration.
* Basic understanding of machine learning, NLP, and deep learning concepts.
* Mandatory: Prior experience in offline classroom training or instructor-led technical training.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI concepts through practical demonstrations and real-world use cases.

Mandatory Requirements

* Previous experience as a Generative AI Trainer, AI/ML Trainer, Python Trainer, Technical Trainer, or AI Faculty Member.
* Proven experience conducting face-to-face classroom training sessions.
* Practical experience developing Generative AI applications and Agentic AI solutions.
* Ability to conduct live coding sessions, hands-on labs, and project-based learning.
* Experience handling classroom batches and supporting learners with different skill levels.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

title: SDET I
description:
The DataX project is Verisk Maplecroft’s data storage and monitoring platform, written largely in the Python programming language and hosted on AWS. GRiD is Verisk Maplecroft’s web-based data delivery platform based on the Angular web framework and the Django Rest Framework. Both projects are presently in active development by Agile based project teams in the UK and are presently supported by a part-time test engineer who works across both projects.
  
The Test Engineer role will be flexible, detail-oriented, and skilled at working with internal customers (Software and Product Team). The Tester will champion the quality of our data and products via automated and manual tests, quality assurance and regression testing, proactive reporting and verification of bugs and/or data errors and will play a critical role in delivering the DataX and GRiD product visions.

**Qualifications:**

  

The Test Engineer will:
  

* Work closely with the UK-based Technical Project Manager to create test strategies and plans that provide acceptable coverage for a given dataset or product
* Attend requirement gathering meetings with Product and Stakeholders to better understand business needs, functionality and system requirements
* Work in an Agile delivery methodology
* Provide regular and open communication across the program for transparency of progress and roadblocks
* Take ownership of test processes and implementing them
* Coordinate with the Technical Lead and UK Technical Project Manager to align tests with requested timelines
* Produce detailed testing documents, including test scripts to automate and rapidly perform testing iteratively

  

* At least 3+ years of software QA testing experience
* Expertise on STLC , SDLC, Defect life cycle
* Must have strong knowledge and experience in Python programming language.
* Ability to design and develop the automation framework from scratch.
* Strong knowledge on Postman and Swagger tools.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipeline.
* Experience in building frameworks using selenium, Requests and related libraries.
* Expertise in test management tools like Test rail/Browser Stack.
* Experience with version control systems like Git.
* Excellent and proven Troubleshooting skills
* Experience configuring, deploying and testing software updates
* Ability to identify issues and escalate as appropriate
* Ability to understand propagation of data through environments and components
* Familiarity working with APIs providing structured data
* Ability to communicate technical matters effectively to a variety of Stakeholders
* Familiarity working in an Agile environment and with Atlassian products, such as JIRA, confluence etc.
* Fluency and clarity in spoken and written English, being able to concisely communicate technical ideas internally and to UK/US staff
* Testing is conducted with 20% being manual and 80% automation.
* Expertise Knowledge on Figma tool.

**Nice to have**  

* Programming experience in language such as Python, Django
* Hands on experience on Docker
* SQL and database knowledge.
* GitHub / Copilot / Rovo etc. AI tools
* Any QA certifications.

  

**Our People, Our Culture**

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. We are a leading strategic data, analytics, and technology partner to the global insurance industry, guided by core values of learning, caring, and results while maintaining the highest ethical standards as stewards of the industry's most comprehensive datasets. Learn more about Verisk and what we are doing within the insurance industry.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Platform Engineering, Agile Best Practices, User Experience Design, Compliance Management, Communication and Collaboration, Problem Solving, Attention to Detail, Mentoring and Coaching, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Containerisation, AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

### **Purpose of role**

* The Data Analyst is a key member of the Kilimanjaro Transformation Pprogramme, responsible for the accuracy, consistency and integrity of Keyloop’s product and pricing data, with a primary focus on legacy SKU mapping and catalogue validation

* The Data Analyst works closely with Pricing, Product Management and, Finance and Billing to ensure that legacy SKUs are accurately mapped to the Product Index architecture and that catalogue and CPQ data reflects the agreed pricing logic

### **Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the mapping of legacy SKUs to the Product Index architecture, documenting the mapping rationale, dependencies and exceptions for each SKU

* Investigate the commercial history of legacy SKUs (including contractual, pricing and billing context) and work with Pricing and Product Management to resolve ambiguities and agree the target mapping

* Validate product catalogue and pricing data on CPQ against the Product Index and the agreed pricing rules; identify, log and drive the resolution of discrepancies

* Design and run repeatable validation checks (e.g. mapping coverage, completeness, duplicates, price and unit consistency) to give confidence in data quality

* Extract, cleanse and reconcile data from legacy systems, the data warehouse and Salesforce, ensuring a clear audit trail from source to target

* Work with Billing and Finance to ensure that mapped SKUs remain consistent with contract and invoice data

* Support data migration and validation activities as required by the programme

* Maintain clear documentation (mapping rules, data definitions and decision log) and report progress, risks and open issues to the Pricing team and programme stakeholders

### **Key Skills**

* Proven experience in data analysis, data mapping and validation of large, complex datasets (ideally product, catalogue or pricing data)

* Proficient in Excel, including advanced lookups, pivot tables, data cleansing and reconciliation

* Comfortable with Salesforce or similar – including database manipulation, extraction and validation

* Strong attention to detail, with a structured approach to investigating legacy data and resolving ambiguity

* Strong written and verbal communication, with good stakeholder management across Pricing, Product, Finance and Billing

* Able to work independently and deliver to programme deadlines in a fixed-term environment

### **Desired, but not essential:**

* Experience with Salesforce CPQ – including product catalogue architecture, pricing rules and data migration/validation

* Experience working on a large CRM, ERP or data migration programme

* Experience with B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) products and pricing

* Comfortable with Power BI

* Experience working in an international environment

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*
