title: Analyst Project Analytics - Finance
description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
To provide financial support to the project management functions within Operations. Assist with reviewing overall performance, including scope, revenue, cost and other related matters. Act as a liaison between Operations and Finance to ensure accurate and timely reporting of all activity and to proactively identify potential issues and action plans.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function
  
1. Monitor financial performance metrics including profitability, change orders, and delivery timelines for revenue recognition.
  
2. Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances between actual and budgeted results, and opportunities for improvement.
  
3. Review projects regularly to assess historical and future trends in revenue, costs, and expenses, developing actionable recommendations.
  
4. Support the Finance team in accurate monthly revenue recognition and financial statement preparation.
  
5. Partner with delivery teams to establish effective feedback loops between operations, accounting, and FP&A.
  
6. Collaborate across departments to gather information for accurate financial projections and reporting.
  
7. Participate in developing and implementing project finance policies and procedures.
  
8. Communicate project’s financial information effectively to various stakeholders.
  
9. Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance financial tracking and reporting efficiency.
  
10. Demonstrate strong attention to detail in all financial activities.
  
  
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  
1. A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is typically required.
  
2. 5-6 years of relevant experience and specifically in financial planning, budgeting, and analysis is highly desirable.
  
3. Strong stakeholder management skills.
  
4. Ability to work in a global environment and support teams geographically dispersed across US, Europe and Asia.
  
5. Advanced Excel and other business intelligence tools knowledge.
  
6. Familiarity with concepts, practices, and procedures of financial planning & analysis.
  
7. Understanding business operations, financial statements, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  
8. Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret financial data to identify trends and insights.
  
  
**Preferred:**  
1. Qualified (CIMA, ACCA, ACA, CPA, CMA or equivalent).
  
2. Previous systems experience with Salesforce, NetSuite and / or data analytics software (e.g. OneStream), and using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau etc.).
  
  
#LI-AB1
  
  
Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
Job description
  
The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the pharma clinical data management business domain and understanding of data engineering& analytics technologies, operating at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology needs.
  
In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of clinical trial data and real-world data (RWD) systems, translating business needs into system requirements, oversee initiatives with full autonomy and lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data.
  
Description of the area
  
This team is responsible for delivering software systems for the data acquisition and processing of Roche clinical trial data, serving as the source of truth across Roche Pharma. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s electronic data capture (EDC) - Medidata Rave, non-CRF systems, and clinical data warehouses.
  
These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.
  
A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition and data management. This includes enriching metadata and building AI-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human-in-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Analysis Leadership& Delivery: Lead business analysis for initiatives or workstreams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale. Defines and leads analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, translating complex data requirements into process maps, epics, features, and users stories.
* Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that may span organizational boundaries. Proactively prevents scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for business analysis deliverables ensuring alignment across functions and dependent systems.
* Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across both IT and business organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.
* Impact& Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.
* Complexity: Works typically on multiple systems across the sub-function, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements. Demonstrates an end-to-end viewpoint to analyze problems, considering how data flows across systems.
* Business Domain& Technical Expertise: Uses in-depth knowledge of clinical data business processes and technical expertise in data integration and engineering to inform business strategies.

Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience: 7+ years as a Business Analyst/Consultant, with at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry.
* Experience with Clinical Data Systems, Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems or Non-CRF data systems, clinical data warehouses or data lakes.
* Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.
* Strong communication skills to manage stakeholders and facilitate discussions between business and IT users globally.
* Familiar with Agile product delivery, backlog management, and delivering GxP validated systems

Technical Skills
  
  

* Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.
* Mastery in requirements and domain knowledge, with the ability to conduct comprehensive root cause analysis and advanced value and risk assessments.
* Experience with databases, SQL, scripting languages such as python, APIs, and data analytics tools
* Strong willingness to learn and develop practical experience in AI agentic workflows

Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, acting as a role model in teamwork and driving good collaboration across Informatics and business structures.
* Flexibility: Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and commit to collaboration with team members globally.

* Up to 10 yrs of strong experience in data management, business analysis, product ownership, and project delivery within financial services / investment banking.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Proven experience driving initiatives through Agile/Scrum and/or traditional project management methodologies.
* Strong understanding of investment banking products, workflows, trade lifecycle, positions, and related data flows.
* Experience with DataLake / NetApp S3 / Lakehouse architectures and modern enterprise data platforms.

* Hands-on understanding of large-scale data processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, and S3-based storage patterns.
* Strong SQL, Python and data analysis skills with the ability to assess data quality, trace issues, and recommend remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and governance expectations such as BCBS 239, GDPR, and enterprise data risk/control practices.
* Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders, influence priorities, and drive alignment across competing demands.
* Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Job Expectations:**

* Operate as the business-side owner for strategic data platform capabilities supporting CIB trades and positions.

title: Analyst - Global Trade Content
description:

The analyst is also expected to actively utilize AI and digital tools to improve productivity, accuracy, consistency, and content quality while adhering to company governance and data privacy requirements.

title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Rates Researcher to support a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project.

The role involves evaluating AI-generated quantitative research and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in quantitative finance, rates markets, statistical modeling, and backtesting methodologies to assess research quality, validate assumptions, and identify methodological flaws.

Prior experience with AI systems is not required. Strong domain expertise in quantitative finance and interest rate markets is the primary requirement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Review and evaluate quantitative research outputs and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets.
* Identify research and backtesting issues, including lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
* Evaluate backtesting frameworks, including rates-specific mechanics such as carry, roll-down analytics, and contract roll conventions.
* Assess the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Review yield curve models, relative value strategies, and interest rate trading instruments.
* Validate model assumptions, implementation accuracy, and research methodologies.
* Evaluate strategies under realistic market conditions, accounting for transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and execution assumptions.
* Provide detailed written feedback with actionable recommendations to improve research quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators to clarify findings and communicate technical insights.
* Contribute to improving quantitative research evaluation methodologies.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in quantitative research, quantitative analysis, or quantitative finance.
* Strong expertise in fixed income analysis and interest rate markets.
* Advanced proficiency in Python or R for quantitative research and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy.
* Strong understanding of systematic trading strategy development and backtesting.
* Experience with yield curve modeling and carry/roll-down analytics.
* Knowledge of relative value trading strategies and interest rate market instruments.
* Familiarity with SOFR and Eurodollar instruments, as well as Treasury futures.
* Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Understanding of transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and realistic trading assumptions.
* Ability to identify lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and other research methodology flaws.
* Excellent analytical, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience as a Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, or Consultant specializing in fixed income or interest rate markets.
* Experience developing and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset management firm, or investment bank.
* Strong practical knowledge of rates trading, yield curve dynamics, and quantitative modeling.
* Experience reviewing and validating quantitative models against established quantitative finance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to assess research quality, implementation fidelity, model assumptions, and statistical robustness.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

#COICareers | #EPCCareers | #DCDCareers

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
**What's the role?**
Our team has partnered closely with customers to build a robust quality measurement system for HD maps, ensuring both safety and availability in automated driving. Through multi-step review processes, we generate independent reference data for map features and attributes, guaranteeing high data integrity. This system not only evaluates map content quality against agreed KPIs but also quantifies the reliability and uncertainty of these measurements, providing timely feedback that supports critical use cases.
  
  
As a
**Senior Data Scientist**
within the Quality and Business Planning team, you are passionate about delivering quality products. This involves deploying statistical and analytic methods, measurements, and machine learning models to measure and impact the quality of our map products. You are responsible for developing sampling and test designs, data and computing workflows, and analytics centered on Map and Location quality requirements.
  
  
**What would you do?**

* Be a subject matter expert on statistical and experimental design methods for Map and Location quality testing processes
* Interpret project objectives and requirements, create enabling data science solutions and produce impactful outcomes
* Develop sampling plans for data collection, quality evaluation, and the production of training data, along with technical estimators for the evaluation of map quality, and A/B experiments to validate optimization and solution approaches
* Build and test statistical and machine learning models to support improvement of a wide variety of data-driven processes for map making
* Design and develop data and computing tools to enable processing of quality testing data and results
* Work with map and location experts, engineering teams, and other teams across the company to enable high-quality map products

**Who are you?**

* Master's or PhD degree required. Degree in statistics, mathematics, computer sciences, natural sciences, econometrics, or related fields.
* 5+ years of related work experience
* Team player with good communication, presentation, and people skills
* Proficiency and understanding of sampling methods and experimental design
* Proficiency of machine learning and modeling techniques, including analytic methods such as regression, classifiers, clustering, association rules, decision trees, etc.
* Proficiency with analysis and programming in Python and SQL, or similar packages (R, Matlab, SAS, etc.)
* Knowledge and experience with using GIS tools for spatial data analysis
* Experience with understanding, specifying and explaining measurement and analytic systems with other teams of data scientists and engineers to execute projects delivering those solutions.
* Knowledge of tools for working with big data in Hadoop or Spark for data extraction and preparation for analysis will be a plus
* Knowledge and experience in Quality management, End-to-End quality test strategy and Six Sigma will be a plus

**Who are we?**
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.
  
  
At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

title: Quant Researcher Commodities MFT
description:
**Position: Quantitative Researcher – Commodities, MFT (Neo Markets)**

**Summary:**

As a Quantitative Researcher on our Medium-Frequency Trading (MFT) desk, you will be responsible for researching, developing and deploying systematic trading strategies in commodity futures and options, with a primary focus on MCX. The ideal candidate combines strong statistical and Python skills with a solid understanding of commodity market dynamics and will work closely with traders and developers to take ideas from research to live trading.

**Job Responsibilities:**

The position holder shall be responsible for:

* Research, develop and implement systematic mid-frequency trading strategies in commodity futures and options, with a primary focus on MCX energy, base metals and bullion contracts
* Conduct alpha signal research using statistical techniques, time-series analysis and machine learning across intraday to multi-day horizons
* Model commodity-specific drivers such as term structure, calendar and inter-commodity spreads, rollover dynamics, seasonality, inventory and macro data releases
* Analyse the relationship between MCX contracts and international benchmarks (CME/NYMEX, COMEX, LME), including the impact of USD-INR movements, to identify trading opportunities
* Build predictive models for price movement, volatility and liquidity, and develop volatility and pricing models for commodity options
* Work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets (tick, bar and order book data, along with fundamental and alternative data), ensuring data quality and integrity
* Design robust backtesting frameworks in Python with realistic assumptions for transaction costs, slippage, liquidity, contract rollovers and exchange-specific constraints such as trading hours, daily price ranges and margins
* Evaluate strategy performance using metrics such as Sharpe ratio, Calmar ratio, drawdown, hit rate, turnover and PnL attribution, and conduct parameter optimization, robustness checks and stress testing
* Collaborate with traders and developers to take strategies from research into production
* Monitor live strategies, analyse realised versus expected performance, and refine models based on live feedback
* Manage strategy-level risk, including position sizing, capacity analysis and portfolio construction across commodities

**Knowledge, Competency and Skills requirement:**

* Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Economics or a related quantitative field
* 3 years of experience in quantitative research or systematic trading is preferred
* Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory), with experience in NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, statsmodels and scikit-learn
* Familiarity with version control (Git)
* Experience handling and processing large time-series datasets; working knowledge of SQL
* Solid understanding of probability and statistics, linear algebra, optimization and time-series analysis
* Good understanding of futures and options, including term structure, basis, rollovers, option pricing and Greeks
* Passion for financial markets, particularly commodities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and show exceptional prowess at managing large impact situations
* Keen to learn, hungry for growth
* Flexibility to work independently and as a part of the team

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience researching and trading commodities, particularly on MCX
* Exposure to international commodity markets (CME/NYMEX, COMEX, LME) and their linkages with domestic prices
* Prior experience at a proprietary trading firm, hedge fund or systematic trading desk running MFT strategies
* Experience running trading strategies in production with PnL responsibility
* Experience with commodity options and volatility trading
* Participation in competitive programming / Kaggle / quant competitions

description:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.

India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Own the India marketing strategy**

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

### **Build and execute account-based marketing**

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

### **Create demand that converts**

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

### **Build the India events engine**

* Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.
* Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.
* Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.
* Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

### **Turn partnerships into growth**

* Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.
* Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.
* Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

### **Establish Kong’s presence in India**

* Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.
* Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.
* Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

### **Own the budget and prove impact**

* Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.
* Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* **A builder’s mindset.** You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.
* **B2B technology marketing experience.** You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.
* **Strong ABM and demand generation expertise.** You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.
* **A track record in high-growth environments.** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* **Events that deliver results.** You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.
* **Commercial and analytical rigor.** You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.
* **Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape.** You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.
* **Clear, adaptable communication.** You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

**What will set you apart**
---------------------------

* Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
* Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.
* Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**CybersecurityEngineer, Fonazo**

**The role:**

Fonazo is hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to own the security of a real-time, multi-tenant voice AI product used by enterprises in regulated industries.

Fonazo is an AI Voice Agent Builder. A business launches a multilingual voice agent in about two minutes. Each agent has its own phone number, speaks 76 languages, sends WhatsApp and SMS, connects to customer CRM and calendar systems, and records and analyses every call. The customers are banks, insurers, hospitals, logistics firms, and government bodies across India, the UAE, the US, the UK, and Europe.

That creates a security surface few products have: live voice, telephony, language models, customer integrations, call recordings, and personal data, all inside a sub-second response budget. This role secures every layer of it and gives enterprise security teams the evidence to approve Fonazo quickly.

**Reports to** - Founder and CEO

**Base** - Pune, India

**Type** - Full time

**Experience** - 4+ years in security engineering for cloud-native, multi-tenant products

**What the role owns**

* Security architecture across the product: identity and access, network segmentation, secrets, encryption in transit and at rest, and key management.
* Tenant isolation. One customer's agents, recordings, transcripts, contacts, and analytics are never reachable from another's, and that is proven by test.
* AI and agent security: prompt injection, data leakage through agent responses, tool and integration abuse, voice spoofing, and misuse of agents for fraud or social engineering.
* Telephony and messaging security: toll fraud, number abuse, signalling attacks, and account takeover of calling resources.
* Protection of call recordings and personal data: redaction, access logging, retention enforcement, and secure deletion.
* Integration security for customer CRM, calendar, and messaging connections: token handling, scope minimisation, and webhook validation.
* Secure development lifecycle: threat modelling, code review, dependency and container scanning, and security gates in the release pipeline.
* Detection and response: logging, alerting, incident runbooks, on-call, and post-incident reviews.
* Offensive testing: internal penetration tests, management of external testers, and a responsible disclosure programme.
* The technical controls and evidence behind independent audits such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, in partnership with the Compliance Engineer.
* Enterprise security reviews: architecture walkthroughs and questionnaire responses that get Fonazo approved by bank and hospital security teams.

**What the candidate brings**

* 4+ years securing cloud-native, multi-tenant software in production.
* Depth in cloud security, container and orchestration security, and identity and access management.
* Application security experience: threat modelling, secure code review, and API security.
* Practical incident response experience, including at least one real incident led from detection to closure.
* Offensive skills sufficient to test the product personally and to judge external findings.
* Working knowledge of language model security risks, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* The judgement to add security without adding latency to a live voice call.
* Experience with real-time communications or telephony security is a strong advantage.
* Experience in BFSI, healthcare, or another regulated sector is an advantage.
* Recognised certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or cloud security specialisations are welcome and not required.

**Stack and tooling**

* Fonazo does not publish its internal architecture. Fit is assessed on what the candidate has secured in production, so every application should state:
* Cloud providers and services secured, and at what scale.
* Container, orchestration, and infrastructure as code tooling worked with.
* Detection, logging, and response tooling operated, and which detections were written personally.
* Scanning and testing tools used across code, dependencies, containers, and running systems.
* Secrets management, key management, and identity systems deployed.
* Languages used for security tooling and automation.
* Real-time voice, telephony, or messaging systems secured, if any.
* AI or language model systems secured, the threats found, and the mitigations shipped.
* The security stack the candidate would choose for a real-time, multi-tenant voice AI product from zero, and why.

**What success looks like**

Timeframe - Outcome

30 days - Full threat model of the product and a ranked remediation plan agreed with engineering

90 days - Security gates live in the release pipeline, tenant isolation tests automated, and incident runbooks rehearsed

180 days - External penetration test completed with all critical and high findings closed, and a responsible disclosure programme open

12 months - Enterprise security reviews cleared from a standard evidence pack, with independent audit controls operating continuously

**Why this role**

* A security surface that combines voice, telephony, language models, and enterprise data in real time.
* First dedicated security hire, with the authority to set the architecture and the standard.
* Security that closes deals: the work is presented directly to enterprise security teams.
* Direct line to the founder and to the engineers shipping the product.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

You'll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
**Compliance Engineer**, Fonazo

**The role:**

Fonazo is hiring a Compliance Engineer to own the Global Compliance Engine: the controls that let an AI voice agent place a lawful call in any country it operates in.

Fonazo is an AI Voice Agent Builder. A business launches a multilingual voice agent in about two minutes, and every call that agent makes passes through compliance controls enforced in the product, not in a policy document. The engine is live in five countries today.

**Country - Regimes enforced in product**

India - TRAI, DoT, DLT, DPDP Act 2023

United States - FCC, TCPA, FTC

United Kingdom - Ofcom, ICO, PECR

Germany - BNetzA, UWG

France - ARCEP, DGCCRF

The next markets are the UAE, Spain, and Italy. This role turns each new country from a legal reading into shipped, tested, auditable controls, and makes compliance the reason enterprises choose Fonazo.

Reports to - Founder and CEO

Base - Pune, India

Type - Full time

Experience - 4+ years in compliance engineering, GRC engineering, or regulated product engineering

**What the role owns**

* The Global Compliance Engine rule set for every live country: consent capture, calling windows, do-not-call and preference register scrubbing, caller identification, AI disclosure, sender and template registration, call frequency limits, and recording consent.
* Country launches. Each new market moves from regulatory text to product requirements, shipped controls, automated tests, and a customer-facing control summary.
* Compliance as code. Rules are versioned, tested, and deployed like software, so a regulatory change becomes a release, not a memo.
* Data protection engineering under DPDP, GDPR, and UK GDPR: data mapping, retention and deletion, data subject requests, cross-border transfer controls, and processor obligations.
* Audit programmes. Readiness, evidence automation, and auditor management for independent attestations such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, carried through to formal closure.
* Audit trails. Every call carries a tamper-evident record of which controls applied and why.
* Enterprise deal support: security and compliance questionnaires, data processing agreements, and regulator-facing documentation, answered in days.
* Regulatory watch across all live and planned markets, with impact assessed and scheduled before the effective date.
* Telecom registration workflows with operators and aggregators in each country.

**How Fonazo positions compliance**

Fonazo states precisely which controls the product enforces and proves each one with evidence. The person in this role protects that standard in every external document, sales conversation, and contract.

**What the candidate brings**

* 4+ years building compliance controls into a software product, or running GRC engineering for a regulated technology company.
* Working knowledge of telemarketing and electronic communications regulation in at least two of India, the US, the UK, and the EU.
* Hands-on data protection experience under GDPR or DPDP, including records of processing, impact assessments, and deletion pipelines.
* Direct experience taking a company through an independent security or privacy audit from readiness to report.
* The ability to read primary regulation and write an unambiguous product requirement and test case from it.
* Engineering skill to script, query, and automate: policy as code, evidence collection, control monitoring.
* Clear writing for three audiences: engineers, enterprise legal teams, and regulators.
* Experience with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NISTAI RMF, or ISO 42001 is a strong advantage.
* A background in telecom, fintech, healthtech, or contact centre technology is an advantage.

**Stack and tooling**

Fonazo does not publish its internal architecture. Fit is assessed on what the candidate has run in production, so every application should state:

* Cloud environments and deployment models operated in, and at what scale.
* GRC, evidence automation, and control monitoring tools used, and which were built in house.
* Policy as code and rules engine approaches used, with one example of a regulation turned into an automated control.
* Languages and data tooling used for compliance automation.
* Consent management, preference register, and data subject request systems built or integrated.
* Telephony, messaging, or communications systems worked with.
* Frameworks audited against, the candidate's exact role in each audit, and the outcome.
* The stack the candidate would choose to build a multi-country compliance engine from zero, and why.

**What success looks like**

Timeframe - Outcome

30 days - Full control inventory for all five live countries, mapped to source regulation, with gaps ranked

90 days - Automated test coverage for every live control and a standard enterprise compliance pack used by sales

180 days - One new country launched end to end and one independent audit programme in active fieldwork

12 months - New country launch reduced to a repeatable playbook measured in weeks

**Why this role**

Compliance here is the product, shipped in code and sold as a reason to buy.

Ownership of a multi-country engine at a stage where every design decision is still open.

Work that sits at the front of AI voice regulation in eight markets.

Direct line to the founder and a seat in enterprise deals.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.
  

  

**GlobalFoundries Equal Opportunity Statement**
-----------------------------------------------

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

### **No Recruitment Fee Policy**

GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately. All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact the Ethics & Compliance Office at global.compliance@globalfoundries.com. The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only.

title: Senior Lead, Security Engineering and Operations
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Senior Lead, Security Engineer is an experienced individual contributor responsible for engineering and operationalizing enterprise security platforms across Northern Trust. This role combines hands-on platform delivery with technical ownership for reliable, auditable and scalable security capabilities. It suits an engineer who can work across architecture discussions, implementation planning, operational support and deep technical troubleshooting while partnering effectively with engineering, infrastructure, application and risk stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**
==================

***Security Platform Engineering Across Key Domains***
------------------------------------------------------

* Contribute technical expertise to security platform engineering decisions and operational governance.
* Design, engineer and operate security tools spanning zero-trust, SASE/SSE, network, vulnerability & exposure management, AI guardrails, and SaaS.
* Apply engineering patterns, implementation standards and operational runbooks that support consistent adoption across business units and technology teams.

* Develop maturity models and metrics to measure assurance and compliance.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure and application teams on cross-functional security initiatives

***Key Deliverables***
----------------------

* Design, Engineer, Coordinate and Operate:
* + Intrusion prevention(IPS) across next-gen firewalls
* + Vulnerability scanning platforms and unified vulnerability management(UVM) layer
* + Enterprise SASE / SSE security platforms
* + Secure web gateway, CASB, and cloud access protection
* + SaaS application protection and monitoring
* + Secure remote access and internet traffic inspection
* + Browser isolation and modern web threat prevention
* + AI gateway controls that govern how users and applications consume LLMs and AI services

* + ServiceNow integrations (Vulnerability Response, ITSM, CMDB)
* Support technical outcomes for platform health, upgrades, capacity, resilience, lifecycle management and vendor escalations across the stack.
* Define and publish metrics on coverage, control effectiveness, SLA adherence, tool health, control performance and measurable risk reduction.
* Support audits and regulatory exams (PCI-DSS, SOX, GLBA, OCC/FFIEC) by ensuring controls are designed for evidence quality, traceability and repeatable operation.
* Author runbooks and executive-ready documentation that can be used by engineering, operations, risk and audit stakeholders.
* Evaluate new capabilities, proofs of concept and tool rationalization opportunities, with recommendations based on risk reduction, operational fit, cost and control outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

  

* Typically 12+ years of experience in information technology, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, network security or platform engineering, with hands-on experience supporting enterprise-scale security platforms.
* Ability to operate as an experienced technical contributor: making sound tradeoffs across security, reliability, usability and compliance while helping drive alignment on technical decisions.
* Deep hands-on experience with at least one SSE/SASE platform, including ZTNA, secure web gateway policy, segmentation, connector architecture and operating model design.
* Working knowledge of IPS/next-gen firewall platforms and signature tuning.
* Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, DNS, TLS/PKI, proxies and tunneling (IPsec/GRE), and segmentation.
* Experience with vulnerability management tooling.
* Familiarity with identity integration: SAML/OIDC, Entra ID, conditional access.
* Scripting and API skills (Python, PowerShell, REST/JSON).
* Experience integrating security tools with ServiceNow, SIEM platforms and enterprise reporting workflows.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to document technical decisions, support audit inquiries and collaborate with stakeholders across engineering, operations, risk and audit.
* Experience working in a regulated environment with control evidence, operational resilience, risk acceptance, issue management and audit/regulatory response expectations.

**Nice to Have**
================

  

* Exposure to AI/LLM security controls:
* AI gateways
* Prompt-injection defenses
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* MITRE ATLAS
* ServiceNow Vulnerability Response or USEM implementation experience.
* Low-code automation or Terraform/IaC.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Job title:** Domain Lead – QSR Operations & Food Cost (AI Restaurant Platform)

**Company:** Yutrix Labs LLP  
**Location:** Pune (Baner), hybrid. Occasional international travel to North America (2–4 weeks at a time).  
**Experience:** 8–12 years  
**Employment type:** Full-time

**About Yutrix Labs**  
Yutrix Labs is a Pune-based technology company building AI-native platforms for regulated and operations-heavy businesses. We are building an AI Restaurant Manager for a North American QSR franchise brand. It is an operating-control platform that watches inventory, food cost, food safety, service speed and loss prevention across restaurants. It flags exceptions with evidence and tells managers what to fix today.

We are looking for a domain lead who has run the back office of a QSR chain and wants to turn that experience into a product.

**What you will do**

* Own the business side of the product: inventory, purchasing and receiving, recipe and food cost, waste, cash control, HACCP/food safety, speed of service.
* Lead discovery workshops with the client’s operations, finance, procurement and QA teams, and with store managers.
* Turn SOPs and operating standards into system rules: thresholds, tolerances, severity levels, escalation paths and KPIs.
* Write user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and UAT scripts for the engineering and AI teams.
* Define how theoretical vs actual food cost, inventory variance, receiving variance and cash exceptions are calculated and explained.
* Review POS, inventory and purchasing data to assess data quality and design dashboards and reports.
* Support the pilot restaurant go-live: training, threshold tuning, and feedback from store teams.
* Act as the trusted operations voice with the client, and challenge scope where it doesn’t match how restaurants really work.

**What we are looking for**

* 8–12 years in QSR or fast-casual chains, with at least 3–5 years in restaurant operations, cost control, supply chain or operations excellence at a multi-unit or franchise brand.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of:
* Recipe/BOM costing, yields, portion standards and packaging BOMs
* Theoretical vs actual (AvT) food cost and variance analysis
* Inventory management: cycle counts, UOM conversions, FEFO/expiry, transfers, shrinkage
* Purchasing and receiving: par levels, reorder logic, 3-way match, price variance, supplier claims
* Store operations: opening and closing, waste capture, cash reconciliation, voids, refunds and discounts
* HACCP and food safety: temperature logs, holding times, cleaning, allergen control, audits
* Speed of service and KDS flow
* Franchise standards, audits and scorecards
* Experience working with technology teams on a POS, inventory, ERP or restaurant software rollout, as business owner or functional consultant.
* Strong analytical skills (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus).
* Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence running workshops with senior client stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Experience with restaurant systems such as POS/KDS, inventory and costing tools (e.g. Restroworks/Posist, MarketMan, Restaurant365, CrunchTime) or ERP purchasing modules.
* Central kitchen or commissary operations, halal or spec-compliant sourcing.
* Loss prevention or internal audit experience in F&B or retail.
* Exposure to North American or Middle East QSR markets. French is a bonus.

**Why join us**

* Shape an AI product from day one, alongside architects, data scientists and engineers.
* Work directly with an international QSR brand, with travel to the client.
* A small, senior team that builds fast and makes heavy use of AI tools.
* Competitive compensation.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,050,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Success in this position requires a balance of inspirational people leadership, rigorous analytical craft, and executive stakeholder management. You will champion a culture of "context over control," empowering your team to solve complex problems independently while ensuring regional deliverables seamlessly align with QMI’s global strategic objectives across London, Princeton, and New York.
