title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technical Program ManagerAn AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.  
  
Experiences  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Portfolio, Product, & Value
description:
The Senior Product Manager, AI Portfolio, Product & Value (Focus: Commercial) owns AI products for Sensata's commercial organization, starting with Sales and Revenue Operations and extending to Pricing, Marketing and Commercial Finance. Working directly with sellers, account managers, pricing and commercial finance teams, the role maps how work gets done today, pinpoints the real pain points, and shapes AI solutions whose features directly address them. This includes defining what gets built and the first version's scope and acceptance criteria. The role also owns prioritization, business cases and measured value, so solutions move from pilot to production and are used every day.

General Responsibilities  

* Drives the development of actionable product roadmaps by integrating inputs from cross-functional stakeholders in our business objectives & product strategy.
* Manage product positioning in the marketplace, including rationalizing pricing strategy based on market conditions.
* Develop product strategy and optimize product portfolio, providing planning and project prioritization
* Contributes to the pricing strategy through the product life cycle.
* Drives the development and execution of the product roadmap to improvement
* Provide support for operational issues associated with quality, delivery and production.
* Anticipating and communicating issues, recommending corrective action, and taking independent remedial actions and reporting outcomes

Experience / Qualifications  

* A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

**Additional Responsibilities**:

* Own AI products for commercial use cases, starting with Sales and Revenue Operations (e.g., lead triage and routing, opportunity scoring, account insights, next-best-offer) and extending to Pricing, Marketing and Commercial Finance (e.g., quote guidance, pipeline and bookings forecasting, competitor and peer performance intelligence).
* Map current workflows with sellers, account managers, pricing, marketing and commercial finance teams. Identify pain points, root causes and where AI can improve decisions or remove manual work.
* Translate pain points into product requirements: map AI features against each pain point, write user stories, and define the first version's scope, acceptance criteria and success metrics.
* Own the product backlog and roadmap. Prioritize features and make clear trade-offs with AI engineers, data scientists and the AI Architect.
* Test solutions with users, run pilots, gather feedback and iterate until the product is adopted in daily work.
* Run intake, triage and prioritization for commercial AI use cases, and recommend scale, pivot or stop decisions.
* Build business cases with business owners and Finance (baseline, target value, cost). After go-live, track realized value such as revenue growth, win rate, price and margin, pipeline conversion and seller productivity.
* Make sure every product has a named business owner, success metrics and an adoption plan before build starts.
* Work with AI Governance, AI Enablement, IT and vendors (eg Salesforce) so products clear governance gates and fit into CRM, CPQ and ERP systems. Own business requirements in vendor and build/buy evaluations.
* Report product status, value and key decisions to AI leadership and business leaders.

**Additional Qualifications**:

* 7+ years in product management, digital/AI product, sales operations, revenue operations or commercial roles, including 3+ years owning data, analytics or AI products.
* Hands-on commercial background, ideally in sales operations, revenue operations, pricing, key account management or commercial finance.
* Strong product discovery skills: workflow and process mapping, user research and pain-point analysis, turned into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

title: Product Manager - ZTNA experience is required
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

### **About Cloud Secure Edge**

Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall's cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that provides enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall's SASE transformation.

### **The Role**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will connect engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform's evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall's SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
* Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
* Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.

#### **Technical Product Ownership**

* Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
* Drive integration strategy across SonicWall's security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
* Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
* Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.

#### **Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership**

* Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
* Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
* Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.

#### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Go-to-Market**

* Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
* Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design-partner programs, and gather feedback.
* Support sales engineering teams with technical deep-dives, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements.
* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
* Proven track record of shipping cloud-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi-tenant platforms.
* Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-level stakeholders..

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
* Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
* Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
* Background in data-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
* AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

**Company Description**

QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.

The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.

 **Job Description**

The **Lead AI Engagement Specialist** owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.

This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.

**Where this role sits**

**Reports to:** Head of the AI Centre of Excellence

**Alignment:** Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover

**Works with:** AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required

**Owns:** The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.

**Accountable for:** Realised, measured business value — not deployment count

**What you will own**

**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**

This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.

**Strongly preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain knowledge.
* Having deployed AI or automation into production and lived with the results — including a deployment that underperformed and what you did about it.
* Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience working alongside system integrators or external delivery partners.

**What this role is not**

* Not a process documentation role. Mapping is an input; redesigned, adopted, measured work is the output.
* Not a change communications role. You own the product, not the announcement.
* Not a requirements-gathering role. You will not hand a wish list to engineering and wait; you will specify, decide and stay accountable through production.
* Not a role that ends at go-live. Managing agent performance afterwards is a permanent part of the job.

**What success looks like**

**First 3 months**

* A credible, ranked workflow pipeline for your functions, grounded in real process data and endorsed by function leadership.
* The first one or two PRDs written and accepted into build by the architect and engineering without a translation gap.
* Baselines established for the metrics your first workflows will move.

**First 6 months**

* First workflows live in production, with adoption instrumented and quality actively monitored.
* A functioning feedback loop between live agent performance and the engineering backlog.
* A 12-month roadmap for your function that leadership has signed up to.

**First 12 months**

* Measured, defensible business value delivered against pre-established baselines — reported honestly, including where the result fell short.
* Adoption at a level where the redesigned workflow is the normal way the work is done, not an optional tool.
* At least one reusable pattern contributed to the CoE and adopted by another function.
* A function that is materially more capable of absorbing the next wave than it was when you joined.

**How we assess**

* Portfolio conversation — a transformation or product initiative you owned end to end, including the value actually realised versus the value forecast.
* Written exercise — a short PRD or workflow redesign on a realistic problem from your function.
* Working session with the AI CoE on scoping and quality definition for a live QAD workflow.
* Stakeholder interview with leadership from the function you would cover.

 **Additional Information**  

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Senior Associate - AI Platform Lead Engineer
description:
**AI Platform Lead Engineer**  
The Senior Associate, AI Platform Lead Engineer (Foundation Engineering) will design, build, and optimize the core infrastructure and tooling powering AI agent systems and LLM/SLM applications within the AI Center of Excellence. This individual works at the intersection of AI engineering and backend systems design, building scalable, production-grade foundations for enterprise AI initiatives.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* Design and develop AI agent frameworks and orchestration layers supporting enterprise use cases
* Apply LLM optimization techniques (quantization, distillation, prompt/context optimization, caching) to improve latency, cost, and performance
* Lead fine-tuning efforts for small language models (SLMs) tailored to domain-specific use cases
* Architect and implement backend services and APIs supporting AI model integration and deployment
* Design and deploy AI infrastructure and services on AWS/cloud platforms
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enable standardized tool and data access for AI agents
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Mentor Associate-level engineers and review code/design for quality
* Evaluate emerging agentic AI and LLM engineering tools/research and recommend adoption
* Contribute to engineering standards and documentation for the Foundation Engineering practice
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Python with production-grade backend development experience
* Demonstrated experience with agent development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen)
* Proven experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale LLM solutions, multi-agent workflows, and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with robust context and memory management systems
* Hands-on experience with LLM optimization techniques (prompt engineering, RAG, quantization, distillation, fine-tuning)
* Practical experience fine-tuning SLMs
* Solid backend development experience including API design, microservices, and system architecture
* Required expertise in AWS and cloud infrastructure (compute, storage, networking, security, deployment/CI-CD)
* Mandatory hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for building standardized agent-to-tool and agent-to-data integrations
* Background in machine learning fundamentals preferred
* Strong communication skills
* Demonstrated stakeholder management skills engaging business leaders, product owners, and cross-functional partners
* Prior experience mentoring junior engineers preferred
  

**Educational Requirements**

Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred

  

**Work Experience**

5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

  

**Physical Requirements**

Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

  
  

**Career Level**  
8IC

NA

Related SkillsContinuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle

title: Senior Project Manager_3418
description:
Role Description Responsibilities
  
  
Are you energised by turning complex, multi-team technology programmes into predictable delivery for one of the world's largest financial services groups?
  
  
If so, this role puts you at the centre of that work. You will own the end-to-end delivery of projects across the Allianz Data Platform and the wider DAP portfolio, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure, translating complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables that engineering teams can act on.The role sits at the crossroads of business, technology, and data, which means the governance you put in place, from risk and dependency management through to status reporting and escalation, shapes how thousands of colleagues across Allianz Group turn data into decisions.To get there, you will facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams, and work alongside Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to keep delivery aligned with DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.What we value most is your ability to bring structure to ambiguity, engage credibly with engineers on technical trade-offs, navigate stakeholders, product owners, and vendors, and coach the project managers coming up behind you.
  
  
**As part of this role you will:**  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale data, analytics, and AI platform projects, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables, ensuring alignment between stakeholder expectations and engineering outcomes.
* Work closely with new and emerging technologies to improve platform usability, performance, and scalability across the DAP ecosystem.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, documentation, delivery, and ongoing maintenance, acting as the connective tissue between workstreams.
* Evaluate and make informed decisions around the adoption of new or existing technologies, tools, and project management methodologies.
* Define and maintain project governance frameworks, including risk management plans, dependency tracking, status reporting, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams.
* Coach and mentor junior project managers and support the professional development of team members across the organisation.
* Collaborate with Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to contribute to and align with the DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, product owners, and external vendors or partners.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery practices, tooling, and team ways of working.

✅ Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor/Master degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in technical project management, with a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects, ideally within financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* 1+ years of experience contributing to system design or architecture discussions (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling) within data, analytics, AI, or platform engineering contexts.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycles and the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams on technical topics.
* Experience working with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, SQL, Bash) at a level sufficient to understand technical trade-offs and review technical documentation.
* Demonstrated experience in object-oriented or data-oriented programming concepts, enabling effective collaboration with development teams.
* Experience with end-to-end (E2E) Data Product Management, including data governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Strong command of agile project management methodologies, including SAFe, Scrum, and/or Kanban.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

⭐ Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in technical project management, ideally within data engineering, analytics platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software environments.
* Experience managing the full software or data product development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing pipelines, and operational support.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe, or equivalent.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern data stack technologies (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar).
* Experience working in a multinational or globally distributed organisation, ideally within financial services, insurance, or a regulated industry.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  
**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Architect Manager, Data & AI (GenAI) — Tax Automations & Innovation
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Tax Technology Automations & Innovation team — known internally as the AI Team — builds the automations, Generative AI, and internal tooling that let DoorDash's global Tax function scale as the business grows across the US, Canada, and — through Wolt and Deliveroo — internationally. We turn manual, repetitive tax work into reliable, governed software, and we bring modern AI into the heart of how a tax function operates — responsibly, and with auditability built in. The team is organised into an AI Strategy function and three regional pillars: EMEA, US & Canada, and Coffee & Special Projects.

This role sits in the AI Strategy function and reports to the Tax Technology lead. You will set the technical and AI direction the three regional pillars build around, and partner across Tax, Tax Tech, Data Operations, Accounting, Product, and Engineering, as well as InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.

**About the Role**
------------------

DoorDash is looking for a senior-level AI and data expert to lead how the Tax department operates through automation, Generative AI, and intelligent data tooling. Beyond building high-impact automation, you will set the strategy for how LLMs, GenAI, and machine learning are integrated into critical tax workflows at scale, and act as the AI authority for the function.

This is the role that makes the entire team AI-native rather than merely AI-assisted. By owning the AI and automation governance framework, you will also ensure that everything the team builds on top of sensitive tax data stays controlled, defensible, and audit-ready. You don't just build — you set the bar, mentor the regional teams, and decide how we adopt a fast-moving technology responsibly.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Define and lead the GenAI strategy for the Tax function, identifying high-value use cases and setting adoption standards.
* Architect and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions — intelligent assistants, AI-driven classification, anomaly detection, automated audit support, document summarization, and retrieval-augmented reporting.
* Own the AI and automation governance framework — model risk, change control, testing and validation standards, documentation, and auditability for tools that touch tax data and filings.
* Set the rules for responsible, controlled AI use, including data privacy, data residency, and what data may be sent to external model providers, partnering with InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance.
* Partner with senior Tax, Product, and Engineering leaders to drive requirements and deliver measurable business impact.
* Mentor the Senior Analysts and Associate Managers across all regional pillars on applying GenAI/LLMs effectively and within governance guardrails.
* Quantify, track, and communicate the business impact of AI solutions (efficiency gains, error reduction, compliance risk mitigation).

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AI, GenAI, and data automation, delivering production-grade solutions at scale.
* You have deep expertise in LLMs and GenAI techniques — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation frameworks, conversational AI, classification, and summarization.
* You are advanced in Python and SQL and have built scalable AI and automation pipelines.
* You have a strong background in automation and applied analytics, ideally in tax, finance, or regulated industries.
* You have deployed AI in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Databricks.
* You have expertise in AI governance, compliance, and risk management for regulated environments.
* You can translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive tools for non-technical users, and influence at all levels from hands-on teams to executives.
* You have a Bachelor's degree or higher.
* You have (preferably) knowledge of tax technology platforms or experience with global tax teams
* You have (preferably) experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or e-commerce company.

**About DoorDash**
==================

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Scientist
  
  
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Executive Reporting Centre of Excellence
  
  
Product Data & Analytics is a centralized global team that enables Mastercard product business units to make better data‑driven decisions. We build internal analytics partnerships that strengthen focus on business performance, portfolio and revenue optimization, initiative tracking, new product development, and go‑to‑market strategies. These capabilities are underpinned by our data platforms that enable insights to be delivered in a standardized, scalable, and cost‑efficient manner.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Senior Data Scientist to drive enterprise-level KPI reporting, business performance tracking, and strategic analytics initiatives across global business units and regions.
  
  
The role will be responsible for owning end-to-end analytics solutions from requirement gathering, conceptualization, KPI framework design, data engineering, dashboard development, stakeholder alignment, finance automation, and ongoing commercialization of reporting solutions. The candidate will partner with global business leaders, Finance, FP&A, data providers, and technology teams to transform complex business requirements into scalable analytical products that enable executive decision-making. This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, technical expertise, product thinking, and team leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage executive-level KPI reporting across multiple business units, products, and regions.
* Design and implement scalable KPI measurement frameworks, reporting methodologies, and governance processes.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting products using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Python.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and operational scalability.
* Lead finance automation initiatives that transform manual FP&A reporting packs into governed, scalable, role-based dashboards and financial intelligence layers.
* Partner with global stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, resolve reporting issues, and provide actionable insights.
* Monitor data quality, perform validations, and ensure accuracy of business-critical reporting.
* Lead cross-functional projects from conceptualization through implementation, commercialization, and business adoption.
* Translate complex business problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions for senior leadership.
* Evaluate, identify, and integrate GenAI and AI capabilities into existing products and business processes.
* Contribute to AI product roadmap planning by identifying opportunities for AI-driven features, automation, insights generation, and user experience enhancements.
* Collaborate with technology teams to define AI solution architecture, integration requirements, data dependencies, and governance standards.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical tools, analytics best practices, AI adoption, and business processes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize deliverables, and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives.

Job Requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product Analytics, Product Management, or related fields.
* Experience designing and managing enterprise-level KPI frameworks and executive reporting solutions with proven ability to build scalable analytics products and automate reporting processes.
* Experience automating finance or FP&A reporting processes, including revenue, expense, driver, budget, forecast, and P&L reporting, with strong understanding of financial data governance and validation.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, AI agents, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience evaluating, planning, and integrating AI capabilities into business products and analytical solutions.
* Understanding of AI solution architecture, data flows, API integrations, model governance, and deployment considerations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into product roadmaps and identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data validation, performance measurement, and reporting governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, and product planning capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile/Product-oriented environments; CSPO, CSM, Product Management, AI, or Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager - Data Science
description:
**About noon**

We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, who can help us move even faster.

noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

**What you'll do**

* ***Applied AI, analytics automation and internal tools (must have***
  *)*

• Lead analytics automation by connecting LLMs to governed data: certified metrics, curated tables and semantic layers.

•Ensure AI-generated insights are accurate, explainable and secure, with clear evaluation, transparency and data governance built in from the start.

• Build internal tools and self-serve products that help teams answer their own questions and reduce ad-hoc requests.

• Spot opportunities nobody has asked for yet, and turn the best into solutions teams actually adopt.

* ***Data science***

• Build solutions that shape how customers discover, engage with, and buy on noon, from personalized recommendations to a smarter, more relevant app experience.

• Choose the simplest method that works, and measure models on business outcomes, not just offline accuracy.

* ***Product analytics and experimentation***

• Partner with PMs on what to build and how to measure it: North Star and guardrail metrics, funnels, cohorts, opportunity sizing and A/B test design and readouts.

• Own experimentation standards, from randomization, power and pre-registered metrics to novelty effects and clear ship/kill decisions.

• Push back when the data doesn't support a decision, and propose what to do instead.

* ***Lead and grow the team***

• Manage analysts and data scientists: hiring, goals, reviews, coaching and hard performance conversations when needed.

• Allocate capacity across squads and run a clear intake and prioritization process with Product.

• Raise the quality bar by reviewing analyses, test designs and models before they reach stakeholders.

* ***Communicate and influence***

• Turn complex data into clear recommendations and actionable stories for leadership.

• Build trust with Product, Engineering and Business by being direct, timely and right.

**What you bring**

• 7–9 years in product analytics, data science or growth analytics, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces or consumer tech at scale.

• 2+ years managing analysts or data scientists as direct reports, including hiring, reviews and handling underperformance. Mentoring alone doesn't count.

• Strong SQL and Python, plus a cloud warehouse (Big Query preferred) and a BI tool (Looker preferred).

• Deep experimentation skills, including knowing when results can't be trusted.

• Production experience applying LLMs to analytics or internal tools, and the safeguards you added when things went wrong.

• Product thinking and clear communication with senior stakeholders, even when the answer isn't what they wanted.

* ***Nice to have***

• Text-to-SQL, RAG or agent workflows over a semantic layer or metric catalogue.

• Building internal data tools or self-serve analytics products.

• Recommendation systems, personalization or search ranking.

• Causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modelling).

• GCC or Arabic-language product experience.

**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**ETAP**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:** Team Lead - R&D
  
**Location:** Delhi, India
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**The job**

We are looking for an R&D Technical Lead to lead software development and R&D activities for ETAP Real-Time products. The role focuses on SCADA, ADMS, real-time power-system applications, communication protocols, product testing, and engineering solutions. You will work closely with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams to develop innovative solutions, improve product quality, and address evolving market and customer requirements. This position will contribute to strengthening ETAP’s local R&D capabilities in India and supporting software localization and innovation initiatives.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate R&D and product development activities, providing technical guidance, reviewing solutions, mentoring developers, and resolving technical challenges.
* Coordinate verification and validation (V&V), functional, integration, and regression testing, ensuring defects and Incident Reports (IRs) are investigated, tracked, and resolved.
* Manage development tasks, testing activities, defects, and priorities in Jira, monitor progress against timelines, and communicate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Evaluate new technologies, communication protocols, and market requirements; develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and contribute to product performance, reliability, scalability, and usability improvements.
* Collaborate with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams on technical reviews, release planning, product demonstrations, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

**Essential requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in software development, R&D, or engineering software, preferably involving SCADA, real-time systems, industrial automation, or power-system applications.
* Strong programming knowledge in C#, .NET, or .NET Framework; experience with software design, debugging, performance analysis, and system integration.
* Working knowledge of databases and development tools, including SQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, REST APIs, Git, and Visual Studio.
* Experience coordinating technical activities or guiding development teams, with good problem-solving, planning, communication, and team coordination skills.

**Desired skills and competencies**

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Hiring: AI-Native Technical Product Owner & Agentic Systems Engineer

**Company:** RoamYoo  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 years preferred; exceptional builders with demonstrable production experience are welcome

About RoamYoo

RoamYoo is building an AI-powered, social-meets-marketplace travel platform that connects travellers with verified local hosts, authentic experiences, group trips, stays, transport, and community-driven travel opportunities.

We are looking for a highly capable, technology-driven professional who can take ownership of multiple applications, manage the complete product lifecycle, build AI-powered systems, automate engineering workflows, and ensure that every application is reliable, secure, scalable, and production-ready.

This is not a conventional Product Owner role focused on meetings, documentation, and task management.

We need a **hands-on technical owner who can think like a product manager, build like an engineer, automate like a DevOps specialist, and troubleshoot like a production engineer.**

Role Overview

You will own the complete lifecycle of multiple digital products and applications, from requirements and architecture to development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

You must understand how modern AI coding tools, agentic workflows, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation systems work together to deliver production-grade applications.

You will be expected to work independently, identify technical and product problems, implement solutions, coordinate with other developers when required, and take accountability for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Ownership & Application Management

* Own multiple web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, admin panels, and AI-powered products.
* Convert business requirements into product specifications, user stories, technical tasks, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage product roadmaps, sprint priorities, backlogs, releases, and dependencies.
* Understand user journeys, business logic, database relationships, API integrations, and application architecture.
* Coordinate product development from initial prototype to MVP and production release.
* Identify bottlenecks, technical debt, performance issues, and opportunities for automation.
* Maintain product documentation, system diagrams, API documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks.
* Ensure applications remain functional as requirements, users, integrations, and business processes evolve.

2. Agentic AI Systems & AI Engineering

* Design, implement, and maintain agentic AI workflows that can plan, execute tasks, use tools, and validate outcomes.
* Build multi-agent systems where appropriate, including orchestration, delegation, state management, retries, and human approval checkpoints.
* Work with LLM APIs, structured outputs, function calling, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and embeddings.
* Understand agent memory, context management, evaluation, guardrails, and failure recovery.
* Integrate AI agents with databases, internal applications, third-party APIs, browser tools, and business workflows.
* Develop reliable workflows rather than depending on unstructured prompts alone.
* Implement observability, tracing, evaluation datasets, token and latency monitoring, and cost controls.
* Know when to use a deterministic workflow instead of an autonomous agent.

**Relevant technologies:** OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, vector databases, and other relevant agent orchestration frameworks.

3. AI-Assisted & Agentic Software Development

* Work effectively with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI-assisted development environments.
* Use AI coding agents for implementation, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, and documentation.
* Create reusable project instructions, coding standards, agent skills, tool integrations, and repeatable development workflows.
* Design multi-step coding workflows with planning, implementation, testing, review, and validation.
* Understand the code being generated rather than blindly accepting AI-generated output.
* Review AI-generated code for security vulnerabilities, incorrect business logic, performance problems, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control, pull requests, branch protection, and code review practices.
* Establish a repeatable workflow for moving from an idea or prompt to tested, deployable software.

4. Full-Stack Development & System Architecture

* Understand and work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Build and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces.
* Design REST APIs and understand GraphQL where appropriate.
* Implement authentication, role-based access control, permissions, session management, and secure data handling.
* Design database schemas, migrations, indexes, relationships, transactions, and query optimization.
* Integrate payment gateways, messaging systems, maps, analytics, AI services, and third-party platforms.
* Understand modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven systems, background jobs, and asynchronous processing.
* Diagnose issues across the entire stack instead of treating frontend and backend as isolated components.

**Preferred technologies:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, and other equivalent production-grade technologies.

5. Automated Deployment & DevOps

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, builds, deployments, and release verification.
* Configure development, staging, and production environments.
* Manage environment variables, secrets, configuration, and database migrations safely.
* Work with GitHub Actions, Docker, cloud hosting, managed databases, and deployment platforms.
* Automate build validation, linting, type checks, test execution, security scanning, and release workflows.
* Implement deployment verification, health checks, rollback procedures, and recovery plans.
* Understand containerization, infrastructure configuration, networking, logs, and application runtime environments.
* Manage production releases with minimal downtime and controlled risk.
* Troubleshoot failed deployments, dependency conflicts, build errors, server issues, and environment-specific bugs.

**Relevant tools:** GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, AWS, GCP, Azure, Railway, Render, Supabase, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools.

6. Quality Assurance & Production Readiness

* Build a reliable testing strategy covering unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Vitest, Jest, or equivalent frameworks.
* Verify critical business flows before releases, including authentication, payments, bookings, notifications, and admin operations.
* Identify race conditions, edge cases, inconsistent data, permission errors, and failure scenarios.
* Implement structured logging, error tracking, uptime monitoring, and application performance monitoring.
* Use tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and cloud-native monitoring solutions.
* Establish production-readiness checklists, incident response procedures, backup policies, and disaster recovery practices.
* Ensure that an application is not considered complete merely because it works on a developer's machine.

7. Security, Reliability & Scalability

* Apply secure coding practices and follow relevant OWASP guidance.
* Prevent common vulnerabilities such as injection, broken access control, exposed secrets, and insecure API endpoints.
* Protect user data and implement appropriate authorization, validation, rate limiting, and audit logging.
* Understand secure authentication flows, password handling, OAuth, and token management.
* Manage database backups, recovery procedures, dependency vulnerabilities, and access permissions.
* Identify scalability bottlenecks and optimize database queries, API response times, caching, and background processing.
* Establish sensible controls for AI tool permissions, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe agent actions.

8. Technical Documentation & Engineering Operations

* Maintain a clear inventory of all applications, repositories, environments, domains, integrations, and deployment pipelines.
* Document architecture, setup instructions, environment configuration, dependencies, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Track technical debt, recurring production issues, service dependencies, and infrastructure costs.
* Create reusable templates and standards so new applications can be launched consistently.
* Ensure that no critical system depends entirely on undocumented knowledge held by one individual.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical competence in the following areas:

* **Product engineering:** Requirements gathering, feature prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and product lifecycle ownership.
* **Programming:** Strong proficiency in at least one production-grade language, preferably TypeScript or Python.
* **Full-stack fundamentals:** Frontend, backend, REST APIs, authentication, databases, and integrations.
* **Agentic AI:** LLM integration, tool calling, agent orchestration, structured outputs, workflow reliability, and evaluation.
* **AI development tools:** Practical experience with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or comparable AI coding agents.
* **Version control:** Git, GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review.
* **CI/CD:** Automated pipelines, build checks, deployment automation, release verification, and rollback.
* **Cloud and infrastructure:** Practical experience deploying and operating real applications.
* **Testing:** Automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* **Production operations:** Logs, monitoring, incident diagnosis, backups, performance, and reliability.
* **Security:** Secrets management, authorization, secure API design, and dependency management.
* **Technical communication:** Ability to explain architecture, trade-offs, risks, and implementation decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing or maintaining multiple production applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI-powered products or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP servers, reusable agent skills, and tool integrations.
* Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, authentication systems, and database migrations.
* Experience with payment gateways, third-party integrations, and webhook processing.
* Understanding of queues, scheduled jobs, event-driven workflows, and distributed system fundamentals.
* Experience with observability, cloud cost optimization, and infrastructure automation.
* Familiarity with travel technology, marketplaces, booking systems, SaaS products, or consumer applications.
* Experience working in a startup environment with limited resources and high ownership expectations.

What We Expect From You

* Take ownership from problem identification to verified resolution.
* Build and maintain systems instead of relying entirely on other developers or external agencies.
* Make informed decisions about when to code manually, use AI agents, or automate a workflow.
* Prioritize reliability, security, maintainability, and business value over impressive demos.
* Move quickly without compromising essential engineering standards.
* Work independently, communicate blockers early, and document critical decisions.
* Be comfortable operating in an environment where product requirements and priorities evolve.
* Treat the product as something you are responsible for building and improving, not merely a list of assigned tickets.

First 90-Day Success Criteria

**First 30 days — Understand and stabilize**

* Audit existing applications, repositories, infrastructure, integrations, and deployment processes.
* Identify critical bugs, security gaps, undocumented dependencies, and operational risks.
* Create an application inventory, architecture overview, and prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Days 31–60 — Automate and improve**

* Establish reliable CI/CD workflows for priority applications.
* Improve automated testing, monitoring, error reporting, and release procedures.
* Build or improve at least one meaningful AI-powered workflow or agentic automation.
* Document setup, deployment, rollback, and recovery processes.

**Days 61–90 — Deliver and scale**

* Independently deliver a production-ready feature or application improvement.
* Demonstrate repeatable, tested deployments with appropriate release safeguards.
* Establish measurable engineering KPIs, including deployment success, escaped defects, recovery time, and release lead time.
* Present a technical roadmap covering scalability, security, AI automation, reliability, and engineering efficiency.

Application Process

Please share:

* Your resume and LinkedIn profile.
* GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant technical projects.
* One application you have taken from development to production.
* One example of an AI agent or automation workflow you have built.
* Your role in deployment automation, testing, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
* The AI coding tools, frameworks, cloud services, and development tools you use regularly.

Candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment covering application architecture, AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, debugging, automated deployment, and production-readiness decisions.

**We are looking for builders who can take complete ownership of technology and turn ideas into dependable, production-ready products.**

Pay: ₹519,000.00 - ₹630,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What kind of end to product you have handled
* Define product ownership to you, as core skills and expertise you should have.
* Define product ownership role to you, as core skills and expertise you dont have.

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Location**
------------

New Delhi, India; Mumbai, India

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
