**Required Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience working in a full-stack capacity
* 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and building modern front-end user interfaces using React.js (including state management, Hooks, and component architecture)
* 4+ years of backend software engineering experience using Java and enterprise frameworks (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot)
* 4+ years of experience working with relational databases and writing complex PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and database optimizations
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices to support React web applications and AI/ML integrations
* 3+ years of experience working within an Agile/Scrum development team
* 3+ years of experience integrating AI/ML models, machine learning APIs, or intelligent automation services into software applications

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AI/ML frameworks, model deployment platforms, Large Language Models (LLMs), or MLOps practices
* Experience with advanced React state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API) and modern web build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite)
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

**Vice President, Tech Lead**

PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY - 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**Position Summary**
====================

Prudential is seeking a Vice President, Tech Lead for our Data & AI Shared Services team to serve as a senior leader within PFI India. This individual will build and lead Prudential's Data & AI Shared Services organization in India, establishing scalable capabilities that support enterprise priorities across data engineering, AI engineering, platforms, enterprise business intelligence, data enablement, process excellence, and delivery management.

The successful candidate will be responsible for translating enterprise Data & AI priorities into a scalable operating model, workforce strategy, talent pipeline, engineering excellence, and delivery capabilities that accelerate business outcomes and strengthen internal ownership of critical capabilities. The role will operate in close partnership with the Chief Data & AI Office, PFI India leadership, People Team, and Talent Acquisition to build an enduring capability hub that supports Prudential's long-term Data & AI strategy.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Strategy and Capability Development**
---------------------------------------

* Establish and scale Prudential's Data & AI Shared Services organization within PFI India.
* Develop and execute a multi-year capability strategy aligned to enterprise Data & AI priorities.
* Partner with global leaders to build sustainable engineering, platform, governance, automation, analytics, and reporting capabilities and related outcomes.
* Translate enterprise demand into workforce, organizational, infrastructure, and investment plans.
* Drive adoption of common standards, reusable capabilities, and scalable operating models.

**Organization Leadership**
---------------------------

* Lead the development of a high-performing Data & AI organization across multiple disciplines.
* Establish leadership structures, governance processes, operational practices, and performance expectations.
* Build succession pipelines and strengthen leadership capabilities throughout the organization.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders across Prudential and PFI India.

**Talent and Workforce Management**
-----------------------------------

* Develop workforce plans aligned with enterprise priorities and business demand.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, and development of talent across Data & AI disciplines.
* Partner with People Team and Talent Acquisition to strengthen hiring strategies and talent pipelines.
* Build capabilities that support long-term workforce transformation and skills development.
* Establish programs that attract, develop, and retain critical technical talent.

**Delivery and Operational Excellence**
---------------------------------------

* Ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives and capability-building efforts.
* Drive operational excellence across delivery, workforce transitions, vendor management, and knowledge transfer activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, governance, and execution effectiveness.
* Promote adoption of shared platforms, reusable solutions, analytics assets, and engineering best practices.
* Monitor and report on progress, outcomes, and capability maturity measures.

**Enterprise Partnership and Influence**
----------------------------------------

* Build strong relationships with senior business and technology leaders across Prudential.
* Partner closely with the Chief Data & AI Office to align priorities, investments, and workforce decisions.
* Collaborate with PFI India leadership to support broader Innovation Centre objectives.
* Represent Prudential in external talent, technology, and industry forums as appropriate.

**Areas of Responsibility**
===========================

The role will provide leadership across capabilities that may include:

* Data & AI Engineering
* Data & AI Platforms
* Process Excellence and Intelligent Automation
* Strategy & Delivery
* Data Enablement and Governance Support
* Enterprise Business Intelligence, including BI platforms, reporting, dashboards, analytics products, performance insights, and decision-support capabilities.

These capabilities may evolve over time based on enterprise priorities and workforce strategies.

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of experience leading large-scale technology, data, AI, analytics, or engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling technology or engineering teams within India.
* Proven leadership experience in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Platforms, AI Platforms, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Experience leading complex organizational transformation, capability-building, or shared-services initiatives.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Experience managing workforce planning, organizational development, and talent strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and deliver measurable business outcomes.

**What Will Set You Apart?**
============================

* Experience building or leading a Global Capability Center (GCC), Innovation Centre, Shared Services organization, or Center of Excellence.
* Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise AI adoption, modern engineering practices, advanced analytics, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Leadership Competencies**
===========================

* Strategic Thinking
* Operational Excellence
* Enterprise Leadership
* Business Partnership
* Talent Development
* Innovation Mindset
* Organizational Effectiveness
* Results Orientation
* Change Leadership
* Executive Presence and Influence

**Success Measures**
====================

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Development and maturation of enterprise Data & AI capabilities within PFI India.
* Achievement of workforce, talent, and leadership development objectives.
* Execution of strategic capability-building priorities and operational outcomes.
* Establishment of scalable engineering, analytics, and platform capabilities.
* Adoption of reusable enterprise solutions and standards.
* Expansion of internal capability ownership and reduced dependence on external providers where appropriate.
* Delivery of measurable business value through data, AI, analytics, and operational excellence capabilities.

**PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
**Locations**: London | Lisbon | Gurgaon

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 393282
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in API testing, automation framework architecture, microservices validation, integration testing, service virtualization, performance, security, and AI-enabled Quality Engineering.
  
  
This is a senior customer-facing technical role responsible for assessing API landscapes, defining testing solutions, building reusable automation approaches, and guiding QA teams through implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the end-to-end API testing architecture and solutioning strategy across enterprise applications.
* Understand business and technical architecture and translate it into a comprehensive API Quality Engineering strategy.
* Define API testing approaches covering functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, negative, security, performance, and resiliency testing.
* Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and microservices.
* Define automation solutions using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman, Python/PyTest, Java, ReadyAPI/SoapUI, or equivalent.
* Architect testing solutions for complex microservices and distributed API ecosystems.
* Define API validation strategies across UI → API → Microservices → Database → Downstream systems.
* Establish contract testing strategies using tools such as Pact and consumer/provider contract validation.
* Define testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous APIs, including Kafka/event-driven architectures and messaging systems.
* Design service virtualization/mocking solutions where dependent APIs or downstream systems are unavailable.
* Define API test data management and synthetic data generation approaches.
* Establish API automation integration with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and quality gates.
* Define API performance and scalability testing approaches using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, K6, or equivalent.
* Establish API security validation covering authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, data protection, and common API vulnerabilities.
* Define automation coverage, quality metrics, defect prevention strategies, and release-readiness criteria.
* Review existing QA frameworks and recommend modernization and automation improvements.
* Identify opportunities to use AI/GenAI in API testing, including test scenario generation, test data generation, automation script generation, defect analysis, and test optimization.
* Conduct PoCs and evaluate new QE tools, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted testing solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews, and presentations with customers.
* Mentor QA Leads, SDETs, Automation Engineers, and API Testing teams.

API Solutioning Responsibilities
  
  
The candidate should be capable of independently assessing a customer API landscape and developing a complete testing solution:
  
  
Requirement Analysis → API Landscape Assessment → Risk Identification → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → Implementation → CI/CD Integration → Metrics Continuous Improvement
  
  
**The candidate should be able to answer questions such as:**  

* How should APIs across hundreds of microservices be tested efficiently?

* Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.

* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred.
* Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores.
* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.

**Consulting And Leadership Skills**

* Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans.
* Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building.
* Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning.

**Education And Preferred Certifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred.

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
1. Core Machine Learning Development

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using Python and frameworks such as scikit-learn. Basic hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is preferred.
* Apply supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to real-world problems.
* Good understanding of Regression, Classification, and Clustering algorithms. Understand model evaluation techniques such as cross-validation, ROC-AUC, Precision, Recall, and F1-score.
* Perform feature engineering, feature selection, data preprocessing, normalization, and scaling.
* Understand model training, validation, hyperparameter tuning, and performance optimization.
* Ability to analyze model results and identify opportunities for improvement.

2. Data Processing & Analysis

* Strong practical experience with Pandas and NumPy.
* Ability to clean, transform, analyze, and prepare raw datasets for machine learning.
* Experience working with structured datasets and building reusable data-processing workflows.
* Basic understanding of data quality, missing values, outliers, normalization, and feature preparation.
* Polars is optional.
* Experience with time-series data is optional/preferred.

3. Deep Learning & Advanced ML (Preferred)

* Basic practical understanding of neural networks and deep learning concepts.
* Hands-on experience with CNN, RNN, or LSTM is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to understand and work with existing deep learning models.
* Experience with time-series modeling, signal processing, peak/event detection, or waveform data is optional.
* Experience with scientific or instrument-generated datasets, including mass spectrometry data, is a plus but not mandatory.

4. Model Deployment & Software Engineering

* Develop clean, modular, and production-ready Python code.
* Basic hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django for serving ML models is preferred.
* Understand how to expose trained models through APIs.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Ability to write basic unit tests and maintain code quality.
* Basic Docker knowledge is preferred.

5. MLOps (Optional)

* Basic understanding of the machine learning lifecycle.
* Exposure to MLflow, DVC, or similar experiment/model tracking tools is a plus.
* Basic understanding of model monitoring and model drift is a plus.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines for ML deployment is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience deploying ML workflows using Docker is a plus.

6. Database & Data Handling

* Basic to intermediate experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Ability to write queries and efficiently retrieve data required for ML workflows.
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL concepts.
* MongoDB or Redis experience is optional.

7. Key Requirements Summary

**Requirement CategoryDescription**

Experience

2 years of hands-on experience in Python and Machine Learning.

Core ML

Strong foundation in classical Machine Learning, practical model development, data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.

Technical Stack

Proficiency in Python, Pandas, and NumPy. Practical experience with at least one end-to-end ML project.

Software Engineering

Good understanding of software engineering practices, Git, and clean Python development.

Optional / Plus

Deep Learning, MLOps, time-series modeling, signal processing, and scientific/mass-spectrometry data experience.

description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**To Apply**

Upload your resume, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note (3-4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for the role. Include one thing you built with AI coding tools and how you checked that it worked.

title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.  
  
The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.  
  
You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.  
  
The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
* Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
* Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
* Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
* Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
* Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
* Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
* Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow

  
About the team  
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.  
  
RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:  

* Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
* Management of existing business risks across the organization
* Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience in financial modeling, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Manager, Clinical Data Scientist, Clinical Data Sciences
description:
As part of the Clinical Data and Information Sciences (CDIS)group, an integral delivery unit within the Clinical Development & Operations (CD&O) organization, the Clinical Data Scientist is responsible for representing CDIS at the study team level. The Clinical Data Scientist is accountable for the coordination of all CDIS deliverables associated with a clinical trial, as well as adherence to data standards and the quality of the study data sets. The Clinical Data Scientist provides leadership, direction, and oversight to Data Managers working on the clinical trial and is accountable for the trial’s inspection readiness.

  

* Serve as Clinical Data Scientist for one or more clinical trials, assuming responsibility for all CDIS activities including selection and application of data acquisition standards, Data Management Plan, selection of quality risk indicators, third party study data due diligence.
* As a member of the Core Study Team, drive operational excellence in collaboration with cross-functional partners through the application of CDIS best practices at the study level; serve as technical resource on how to best collect, process, consume and report clinical trial data.
* They are accountable for the quality and timeliness of all CDIS deliverables in support of the clinical trial; They partner with Research/Business Units, external data/service providers and internal CDIS staff to deliver high-quality data management for all studies as assigned.
* Proactively drives quality and efficiency to meet study/asset timelines milestones, ensuring scientific and operational excellence in support of strategic imperatives and in collaboration with the cross functional study team.
* Ensure work carried out by/on behalf of CDIS is in accordance with applicable SOPs and work practices; accountable for assuring adherence to regulations, standards, GCDMPs, ALCOA principles by the team they are coordinating.
* Ensure the required study-specific CDIS documents in the Trial Master File (TMF) are of high quality and are filed contemporaneously.
* Work with Asset Leads to establish strategy, timelines, and adequate resourcing of the study.
* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to the CDIS resources working on the clinical trial(s)

title: Data Scientist – Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Data Scientist – Technical Services & Manufacturing Sciences (TSMS)**
**Company Overview**
Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better – through medicines and information – for some of the world’s most urgent medical needs. Founded over 145 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly knows its business has prospered because of its employees – people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team – and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!
  
  
**Manufacturing and Quality Technical Hub Hyderabad**
Lilly has made a strategic investment of more than $1B dollars to establish a Manufacturing and Quality technical hub. This hub will oversee the significant investment in contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India and the technical services responsible for managing the scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. The hub will be recruiting top talent in the areas of process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to build a cutting-edge scientific organization supporting the exciting manufacturing portfolio of Lilly.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Scientist – TSMS is responsible for delivering advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and digital innovation to support manufacturing and development processes across pharmaceutical operations. This role enables data-driven decision-making, process optimization, and compliance by partnering with global teams, site SMEs, and IT/digital functions. The Data Scientist manages analytics solution delivery, supports digital transformation, and ensures alignment with regulatory and business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, validate, and maintain multivariate statistical models (e.g., PCA/PLS) for real-time process monitoring
* Lead development and deployment of predictive models and multivariate analytics for process monitoring, anomaly detection, and performance optimization
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (manufacturing, R&D, quality, IT) to design and implement data-driven solutions
* Work with Information Technology teams at Lilly to deliver secure, scalable analytics products (dashboards, data products, model services) and manage project interdependencies
* Support integration and harmonization of data across PLM, MES, LIMS, ERP, and analytics platforms
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with GMP and regulatory standards
* Facilitate knowledge transfer, training, and adoption of analytics solutions across global teams
* Track and report analytics project progress, risks, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders
* Partner with technical teams to resolve data gaps, inconsistencies, and support validation activities
* Leverage data visualization and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Seeq) for actionable insights
* Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities for digital transformation
* Maintain documentation, best practices, and knowledge repositories for analytics solutions
* Monitor adoption KPIs, gather user feedback, and drive continuous improvement in analytics capabilities

**Required Skills And Experience**
**Technical and Functional Skills:**

* Proficient in statistical modeling, machine learning, coding languages, and predictive analytics (Python, R, SIMCA, JMP)
* Experienced in data integration, data quality assurance, and digital solution delivery
* Skilled in data visualization and reporting (Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet)
* Knowledgeable in GMP, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience working in Pharmaceutical manufacturing, Research & Development or other similar scientific environments
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and detail-oriented mindset
* Effective communicator with experience working in global, cross-functional teams
* Ability to communicate complex insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Change-oriented and proactive in driving digital transformation
* Practical problem-solver who can work independently and within cross-functional teams; skilled at stakeholder management and communication
* Familiarity with cloud analytics (Azure/AWS), data pipelines, and APIs; experience with NLP for unstructured manufacturing knowledge is a plus

**Education & Experience**

* Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field
* 5- 18 years of experience in data science, analytics, or digital deployment in pharmaceutical or life sciences industry
* Experience in pharmaceutical GMP operations and TSMS or process development; strong understanding of manufacturing unit operations and process monitoring concepts

**Additional Information**

* 10 – 20% travel may be required
* Some off-shift work (night/weekend) may be required to support 24/7 operations across global supplier network

title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Analytics (L09)
description:
**Role Title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Analytics (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge. Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Manager (L9), Enterprise Risk Analytics is an individual contributor role and will be responsible for providing reporting and visual analytics solutions based off the company’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system. This role is a key driver in transforming raw risk data into clear, actionable, and visually compelling reports and dashboards primarily using Tableau. The role will have a dotted line of reporting to the AVP – Enterprise Risk Analytics (US) while directly reporting into the Enterprise Risk Analytics Team in India, which rolls up into Synchrony Financial India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and maintenance of advanced risk reports, dashboards, and visualizations primarily utilizing Tableau based on data extracted from the GRC system and related data sources
* Partner with the eGRC FA and DM teams to understand continuous upgrades and changes to the system and data that can affect downstream reporting
* Collaborate with senior leaders, risk managers, and governance functions to gather, understand, and translate complex business requirements into technical reporting specifications
* Present analytics findings and visualizations to stakeholders, clearly articulating the story behind the data to drive risk-informed decision-making
* Design and build data extracts and queries from the eGRC Data Mart to efficiently support complex risk analytics and reporting requirements
* Perform in-depth analysis of risk data to identify emerging trends, concentrations, and key risk indicators (KRIs) across the enterprise
* Perform other special tasks as needed

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with Tableau
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with one or more data analytics tools like SAS/SQL an Python etc.
* Strong written/oral communication skills.
* Proven ability to deliver Analytical solutions for Business problems.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM related or Business field.
* Experience in consumer credit/risk analytics role
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, organize workflow, and prioritize work assignments
* Working knowledge and experience with GenAI in workspace
* Commercially effective and collaborative across teams and functions
* Intermediate EXCEL skill-set

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
**02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**

Reports Directly to:

Direct Reports:

MD, Country Delivery - India

None

**Overview of the role**

The Data and Analytics Manager role will support initiatives focused on emerging renewable energy solutions as part of the sustainable energy transition in India. In this mission-driven role, this role will work at the intersection of technical innovation, stakeholder engagement, and data analytics, driving impactful solutions that empower communities and promote clean energy access. The Data and Analytics Manager will work closely with the India Country Delivery team and with the Grids of the Future and Powering Opportunity teams.

**Accountabilities**

#### **Data Analysis and Insights:**

* Gather, analyse, and interpret data on renewable energy markets, battery technology, and energy storage applications to inform program strategies.
* Develop and maintain databases and dashboards to track market trends, project performance, and emerging opportunities in the energy sector.
* Support feasibility studies and pilot projects by providing robust data analytics and scenario
* Work closely with the Impact team to meet global requirements for data analytics and reporting.
* Develop and refine financial and operational models for energy storage solutions, including cost-benefit analyses, return on investment, and impact projections.
* Collaborate with the Powering Opportunity and Grids of the Future teams to evaluate the scalability and replicability of projects across different local markets.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for program design and policy advocacy efforts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

#### **Program Support:**

* Work closely with program and technical teams to integrate data insights into the design and implementation of renewable energy solutions including distributed renewable energy, battery energy storage solutions, digital grid monitoring systems and utility scale renewable energy.
* Contribute to the documentation of lessons learned and the creation of knowledge-sharing resources.
* Support internal teams in optimizing their data collection and reporting processes to enhance program impact assessment.

#### **Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Prepare presentations to communicate data-driven insights and business models to internal and external stakeholders, including donors, government agencies, and alliance partners.
* Support engagement with funders by preparing data-driven presentations and reports to secure resources for program growth.
* Collaborate with regional and international stakeholders to represent the organization’s analytical capabilities and contribute to global discussions on renewable energy.
  

**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**

  

**Preferred attributes**

* **Working in Partnership:** Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* **Directs Work:** Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* **Manages Complexity:** Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* **Values Differences:** Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* **Intellectual Humility:** We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* **Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit:** A self-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start-Up Philosophy.’

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

The ideal candidate would be a self-starter and be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Recognising GEAPP’s unique position and its stage of organisational life, the ideal candidate would be interested in contributing to and building a strong, enduring organisation.

Essential qualifications, skills and experience include:

* Qualifications: Degree or post graduate qualifications; data science, engineering or economics subjects preferable;
* Experience: At least 5 years’ experience in the data analysis, business modelling or program development, preferably from a non profit environment or from an energy related field.
* Network: Good network in the non profit or data analytics sectors;
* Communication: Good written and verbal communication skills, excellent numeracy and data analytics skills;
* Market knowledge: Good understanding of the India market and key metrics/measures;
* Organisation and management: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task effectively and a willingness to take ownership and responsibility for own work. Strong organisation and prioritisation skills with good attention to detail.

In addition, the following would be a bonus:

* + Experience of working on energy and infrastructure-related matters including, specifically, climate finance, renewable energy, energy transition and sustainable development; and
  + Experience working on energy and infrastructure related projects in Asia.

title: Analyst-Data Analytics (Agentic)
description:
The Analytics, Investment Optimization and Marketing Enablement (AIM) team – a part of Global Commercial Services Marketing group within American Express – is the analytical engine that enables the Global Commercial Card & Non-Card business. The team enables profitable business growth through data, analytics, decision science and AI-powered capabilities, providing actionable insights and innovative solutions to drive business and marketing strategy.

This role, based out of Gurugram, will be a part of the AIM team and will focus on developing and applying advanced Data Science and Generative AI solutions across Global Commercial Services. The incumbent will work on high-impact business problems spanning customer acquisition, engagement, targeting and personalization, product and portfolio analytics, marketing measurement and analytical productivity.

The role will focus on applying Generative AI to business and analytical problems and translating opportunities into hands-on solutions and prototypes. The incumbent will apply Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, agentic AI and other emerging AI techniques alongside traditional Data Science and Machine Learning approaches.

The position is part of a highly collaborative environment, working with partners across AIM, GCS Marketing, Product, Capabilities, Technology and other teams at American Express.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI or Analytics, with demonstrated hands-on experience developing Generative AI solutions through professional work, internships, academic research or substantial projects.
* Strong programming skills in Python and working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to manipulate data, conduct analysis and develop Data Science/AI solutions.
* Strong foundation in Data Science and Machine Learning concepts, including statistical modeling, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and experimentation.
* Hands-on understanding of Large Language Models and core GenAI techniques such as prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including concepts such as embeddings, semantic retrieval and using relevant data and context to improve LLM responses.
* Understanding of approaches for evaluating GenAI solutions across dimensions such as response quality, relevance, consistency and reliability.
* Strong analytical/conceptual thinking acumen with the ability to structure and solve unstructured and complex business problems.
* Ability and curiosity to rapidly learn, experiment with and apply emerging AI techniques to practical business problems.
Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on exposure to agentic AI concepts and workflows involving capabilities such as tool use, reasoning or multi-step orchestration.
* Experience with GenAI/LLM frameworks and libraries such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face or equivalent tools.
* Experience with vector-based retrieval, semantic search, advanced RAG techniques or LLM evaluation frameworks.
* Familiarity with commercial and open-source LLMs and considerations involved in selecting appropriate models and approaches for different use cases.
* Exposure to advanced GenAI techniques such as model fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or advanced retrieval approaches.
* Experience working with unstructured data or Natural Language Processing techniques.
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles and considerations related to applying AI within enterprise or regulated environments.
* Interest in applying AI and GenAI capabilities to marketing, customer engagement, personalization, analytical productivity and business decision-making.

description:
TECHNICAL LEAD -- ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY & AI

Company: Haiintel | Location: Coimbatore / Hybrid / Remote

Experience: 10+ Years

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Haiintel is an AI and technology engineering company specializing in enterprise-grade solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, Cloud Computing, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Blockchain, and Digital Transformation. We partner with enterprise clients to solve complex technology challenges requiring strong architectural thinking, deep engineering expertise, and independent technical leadership.

JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly intelligent, technically strong, and execution-oriented Technical Lead to independently own complex enterprise projects. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep architectural expertise, team guidance, and direct client engagement. The ideal candidate will take complete technical ownership from problem understanding through production delivery, work with minimal supervision, and make critical technical decisions independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Ownership & Architecture

● Take end-to-end technical ownership of assigned enterprise projects

● Design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable enterprise solutions

● Lead system architecture, API design, data architecture, system integration, and technology stack decisions

● Create HLDs/LLDs and comprehensive technical documentation

● Review existing architectures and identify modernization and optimization opportunities

● Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Engineering Leadership & Execution

● Lead and mentor engineering teams across multiple technology stacks

● Provide technical direction through rigorous design reviews and code reviews

● Resolve complex engineering challenges and critical production issues

● Establish engineering standards, best practices, development processes, and quality benchmarks

● Remain hands-on to investigate and solve critical technical problems when required

● Ensure solutions achieve the right balance of technical quality, development speed, and scalability

Client & Stakeholder Management

● Act as the senior technical representative and point of contact with enterprise clients

● Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions, architecture design discussions, and solution assessments

● Directly engage with senior client stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams

● Translate complex business and functional requirements into practical technical solutions

● Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

● Independently manage technical discussions, escalations, and decision-making

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Professional Experience

● 10+ years of professional software engineering and system development experience

● Proven experience as Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, or Solution Architect

● Demonstrated experience owning complex, mission-critical enterprise applications or platforms

● Successfully taken projects from architecture and design through production deployment

● Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with varying levels of expertise

Technical Competencies

● Deep knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems

● Strong backend/server-side software engineering fundamentals

● Extensive hands-on experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud-native architecture

● Strong foundation in microservices architecture, APIs, databases, and data systems

● Solid knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code

● Understanding of security best practices, IAM, authentication/authorization, and API security

Core Competencies & Attributes

● Exceptional problem-solving ability - can break down complex, ambiguous problems and derive practical solutions

● Strong architectural thinking - understands complete system requirements while maintaining implementation depth

● Complete ownership mindset - takes responsibility for technical outcomes without waiting for detailed instructions

● Client maturity and confidence - can effectively represent the organization before senior enterprise stakeholders

● Sound technical judgment - can independently evaluate alternatives, understand trade-offs, and make critical decisions

● Technical adaptability - can quickly learn new technologies, understand unfamiliar domains, and work with existing systems

● Strong communication skills - can articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE

● AI & Modern Technology: Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG systems, knowledge graphs, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks

● Cloud Platforms: GCP (strongly preferred), AWS, Azure - with deep hands-on experience

● Architecture & Design: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design

● Databases & Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery, or equivalent data platforms

● Engineering Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, IaC tools, monitoring and observability solutions

Note: Deep hands-on expertise across multiple areas is more valuable than superficial knowledge of many technologies. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Java, Go, Node.js, .NET, or equivalent) is essential.
