title: Remote Engineer
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Service Delivery Client Engineering - Remote Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.  
  
This role makes use of technical knowledge to handle technical enquiries and/or troubleshoot problems reported by clients in a timely manner.  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role restores service to clients by managing incidents and seeing them through to an effective resolution.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Serves as the initial point of contact for end-users seeking technical assistance in the areas of networking, collaboration tools, and end-user computing.
* Provides prompt and efficient troubleshooting and support for incidents and service requests related to networking issues, such as network connectivity, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, wireless connectivity, and network equipment configurations.
* Resolves collaboration-related issues, including but not limited to email systems, video conferencing platforms, instant messaging tools, and document sharing applications.
* Addresses end-user computing problems encompassing operating systems, hardware, software applications, printers, and mobile devices.
* Utilizes appropriate tools, techniques, and remote access software to diagnose and resolve technical issues across the networking, collaboration, and end-user computing domains.
* Follows established procedures, guidelines, and best practices to deliver timely and accurate resolutions to end-users' problems.
* Documents all incidents, service requests, and actions taken in the service desk ticketing system, ensuring detailed and accurate records.
* Escalates complex or unresolved issues to level 2 or higher-level engineers or specialised teams, providing comprehensive information and analysis.
* Collaborates with other IT support teams, including networking, collaboration, and end-user computing specialists, to resolve cross-functional issues and contribute to problem resolution.
* Monitors network performance, conduct routine maintenance tasks, and apply patches and updates to network infrastructure and collaboration tools as required.
* Assists in the development and maintenance of knowledge base documentation, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures to enhance service desk efficiency and effectiveness.
* Keeps up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in networking, collaboration, and end-user computing to provide high-quality support and contribute to continuous learning and development.
* Adheres to IT service management processes and standards, including incident, problem, and change management procedures.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Knowledge of networking concepts and protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, video conferencing, and collaboration tools.
* Familiarity with end-user computing technologies, including Windows and macOS operating systems, hardware troubleshooting, software applications, mobile devices, and printer configurations.
* Proficiency in using network monitoring and troubleshooting tools, collaboration platforms, remote desktop tools, and incident ticketing systems.
* Displays problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to think logically and troubleshoot issues effectively across multiple IT domains.
* Good customer service orientation, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical users in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365, or Cisco collaboration certifications are a plus.

**Required experience:**

* Basic experience in a service desk or helpdesk role, providing support in multiple IT towers, including networking, collaboration, and end-user computing.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

title: Client Support Engineer
description:
**Overview**  
**About the Role:**  
The primary responsibility of the Loyalty Client Support Engineer is to assist with the management and support of the technical solution for an existing large financial services client. They will act as the backbone of daily production processes and procedures; monitoring and escalating if alignment is not achieved with standard operating procedures.
  
  
The individual in this position will be support coverage for "Lights On" support, SLA Adherence, and operational monitoring while displaying a deep understanding solution standards, features, and dependent functionalities associated to the account.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Ensure batch files are received and sent according to File Processing Schedule, that no large-scale errors have occurred, and escalate where needed.
* Monitor API processing to determine reasons for any errors, initiate reprocessing where necessary, and obtaining the appropriate approvals to proceed.
* Ensuring reports are sent according to the report distribution schedule.
* Gather data for monthly SLA Reporting and present to the internal team and client.
* Optimize monitoring tools and alerting to ensure first to identify and increase efficiency around time to resolution.
* Create and maintain monitoring patching schedules, ensuring testing approval is received prior to production release.
* Gathering inputs around production readiness activities to ensure completion prior to technical releases.
* Leading Change Approval Board meetings internally to achieve alignment on production readiness.
* Reviewing vulnerabilities found through scanning to determine activities necessary for remediation.
* Manage documentation and requests surrounding certificates necessary to maintain day-to-day access security.
* Change scheduling and submission of necessary data required for change approval.
* Create and maintain training materials, standard operating procedures, and core system documentation.
* Configure and implement systems and programs to automate tasks and processes.
* Maintain and continuously improve production monitoring capabilities, operational dashboards, and KPI reporting to ensure platform availability, SLA adherence, proactive issue identification, and rapid incident resolution.
* Collaborate with STS, Infrastructure, Windows, and Network engineering teams to improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, address operational gaps, and maintain service availability in accordance with SLA commitments.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum of 5 years of production support experience in SLA-driven environments.
* Demonstrated ability to own incidents from triage through communication, escalation, root cause analysis, and runbook or knowledge base updates.
* Comfortable participating in on-call rotations and providing after-hours production support when required.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Soft Skills Required:**
  

* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies across Windows server environments and related infrastructure components, determine root cause, and drive production and project issues through to successful resolution.
* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and SQL-based troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies, determine root cause, and drive production or project issues to effective closure.
* Able to quickly develop rapport, establish credibility, and maintain trusted relationships with business, technical, global, and external partner teams.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence a wide range of stakeholders across all roles and levels.
* Contribute to effective client meetings, make proactive recommendations, and drive successful outcomes in your area of expertise.
* Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and often changing environment.
* Shows drive, initiative, and a sense of personal accountability.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, interpersonal, and time management skills.

  
**Technical Skills Required:**
  

* 5+ years supporting Windows Server in production environments, with experience across the 2016-2022 era and strong Windows Server 2022 experience preferred.
* 3+ years troubleshooting IIS-hosted applications in live production environments.
* Hands-on Windows Services, IIS administration, including sites, applications, application pools, web.config/applicationHost.config, handlers, and modules.
* Ability to diagnose common HTTP failures, including 401, 403, 500, 502, and 503 errors, and restore service under SLA.
* Experience using Failed Request Tracing (FREB), IIS/W3C logs, Windows Event Logs, and PerfMon for production diagnostics.
* Experience troubleshooting application pool issues, including recycles, rapid-fail protection, identity and permissions, and startup failures.
* Working knowledge of TLS/HTTPS bindings, certificates, SNI, and common Schannel/TLS breakages.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows Server vulnerabilities, including vulnerability assessment, patch planning, remediation validation, exception management, and coordination with infrastructure and security teams.
* Experience supporting ASP.NET Framework and/or ASP.NET Core applications on IIS, including ANCM and hosting model issues.
* PowerShell experience for remote administration, automation, and diagnostics.
* Active Directory fundamentals as they affect applications, including Kerberos/NTLM, SPNs, service accounts, and double-hop scenarios.
* Networking fundamentals for production applications, including DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies.
* Solid understanding of Relational Database Management Systems and proficiency with SQL.
* Proficient with Business Intelligence tools such as Cognos.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies and creation of defined artifacts.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise production monitoring, operational health management, KPI development, SLA measurement, trend analysis, and service reporting to ensure application availability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Proven experience collaborating with STS, Infrastructure, Windows Server, Network, and Security teams to troubleshoot production issues, improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, and support critical service availability objectives.

title: Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

IT&S Group  

**Job Description:**

**You will work with**

You will lead a high-energy, top-performing team of engineers and product managers, working alongside technology and business leaders to shape the vision and drive the execution of progressive platform initiatives that make a real impact.

  
  

**Let me tell you about the role**

The Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer provides engineering leadership across bp's digital landscape, connecting squads with bp's platforms and engineering capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions aligned to business strategy. They lead end-to-end technical delivery, ensure engineering integrity at scale, and actively manage delivery and technical risk while guiding teams through complex build challenges.

Operating as a hands-on technical leader with strong customer and stakeholder influence, they balance long-term engineering excellence with near-term delivery outcomes, empowering squads to make sound technical decisions and fostering a unified, pragmatic, and sustainable engineering culture across bp.

This role will play a key leadership position in delivering modern B2B customer portal and commerce capabilities, working closely with customer engagement platforms, product teams, architecture teams, SAP teams, and engineering squads to maximise reuse of shared platform capabilities and accelerate delivery through modern composable architecture principles.

  
  

**What you will deliver**

  
  

**Technology**

Leads a team of enterprise engineers to design, develop, and deliver high-quality platforms and services. Acts as a hands-on technical authority on bp's platforms, languages, and frameworks, including Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns. Drives squad goals, prioritises initiatives, and delivers in a product-led, empowered environment. Guides modernisation of legacy estates to unlock future capabilities.

  
  

**Delivery & Transformation**

Owns end-to-end delivery of complex B2B commerce and customer portal transformation programmes, from discovery through build, migration, cutover, and hypercare. Manages delivery risk, sequencing, and dependencies across squads, vendors, and SI partners. Ensures legacy-to-modern transitions are planned for coexistence, data migration, and minimal business disruption.

Drives adoption of MACH and composable architecture principles, ensuring alignment with strategic customer engagement platforms through reuse of shared capabilities, APIs, services, and design patterns.

  
  

**Data**

Engineers data-intensive solutions and integration flows across enterprise systems. Builds secure, governed, and interoperable data pipelines with strong quality, lineage, and observability. Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.

  
  

**Commercial Awareness**

Applies engineering insight to cost and value priorities, including cloud spend and TCO. Evaluates tools and platforms for fit, resilience, and lock-in risk to inform build-vs-buy decisions.

  
  

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

Embeds secure-by-design practices and supports audit, licensing, and compliance obligations as part of routine delivery.

  
  

**Collaboration & Influence**

Acts as a technical expert, providing guidance and support to the squad and wider engineering community. Communicates clearly with team members, partners, and customers. Represents engineering in governance and design forums to resolve technical trade-offs.

Leads and governs delivery partners, system integrators, and product vendors, ensuring architectural and engineering standards are upheld across the extended delivery ecosystem.

Works closely with Product, UX, Architecture, SAP, Integration, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align with strategic platform roadmaps and maximise reuse of common capabilities and technical assets.

  
  

**Building Teams**

Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.

  
  

**Growing People**

Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.

  
  

**Change Leadership**

Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.

  
  

**What you will need to be successful**

  
  

**Technical Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, security, and operations in large-scale global environments, with 4+ years in a technical leadership role delivering cloud-native, MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless), composable architecture, and customer-facing digital platform solutions.
* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Strong technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, JavaScript, relational databases, microservices, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) patterns, API orchestration, API gateways, and modern distributed system design.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering modern web applications using React, reusable component architectures, responsive design, GraphQL, and headless front-end architectures.
* Experience delivering cloud-native applications on Azure and/or AWS using containers, Kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps pipelines.
* Experience implementing enterprise security solutions including OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Azure AD, SSO, and role-based access control.
* Experience working with Git-based source control, modern software delivery practices, and engineering lifecycle management.
* Experience leading delivery through vendor and SI partner ecosystems, holding partners accountable for engineering quality, timelines, architecture compliance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience designing and delivering global, multi-country, multi-currency, and multi-language B2B commerce and customer portal solutions.
* Experience within the Energy, Oil & Gas, or other complex enterprise industries is an advantage.
  

  

**Essential Skills**

* Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems.
* Strong experience delivering B2B customer portals and commerce solutions using MACH (Microservices, API-First, Cloud-Native, Headless) and composable architecture principles.
* Deep technical expertise in **Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL**, API-led integration, and event-driven architectures within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms with **SAP ERP/S/4HANA** and other business-critical systems using modern integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native delivery on Azure and/or AWS, including infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, operational readiness, and lifecycle ownership.
* Proven experience in reliability engineering, incident management, disaster recovery, application performance monitoring, and operational excellence for business-critical platforms.
* Experience delivering solutions spanning custom-built software, configured platforms, and third-party integrations at enterprise scale.
* Experience establishing engineering standards, architecture governance, reusable platform capabilities, and engineering best practices across multiple squads.
* Strong ability to resolve technical trade-offs across squads, platforms, vendors, and stakeholders while balancing delivery, architecture, and business priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, UX, Architecture, Platform Engineering, SAP, and business teams to deliver customerfocused solutions.
  

  

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience delivering omnichannel B2B journeys spanning portal, mobile, CSR-assisted, and partner channels.
* Familiarity with CDP, CRM, and customer experience platforms (e.g., Salesforce, SAP Qualtrics) and related integrations.

**About bp**

  

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. title: Data Architect (Ontologist / Knowledge Graph)
description:
Hiring: Semantic Data Architect (Ontologist / Knowledge Graph)

**Company:** PyxTech  
**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Salary:** Competitive  
**Location:** Remote (India)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** US Time Zone Overlap  
**Notice Period:** Maximum 30 Days  
**Openings:** 1

About PyxTech

PyxTech is a B2B SaaS and AI technology company specializing in enterprise software, AI-powered solutions, digital engineering, and technology consulting. We help organizations modernize enterprise architecture, automate workflows, and unlock business value through intelligent data and AI solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Semantic Data Architect / Ontologist** with strong expertise in enterprise ontology development, RDF-based semantic modeling, and knowledge graph architecture.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies, building semantic data models, connecting fragmented enterprise data sources, and implementing W3C semantic web standards to support enterprise search, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic knowledge models.
* Build RDF-based semantic data structures using RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems into connected knowledge graphs.
* Develop and manage controlled vocabularies, metadata models, and taxonomy lifecycle processes.
* Implement SHACL-based data validation and constraints, along with SKOS for knowledge organization.
* Deploy and manage knowledge graphs using Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Work with ontology and taxonomy management platforms such as PoolParty and TopBraid EDG.
* Optimize semantic models for enterprise search, analytics, metadata extraction, and AI applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Support cloud-based deployments using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of overall IT/data experience.
* **Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience specifically in RDF-based semantic ontology development and modeling.**
* Strong expertise in enterprise ontology design, taxonomy development, and semantic metadata management.
* Expert knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Practical experience with SHACL and SKOS.
* Production experience with at least one graph database: Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ontology/taxonomy management platform, such as PoolParty, TopBraid EDG, or GraphDB (Ontotext).
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and overlap with US business hours.
* Maximum notice period of 30 days.

Preferred Skills

* NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and semantic metadata extraction.
* Experience with spaCy or similar NLP tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise search, knowledge discovery, and AI-driven applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Library Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Interview Process

* HR Screening and Initial Evaluation
* Client Technical Assessment / Deep Dive
* Client Final / Behavioral Interview

How to Apply

If you have strong hands-on experience in RDF-based ontology engineering, semantic data architecture, and enterprise knowledge graphs, we would love to hear from you.

**Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your ontology projects, RDF experience, graph database expertise, and notice period.**

**Important:** This role requires substantial practical ontology engineering experience, not just general data architecture or basic knowledge of graph databases.

title: Lead Engineer - Network & Security
description:

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

* Design, configure, implement, test, and support enterprise routing, switching, software-defined networking, and network security solutions
* Participate in customer discovery sessions and technical workshops to document requirements, dependencies, constraints, and success criteria
* Develop and maintain technical designs, implementation procedures, migration plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and as-built documentation
* Build and support resilient networks across campus, data center, lab, branch, cloud-connected, and hybrid environments
* Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols, VLANs, network segmentation, redundancy, high availability, quality of service, and common network services
* Implement and support software-defined networking and network virtualization solutions under established architecture and design standards
* Configure and support network security controls, including firewalls, secure remote access, segmentation, access policies, and secure connectivity between environments
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, collect and analyze diagnostic information, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors
* Plan and execute approved lifecycle activities, including software upgrades, firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, configuration updates, and post-change validation
* Support Presidio lab network and security infrastructure used for engineering, demonstrations, proofs of concept, validation, training, and customer-facing activities
* Maintain lab configurations, diagrams, inventories, access records, standards, and operational documentation to promote repeatability and reduce configuration drift
* Serve as a technical point of contact for assigned projects and workstreams, providing clear status updates, technical recommendations, and escalation of risks or blockers
* Coordinate implementation activities with customers, project managers, vendors, facilities teams, remote hands, and other engineering disciplines
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, peer reviews, troubleshooting support, lab exercises, and knowledge-sharing sessions
* Review configurations and engineering deliverables for technical accuracy, security, consistency, and operational readiness
* Contribute to technical standards, runbooks, reference designs, automation practices, and reusable implementation methods

**Technology/Area of Specialization:**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching, including dynamic routing protocols, Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, redundancy, segmentation, quality of service, and network services
* Working knowledge of software-defined networking, policy-based networking, network virtualization, automation, and centralized management platforms
* Practical knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, secure access, segmentation, access control, policy enforcement, and security monitoring integrations
* Familiarity with network automation, APIs, configuration management, telemetry, monitoring, and operational analytics
* Understanding of infrastructure dependencies such as DNS, DHCP, IP address management, identity services, virtualization, cloud connectivity, and data center facilities
* Experience with Cisco ACI and NDFC is highly desired

**Basic Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze issues across network, security, virtualization, cloud, and application dependencies
* Ability to develop sound technical solutions within established architecture, security, operational, and project requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to customers, project teams, and internal stakeholders
* Solid project execution skills, including task planning, effort estimation, dependency tracking, risk identification, and timely completion of assigned deliverables
* Ability to lead defined technical workstreams while collaborating with senior architects and engineering leadership on complex decisions
* Ability to facilitate technical discussions, implementation planning, peer reviews, and operational handoffs
* Collaborative mindset with a willingness to mentor less-experienced engineers and share practical knowledge
* Attention to detail and consistent documentation practices across designs, configurations, test results, implementation records, and support procedures

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Typically, 5-7 years of progressive experience implementing and supporting enterprise network and security infrastructure
* Hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching, including dynamic routing, segmentation, resiliency, and troubleshooting

title: Data Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking a versatile
**Data Engineer**

with a hybrid background in traditional data engineering (SQL), semantic modeling (Ontologies), Graph Databases, and Machine Learning systems. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize the connected data architecture that powers our Enterprise Knowledge Graph (EKG), feature stores, and advanced ML pipelines.

You will bridge relational systems, graph databases, and ML models—building scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT), transforming raw data into structured ontologies, and preparing graph-native features for downstream AI/ML applications like GraphRAG, link prediction, and recommendation systems.

WeAreDevelopers

**Key Responsibilities****Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture**

* **Scalable Data Pipelines:**

  Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput batch and streaming ETL/ELT data pipelines using SQL, Python, and modern data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt).
* WeAreDevelopers
* **Relational & Analytical Data Stores:**

  Write complex SQL queries, procedures, and transformations across data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL) to clean, aggregate, and stage raw business data.
* **Data Integration:**

  Extract structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from transactional databases, APIs, and file systems to map into graph-ready schemas.
* WeAreDevelopers

**Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering**

* **Graph Modeling:**

  Build and optimize graph data schemas and property graph models (nodes, edges, labels) aligned with business domain ontologies.
* WeAreDevelopers
* **Semantic Mapping & Ingestion:**

  Translate semantic concepts (OWL, RDF, SKOS, SHACL) and relational SQL schemas into Graph Database models (Property Graphs or Triple Stores).
* Siemens Jobs
* **Graph Database Management:**

  Administer, query, and tune performance on graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune, Stardog, GraphDB) using languages like Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL.
* Myworkdayjobs.com

**Machine Learning & AI Integration**

* **Graph ML & Feature Engineering:**

  Generate node/edge embeddings (e.g., Node2Vec, PyTorch Geometric) and engineer graph-based features for ML pipelines.
* **ML Pipeline Support:**

  Partner with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to operationalize ML models, enabling GraphRAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), entity resolution, link prediction, and vector/graph hybrid search.
* WeAreDevelopers
* **Feature Store Integration:**

  Maintain dataset versioning, lineage, and metadata catalogs for both ML training data and graph nodes/relationships.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Core Data Engineering:**

  3+ years of data engineering experience with expert proficiency in
  **Python**

  and advanced
  **SQL**

  (window functions, query tuning, complex JOINs).
* Myworkdayjobs.com
* **Graph Databases:**

  2+ years of hands-on experience building, querying, and managing graph databases (e.g.,
  **Neo4j, AWS Neptune, TigerGraph, Stardog**

  ) using query languages like
  **Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL**

  .
* **Ontology & Semantic Web:**

  Familiarity with data ontologies, taxonomies, and W3C standards (
  **RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS, SHACL**

  ).
* **Machine Learning Fundamentals:**

  Practical experience deploying or supporting ML models, feature stores, and working with libraries such as
  **PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, spaCy, or Hugging Face**

  .
* **Cloud & Orchestration:**

  Proven experience with cloud platforms (
  **AWS, GCP, or Azure**

  ) and pipeline orchestration tools (
  **Apache Airflow, Prefect, or dbt**

  ).

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building
  **GraphRAG**

  solutions combining Knowledge Graphs with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant) and LLMs.
* WeAreDevelopers
* Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph embedding algorithms (e.g., PyG, DeepWALK).
* WeAreDevelopers
* Exposure to streaming architectures (
  **Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming**

  ) for real-time graph updates.
* Knowledge of SHACL/ShEx for data quality validation in graph environments.

**Education & Experience**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree**

  in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* **3+ years**

  of experience in software or data engineering, with at least 2 years actively working with semantic graphs or graph databases.
* Professional certifications from Google/Oracle/AWS are an added advantage for this role.

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer, Digital Analytics to join Ford’s Digital Analytics & Experimentation team. This role will design, build, validate, and scale the data foundations that power trusted digital measurement, KPI reporting, experimentation, AI-enabled analytics, and enterprise digital data products across the broader DAE portfolio.
  
  
Working closely with digital product, analytics, tagging, data platform, and business stakeholders across Digital Analytics & Experimentation, you will translate analytical and product requirements into resilient data pipelines, reusable data assets, automated validation frameworks, and well-documented data models that support Ford’s global digital ecosystem.
  
  
The strongest candidate will bring deep technical fluency in data engineering, strong digital analytics context, and practical experience applying AI tools, automation, and modern development practices to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of analytics delivery.
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and curated data assets that support digital analytics, KPI reporting, experimentation, personalization, and AI-enabled insight generation.
* Partner with analytics leads, product managers, tagging teams, engineers, and data platform partners to translate measurement needs and stakeholder questions into reliable technical requirements, data models, and delivery plans.
* Integrate, query, transform, and validate clickstream, customer, vehicle, lead, dealer, campaign, CRM, product, and other approved enterprise datasets to create trusted views of digital journeys and business outcomes.
* Develop reusable data models, semantic layers, feature-ready datasets, and governed data products that enable Power BI reporting, self-service analytics, advanced analysis, and AI-assisted analytics workflows.
* Implement automated data quality checks, reconciliation routines, anomaly detection, and pipeline monitoring to improve confidence in digital data and reduce manual validation effort.
* Support digital measurement quality by partnering with analytics and implementation teams to validate data capture, diagnose downstream issues, and ensure datasets reflect intended business logic and KPI definitions.

title: AI architect
description:
**Purpose of the role**

Design and build the Investment Division’s data and AI platform on Databricks/Azure, serving as the technical lead for the three-person AI Lab. Own the platform architecture, integration layer connecting Addepar, Capital IQ, and all data sources to the lakehouse, the serving infrastructure delivering model outputs to dashboards, chat interface, and APIs, and the security and governance framework ensuring regulatory compliance. This role is the bridge between the AI Lab’s technical capabilities and the investment team’s business requirements

**Key responsibilities**

* Design the Databricks lakehouse architecture: medallion schema (bronze/silver/gold), Delta table design, Unity Catalog governance, and vector store configuration.
* Build and maintain the API integration layer: Addepar REST API (ingestion and reverse push), Capital IQ API, eVestment/Mercer feeds, email ingestion (Outlook Graph API), and operating division ERP connectors.
* Design the serving infrastructure: Databricks SQL dashboards, Streamlit/Genie chat interface, REST API endpoints for Addepar and external systems, alert engine, and scheduled report distribution.
* Implement the security and governance framework: Azure Active Directory integration, Unity Catalog role-based access control, encryption (Azure Key Vault), data lineage tracking, and audit trail for IC governance.
* Design the regulated entity isolation architecture (Zone A / Zone B) ensuring Nama Financing customer data stays within the SAMA-compliant perimeter.
* Manage the Databricks workspace: compute cluster sizing, job scheduling, cost optimisation, and capacity planning.
* Attend daily standups with the investment team to understand analytical requirements and translate them into technical specifications for the data engineer and ML engineer.
* Review and approve all code deployments, data model changes, and infrastructure modifications.
* Plan the platform’s extension from the Investment Division to the five operating divisions (Waves 2–5).
* Evaluate and recommend technology decisions: vendor selection, open-source vs commercial tools, build vs buy.

**Qualifications and experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data engineering and platform architecture, with at least 3 years on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
* Experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Active Directory.
* Demonstrated experience building API integrations with financial data providers (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Refinitiv, or similar).
* Understanding of data governance frameworks, RBAC implementation, and regulatory data requirements (financial services preferred).
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM deployment for enterprise applications.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or equivalent.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment operations strongly preferred.

title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description – Senior Data Migration Engineer**
**Company:**
MAKO IT
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Data Migration Engineer
  
  
**Experience:**
3+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai (Work from Office)
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department:**
Data Engineering / Data Migration
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior Data Migration Engineer with 4–7 years of hands-on experience in Python, SQL, ETL development, API integrations, and data migration.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing complex data migration solutions while ensuring data accuracy, performance, scalability, and reliability.
  
  
In addition to customer migration projects, the candidate will play a key role in developing and enhancing our
**AI-powered Data Migration Platform**
, focused on automating data extraction, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration workflows.
  
  
We are looking for someone with strong technical ownership, problem-solving abilities, and a willingness to learn, experiment with, and implement AI-driven solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Migration & ETL Development
* Independently design, develop, and execute end-to-end data migration workflows.
* Build scalable and reusable ETL pipelines using Python and SQL.
* Handle data extraction and migration across databases, CSV, Excel, JSON, and REST APIs.
* Develop complex data mapping, cleansing, transformation, and loading logic.
* Implement incremental migrations, delta updates, and bulk data processing.
* Optimize migration scripts for performance and reliability.
* Identify and resolve complex data migration issues.
* Python Development & Automation
* Develop robust, modular, and maintainable Python applications.
* Build reusable components for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Work extensively with Pandas and other Python data-processing libraries.
* Implement exception handling, logging, retry mechanisms, and error recovery.
* Optimize scripts for handling large datasets.
* Perform code reviews and guide junior engineers on development best practices.
* API & Database Integrations
* Design and implement REST API-based migration and integration workflows.
* Handle API authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and bulk operations.
* Troubleshoot API failures, data inconsistencies, and integration challenges.
* Develop complex SQL queries for transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
* Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL Server.
* AI-Powered Migration Platform Development
* Contribute to the architecture, development, and enhancement of an AI-powered Data Migration Platform.
* Explore and implement AI-assisted data mapping, field matching, and transformation recommendations.
* Develop automation components to reduce manual migration efforts.
* Evaluate LLM-based approaches for intelligent data processing and validation.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing Python-based migration workflows.
* Work with the team to improve platform scalability, reusability, and maintainability.
* Continuously learn and adopt emerging AI technologies and development practices.
* Data Quality & Validation
* Design and implement automated data validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity of migrated data.
* Develop reusable validation scripts and exception reports.
* Investigate and resolve source-to-target data mismatches.
* Establish quality checkpoints for migration execution.
* Technical Ownership & Collaboration
* Take technical ownership of assigned customer migration projects.
* Analyze source and target systems and identify migration dependencies and risks.
* Participate in technical discussions, solution design, and estimation.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads, Project Managers, and implementation teams.
* Identify technical blockers early and communicate risks proactively.
* Prepare technical documentation, mapping specifications, and migration execution reports.
* Mentor junior engineers and support their technical development.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong programming skills, modular development, scripting, automation, and exception handling.
* SQL: Advanced SQL queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, data transformations, and performance optimization.
* ETL & Data Migration: Hands-on experience designing and executing end-to-end migration workflows.
* Pandas: Strong experience in data manipulation, transformation, and processing.
* REST APIs: API integrations, authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and error handling.
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or equivalent relational databases.
* Data Processing: CSV, Excel, JSON, XML, and structured/semi-structured datasets.
* Data Validation: Reconciliation, data-quality checks, exception reporting, and troubleshooting.
* Git: Version control and collaborative development.
* Debugging & Optimization: Strong troubleshooting and performance-improvement capabilities.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience in SaaS-to-SaaS or enterprise application data migration.
* Experience developing reusable ETL or migration frameworks.
* Knowledge of Docker, cloud platforms, and deployment practices.
* Familiarity with AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted automation.
* Exposure to AI frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with fuzzy matching, intelligent data mapping, or schema matching.
* Understanding of data pipelines, scheduling, and workflow orchestration.
* Experience working with high-volume datasets and complex data structures.

Candidate Expectations
  
  

* Strong technical ownership and independent problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to understand migration requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Experience independently handling complex migration tasks.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to review code and mentor junior developers.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to learn, experiment with, and contribute to AI-driven migration technologies.
* Ability to proactively identify project risks and technical dependencies.
* Commitment to code quality, documentation, and timely delivery.
* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST shift.

Educational Qualification
  
  
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
3+ years in Python development, ETL engineering, data migration, or data engineering.

Data Migration Python Data Transformation API Integration ETL Basics Data Validation Pandas REST API SQL

title: Lead Security Engineer - Platform
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Lead Security Engineer | Platform**, you will be the subject matter expert for the client's endpoint, application control, email, and web-edge security platforms and will lead the Network and Identity Security Engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

* Act as a subject matter expert in endpoint protection and XDR, application allowlisting, email security gateways, and web-edge platforms (WAF, DDoS, and DNS).
* Define and maintain secure configuration baselines and hardening standards aligned to vendor best practices and client policy.
* Review platform configurations, using exports released through the UK service boundary, and recommend improvements.
* Design platform changes and prepare complete change packages, including implementation, test and back-out plans, for implementation by UK-based personnel.
* Assess application control exception and policy exclusion requests and provide risk-based recommendations for governance approval.
* Analyse platform reporting (endpoint coverage and drift, malware trends, email threat trends, application control activity) and produce monthly reports and recommendations.
* Assess the coverage of security log feeds in the client's retained SIEM against the logging design, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to detection use cases.
* Track vendor support lifecycles, identify end-of-support risk and produce upgrade plans.
* Provide platform expertise and forensic-readiness input (runbooks, evidence sources, playbooks) to support the UK SOC and incident response partner.
* Provide advisory support to incident management when requested, including during major incidents.
* Contribute platform content to monthly service reports and maintain platform diagrams and documentation.
* Lead, allocate and quality-review the work of the Network and Identity Security Engineers.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vendor certification in at least one enterprise endpoint/XDR or SIEM platform (e.g. Palo Alto Cortex, Microsoft SC-200, CrowdStrike, IBM QRadar, Splunk).
* GIAC GCIH/GCIA, CompTIA CySA+ or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Strong knowledge of EDR/XDR and anti-malware platforms (e.g. Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trellix).
* Application allowlisting and device control (e.g. Carbon Black App Control, Airlock Digital, WDAC).
* Email security gateways (e.g. Cisco Secure Email, Proofpoint, Mimecast).
* Web application firewall, DDoS and DNS protection services (e.g. F5, Cloudflare, Akamai).
* Understanding of SIEM log onboarding and detection use cases (e.g. QRadar, Splunk, Sentinel).
* Producing secure configuration baselines, design documentation and change packages.
* Incident response lifecycle (NIST SP 800-61) and ITIL change and incident management.
* Scripting and data analysis (PowerShell, Python, KQL, AQL or SPL) for reporting.

Desired skills:

* Digital forensics and forensic-readiness experience (e.g. EnCase, FTK, Magnet AXIOM) and chain-of-custody practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Awareness of OT security constraints.

Experience:

* 10-12 years in security engineering or operations, including 3+ years in a lead role across endpoint, gateway and logging platforms.
* Experience leading and quality-reviewing the work of other engineers.
* Experience supporting managed security services in regulated or CNI environments.

description:
Role Overview

The Desktop Engineer will be responsible for providing technical support and troubleshooting for end-user computing environments. This role involves installation, configuration, and maintenance of operating systems, applications, and hardware. The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving skills, hands-on experience with computer assembly, and the ability to support users with day-to-day IT issues. The role also requires **travel to client locations** for on-site support.

Key Responsibilities

* Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues on desktops and laptops.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (Windows).
* Configure and troubleshoot Microsoft Outlook and other email clients.
* Perform laptop and desktop hardware troubleshooting.
* Assemble and disassemble computers, ensuring proper installation of components.
* Install and configure applications and drivers as required.
* Provide remote and on-site support for end-users.
* Maintain documentation of incidents, solutions, and system configurations.
* Ensure systems are updated with the latest patches and security updates.
* Support peripheral devices (printers, scanners, monitors, docking stations).
* Collaborate with IT teams to escalate and resolve complex issues.

Desired Skills & Qualifications

* Strong knowledge of desktop and laptop hardware components.
* Experience with Windows OS installation and troubleshooting; Linux/macOS knowledge is a plus.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Outlook configuration, and email troubleshooting.
* Basic networking knowledge (Wi-Fi troubleshooting).
* Understanding of IT security practices (antivirus, data backup).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
* Willingness to travel to client sites as required.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**
The purpose of the Data Engineer role is to transform diverse and complex data sources into reliable, accessible, and trusted datasets that support Ferrero’s business, digital, and Data & AI transformation objectives. With a primary focus on North American markets, the role will develop and optimize data pipelines across digital, eCommerce, retail, shopper, and third-party data while supporting the ongoing management of Ferrero’s data lake pipelines. Working with cross-functional data and business teams, the Data Engineer will help establish a strong data foundation for analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**
Build new data pipelines: The Group is implementing new platforms to collect marketing campaigns, global syndicated, eCommerce and Open Innovation R&D data and the Data Engineer will be part of those project teams to understand the full collection cycle. They will then take over responsibility - together with IT partners - to build data pipelines to bring the data into Ferrero IT architecture for modelling and reporting.
  
  
**Support**
A2A, MCP and other technologies that expose data for AI without necessity of ETL pipelines.
  
  
An important part of any new data pipeline or AI-enabling technology will be to automate data quality and business logic implementation and verification. Alignment with AI strategy and architecture, Group masterdata and/or domain data governance will also be required, where relevant.
  
  
**Support data governance initiatives:**
The Data Engineer will be responsible for supporting projects related to the standardization of data.
  
  
**Manage existing pipelines and databases:**
Working in Group tools to manage existing AI data agents, pipelines and databases on retail panel (“sellout”) and consumer surveys. Perform data extractions and / or visualizations as needed by stakeholders.
  
  
**About You:**

* Master’s degree in computer science, Data Management, Information Systems, Information Science or a related quantitative field.
* 4-6 yrs of experience with data engineering responsibilities and tasks.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams and with business stakeholders; strong communication and collaboration skills Strong experience with ETL tools (Microsoft Fabric, Fabric Data Engineering, Databricks, Analysis Services,); SQL database design / architecture / management; and data cataglog technology (Purview). Relevant certifications will constitute a preferential parameter for selection.
* Experience with common AI agents development frameworks and tools (Fabric Data Agents, AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, MCP protocol). Relevant certifications will constitute a preferential parameter for selection.
* Experience with databases and data lake design principles and programming languages including [SQL, PL/SQL, others] for relational databases is required. Knowledge of Python would be a plus.
* Experience with PowerBI for data visualization.
* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, etc), cloud computing platforms (MS Azure) and DevOps.
* Understanding data security and compliance.
* Fluent in English;Other languages and international experience a plus.

**Job Referral Code - B**
**What We Offer:**
Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.
  
  
**About Ferrero:**
Ferrero began its journey in the small town of
**Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946.**
Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many
**iconic brands**
sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.
  
  
**DE&I at Ferrero:**
Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.
  
  
Find out more here.

title: Technical Chief of Staff
description:
**About Castler**

Castler provides compliance-grade trust infrastructure for both money and software. We help enterprises and financial institutions govern mission-critical assets through independent, rules-based escrow frameworks, so that financial flows and software dependencies are not left solely in the hands of a counterparty. Built on bank-grade security standards, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, we are trusted by technology and risk teams across the country. Castler is backed by Flipkart, Capital 2B (an Info Edge fund), Zerodha, IIFL Ventures, and Stride Ventures, and has been recognised at the NASSCOM Fintech Awards, MINT Startup Awards, and IAMAI Digital Awards.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Technical Chief of Staff who works alongside leadership to drive our most important priorities and owns processes end to end, from building on our product tech stack to architecting and optimising our go-to-market motion. This role sits at the intersection of technology, revenue, operations, and execution. Your job is to build scalable systems that turn our Ideal Customer Profile into predictable revenue. It is a hands-on engineering role as much as a strategic one; you will write code and present to leadership in the same week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and orchestrate end-to-end buyer journeys, from ICP identification through to revenue conversion.
* Build and optimise multi-channel GTM experiments using AI tools and platforms.
* Develop data-driven strategies to identify, engage, and convert high-value accounts.
* Build automated workflows and systems that scale revenue operations, integrating GTM tools with our core product and data.
* Partner with the leadership team to drive key projects and strategy initiatives from planning through execution.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimise the full revenue funnel.
* Evaluate and implement new GTM technologies to keep our edge.
* Own daily, weekly, and monthly business reporting so decisions stay data-driven.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and build AI-based solutions to streamline workflows.
* Scope, build, ship, and maintain internal tools, integrations, and automations on our product stack (Node.js, Python, React.js).
* Build AI-powered solutions using OpenAI APIs and Claude Code to accelerate engineering, operations, and GTM.
* Act as the bridge between engineering, product, and business, translating priorities into technical execution.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with exposure to AI-driven operations, automation, and business intelligence.
* Strong working knowledge of our stack: Node.js, Python, React.js, OpenAI APIs, and Claude Code.
* Familiarity with a modern GTM tech stack such as Clay, HubSpot, and Sendspark.
* Hands-on expertise with AI and automation tools, prompt engineering, and building scalable workflows.
* Strong analytical skills and a data-first approach to decisions.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* A background in revenue operations, growth, or similar technical GTM roles is a strong plus.

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid experimentation.
* A data-driven decision maker with creative problem-solving ability.
* Strong business acumen with a focus on cost-effective solutions.
* Able to influence and align stakeholders across functions.
* An engineer at heart with an owner’s mindset, equally comfortable writing code and presenting to leadership.

**Location**

Delhi. This is a 100% work-from-office role.

To apply, use the link below or write to hr@castler.com.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each oneAI and ML Applied to EvaluationApplies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools changeBuilds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose-built analysisExternal RepresentationPresents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research communityTeam building and enablementFosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organizationWillingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding teamOvertime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvementDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.RequirementsEssentials:Relevant professional background: 7-9 years of experience in M&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international developmentRigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research labApplied AI and ML fluency: is already using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work todayCost-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non-technical decision-makerAnalytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified briefProgram collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; title: QA Tester
description:
Job Description: QA Tester – FinTech

**Job Title:** QA Tester / Quality Assurance Engineer  
**Department:** Technology / Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Financial Technology (FinTech)  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Noida  
**Work Mode:** On-site

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Tester to join our technology team and ensure the quality, reliability, security, and performance of our FinTech products. The ideal candidate will have experience in manual and API testing, strong analytical skills, and an understanding of financial transactions, payment systems, and digital banking workflows.

The candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product managers, and other stakeholders to identify defects, validate business requirements, and deliver a seamless and secure user experience.

Key Responsibilities1. Functional and Manual Testing

* Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate web and mobile applications across different browsers, devices, and environments.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Ensure product functionality aligns with business requirements and acceptance criteria.

2. FinTech and Financial Transaction Testing

* Test financial workflows such as fund transfers, payments, refunds, settlements, and transaction reversals.
* Validate transaction statuses, balances, fees, commissions, and applicable limits.
* Verify transaction accuracy, duplicate transaction prevention, and idempotency.
* Test failed, pending, successful, timed-out, and reversed transactions.
* Validate transaction histories, statements, reconciliation reports, and audit trails.
* Test edge cases involving insufficient balances, concurrent transactions, network failures, and partial failures.
* Verify role-based access, maker-checker approvals, and transaction authorization wherever applicable.

3. API Testing

* Perform REST API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Validate request and response payloads, status codes, headers, authentication, and error handling.
* Test API integrations with payment gateways, banking systems, third-party service providers, and internal services.
* Validate data consistency across APIs, databases, and user interfaces.
* Test negative scenarios, boundary conditions, rate limits, retries, and timeout handling.

4. Database Testing

* Write SQL queries to validate data integrity and transaction records.
* Verify database entries against application behavior and API responses.
* Test data consistency, constraints, duplicate records, and transaction updates.
* Validate financial calculations and reconciliation data.

5. Automation Testing

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks, where applicable.
* Automate repetitive functional and regression test cases.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with development teams.
* Analyze test execution results and troubleshoot failures.

6. Security and Performance Testing

* Support testing of authentication, authorization, session management, and access controls.
* Validate sensitive data masking and secure handling of financial information.
* Identify potential security vulnerabilities and coordinate with security teams.
* Assist with performance and load testing for transaction-heavy workflows using tools such as JMeter or similar platforms.

7. Documentation and Collaboration

* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, execution reports, and test evidence.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve defects and improve product quality.
* Provide QA sign-off based on test results, defect severity, and release acceptance criteria.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing.
* Strong knowledge of manual testing concepts and software testing life cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience with test case design, defect lifecycle, and regression testing.
* Experience in API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge.
* Understanding of web applications, client-server architecture, and REST APIs.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in FinTech, digital payments, banking, lending, wallets, or financial services.
* Knowledge of UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, card payments, payment gateways, or similar payment systems, depending on the product.
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or another automation framework.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and performance testing.
* Awareness of PCI DSS, KYC/AML requirements, data privacy, and financial compliance controls, as relevant to the product.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Test coverage of business-critical requirements.
* Defect detection rate and defect leakage to production.
* Test execution efficiency and regression coverage.
* Accuracy of financial transaction validation.
* Timely completion of testing within release timelines.
* Effectiveness and reliability of automated test suites.
* Reduction in recurring production defects.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on innovative FinTech products.
* Collaborative and fast-paced work environment.
* Opportunities for technical learning and professional growth.
* Exposure to financial systems, payment integrations, and modern QA practices.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:** We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered based on their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Pay: Up to ₹500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
