Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
The Opportunity
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  
Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  
Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  
Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  
Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
**Hands-on engineering:** You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  
**Customer empathy:** You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  
**Collaboration and communication:** You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
**Enterprise architecture:** You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  
**Data expertise:** You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  
**AI fluency and continuous learning:** You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  
**Proactive problem solving:** You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.
  
What You Need to Succeed
  
10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
  
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in API testing, automation framework architecture, microservices validation, integration testing, service virtualization, performance, security, and AI-enabled Quality Engineering.
  
  
This is a senior customer-facing technical role responsible for assessing API landscapes, defining testing solutions, building reusable automation approaches, and guiding QA teams through implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the end-to-end API testing architecture and solutioning strategy across enterprise applications.
* Understand business and technical architecture and translate it into a comprehensive API Quality Engineering strategy.
* Define API testing approaches covering functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, negative, security, performance, and resiliency testing.
* Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks for REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and microservices.
* Define automation solutions using tools/frameworks such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman, Python/PyTest, Java, ReadyAPI/SoapUI, or equivalent.
* Architect testing solutions for complex microservices and distributed API ecosystems.
* Define API validation strategies across UI → API → Microservices → Database → Downstream systems.
* Establish contract testing strategies using tools such as Pact and consumer/provider contract validation.
* Define testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous APIs, including Kafka/event-driven architectures and messaging systems.
* Design service virtualization/mocking solutions where dependent APIs or downstream systems are unavailable.
* Define API test data management and synthetic data generation approaches.
* Establish API automation integration with CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and quality gates.
* Define API performance and scalability testing approaches using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, K6, or equivalent.
* Establish API security validation covering authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys, data protection, and common API vulnerabilities.
* Define automation coverage, quality metrics, defect prevention strategies, and release-readiness criteria.
* Review existing QA frameworks and recommend modernization and automation improvements.
* Identify opportunities to use AI/GenAI in API testing, including test scenario generation, test data generation, automation script generation, defect analysis, and test optimization.
* Conduct PoCs and evaluate new QE tools, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted testing solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews, and presentations with customers.
* Mentor QA Leads, SDETs, Automation Engineers, and API Testing teams.

API Solutioning Responsibilities
  
  
The candidate should be capable of independently assessing a customer API landscape and developing a complete testing solution:
  
  
Requirement Analysis → API Landscape Assessment → Risk Identification → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → Implementation → CI/CD Integration → Metrics Continuous Improvement
  
  
**The candidate should be able to answer questions such as:**  

* How should APIs across hundreds of microservices be tested efficiently?
* What should be automated at the API layer versus UI/E2E layer?
* How can API regression execution time be reduced?
* How should dependencies on unavailable downstream services be handled?
* How can contract testing prevent integration defects?
* How should asynchronous APIs and Kafka events be validated?
* How can API automation be integrated into CI/CD quality gates?
* How can AI improve API test design, automation, execution, and defect analysis?

Required Technical Skills
  
  
**Strong hands-on experience with:**  
API Testing Automation
  

* REST API and SOAP Web Services
* REST Assured
* Postman/Newman
* Karate
* SoapUI/ReadyAPI
* Python/PyTest
* Java/TestNG/JUnit
* JSON/XML validation
* OpenAPI/Swagger

API Integration Architecture
  

* REST/SOAP/GraphQL
* Microservices architecture
* API Gateway/API Management
* Kafka/Event-driven architecture
* Messaging systems
* API contracts and schema validation
* Database/backend validation

Advanced Testing
  

* Contract Testing
* Service Virtualization/Mocking
* API Performance Testing
* API Security Testing
* Integration Testing
* Resiliency/Failure Testing
* Test Data Management

DevOps Cloud
  

* Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions
* CI/CD and Continuous Testing
* Docker/Kubernetes fundamentals
* Azure/AWS/GCP exposure
* Git and source-code management

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
  

* GenAI/LLM-assisted test generation
* AI-assisted automation development
* Intelligent test selection
* Synthetic test-data generation
* Defect/root-cause analysis
* GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistants

Architecture Leadership Expectations
  

* Strong experience designing enterprise API automation frameworks from scratch.
* Ability to assess an existing testing ecosystem and propose a target-state QE architecture.
* Strong understanding of automation framework design, reusable components, maintainability, and scalability.
* Ability to conduct technical PoCs and tool/framework evaluations.
* Ability to estimate automation effort, resource requirements, timelines, and implementation roadmap.
* Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical solutions to both engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
* Experience leading multiple QA/Automation teams and providing technical governance.

Experience
  

* 8+ years of overall Quality Engineering/Testing experience.
* 5+ years of strong API testing and automation experience.
* Demonstrated experience in API Test Architecture / Automation Architecture / QE Solutioning.
* Experience leading enterprise-level API testing and automation initiatives.
* Experience working directly with customers on QA transformation, solutioning, architecture, and implementation.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The candidate should be able to demonstrate at least 2–3 large API testing solutions personally architected and implemented, explaining:
  
  
Customer Problem → Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → Automation Architecture → Tool Selection → PoC → CI/CD Integration → Implementation → Coverage Improvement → Business Outcome
  
  
The role requires a hands-on API Test Architect and Solutioning expert, not primarily a QA Project/People Manager. The individual should be capable of designing the solution, defending architecture decisions in front of customers, conducting PoCs when required, and guiding engineering teams through implementation.

description:
**Position Overview:** As our Founding IT Systems, ***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)**

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:** Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:** Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:** Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:** Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

**Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)**

* **Identity & Access Control:** Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:** Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:** Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

**GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)**

* **GPU Environment Isolation:** Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:** Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:** Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:** 3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:** High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:** Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:** Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:** Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

title: DevOps - Tech Lead : Head of Platform Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Head of Platform Engineering**

**Experience:** 9+ Years  
**Location:** Salt Lake, Kolkata  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Head of Platform Engineering to lead the evolution of our global DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure ecosystem at Webskitters.

This is a high-impact leadership position responsible for defining the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of our internal platforms that empower development teams, drive automation, and deliver value across a diverse portfolio of global clients.

As the strategic owner of our cloud platform and delivery framework, you will oversee the creation of scalable, secure, and self-service systems that enable engineering agility, cost efficiency, and consistent quality across all projects. The role requires deep technical expertise in AWS, proven team leadership experience, and strong exposure to service-based delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic & Organisational Leadership**

· Define, implement, and own the enterprise-wide Platform Engineering strategy, ensuring it aligns with organisational goals, delivery models, and long-term technology objectives.

· Lead the transition from traditional DevOps practices to a platform-first engineering culture, built around automation, reliability, and developer empowerment.

· Establish a multi-tenant platform architecture suitable for a global service organisation handling varied client workloads, regulatory needs, and delivery models.

· Develop and maintain a comprehensive technology roadmap, ensuring continuous modernisation of infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD processes.

· Collaborate with the CTO and senior leadership to define cloud governance, budget forecasting, and platform performance objectives.

**Technical Ownership & Architecture**

· Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure on AWS, leveraging advanced services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, VPC, and Route 53.

· Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CloudFormation to ensure consistent and repeatable deployments.

· Lead the design and optimisation of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD, etc.), enabling high-frequency and low-risk software releases.

· Drive the adoption of containerisation and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) to standardise and simplify deployment pipelines across client projects.

· Establish observability and monitoring standards using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or ELK/EFK for real-time visibility and proactive issue management.

· Develop and oversee disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region deployment strategies to ensure resilience and uptime.

· Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to integrate robust access control, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

**Operational Excellence**

· Lead operational governance for cloud environments, ensuring performance, cost optimisation, and SLA adherence.

· Define and monitor service-level objectives (SLOs) and service-level indicators (SLIs) to track availability, latency, and reliability.

· Implement automation strategies to reduce manual dependencies, deployment times, and infrastructure maintenance overhead.

· Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes, driving operational maturity across environments.

· Promote cost visibility and accountability across projects through effective budgeting and monitoring of AWS spend.

**Team Leadership & Management**

· Build and manage a high-performing Platform Engineering team, encompassing DevOps Engineers, Cloud Architects, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), and Automation Specialists.

· Provide hands-on leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to ensure consistent skill development and delivery excellence.

· Develop career progression paths, performance management frameworks, and training initiatives for team growth.

· Foster a collaborative engineering culture across departments, driving alignment between development, QA, and operations.

· Represent the Platform Engineering function in technical reviews, architectural discussions, and executive strategy sessions.

· Proven team management experience is mandatory, with a demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in distributed or hybrid environments.

**Stakeholder & Client Collaboration**

· Partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure platform capabilities align with client delivery requirements and organisational goals.

· Support pre-sales and solutioning efforts by providing architectural inputs, effort estimation, and platform strategy for proposals.

· Communicate platform performance, cloud spend, and reliability metrics to executive leadership and client-facing delivery teams.

· Collaborate with product, security, and quality assurance teams to streamline integration and operational workflows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

· AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional or Associate) – *Mandatory.*

· 12–15 years of total experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.

· Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership or team management capacity.

· Proven track record in a service-based organisation, leading cloud and platform teams across multiple client projects.

o Strong expertise in: AWS Cloud Infrastructure (networking, storage, compute, scaling).

o CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, CodePipeline, or equivalent).

o Container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).

o Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).

o Monitoring and Observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).

· Experience implementing automation for deployment, configuration management, and system scaling.

· Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles, compliance frameworks, and cloud security best practices.

· Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Desirable**

· Additional certifications in Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), DevOps, or Cloud Security.

· Experience working in multi-cloud or hybrid environments.

· Exposure to compliance-driven industries (finance, healthcare, or enterprise IT).

· Experience or certification in Cyber and Data Security will be considered a significant advantage. (e.g., CISSP, CompTIA Security+, or practical exposure to data protection and secure cloud architecture).

**Personal Attributes**

· Strategic yet hands-on approach to leadership and technical decision-making.

· Ability to thrive in a multi-client, service-oriented, and fast-paced environment.

· Natural mentor with the ability to inspire teams and encourage continuous improvement.

· Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.

· Passion for automation, scalability, and security-focused innovation.

· Exceptional communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing both technical and business audiences.

**About Us**

Webskitters Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a globally recognized digital transformation and IT services company with over 15 years of proven industry experience. Headquartered in Kolkata, India, with operational offices in the USA and the UK, we deliver innovative, scalable, and performance-driven technology solutions to clients worldwide.

Our expertise spans Web and Mobile Application Development, eCommerce Solutions, Digital Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, and IoT services, enabling businesses to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen digital presence, and achieve sustainable growth.

As a CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9001:2015 certified organization, we adhere to globally benchmarked quality standards and structured delivery processes to ensure consistent excellence. Backed by award-winning credentials and a highly skilled team, we remain committed to driving measurable business impact through innovation and technology.

title: Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

The Senior Manager, NetSuite Enterprise Applications & Architecture will lead hands-on NetSuite implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform ownership. The role requires strong expertise in NetSuite financials, inventory, procurement, order management, and distribution workflows. The ideal candidate will drive solution design, validate business processes, maintain financial controls, and ensure a scalable, reliable ERP environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

* Participate directly in solution design, configuration, prototyping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Learn and document company's current processes, legacy applications, business rules, controls, data structures, and operational dependencies before replacing or redesigning them.
* Translate business requirements into practical NetSuite designs that favor standard functionality when it meets the business need.
* Review partner-proposed designs, identify gaps and downstream consequences, and challenge recommendations that create avoidable complexity, weak controls, or poor operational outcomes.
* Own material application design decisions and maintain functional architecture, configuration, decision, and support documentation.

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close
* Understand and validate the accounting consequences of transaction design across sales, purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, billing, returns, credits, and adjustments
* Protect subledger-to-general-ledger integrity through reconciliations, conversion validation, controlled posting logic, and clear exception handling.
* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.
* Validate financial reporting outputs and ensure configuration supports accurate, explainable, and repeatable close processes.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.
* Work with process owners to define exceptions, approvals, controls, and measurable acceptance criteria for end-to-end customer transactions.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.
* Support item master design, units of measure, locations, lot traceability, transfers, adjustments, cycle counts, costing, and inventory reconciliation.
* Address food-distribution requirements such as master case and break pack, assemblies, repack, catch weight, lot control, and related accounting flows when applicable.
* Confirm that application design works in the operating environment and does not shift hidden effort or control risk into warehouse, procurement, customer service, or Finance teams.

**Configuration administration and release governance**

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.
* Establish standards for configuration, customization, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, naming, documentation, and environment management.
* Evaluate native functionality before approving extensions and ensure each customization has a clear owner, business purpose, test plan, and support approach.
* Maintain disciplined development, test, sandbox, and production practices with documented change control and release procedures.
* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios covering normal transactions, exceptions, integrations, financial posting, operational handoffs, and reporting.
* Take an active role in conference-room pilots, system and integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, go-live readiness, and hypercare.
* Reject incomplete testing or unresolved defects that could compromise financial integrity, inventory accuracy, customer service, or operational continuity.

**Long term platform ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner and subject-matter expert for the NetSuite application environment.
* Build sufficient internal knowledge to reduce unnecessary dependence on outside consultants while using specialized partners where they add value.
* Maintain current documentation, operating procedures, configuration standards, training materials, and decision history.
* Evaluate new capabilities and enhancements against business value, total cost, control implications, operational impact, and supportability.
* Help establish a scalable ERP operating model that can support organic growth, new operating requirements, and future acquisitions.

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of ERP implementation, enterprise applications, or ERP administration experience, including at least five years of meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Participation in at least one full-cycle NetSuite implementation with direct responsibility for design, configuration, testing, conversion, cutover, or stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of NetSuite financials and core ERP capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, order management, purchasing, and inventory.
* Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, inventory accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and subledger-to-general-ledger integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical, supportable system designs.
* Hands-on experience with roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reporting, master data, data conversion, and test execution.
* Ability to assess operational impacts and work effectively with Finance, procurement, operations, warehouse, customer service, and technology teams.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations using business, accounting, control, data, and operational evidence.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* NetSuite OneWorld experience and relevant NetSuite certifications.
* Food distribution, wholesale distribution, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive industry background.
* Experience with lot-controlled inventory, catch weight, repack, assemblies, drop ship, EDI-enabled transactions, or complex pricing.

Professional Experience

● 10+ years of professional software engineering and system development experience

● Demonstrated experience owning complex, mission-critical enterprise applications or platforms

● Successfully taken projects from architecture and design through production deployment

● Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with varying levels of expertise

Technical Competencies

● Deep knowledge of system design, architecture patterns, and distributed systems

title: AI Engr.
description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**To Apply**

Upload your resume, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note (3-4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for the role. Include one thing you built with AI coding tools and how you checked that it worked.

Pay: From ₹380,000.00 per year

* Node.js: 2 years (Required)

Location:

**Description**
**Job Description:**
**Senior Analyst, Observational Health Data Analytics, Epidemiology - Hyderabad**
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
  
  
Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
  
  
Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine
  
  
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a
**Senior Analyst, Observational Health Data Analytics**
(OHDA) to join our Global Epidemiology team. This role is based in Hyderabad, India and requires regular in-office presence.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst on the OHDA team, you will help generate real-world evidence from large-scale healthcare data to support important scientific and business questions across Johnson & Johnson. This is a hands-on analytics role for someone who enjoys applying epidemiologic and data science methods to observational research. The types of analysis typically performed fall into three major categories: characterization, population-level estimation, and patient-level prediction.
  
  
OHDA collaborates with the broader international research community to establish and promote best practices in the appropriate use of observational data by conducting methodological research, developing standardized analytics tools, and demonstrating successful applications to important clinical questions.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Collaborate with colleagues across OHDA and Global Epidemiology to support observational research and evidence-generation priorities.
* Support the design and delivery of observational analyses for clinical characterization, population-level effect estimation, and patient-level prediction.
* Contribute to study design documents, including protocols and analysis plans, in partnership with scientists and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Execute analyses using standardized tools and statistical programming against internal and external observational healthcare data sources.
* Help evaluate and improve methods, processes, and scientific best practices that support reliable real-world evidence generation.
* Contribute to the development of software and analytical tools that enable scalable, reproducible observational research.
* Support the evaluation and characterization of observational data for fitness-for-use in addressing clinical and epidemiologic questions.
* Provide technical and scientific support for the data and analytics environment used by epidemiologists and product teams.

**Qualifications**

* Education:

+ An MD or PhD with at least 2+ years of epidemiology programming or related research experience is required. OR
+ A Master’s degree in Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Health Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, Public Health, Informatics, Computer Science, or a related discipline with at least 4+ years of epidemiology or related research experience in healthcare is required.

* Required experience and skills:

+ At least 2 years of experience in statistical programming using R and/or database programming using SQL.
+ At least 1 year of experience programming against large healthcare datasets, such as claims or electronic health records.
+ At least 1 year of relevant experience in the healthcare industry, including pharmaceutical, payer, provider, health system, CRO, or related research settings.
+ Experience managing and analyzing administrative claims data and/or electronic health or medical record data.
+ Experience analyzing and interpreting quantitative data.
+ Experience contributing to epidemiology study documents, including protocols and study reports.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills.
+ Fluency in English.
+ Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally, as needed.

* Preferred qualifications:

+ Experience supporting epidemiology or real-world evidence research.
+ Experience with OHDSI and/or the OMOP Common Data Model.
+ Knowledge of medical terminologies such as ICD, NDC, SNOMED, MedDRA, LOINC, and CPT.
+ Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as R Shiny and ggplot2.
+ Experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostics, or related healthcare research environments.
+ A track record of scientific communication, including publications, posters, presentations, or technical reports.
+ Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics or intelligent automation concepts relevant to data science and research workflows.

description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

This role is a key element of our newly established Fincrime Intelligence and Reporting function. You'll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through reporting potentially suspicious activity to authorities and taking measures to disrupt criminals. You'll have opportunities to be involved in wider Financial Crime projects which will help reduce risk to Tide and let our members get back to doing what they love.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As an Investigative Reporting Analyst you'll be:

* Achieve and maintain formal accreditation to carry out specific responsibilities on behalf of Tide's Nominated Officer, including collating and evaluating internal reports for inclusion within reports to Law Enforcement and ensuring the accuracy and quality of external reports
* Collating information and writing comprehensive reports relating to all types of financial crime for inclusion within notifications to Law Enforcement Agencies, including SAR submissions
* Supporting in complex, proactive investigations by ensuring we report the right information at the right time to external partners
* Providing assurance by reviewing the outcomes and decisions of cases, determining whether the correct case outcome was achieved and correctly documented
* Providing feedback, leading workshops and training sessions
* Confident in calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes, making recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud/financial crime offences
* Managing your own case load to meet performance targets
* Consistently reaching the targets for Productivity and Quality
* Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
* Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

Here at Tide, we are looking for a proactively minded Investigative Reporting Analyst with a good understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime typologies and prevention measures. We need a passionate and proactive individual, who will help ensure Tide is taking all the relevant steps to report and enforce against all aspects of financial crime. The ideal candidate will have:

* 1 to 3 years of experience in a financial crime investigations, compliance or QA related role in financial services, specialising in business-related anti-money laundering/fraud investigations
* Ability to work well as part of a team; decisive; goal-oriented; proactive
* Strong stakeholder management skills and comfortable communicating with a wide range of associates
* A proactive and open-minded approach to finding effective solutions
* A genuinely curious mindset, asking the right questions at the right times, with a problem solving attitude
* A keen eye for process improvements, looking at how we can work leaner and more robustly
* Exceptional communication skills – written and verbal – and are able to communicate with our members, internal stakeholders & regulatory bodies if required

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**

* 25 days paid annual leave
* 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
* Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
* Personal L&D budget
* Additional health & dental insurance
* Mental wellbeing platform
* Food vouchers
* Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
* WFH equipment allowance

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.*

**Disclaimer**

*It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:*

* *Tide does* ***not*** *charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.*
* *All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our* ***Careers Page*** *and applications should be submitted through this channel.*
* *Communication from Tide will only come from an official* ***@tide******.co*** *email address.*
* *Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.*

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at* *talent@tide.co*  
*Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

  

*Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our* *AI Policy**.*

*Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* *Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

title: Finance System Integration Analyst
description:
**About Skyspecs:**

  

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Systems Integration Analyst to support the implementation and ongoing operation of the Horizon Finance platform. This role will help coordinate integrations between outsourced service providers (OSPs), client accounting systems, and internal reporting platforms.

Working closely with the Portfolio Manager for Integrations, the successful candidate will support data onboarding, monitor integration progress, troubleshoot data issues, and help ensure financial data is accurately uploaded and processed within Horizon Finance.

The role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, and requires strong analytical, communication, and organisational skills.

**As a Finance Systems Integration Analyst, you will:**

* Assist with onboarding new outsourced service providers (OSPs) to the Horizon Finance platform.
* Coordinate the collection of financial data from external accounting systems.
* Support the mapping of charts of accounts between OSP systems and the Horizon Finance structure.
* Review uploaded financial data for completeness and accuracy.

**Data Management & Validation:**

* Assist in preparing and transforming financial datasets for upload into Horizon Finance.
* Perform quality checks on uploaded accounting data and bank statement files.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or formatting issues.
* Maintain documentation of data structures, mappings, and integration processes.

**Operational Coordination:**

* Act as a point of contact for OSP integration queries and follow up on outstanding data requests.
* Track integration progress across multiple funds and service providers.
* Maintain integration timelines and task lists.
* Assist in organising training sessions and guidance materials for OSP users.

**Reporting & Analysis:**

* Support reconciliation and validation of financial information within the platform.
* Assist in monitoring integration performance and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
* Prepare internal updates on integration progress and key issues.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Help identify opportunities to streamline data ingestion and automation processes.
* Assist in testing new system features and enhancements within Horizon Finance.
* Support the development of best practices for financial and operational data integration.

**Requirements of the job:**

* 1–3 years of experience in finance operations, data analysis, or financial systems integration.
* Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple integration processes and data onboarding timelines simultaneously.
* Solid analytical skills with experience in data mapping, reconciliation, and troubleshooting financial data discrepancies.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Strong attention to detail and high accuracy in data entry
* Basic understanding of accounting principles or management accounts
* Solid comprehension of financial data structures and reporting
* Experience or interest in financial systems integration and technology

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Senior Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
Job Description

**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

The Senior Customer Success Data Analyst owns how Customer Success uses data to improve adoption, retention, drive expansion and decide where CSMs focus.

You will own the CS analytics strategy, metric framework, customer health score and churn-prediction approach, and act as the analytics partner to the Head of CS Operations and CS leadership. As the team is new, you will design how data from various platforms, databases and raw Excel dumps in Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk and product telemetry comes together, and set the standard for how we use analytics and AI across Customer Success.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

**CS analytics strategy**

* Own the CS analytics roadmap with the Head of CS Operations, prioritizing work by impact on retention and growth.
* Act as the trusted analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping decisions on segmentation, coverage models and customer playbooks.
* Present insights to CS leadership and contribute to board-level reporting.

**Customer health and churn prediction**

* Own the customer health score methodology end to end — design, validation against actual renewal and churn outcomes, and regular recalibration.
* Build predictive churn and propensity models (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis) and turn them into early-warning signals CSMs can act on.
* Compare retention and outcomes across customer groups (industry, region, account segments, products, sign-up period) to uncover what drives churn and growth.
* Lead root-cause analysis of churn and downsell.

**Metrics, dashboards and reporting**

* Define and govern the CS metric framework and a single source of truth so CS, Sales, Finance and Product report the same numbers and details.
* Own reporting on core CS KRAs — Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR/NRR), other renewal and growth details, time-to-value, adoption and health distribution.
* Oversee dashboards in Excel, presentations and Power BI for CS leadership and CSMs.
* Lead data and meeting preparation for internal monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and leadership/board reporting.

**Product usage, renewals and expansion**

* Partner with Product and Engineering to model product telemetry for adoption and value-realization metrics.
* Own risk-weighted renewal forecasting, so leadership sees a realistic outlook and CSMs know which renewals need attention.
* Analyze feature adoption, usage depth and breadth, and onboarding milestones to identify at-risk and high-potential accounts.
* Build models that identify upsell and cross-sell signals from usage, license utilization, account health and intelligence, and share them with CSMs.
* Measure the impact of CS programs and plays on retention and expansion revenue.

**Data foundations**

* Set data-quality and governance standards for CRM and CS-platform data, and drive fixes with system owners
* Design the CS data model and integrations across Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk, internal deployment tools and product data.
* Document metrics, data sources and processes so analytics can scale with the team.

**AI-enabled analytics**

* Use LLMs such as Claude hands-on to accelerate building modules, analysis of data, querying data, documentation and insight generation.
* Design and roll out AI-assisted workflows and agents for CS — e.g. account summaries, sentiment analysis, renewal-risk briefs etc.
* Set guidelines for responsible, secure use of AI with customer data, in line with Seclore's data-protection standards.

**Your first 90 days:**

First 30 days

* Understand our customers, products and CS motion; assess data sources across various tools like Salesforce, Statisfy, product telemetry etc.
* Deliver a gap assessment of data quality.
* Deliver a baseline view of retention and renewals.

By 60 days

* Get the CS metric definition and framework agreed across CS and Finance.
* Launch the first version of CS leadership dashboard.
* Present the health-score framework and churn-model design.

By 90 days

* Launch V1 of the health score.
* Deliver a risk-weighted renewal forecast framework to CSMs for regular use.
* Publish a prioritized CS analytics roadmap.

**How we will measure impact over time:** Predictive accuracy of the health score and churn models, use of insights in leadership and CSM decisions, data-quality improvements in CRM/CS platforms, and measurable contribution to GRR, NRR and adoption.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, with at least 2–3 years in customer success, revenue or business operations analytics, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Proven track record of building customer health scores or churn models end to end and getting them adopted by CS teams.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python for data wrangling, statistical analysis and predictive modeling (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis).
* Expert-level dashboard building in Power BI and Excel.
* Deep experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) data — accounts, opportunities, renewals.
* Hands-on experience administering or configuring a customer success platform such as Statisfy, Gainsight, Totango or ChurnZero.
* Experience designing data models and working with data from multiple systems and raw sources.

Complete the Microsoft Form.

title: Analyst - Advanced Analytics, GIC SC Analytics
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

In this role, the Analyst key responsibilities involve leveraging data science to solve supply chain challenges. This includes data analysis, model development (descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive), and scenario planning. Focus on improving modeling efficiency through automation. Finally, under supervision of project leads manage projects to deliver timely and impactful solutions. This role requires to operate in 1.30pm to 10.30 pm shift.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* Translate supply chain business objectives into analytical scope, assess data feasibility, and define success criteria.
* Cleanse and explore data to identify trends and root causes, then develop statistical, optimization, or machine learning models under guidance.
* Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to present information in a structured and understandable manner.
Drive process automation, identify opportunities to automate workflows and eliminate redundant tasks  

  

**Domain Expertise**

* **Plan** : Supply and production planning; capacity, demand, and inventory planning; make-versus-buy decisions; service-level optimization and cost trade-offs.
* **Source** : Procurement process optimization; cost-saving and efficiency opportunities; financial, geopolitical, and environmental, social, and governance risk assessment; supplier sustainability and carbon-footprint tracking.
* **MakE** : Manufacturing performance improvement and waste reduction; failure-mode analysis; anomaly detection; predictive maintenance; root-cause analysis; predictive and prescriptive downtime reduction.
* **Network** : Network design and distribution; facility location; greenfield and brownfield analysis; transportation and logistics planning; route optimization; cross-docking; push, pull, and postponement replenishment strategies.
* **End-to-End & Operating Unit** : Understanding of the Plan, Make, Source, and Deliver pillars; ability to connect cross-functional priorities; holistic solution mindset; awareness of key supply chain metrics, including service, cost of goods sold, and waste.

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree from accredited university (Full Time) in Business Analytics, engineering, statistics or a related quantitative field.

  

**Experience:** 2+ years of related experience in Supply chain analytics

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Knowledge of statistical modeling, optimization
* Proficiency in Excel Macros and PowerPoint, leveraging advanced functions for data analysis, visualization, and effective business storytelling
Python, Dash or similar visualization tools, SQL, and cloud platforms such as BigQuery (nice to have)  

  

**Soft Skills:** Self-driven, adaptable, accountable, and comfortable collaborating across functions and locations.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Post graduation in Industrial Engineering, statistics or Supply Chain operations
* Professional Certifications for supply chain and Data science

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: External Reporting Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in External Reporting. You have found the right team.

As an analyst within the External Reporting function, you oversee financial statement and management reporting activities while maintaining a sound control environment. You understand and apply appropriate accounting treatments and support compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements. You coordinate quarterly regulatory requirements and ensure accurate and complete data submission to regulators. You validate balance sheet items and understand balance sheet usage and reporting.

Job responsibilities

* Apply up-to-date product, industry, and market knowledge in specialty reporting areas.
* Consolidate, review, and analyze quarterly financial data for accuracy and completeness, including quarter-over-quarter variance analytics.
* Coordinate data collection and quarterly business results with various lines of business and reporting teams, including Regulatory Controllers and Securities and Exchange Commission reporting teams.
* Assess issues and outcomes thoroughly and support appropriate follow-up.
* Clearly communicate financial information to lines of business and flag potential issues.
* Produce, review, and file monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual regulatory reports used by regulators to compile statistics on domestic and international portfolio positions.
* Follow proof and control procedures to ensure accurate reconciliation across regulatory filings, Securities and Exchange Commission filings, and other published financial reports (e.g., Form 10-Q, Annual Report/Form 10-K, Call Report, FR Y-9C, Pillar III).
* Perform control procedures and edit checks to support the integrity of reported financial results.
* Ensure accurate and complete data submission to regulators.
* Interpret and define regulatory and Securities and Exchange Commission requirements and coordinate internal and external policies.
* Build and manage relationships with lines of business and external regulatory agency constituents through ongoing partnership and dialogue, and participate in data quality and external reporting improvement efforts.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* 1 years of experience in a Finance organization with exposure to accounting, financial statements, and/or regulatory reporting.
* Strong time management, problem solving, and written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively across diverse functions, locations, and businesses.
* Proficiency in Excel and standard computer applications.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Experience in Product Control or Financial Control, or knowledge of Securities and Exchange Commission reporting and regulatory reporting.
* Project management experience or skills.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s.
